ProductId.description_en: Business ID to which the instance belongs. You can obtain it in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details"

DisplayList.description_cn: 屏幕 ID 列表。若将该参数置空则对表示所有屏幕进行暂停或恢复推流。
DisplayList.description_en: Screen ID list. If this parameter is left empty, it will pause or resume streaming for all screens.

Mute.description_cn:
暂停/恢复推流。
- true：暂停推流。
- false：恢复推流。
Mute.description_en:
Pause/Resume streaming
- true: Pause streaming
- false: Resume streaming

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。
PodId.description_en: Instance ID, which can be obtained by calling the `ListPod` API.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The business ID to which the instance belongs. You can find it in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。
PodId.description_en: Instance ID, obtainable by calling the `ListPod` API.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The business ID to which the instance belongs can be obtained in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

PodId.description_cn:
实例 ID，若仅需对**单个**实例执行关机操作，请使用该参数。
> 批量操作实例关机，请使用 `PodIdList` 参数。

PodIdList.description_cn:
实例 ID 列表，若需对**多个**实例批量执行关机操作，请使用该参数。支持批量操作的实例数上限为 200。
> 对单个实例执行关机操作，请使用`PodId` 参数。

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID。

PodId.description_cn:
实例 ID，若仅需对**单个**实例执行开机操作，请使用该参数。
> 批量操作实例开机，请使用 `PodIdList` 参数。
PodId.description_en:
Instance ID. To start up **a single** instance, use this parameter.
> To start up instances in batch, use the `PodIdList` parameter.

PodIdList.description_cn:
实例 ID 列表，若需对**多个**实例批量执行开机操作，请使用该参数。支持批量操作的实例数上限为 200。
> 对单个实例执行开机操作，请使用`PodId` 参数。
PodIdList.description_en:
Instance ID list. To start up **multiple** instances in batch, use this parameter. The maximum number of instances supported for batch operations is 200.
> To start up a single instance, use the `PodId` parameter.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID to which the instance belongs.

FilePath.description_cn:
实例中待下载文件的路径或文件名，支持从以下路径下载文件：

- /sdcard/
	
- /data/misc/logd/ + 日志文件名/
FilePath.description_en:
Path or file name of the file to be downloaded in the instance. Supports downloading files from the following paths:

- /sdcard/
	
- /data/misc/logd/ + log file name/

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。
PodId.description_en: Instance ID, obtainable by calling the `ListPod` API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, available in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

Region.description_en: Object storage service region.

TosBucket.description_cn: 火山引擎对象存储中的存储桶名称。
TosBucket.description_en: Name of the bucket in Volcengine Object Storage.

TosFilePath.description_cn:
存储桶下保存文件的完整路径，包括文件名，并且指定的路径必须存在（不能以 / 开头），例如：`cloudphone/screen_record/record.mp4`

> 说明：当下载文件夹时，会将文件夹以 .zip 文件的格式下载，`TosFilePath` 也要指定为以 .zip 文件格式结尾。
TosFilePath.description_en:
Full path to the file saved under the bucket, including the file name. The specified path must exist and cannot start with /. For example: `cloudphone/screen_record/record.mp4`

> Note: When downloading a folder, the folder will be downloaded as a .zip file. `TosFilePath` must also end with the .zip file format.

AutoUnzip.description_cn:
是否自动解压推送的压缩文件：

- 0：推送 zip 文件后，自动解压文件（默认）；
- 1：推送 zip 文件后，不自动解压文件。
AutoUnzip.description_en:
Whether to automatically unzip the pushed compressed file:

- 0: Automatically unzip the file after pushing a zip file (default)
- 1: Do not automatically unzip the file after pushing a zip file.

DownloadUrl.description_cn:
从下载链接推送文件到云手机实例。
> 与 TOS 上传二选一，如果 `TosBucket` 为空则此参数生效。
DownloadUrl.description_en:
Push files from a download link to cloud phone instances.
> Choose either TOS upload or download link. If `TosBucket` is empty, this parameter takes effect.

Endpoint.description_cn: （TosBucket 填写时，必填）对象存储服务地址，例如：`tos-cn-beijing.volces.com`。
Endpoint.description_en: (Required when TosBucket is specified) Object storage service address, for example: `tos-cn-beijing.volces.com`.

FileName.description_cn:
推送文件的文件名：

- 如果通过下载链接（DownloadUrl）推送文件，则必填；
	
- 如果通过火山引擎对象存储（TOS）推送文件，则非必填。

> 说明：如重复上传同名文件，已有文件将被覆盖。
FileName.description_en:
File name to push:

- Required if pushing via download link (DownloadUrl)
- Optional if pushing via Volcano Engine Object Storage (TOS)

> Note: If you upload a file with the same name repeatedly, the existing file will be overwritten.

PodIdList.description_cn: 需要推送文件的实例 ID 列表，长度上限为 200。
PodIdList.description_en: List of instance IDs to push files to. Maximum length is 200.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, which can be obtained in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details".

Region.description_cn: （TosBucket 填写时，必填）对象存储服务区域，例如：`cn-beijing`。
Region.description_en: (Required when TosBucket is specified) Object storage service region, for example: `cn-beijing`.

TargetDirectory.description_cn:
推送文件至云手机实例中的目标路径（不包括文件名），支持的目标路径包括以下目录：

- /sdcard/
	
- /data/local/
TargetDirectory.description_en:
Target path in the cloud phone instance to push the file to (excluding the file name). Supported target directories include:

- /sdcard/
- /data/local/

TosBucket.description_cn:
从对象存储推送文件到云手机实例，指定保存源文件的火山引擎对象存储中的存储桶名称，例如：`test-bucket`。

> 说明：与 `DownloadUrl` 二选一，如果 `TosBucket` 填写，则会忽略 `DownloadUrl` 参数。
TosBucket.description_en:
Push files from object storage to cloud phone instances. Specify the bucket name in Volcano Engine Object Storage where the source file is saved, for example: `test-bucket`.

> Note: Choose either `DownloadUrl` or `TosBucket`. If `TosBucket` is specified, the `DownloadUrl` parameter will be ignored.

TosFilePath.description_cn: （TosBucket 填写时，必填）存储桶下的目录或文件名称（不能以 / 开头），正确示例：`cloudphone/gameApk/my_photo.jpg`。
TosFilePath.description_en: (Required when TosBucket is specified) Directory or file name under the bucket (cannot start with /). Correct example: `cloudphone/gameApk/my_photo.jpg`.

Force.description_cn:
是否强制重启。取值如下：

- `true`：（默认）不会将云机实例主动关机。
- `false`：会将云机实例强制重启。
Force.description_en:
Force reboot. Possible values:

- `true`: (default) The cloud instance will be rebooted directly without being shut down first.
- `false`: The cloud instance will be forcibly shut down before rebooting.

HostIdList.description_cn: 云机 ID 列表。可通过调用 [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) 接口获取。
HostIdList.description_en: Cloud instance ID list. You can obtain it by calling the [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID。可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID. You can find it in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

PodId.description_cn:
实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。指定该参数时，仅对单个实例执行重启操作。
> 与 `PodIdList` 二选一。
PodId.description_en:
Instance ID, which can be obtained by calling the `ListPod` API. When this parameter is specified, only a single instance will be restarted.
> Choose either `PodId` or `PodIdList`.

PodIdList.description_cn:
实例 ID 列表，指定该参数时，对多个实例批量执行重启操作。支持批量操作的实例数上限为100。
> 与 `PodId` 二选一。
PodIdList.description_en:
Instance ID list. When this parameter is specified, multiple instances will be restarted in batch. The maximum number of instances supported for batch operation is 100.
> Choose either `PodId` or `PodIdList`.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The business ID to which the instance belongs. You can obtain it in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

ResourcePolicy.description_cn:
重启实例时设置的 IP 资源策略：

- Persist：保持亲和性调度策略。
	
- NonPersist：进行非亲和性调度策略。
ResourcePolicy.description_en:
IP resource policy set when restarting the instance:

- Persist: Use affinity scheduling policy
	
- NonPersist: Use non-affinity scheduling policy

PreOrderList.description_cn: 并发实例资源续订配置列表。
PreOrderList.description_en: Concurrent instance resource renewal configuration list.

PreOrderList.HostId.description_cn: 云机id, 资源组id和云机id对于节点售卖方式可以二选一
PreOrderList.HostId.description_en: For the node selling method, use either the cloud instance ID or the resource group ID

PreOrderList.Term.description_cn: 订购资源的租期：- 预付费模式：租期数，单位：月 - 后付费模式：0
PreOrderList.Term.description_en:
Resource rental period:
- Prepaid mode: number of rental periods (months)
- Postpaid mode: 0

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID。您可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID. You can find it in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

RoundId.description_cn:
订购请求的唯一标识。

防止由于网络等原因造成重复请求，同一 `RoundId` 在 1 天内只可使用一次。
RoundId.description_en:
Unique identifier for the order request.

To prevent duplicate requests caused by network issues, the same `RoundId` can only be used once within 1 day.

HostIdList.description_cn: 云机 ID 列表。可通过调用 [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) 接口获取。
HostIdList.description_en: Cloud host ID list. You can obtain it by calling the [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID。可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID. You can find it in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

DataSize.description_cn:
重置后，单个实例预期占用的存储容量大小，取值范围为 1Gi～128Gi，且必须为整数。请结合实际业务情况按需填写。
* 如不指定，则默认保持和重置前大小一致。
* 如需保留系统分区或预安装应用（即 `SystemDirPersistedType` 设为 1 或 2，或 `PreInstallAppPersistedType` 设为 1 时），则本参数不可更新。
* 本参数仅适用于云盘存储业务，本地存储业务无需关注。
DataSize.description_en:
After reset, specify the expected storage capacity for a single instance. The value must be an integer between 1Gi and 128Gi. Please fill in as needed according to your actual business situation.
* If not specified, the size will remain the same as before the reset.
* If you need to retain the system partition or pre-installed applications (that is, when `SystemDirPersistedType` is set to 1 or 2, or `PreInstallAppPersistedType` is set to 1), this parameter cannot be updated.
* This parameter applies only to cloud disk storage. Local storage does not require attention.

PhoneTemplateId.description_cn: 机型库 ID。如果传入该参数，重置实例时将会使用当前指定的机型库。
PhoneTemplateId.description_en: Model library ID. If you provide this parameter, the currently specified model library will be used when resetting the instance.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。对多个实例批量执行重置操作，支持的最大实例数量为 100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. You can batch reset multiple instances; up to 100 instances are supported.

PreInstallAppPersistedType.description_cn:
预安装应用保留策略：

* `0`：（默认值）清除预安装应用及相关数据；
* `1`：保留预安装应用，仅清理相关数据。

该参数不能与 `SystemDirPersistedType` 同时设置。
PreInstallAppPersistedType.description_en:
Pre-installed App Retention Policy:

* `0`: (Default) Remove pre-installed apps and related data
* `1`: Retain pre-installed apps, clear only related data

This parameter cannot be set at the same time as `SystemDirPersistedType`.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, can be obtained from Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details

ResetType.description_cn:
实例重置操作方式。取值如下：

* `0`：（默认值）全部重置，清除实例属性；
* `1`：保留实例属性。
ResetType.description_en:
Instance reset operation mode. Available values:

* `0`: (default value) Reset all and clear instance properties
* `1`: Retain instance properties

SystemDirPersistedType.description_cn:
系统目录分区保留策略。
执行 remount 操作将应用或文件存储至 /system、/vendor 或 /odm 系统目录后，可使用该参数指定重置实例时对系统目录的处理：

* `0`：（默认值）实例重置时，清除该实例中全部应用和数据；
* `1`：实例重置时，保留系统目录内的应用和数据，清除系统目录外的全部应用和数据；
* `2`：实例重置时，保留系统目录外的应用和数据，清除系统目录内的全部应用和数据。

1. remount 功能默认关闭，请联系技术支持开启。
2. 该参数不能与 `PreInstallAppPersistedType` 同时设置。
3. 该参数需配合 2024 年 5 月 16 日及之后发布的公共镜像版本使用。
SystemDirPersistedType.description_en:
System directory partition retention policy
After performing a remount operation to store applications or files in the /system, /vendor, or /odm system directories, you can use this parameter to specify how system directories are handled when resetting an instance:

* `0` (default): When the instance is reset, all applications and data in the instance are cleared
* `1`: When the instance is reset, applications and data inside the system directories are retained, while all applications and data outside the system directories are cleared
* `2`: When the instance is reset, applications and data outside the system directories are retained, while all applications and data inside the system directories are cleared

1. The remount feature is disabled by default. Please contact technical support to enable it
2. This parameter cannot be set together with `PreInstallAppPersistedType`
3. This parameter must be used with public image versions released on or after May 16, 2024

ForceReboot.description_cn:
是否在变更机型参数后强制重启实例使配置立即生效，取值：

* `true`：（默认值）变更后立即重启实例。
* `false`：变更后不重启实例。
ForceReboot.description_en:
Whether to force reboot the instance after changing the phone model parameters to apply the configuration immediately. Values:

* `true`: (default) Reboot the instance immediately after the change
* `false`: Do not reboot the instance after the change

PhoneTemplateIdList.description_cn: 目标机型库的 ID 列表，实例重启后将变更为对应机型。当前仅支持传入 1 个机型库 ID，您可以通过调用 [ListPhoneTemplate](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1905403) 接口获取。
PhoneTemplateIdList.description_en: List of target phone template library IDs. After the instance restarts, it will switch to the corresponding phone model. Currently, only one phone template library ID is supported. You can obtain it by calling the [ListPhoneTemplate](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1905403) API.

PodIdList.description_cn: 需要更换机型参数的云手机实例 ID 列表，您可以通过调用 [ListPod](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6394/2304643) 接口获取。列表长度上限为 100。
PodIdList.description_en: List of cloud phone instance IDs whose phone model parameters need to be changed. You can obtain them by calling the [ListPod](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6394/2304643) API. The maximum list length is 100.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。您可以登录 [云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to manage cloud phone resources and identify cloud phone business. You can log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from the created business resources.

CreatePodNum.description_cn:
基于备份数据自动创建实例的数量，所创建的实例规格与备份数据的源实例规格一致，且创建后的实例为开机状态。请确认对应业务下有足够的云机资源可供创建实例。

* 最大数量为100。
* 与 PodIdList 二选一传值。
CreatePodNum.description_en:
Automatically create the number of instances specified in the backup data. The specifications of the created instances will match those of the source instance, and the instances will be powered on. Please ensure there are enough cloud resources available for instance creation under the relevant business.

* Maximum number: 100
* Either this parameter or PodIdList must be provided

PodIdList.description_cn:
实例 ID 列表，用于指定想要恢复数据的实例。

* 最大长度为100。
* 不支持跨云机规格、Android 系统版本、区域恢复数据。
* 指定实例的存储空间需要大于备份数据的原始大小。
* 与 CreatePodNum 二选一传值。
PodIdList.description_en:
Instance ID list used to specify the instances for data recovery

* Maximum length is 100
* Data recovery across cloud machine specifications, Android system versions, or regions is not supported
* The storage space of the specified instance must be greater than the original size of the backup data
* Either this parameter or CreatePodNum must be provided

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要恢复数据的实例所在业务。可登录云手机控制台，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to specify the business containing the instance you want to recover data for. Log in to the Cloud Phone Console and obtain it from an existing business entry.

RestoreMode.description_cn:
恢复模式。如果是开机状态的实例，可选择恢复模式：

* `0`：（默认值）先关机实例，再进行恢复，恢复完成后会自动开机。
* `1`：开机状态下直接恢复实例，选择该模式表明了解并确认开机操作存在一定风险。

如果是关机状态的实例，则无需传入该参数，实例会在关机状态下直接进行恢复，恢复完成后实例仍处于关机状态。
RestoreMode.description_en:
Recovery mode
If the instance is powered on, you can choose a recovery mode:

* `0` (default): Shut down the instance first, then recover it. The instance will automatically start after recovery
* `1`: Recover the instance directly while it is powered on. Selecting this mode means you understand and confirm the potential risks of recovering while powered on

If the instance is powered off, you do not need to specify this parameter. The instance will be recovered while powered off and will remain powered off after recovery

PodIdList.description_cn:
待还原的实例 ID 列表，多个实例 ID 请以英文逗号 "," 分隔。最多支持传入 100 个实例 ID。
1. 请确保传入的全部实例皆处于“备份完成”状态。
2. 本参数与 `SpecifyHostList` 参数必须至少择一填写，具体规则如下：
	- 若无需指定云机还原，请使用本参数传入实例 ID 列表；
	- 若需要指定云机还原，请使用 `SpecifyHostList` 传入实例 ID 列表；
	- 若本参数与 `SpecifyHostList` 中的 `PodIdList` 参数均传值，为保证还原任务的成功执行，请务必确保两组列表中的实例 ID 完全不重叠。
PodIdList.description_en:
List of instance IDs to be restored. For multiple instance IDs, separate them with English commas ",". Up to 100 instance IDs are supported.
1. Make sure all specified instances are in the "Backup Completed" status.
2. You must fill in either this parameter or the `SpecifyHostList` parameter. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If you do not need to specify cloud host restoration, use this parameter to provide the list of instance IDs.
	- If you need to specify cloud host restoration, use `SpecifyHostList` to provide the list of instance IDs.
	- If both this parameter and the `PodIdList` parameter in `SpecifyHostList` are provided, to ensure successful restoration, ensure that the instance IDs in both lists do not overlap.

ProductId.description_cn: 待还原实例所归属的业务 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID associated with the instance to be restored

SpecifyHostList.description_cn: 云机列表，用于指定云手机实例还原到的目标云机。当 `PodIdList` 为空时，本参数必填。
SpecifyHostList.description_en: Cloud machine list, used to specify the target cloud machine for restoring a cloud phone instance. This parameter is required when `PodIdList` is empty.

SpecifyHostList.HostId.description_cn:
实例还原的目标云机。
目标云机上可运行的实例规格需与待还原实例规格保持一致，可通过 [`DetailHost`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221481) 接口返回的 `ConfigurationCode` 参数判断。
SpecifyHostList.HostId.description_en:
Target cloud machine for instance restoration
The instance specifications that can run on the target cloud machine must match those of the instance to be restored. You can check this using the `ConfigurationCode` parameter returned by the [`DetailHost`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221481) API.

SpecifyHostList.PodIdList.description_cn:
待还原的实例 ID 列表，多个实例 ID 请以英文逗号 "," 分隔。
待还原的实例数量不得超过目标云机剩余的可创建实例数量，可通过 [`DetailHost`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221481) 接口返回的 `PodNumAvailable` 和 `PodNumOnHost` 参数判断余量。
SpecifyHostList.PodIdList.description_en:
List of instance IDs to restore. Separate multiple instance IDs with an English comma ","
The number of instances to restore must not exceed the remaining available instance quota on the target cloud machine. You can determine the remaining quota using the [`DetailHost`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221481) API and the `PodNumAvailable` and `PodNumOnHost` parameters

Command.description_cn: 待执行的命令，支持的最大长度为 1024 字节。
Command.description_en: Command to be executed. Maximum supported length is 1024 bytes.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，对多个实例批量执行命令操作时，支持的最大实例数量为 100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. When executing commands in batches on multiple instances, the maximum supported number of instances is 100.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID to which the instance belongs. You can obtain it in "Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details".

TimeoutSeconds.description_cn: 异步命令执行的超时时长，单位为 s，默认值为 300，取值范围为 [0,21600]。
TimeoutSeconds.description_en: Timeout duration for asynchronous command execution, in seconds. Default is 300. Value range: [0,21600].

Command.description_cn: 待执行的命令，支持的最大长度为 1024 字节。
Command.description_en: Command to be executed. The maximum supported length is 1024 bytes.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，对多个实例批量执行命令操作时，支持的最大实例数量为 100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. When executing commands in batches on multiple instances, the maximum supported number of instances is 100.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID to which the instance belongs. You can find it in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

PodIdList.description_cn: 需要设置代理的实例 ID 列表，可通过调用 ListPod 接口获取。列表长度上限为 100。
PodIdList.description_en: List of instance IDs to set proxy for. You can obtain this list by calling the ListPod API. Maximum list length is 100.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, which can be obtained in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'

ProxyConfig.description_cn: 代理配置键值对。具体参看 [ProxyConfig 字段说明](#proxyconfig-字段说明)。
ProxyConfig.description_en: Proxy configuration key-value pairs. See [ProxyConfig field description](#proxyconfig-字段说明) for details.

ProxyStatus.description_cn:
是否开启代理：

- 1：开启；

- 0：关闭。

ClientCertificate.description_cn: 客户端生成的自签证书
ClientCertificate.description_en: Self-signed certificate generated by the client

PodId.description_cn: PodId
PodId.description_en: PodId

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, available in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'

DurationLimit.description_cn:
设置最大录屏时长，单位：秒。
支持设置的最大值为 14400，即 4 小时。
DurationLimit.description_en:
Set the maximum recording duration in seconds.
The maximum supported value is 14400, which is 4 hours.

IsSavedOnPod.description_cn:
是否保存录屏文件在云手机实例：

* true：上传录屏文件到火山引擎对象存储，并保存录屏文件在云手机实例中；
* false：默认值，上传录屏文件到火山引擎对象存储，上传完成后，删除保存在云手机实例中的文件。
IsSavedOnPod.description_en:
Whether to save the recording file on the cloud phone instance:

* true: Upload the recording file to Volcengine Object Storage and also save the recording file on the cloud phone instance
* false: Default value. Upload the recording file to Volcengine Object Storage, and delete the file from the cloud phone instance after upload is complete

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。
PodId.description_en: Instance ID. You can obtain it by calling the `ListPod` API.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所属业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID of the instance. You can find it in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

RoundId.description_cn:
录屏请求的唯一标识。
为避免由于网络等原因造成重复请求，同一 `RoundId` 在 5 分钟内只可使用一次。
RoundId.description_en:
Unique identifier for the recording request.
To avoid duplicate requests due to network issues, the same `RoundId` can only be used once within 5 minutes.

DurationLimit.description_cn:
截图操作持续的最大时长，仅在需要启用周期性实例截图时设置本参数。
单位为毫秒，取值范围为 100 到 43,200,000（即 12 小时），默认值为 1,000。
单次截图无需设置本参数。
DurationLimit.description_en:
Maximum duration for screenshot operations. Set this parameter only when enabling periodic instance screenshots
Unit: milliseconds. Valid range: 100 to 43,200,000 (12 hours). Default: 1,000
No need to set this parameter for single screenshots

FileType.description_cn: 截图文件的格式，可选值包括 `jpg`、`jpeg`、`png`，默认值为 `jpeg`。
FileType.description_en: Screenshot file format. Available options: `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`. Default: `jpeg`.

Interval.description_cn:
两次自动截图操作之间的时间间隔，仅在需要启用周期性实例截图时设置本参数。
单位为毫秒，取值范围为100 到 43,200,000（即 12 小时），默认值为 1,000。
单次截图无需设置本参数。
Interval.description_en:
Interval between two automatic screenshot operations. Set this parameter only when you need to enable periodic instance screenshots.
Unit: milliseconds. Valid range: 100 to 43,200,000 (12 hours). Default: 1,000.
You do not need to set this parameter for single screenshots.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，用于指定想要截图的实例 ID 列表。最大长度为100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list used to specify the instances you want to take screenshots of. Maximum length is 100

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要截图的实例所在业务。可登录云[手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP/Business/5)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to specify the business where the instance you want to screenshot is located. Log in to the cloud [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP/Business/5) and obtain it from an existing business entry.

Quality.description_cn: 截图图片质量，取值范围为 [1, 100]，默认值为 100。

Rotation.description_cn:
截图画面是否做旋转处理，包含以下取值：

* 0：默认值，截图不做旋转处理，即维持原有画面方向； 
* 1：截图画面旋转为竖屏。手机竖屏的截图，不做处理；手机横屏的截图，截图顺时针旋转 90 度。
Rotation.description_en:
Whether to apply rotation processing to the screenshot image; possible values:

* 0: Default value. The screenshot is not rotated and keeps its original orientation.
* 1: The screenshot is rotated to portrait mode. If the phone screenshot is already in portrait mode, no change is made; if the phone screenshot is in landscape mode, the screenshot is rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

RoundId.description_cn:
截图请求的唯一标识。
为避免由于网络等原因造成重复请求，同一 `RoundId` 在 5 分钟内只可使用一次。
RoundId.description_en:
Unique identifier for the screenshot request.
To prevent duplicate requests due to network issues, the same `RoundId` can only be used once within 5 minutes.

Scale.description_cn: 截图图片同比缩放的比率，取值范围为 [0.1, 1.0]，默认值为 1.0。
Scale.description_en: Scaling ratio for screenshot images; valid range: [0.1, 1.0], default value: 1.0

TosInfo.description_cn: 对象存储服务相关信息，当选择上传截图文件至私有存储桶，即 `UploadType` 设置为 2 时，本参数必填。
TosInfo.description_en: Object storage service information. This parameter is required when you choose to upload screenshot files to a private storage bucket (that is, when UploadType is set to 2).

TosInfo.Bucket.description_cn: 火山引擎对象存储中的存储桶名称。
TosInfo.Bucket.description_en: Bucket Name in Volcengine Object Storage

UploadType.description_cn:
上传截图文件的方式，包含以下取值：

* 1：默认值，上传截图文件至云手机的对象存储桶中。您需要确保已参考本文**使用说明**，为云手机业务配置了对象存储服务；
* 2：上传至火山引擎账号下的私有存储桶中。设为该值前，需先自行开通[火山引擎对象存储](https://www.volcengine.com/product/TOS)服务，后参考[开通火山引擎对象存储访问权限](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/671880#%E5%BC%80%E9%80%9A%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90)文档，授权云手机访问账号下对象存储的权限。

上传至私有存储桶适用于对截图隐私性有要求的业务场景，但需承担对象存储服务费用，请结合实际业务需求选择是否开通。
UploadType.description_en:
Screenshot file upload methods include the following options:

* 1: Default value. Upload screenshot files to the object storage bucket of the cloud phone. Make sure you have configured object storage service for your cloud phone business as described in the **Usage Instructions**.
* 2: Upload to a private object storage bucket under your Volcengine account. Before setting this value, you must first activate the [Volcengine Object Storage](https://www.volcengine.com/product/TOS) service, then refer to the [Enable Volcengine Object Storage Access Permissions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/671880#%E5%BC%80%E9%80%9A%E7%81%AB%E5%B1%B1%E5%BC%95%E6%93%8E%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90) documentation to authorize cloud phone access to the object storage under your account.

Uploading to a private storage bucket is suitable for business scenarios requiring screenshot privacy, but you will incur object storage service fees. Please decide whether to enable this feature according to your business needs.

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。
PodId.description_en: Instance ID, which can be obtained by calling the `ListPod` API

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所属业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID to which the instance belongs, available in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，用于指定想要停止截图的实例 ID 列表。最大长度为100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list, used to specify the instance ID list you want to stop screenshotting. Maximum length is 100

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要截图的实例所在业务。可登录云[手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP/Business/5)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to specify the business that contains the instance you want to screenshot. Log in to the cloud console at [https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP/Business/5] and obtain it from an existing business tile.

AutoRenew.description_cn:
是否开启自动续费。取值如下：

- `true`：开启自动续费。
- `false`：（默认）不开启自动续费。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Enable auto-renewal. Values:

- `true`: Enable auto-renewal
- `false`: (default) Do not enable auto-renewal

PreOrderList.ApplyNum.description_cn: 本次订购期望增加的数量。对于云盘存储方案，本参数指实例资源；对于本地存储方案，本参数指云机资源。
PreOrderList.ApplyNum.description_en: The quantity expected to be increased for this order For the cloud disk storage solution, this parameter refers to instance resources; for the local storage solution, it refers to cloud server resources

PreOrderList.AutoCreatePod.description_cn:
是否自动创建实例，取值如下：

- `true`：是
- `false`：（默认）否
PreOrderList.AutoCreatePod.description_en:
Whether to automatically create an instance. Possible values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: (default) No

PreOrderList.ConfigurationCode.description_cn:
云机上运行的实例资源规格 ID，取值如下：

- `ultimate`：旗舰型
- `enhanced`：加强型
- `common`：通用型
- `sample`：入门型
- `basic`：基础型
- `elementary`：低配型
- `ultimatePlus`：旗舰型Plus
- `enhancedPlus`：加强型Plus
- `commonPlus`：通用型Plus
- `samplePlus`：入门型Plus
- `basicPlus`：基础型Plus
- `elementaryPlus`：低配型Plus

对于本地存储方案，除上述 12 种规格外，还包含以下 6 种规格：
- `ultimatePro`：旗舰型Pro
- `enhancedPro`：加强型Pro
- `commonPro`：通用型Pro
- `samplePro`：入门型Pro
- `basicPro`：基础型Pro
- `elementaryPro`：低配型Pro
PreOrderList.ConfigurationCode.description_en:
Instance resource specification IDs for cloud machines. Possible values:

- `ultimate`: Ultimate
- `enhanced`: Enhanced
- `common`: General Purpose
- `sample`: Entry Level
- `basic`: Basic
- `elementary`: Low Spec
- `ultimatePlus`: Ultimate Plus
- `enhancedPlus`: Enhanced Plus
- `commonPlus`: General Purpose Plus
- `samplePlus`: Entry Level Plus
- `basicPlus`: Basic Plus
- `elementaryPlus`: Low Spec Plus

For local storage solutions, in addition to the 12 specifications above, the following 6 specifications are also available:
- `ultimatePro`: Ultimate Pro
- `enhancedPro`: Enhanced Pro
- `commonPro`: General Purpose Pro
- `samplePro`: Entry Level Pro
- `basicPro`: Basic Pro
- `elementaryPro`: Low Spec Pro

PreOrderList.Dc.description_cn:
实例所属机房。如果指定，则在订购指定机房中的实例。
`Dc` 和 `Region` 至少需要指定一个值，`Dc` 优先级高于 `Region`。
PreOrderList.Dc.description_en:
Data center where the instance is located. If specified, the instance will be created in the selected data center.
At least one of `Dc` or `Region` must be specified. `Dc` takes precedence over `Region`.

PreOrderList.DisplayLayoutId.description_cn:
屏幕布局，全局屏幕配置；可通过调用 [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495) 接口获取；可选的系统屏幕布局 ID 包括：

- `single-display-landscape`
- `single-display-portrait`
- `single-display-portrait-720p`
- 如未指定屏幕布局 ID，当运行资源套餐 `ConfigurationCode` 为入门型 `sample` ，云手机实例将会使用 720P 和 30fps 的默认配置。
- 该参数适用于本地存储方案，云盘存储无需关注。
PreOrderList.DisplayLayoutId.description_en:
Screen layout and global screen configuration. You can obtain this information by calling the [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495) API. Available system screen layout IDs include:

- `single-display-landscape`
- `single-display-portrait`
- `single-display-portrait-720p`
- If you do not specify a screen layout ID and the resource package `ConfigurationCode` is set to the entry-level `sample`, the cloud phone instance will use the default configuration of 720P and 30fps.
- This parameter applies to local storage solutions; no need to pay attention to this parameter for cloud disk storage.

PreOrderList.ImageId.description_cn: 自定义镜像 ID，如不指定，则默认使用平台提供的官方标准镜像。
PreOrderList.ImageId.description_en: Custom image ID. If not specified, the platform's official standard image is used by default

PreOrderList.ProjectName.description_cn: 用户选择关联的火山项目名称，可选，默认为default项目
PreOrderList.ProjectName.description_en: User selects the associated Volcano project name (optional, defaults to the "default" project)

PreOrderList.Region.description_cn:
实例所属机房所在的大区 ID。如果指定，则在指定大区内随机分配机房进行实例订购。
- 当资源所在区域选择中国大陆，即 `VolcRegion` 设置为 `inner` 时，该参数可选值包含：
	- `cn-north`：华北
	- `cn-south`：华南
	- `cn-east`：华东
	- `cn-middle`：华中
	- `cn-southwest`：西南
- 当资源所在区域选择中国香港，即 `VolcRegion` 设置为 `cn-hongkong-pop` 时，该参数可选值为 `cn-hongkong-pop`。
`Dc` 和 `Region` 至少需要指定一个值，`Dc` 优先级高于 `Region`。
PreOrderList.Region.description_en:
Region ID of the data center where the instance is located. If specified, a data center within the selected region will be randomly assigned for instance ordering
- If the resource region is Mainland China (that is, `VolcRegion` is set to `inner`), valid values for this parameter include:
	- `cn-north`: North China
	- `cn-south`: South China
	- `cn-east`: East China
	- `cn-middle`: Central China
	- `cn-southwest`: Southwest China
- If the resource region is Hong Kong (that is, `VolcRegion` is set to `cn-hongkong-pop`), the valid value for this parameter is `cn-hongkong-pop`
You must specify at least one of `Dc` or `Region`. `Dc` takes precedence over `Region`.

PreOrderList.ServerTypeCode.description_cn:
云机规格。包含以下取值：
- `g2.8c12g`：8vCPU｜12G内存｜128G存储
- `g2.8c16g.basic`：8vCPU｜16G内存｜128G存储
- `g2.8c16g.plus`：8vCPU｜16G内存｜256G存储

可调用 [ListConfiguration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262346) 接口查询。
> 该参数适用于本地存储方案，云盘存储无需关注。
PreOrderList.ServerTypeCode.description_en:
Cloud machine specifications. Available options:
- `g2.8c12g`: 8 vCPU | 12 GB memory | 128 GB storage
- `g2.8c16g.basic`: 8 vCPU | 16 GB memory | 128 GB storage
- `g2.8c16g.plus`: 8 vCPU | 16 GB memory | 256 GB storage

You can query using the [ListConfiguration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262346) API.
> This parameter is not relevant for cloud disk storage; it applies only to local storage solutions.

PreOrderList.Tags.description_cn: 用户选择关联的火山自定义标签，可选
PreOrderList.Tags.description_en: User selects the associated Volcano custom tag (optional)

PreOrderList.Term.description_cn: 订购实例的租期，单位为月，默认值为 1。例如：“1.10 - 2.10” 为 1 个月租期。
PreOrderList.Term.description_en: Rental period for ordered instances, measured in months; default is 1. For example, “1.10 - 2.10” represents a 1-month rental period.

PreOrderList.VolcRegion.description_cn:
资源所在的物理区域，包含以下选项：
- `inner`：中国大陆（默认值）
- `cn-hongkong-pop`：中国香港
PreOrderList.VolcRegion.description_en:
Physical region of the resource. Available options:
- `inner`: Mainland China (default)
- `cn-hongkong-pop`: Hong Kong, China

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID。您可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID. You can find it in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

RoundId.description_cn:
订购请求的唯一标识。您可根据自身业务需求，自定义设置订购请求的唯一标识。

防止由于网络等原因造成重复请求，同一 `RoundId` 在 1 天内只可使用一次。
RoundId.description_en:
Unique identifier for the order request. You can customize the unique identifier for the order request based on your business needs.

To prevent duplicate requests due to network issues, the same `RoundId` can only be used once within 1 day.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。支持同时指定多个实例 ID，多个实例 ID 之间请使用英文逗号`,`分隔，最多可指定 100 个。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. You can specify multiple instance IDs at the same time. Separate multiple instance IDs with a comma (','). Up to 100 instance IDs can be specified.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。可登录 [云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID. Used to manage cloud phone resources and operations. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from an existing business resource card.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。可通过调用 [ListPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) 接口获取。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. You can obtain instance IDs by calling the [ListPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) API.

PortMappingRuleIdList.description_cn: 端口映射规则 ID 列表，需确保规则 ID 全局唯一；可通过调用 [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) 接口获取。
PortMappingRuleIdList.description_en: Port mapping rule ID list. Make sure each rule ID is globally unique. You can obtain rule IDs by calling the [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) API.

ProductId.description_cn: 云手机业务 ID，可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Cloud phone business ID. You can find it in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

AppId.description_cn: 应用 ID，可通过调用 `ListApp` 接口获取。
AppId.description_en: App ID, which can be obtained by calling the `ListApp` API.

PodIdList.description_cn: 指定实例 ID 列表进行应用卸载。单次接口调用最多支持对 1000 个实例进行应用卸载。
PodIdList.description_en: Specify a list of instance IDs to uninstall the app. Each API call supports uninstalling the app from up to 1000 instances.

ProductId.description_cn:
业务 ID。
如不指定 `PodIdList` 及 `TagIdList`，则对业务下所有实例进行应用卸载。
ProductId.description_en:
Business ID
If `PodIdList` and `TagIdList` are not specified, the app will be uninstalled from all instances under the business.

TagIdList.description_cn: 指定标签 ID 列表进行应用卸载。

Force.description_cn:
是否允许强制退订。取值如下：

- `false`：（默认）不允许强制退订。
- `true`：允许强制退订。

节点资源存在实例时依然可以退订，并主动删除相关实例数据。
Force.description_en:
Whether to allow forced unsubscription. The values are:

- `false`: (Default) Forced unsubscription is not allowed
- `true`: Forced unsubscription is allowed

You can still unsubscribe when node resources have instances, and related instance data will be actively deleted.

HostIdList.description_cn: 云机 ID 列表。可通过 [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) 接口获取。
HostIdList.description_en: Cloud phone ID list. You can obtain it via the [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) API.

AppMode.description_cn:
修改应用生效范围。调用 [UploadApp](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262199) 时设置的应用可安装范围可通过该参数进行修改。

AppMode.description_en:
Edit the app installation scope. The installation scope set when calling [UploadApp](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262199) can be modified with this parameter.
Currently, only Private apps can be changed to Public apps, meaning non-shared apps can be modified to apps shared across multiple businesses under the account. If no changes are needed, leave this parameter empty.

ProxyCipher.description_cn:
新的代理加密算法。当 `ProxyProtocol` 为 ss 时，此项为必填；对于 SOCKS5 协议，此项无需填写。您选择的加密算法必须与 Shadowsocks 服务端配置完全一致。支持的算法列表如下：
- aes-128-gcm
- aes-192-gcm
- aes-256-gcm
- chacha20-ietf-poly1305
- xchacha20-ietf-poly1305
- aes-128-cfb
- aes-192-cfb
- aes-256-cfb
- aes-128-ctr
- aes-192-ctr
- aes-256-ctr
- rc4-md5
- chacha20
- chacha20-ietf
- xchacha20
ProxyCipher.description_en:
New proxy encryption algorithm. Required when `ProxyProtocol` is set to ss; not needed for the SOCKS5 protocol. The encryption algorithm you select must match the Shadowsocks server configuration exactly. Supported algorithms:
- aes-128-gcm
- aes-192-gcm
- aes-256-gcm
- chacha20-ietf-poly1305
- xchacha20-ietf-poly1305
- aes-128-cfb
- aes-192-cfb
- aes-256-cfb
- aes-128-ctr
- aes-192-ctr
- aes-256-ctr
- rc4-md5
- chacha20
- chacha20-ietf
- xchacha20

ProxyPassword.description_cn:
新的代理认证密码。
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 ss 时必填，请提供与您 Shadowsocks 服务端配置一致的连接密码；
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 socks5 时选填，如果您的 SOCKS5 服务器启用了用户名/密码认证，请在此处填写密码。为保障服务安全，我们**强烈建议**您为 SOCKS5 服务启用并配置认证。
ProxyPassword.description_en:
New proxy authentication password
- Required when `ProxyProtocol` is set to ss. Please enter the connection password that matches your Shadowsocks server configuration
- Optional when `ProxyProtocol` is set to socks5. If your SOCKS5 server uses username/password authentication, enter the password here. To ensure service security, we strongly recommend enabling and configuring authentication for SOCKS5.

ProxyProtocol.description_cn:
新的代理协议类型。当前支持以下协议：
- ss：Shadowsocks 协议。
- socks5：SOCKS5 协议。
ProxyProtocol.description_en:
New proxy protocol types. Currently supports the following protocols:
- ss: Shadowsocks protocol
- socks5: SOCKS5 protocol

ProxyUserName.description_cn:
新的代理认证用户名。
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 ss 时必填，请提供与您 Shadowsocks 服务端配置一致的认证用户名；
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 socks5 时选填，如果您的 SOCKS5 服务器启用了用户名/密码认证，请在此处填写用户名。为保障服务安全，我们**强烈建议**您为 SOCKS5 服务启用并配置认证。
ProxyUserName.description_en:
New proxy authentication username
- Required when `ProxyProtocol` is set to ss. Enter the authentication username that matches your Shadowsocks server configuration
- Optional when `ProxyProtocol` is set to socks5. If your SOCKS5 server uses username/password authentication, enter the username here. To ensure the security of your service, we strongly recommend enabling and configuring authentication for your SOCKS5 service

DNSId.description_cn: DNS 规则 ID，可通过调用 ListDNSRule 接口获取。
DNSId.description_en: DNS rule ID. You can obtain it by calling the ListDNSRule API.

DNSId.description_cn:
自定义 DNS 规则 ID，已调用 [CreateDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351364) 接口创建自定义 DNS 解析规则后，可使用本参数为实例关联或更新 DNS 规则。
可选的 DNS 规则 ID 可通过 [ListDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351360) 接口查询。
DNSId.description_en:
Custom DNS rule ID. After calling the [CreateDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351364) API to create a custom DNS resolution rule, you can use this parameter to associate or update the DNS rule for the instance.
Available DNS rule IDs can be queried via the [ListDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351360) API.

DataSize.description_cn: 为单个目标实例重新分配存储容量，**仅适用于云盘存储业务**。取值范围为 1Gi～256Gi。请结合实际业务情况，按需填写存储大小
DataSize.description_en: Reallocate storage capacity for a single target instance. **Only applicable to cloud disk storage services**. Value range: 1Gi–256Gi. Please fill in the storage size as needed based on your actual business requirements

DisplayLayoutId.description_cn:
屏幕布局 ID，用于指定想要使用的屏幕显示配置。
您可以选择系统提供的屏幕布局，也可以使用通过 [CreateDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262191) 接口创建的自定义屏幕布局。 - 若使用**系统屏幕布局**，可选项包括： - `single-display-landscape`：1080p 横屏，分辨率 1920\*1080 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 60fps； - `single-display-portrait`：1080p 竖屏，分辨率 1080\*1920 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 60fps； - `single-display-portrait-720p`：高清竖屏，分辨率 720\*1080 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 30fps。 - 若使用**自定义屏幕布局**，可选项可通过 [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495) 接口获取。
DisplayLayoutId.description_en:
Screen layout ID, used to specify the desired screen display configuration.
You can choose a system-provided screen layout or use a custom screen layout created via the [CreateDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262191) API. - If you use a **system screen layout**, available options include: - `single-display-landscape`: 1080p landscape, resolution 1920*1080 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 60fps - `single-display-portrait`: 1080p portrait, resolution 1080*1920 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 60fps - `single-display-portrait-720p`: HD portrait, resolution 720*1080 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 30fps - If you use a **custom screen layout**, available options can be obtained via the [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495) API.

DownBandwidthLimit.description_cn: 实例下行带宽上限，单位为 Mbps；如设置为 0，则不限速。
DownBandwidthLimit.description_en: Instance downstream bandwidth limit, in Mbps. If set to 0, there is no speed limit.

Force.description_cn:
是否可在开机状态下强制更新实例镜像，取值如下：

- `true`：可强制执行更新（会触发实例重启）
	
- `false`：（默认）不可强制执行更新
Force.description_en:
Can you force update the instance image while it is powered on? Values:

- `true`: Force update is allowed (will trigger instance restart).

- `false`: (default) Force update is not allowed.

IPWhiteList.description_cn: - 支持配置白名单IP，对白名单IP不限速。同时对pod访问的其他IP进行整体限速,','分割
IPWhiteList.description_en: - Supports configuring allowlist IPs. Allowlist IPs are not subject to speed limits. All other IPs accessed by the pod are subject to overall speed limits. Separate IPs with ','.

ImageId.description_cn:
镜像 ID，用于指定想要使用的新镜像。可选镜像 ID 可通过 [ListImage](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1328782) 接口获取。

- 默认情况下，更新镜像前需将云手机实例关机，新的镜像将在实例下次启动时生效。如需在实例开机状态下更新镜像，请将 `Force` 参数设置为 `true`，更新完成后实例将自动重启。

- 更新会引起实例重启。
- 仅支持从低版本镜像升级为高版本镜像。
ImageId.description_en:
Image ID, used to specify the new image you want to use. Available image IDs can be obtained via the [ListImage](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1328782) API.

- By default, you must shut down the cloud phone instance before updating the image. The new image will take effect the next time the instance starts. To update the image while the instance is powered on, set the `Force` parameter to `true`. After the update, the instance will automatically restart.

- Updating will cause the instance to restart.
- Only supports upgrading from a lower version image to a higher version image.

IsSelinuxOn.description_cn: 实例是否开启Selinux,开机实例强制更新后需要重启或关机再开机才能生效;开机实例非强制更新情况下会报错
IsSelinuxOn.description_en: Whether Selinux is enabled for the instance: After a forced update on a running instance, you must restart or shut down and then restart the instance for changes to take effect; if the update is not forced while the instance is running, an error will occur

PodId.description_cn:
实例 ID，指定该参数时，仅更新单个实例的属性信息。

与 `PodIdList`、`TagId` 、`Dc` 参数，必须填一个。
PodId.description_en:
Instance ID. When you specify this parameter, only the properties of a single instance are updated.

You must specify one of this parameter, `PodIdList`, `TagId`, or `Dc`.

PodIdList.description_cn:
实例 ID 列表，若需对**多个**实例批量执行更新操作，请使用该参数。支持批量操作的实例数上限为 200。
> 对单个实例执行更新操作，请使用`PodId` 参数。
PodIdList.description_en:
Instance ID list. To batch update **multiple** instances, use this parameter. The maximum number of instances for batch operations is 200.
> To update a single instance, use the `PodId` parameter.

PodName.description_cn: 自定义实例名称，如不指定，则默认为实例 ID。
PodName.description_en: Custom instance name. If not specified, defaults to the instance ID.

PortMappingRuleIdList.description_cn: 端口映射规则 ID 列表。

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID to which the instance belongs.

UpBandwidthLimit.description_cn: 实例上行带宽上限，单位为 Mbps；如设置为 0，则不限速。
UpBandwidthLimit.description_en: Instance upstream bandwidth limit, in Mbps. If set to 0, there is no speed limit.

PhoneTemplateId.description_cn: 机型库 ID。可通过该参数更新实例所用的机型库。可选的机型库列表可通过 **ListPhoneTemplate** 接口获取。
PhoneTemplateId.description_en: Model library ID. Use this parameter to update the model library for the instance. You can get the list of available model libraries through the **ListPhoneTemplate** API.

实例 ID，可通过调用 [ListPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1556117) 接口获取。
若仅需更新**单个**实例的属性，请使用该参数。
批量操作实例更新属性，请使用 `PodIdList` 参数。

To update the properties of a **single** instance, use this parameter.
To update properties for multiple instances in batch, use the `PodIdList` parameter.

PodSettings.SettingsValue.example_en: If there is a capitalization inconsistency between the source text and the glossary (for example, the source text uses initial capitalization while the glossary term is in lowercase), you MUST align the initial capitalization of the translated term with the source text (that is, capitalize the initial letter of the glossary term to match the source text's capitalization style). The following list specifies that when encountering an original word contained in the BlackList, you should not translate the original word into any of the translations listed in the BlackList. The following list specifies that when encountering an original word contained in the WhiteList, you should preferably use the corresponding translation provided in the WhiteList. You must adjust the singular and plural forms of the term to keep the singular and plural consistency between the original text and the translation. ## Style Prefer short, active sentences; avoid passive voice where possible. Omit trailing periods for buttons/labels. Use title case for English buttons/menus; sentence case for messages. Follow local conventions for dates, numbers, and units. Avoid slang, idioms hard to localize, or culture-specific jokes. Ensure terminology consistency across the app You must ensure that the symbols, digits, and special characters in the source texts are preserved. You must ensure that the translation matches the capitalization style (e.g., title case, all caps, lowercase) of the source text.

PodSettings.SettingsValueType.description_en:

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The business ID associated with the instance can be found in the cloud phone console under Business Management > Business Details

- `enhanced`：加强型
- `common`：通用型
- `sample`：入门型
- `basic`：基础型
- `elementary`：低配型

- `elementaryPro`: Elementary Pro

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The business ID to which the instance belongs. You can obtain it in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details".

ResourceSetId.description_cn:
实例资源组 ID：
- 如指定，则优先级大于 ConfigurationCode 和 Dc
- 如不指定，则 ConfigurationCode 和 Dc 必填，由 ConfigurationCode + Dc 确定 ResourceSetId
ResourceSetId.description_en:
Instance resource group ID:
- If specified, it takes priority over ConfigurationCode and Dc
- If not specified, ConfigurationCode and Dc are required, and ResourceSetId is determined by ConfigurationCode + Dc

ApplyDataSize.description_cn: 修改后，需订购的存储资源总容量，单位 GB。修改后的存储容量不能小于已使用的存储容量。
ApplyDataSize.description_en: After modification, the total storage resource capacity to be ordered, in GB. The modified storage capacity cannot be less than the storage capacity already used.

ProductId.description_cn: 实例所归属的业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The business ID to which the instance belongs can be obtained in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

VolcRegion.description_cn:
资源所在的物理区域，包含以下选项：

- inner：中国大陆（默认值）
- cn-hongkong-pop：中国香港
VolcRegion.description_en:
The physical region where the resource is located. Options include:

- inner: Chinese mainland (default)
- cn-hongkong-pop: Hong Kong, China

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, can be obtained in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details"

TagId.description_cn: 标签 ID，可通过调用 `ListTag` 接口获取。
TagId.description_en: Tag ID, can be obtained by calling the `ListTag` API

AppId.description_cn:
应用 ID。
如不指定，则自动生成；如指定，需保证应用 ID 在账号下唯一。
AppId.description_en:
App ID
If not specified, it will be generated automatically; if specified, the app ID must be unique within the account

AppMode.description_cn:
应用可安装范围：
- `Public`：应用设为共享模式，允许在同一个账户下不同业务的实例中安装；
- `Private`：默认设置，应用设为非共享模式，仅允许在某一业务的实例中安装。
AppMode.description_en:
App installation scope:
- `Public`: App is set to shared mode, allowing installation on instances of different businesses under the same account
- `Private`: Default setting, app is set to non-shared mode, allowing installation only on instances of a specific business

AppName.description_cn: 应用名称，如不填写，则默认返回空值。
AppName.description_en: App name. If not provided, the default is an empty value

AppType.description_en:
App type:

- `0`: Other

- `1`: Video

- `2`: Game

- `3`: Productivity

- `4`: Office

DownloadUrl.description_cn: 应用下载 URL 地址。

ExtraInfo.description_cn: 应用信息，参考以下 [AppUploadExtra](#appuploadextra) 数据结构说明。
ExtraInfo.description_en: App information, refer to the [AppUploadExtra](#appuploadextra) data structure description below

ParseFlag.description_cn:
应用文件解析类型：

- `0`，解析；前向兼容，默认解析并且转存到火山引擎对象存储
	
- `1`，不解析，透传地址，不转存到火山引擎对象存储
ParseFlag.description_en:
App file parsing type:

- `0`: Parse; forward compatible, default is to parse and store in Volcengine Object Storage

- `1`: Do not parse, direct address passthrough, do not store in Volcengine Object Storage

ProductId.description_cn:
应用上传的目标业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
若指定 AppMode 为 Private，则该参数必填。
ProductId.description_en:
Target business ID for app upload, can be obtained in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details"
If AppMode is set to Private, this parameter is required

Rotation.description_cn:
应用的横竖屏：

- `0`：竖屏
	
- `270`：横屏

Sign.description_cn:
是否给应用增加系统签名：
- `true`：增加；
- `false`：默认设置，不增加。
> 注意：
> 1. 非系统应用不支持增加系统签名；
> 2. `ParseFlag` 为 0 时该字段无效；
> 3. 开启 `apkserver` 的业务该字段无效。
Sign.description_en:
Whether to add a system signature to the app:
- `true`: Add
- `false`: Default setting, do not add
> Note:
> 1. Non-system apps do not support adding a system signature
> 2. This field is invalid when `ParseFlag` is 0
> 3. This field is invalid for services with `apkserver` enabled

UploadType.description_cn: 上传方式，目前仅支持设为 0，即 HTTP 下载地址。
UploadType.description_en: Upload method. Currently, only 0 is supported, which means HTTP download URL

AccessMode.description_cn: 接入形式，默认为 1，暂不支持其他值。
AccessMode.description_en: Access type defaults to 1; other values are not supported for now

AllSSLCipher.description_cn:
加密套件启用方式，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时需要设置，默认全部启用。
- 0：自定义启用，此时需要填写加密套件名称
- 1：全部启用
AllSSLCipher.description_en:
Encryption suite enablement method: required when selecting HTTPS protocol type; all suites enabled by default
- 0: Custom enablement—enter encryption suite name
- 1: Enable all

BackUpStatus.description_cn:
主备源站启用状态，默认启用主源站。
- 0：即启用主源站组，不启用备源站组。
- 1：即启用备源站组，不启用主源站组。
BackUpStatus.description_en:
Primary and backup origin group activation status. By default, the primary origin group is enabled
- 0: Enables the primary origin group and disables the backup origin group
- 1: Enables the backup origin group and disables the primary origin group

ChunkMode.description_cn:
是否启用 Chunked 编码。开启后，对源站响应启用分块传输编码，允许在接收数据时逐块处理，提升数据传输速度。默认关闭。
- 1：开启
- 2：关闭
ChunkMode.description_en:
Enable chunked encoding. When enabled, applies chunked transfer encoding to origin server responses, allowing data to be processed in chunks as it is received and improving transfer speed. Default is disabled
- 1: Enable
- 2: Disable

ClientMaxBodySize.description_cn: 可接受客户端请求正文的最大值。默认为 60 MB，支持配置 1～10240 MB。
ClientMaxBodySize.description_en: Maximum client request body size. Default is 60 MB; configurable from 1 to 10240 MB

DefIp.description_cn: 高防 IP 地址，可通过实例列表获取。支持填写多个高防 IP。
DefIp.description_en: DDoS-protected IP address, which can be obtained from the instance list. You can enter multiple DDoS-protected IP addresses

GzipMode.description_cn:
是否启用 Gzip 压缩。开启后，可以通过压缩算法对源站响应数据进行压缩，减少传输数据量，节约带宽。默认关闭。
- 1：开启
- 2：关闭
GzipMode.description_en:
Enable Gzip compression?
When enabled, the origin server's response data is compressed to reduce data transfer and save bandwidth. Default is disabled.
- 1: Enable
- 2: Disable

Host.description_en: Protected Domains

Http2.description_cn:
是否开启 HTTP 2.0 协议接入防护，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时可以设置。默认关闭。
- 0：关闭
- 1：开启
Http2.description_en:
Whether to enable HTTP 2.0 protocol access protection. You can set this when HTTPS protocol type is selected. Default is off.
- 0: Off
- 1: On

KeepAliveRequests.description_cn: 复用长连接请求数。默认为 100 个，支持配置 60 ～ 1000 个。
KeepAliveRequests.description_en: Number of reused long connection requests. Default is 100; you can configure it from 60 to 1000

KeepAliveTimeOut.description_cn: 长连接保持时间。默认为 75 秒，支持配置 0 ～ 900 秒。
KeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Long connection keep-alive duration. Default is 75 seconds, configurable from 0 to 900 seconds.

LBAlgorithm.description_cn:
负载均衡算法类型，默认为加权轮询（wrr)。
- wrr：加权轮询
- wlc：加权最小连接数
- sh：源地址哈希
LBAlgorithm.description_en:
Load balancing algorithm type. Default is weighted round robin (wrr).
- wrr: Weighted Round Robin
- wlc: Weighted Least Connections
- sh: Source Address Hash

ProtoFollow.description_cn:
是否开启协议跟随，同时选择 HTTP 和 HTTPS 协议类型时可以设置。默认关闭。
- 0：关闭
- 1：开启
ProtoFollow.description_en:
Protocol following (available only when both HTTP and HTTPS are selected). Default: Off
- 0: Off
- 1: On

Protocols.description_cn: 防护协议。支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS。
Protocols.description_en: Protection protocol. Supports HTTP and HTTPS.

ProxyConnectTimeOut.description_cn: 高防和后端服务器的建连超时时间。默认为 4 秒，支持配置 4～ 120 秒。
ProxyConnectTimeOut.description_en: Connection establishment timeout for Anti-DDoS and backend servers. Default is 4 seconds; can be configured from 4 to 120 seconds

ProxyKeepAliveRequests.description_cn: 高防回源时，长连接可复用的个数。默认为 100 个，支持配置 60～1000 个。
ProxyKeepAliveRequests.description_en: Number of reusable persistent connections during DDoS-protected origin fetch. Default is 100; can be configured from 60 to 1000

ProxyKeepAliveTimeOut.description_cn: 高防与后端服务器建立请求的长连接空闲时间。默认为 15 秒，支持配置 1～60 秒。
ProxyKeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Idle timeout for persistent connections between anti-DDoS protection and backend servers. Default is 15 seconds; configurable from 1 to 60 seconds

ProxyReadTimeOut.description_cn: 高防从后端服务器读取响应的超时时间，如果后端服务器在该时间内未响应任何内容，则关闭连接。默认为 60 秒，支持配置 30～3600 秒。
ProxyReadTimeOut.description_en: Timeout for reading responses from the backend server in Anti-DDoS mode. If the backend server does not respond with any content within this time, the connection closes. Default is 60 seconds; configurable from 30 to 3600 seconds.

ProxyRetry.description_cn: 高防回源失败后，可重试的次数。默认为 3 次，支持配置 1～10 次。
ProxyRetry.description_en: Number of retries after high protection origin fetch failure. Default is 3; configurable from 1 to 10.

ProxySendTimeOut.description_cn: 高防将请求传输到后端服务器的超时时间，如果后端服务器在该时间内未收到任何请求，则关闭连接。默认为 60 秒，支持配置 30～3600 秒。
ProxySendTimeOut.description_en: Idle timeout for connections from the high-defense system to the backend server. If the backend server does not receive any requests within this period, the connection closes. Default is 60 seconds; configurable from 30 to 3600 seconds.

ProxySetHeader.description_cn:
流量标识信息。
- 为空值时不开启。
- 若希望开启，需要配置自定义字段。高防会在转发回源的请求中添加您配置的自定义字段，以区分正常回源请求。
ProxySetHeader.description_en:
Traffic identification information
- If left empty, this feature is disabled
- To enable, configure a custom field. The anti-DDoS protection service adds your custom field to requests forwarded to the origin server to distinguish them from normal origin requests

ProxySetHeader.Args.description_cn:
流量标识的自定义字段值。
- 只能包含字母、数字、"\_"、"-"、 "\*"、 ","、 "/"、 ""、 ":"、 "@"、 "="、 "."、 "("、 ")"、空格、英文单双引号。
- 带有数字字母外的特殊字符时，需要使用引号包裹整个头部值，且使用转义符，如 \\"POST, OPTIONS\\"。
- 长度限制在 1~128 个字符之间。
ProxySetHeader.Args.description_en:
Custom field value for traffic identifier
- Only letters, numbers, "_", "-", "*", ",", "/", "\", ":", "@", "=", ".", "(", ")", spaces, and English single or double quotation marks are allowed
- If the value contains special characters other than letters or numbers, enclose the entire header value in quotation marks and use escape characters, for example: \"POST, OPTIONS\"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

ProxySetHeader.Name.description_cn:
流量标识的自定义字段名称。
请不要填写标准 HTTP 头部字段，以避免自定 Header 值被覆盖。
ProxySetHeader.Name.description_en:
Custom field name for traffic identification
Please do not enter standard HTTP header fields to avoid overwriting custom header values

SSLProtocols.description_cn:
加密协议，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时需要设置，默认选择 TLSv1.2 和 TLSv1.3。支持以下版本：
- TLSv1
- TLSv1.1
- TLSv1.2
- TLSv1.3
   * 至少选择一个协议版本，暂不支持单独选中 TLSv1.3 版本。
   * 选择多个版本时需注意版本号需要保持连续。例如，您不能仅选择 TLSv1 和 TLSv1.3。
SSLProtocols.description_en:
Encryption protocol. When you select the HTTPS protocol type, you need to configure this setting. TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 are selected by default. The following versions are supported:
- TLSv1
- TLSv1.1
- TLSv1.2
- TLSv1.3
   * You must select at least one protocol version. Selecting only TLSv1.3 is not supported.
   * If you select multiple versions, make sure the version numbers are consecutive. For example, you cannot select only TLSv1 and TLSv1.3.

Servers.Addr.description_cn:
需要接入 DDoS 高防的网站所提供服务的源站公网 IP 或源站域名。
请勿配置与接入域名或高防 IP 地址一致的源站，以免造成业务异常。
Servers.Addr.description_en:
Specify the origin server public IP or domain name for the website that requires DDoS protection.
Do not configure the origin server to use the same domain or high defense IP address as the protected site to avoid service disruptions.

Servers.BackUp.description_cn:
该源站添加到主源站组还是备源站组。默认为 0，即添加到主源站组。
- 0：添加到主源站组
- 1：添加到备源站组
Servers.BackUp.description_en:
Add this origin to the primary origin group or the backup origin group. The default is 0, which adds it to the primary origin group
- 0: Add to primary origin group
- 1: Add to backup origin group

Servers.Protocol.description_cn:
从 DDoS 高防回源至源站的回源协议，可选 HTTP 或 HTTPS 协议。

- 如选择启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中需要有 HTTP 协议源站配置和 HTTPS 协议源站配置以实现协议跟随。
- 如未启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中只能配置一种协议。
Servers.Protocol.description_en:
The protocol used for back-to-origin connections from DDoS protection to the origin server can be HTTP or HTTPS

- If you enable protocol follow, the origin group must include both HTTP and HTTPS origin configurations for protocol follow to work
- If protocol follow is not enabled, you can configure only one protocol in the origin group

Servers.Weight.description_cn:
权重数值，表示源站收到请求的概率（概率为该源站权重/组中所有服务器的总权重）。默认为 100，可配置区间为 1 ～ 100。
当负载均衡算法为源地址哈希（SH）时，权重对后端服务器收到请求的概率无影响。
Servers.Weight.description_en: Weight value indicates the probability that the origin server receives a request (calculated as this server's weight divided by the total weight of all servers in the group). The default is 100; you can set a value from 1 to 100. When the load balancing algorithm is source address hash (SH), weight does not affect the probability that backend servers receive requests.

UserCertId.description_cn: 证书 ID。选择 HTTPS 协议时需要设置。如您已将证书上传至证书中心，可前往[证书中心>证书管理](https://console.volcengine.com/certificate-center/ssl/certificate?certStatus=all&instanceType=)模块，查看证书 ID。
UserCertId.description_en: Certificate ID. Required when selecting the HTTPS protocol. If you have uploaded your certificate to the Certificate Center, go to [Certificate Center > Certificate Management](https://console.volcengine.com/certificate-center/ssl/certificate?certStatus=all&instanceType=) to view the certificate ID.

ConfList.AccessMode.description_cn: 接入形式，默认为 1，暂不支持其他值。
ConfList.AccessMode.description_en: Access mode; default is 1, other values are not supported for now

ConfList.AllSSLCipher.description_cn:
加密套件启用方式，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时需要设置，默认全部启用。

- 0：自定义启用，此时需要填写加密套件名称
- 1：全部启用
ConfList.AllSSLCipher.description_en:
Cipher suite enablement method. This is required when selecting the HTTPS protocol type. All cipher suites are enabled by default

- 0: Custom enablement. You need to enter cipher suite names
- 1: Enable all

ConfList.BackUpStatus.description_cn:
主备源站启用状态，默认启用主源站。
- 0：即启用主源站组，不启用备源站组。
- 1：即启用备源站组，不启用主源站组。
ConfList.BackUpStatus.description_en:
Primary and backup origin activation status. The primary origin group is enabled by default
- 0: Enable the primary origin group; do not enable the backup origin group
- 1: Enable the backup origin group; do not enable the primary origin group

ConfList.ChunkMode.description_cn:
是否启用 Chunked 编码。开启后，对源站响应启用分块传输编码，允许在接收数据时逐块处理，提升数据传输速度。默认关闭。

- 1：开启
- 2：关闭
ConfList.ChunkMode.description_en:
Enable chunked encoding. When enabled, chunked transfer encoding is applied to origin server responses, allowing data to be processed in chunks as it is received and improving transfer speed. Disabled by default.

- 1: Enable
- 2: Disable

- TLSv1

- TLSv1
- TLSv1.1
- TLSv1.2
- TLSv1.3
- You must select at least one protocol version. Selecting only TLSv1.3 is not supported.
- If you select multiple versions, make sure the version numbers are consecutive. For example, you cannot select only TLSv1 and TLSv1.3.

ConfList.Servers.Addr.description_cn:
需要接入 DDoS 高防的网站所提供服务的源站公网 IP 或源站域名。
请勿配置与接入域名或高防 IP 地址一致的源站，以免造成业务异常。
ConfList.Servers.Addr.description_en:
Provide the origin server's public IP address or domain name for the website protected by DDoS mitigation.
Do not configure the origin server with the same domain name or DDoS-protected IP address as the protected site, as this may cause business anomalies.

ConfList.Servers.BackUp.description_cn:
该源站添加到主源站组还是备源站组。默认为 0，即添加到主源站组。

- 0：添加到主源站组
- 1：添加到备源站组
ConfList.Servers.BackUp.description_en:
Add this origin to the primary origin group or the backup origin group. Default is 0, which adds to the primary origin group.

- 0: Add to primary origin group
- 1: Add to backup origin group

ConfList.Servers.Protocol.description_cn:
从 DDoS 高防回源至源站的回源协议，可选 HTTP 或 HTTPS 协议。

- 如选择启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中需要有 HTTP 协议源站配置和 HTTPS 协议源站配置以实现协议跟随。
- 如未启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中只能配置一种协议。
ConfList.Servers.Protocol.description_en:
The protocol for back-to-origin connections from DDoS protection to the origin server can be HTTP or HTTPS

- If you enable protocol follow, the origin group must include both HTTP and HTTPS origin server configurations to enable protocol follow
- If you do not enable protocol follow, the origin group can only include one protocol

ConfList.Servers.Weight.description_cn:
权重数值，表示源站收到请求的概率（概率为该源站权重/组中所有服务器的总权重）。默认为 100，可配置区间为 1 ～ 100。
当负载均衡算法为源地址哈希（SH）时，权重对后端服务器收到请求的概率无影响。
ConfList.Servers.Weight.description_en:
Weight value that determines the probability of the origin server receiving a request (calculated as this server's weight divided by the total weight of all servers in the group). Default is 100; configurable range is 1 to 100.
When the load balancing algorithm is Source Address Hash (SH), weight does not affect the probability of backend servers receiving requests.

ConfList.TLSEnable.description_cn:

- 1：开启

- 1: Enable all

- 1：即启用备源站组，不启用主源站组。

- 1: Enables the backup origin group and disables the primary origin group

- 1：开启
- 2：关闭
ConfList.ChunkMode.description_en:
Enable chunked encoding. When enabled, chunked transfer encoding is applied to origin server responses, allowing data to be processed in chunks as it is received and improving transfer speed. Disabled by default.

- 1: Enable
- 2: Disable

- 2：关闭http压缩模式，1开启 2关闭 3 跟随源站(暂不支持)

ConfList.Servers.Addr.description_cn:
需要接入 DDoS 高防的网站所提供服务的源站公网 IP 或源站域名.
请勿配置与接入域名或高防 IP 地址一致的源站，以免造成业务异常。
ConfList.Servers.Addr.description_en:
Enter the origin server's public IP address or domain name for the website requiring DDoS protection
Do not configure the origin server to match the protected domain or DDoS protection IP address to avoid service issues

ConfList.Servers.BackUp.description_cn:
该源站添加到主源站组还是备源站组。默认为 0，即添加到主源站组。  
- 0：添加到主源站组 
- 1：添加到备源站组
ConfList.Servers.BackUp.description_en:
Should this source station be added to the primary source group or the backup source group? Default is 0, which adds it to the primary source group.
- 0: Add to primary source group
- 1: Add to backup source group

ConfList.Servers.Protocol.description_cn:
从 DDoS 高防回源至源站的回源协议，可选 HTTP 或 HTTPS 协议。 
- 如选择启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中需要有 HTTP 协议源站配置和 HTTPS 协议源站配置以实现协议跟随。
- 如未启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中只能配置一种协议。
ConfList.Servers.Protocol.description_en:
You can choose HTTP or HTTPS as the protocol for returning traffic from DDoS protection to the origin server. 
- If you enable protocol follow, the origin server group must include both HTTP and HTTPS origin server configurations to support protocol follow. 
- If you do not enable protocol follow, you can only configure one protocol in the origin server group.

ConfList.Servers.Weight.description_cn:
权重数值，表示源站收到请求的概率（概率为该源站权重/组中所有服务器的总权重）。默认为 100，可配置区间为 1 ～ 100。 
 
当负载均衡算法为源地址哈希（SH）时，权重对后端服务器收到请求的概率无影响。
ConfList.Servers.Weight.description_en:
Weight value indicating the probability that the origin server receives a request (calculated as this server's weight divided by the total weight of all servers in the group). Default is 100; configurable range is 1 to 100.
When the load balancing algorithm is Source Hash (SH), weight does not affect the probability of backend servers receiving requests.

ConfList.TLSEnable.description_cn:
是否开启日志服务。
- 0：关闭 
- 1：开启

ConfList.UserCertId.description_cn: 证书 ID。选择 HTTPS 协议时需要设置。如您已将证书上传至证书中心，可前往[证书中心>证书管理](https://console.volcengine.com/certificate-center/ssl/certificate?certStatus=all&instanceType=)模块，查看证书 ID。
ConfList.UserCertId.description_en: Certificate ID. Required when selecting the HTTPS protocol. If you have already uploaded your certificate to the Certificate Center, go to [Certificate Center > Certificate Management](https://console.volcengine.com/certificate-center/ssl/certificate?certStatus=all&instanceType=) to view the certificate ID.

AccessMode.description_cn: 接入形式，默认为 1，暂不支持其他值。
AccessMode.description_en: Access type. The default is 1; other values are not supported at this time.

AllSSLCipher.description_cn:
加密套件启用方式，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时需要设置，默认全部启用。
- 0：自定义启用，此时需要填写加密套件名称
- 1：全部启用
AllSSLCipher.description_en:
Encryption suite enablement method. Configure this when selecting the HTTPS protocol type. All suites are enabled by default
- 0: Custom enablement; at this time, enter the encryption suite name
- 1: Enable all

BackUpStatus.description_cn:
主备源站启用状态，默认启用主源站。
- 0：即启用主源站组，不启用备源站组。
- 1：即启用备源站组，不启用主源站组。
BackUpStatus.description_en:
Primary and backup origin group status. The primary origin group is enabled by default.
- 0: That is, only the primary origin group is enabled; the backup origin group is disabled
- 1: That is, only the backup origin group is enabled; the primary origin group is disabled

ChunkMode.description_cn:
是否启用 Chunked 编码。开启后，对源站响应启用分块传输编码，允许在接收数据时逐块处理，提升数据传输速度。默认关闭。
- 1：开启
- 2：关闭
ChunkMode.description_en:
Enable chunked encoding. When enabled, origin server responses use chunked transfer encoding, allowing data to be processed in segments as it is received and improving transfer speed. Disabled by default.
- 1: Enable
- 2: Disable

ClientMaxBodySize.description_cn: 可接受客户端请求正文的最大值。默认为 60 MB，支持配置 1～10240 MB。
ClientMaxBodySize.description_en: Maximum client request body size. Default is 60 MB; configurable from 1 to 10240 MB

DefIp.description_cn: 高防 IP 地址，可通过实例列表获取。支持填写多个高防 IP。
DefIp.description_en: DDoS-protected IP address, available from the instance list. You can enter multiple DDoS-protected IPs

GzipMode.description_cn:
是否启用 Gzip 压缩。开启后，可以通过压缩算法对源站响应数据进行压缩，减少传输数据量，节约带宽。默认关闭。
- 1：开启
- 2：关闭
GzipMode.description_en:
Enable Gzip compression. When enabled, origin server response data is compressed using a compression algorithm to reduce the amount of data transferred and save bandwidth. Default is disabled.
- 1: Enable
- 2: Disable

Host.description_en: Protected Domains

Http2.description_cn:
是否开启 HTTP 2.0 协议接入防护，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时可以设置。默认关闭。
- 0：关闭
- 1：开启
Http2.description_en:
Option to enable HTTP 2.0 access protection. Available when HTTPS protocol is selected. Default is off
- 0: Off
- 1: On

KeepAliveRequests.description_cn: 复用长连接请求数。默认为 100 个，支持配置 60 ～ 1000 个。
KeepAliveRequests.description_en: Number of requests per persistent connection. Default is 100; you can configure it from 60 to 1000

KeepAliveTimeOut.description_cn: 长连接保持时间。默认为 75 秒，支持配置 0 ～ 900 秒。
KeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Keep-alive duration for long connections. Default is 75 seconds; configurable from 0 to 900 seconds

LBAlgorithm.description_cn:
负载均衡算法类型，默认为加权轮询（wrr)。
- wrr：加权轮询
- wlc：加权最小连接数
- sh：源地址哈希
LBAlgorithm.description_en:
Load balancing algorithm type, default is weighted round robin (wrr)
- wrr: Weighted round robin
- wlc: Weighted least connections
- sh: Source address hash

ProtoFollow.description_cn:
是否开启协议跟随，同时选择 HTTP 和 HTTPS 协议类型时可以设置。默认关闭。
- 0：关闭
- 1：开启
ProtoFollow.description_en:
Protocol following can be enabled only when both HTTP and HTTPS are selected. Default is Off
- 0: Off
- 1: On

Protocols.description_cn: 防护协议。支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS。

ProxyConnectTimeOut.description_cn: 高防和后端服务器的建连超时时间。默认为 4 秒，支持配置 4～ 120 秒。
ProxyConnectTimeOut.description_en: Connection establishment timeout between the anti-DDoS server and backend server. Default is 4 seconds; supports configuration from 4 to 120 seconds.

ProxyKeepAliveRequests.description_cn: 高防回源时，长连接可复用的个数。默认为 100 个，支持配置 60～1000 个。
ProxyKeepAliveRequests.description_en: This parameter specifies the number of reusable persistent connections during high-protection origin retrieval. The default is 100; configurable from 60 to 1000.

ProxyKeepAliveTimeOut.description_cn: 高防与后端服务器建立请求的长连接空闲时间。默认为 15 秒，支持配置 1～60 秒。
ProxyKeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Idle timeout for persistent connections between the high defense system and backend server. Default is 15 seconds; configurable from 1 to 60 seconds

ProxyReadTimeOut.description_cn: 高防从后端服务器读取响应的超时时间，如果后端服务器在该时间内未响应任何内容，则关闭连接。默认为 60 秒，支持配置 30～3600 秒。
ProxyReadTimeOut.description_en: Timeout for reading responses from the backend server in high protection mode. If the backend server does not respond with any content within this time, the connection closes. Default is 60 seconds; you can set a value from 30 to 3600 seconds.

ProxyRetry.description_cn: 高防回源失败后，可重试的次数。默认为 3 次，支持配置 1～10 次。
ProxyRetry.description_en: Number of retries after high protection origin server failure. Default is 3; you can set between 1 and 10 times.

ProxySendTimeOut.description_cn: 高防将请求传输到后端服务器的超时时间，如果后端服务器在该时间内未收到任何请求，则关闭连接。默认为 60 秒，支持配置 30～3600 秒。
ProxySendTimeOut.description_en: Timeout for the high-defense system to transmit requests to the backend server. If the backend server does not receive any requests within this period, the connection closes. Default is 60 seconds; configurable from 30 to 3600 seconds.

ProxySetHeader.description_cn:
流量标识信息。
- 为空值时不开启。
- 若希望开启，需要配置自定义字段。高防会在转发回源的请求中添加您配置的自定义字段，以区分正常回源请求。
ProxySetHeader.description_en:
Traffic identification information
- Disabled if left blank
- To enable, configure a custom field. DDoS protection will add your custom field to forwarded requests, allowing you to distinguish these from normal origin requests

ProxySetHeader.Args.description_cn:
流量标识的自定义字段值。
- 只能包含字母、数字、"\_"、"-"、 "\*"、 ","、 "/"、 ""、 ":"、 "@"、 "="、 "."、 "("、 ")"、空格、英文单双引号。
- 带有数字字母外的特殊字符时，需要使用引号包裹整个头部值，且使用转义符，如 \\"POST, OPTIONS\\"。
- 长度限制在 1~128 个字符之间。
ProxySetHeader.Args.description_en:
Custom field value for traffic identifier
- Only letters, numbers, "_", "-", "*", ",", "/", "\", ":", "@", "=", ".", "(", ")", spaces, and English single or double quotation marks are allowed
- If the value contains special characters other than letters or numbers, enclose the entire header value in quotation marks and use escape characters, for example: \"POST, OPTIONS\"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

ProxySetHeader.Name.description_cn:
流量标识的自定义字段名称。
请不要填写标准 HTTP 头部字段，以避免自定 Header 值被覆盖。
ProxySetHeader.Name.description_en:
Custom field name for traffic identification
Please do not enter standard HTTP header fields to avoid overwriting custom header values

SSLProtocols.description_cn:
加密协议，选择 HTTPS 协议类型时需要设置，默认选择 TLSv1.2 和 TLSv1.3。支持以下版本：
- TLSv1
- TLSv1.1
- TLSv1.2
- TLSv1.3
   * 至少选择一个协议版本，暂不支持单独选中 TLSv1.3 版本。
   * 选择多个版本时需注意版本号需要保持连续。例如，您不能仅选择 TLSv1 和 TLSv1.3。
SSLProtocols.description_en:
Encryption protocol. You need to configure this when selecting the HTTPS protocol type. TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 are selected by default. Supported versions:
- TLSv1
- TLSv1.1
- TLSv1.2
- TLSv1.3
   * You must select at least one protocol version. Selecting only TLSv1.3 is not supported.
   * If you select multiple versions, make sure the version numbers are consecutive. For example, you cannot select only TLSv1 and TLSv1.3.

Servers.Addr.description_cn:
需要接入 DDoS 高防的网站所提供服务的源站公网 IP 或源站域名。
请勿配置与接入域名或高防 IP 地址一致的源站，以免造成业务异常。
Servers.Addr.description_en:
Specify the origin server public IP or domain name for the website that requires DDoS protection.
Do not configure the origin server to use the same domain or high defense IP address as the protected site to avoid service disruptions.

Servers.BackUp.description_cn:
该源站添加到主源站组还是备源站组。默认为 0，即添加到主源站组。
- 0：添加到主源站组
- 1：添加到备源站组
Servers.BackUp.description_en:
Add this origin to the primary origin group or the backup origin group. The default is 0, which adds it to the primary origin group
- 0: Add to primary origin group
- 1: Add to backup origin group

Servers.Protocol.description_cn:
从 DDoS 高防回源至源站的回源协议，可选 HTTP 或 HTTPS 协议。

- 如选择启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中需要有 HTTP 协议源站配置和 HTTPS 协议源站配置以实现协议跟随。
- 如未启用“协议跟随”，则源站组中只能配置一种协议。
Servers.Protocol.description_en:
The protocol used for back-to-origin connections from DDoS protection to the origin server can be HTTP or HTTPS

- If you enable protocol follow, the origin group must include both HTTP and HTTPS origin configurations for protocol follow to work
- If protocol follow is not enabled, you can configure only one protocol in the origin group

Servers.Weight.description_cn:
权重数值，表示源站收到请求的概率（概率为该源站权重/组中所有服务器的总权重）。默认为 100，可配置区间为 1 ～ 100。
当负载均衡算法为源地址哈希（SH）时，权重对后端服务器收到请求的概率无影响。
Servers.Weight.description_en: Weight value indicates the probability that the origin server receives a request (calculated as this server's weight divided by the total weight of all servers in the group). The default is 100; you can set a value from 1 to 100. When the load balancing algorithm is source address hash (SH), weight does not affect the probability that backend servers receive requests.

UserCertId.description_cn: 证书 ID。选择 HTTPS 协议时需要设置。如您已将证书上传至证书中心，可前往[证书中心>证书管理](https://console.volcengine.com/certificate-center/ssl/certificate?certStatus=all&instanceType=)模块，查看证书 ID。
UserCertId.description_en: Certificate ID. Required when selecting the HTTPS protocol. If you have uploaded your certificate to Certificate Center, go to [Certificate Center > Certificate Management](https://console.volcengine.com/certificate-center/ssl/certificate?certStatus=all&instanceType=) to view the certificate ID.

BandWidth.description_cn:
- 自定义告警攻击带宽阈值，单位：Mbps。
- 当 ThresType=1，即`配置类型`为`攻击带宽阈值`时生效。
- 取值范围：0~1,000,000，默认为 100。
BandWidth.description_en:
- Custom alert attack bandwidth threshold, unit: Mbps.
- Applies when ThresType=1, i.e., when `Configuration Type` is set to `Attack Bandwidth Threshold`.
- Value range: 0–1,000,000; default is 100.

DefaultBandWidth.description_cn: 选择系统阈值时的带宽阈值 仅作查询
DefaultBandWidth.description_en: Bandwidth threshold is for query only when selecting the system threshold

DefaultPps.description_cn: 选择系统阈值时的pps阈值 仅作查询
DefaultPps.description_en: The PPS threshold used when selecting the system threshold is only for query

InstanceIp.description_cn: 高防实例 IP 地址。

Pps.description_cn:
- 自定义告警包速率阈值，单位：pps。
- 当 ThresType=2，即`配置类型`为`攻击包速率阈值`时生效。
- 取值范围：0~450,000,000，默认为 50,000。
Pps.description_en:
- Set a custom alert packet rate threshold (unit: pps)
- Applies when ThresType=2, that is, when `Configuration Type` is set to `Attack Packet Rate Threshold`
- Range: 0–450,000,000; default is 50,000

ThresType.description_cn:
配置类型。

- 0：恢复默认值，即攻击带宽 100 Mbps 或攻击包速率 50,000 pps 时触发告警。
- 1：自定义攻击带宽阈值。
- 2：自定义攻击包速率阈值。
ThresType.description_en:
Configuration Type

- 0: Restore default values—an alert is triggered when attack bandwidth reaches 100 Mbps or attack packet rate reaches 50,000 pps
- 1: Customize attack bandwidth threshold
- 2: Customize attack packet rate threshold
