frequency_penalty.description_cn: 频率惩罚系数。如果值为正，会根据新 token 在文本中的出现频率对其进行惩罚，从而降低模型逐字重复的可能性。取值范围为 \[-2.0, 2.0\]。

logit_bias.description_cn:
调整指定 token 在模型输出内容中出现的概率，使模型生成的内容更加符合特定的偏好。`logit_bias` 字段接受一个 map 值，其中每个键为词表中的 token ID（使用 tokenization 接口获取），每个值为该 token 的偏差值，取值范围为 \[-100, 100\]。
\-1 会减少选择的可能性，1 会增加选择的可能性；-100 会完全禁止选择该 token，100 会导致仅可选择该 token。该参数的实际效果可能因模型而异。 ```json { "1234": -100 } ```

logprobs.description_cn:
是否返回输出 tokens 的对数概率。

- `false`：不返回对数概率信息
- `true`：返回消息内容中每个输出 token 的对数概率

max_tokens.description_cn:
模型回复最大长度（单位 token），取值范围各个模型不同，详细见[模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310)。
输入 token 和输出 token 的总长度还受模型的上下文长度限制。

messages.description_cn: 由目前为止的对话组成的消息列表

metadata.emit_intention_signal_extra.description_cn: 值是 `"true"` 时，会中途返回intention状态 `"正在搜索"`

metadata.target_character_name.description_cn: 群聊Bot对话时填写，指定本次要发言的角色名，必须是存在于`characters`里的角色

metadata.user_info.description_cn:
联网的智能体可使用，如查询天气场景，前端可以直接通过该字段传地点信息给模型，方便查对应地点的天气。
传入的信息需满足条件：可以被反序列化成 json 的字符串，并需包含 city 和 district 两个字段。

model.description_cn:
您创建的应用 ID。支持零代码应用和高代码应用：

- 获取零代码应用 ID，请参见 [零代码应用操作指南](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1267885)
- 获取高代码应用 ID，请参见 [高代码应用创建部署指南](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1333715)
高代码应用必须配置方舟触发器，否则无法正常调用。

stop.description_cn: 模型遇到 `stop` 字段所指定的字符串时将停止继续生成，这个词语本身不会输出。最多支持 4 个字符串。

stream.description_cn:
响应内容是否流式返回

- `false`：模型生成完所有内容后一次性返回结果
- `true`：按 SSE 协议逐块返回模型生成内容，并以一条 `data: [DONE]` 消息结束

- `false`：模型生成完所有内容后一次性返回结果
- `true`：按 SSE 协议逐块返回模型生成内容，并以一条 `data: [DONE]` 消息结束

stream_options.description_cn: 流式响应的选项。仅当 `stream: true` 时可以设置 `stream_options` 参数。

stream_options.include_usage.description_cn:
是否包含本次请求的 token 用量统计信息

- `false`：不返回 token 用量信息
- `true`：在 `data: [DONE]` 消息之前返回一个额外的块，此块上的 `usage` 字段代表整个请求的 token 用量，`choices` 字段为空数组。所有其他块也将包含 `usage` 字段，但值为 `null`。

temperature.description_cn:
采样温度。控制了生成文本时对每个候选词的概率分布进行平滑的程度。取值范围为 \[0, 1\]。当取值为 0 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。
较高的值（如 0.8）会使输出更加随机，而较低的值（如 0.2）会使输出更加集中确定。通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。

tools.description_cn: 模型可以调用的工具列表（参见\[支持范围\](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262342#8c325d45)）。目前，仅函数作为工具被支持。用这个来提供模型可能为其生成 JSON 输入的函数列表。

tools.function.description_cn: 模型可以调用的工具列表。

tools.function.description.description_cn: 对函数用途的描述，供模型判断何时以及如何调用该工具函数
tools.function.description.example_cn: 获取指定城市的天气信息

top_logprobs.description_cn: 指定每个输出 token 位置最有可能返回的 token 数量，每个 token 都有关联的对数概率。仅当 `logprobs: true` 时可以设置 `top_logprobs` 参数，取值范围为 \[0, 20\]。

top_p.description_cn:
核采样概率阈值。模型会考虑概率质量在 `top_p` 内的 token 结果。取值范围为 \[0, 1\]。当取值为 0 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。
如 0.1 意味着只考虑概率质量最高的前 10% 的 token，取值越大生成的随机性越高，取值越低生成的确定性越高。通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。

Id.description_cn: 待取消的滚动升级任务 ID。通过 [`CreateEndpointRolling`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2582730?lang=zh) 接口创建推理接入点滚动升级任务后获取。
Id.description_en: ID of the rolling upgrade task to be canceled. Obtain this after creating a rolling upgrade task for an inference endpoint using the [`CreateEndpointRolling`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2582730?lang=zh) API.

Id.description_cn:
待查询的 `task_id`。支持传入单个 `task_id` 或 `task_id` 列表。
格式要求：支持字符串或字符串列表；字符串会按英文逗号、中文逗号、换行、空格、Tab 等分隔符拆分为统一的 `task_id` 列表，并去除首尾空白和空片段。
取值范围：标准化后的 `task_id` 数量为 1 到 50。若标准化结果为空，或 `task_id` 数量超过 50，参数校验失败，返回 HTTP 422。
Id.description_en:
The `task_id` to be queried. Supports passing a single `task_id` or a list of `task_id` values.
Format requirements: Supports a string or a list of strings. Strings will be split into a unified `task_id` list using delimiters such as English comma, Chinese comma, newline, space, Tab, etc., with leading and trailing whitespace and empty segments removed.
Value range: The number of standardized `task_id` values must be between 1 and 50. If the standardized result is empty or the number of `task_id` values exceeds 50, parameter validation fails and HTTP 422 is returned.

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称。默认值：default；若资源不在默认项目中，需填写实际项目名称。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name. Default value: default; if the resource is not in the default project, you need to fill in the actual project name.

AccountId.description_cn: `Id`（`task_id`）所属的火山账号 ID。未传入时，服务端会根据 AK/SK 或方舟 API Key 解析账号 ID。
AccountId.description_en: `Id` (`task_id`) refers to the Volcano Engine account ID it belongs to. If not provided, the server will resolve the account ID based on AK/SK or Ark API Key.

BadcaseType.description_cn:
Badcase 类型。可选值请参见枚举值介绍中的 BadcaseType。若传入非法枚举值，参数校验失败，返回 HTTP 422。
注意事项：当前基于 `task_id` 的导入能力仅支持 Seedance 2.0 和 Seedance 2.0 fast 任务。若 `task_id` 对应的真实模型不在支持范围内，服务端返回业务错误，例如 `60002`，并提示该任务对应模型不受支持。
BadcaseType.description_en:
Badcase type. For available values, refer to the BadcaseType enumeration description. If an invalid enumeration value is provided, parameter validation fails and HTTP 422 is returned.
Note: The current import capability based on `task_id` only supports Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.0 fast tasks. If the actual model corresponding to `task_id` is not within the supported range, the server returns a business error, such as `60002`, and indicates that the model for this task is not supported.

ContactInfo.description_cn: 联系方式，支持邮箱或电话。最大长度：255 个字符。
ContactInfo.description_en: Contact information. Supports email or phone. Maximum length: 255 characters.

Feedback.description_cn: 效果问题描述。长度范围为 1 到 2000 个字符；不支持纯空白字符串。提交成功后，该内容会作为一条 `feedback` 注解持久化。
Feedback.description_en: Description of the effect problem. The length must be between 1 and 2000 characters; pure whitespace strings are not supported. After successful submission, this content will be persisted as a `feedback` annotation.
Feedback.example_cn: 人物手部扭曲，且嘴型和中文配音对不上
Feedback.example_en: The character's hands are distorted, and the lip movements do not match the Chinese voiceover.

Id.description_cn:
待上报的 `task_id`。支持传入单个 `task_id` 或 `task_id` 列表。
服务端会对传入的 `task_id` 进行标准化处理：支持单个字符串或多个字符串列表；会按英文逗号、中文逗号、换行、空格、Tab 等分隔符拆分为统一的 `task_id` 列表，并去除首尾空白和空片段。
标准化后的 `task_id` 数量必须大于等于 1 且小于等于 50。若标准化结果为空，或 `task_id` 数量超过 50，参数校验失败，返回 HTTP 422。
Id.description_en: The `task_id` to be reported. Supports passing a single `task_id` or a list of `task_id` values. The server will normalize the provided `task_id`: it supports either a single string or a list of strings, and will split the input into a unified `task_id` list using delimiters such as English commas, Chinese commas, line breaks, spaces, and tabs, removing leading/trailing whitespace and empty segments. The number of normalized `task_id` must be greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 50. If the normalized result is empty or the number of `task_id` exceeds 50, parameter validation fails and HTTP 422 is returned.

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称。默认值：`default`；若资源不在默认项目中，需填写实际项目名称。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name. Default value: `default`; if the resource is not in the default project, you need to enter the actual project name.

Source.description_cn: 反馈来源，省略或 null 时默认  case_import。
Source.description_en: Feedback source. Defaults to case_import if omitted or null.

frequency_penalty.description_cn: 频率惩罚系数。如果值为正，会根据新 token 在文本中的出现频率对其进行惩罚，从而降低模型逐字重复的可能性。取值范围为 \[-2.0, 2.0\]。
frequency_penalty.description_en: Frequency penalty coefficient. If set to a positive value, new tokens are penalized based on their frequency in the text, reducing the likelihood of the model repeating the same words verbatim. Range: \[-2.0, 2.0\].

logit_bias.description_cn:
调整指定 token 在模型输出内容中出现的概率，使模型生成的内容更加符合特定的偏好。`logit_bias` 字段接受一个 map 值，其中每个键为词表中的 token ID（使用 tokenization 接口获取），每个值为该 token 的偏差值，取值范围为 \[-100, 100\]。
\-1 会减少选择的可能性，1 会增加选择的可能性；-100 会完全禁止选择该 token，100 会导致仅可选择该 token。该参数的实际效果可能因模型而异。 ```json { "1234": -100 } ```
logit_bias.description_en:
Adjust the probability of specified tokens appearing in the model output to better align the generated content with specific preferences. The `logit_bias` field accepts a map where each key is a token ID from the vocabulary (obtained using the tokenization interface), and each value is the bias for that token, ranging from [-100, 100].
A value of -1 decreases the likelihood of the token being selected, while 1 increases it; -100 completely bans the token, and 100 restricts selection to only that token. The actual effect of this parameter may vary depending on the model. ```json { "1234": -100 } ```

logprobs.description_cn:
是否返回输出 tokens 的对数概率。

- `false`：不返回对数概率信息
- `true`：返回消息内容中每个输出 token 的对数概率
logprobs.description_en:
Whether to return the log probabilities of the output tokens.

- `false`: Do not return log probability information
- `true`: Return the log probability of each output token in the message content

max_tokens.description_cn:
模型回复最大长度（单位 token）。
- **模型回复最大长度（单位 token），取值范围各个模型不同，详细见**[模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310)**。** 
- **输入 token 和输出 token 的总长度还受模型的上下文长度限制。**
max_tokens.description_en:
Maximum model response length (in tokens).
- **The maximum model response length (in tokens) varies by model. For details, see** [Model List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310)**.**
- **The total length of input and output tokens is also limited by the model's context length.**

messages.description_cn: 由目前为止的对话组成的消息列表
messages.description_en: A list of messages that make up the conversation so far

model.description_cn: 本次请求使用模型的 Model ID，或者使用已配置的视觉理解模型的[推理接入点](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1099522)(Endpoint ID)。
model.description_en: The Model ID of the model used for this request, or the inference entry point for the configured vision understanding model (https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/1099522 Endpoint ID).

presence_penalty.description_cn: 存在惩罚系数。如果值为正，会根据新 token 到目前为止是否出现在文本中对其进行惩罚，从而增加模型谈论新主题的可能性。取值范围为 \[-2.0, 2.0\]。
presence_penalty.description_en: A penalty coefficient is available. If the value is positive, new tokens will be penalized if they have already appeared in the text so far, increasing the likelihood that the model discusses new topics. The value can range from [-2.0, 2.0].

service_tier.description_cn:
指定是否使用[TPM保障包](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1510762)。生效对象为购买了保障包推理接入点。取值范围
- auto：优先使用TPM保障包。如果有TPM保障包额度的推理接入点，本次请求将会使用 TPM 保障包用量，获得更高限流以及响应速度。否则不使用，使用默认的限流和普通的服务响应速度。
- default：本次请求，不使用 TPM 保障包，使用默认的限流和普通的服务响应速度，即使请求的是有TPM保障包额度的推理接入点。
service_tier.description_en:
Specify whether to use the [TPM Protection Package](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1510762). Applies to inference endpoints with a purchased protection package. Value options:
- auto: Preferentially use the TPM Protection Package. If the inference endpoint has available TPM Protection Package quota, this request will use the TPM Protection Package, providing higher rate limits and faster response times. Otherwise, the default rate limits and standard response times will apply.
- default: For this request, do not use the TPM Protection Package. The default rate limits and standard response times will be used, even if the inference endpoint has available TPM Protection Package quota.

stop.description_cn: 模型遇到 `stop` 字段所指定的字符串时将停止继续生成，这个词语本身不会输出。最多支持 4 个字符串。
stop.description_en: When the model encounters a string specified in the `stop` field, it will stop generating further output. The stop word itself will not be included in the output. Up to 4 strings are supported.

stream.description_cn:
响应内容是否流式返回
- `false`：模型生成完所有内容后一次性返回结果
- `true`：按 SSE 协议逐块返回模型生成内容，并以一条 `data: [DONE]` 消息结束
stream.description_en:
Should the response content be streamed?
- `false`: The model returns the complete result in a single response after generating all content.
- `true`: The model streams the generated content in chunks according to the SSE protocol, ending with a `data: [DONE]` message.

stream_options.description_cn: 流式响应的选项。仅当 `stream: true` 时可以设置 `stream_options` 参数。
stream_options.description_en: Options for streaming responses. The `stream_options` parameter can only be set when `stream: true` is enabled.

stream_options.include_usage.description_cn:
是否包含本次请求的 token 用量统计信息

- `false`：不返回 token 用量信息
- `true`：在 `data: [DONE]` 消息之前返回一个额外的块，此块上的 `usage` 字段代表整个请求的 token 用量，`choices` 字段为空数组。所有其他块也将包含 `usage` 字段，但值为 `null`。
stream_options.include_usage.description_en:
Include token usage statistics for this request?

- `false`: Token usage information will not be returned.
- `true`: An additional block will be returned before the `data: [DONE]` message. The `usage` field in this block represents the total token usage for the entire request, and the `choices` field will be an empty array. All other blocks will also include a `usage` field, but its value will be `null`.

temperature.description_cn:
采样温度。控制了生成文本时对每个候选词的概率分布进行平滑的程度。取值范围为 \[0, 2\]。当取值为 0 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。
较高的值（如 0.8）会使输出更加随机，而较低的值（如 0.2）会使输出更加集中确定。通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。
temperature.description_en:
Sampling temperature. Controls the degree to which the probability distribution for each candidate word is smoothed during text generation. The value range is [0, 2]. When set to 0, the model only considers the token with the highest log probability.
Higher values (e.g., 0.8) make the output more random, while lower values (e.g., 0.2) make the output more focused and deterministic. It is generally recommended to adjust either `temperature` or `top_p`, but not both.

thinking.description_cn:
控制模型是否开启深度思考模式。默认开启深度思考模式，可以手动关闭。
> - 支持此字段的模型为 doubao-1.5-thinking-vision-pro-250428、doubao-1.5-thinking-pro-m-250428、doubao-1.5-ui-tars-250428。
thinking.description_en:
Control whether to enable Deep Thinking Mode for the model. Deep Thinking Mode is enabled by default and can be turned off manually.
> - This field is supported by the following models: doubao-1.5-thinking-vision-pro-250428, doubao-1.5-thinking-pro-m-250428, doubao-1.5-ui-tars-250428.

thinking.type.description_cn:
取值范围：enabled， disabled，auto。
- enabled：开启思考模式，模型一定先思考后回答。
- disabled：关闭思考模式，模型直接回答问题，不会进行思考。
- auto：自动思考模式，模型根据问题自主判断是否需要思考，简单题目直接回答。该取值只有doubao-1.5-thinking-pro-m-250428模型支持。
thinking.type.description_en:
Value range: enabled, disabled, auto.
- enabled: Enables thinking mode. The model will always think before responding.
- disabled: Disables thinking mode. The model will answer questions directly without thinking.
- auto: Automatic thinking mode. The model will decide whether to think based on the question; for simple questions, it will answer directly. This option is only supported by the doubao-1.5-thinking-pro-m-250428 model.

tools.description_cn: 模型可以调用的工具列表（参见[支持范围](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262342#8c325d45)）。目前，仅函数作为工具被支持。用这个来提供模型可能为其生成 JSON 输入的函数列表。
tools.description_en: List of tools available for model invocation (see [Supported Scope](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262342#8c325d45)). Currently, only functions are supported as tools. Use this to provide a list of functions for which the model may generate JSON input.

tools.function.description_cn: 模型可以调用的工具列表。
tools.function.description_en: List of tools available to the model.

tools.function.description.description_cn: 对函数用途的描述，供模型判断何时以及如何调用该工具函数
tools.function.description.description_en: A description of the function's purpose, used by the model to determine when and how to call this utility function.
tools.function.description.example_cn: 获取指定城市的天气信息
tools.function.description.example_en: Get weather information for the specified city

tools.type.description_en: Tool type, currently only `function` is supported

top_logprobs.description_cn: 指定每个输出 token 位置最有可能返回的 token 数量，每个 token 都有关联的对数概率。仅当 `logprobs: true` 时可以设置 `top_logprobs` 参数，取值范围为 \[0, 20\]。
top_logprobs.description_en: Specifies the number of most likely tokens to return for each output token position, with each token associated with a log probability. The `top_logprobs` parameter can only be set when `logprobs: true`, and its value must be within the range [0, 20].

top_p.description_cn:
核采样概率阈值。模型会考虑概率质量在 `top_p` 内的 token 结果。取值范围为 \[0, 1\]。当取值为 0 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。
如 0.1 意味着只考虑概率质量最高的前 10% 的 token，取值越大生成的随机性越高，取值越低生成的确定性越高。通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。
top_p.description_en:
Nucleus sampling probability threshold. The model considers tokens whose cumulative probability mass falls within `top_p`. The valid range is [0, 1]. When set to 0, the model only considers the token with the highest log probability.
For example, a value of 0.1 means only the top 10% of tokens by probability mass are considered. Higher values increase randomness in generation, while lower values make outputs more deterministic. It is generally recommended to adjust either `temperature` or `top_p`, but not both.

context_id.description_cn: 上下文缓存的ID，用于关联缓存的信息。
context_id.description_en: The context cache ID, used to associate cached information.

frequency_penalty.description_cn: 频率惩罚系数。如果值为正，会根据新 token 在文本中的出现频率对其进行惩罚，从而降低模型逐字重复的可能性。取值范围为 \[-2.0, 2.0\]。
frequency_penalty.description_en: Frequency penalty coefficient. If set to a positive value, new tokens are penalized based on their frequency in the generated text, reducing the likelihood of the model repeating itself verbatim. Valid range: [-2.0, 2.0].

logit_bias.description_cn:
调整指定 token 在模型输出内容中出现的概率，使模型生成的内容更加符合特定的偏好。`logit_bias` 字段接受一个 map 值，其中每个键为词表中的 token ID（使用 tokenization 接口获取），每个值为该 token 的偏差值，取值范围为 \[-100, 100\]。
\-1 会减少选择的可能性，1 会增加选择的可能性；-100 会完全禁止选择该 token，100 会导致仅可选择该 token。该参数的实际效果可能因模型而异。
logit_bias.description_en:
Adjust the probability of specified tokens appearing in the model's output to better align the generated content with specific preferences. The `logit_bias` field accepts a map value, where each key is a token ID from the vocabulary (obtained using the tokenization interface), and each value is the bias for that token, ranging from [-100, 100].
A value of -1 decreases the likelihood of selecting the token, while 1 increases it; -100 completely prohibits the token from being selected, and 100 will result in only that token being selectable. The actual effect of this parameter may vary depending on the model.

logprobs.description_cn:
是否返回输出 tokens 的对数概率。

- `false`：不返回对数概率信息
- `true`：返回消息内容中每个输出 token 的对数概率
logprobs.description_en:
Whether to return the log probabilities of output tokens.

- `false`: Do not return log probability information
- `true`: Return the log probability of each output token in the message content

max_completion_tokens.description_cn: 模型生成的 token 数量的上限，包含思维链内容（**reasoning\_content**）与回答内容（**content**），不包含传入的信息（**messages**）。超出后，停止模型输出思维链内容及模型回答，并返回finish\_reason字段为length。
max_completion_tokens.description_en: The maximum number of tokens that the model can generate includes both the reasoning chain content (**reasoning_content**) and the answer content (**content**), but does not include the input information (**messages**). If this limit is exceeded, the model will stop outputting both the reasoning chain and the answer, and the finish_reason field will be returned as length.

max_tokens.description_cn:
模型回复最大长度（单位 token），取值范围各个模型不同，详细见[模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310)。
输入 token 和输出 token 的总长度还受模型的上下文长度限制。
max_tokens.description_en: The maximum response length for the model (measured in tokens) varies by model. For details, see [Model List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310). The combined length of input and output tokens is also limited by the model's context length.

messages.description_cn: 由目前为止的对话组成的消息列表
messages.description_en: A list of messages composed of the conversations so far

presence_penalty.description_cn: 存在惩罚系数。如果值为正，会根据新 token 到目前为止是否出现在文本中对其进行惩罚，从而增加模型谈论新主题的可能性。取值范围为 \[-2.0, 2.0\]。
presence_penalty.description_en: A penalty coefficient is available. If the value is positive, new tokens are penalized if they have already appeared in the text so far, increasing the likelihood that the model discusses new topics. The valid range is [-2.0, 2.0].

reasoning_effort.description_cn: 调用深度推理模型时，控制推理的思考的工作量，3个可选范围 low, medium, high。如设置low，会减少思考时花费的 token 数和思考时间。
reasoning_effort.description_en: When invoking the deep inference model, you can control the reasoning workload with three available levels: low, medium, and high. Selecting 'low' will reduce the number of tokens used and the time spent on reasoning.

service_tier.description_cn:
指定是否使用[TPM保障包](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1510762)。生效对象为购买了保障包推理接入点。取值范围
- auto：优先使用TPM保障包。如果有TPM保障包额度的推理接入点，本次请求将会使用 TPM 保障包用量，获得更高限流以及响应速度。否则不使用，使用默认的限流和普通的服务响应速度。
- default：本次请求，不使用 TPM 保障包，使用默认的限流和普通的服务响应速度，即使请求的是有TPM保障包额度的推理接入点。
service_tier.description_en:
Specifies whether to use the [TPM Protection Package](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1510762). Applies to inference endpoints with a purchased protection package. Value options:
- auto: Preferentially uses the TPM Protection Package. If the inference endpoint has available TPM Protection Package quota, this request will consume the package quota, providing higher rate limits and faster response speed. Otherwise, the default rate limits and standard response speed will be used.
- default: This request does not use the TPM Protection Package and will use the default rate limits and standard response speed, even if the inference endpoint has available TPM Protection Package quota.

stop.description_cn: 模型遇到 `stop` 字段所指定的字符串时将停止继续生成，这个词语本身不会输出。最多支持 4 个字符串。
stop.description_en: When the model encounters a string specified in the `stop` field, it will stop generating further output. The stop string itself will not be included in the output. Up to 4 strings are supported.

stream.description_cn:
响应内容是否流式返回

- `false`：模型生成完所有内容后一次性返回结果
- `true`：按 SSE 协议逐块返回模型生成内容，并以一条 `data: [DONE]` 消息结束
stream.description_en:
Whether to stream response content

- `false`: Returns the result all at once after the model has generated all content
- `true`: Returns generated content in chunks according to the SSE protocol, ending with a `data: [DONE]` message

stream_options.description_cn: 流式响应的选项。仅当 `stream: true` 时可以设置 `stream_options` 参数。
stream_options.description_en: Options for streaming responses. The `stream_options` parameter can only be set when `stream: true`.

stream_options.include_usage.description_cn:
是否包含本次请求的 token 用量统计信息

- `false`：不返回 token 用量信息
- `true`：在 `data: [DONE]` 消息之前返回一个额外的块，此块上的 `usage` 字段代表整个请求的 token 用量，`choices` 字段为空数组。所有其他块也将包含 `usage` 字段，但值为 `null`。
stream_options.include_usage.description_en:
Include token usage statistics for this request?

- `false`: Token usage information will not be returned.
- `true`: An additional block will be returned before the `data: [DONE]` message. The `usage` field in this block represents the total token usage for the entire request, and the `choices` field will be an empty array. All other blocks will also include a `usage` field, but its value will be `null`.

temperature.description_cn:
采样温度。控制了生成文本时对每个候选词的概率分布进行平滑的程度。取值范围为 \[0, 1\]。当取值为 0 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。
较高的值（如 0.8）会使输出更加随机，而较低的值（如 0.2）会使输出更加集中确定。通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。
temperature.description_en:
Sampling temperature. Controls the degree of smoothing applied to the probability distribution over candidate words when generating text. The value ranges from [0, 1]. When set to 0, the model only considers the token with the highest log probability.
Higher values (e.g., 0.8) make the output more random, while lower values (e.g., 0.2) make the output more focused and deterministic. It is generally recommended to adjust either `temperature` or `top_p`, but not both.

top_logprobs.description_cn: 指定每个输出 token 位置最有可能返回的 token 数量，每个 token 都有关联的对数概率。仅当 `logprobs: true` 时可以设置 `top_logprobs` 参数，取值范围为 \[0, 20\]。
top_logprobs.description_en: Specifies the number of most likely tokens to return for each output token position, with each token having an associated log probability. The `top_logprobs` parameter can only be set when `logprobs: true`, and its value range is [0, 20].

top_p.description_cn:
核采样概率阈值。模型会考虑概率质量在 `top_p` 内的 token 结果。取值范围为 \[0, 1\]。当取值为 0 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。
如 0.1 意味着只考虑概率质量最高的前 10% 的 token，取值越大生成的随机性越高，取值越低生成的确定性越高。通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。
top_p.description_en:
Nucleus sampling probability threshold. The model considers tokens whose cumulative probability mass falls within `top_p`. The valid range is [0, 1]. When set to 0, the model only considers the single token with the highest log probability.
For example, a value of 0.1 means only the top 10% of tokens by probability mass are considered. Higher values increase randomness in generation, while lower values make the output more deterministic. It is generally recommended to adjust either `temperature` or `top_p`, but not both.

messages.description_cn: 由目前为止的对话组成的消息列表
messages.description_en: A list of messages composed of the conversation so far

mode.description_cn:
上下文缓存的类型，详细见[上下文缓存（Context API）概述](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1398933)。

- `session` ：Session 缓存，支持的模型请参见[支持的模型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#5f0f3750)。
- `common_prefix` ：前缀缓存，支持的模型请参见[模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396490#5f0f3750)。
mode.description_en:
Types of context cache. For details, see [Context Cache (Context API) Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1398933).

- `session`: Session cache. For supported models, see [Supported Models](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#5f0f3750).
- `common_prefix`: Prefix cache. For the list of models, see [Model List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396490#5f0f3750).

model.description_cn:
模型的推理接入点ID（Endpoint id），获取方式参见[创建推理接入点](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1099522)。
- Session 缓存支持的模型请参见[支持的模型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#5f0f3750)。
- 前缀缓存支持的模型请参见[模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396490#5f0f3750)。
model.description_en:
The inference access point ID (Endpoint id) for the model. For details, see [Create Inference Access Point](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/1099522).
- For models that support session caching, please see [Supported Models](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/1396491#5f0f3750). 
- The models supported by prefix caching can be found in the [model list](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/ModelArk/1330310).

truncation_strategy.description_cn:
控制历史上下文窗口。不设置会根据推理接入点调用的模型自动判断使用哪种模式的Session 缓存。

- 当`mode`字段设置为`session`，该字段可设置。
- 当`mode`字段设置为`common_prefix`，该字段不可设置。
truncation_strategy.description_en:
Controls the historical context window. If not set, the system will automatically determine which type of session cache to use based on the model called by the inference endpoint.

- When the `mode` field is set to `session`, this field can be configured.
- When the `mode` field is set to `common_prefix`, this field cannot be configured.

truncation_strategy.last_history_tokens.description_cn:
`type`设置为`last_history_tokens`时，进行设置。缓存存储的最大 token 数，触发该上限将根据模型上下文大小对缓存内容进行截断，截断顺序按照时间由远及近。

```json
{
   "type": "last_history_tokens",
   "last_history_tokens": 12000
}
```
truncation_strategy.last_history_tokens.description_en:
Set this option when `type` is set to `last_history_tokens`. Specifies the maximum number of tokens to store in the cache. When this limit is reached, the cache will be truncated based on the model's context size, removing the oldest content first.

```json
{
   "type": "last_history_tokens",
   "last_history_tokens": 12000
}
```

truncation_strategy.rolling_tokens.description_cn:
`type`设置为`rolling_tokens`时，进行设置。在context历史消息长度接近模型上下文时，是否自动对历史上下文进行裁剪。

- `false`：在历史消息长度超过上下文长度时模型会停止输出（`finish_reason`为`length`时)。
- `true`：在历史消息长度接近上下文长度时模型自动按照先进先出的顺序，删除定量（4k）的内容，为新对话内容腾挪缓存空间；同时对缓存中的信息进行重新计算和读入，保障内容理解一致性。具体的计算逻辑，请参见 [rolling\_tokens 模式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#dc052059)。

```json
{
   "type": "rolling_tokens",
   "rolling_tokens": true
}
```
truncation_strategy.rolling_tokens.description_en:
Set this option when `type` is set to `rolling_tokens`. Determines whether the historical context is automatically trimmed when the length of context history approaches the model's context window.

- `false`: If the context history length exceeds the model's context window, the model will stop generating output (`finish_reason` is `length`).
- `true`: When the context history length approaches the model's context window, the model will automatically remove a fixed amount of content (4k) in a first-in, first-out manner to free up buffer space for new conversation content. The cached information is then recalculated and reloaded to ensure consistent understanding of the content. For details on the calculation logic, see [rolling_tokens mode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#dc052059).

```json
{
   "type": "rolling_tokens",
   "rolling_tokens": true
}
```

truncation_strategy.type.description_cn:
用户截断的策略，对话会综合最近存储的历史token数、模型大小和chat时的`max_tokens`进行截断。

- `last_history_tokens`：使用[last\_history\_tokens模式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#a14e038d)，取决于使用的模型支持哪种Session 缓存。
- `rolling_tokens`：使用[rolling\_tokens模式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#dc052059)，取决于使用的模型支持哪种Session 缓存
truncation_strategy.type.description_en:
User truncation strategies: The conversation will be truncated based on a combination of the most recently stored history token count, model size, and the 'max_tokens' parameter used during chat.

- `last_history_tokens`: Uses the [last_history_tokens mode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#a14e038d), depending on which session cache is supported by the model.
- `rolling_tokens`: Uses the [rolling_tokens mode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1396491#dc052059), depending on which session cache is supported by the model.

ttl.description_cn:
过期时长，单位为秒。信息在创建后即开始计时，每次使用则重置为0。计时超过ttl，信息会被从缓存中删除。每次调用chat均根据ttl更新过期时间。
过期时间可以设置的范围在1小时到7天，即\[3600, 604800\]。
ttl.description_en:
Expiration duration, in seconds. Timing starts as soon as the information is created and resets to 0 each time it is accessed. If the elapsed time exceeds the TTL, the information will be removed from the cache. Each time chat is called, the expiration time is updated based on the TTL.
The expiration time can be set from 1 hour to 7 days, i.e., within the range [3600, 604800].

callback_url.description_cn:
填写本次生成任务结果的回调通知地址。当视频生成任务有状态变化时，方舟将向此地址推送 POST 请求。

回调请求内容结构与[查询任务API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1521309)的返回体一致。

回调返回的 status 包括以下状态：
- queued：排队中。
- running：任务运行中。
- succeeded： 任务成功。（如发送失败，即5秒内没有接收到成功发送的信息，回调三次）
- failed：任务失败。（如发送失败，即5秒内没有接收到成功发送的信息，回调三次）
- expired：任务超时，即任务处于运行中或排队中状态超过过期时间。可通过 execution_expires_after 字段设置过期时间。
callback_url.description_en:
Provide the callback notification URL for the result of this generation task. When the video generation task status changes, Ark will send a POST request to this address.

The structure of the callback request content is consistent with the response body of the [Query Task API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1521309).

The status returned in the callback includes the following states:
- queued: In queue.
- running: Task is running.
- succeeded: Task succeeded. (If sending fails, i.e., if no successful delivery information is received within 5 seconds, the callback will be retried three times)
- failed: Task failed. (If sending fails, i.e., if no successful delivery information is received within 5 seconds, the callback will be retried three times)
- expired: Task timed out, meaning the task remains in running or queued status beyond the expiration time. The expiration time can be set via the execution_expires_after field.

camera_fixed.description_cn:
> 参考图场景不支持，Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast 暂不支持

是否固定摄像头。枚举值：

- true：固定摄像头。平台会在用户提示词中追加固定摄像头，实际效果不保证。

- false：不固定摄像头。
camera_fixed.description_en:
Reference image scenarios are not supported. Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast are temporarily not supported.

Whether to fix the camera. Enum values:

- true: Fix the camera. The platform will append 'fix the camera' to the user's prompt, but the actual effect is not guaranteed.

- false: Do not fix the camera.

draft.description_cn:
> 仅 Seedance 1.5 pro 支持

控制是否开启样片模式。[阅读文档](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1366799?lang=zh#5acd28c8) 获取使用教程和注意事项。

- true：开启样片模式，生成一段预览视频，快速验证场景结构、镜头调度、主体动作与 prompt 意图是否符合预期。消耗 token 数较正常视频更少，使用成本更低。

- false：关闭样片模式，正常生成一段视频。
draft.description_en:
> Supported only by Seedance 1.5 pro

Control whether to enable Sample Video Mode. [Read the documentation](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1366799?lang=zh#5acd28c8) for usage instructions and important notes.

- true: Enable Sample Video Mode to generate a preview video, allowing you to quickly verify scene structure, camera scheduling, subject actions, and whether the prompt intent meets expectations. Consumes fewer tokens than a normal video, resulting in lower usage costs.

- false: Disable Sample Video Mode to generate a normal video.

duration.description_cn:
> duration 和 frames 二选一即可，frames 的优先级高于 duration。如果您希望生成整数秒的视频，建议指定 duration。

生成视频时长，仅支持整数，单位：秒。详情参考[创建视频生成任务 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1520757)。

- Seedance 1.0 pro、Seedance 1.0 pro fast、Seedance 1.0 lite: \[2, 12\] s。

- Seedance 1.5 pro: \[4,12\] 或设置为-1

- Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast: \[4,15\] 或设置为-1
duration.description_en:
Either duration or frames can be specified; frames takes precedence over duration. If you want to generate a video with an integer number of seconds, it is recommended to specify duration.

The video duration supports only integer values, in seconds. For details, refer to [Create Video Generation Task API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1520757).

- Seedance 1.0 pro, Seedance 1.0 pro fast, Seedance 1.0 lite: [2, 12] s.

- Seedance 1.5 pro: [4, 12] or set to -1

- Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast: [4, 15] or set to -1

execution_expires_after.description_cn:
任务超时阈值。指定任务提交后的过期时间（单位：秒），从 created at 时间戳开始计算。默认值 172800 秒，即 48 小时。取值范围：[3600，259200]。
不论使用哪种 service_tier，都建议根据业务场景设置合适的超时时间。超过该时间后任务会被自动终止，并标记为 expired 状态。
execution_expires_after.description_en:
Task timeout threshold. Specifies the expiration time after a task is submitted (unit: seconds), calculated from the created at timestamp. The default value is 172800 seconds, which is 48 hours. Value range: [3600, 259200].
Regardless of which service_tier is used, it is recommended to set an appropriate timeout based on your business scenario. After this time is exceeded, the task will be automatically terminated and marked as expired.

frames.description_cn:
> Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast、Seedance 1.5 pro 暂不支持
> duration 和 frames 二选一即可，frames 的优先级高于 duration。如果您希望生成小数秒的视频，建议指定 frames。

生成视频的帧数。通过指定帧数，可以灵活控制生成视频的长度，生成小数秒的视频。
由于 frames 的取值限制，仅能支持有限小数秒，您需要根据公式推算最接近的帧数。

- 计算公式：帧数 = 时长 × 帧率（24）。

- 取值范围：支持 [29, 289] 区间内所有满足 25 + 4n 格式的整数值，其中 n 为正整数。

例如：假设需要生成 2.4 秒的视频，帧数=2.4×24=57.6。由于 frames 不支持 57.6，此时您只能选择一个最接近的值。根据 25+4n 计算出最接近的帧数为 57，实际生成的视频为 57/24=2.375 秒。
frames.description_en:
Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast and Seedance 1.5 pro are temporarily not supported
> You can choose either duration or frames; frames takes precedence over duration. If you want to generate a video with a fractional number of seconds, it is recommended to specify frames.

The number of frames to generate for the video. By specifying the number of frames, you can flexibly control the length of the generated video and create videos with fractional seconds.
Due to the value restrictions of frames, only a limited range of fractional seconds is supported. You need to use the formula to calculate the closest number of frames.

- Calculation formula: Number of frames = Duration × Frame rate (24).

- Value range: Supports all integer values in the range [29, 289] that fit the format 25 + 4n, where n is a positive integer.

For example: Suppose you want to generate a 2.4-second video. Number of frames = 2.4 × 24 = 57.6. Since frames does not support 57.6, you can only choose the closest value. According to 25 + 4n, the closest number of frames is 57, so the actual generated video will be 57/24 = 2.375 seconds.

generate_audio.description_cn:
> 仅 Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast、Seedance 1.5 pro 支持

控制生成的视频是否包含与画面同步的声音。

- true：模型输出的视频包含同步音频。模型会基于文本提示词与视觉内容，自动生成与之匹配的人声、音效及背景音乐。建议将对话部分置于双引号内，以优化音频生成效果。例如：男人叫住女人说：“你记住，以后不可以用手指指月亮。”

- false：模型输出的视频为无声视频。
generate_audio.description_en:
Supported only by Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast, and Seedance 1.5 pro

Controls whether the generated video includes audio synchronized with the visuals.

- true: The model outputs a video with synchronized audio. The model will automatically generate matching voices, sound effects, and background music based on the text prompt and visual content. It is recommended to enclose dialogue in double quotation marks to optimize audio generation. For example: The man calls out to the woman and says, "Remember, from now on you must never point at the moon with your finger."

- false: The model outputs a silent video.

- 1080p: For Seedance 1.0 lite, available only in reference image scenarios; not supported by Seedance 2.0 fast.

return_last_frame.description_cn:
- true：返回生成视频的尾帧图像。设置为 true 后，可通过 [查询视频生成任务接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1521309) 获取视频的尾帧图像。尾帧图像的格式为 png，宽高像素值与生成的视频保持一致，无水印。

使用该参数可实现生成多个连续视频：以上一个生成视频的尾帧作为下一个视频任务的首帧，快速生成多个连续视频，调用示例详见 [教程](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1366799?lang=zh#%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E5%A4%9A%E4%B8%AA%E8%BF%9E%E7%BB%AD%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91)。

- false：不返回生成视频的尾帧图像。
return_last_frame.description_en:
- true: Returns the last frame image of the generated video. When set to true, you can obtain the last frame image via the [Query Video Generation Task API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1521309). The last frame image is in PNG format, with the same width and height as the generated video, and contains no watermark.

This parameter enables the generation of multiple consecutive videos: use the last frame of the previous video as the first frame of the next video task to quickly generate a series of consecutive videos. For usage examples, see the [tutorial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1366799?lang=zh#%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E5%A4%9A%E4%B8%AA%E8%BF%9E%E7%BB%AD%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91).

- false: Does not return the last frame image of the generated video.

safety_identifier.description_cn: 终端用户的唯一标识符，用于协助平台检测您的应用中可能违反火山方舟使用政策的用户。该标识符为英文字符串，需保证对单个用户固定且唯一，长度不超过 64 个字符。推荐传入对用户名、用户 ID 或邮箱进行哈希处理后生成的字符串，避免泄露用户隐私信息。
safety_identifier.description_en: The unique identifier for the end user, used to help the platform detect users in your application who may violate the Volcano Ark usage policy. This identifier must be an English string, fixed and unique for each individual user, and no longer than 64 characters. It is recommended to use a string generated by hashing the username, user ID, or email address to avoid exposing user privacy information.

seed.description_cn:
种子整数，用于控制生成内容的随机性。

取值范围：[-1, 2^32-1]之间的整数。
seed.description_en:
Seed integer, used to control the randomness of generated content.

Value range: integers from -1 to 2^32-1 (inclusive).

service_tier.description_cn:
> 不支持修改已提交任务的服务等级
> Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast 不支持离线推理

指定处理本次请求的服务等级类型，枚举值：

- default：在线推理模式，RPM 和并发数配额较低（详见 [模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310?lang=zh#2705b333)），适合对推理时效性要求较高的场景。

- flex：离线推理模式，TPD 配额更高（详见 [模型列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310?lang=zh#2705b333)），价格为在线推理的 50%， 适合对推理时延要求不高的场景。
service_tier.description_en:
> Modifying the service level of submitted tasks is not supported
> Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast do not support offline inference

Specify the service level type for processing this request. Enum values:

- default: Online inference mode, with lower RPM and concurrency quotas (see [Model List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310?lang=zh#2705b333)), suitable for scenarios where inference timeliness is critical.

- flex: Offline inference mode, with higher TPD quotas (see [Model List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1330310?lang=zh#2705b333)), priced at half the rate of online inference, suitable for scenarios where inference latency requirements are not high.

tools.description_cn:
> 仅 Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast 支持
配置模型要调用的工具。
tools.description_en:
> Supported only by Seedance 2.0 & 2.0 fast
Configure the tools to be called by the model.

tools.type.description_cn:
指定使用的工具类型。

- web_search：联网搜索工具。[阅读教程](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2291680?lang=zh#c40ed3ef) 获取详细代码示例。
tools.type.description_en:
Specify the type of tool to use.

- web_search: Online search tool. [Read the tutorial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2291680?lang=zh#c40ed3ef) for detailed code examples.

watermark.description_cn:
生成视频是否包含水印。

- false：不含水印。
- true：含有水印。
watermark.description_en:
Whether the generated video contains a watermark.

- false: Does not contain a watermark.
- true: Contains a watermark.

AgenticStrategy.description_cn: Agentic 接入点策略。`IsAgentic=true` 时必填，包含技能和上下文配置。
AgenticStrategy.description_en: Agentic access point policy. Required when `IsAgentic=true`, includes skill and context configuration.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.description_cn: Agentic 上下文配置。创建接口中 `IsAgentic=true` 时必填。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.description_en: Agentic context configuration. Required when `IsAgentic=true` in the creation interface.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.AgenticCo.description_cn: 上下文数据的 TOS 存储位置。创建 Agentic 接入点时必填；ObjectKey 非空时必须以 `/` 结尾且不能包含 `//`。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.AgenticCo.description_en: TOS storage location for context data. Required when creating an Agentic access point; if ObjectKey is not empty, it must end with '/' and cannot contain '//'.
TOS Bucket name. Currently, only buckets in the North China 2 (cn-beijing) Region are supported.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.Compressi.description_cn:
是否启用上下文压缩。取值：
- true：启用
- false：不启用
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.Compressi.description_en:
Whether to enable context compression. Values:
- true: Enabled
- false: Not enabled

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_cn: 注入沙箱进程的环境变量键值对（map<string,string>）。变量名长度为 1～63，必须以字母开头且仅包含字母、数字和下划线，不能以 `ARK_` 开头。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_en: Environment variable key-value pairs injected into the sandbox process (map<string,string>). Variable names must be 1–63 characters long, start with a letter, and contain only letters, digits, and underscores. Variable names must not start with `ARK_`.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_cn: 沙箱预安装软件包配置。
通过 APT 预安装的系统软件包列表。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_en: List of system software packages pre-installed via APT.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_cn: 通过 NPM 预安装的 Node.js 软件包列表。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_en: List of Node.js packages pre-installed via NPM.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_cn: 通过 PIP 预安装的 Python 软件包列表。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.SandboxCo.description_en: List of Python packages pre-installed via PIP.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.WebSearch.description_cn: 是否启用联网搜索。未配置时按启用处理。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.WebSearch.description_en: Whether to enable network search. If not configured, it will be treated as enabled.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticContext.WebSearch.description_cn: 每轮最大搜索次数，取值范围为 1～50。

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.description_cn: Agentic 接入点的内置技能（Skill）配置。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.description_en: Configuration of built-in skills (Skill) for Agentic access point.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_cn: 技能实例的 ID。当 `Type=Custom` 时为自定义技能 ID，`Type=Sharing` 时为共享技能 ID。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_en: The ID of the skill instance. When `Type=Custom`, this is the custom skill ID; when `Type=Sharing`, this is the shared skill ID.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_cn:
技能实例的类型。取值：
- `Custom`：账号私有的自定义技能。
- `Sharing`：平台共享的公开技能。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_en:
The type of the skill instance. Valid values:
- `Custom`: A custom skill private to the account.
- `Sharing`: A public skill shared on the platform.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_cn: 技能实例的语义化版本号，例如 `1.0.0`。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_en: The semantic version number of the skill instance, for example, `1.0.0`.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_cn: 技能实例的版本 ID，用于唯一定位某个具体版本；不填时默认使用 `Version` 对应的最新版本。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.AgenticSkil.description_en: The version ID of the skill instance, used to uniquely identify a specific version. If not specified, the latest version corresponding to `Version` is used by default.

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.Enabled.description_cn: 是否启用 Agentic 内置技能能力。

AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.Mode.description_cn:
技能模式。取值：
- `Auto`：由模型自动决定使用哪些内置技能。
- `Custom`：仅使用 `AgenticSkillInfos` 中显式指定的技能。
AgenticStrategy.AgenticSkill.Mode.description_en:
Skill mode. Possible values:
- `Auto`: The model automatically determines which built-in skills to use.
- `Custom`: Only the skills explicitly specified in `AgenticSkillInfos` are used.

AllowDataCollected.description_cn:
是否授权采集接入点推理数据。取值：
- true：授权采集；
- false（默认）：不授权采集。
> AICC 接入点必须为 false。
AllowDataCollected.description_en:
Authorize the collection of inference data at access points. Value options:
- true: authorize collection;
- false (default): do not authorize collection.
> AICC access points must be set to false.

BatchOnly.description_cn:
是否仅支持批量推理（Batch Chat）。取值：
- true：仅支持批量推理；
- false（默认）：支持常规推理。
> 仅 Ark 接入点支持该配置；MLP 接入点不支持该模式。
BatchOnly.description_en:
Is only batch inference (Batch Chat) supported? Values:
- true: Only batch inference is supported;
- false (default): Regular inference is supported.
> Only the Ark endpoint supports this configuration; the MLP endpoint does not support this mode.

ContentGeneration.description_cn: 图像/视频生成模型的并发与任务创建限流配置。
ContentGeneration.description_en: Concurrency and task creation rate limiting configuration for image/video generation models.

ContentGeneration.ConcurrentRequestsFor4.description_cn: 图像/视频 4K 生成任务的并发请求数上限。仅在支持 4K 生成的模型下生效。
ContentGeneration.ConcurrentRequestsFor4.description_en: Concurrent request limit for image/video 4K generation tasks. Only effective for models that support 4K generation.

ContentGeneration.CreateTaskRpm.description_cn: 每分钟可创建的任务数上限
ContentGeneration.CreateTaskRpm.description_en: Maximum number of tasks that can be created per minute

ContentGeneration.CreateTaskRpmFor4K.description_cn: 图像/视频 4K 生成任务每分钟创建数上限。仅在支持 4K 生成的模型下生效。
ContentGeneration.CreateTaskRpmFor4K.description_en: Maximum number of 4K image/video generation tasks that can be created per minute. Effective only for models that support 4K generation.

DataDelivery.description_cn:
是否开启数据回流，仅对支持该能力的模型生效。取值：
- true：开启；
- false（默认）：关闭。

DedicatedToDynamicPTU.description_cn:
是否创建专属动态 PTU 接入点。取值：
- true：创建；
- false（默认）：不创建。

DedicatedToPTU.description_cn:
是否创建专属 PTU 接入点。取值：
- true：创建；
- false（默认）：不创建。

DeploymentType.description_cn:
部署类型。取值：
- `standard`（默认）：标准部署；
- `global`：全局部署；
- `regional`：区域部署；仅当当前账号和基础模型已开通该能力时可选。。

Description.description_cn: 接入点描述。
Description.description_en: Endpoint description.

Domain.description_cn:
接入点类型。取值：
- `Ark`（默认）：方舟接入点；
- `Mlp`：机器学习平台服务接入点；
- `Foundry`：推理代工接入点。

DryRun.description_cn:
是否仅校验请求而不实际创建接入点。
- true：仅校验，不实际创建；
- false（默认）：正式创建。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only validate the request without actually creating the access point.
- true: Only validate, do not actually create.
- false (default): Create the access point.

Fallback.description_cn: 模型回退配置。AICC 接入点不能启用回退。
Fallback.description_en: Model fallback configuration. Fallback cannot be enabled for AICC access points.

Fallback.CandidateModels.description_cn: 备选模型列表。按顺序依次尝试，直到某个模型调用成功。
Fallback.CandidateModels.description_en: Candidate model list. Models are tried in sequence until one is successfully called.

Fallback.NeedFallback.description_cn: 是否启用模型回退（Fallback）。取值 `true` 时，若主模型调用失败会自动切换到 `CandidateModels` 中的备选模型。
Fallback.NeedFallback.description_en: Whether to enable model fallback. When set to `true`, if the primary model invocation fails, it will automatically switch to a backup model in `CandidateModels`.

InferenceFoundry.description_cn: 推理代工配置。`Domain=Foundry` 时必填，且创建时必须配置 `InferenceFoundryPerformance`；创建接口不支持设置 `AutoHibernatedDuration`。
InferenceFoundry.description_en: Inference foundry configuration. Required when `Domain=Foundry`, and `InferenceFoundryPerformance` must be configured during creation; the creation API does not support setting `AutoHibernatedDuration`.

InferenceFoundry.AutoHibernatedDuration.description_cn: 接入点空闲自动休眠时长，单位秒。达到该时长未收到请求则自动休眠，0 表示不自动休眠。
InferenceFoundry.AutoHibernatedDuration.description_en: Idle automatic sleep duration for the access point, in seconds. If no requests are received within this duration, the access point will automatically enter sleep mode. A value of 0 means automatic sleep is disabled.

InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_cn: 推理代工接入点的性能档位配置：性能等级、TPM 上限以及计算单元费率上限。
InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_en: Performance tier configuration for inference outsourcing access points: performance level, TPM limit, and compute unit rate limit.

InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_cn: 接入点单实例每小时费率上限，单位元/小时，保留两位小数（例如 `12.50`）。
InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_en: Maximum hourly rate per access point instance, in yuan/hour, with two decimal places retained (for example, `12.50`).

InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_cn: 推理代工接入点的性能等级档位。
InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_en: The performance tier of the inference outsourcing access point.

InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_cn: 推理代工接入点该性能档位下的每分钟 Token 数量上限。
InferenceFoundry.InferenceFoundryPerform.description_en: The maximum number of tokens per minute for the inference outsourcing access point at this performance tier.

IntelligentRouter.description_cn: 智能路由配置。`IsIntelligent=true` 时必填。

IntelligentRouter.BaselineModel.CustomMo.description_cn: 定制模型的ID。可通过 [`ListCustomModels`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262846?lang=zh) 接口查询。
IntelligentRouter.BaselineModel.CustomMo.description_en: Custom model ID. You can query it via the [`ListCustomModels`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262846?lang=zh) API.

IntelligentRouter.CandidateModels.description_cn: 候选模型列表。Mode 为 `CandidateSet` 或 `Ordered` 时必填；Mode 为 `Automatic` 时可为空。
IntelligentRouter.CandidateModels.description_en: Candidate model list. Required when Mode is `CandidateSet` or `Ordered`; optional when Mode is `Automatic`.

IntelligentRouter.CandidateModels.Custom.description_cn: 定制模型的ID。可通过 [`ListCustomModels`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262846?lang=zh) 接口查询。
IntelligentRouter.CandidateModels.Custom.description_en: Custom model ID. You can query it via the [`ListCustomModels`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262846?lang=zh) API.

IntelligentRouter.Mode.description_cn:
路由模式。取值：
- `Automatic`：自动模式
- `CandidateSet`：候选模型集合模式
- `Ordered`：按顺序路由模式
IntelligentRouter.Mode.description_en:
Routing modes. Values:
- `Automatic`: Automatic mode
- `CandidateSet`: Candidate model set mode
- `Ordered`: Ordered routing mode

IntelligentRouter.Strategy.description_cn:
路由策略。取值：
- `EffectFirst`：效果优先
- `CostFirst`：成本优先
- `Balanced`：均衡
IntelligentRouter.Strategy.description_en:
Routing policy. Possible values:
- `EffectFirst`: Effect is prioritized
- `CostFirst`: Cost is prioritized
- `Balanced`: Balanced

IsAgentic.description_cn:
是否创建 Agentic 接入点。取值：
- true：创建，且需配置 `AgenticStrategy`；
- false（默认）：不创建，且不可配置 `AgenticStrategy`。

IsAicc.description_cn:
是否创建 AICC 安全接入点。取值：
- true：创建。开启后不能授权数据采集或启用模型回退，并需满足 AICC 白名单与地域要求。
- false（默认）：不创建。
IsAicc.description_en:
Whether to create an AICC secure access point. Values:
- true: Create. Once enabled, data collection authorization and model rollback cannot be granted, and you must meet the AICC Allowlist and region requirements.
- false (default): Do not create.

IsIntelligent.description_cn:
是否创建智能路由接入点。取值：
- true：创建；
- false（默认）：不创建。

LimitCoefficient.description_cn: 模型级限流系数开关配置。

LimitCoefficient.NeedLimitCoefficient.description_cn: 是否为该接入点启用模型级限流系数（LimitCoefficient）。
LimitCoefficient.NeedLimitCoefficient.description_en: Should the model-level rate limiting coefficient (LimitCoefficient) be enabled for this access point?

ModelReference.description_cn: 接入点使用的模型引用。普通 Ark 接入点可指定基础模型或定制模型；`Domain=Foundry` 时必须指定 `CustomModelId`。
ModelReference.description_en: Model reference used by the endpoint. Standard Ark endpoints can specify a base model or a custom model; when `Domain=Foundry`, `CustomModelId` must be specified.

ModelReference.CustomModelId.description_cn: 定制模型的ID。可通过 [`ListCustomModels`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262846?lang=zh) 接口查询。
ModelReference.CustomModelId.description_en: Custom model ID. You can query it via the [`ListCustomModels`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262846?lang=zh) API.

ModelUnitId.description_cn: 模型单元 ID。不传表示按量付费；传入表示使用对应预付费模型单元。
ModelUnitId.description_en: Model unit ID. If not provided, pay-as-you-go is used; if provided, the corresponding prepaid model unit is used.

Moderation.description_cn: 内容安全护栏配置。使用 `Customized` 策略时需同时配置 `CustomizedModerationInfos`。
Moderation.description_en: Content safety guardrail configuration. When using the `Customized` strategy, you must also configure `CustomizedModerationInfos`.

Moderation.CustomizedModerationInfos.description_en: Custom Volcano content moderation configuration list. Required when `Strategy=Customized`.

Moderation.CustomizedModerationInfos.App.description_en: AppID of the Volcano Content Review Service.

Moderation.CustomizedModerationInfos.Biz.description_en: Business identifier (BizType) of the Volcano Content Moderation Service.

Moderation.Strategy.description_en:
Content Safety Guardrail Solution. Available values:
- `Default` (default): Lower latency, broadly covers general content safety requirements.
- `Basic`: Basic solution (currently in public beta). Supports returning the triggered risk categories in the response (currently only includes two categories: severe violations and aggressive behavior).

- `Customized`: Customized Volcano content moderation solution. Requires specifying moderation scenario, risk type, Volcano account AppID, and BizType via `CustomizedModerationInfos`.
It is not recommended to use `Basic` in streaming scenarios, as it may lead to increased response latency.

Name.description_cn: 接入点名称。

NeedWatermark.description_cn:
是否为生成内容添加水印。取值：
- true：添加水印。开启时需根据模型能力配置 `WatermarkInfo`。
- false（默认）：不添加水印。
NeedWatermark.description_en:
Whether to add a watermark to generated content. Values:
- true: Add a watermark. When enabled, configure `WatermarkInfo` according to model capabilities.
- false (default): Do not add a watermark.

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称。不传时默认为 `default`。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name. If not provided, defaults to `default`.

RateLimit.description_cn: 接入点限流配置。不传时使用模型默认限流。
RateLimit.description_en: Endpoint rate limiting configuration. If not specified, the model's default rate limit is used.

RateLimit.FastTpm.description_cn: 每分钟低延迟 token 数量。仅对已适配低延迟能力的模型生效，未启用时可忽略该字段。支持低延迟的模型请在[开通管理](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:ark+cn-beijing/openManagement?LLM=%7B%7D)中查看。
RateLimit.FastTpm.description_en: Number of low-latency tokens per minute. This field only applies to models adapted for low-latency capability and can be ignored if not enabled. To view models that support low-latency, please check [Open Management](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:ark+cn-beijing/openManagement?LLM=%7B%7D).

ServiceInfo.description_cn: MLP 服务信息。`Domain=Mlp` 时必填，其中 `Id` 和 `Region` 必填。
ServiceInfo.description_en: MLP service information. Required when `Domain=Mlp`, and both `Id` and `Region` are mandatory.

SpecifyRegion.description_cn: 指定 AICC 接入点部署地域。`IsAicc=false` 时必须为空；`IsAicc=true` 且不是专属 PTU 接入点时必填。
SpecifyRegion.description_en: Specify the deployment region for the AICC access point. Must be empty when `IsAicc=false`; required when `IsAicc=true` and not a dedicated PTU access point.

Tags.description_cn: 绑定到接入点的标签列表。
Tags.description_en: List of tags bound to the access point.

Description.description_cn: 滚动升级任务描述，会记录到滚动升级详情中。
Description.description_en: Rolling upgrade task description, which will be recorded in the rolling upgrade details.

DryRun.description_cn:
是否只校验请求而不实际创建滚动升级任务。取值：
- `true`：仅校验；
- `false`（默认）：创建任务。

EndpointId.description_cn: 待滚动升级的推理接入点 ID。可通过 [`CreateEndpoint`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262823?lang=zh) 接口返回结果、[`ListEndpoints`](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1262430?lang=zh) 接口或控制台获取。
EndpointId.description_en: ID of the inference endpoint pending rolling upgrade. EvaluationDatasets.TosLocation.description_en: Storage location in TOS for evaluation sets imported by the user

EvaluationDatasets.TosLocation.BucketNam.description_en: TOS Bucket name. Currently, only buckets in the North China 2 (cn-beijing) Region are supported.

EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_cn: 频率惩罚系数。如果值为正，会根据新 token 在文本中的出现频率对其进行惩罚，从而降低模型逐字重复的可能性。取值范围为 [-2.0, 2.0]
EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_en: Frequency penalty coefficient. If the value is positive, new tokens will be penalized based on their frequency in the text, reducing the likelihood of the model repeating itself word for word. Value range: [-2.0, 2.0]

EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_cn: 模型可以生成的最大 token 数量。取值范围为 [0, 4096]
EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_en: The maximum number of tokens the model can generate. Range: [0, 4096]

EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_cn: 模型遇到 stop 字段所指定的字符串时将停止继续生成，这个词语本身不会输出。最多支持 4 个字符串。
EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_en: The model will stop generating when it encounters any of the strings specified in the stop field. These strings themselves will not be included in the output. Up to 4 strings are supported.

EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_cn: 采样温度。控制了生成文本时对每个候选词的概率分布进行平滑的程度。取值范围为 [0, 1]
EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_en: Sampling temperature. Controls the degree of smoothing applied to the probability distribution over candidate words during text generation. Value range: [0, 1]

EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_cn: 指定每个输出 token 位置最有可能返回的 token 数量，每个 token 都有关联的对数概率。仅当 logprobs: true 时可以设置 top_logprobs 参数，取值范围为 [0, 20]
EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_en: Specifies the number of most likely tokens to return at each output token position, with each token associated with a log probability. The top_logprobs parameter can only be set when logprobs: true, and its value must be within the range [0, 20].

EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_cn: 核采样概率阈值。模型会考虑概率质量在 top_p 内的 token 结果。取值范围为 [0, 1]
EvaluationJobSettings.InferenceParameter.description_en: Nucleus sampling probability threshold. The model considers tokens whose cumulative probability mass falls within the top_p value. Valid range: [0, 1]

EvaluationJobSettings.LLMJudgeMetricSyst.description_cn: 裁判模型 system prompt - 描述评估指标
EvaluationJobSettings.LLMJudgeMetricSyst.description_en: Judge Model system prompt - Describe Evaluation Metrics

EvaluationJobSettings.ResultTosLocation..description_en: TOS Bucket name. Currently, only buckets in the North China 2 (cn-beijing) Region are supported.

CustomizationType.description_en: Training type. Possible values: FinetuneSft (Full SFT), FinetuneLoRA (SFT-LoRA), Pretrain (Continued pretraining), DPOLoRA (DPO-LoRA)

Data.KMSTrn.description_en: Encryption key TRN, obtainable from KMS. When EncryptionKeyringType is set to ManagedKeyring (default), it is generated automatically and cannot be entered manually. If set to CustomKeyring, this field is required.

Data.TrainingSet.Datasets.SampleCount.description_en: Number of samples collected by sampling

Data.TrainingSet.PresetData.description_cn: 预置数据集名称，不填不适用预置数据集

Data.TrainingSet.PresetDataPercentage.description_cn: 预置数据集使用百分比（0-100），仅在填写了 PresetData 时有效
Data.TrainingSet.PresetDataPercentage.description_en: Preset dataset usage percentage (0-100). Only effective when PresetData is specified.

Data.TrainingSet.PresetDatasets.InjectSa.description_cn: 预置数据集混入的样本数
Data.TrainingSet.PresetDatasets.InjectSa.description_en: Number of samples mixed in from the preset dataset

Data.TrainingSet.TosBucket.description_en: TOS bucket name. Must be specified together with TosPaths. When this field is not empty, TOS data will be used directly for training. Cannot be used together with Datasets.

Data.TrainingSet.TosPaths.description_cn: TOS 存储路径，需与 TosBucket 同时存在，当此字段不为空时表示使用直接使用 TOS 数据训练，不可与 Datasets 同时存在。
Data.TrainingSet.TosPaths.description_en: The TOS storage path must be specified together with TosBucket. When this field is not empty, it indicates that TOS data will be used directly for training. It cannot be used together with Datasets.

Data.ValidationPercentage.description_cn: 使用训练集数据作为验证集的比例（0-100）
Data.ValidationPercentage.description_en: Proportion of training set data used as validation set (0-100)

Data.ValidationSet.Datasets.SampleCount.description_en: Number of samples collected by sampling

Data.ValidationSet.TosBucket.description_en: TOS bucket name. Must be used together with TosPaths. When this field is not empty, it indicates that TOS data is used directly. Cannot be used together with Datasets.

Data.ValidationSet.TosPaths.description_cn: TOS 存储路径，需与 TosBucket 同时存在，当此字段不为空时表示使用直接使用 TOS 数据，不可与 Datasets 同时存在。
Data.ValidationSet.TosPaths.description_en: TOS storage path. Must be used together with TosBucket. When this field is not empty, it indicates that TOS data is used directly. Cannot be used together with Datasets.

EndTime.description_en:
Task end time (UTC Unix timestamp, in seconds).
Valid range: `EndTime - StartTime ≤ 10800`, maximum time span is 3 hours.

StartTime.description_cn:
任务起始时间（UTC Unix 时间戳，单位：秒）。
取值范围：`StartTime ≥ 1777593600`（对应 UTC 时间： `2026-05-01 00:00`）。
StartTime.description_en:
Task start time (UTC Unix timestamp, unit: seconds).
Value range: `StartTime ≥ 1777593600` (corresponds to UTC time: `2026-05-01 00:00`).

DryRun.description_cn: 是否仅校验不下单。设为 `true` 时，仅完成参数、额度全链路校验，不占用席位且不执行扣款，适用于上线前预校验场景。默认值为 `false` 。
DryRun.description_en: Whether to perform validation only without placing an order. When set to `true`, only parameter and limit full-chain validation is performed; no slot is occupied and no deduction is made. This is suitable for pre-launch validation scenarios. The default value is `false`.

- `CodingPlanTeam`: Coding Plan Enterprise Edition

ProjectName.description_en: Project name. If the parameter is not provided or is empty, `default` will be used; if a non-existent project is specified, a `NotFound.ProjectName` error will be returned.

Seats.description_cn:
席位配置明细列表。配置规则如下：
- 当 Plan 为 `AgentPlanTeam` 时：最多支持 4 项配置，分别对应 `Small`、`Medium`、`Large`、`Max`
- 当 Plan 为 `CodingPlanTeam` 时：最多支持 2 项配置，分别对应 `Lite` 、`Pro`
- 单次请求内不允许存在重复 `PlanType`，重复将返回 `Duplicated.PlanType`错误
Seats.description_en:
Seat configuration details list. Configuration rules are as follows:
- When Plan is `AgentPlanTeam`: Up to 4 configurations are supported, corresponding to `Small`, `Medium`, `Large`, and `Max`.
- When Plan is `CodingPlanTeam`: Up to 2 configurations are supported, corresponding to `Lite` and `Pro`.
- Duplicate `PlanType` values are not allowed within a single request; duplicates will return a `Duplicated.PlanType` error.

Seats.AutoRenew.description_cn: 是否开启自动续费，默认值为 `false` 。设为 `true` 时，套餐到期前将从云账户余额自动续费，仅支持单次续费。
Seats.AutoRenew.description_en: Whether to enable automatic renewal. The default value is `false`. When set to `true`, the package will be automatically renewed from the cloud account balance before expiration, and only one-time renewal is supported.

Seats.Duration.description_cn: 订购时长，单位以 `PricingCycle` 为准，取值范围 `1 ~ 12`。
Seats.Duration.description_en: Order duration, measured in `PricingCycle`. Valid values: `1 ~ 12`.

Seats.PlanType.description_cn:
套餐档位。支持以下套餐类型及档位取值：
- `AgentPlanTeam` ：`Small` 、`Medium`、`Large`、`Max`
- `CodingPlanTeam` ：`Lite`、`Pro`
- 单次请求内不允许存在重复 `PlanType`，重复将返回 `Duplicated.PlanType` 错误
Seats.PlanType.description_en:
Plan tiers. The following plan types and tier values are supported:
- `AgentPlanTeam`: `Small`, `Medium`, `Large`, `Max`
- `CodingPlanTeam`: `Lite`, `Pro`
- Duplicate `PlanType` values are not allowed within a single request; otherwise, a `Duplicated.PlanType` error will be returned

Seats.PricingCycle.description_cn: 计费周期，当前仅支持 `Month`包月类型。
Seats.PricingCycle.description_en: Billing cycle: currently, only the `Month` monthly subscription type is supported.

Seats.SeatNumber.description_cn: 该档位创建的席位数量，需大于 0。企业版首次购买需满足：账号下已 `Active` 席位数 + 本次新购总数 ≥ 5。
Seats.SeatNumber.description_en: The number of seats created for this tier must be greater than 0. For the first purchase of the Enterprise Edition, the following requirement must be met: the number of `Active` seats under the account plus the total number of new seats purchased this time must be at least 5.

input.description_cn:
需要向量化的内容列表，支持中文、英文。输入字符需要满足：

- 不得超过模型的最大输入 token 数。

- 不能为空列表，列表的每个成员不能为空字符串。
- 单条文本以 utf-8 编码，长度不超过 100,000 字节。
- 文本数量不超过 256 条。
input.description_en:
List of content to be vectorized; supports both Chinese and English. Input text must meet the following requirements:

- Must not exceed the model's maximum input token limit.
- The list cannot be empty, and each item in the list must not be an empty string.
- Each text entry must be UTF-8 encoded and no longer than 100,000 bytes.
- The total number of text entries must not exceed 256.
input.example_en: ["The sky is very blue","The sea is very deep"]

input.description_cn:
需要向量化的内容列表。注意：

- type 可为`text`、`image_url`，且每种类型最多1个
在处理不同类型的输入内容（包括纯文本、纯图片以及图文混排）时，系统会生成一定数量的文本 tokens（约 20 个）以辅助模型完成推理任务。
input.description_en:
List of content to be vectorized. Note:

- The type can be either `text` or `image_url`, with a maximum of one for each type.
When processing different types of input (including plain text, images, or mixed text and images), the system will generate a certain number of text tokens (approximately 20) to assist the model in completing the inference task.

input.image_url.description_cn:
当`tpye`设置为`image_url`时，输入图片信息。

- url \[String\]：必选，支持传入图片URL或图片Base64编码。
	- 传入图片URL：需确保图片URL可被访问。
	- 传入Base64编码：请遵循格式`data:image/{图片格式};base64,{Base64编码}`：
		- `{图片格式}`：支持多种格式，参见下面的**图片要求**。
		- `{Base64编码}`：图片的Base64编码。
	- **图片要求**：
		- 格式：支持多种格式，具体请参见[图片格式说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1409290#93dcee4d)。
		- 尺寸：具体请参见[图片尺寸说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1409290#bc1f8450)。
		- 大小：单图最大 10 MB。
input.image_url.description_en:
When `type` is set to `image_url`, enter the image information.

- url [String]: Required. Supports providing either an image URL or an image Base64 encoding.
	- If providing an image URL: Ensure the image URL is accessible.
	- If providing a Base64 encoding: Follow the format `data:image/{image format};base64,{Base64 encoding}`:
		- `{image format}`: Multiple formats are supported. See **Image Requirements** below.
		- `{Base64 encoding}`: The Base64 encoding of the image.
	- **Image Requirements**:
		- Format: Multiple formats are supported. For details, see [Image Format Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1409290#93dcee4d).
		- Dimensions: For details, see [Image Size Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1409290#bc1f8450).
		- Size: Maximum size per image is 10 MB.

input.text.description_cn:
当`tpye`设置为`text`时，输入文本信息。

- 单条文本以 utf-8 编码，长度不超过 100,000 字节。
- 单条文本不超过模型的最大输入 token 数为 8k。
input.text.description_en:
When `tpye` is set to `text`, enter the text information.

- Each text entry must be encoded in UTF-8 and not exceed 100,000 bytes in length.
- Each text entry must not exceed the model's maximum input token limit of 8k.

input.type.description_cn:
支持`text` 或 `image_url`，传入的信息类型。

- 传入信息为文本信息设置为`text`。
- 传入信息为图片信息设置为`image_url`。
input.type.description_en:
Supports `text` or `image_url` as the input type.

- Set to `text` for text input.
- Set to `image_url` for image input.

Filters.Key.description_cn:
表示过滤字段，目前支持：
由于安全升级，用量查询能力将调整为基于 ApiKeyID 的查询方式。
- 2026‑08‑12 及之后创建的 API Key，仅支持通过 ApiKeyID 查询用量，不再支持 AuthToken 查询方式。
- 2026‑08‑12 之前创建的存量 API Key，当前同时兼容 AuthToken 与 ApiKeyID 两种用量查询方式；其中 AuthToken 查询方式即将下线。**为避免业务受影响，请您尽快将业务逻辑切换至 ApiKeyID 进行用量查询。**

- AuthToken：鉴权token
	- 若为jwt token鉴权，则默认为\*\*\*\*
		
	- 若为apikey鉴权：
		- 传统格式 APIKey：取前 8 位 + `****` + 后 12 位字符，示例：`37efcc63****92c8fe4c880e`
		- 新版方舟 APIKey：取前 3 位 + `****` + 后 5 位字符，示例：`ark****d5b88`
- ApikeyID：API Key 对应的资源ID。
在按 API Key 维度统计用量的场景中，会出现不同命名，**实际指向同一个 API Key 唯一标识**，仅命名存在差异，对应关系如下：
- 资源 ID（Resource ID）：火山方舟控制台 “API Key 管理” 页面展示的列名。
- ApikeyID / apikey_id：分账账单系统中的分账维度名称，以及查账单 API 过滤条件 Filters 的键名。

您可以前往方舟控制台的 [API Key 管理](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:ark+cn-beijing/apiKey?apikey=%7B%7D)页面，在对应 API Key 的详情中查看并复制"资源 ID"。请注意，资源 ID 并非 API Key 密钥本身，请勿将API Key密钥作为APIKeyID 传入。

		
- ModelUnitID：模型单元ID
	
- BillingStatus：计费方式，后付费按量计费值为normal
	- no\_need\_billing：表示无需付费，一般是由于客户未开通前体验的用量
		
	- free\_for\_model\_unit：表示模型单元用量
		
	- free\_for\_free\_quota/free\_for\_limit\_boundary：表示超过安心体验边界的用量
		
	- normal：表示正常后付费按量计费用量
		
	- free\_for\_viptier：表示tpm保障包用量
		
- ModelName：模型名称
	
- ModelVersion：模型版本
	
- ModelEndpoint：接入点ID
	
- BatchJobID：批量任务ID
	
- EndpointName：接入点名称
	
- BatchType: 批量推理类型
Filters.Key.description_en:
Indicates filter fields. Currently supported:
Due to security upgrades, usage query capabilities will be adjusted to be based on ApiKeyID.
- API Keys created on or after 2026‑08‑12 will only support usage queries via ApiKeyID and will no longer support AuthToken queries.
- Existing API Keys created before 2026‑08‑12 currently support both AuthToken and ApiKeyID usage query methods; however, AuthToken queries will soon be discontinued. **To avoid business impact, please switch your business logic to use ApiKeyID for usage queries as soon as possible.**

- AuthToken: Authentication token
	- If using jwt token authentication, the default is ****
	
	- If using apikey authentication:
		- Traditional format APIKey: First 8 characters + `****` + last 12 characters, example: `37efcc63****92c8fe4c880e`
		- New Ark APIKey: First 3 characters + `****` + last 5 characters, example: `ark****d5b88`
- ApikeyID: Resource ID corresponding to the API Key.
In scenarios where usage is counted by API Key, different naming conventions may appear, but **they actually refer to the same unique API Key identifier**. Only the naming differs. The mapping is as follows:
- Resource ID: The column name displayed on the "API Key Management" page in the Volcano Ark console.
- ApikeyID / apikey_id: The account dimension name in the billing system, and the key name for the Filters condition in the bill query API.

You can go to the Ark console's [API Key Management](https://console.volcengine.com/ark/region:ark+cn-beijing/apiKey?apikey=%7B%7D) page, view and copy the "Resource ID" in the details of the corresponding API Key. Please note, the Resource ID is not the API Key secret itself. Do not use the API Key secret as the APIKeyID.

	
- ModelUnitID: Model unit ID
	
- BillingStatus: Billing method. The value for postpaid, pay-as-you-go is normal
	- no_need_billing: Indicates no payment required, usually due to usage before activation
	
	- free_for_model_unit: Indicates model unit usage
	
	- free_for_free_quota/free_for_limit_boundary: Indicates usage beyond the safe experience boundary
	
	- normal: Indicates regular postpaid, pay-as-you-go usage
	
	- free_for_viptier: Indicates TPM protection package usage
	
- ModelName: Model name
	
- ModelVersion: Model version
	
- ModelEndpoint: Endpoint ID
	
- BatchJobID: Batch job ID
	
- EndpointName: Endpoint name
	
- BatchType: Batch inference type

guidance_scale.description_cn:
> doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i 默认值 2.5
> doubao-seededit-3.0-i2i 默认值 5.5
> doubao-seedream-5.0-lite/4.5/4.0 不支持

模型输出结果与prompt的一致程度，生成图像的自由度，又称为文本权重；值越大，模型自由度越小，与用户输入的提示词相关性越强。

取值范围：[1, 10] 。
guidance_scale.description_en:
> doubao-seedream-3.0-t2i default value 2.5
> doubao-seededit-3.0-i2i default value 5.5
> doubao-seedream-5.0-lite/4.5/4.0 not supported

The degree of consistency between the model output and the prompt, as well as the freedom in generating images, also known as text weight; the higher the value, the lower the model's freedom, and the stronger the correlation with the user's input prompt.

Value range: [1, 10].

prompt.example_en: Generate a set of 4 coherent illustrations, centered on the seasonal changes of the same corner of a courtyard, showcasing the unique colors, elements, and atmosphere of each season in a unified style.

response_format.description_cn:
指定生成图像的返回格式。支持以下两种返回方式：

- url：返回图片下载链接；链接在图片生成后24小时内有效，请及时下载图片。
- b64_json：以 Base64 编码字符串的 JSON 格式返回图像数据。
response_format.description_en:
Specify the return format for generated images. The following two return methods are supported:

- url: Returns a download link for the image; the link is valid for 24 hours after the image is generated, so please download the image promptly.
- b64_json: Returns the image data in JSON format as a Base64-encoded string.

The random seed is used to control the randomness of the model's generated content. The value range is [-1, 2147483647].

sequential_image_generation.description_cn:
> 仅 doubao-seedream-5.0-lite/4.5/4.0 支持该参数 | [查看组图输出示例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1824121?lang=zh#fc9f85e4)
控制是否关闭组图功能。
- auto：自动判断模式，模型会根据提供的提示词自主判断是否返回组图以及组图包含的图片数量。
- disabled：关闭组图功能，模型只会生成一张图。
sequential_image_generation.description_en:
> Only doubao-seedream-5.0-lite/4.5/4.0 support this parameter | [View group image output example](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1824121?lang=zh#fc9f85e4)
Controls whether to disable the group image feature.
- auto: Automatic mode. The model will independently determine whether to return a group image and the number of images in the group based on the provided prompt.
- disabled: Disables the group image feature. The model will generate only one image.

> 仅 doubao-seedream-5.0-lite/4.5/4.0 支持该参数 | [查看流式输出示例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1824121?lang=zh#e5bef0d7)

控制是否开启流式输出模式。

- false：非流式输出模式，等待所有图片全部生成结束后再一次性返回所有信息。

- true：流式输出模式，即时返回每张图片输出的结果。在生成单图和组图的场景，流式输出模式均生效。
stream.description_en:
> Only doubao-seedream-5.0-lite/4.5/4.0 support this parameter | [View streaming output example](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1824121?lang=zh#e5bef0d7)

Controls whether to enable streaming output mode.

- false: Non-streaming output mode. Wait until all images are generated before returning all information at once.

- true: Streaming output mode. Instantly returns the result for each generated image. Streaming output mode is effective in both single-image and multi-image generation scenarios.

实例挂起状态结束后执行的策略，如不填则表示遵循所属生命周期挂钩的策略。取值：
- CONTINUE：继续执行。
- REJECT：中止后续操作。
- ROLLBACK：针对弹性收缩活动，会拒绝释放ECS实例，进行回滚；针对弹性扩张活动，效果同REJECT一样。
 tip

LifecycleActivityPolicy.description_en:
Strategy executed after the instance exits the suspended state. If left blank, the strategy defined by the associated lifecycle hook will be used. Options:
- CONTINUE: Continue execution
- REJECT: Abort subsequent operations
- ROLLBACK: For scale-in activities, the ECS instance will not be released and the operation will roll back; for scale-out activities, this has the same effect as REJECT
 tip
For a detailed introduction to the instance change process after execution, see [Execution Process and Strategy](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5).

LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_cn:
云助手命令ID，表示触发生命周期挂钩后在实例中执行云助手命令。
- 如果命令执行成功，则按照CONTINUE执行挂起结束后的策略。
- 如果命令执行失败/超时或生命周期挂钩超时，则按照`LifecycleHookPolicy`参数的配置执行挂起结束后的策略。
 tip
关联云助手前，您需要首先创建所需的运维命令，并确认相关实例已安装云助手客户端。详细操作请参见[挂钩关联云助手功能介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)。
LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_en:
Cloud Assistant command ID, used to execute a Cloud Assistant command on the instance after a lifecycle hook is triggered
- If the command executes successfully, the post-suspension policy follows the CONTINUE action
- If the command fails, times out, or the lifecycle hook times out, the post-suspension policy follows the configuration of the `LifecycleHookPolicy` parameter
 tip
Before associating Cloud Assistant, create the required maintenance command and make sure the relevant instance has the Cloud Assistant client installed. For details, see [Introduction to associating Cloud Assistant with lifecycle hooks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)
