* 当`Protocol` 传入TCP、UDP、GRE或ALL时，可传入IPv4或IPv6类型的网段。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMP时，仅支持传入IPv4类型的网段。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMPV6时，仅支持传入IPv6类型的网段。

`DestinationCidrBlock`与`SourceCidrBlock`传入的IP类型应保持一致，例如，两者均为IPv4网段，或均为IPv6网段。
DestinationCidrBlock.description_en:
IPv4 CIDR or IPv6 CIDR of the destination address.

* When `Protocol` is set to TCP, UDP, GRE, or ALL, you can enter either an IPv4 or IPv6 subnet.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMP, only IPv4 subnets are supported.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMPV6, only IPv6 subnets are supported.

The IP types for `DestinationCidrBlock` and `SourceCidrBlock` must match. For example, both must be IPv4 subnets or both must be IPv6 subnets.

DestinationPortEnd.description_cn:
目的地址端口范围结束值。

* 当`Protocol` 传入TCP或UDP时，取值范围：**-1**、**1~65535**。-1表示不限制端口。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMP、ICMPV6、GRE或ALL时，仅支持传入-1，表示不限制端口。

`DestinationPortEnd`必须和`DestinationPortStart`传入相同的值。
DestinationPortEnd.description_en:
End value of the destination port range.

* When `Protocol` is set to TCP or UDP, valid values: **-1**, **1~65535**. -1 means no port restriction.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMP, ICMPV6, GRE, or ALL, only -1 is supported, meaning no port restriction.

`DestinationPortEnd` must be the same as `DestinationPortStart`.

DestinationPortStart.description_cn:
目的地址端口范围开始值。

* 当`Protocol` 传入TCP或UDP时，取值范围：**-1**、**1~65535**。-1表示不限制端口。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMP、ICMPV6、GRE或ALL时，仅支持传入-1，表示不限制端口。

`DestinationPortStart`必须和`DestinationPortEnd`传入相同的值。
DestinationPortStart.description_en:
Start value of the destination port range.

* When `Protocol` is set to TCP or UDP, valid values: **-1**, **1~65535**. -1 means no port restriction.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMP, ICMPV6, GRE, or ALL, only -1 is supported, meaning no port restriction.

`DestinationPortStart` must be the same as `DestinationPortEnd`.

DirectConnectTrafficQosPolicyId.description_cn: 流分类规则待关联流队列所属的QoS策略的ID。您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355651)查询QoS的ID。
DirectConnectTrafficQosPolicyId.description_en: ID of the QoS policy associated with the traffic queue for the traffic classification rule. You can call [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355651) to query the QoS ID.

DirectConnectTrafficQosQueueId.description_cn:
流分类规则待关联流队列的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosQueues](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355657)查询流队列的ID。
DirectConnectTrafficQosQueueId.description_en:
ID of the traffic queue to associate with the traffic classification rule.
You can call [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosQueues](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355657) to query the traffic queue ID.

DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleName.description_cn:
流分类规则的名称。

* 以中文、字母、数字开头，只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号（.）、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不填默认为流分类规则的ID。
DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleName.description_en:
Name of the traffic classification rule.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-) are allowed.
* Length: 1 to 128 characters.
* If not specified, the rule ID is used by default.

MatchDscp.description_cn: 流量进入专线网关之前携带的原有DSCP值。取值范围：**0**~**63。**
MatchDscp.description_en: The original DSCP value carried by the traffic before entering the dedicated gateway. Value range: **0**~**63.**

Priority.description_cn:
流分类规则的优先级。

* 取值范围：**1 ~ 10000**， 数字越小优先级越高。
* 在同一个 QoS策略内流分类规则的优先级不允许重复。
Priority.description_en:
Priority of the traffic classification rule.

* Value range: **1 ~ 10000**. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.
* Priority values for classification rules within the same QoS policy must be unique.

Protocol.description_cn:
协议类型。取值如下：

* ICMP
* ICMPV6
* TCP
* UDP
* GRE
* ALL（默认）：支持所有协议

专线连接IPv6功能正在邀测中，仅开通IPv6功能后协议类型可传入`ICMPV6`，如有需要请联系客户经理。
Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type. Valid values:

* ICMP
* ICMPV6
* TCP
* UDP
* GRE
* ALL (default): Supports all protocols

The IPv6 feature for dedicated connections is in invite-only testing. The protocol type can be set to `ICMPV6` only after enabling the IPv6 feature. Please contact your account manager if needed.

RemarkingDscp.description_cn: 为匹配当前流分类规则的流量设置的新DSCP值，用于对进入专线网关的流量进行分类标记。取值范围：**0~63**，如果不生效时取值为-1。
RemarkingDscp.description_en: Set a new DSCP value for traffic matching the current classification rule. This value is used to mark and classify traffic entering the dedicated gateway. Value range: **0~63**. If not effective, the value is -1.

SourceCidrBlock.description_cn:
源地址的IPv4 CIDR或IPv6 CIDR。

* 当`Protocol` 传入TCP、UDP、GRE或ALL时，可传入IPv4或IPv6类型的网段。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMP时，仅支持传入IPv4类型的网段。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMPV6时，仅支持传入IPv6类型的网段。

`DestinationCidrBlock`与`SourceCidrBlock`传入的IP类型应保持一致，例如，两者均为IPv4网段，或均为IPv6网段。
SourceCidrBlock.description_en:
IPv4 CIDR or IPv6 CIDR of the source address

* When `Protocol` is set to TCP, UDP, GRE, or ALL, you can specify either an IPv4 or IPv6 subnet.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMP, only IPv4 subnets are supported.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMPV6, only IPv6 subnets are supported.

The IP type specified for `DestinationCidrBlock` and `SourceCidrBlock` must be consistent. For example, both must be IPv4 subnets or both must be IPv6 subnets.

SourcePortEnd.description_cn:
源地址端口范围结束值。

* 当`Protocol` 传入TCP、UDP或ALL时，取值范围：**-1**、**1~65535**。-1表示不限制端口。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMP、ICMPV6或GRE时，仅支持传入-1，表示不限制端口。

`SourcePortEnd`必须和`SourcePortStart`传入相同的值。
SourcePortEnd.description_en:
End value of the source port range.

* When `Protocol` is set to TCP, UDP, or ALL, valid values: **-1**, **1~65535**. -1 means no port restriction.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMP, ICMPV6, or GRE, only -1 is supported, meaning no port restriction.

`SourcePortEnd` must be the same as `SourcePortStart`.

SourcePortStart.description_cn:
源地址端口范围开始值。

* 当`Protocol` 传入TCP、UDP或ALL时，取值范围为：**-1**、**1~65535**。-1表示不限制端口。
* 当`Protocol` 传入ICMP、ICMPV6或GRE时，仅支持传入-1，表示不限制端口。

`SourcePortStart`必须和`SourcePortEnd`传入相同的值。
SourcePortStart.description_en:
Start value for the source address port range.

* When `Protocol` is set to TCP, UDP, or ALL, the value range is: **-1**, **1~65535**. -1 means no port restriction.
* When `Protocol` is set to ICMP, ICMPV6, or GRE, only -1 is supported, indicating no port restriction.

`SourcePortStart` must be set to the same value as `SourcePortEnd`.

Bandwidth.description_cn:
虚拟接口的限速带宽，单位：Mbps。

* -1（默认）：不限速。
* 1～100000：虚拟接口出、入云方向的带宽上限，不可超过虚拟接口关联物理专线的带宽。您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705)查询物理专线的信息。
* 若虚拟接口关联的是共享专线，虚拟接口将继承共享专线的带宽，您无需传入此参数。如需传入，请确保传入的值与虚拟接口关联的共享专线带宽值一致，您可调用[DescribeSharedDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/108083)查询共享专线信息（共享专线功能当前正在邀测中，仅开通此功能的账号可使用此功能、可见配套文档，如有需要请联系客户经理申请试用）。
Bandwidth.description_en:
Bandwidth limit for the virtual interface, in Mbps

* -1 (default): No bandwidth limit
* 1–100000: Maximum bandwidth for the virtual interface in either direction (to or from the cloud). Cannot exceed the bandwidth of the associated physical dedicated connection. You can call [DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705) to query information about the physical dedicated connection
* If the virtual interface is associated with a shared dedicated connection, it inherits the bandwidth of the shared dedicated connection. You do not need to specify this parameter. If you do specify it, make sure the value matches the bandwidth of the associated shared dedicated connection. You can call [DescribeSharedDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/108083) to query information about shared dedicated connections (The shared dedicated connection feature is currently in invite-only testing. Only accounts with this feature enabled can use it and access related documentation. Contact your account manager to request a trial if needed)

BfdDetectInterval.description_cn: BFD检测时间间隔。单位：ms，取值范围：200～1000，默认1000。未开启BFD检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
BfdDetectInterval.description_en:
BFD Detection Interval
Unit: ms (200–1000), default: 1000
Do not set this parameter if BFD detection is disabled

BfdDetectMultiplier.description_cn: BFD检测次数。取值范围：3～10，默认3。未开启BFD检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
BfdDetectMultiplier.description_en: BFD detection count. Range: 3–10, default is 3. If BFD detection is disabled, do not specify this parameter

Description.description_cn:
虚拟接口的描述信息。

* 以中文、字母、数字开头，只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号（.）、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、中划线（-）、等号（=）、英文逗号（,）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Description for the virtual interface

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), spaces ( ), underscores (_), hyphens (-), equals signs (=), English commas (,), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。)
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* If this parameter is not specified or no value is provided, the default is an empty string

DirectConnectConnectionId.description_cn:
虚拟接口关联的物理专线的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705)接口，查询物理专线的ID。
DirectConnectConnectionId.description_en:
ID of the physical dedicated connection associated with the virtual interface
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705) API to query the ID of the physical dedicated connection

DirectConnectGatewayId.description_cn:
虚拟接口关联的专线网关的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口，查询专线网关的ID。
DirectConnectGatewayId.description_en:
ID of the dedicated connection gateway associated with the virtual interface.
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to query the gateway ID.

EnableBfd.description_cn:
是否开启BFD检测控制报文模式，取值如下：

* true：开启
* false（默认）：不开启
EnableBfd.description_en:
Enable BFD detection control packet mode. Options:

* true: Enable
* false (default): Disable

EnableBfdEcho.description_cn:
是否开启BFD检测echo报文模式，取值如下：

* true：开启
* false（默认）：不开启
EnableBfdEcho.description_en:
Enable BFD detection echo packet mode. Options:

* true: Enable
* false (default): Disable

EnableNqa.description_cn:
是否开启NQA检测功能，取值如下：

* true：开启
* false（默认）：不开启

仅`RouteType`为`Static`时，支持开启NQA检测功能。
EnableNqa.description_en:
Enable NQA detection. Options:

* true: Enable
* false (default): Disable

NQA detection is supported only when `RouteType` is `Static`.

LocalIp.description_cn: 虚拟接口的本端网关互联IP地址。
LocalIp.description_en: Local gateway interconnection IP address (virtual interface)

LocalIpv6Ip.description_cn: 虚拟接口本端网关互联IP的IPv6地址。
LocalIpv6Ip.description_en: IPv6 address of the local gateway interconnection IP for the virtual interface.

NqaDetectInterval.description_cn: NQA检测发送连续探测报文的时间间隔。单位：ms，取值：1000～5000，默认2000。未开启NQA检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
NqaDetectInterval.description_en: Time interval for sending consecutive probe packets during NQA detection (unit: ms; range: 1000–5000; default: 2000). If NQA detection is disabled, do not specify this parameter

NqaDetectMultiplier.description_cn:
NQA检测的时间次数，若NQA检测连续失败次数达到设定的检测次数，则判定此线路故障。取值：3～8 ，默认5。未开启NQA检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
开启NQA功能后，若线路流量几乎可达带宽上限，建议把检测次数设为`8`。
NqaDetectMultiplier.description_en:
Number of NQA test attempts. If the number of consecutive NQA test failures reaches the set value, the line is considered faulty. Value range: 3–8, default is 5. If NQA detection is not enabled, do not provide this parameter.
After enabling NQA, if the line traffic is close to the bandwidth limit, it is recommended to set the test attempts to `8`.

PeerIp.description_cn: 虚拟接口的对端网关互联IP地址。
PeerIp.description_en: Peer gateway IP address for virtual interface

PeerIpv6Ip.description_cn: 虚拟接口对端网关互联IP的IPv6地址。
PeerIpv6Ip.description_en: IPv6 address of the interconnection IP on the peer gateway of the virtual interface

RouteType.description_cn:
虚拟接口的路由类型，取值如下：

* BGP：BGP动态路由
* Static：静态路由
RouteType.description_en:
Routing type for the virtual interface. Valid values:

* BGP: BGP dynamic routing
* Static: Static routing

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
虚拟接口标签的标签键（Key）。

* 参数 - N - 参数：表示标签键（Key）的序号，取值范围：1、2、3、……、49、50，且N应按照连续的从小到大的顺序。
* 多个标签键（Key）之间用&分隔。
* 不能以 `volc:`和`sys:`开头，包括任意大小写形式。`volc:`和`sys:`开头为系统预留标签，禁止创建。
* 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key (Key) for the virtual interface.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key (Key). Value range: 1, 2, 3, ..., 49, 50. N must be in continuous ascending order.
* Separate multiple tag keys (Key) with &.
* Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys:`, regardless of case. Tags starting with `volc:` or `sys:` are reserved for the system and cannot be created.
* Length range: 1–128 characters. Supports input of letters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
虚拟接口标签的标签值（Value）。

* 参数 - N - 参数：表示标签值（Value）的序号，取值范围：1、2、3、……、49、50，且N应按照连续的从小到大的顺序。
* 多个标签值（Value）之间用&分隔。
* 长度取值范围为0～256字符，不填默认为空。
* 允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。

传入`Tags.N.Value`则必须传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for the virtual interface.

* Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value). Value range: 1, 2, 3, ..., 49, 50. N must be in continuous ascending order.
* Separate multiple tag values (Value) with &.
* Length range: 0–256 characters. If not specified, will be empty by default.
* Supports input of letters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).
* Case-sensitive. Cannot start or end with a space.

If `Tags.N.Value` is provided, `Tags.N.Key` must also be provided.

VirtualInterfaceName.description_cn:
虚拟接口的名称。

* 必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为虚拟接口实例的ID。
VirtualInterfaceName.description_en:
Name of the virtual interface

* Must start with a letter or Chinese character. Can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If this parameter is not specified or no value is provided, the default is the virtual interface instance ID

VlanId.description_cn:
用于连接本地IDC的VLAN ID，请确保此VLAN ID未被占用，取值范围：0 ～ 2999。

* 0：表示该物理专线交换机端口上不配置VLAN，使用三层路由接口模式，该模式下一条物理专线上只可创建一个无VLAN标签的虚拟接口。
* 1～2999：表示该物理专线的交换机端口采用三层子接口模式，每个子接口配置不同的VLAN ID对应到一个虚拟接口，该模式下一条物理专线上可以创建出多个虚拟接口。
VlanId.description_en:
VLAN ID used to connect to the local IDC. Make sure this VLAN ID is not already in use. Value range: 0–2999.

* 0: Indicates that no VLAN is configured on the physical dedicated connection switch port, using Layer 3 routing interface mode. In this mode, only one virtual interface without a VLAN tag can be created on a single physical dedicated connection.
* 1–2999: Indicates that the switch port of the physical dedicated connection uses Layer 3 subinterface mode. Each subinterface is configured with a different VLAN ID, corresponding to a virtual interface. In this mode, multiple virtual interfaces can be created on a single physical dedicated connection.

BgpPeerId.description_cn:
待删除BGP邻居的ID。
您可调用[DescribeBgpPeers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104726)查询BGP邻居的ID。
BgpPeerId.description_en:
ID of the BGP neighbor to be deleted
You can call [DescribeBgpPeers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104726) to query the BGP neighbor ID

DirectConnectConnectionId.description_cn:
待删除物理专线的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705)接口，查询物理专线的ID。
DirectConnectConnectionId.description_en:
ID of the physical direct connect connection to be deleted.
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705) API to query the ID of the physical direct connect connection.

DirectConnectGatewayId.description_cn:
待删除专线网关的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口，查询专线网关的ID。
DirectConnectGatewayId.description_en: ID of the Direct Connect Gateway to be deleted. You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to query the ID of the Direct Connect Gateway.

DirectConnectGatewayRouteId.description_cn:
待删除静态路由的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectGatewayRoutes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104720)查询专线网关静态路由的ID。
DirectConnectGatewayRouteId.description_en:
ID of the static route to be deleted
You can call [DescribeDirectConnectGatewayRoutes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104720) to query the ID of the static route for the Direct Connect Gateway

DirectConnectTrafficQosPolicyId.description_cn:
待删除的QoS策略的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355651)接口查询QoS策略的ID。
DirectConnectTrafficQosPolicyId.description_en:
ID of the QoS policy to be deleted.
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355651) API to query the QoS policy ID.

DirectConnectTrafficQosQueueId.description_cn:
待删除的流队列的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosQueues](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355657)接口查询流队列的ID。
DirectConnectTrafficQosQueueId.description_en:
ID of the traffic queue to be deleted.
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosQueues](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355657) API to query the traffic queue ID.

DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleId.description_cn:
待删除的流分类规则ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355661)接口查询流分类规则的ID。
DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleId.description_en:
ID of the traffic classification rule to be deleted.
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355661) API to query the ID of the traffic classification rule.

VirtualInterfaceId.description_cn:
待删除虚拟接口实例的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716)接口，查询虚拟接口实例的ID。
VirtualInterfaceId.description_en:
ID of the virtual interface instance to be deleted
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716) API to query the ID of the virtual interface instance

BgpPeerId.description_cn:

TagFilters.N.Values.description_cn:

参数 - N - 参数- N ：第一个N表示标签值对应标签键的序号，应与标签键TagFilters.N.Key的序号保持一致，取值范围：1、2、3、……、9、10，且N应按照连续的从小到大的顺序。第二个N表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1、2、3。
可不传入Value，表示查询时对Value不作限制。
如果传入的Value是空字符串，表示查询 Value 为空的标签。
如果同一个TagFilters.N.Key传入多个TagFilters.N.Values.N，多个TagFilters.N.Values.N之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”。
TagFilters.N.Values.description_en:
Tag value (Value) for cloud resource instances

Parameter - N - Parameter - N: The first N indicates the index of the tag key corresponding to the tag value, which should match the index of the tag key TagFilters.N.Key. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, …, 9, 10. N must be in consecutive ascending order. The second N indicates the index of the tag value, with valid values: 1, 2, 3.

You can omit Value to query without restricting Value.
If Value is an empty string, the query returns tags where Value is empty.
If you specify multiple TagFilters.N.Values.N for the same TagFilters.N.Key, these TagFilters.N.Values.N are combined using logical OR.

If this parameter is not specified, all tag values under the specified tag key and their associated CEN instances are queried.

* If not specified, the original configuration is retained.

DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleId.description_cn:
默认流分类规则的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355661)查询流分类规则的ID，查询结果中参数`DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleName`值为`Default`且参数`Priority`值为`65535`的一条即为默认流分类规则。
DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleId.description_en: ID of the default traffic classification rule. You can call [DescribeDirectConnectTrafficQosRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/1355661) to query the ID of the traffic classification rule. In the query results, the entry where the parameter `DirectConnectTrafficQosRuleName` is `Default` and the parameter `Priority` is `65535` is the default traffic classification rule.

RemarkingDscp.description_cn: 修改流量中的 DSCP 值。取值范围：0~63，如果不生效时取值为-1。
RemarkingDscp.description_en: Modify the DSCP value in the traffic. Value range: 0–63. If not effective, the value is -1.

Bandwidth.description_cn:
虚拟接口的带宽，单位：Mbps。

* -1：不限速。
* 1～100000：虚拟接口出、入云方向的带宽上限，不可超过虚拟接口关联物理专线的带宽。您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705)查询物理专线的信息。
* 若虚拟接口关联的是共享专线，虚拟接口将继承共享专线的带宽，您无需传入此参数。如需传入，请确保传入的值与虚拟接口关联的共享专线带宽值一致，您可调用[DescribeSharedDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/108083)查询共享专线信息（共享专线功能当前正在邀测中，仅开通此功能的账号可使用此功能、可见配套文档，如有需要请联系客户经理申请试用）。
* 不填保持原有配置。
Bandwidth.description_en:
Bandwidth of the virtual interface, unit: Mbps.

* -1: Unlimited.
* 1–100000: Maximum bandwidth for inbound and outbound directions to the cloud. Cannot exceed the bandwidth of the associated physical Direct Connect. You can call [DescribeDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104705) to query information about the physical Direct Connect.
* If the virtual interface is associated with a shared Direct Connect, it inherits the bandwidth of the shared Direct Connect. You do not need to provide this parameter. If you do provide it, ensure the value matches the bandwidth of the associated shared Direct Connect. You can call [DescribeSharedDirectConnectConnections](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/108083) to query shared Direct Connect information (the shared Direct Connect feature is currently in invite-only testing; only accounts with this feature enabled can use it and view supporting documentation. Contact your account manager to apply for a trial if needed).
* Leave blank to retain the original configuration.

BfdDetectInterval.description_cn: BFD检测时间间隔。单位：ms，取值范围：200～1000，默认1000。未开启BFD检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
BfdDetectInterval.description_en: BFD detection interval (ms). Range: 200–1000, default: 1000. If BFD detection is not enabled, do not provide this parameter.

BfdDetectMultiplier.description_cn: BFD检测次数。取值范围：3～10，默认3。未开启BFD检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
BfdDetectMultiplier.description_en: BFD check count. Range: 3–10, default is 3. If BFD is not enabled, do not set this parameter

Description.description_cn:
虚拟接口的描述信息。

* 以中文、字母、数字开头，只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号（.）、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、中划线（-）、等号（=）、英文逗号（,）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不更改该参数时，保持原有配置，表示不修改虚拟接口实例的描述。
Description.description_en:
Description of the virtual interface.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space ( ), underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length limit: 0 ~ 255 characters.
* If you do not change this parameter, the original configuration is retained, meaning the description of the virtual interface instance will not be modified.

EnableBfd.description_cn:
是否开启BFD检测控制报文模式，取值如下：

* true：开启
* false：不开启

您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716)接口，查询`RouteType`类型。
EnableBfd.description_en:
Enable BFD detection control packet mode. Available values:

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716) API to query the `RouteType` type.

EnableBfdEcho.description_cn:
是否开启BFD检测echo报文模式，取值如下：

* true：开启
* false：不开启

您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716)接口，查询`EnableBfdEcho`类型。
EnableBfdEcho.description_en:
Enable BFD detection echo packet mode. Available values:

* true: Enable
* false: Disable

You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716) API to query the `EnableBfdEcho` type.

EnableNqa.description_cn:
是否开启NQA检测功能，取值如下：

* true：开启
* false（默认）：不开启

* 仅`RouteType`为`Static`类型时，支持开启NQA检测功能。
* 您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716)接口，查询`RouteType`类型。
EnableNqa.description_en:
Enable NQA detection. Available values:

* true: Enable
* false (default): Disable

* NQA detection is only supported when `RouteType` is set to `Static`.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716) API to query the `RouteType` type.

LocalIpv6Ip.description_cn: 虚拟接口本端网关互联IP的IPv6地址。
LocalIpv6Ip.description_en: IPv6 address of the local gateway interconnection on the virtual interface

NqaDetectInterval.description_cn: NQA检测发送连续探测报文的时间间隔。单位：ms，取值：1000～5000，默认2000。未开启NQA检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
NqaDetectInterval.description_en: Interval for sending consecutive probe packets in NQA detection. Unit: ms; range: 1000–5000; default: 2000. If NQA detection is not enabled, do not provide this parameter

NqaDetectMultiplier.description_cn:
NQA检测的时间次数，若NQA检测连续失败次数达到设定的检测次数，则判定此线路故障。取值：3～8 ，默认5。未开启NQA检测功能，请避免传入此参数。
开启NQA功能后，若线路流量几乎可达带宽上限，建议把检测次数设为`8`。
NqaDetectMultiplier.description_en:
NQA detection count. If the number of consecutive NQA detection failures reaches the configured count, the route is considered faulty. Valid values: 3–8, default is 5. If NQA detection is not enabled, avoid passing this parameter.
After enabling NQA, if route traffic nearly reaches the bandwidth limit, it is recommended to set the detection count to `8`.

PeerIpv6Ip.description_cn: 虚拟接口对端网关互联IP的IPv6地址。
PeerIpv6Ip.description_en: IPv6 address of the peer gateway interconnection IP for the virtual interface.

VirtualInterfaceId.description_cn:
待修改信息的虚拟接口的ID。
您可调用[DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716)接口，查询虚拟接口的ID。
VirtualInterfaceId.description_en:
ID of the virtual interface to be modified.
You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectVirtualInterfaces](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104716) API to query the virtual interface ID.

VirtualInterfaceName.description_cn:
虚拟接口的名称。

* 以中文、字母、数字开头，只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不更改该参数时，保持原有配置，表示不修改虚拟接口实例的名称。
VirtualInterfaceName.description_en:
Name of the virtual interface.

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* Length limit: 1 ~ 128 characters.
* If you do not change this parameter, the original configuration is retained, meaning the name of the virtual interface instance will not be modified.

ResourceIds.description_cn:
绑定标签的资源ID。

* 参数 - N：表示专线资源的序号，单次调用数量上限50个ID。
* 多个ID之间请使用&分隔。
ResourceIds.description_en:
Resource ID for binding tags

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the dedicated connection resource; maximum of 50 IDs per call
* Separate multiple IDs with &

ResourceIds.N.description_cn:
绑定标签的资源ID。

* 参数 - N：表示专线资源的序号，单次调用数量上限50个ID。
* 多个ID之间请使用&分隔。
ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID for binding tags

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the dedicated connection resource; maximum of 50 IDs per call
* Separate multiple IDs with &

ResourceType.description_cn:
绑定标签的资源类型，取值如下：

* directconnectconnection：物理专线
* directconnectgateway：专线网关
* directconnectvirtualinterface：虚拟接口
ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type for binding tags. Options:

* directconnectconnection: physical dedicated connection
* directconnectgateway: dedicated gateway
* directconnectvirtualinterface: virtual interface

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
资源的标签键。

* 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
* 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
* 不能以 volc:或sys:开头，包括任意大小写形式。
* 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 若标签键开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

> 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the resource

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
* Separate multiple tag keys with &
* Cannot start with volc: or sys:, in any case
* Length range: 1–128 characters; supports input of characters from all languages, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@)
* If the tag key starts or ends with a space, the system automatically removes it

> Tag keys for the same resource must not be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
资源的标签值。

* 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
* 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
* 长度取值范围为0～256字符，不填默认为空。
* 允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 大小写敏感。
* 若标签值开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

> 若传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the resource

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–20
* Separate multiple tag values with &
* Length range: 0–256 characters; if not specified, defaults to empty
* Supports input of characters from all languages, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@)
* Case-sensitive
* If the tag value starts or ends with a space, the system automatically removes it

> If this parameter is provided, Tags.N.Key must be specified first

ResourceIds.description_cn: 资源的ID
ResourceIds.description_en: Resource ID

ResourceIds.N.description_cn: 资源的ID
ResourceIds.N.description_en: Resource ID

ResourceType.description_cn: 专线资源的类型。 - directconnectconnection：表示专线连接。 - directconnectgateway：表示专线网关。- directconnectvirtualinterface：表示虚拟接口
ResourceType.description_en:
Types of dedicated line resources
- directconnectconnection: Dedicated connection
- directconnectgateway: Dedicated gateway
- directconnectvirtualinterface: Virtual interface

TagKeys.description_cn: 要为云企业网资源删除的用户标签的标签键。 - 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，单次调用数量上限20个。 - 多个云企业网资源 ID之间使用&分隔。
TagKeys.description_en:
Specify the tag key of the user tag to delete from Cloud Enterprise Network resources
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key; up to 20 per request
- Separate multiple Cloud Enterprise Network resource IDs with &

TagKeys.N.description_cn: 要为云企业网资源删除的用户标签的标签键。 - 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，单次调用数量上限20个。 - 多个云企业网资源 ID之间使用&分隔。
TagKeys.N.description_en:
Specify the tag key of the user tag to delete from Cloud Enterprise Network resources
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key; up to 20 per request
- Separate multiple Cloud Enterprise Network resource IDs with &

AdvanceConfig.IncreaseSetting.Interval.description_cn: 增量迁移间隔时间，即每隔多长时间启动一次增量迁移任务，单位为秒，仅支持 3600～86400 的整数。
AdvanceConfig.IncreaseSetting.Interval.description_en: Incremental migration interval, in seconds. Specifies how often to start an incremental migration task. Only integer values from 3600 to 86400 are supported

AdvanceConfig.IncreaseSetting.Times.description_cn: 在存量迁移（即首次迁移）完成之后，执行增量迁移的次数，仅支持 1~100 的整数。
AdvanceConfig.IncreaseSetting.Times.description_en: After the initial migration is complete, you can perform incremental migrations a number of times that must be an integer between 1 and 100

AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.description_cn: 使用专线迁移数据时的网络配置。
AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.description_en: Network Configuration for Data Migration Using a Dedicated Line

AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.ENIRole.description_cn:
用户虚拟网卡委托授权角色名称。DMS 创建 shuttle 时需要通过该角色获取相关权限。
在控制台创建 DMS 专线任务后，控制台会自动创建 DMSEniCtlRole 角色，建议您先在控制台创建专线任务，否则您需要手动创建该角色。
AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.ENIRole.description_en:
Name of the delegated authorization role for the user's virtual network card. DMS uses this role to obtain required permissions when creating a shuttle.
After you create a DMS dedicated line task in the console, the DMSEniCtlRole role is created automatically. We recommend creating the dedicated line task in the console first; otherwise, you need to create this role manually.

AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.IdcIP.description_cn: 数据中心的 IPv4 地址。

AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.IdcPort.description_cn: 数据中心的 IPv4 地址的端口号。
AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.IdcPort.description_en: Data Center IPv4 Address Port Number

AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.SecurityGroupI.description_cn: 私有网络下的安全组 ID。
AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.SecurityGroupI.description_en: Security Group ID in Private Network

AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.SubnetID.description_cn: 私有网络下的子网 ID。
AdvanceConfig.PrivateLink.SubnetID.description_en: Subnet ID in the Private Network

AdvanceConfig.RenameSetting.Pattern.description_cn: 重命名的正则表达式规则。

AdvanceConfig.TimeBandwidthSetting.End.description_cn: 流控终止时间。取值范围为 1~24。
AdvanceConfig.TimeBandwidthSetting.End.description_en:
Flow Control End Time
Valid range: 1–24

AdvanceConfig.TimeBandwidthSetting.Start.description_cn: 流控起始时间，取值范围为 0~23。

BasicConfig.Bandwidth.description_cn: 迁移任务的默认带宽，单位为 Byte/s。默认为 1073741824。
BasicConfig.Bandwidth.description_en: Default bandwidth for migration tasks Unit: Byte/s Default: 1073741824

BasicConfig.EnableRangeCheck.description_cn:
是否开启抽样校验功能，开启抽样校验后，DMS 会从源端获取每个对象的 100 个字节，从目标端获取对应每个对象的 100 个字节，然后进行校验，确保源端和目标端的数据一致性。取值说明如下：
- `true`：开启抽样校验。
	
- `false`：不开启抽样校验。
默认为`false`。
BasicConfig.EnableRangeCheck.description_en:
Whether to enable sampling verification. When enabled, DMS retrieves 100 bytes from each object on the source side and 100 bytes from the corresponding object on the target side, then verifies the data to ensure consistency between source and target. Value options:
- `true`: Enable sampling verification
- `false`: Do not enable sampling verification
Default is `false`

BasicConfig.FailedNumToAbort.description_cn: 允许迁移任务连续失败的对象数量，取值范围为 [-1, +∞)。其中 -1 表示无限制，默认为 20。
BasicConfig.FailedNumToAbort.description_en: Number of objects allowed to consecutively fail during migration tasks. Valid range: [-1, +∞). -1 means no limit; default is 20

BasicConfig.ObjectMigrationPolicy.SyncSy.description_cn: 是否迁移 Symlink 对象
BasicConfig.ObjectMigrationPolicy.SyncSy.description_en: Do you want to migrate Symlink objects?

BasicConfig.OverwritePolicy.description_cn:
迁移任务覆盖策略，取值说明如下：
- `Force`：针对同名文件，不做任何判断，直接用源端覆盖目的端。
- `None`：针对同名文件，不做任何判断，直接跳过。
- `LastModify`：当源端和目标端出现同名文件时，根据文件的 lastmodify 字段（最后修改时间）判断是否进行覆盖，仅当源端文件的最后修改时间晚于目的端文件最后修改时间时执行覆盖。
BasicConfig.OverwritePolicy.description_en:
Migration Task Overwrite Policy. The available options are:
- `Force`: For files with the same name, always overwrite the destination with the source file without any checks
- `None`: For files with the same name, skip without any checks
- `LastModify`: When files with the same name exist on both source and destination, use the lastmodify field (last modified time) to decide whether to overwrite. Overwrite only if the source file was modified more recently than the destination file

BasicConfig.SkipArchiveObject.description_cn: 是否跳过归档对象迁移
BasicConfig.SkipArchiveObject.description_en: Do you want to skip archived object migration?

BasicConfig.SourceType.description_cn:
源端数据的类型，取值说明如下：
- `StorageTypeObject`：源端类型为对象存储。
- `StorageTypeUrl`：源端类型为 URL 列表。
BasicConfig.SourceType.description_en:
Source data type. The possible values are:
- `StorageTypeObject`: Source type is object storage
- `StorageTypeUrl`: Source type is URL list

BasicConfig.StorageClass.description_cn:
迁移的对象在目标端的存储类型，取值说明如下：
- `Standard`：标准存储。
- `InheritSource`：继承源端存储类型。
- `Ia`：低频存储。
- `ArchiveFr`：归档闪回存储。
- `IntelligentTiering`：智能分层存储。
- `ColdArchive`：冷归档存储。
- `Archive`：归档存储。
- `DeepColdArchive`：深度冷归档。
BasicConfig.StorageClass.description_en:
Storage type of migrated objects on the target side. The available values are:
- `Standard`: Standard storage
- `InheritSource`: Inherit source storage type
- `Ia`: Infrequent access storage
- `ArchiveFr`: Archive flashback storage
- `IntelligentTiering`: Intelligent tiering storage
- `ColdArchive`: Cold archive storage
- `Archive`: Archive storage
- `DeepColdArchive`: Deep cold archive storage

Source.description_cn: 迁移任务源端配置。
Source.description_en: Migration Task Source Configuration

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.description_cn: 源端数据源为对象存储的访问配置。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.description_en: Source data source is configured for object storage access

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_en: Access Configuration for the Object's Bucket

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_cn: 用于访问对象存储的 AccessKey ID。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_en: AccessKey ID for object storage access

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_cn: 对象存储的访问域名，不包含桶名。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_en: Object Storage access domain name excluding the bucket name

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_cn:
跨服务授权所用 RoleTrn。
设置 RoleTrn 后，您无需设置 AK、SK 信息。经过您的授权，DMS 可直接读取存储桶列表、文件。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_en:
RoleTrn for cross-service authorization
After you set RoleTrn, you do not need to configure AK or SK. With your authorization, DMS can directly read bucket lists and files.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_cn: 用于访问对象存储的 AccessKey Secret。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_en: AccessKey Secret for accessing object storage

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_cn:
源端数据源，取值说明如下:
- `StorageVendorTOS`：对象存储-火山引擎
- `StorageVendorS3`：其他S3协议存储
- `StorageVendorOBS`：华为云
- `StorageVendorCOS`：腾讯云
- `StorageVendorOSS`：阿里云
- `StorageVendorKodo`：七牛云
- `StorageVendorKs3`：金山云
- `StorageVendorGCS`：谷歌云
- `StorageVendorURLAtEndPoint`：源端数据为 URL 列表时，需要选择该项，表示使用下载地址获取文件列表。
使用 CreateDataMigrateTask 接口创建迁移任务时，仅支持一种 URL 列表文件上传方式，即下载地址。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.BucketAccessCo.description_en:
Source Data Source Type. Value descriptions are as follows:
- `StorageVendorTOS`: Object Storage - Volcano Engine
- `StorageVendorS3`: Other S3 Protocol Storage
- `StorageVendorOBS`: Huawei Cloud
- `StorageVendorCOS`: Tencent Cloud
- `StorageVendorOSS`: Alibaba Cloud
- `StorageVendorKodo`: Qiniu Cloud
- `StorageVendorKs3`: Kingsoft Cloud
- `StorageVendorGCS`: Google Cloud
- `StorageVendorURLAtEndPoint`: Select this option when the source data is a URL list file. This means using download URLs to obtain the file list.
When creating a migration task using the CreateDataMigrateTask API, only one URL list file upload method is supported: download URLs.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.IsExcluded.description_cn:
用于指定排除迁移的对象，必须搭配 PrefixList，或者搭配 PrefixListFile 一起使用，否则无效。
通过 PrefixList 或 PrefixListFile 指定对象后，IsExcluded 不同的取值，迁移操作不同，取值说明如下：

- `true`：开启排除功能，开启后，DMS 将排除 PrefixList 或 PrefixListFile 中指定的对象，只迁移排除后剩余的对象。
	
- `false`：不开启排除功能，DMS 将迁移 PrefixList 或 PrefixListFile 中指定的对象。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.IsExcluded.description_en:
Use this option to specify objects to exclude from migration. You must use it together with PrefixList or PrefixListFile; otherwise, it will not take effect. 

After specifying objects with PrefixList or PrefixListFile, the migration behavior depends on the value of IsExcluded:

- `true`: Enables exclusion. DMS will exclude the objects specified in PrefixList or PrefixListFile and migrate only the remaining objects.
- `false`: Disables exclusion. DMS will migrate the objects specified in PrefixList or PrefixListFile.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.KeyListFile.description_cn: 需要迁移的对象列表访问链接。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.KeyListFile.description_en: Access link for the list of objects to be migrated

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.ListEndTime.description_cn: 秒级时间戳，通过日期指定迁移的文件，指定后，将迁移该日期之前创建或修改的文件。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.ListEndTime.description_en: Use a timestamp in seconds to specify the date for migrating files. After specifying, files created or modified before this date will be migrated.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.ListStartTime.description_cn: 秒级时间戳，通过日期指定迁移的文件，指定后，将迁移该日期之后创建或修改的文件。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.ListStartTime.description_en: Second-level timestamp. Specify files to migrate by date. Once specified, files created or modified after this date will be migrated.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.PrefixList.description_cn:

`PrefixList`、`PrefixListFile`、`KeyListFile` 用于指定需要迁移的文件，只需设置其中一个参数即可。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.PrefixList.description_en:
List of prefixes to migrate; separate multiple prefixes with English commas (,)
Use `PrefixList`, `PrefixListFile`, or `KeyListFile` to specify the files to migrate. Only one parameter needs to be set.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.PrefixListFile.description_cn: 指定需要迁移的前缀列表文件访问链接。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.PrefixListFile.description_en: Specify the access link for the prefix list file to be migrated

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.ScanWithDelimi.description_cn:
列举源端是否携带分隔符。取值说明如下：
- `true`：携带分隔符列举，DMS 可以获取到源端存储桶多级目录下的文件，保证了迁移到 TOS 的文件完整性。
      如果使用带分隔符列举功能，设置指定迁移范围为包含（即设置 `IsExcluded` 为 `false`），并且通过前缀（通过 `PrefixList` 参数指定前缀，或通过 `PrefixListFile` 参数指定前缀列表 ）的方式指定迁移范围，那么前缀必须要以斜线（/）结尾。
      
- `false`：不携带分隔符列举，迁移文件的速度更快，但是在源端对象存储开启桶加速等场景下，有可能存在迁移到 TOS 的文件不全的问题。
Source.ObjectSourceConfig.ScanWithDelimi.description_en:
Specify whether to enumerate source files with delimiters. Value descriptions:
- `true`: Enumerate with delimiters. DMS can access files in multi-level directories within the source bucket, ensuring the integrity of files migrated to TOS.
      When using delimiter enumeration, if you set the migration scope to include (set `IsExcluded` to `false`) and specify the migration scope by prefix (using the `PrefixList` parameter or the `PrefixListFile` parameter), each prefix must end with a slash (/)

- `false`: Enumerate without delimiters. Migration is faster, but if bucket acceleration is enabled on the source object storage, some files may not be migrated to TOS.

Source.ObjectSourceConfig.StartTime.description_en: Specify files to migrate by date. After you set a date, files created or modified after that date will be migrated.

Source.UrlSourceConfig.BucketAccessConfi.description_en: AccessKey Secret for accessing object storage

Source.UrlSourceConfig.BucketAccessConfi.description_cn:
源端数据源，取值说明如下:
- `StorageVendorTOS`：对象存储-火山引擎
- `StorageVendorS3`：其他S3协议存储
- `StorageVendorOBS`：华为云
- `StorageVendorCOS`：腾讯云
- `StorageVendorOSS`：阿里云
- `StorageVendorKodo`：七牛云
- `StorageVendorKs3`：金山云
- `StorageVendorGCS`：谷歌云
- `StorageVendorURLAtEndPoint`：源端数据为 URL 列表时，需要选择该项，表示使用下载地址获取文件列表。
使用 CreateDataMigrateTask 接口创建迁移任务时，仅支持一种 URL 列表文件上传方式，即下载地址。
Source.UrlSourceConfig.BucketAccessConfi.description_en:
Source Data Source Type. Value descriptions are as follows:
- `StorageVendorTOS`: Object Storage - Volcano Engine
- `StorageVendorS3`: Other S3 Protocol Storage
- `StorageVendorOBS`: Huawei Cloud
- `StorageVendorCOS`: Tencent Cloud
- `StorageVendorOSS`: Alibaba Cloud
- `StorageVendorKodo`: Qiniu Cloud
- `StorageVendorKs3`: Kingsoft Cloud
- `StorageVendorGCS`: Google Cloud
- `StorageVendorURLAtEndPoint`: Select this option when the source data is a URL list file. This means using download URLs to obtain the file list.
When creating a migration task using the CreateDataMigrateTask API, only one URL list file upload method is supported: download URLs.

Source.UrlSourceConfig.IsUrlTryRangeGet.description_cn:
是否开启 range-get 迁移，说明如下：
- `true`：开启 range-get 迁移，开启后，DMS 将支持断点续传的方式迁移文件，即在网络波动等情况下导致文件传输中断后，重新传输文件，DMS 会在文件断点处开始传输，避免从头传输文件产生额外流量，从而节省成本。
- `false`：不开启 range-get 迁移。
Source.UrlSourceConfig.IsUrlTryRangeGet.description_en:
Enable range-get migration? Details:
- `true`: Enables range-get migration. When enabled, DMS supports resumable file transfers. If a transfer is interrupted due to network issues, DMS resumes the transfer from the breakpoint instead of starting over, reducing extra data usage and saving costs.
- `false`: Disables range-get migration.

Line.description_cn:
解析记录对应的线路。默认为 `default`。该参数的值来自：

- [ListLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155112) 返回的线路的 `Value` 参数。

Line.description_en:
The line associated with the DNS record. The default value is `default`. This parameter is sourced from:

- The `Value` parameter of the line returned by the [ListLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155112)
- The `Line` parameter of the custom line returned by the [ListCustomLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/336589)

The lines that can be configured for a domain depend on the domain's [feature version specification](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/170354).

Remark.description_cn: 解析记录的备注。支持 UTF-8 编码且长度不超过 16 个字符。默认值是空字符串 `""`。
Remark.description_en: Note for the parsing record. Supports UTF-8 encoding and must not exceed 16 characters. The default value is an empty string "".

TTL.description_cn: 解析记录的过期时间，单位是秒。该参数的默认是 `600`。参见 [功能版本规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/170354) 了解 TTL 的限制。
TTL.description_en: Expiration time for resolution records, in seconds. The default value for this parameter is `600`. See [Feature Version Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/170354) for TTL limitations.

Weight.description_en:
Weight of the DNS record. The default value is `1`.

Weight is only effective if load balancing is enabled for the record set containing the DNS record. See [UpdateRecordSet API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155111).

BackupID.description_en: ID of the backup to delete. You can call the [ListUserZoneBackups API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/336609) to get the backup ID.

ZID.description_en: ID of the domain whose backup needs to be deleted. You can use the [ListZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155100) to get the domain ID.

ZID.description_cn: 需要删除的域名的 ID。您可以通过 CreateZone API 或 ListZones API 获取域名 ID。
ZID.description_en: ID of the domain to delete. You can get the domain ID through the CreateZone API or ListZones API.

Custom route CIDR address block

Remark.description_cn: 自定义线路的备注。如果您不设置该参数，该 API 不会根据该参数筛选查询结果。
Remark.description_en: Remarks for custom routes. If you do not set this parameter, the API will not filter results based on it.

End.description_cn: 统计时间段的结束时间。格式是 Unix 时间戳（秒）。如果您不指定 `End` 参数，统计时间段默认是从 `Start` 的时间到您调用 API 的时间。
End.description_en: End time of the statistical period. Format: Unix timestamp (seconds). If you do not specify the `End` parameter, the statistical period defaults to the time from `Start` to the time you call the API.

Name.description_cn: 需要统计请求数的子域名，也可以是子域名包含的关键字。云解析 DNS 根据 `Name` 和 `SearchMode` 确定这些子域名，并对每个子域名统计 DNS 查询请求数。 如果您不指定该参数，则对所有子域名进行统计。
Name.description_en: Specify the subdomains for which you want to count the number of requests, or specify keywords that are contained in subdomain names. Cloud DNS uses the `Name` and `SearchMode` parameters to identify these subdomains and count DNS query requests for each one. If you do not specify this parameter, requests for all subdomains will be counted.

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的每个域名的统计数据。该参数的默认值是 `1`。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The API returns statistics for each domain name included on the specified page. The default value for this parameter is `1`.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的子域名数量。系统会将统计的子域名进行分页显示。页数是由被统计子域名的总数和 `PageSize` 确定。该参数的默认值是 `10`，最大值是 `500`。
PageSize.description_en:
Number of subdomains per page
The system displays the subdomains in a paginated view
The number of pages is determined by the total number of subdomains and `PageSize`
The default value for this parameter is `10`, and the maximum value is `500`

SearchMode.description_cn:
`Name` 的匹配模式。该参数有以下取值：

- `like`（默认）：表示模糊匹配。
- `exact`：表示精确匹配。
SearchMode.description_en:
`Name` matching mode. This parameter has the following options:

- `like` (default): Indicates fuzzy matching
- `exact`: Indicates exact matching

Start.description_cn: 统计时间段的开始时间。格式是 Unix 时间戳（秒）。如果您不指定 `Start` 参数，统计时间段默认是从您调用 API 的时间开始往前推 3 天。例如，如果您在 2023 年 6 月 8 日 14:00:00 调用该 API，则默认统计时间段为 2023 年 6 月 5 日 14:00:00 至 2023 年 6 月 8 日 14:00:00。
Start.description_en: Start time of the statistical period. The format is a Unix timestamp (seconds). If you do not specify the `Start` parameter, the statistical period defaults to the 3-day period from 3 days before the time you call the API up to the time you call the API. For example, if you call the API at 14:00:00 on June 8, 2023, the default statistical period is from 14:00:00 on June 5, 2023 to 14:00:00 on June 8, 2023.

Threshold.description_cn: 请求数的阈值。如果您指定了该参数，API 会过滤掉请求数大于该参数的域名。
Threshold.description_en: Request count threshold. If you specify this parameter, the API filters out domains with a request count greater than this parameter

ZID.description_cn: 主域名的 ID。云解析 DNS 对该主域名下的子域名进行统计。
ZID.description_en: ID of the primary domain. Cloud DNS collects statistics for subdomains under this primary domain.

Hierarchy.description_cn:
是否按层级返回线路。该参数有以下取值：

- `true`：按层级返回线路。在结果中会显示父线路以及子线路。
- `false`（默认）：不按层级返回线路。父线路和子线路都在同一个层级返回。
Hierarchy.description_en:
Return routes by hierarchy. This parameter has the following options:

- `true`: Return routes by hierarchy. Results will show parent routes and child routes
- `false` (default): Do not return routes by hierarchy. Parent routes and child routes are returned at the same level

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的线路。该参数的默认值是 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The API returns the routes included on this page. The default value for this parameter is 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的线路的数量。系统会将获取的线路进行分页显示。页数是由获取的线路总数和 `PageSize` 确定。该参数的取值范围是 1-2000。该参数的默认值是 `2000`。
PageSize.description_en: Number of routes per page. The system displays the retrieved routes in pages. The number of pages is determined by the total number of routes and the `PageSize`. The valid range for this parameter is 1–2000. The default value is `2000`.

ZID.description_cn: 表示一个域名的 ID。根据您设置的域名所在的实例版本，云解析 DNS 返回该版本可用的线路。如果您不设置该参数，云解析 DNS 默认返回所有的线路。
ZID.description_en: Represents a domain name ID. Based on the instance version where your domain is set, Cloud DNS returns the available lines for that version. If you do not set this parameter, Cloud DNS returns all lines by default.

Host.description_en: Host record of the record set. If this parameter is set to `@`, it refers to the domain itself. If you do not set this parameter, the API will not filter query results based on it.

PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The API returns the set of parsed records for this page number. The default value for this parameter is 1.

Host.description_en: Host record of the domain. If this parameter is set to `@`, it refers to the second-level domain itself. If you do not set this parameter, the API will not filter query results based on it.

解析记录的线路。该参数的值来自：

Start.description_en: Start time of the statistical period. The format is a Unix timestamp (seconds). If you do not specify the `Start` parameter, the default statistical period is the 3 days prior to the time you call the API. For example, if you call the API at 14:00:00 on June 8, 2023, the default statistical period is from 14:00:00 on June 5, 2023 to 14:00:00 on June 8, 2023.

Stage.description_cn:
域名的状态。如果您不设置该参数，该 API 不会根据该参数筛选查询结果。该参数有以下取值：

- `0`：正常。
- `1`：域名待找回。

- `5`：请变更DNS服务器
Stage.description_en:
Domain status. If you do not set this parameter, the API will not filter query results based on it. This parameter has the following values:

- `0`: Normal
- `1`: Domain name pending recovery
- `2`: TrafficRoute resolution not used
- `3`: Abnormal
- `5`: Please change DNS server

TagFilters.description_cn:
域名的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，云解析 DNS 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的域名。
- 标签值：例如 `"Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，云解析 DNS 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。

如果您不设置该参数，该 API 不会根据该参数筛选查询结果。
TagFilters.description_en:
Tags for the domain name. You need to specify:

- N: Indicates the index of `TagFilters`, with a value range of 1–10. `N` should be in ascending order and must be consecutive numbers.
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, Cloud DNS will query domain names that contain all specified tag keys.
- Tag value: For example, `"Values":["v1", "v2"]`. The length of the tag value array can range from 1 to 3.

You can choose not to provide `Values`, which means `Values` will not be used as a query condition. If you provide an array containing only an empty string for `Values`, Cloud DNS will query tags where `Values` is empty. If a `Values` array contains multiple values, the relationship between these values is logical OR.

If you do not set this parameter, the API will not filter query results based on this parameter.

TradeCode.description_cn:
域名的功能版本。如果您不设置该参数，该 API 不会根据该参数筛选查询结果。

- `free_inner`：免费版。
- `professional_inner`：专业版。
- `enterprise_inner`：企业版。
- `ultimate_inner`：旗舰版。
- `ultimate_exclusive_inner`：尊享版。
TradeCode.description_en:
Functional version of the domain. If you do not set this parameter, the API will not filter query results based on it.

- `free_inner`: Free version

Tag list information

- You can enter multiple sets of tag key-value pairs at once, separated by English commas (,).
- You can enter up to 20 sets of tag key-value pairs at the same time. Each task can be bound to up to 50 tag key-value pairs.

Tags.Key.description_cn:
标签的键信息。配置规格如下：

- 支持任何语言、文字、数字、空格或符号（`_.:/=+-@`）。
- 大小写敏感，且长度在 1~128 个字符内。
- 使用 UTF-8 编码的 Unicode 格式。
- 不支持设置以 `volc:` 开头的任何形式的 Key，例如 `Volc:`、`VOLC:` 等。
Tags.Key.description_en:
Key information for the label. Configuration specifications:

- Supports any language, character, number, space, or symbol (`_.:/=+-@`)
- Case sensitive; must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Uses Unicode format with UTF-8 encoding
- Keys starting with `volc:` in any form, such as `Volc:` or `VOLC:`, are not supported

Tags.Value.description_cn:
标签的值信息。配置规格如下：

- 支持任何语言、文字、数字、空格或符号（`_.:/=+-@`）。
- 大小写敏感，且长度在 0~256 个字符内。
- 使用 UTF-8 编码的 Unicode 格式。
Tags.Value.description_en:
Label value information. Configuration specifications:

- Supports any language, character, number, space, or symbol (`_.:/=+-@`)
- Case sensitive, with length between 0 and 256 characters
- Uses Unicode format with UTF-8 encoding

- You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by English commas (,). Up to 20 instance IDs can be entered at the same time.

- 长度需在 8~32 个字符内。
- 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的三种类型。特殊字符包含 `_#!@$%^&*()+=-`。
Password.description_en:
Set a password for the consumer group account. Password requirements:

- Must be 8–32 characters long
- Must include at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters. Allowed special characters: _#!@$%^&*()+=-

SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_cn:
主键冲突处理。当目标库已存在同主键值的行时的处理方法，取值如下：

ThrowError：表示冲突报错，表示预检查时提示相关报错，需手动修改相关数据，否则同步任务无法启动。

Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。

Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。

注意

在取值为 Ignore 时，可能会导致数据不一致，给业务带来风险，请谨慎选择。
SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_en:
Primary Key Conflict Handling

Choose how to handle rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually update the affected data; otherwise, the sync task cannot start.

Ignore: Skips rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database during pre-check. The sync task can start normally.

Override: Overwrites target database data with source database data. The sync task can start normally.

Note

Using Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Proceed with caution.

SolutionSettings.MySQL2MySQLSettings.Pol.description_cn:
主键冲突处理。当目标库已存在同主键值的行时的处理方法，取值如下：

ThrowError：表示冲突报错，表示预检查时提示相关报错，需手动修改相关数据，否则同步任务无法启动。
Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。
Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。
注意

SolutionSettings.MySQL2MySQLSettings.Pol.description_en:
Primary Key Conflict Handling

Choose how to handle rows in the target database that have the same primary key value:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually modify the conflicting data; otherwise, the synchronization task cannot start.
Ignore: Skips rows in the target database that have the same primary key value during pre-check. The synchronization task can start normally.
Override: Overwrites the target database data with data from the source database. The synchronization task can start normally.

Note

Selecting Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Please choose carefully.

Tags.description_cn: 标签信息。说明支持一次传入多组标签键值对像，多组标签键值对像间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对。单个任务最多可绑定 50 个键值。详细信息，请参见 [Tag](../6390/76140#tag)。
Tags.description_en: Tag information. You can enter multiple sets of tag key-value pairs at once, separated by commas (,). You can enter up to 20 sets at the same time. Each task can be bound to up to 50 key-value pairs. For details, see [Tag](../6390/76140#tag).

Tags.Key.description_cn:
标签的键信息。配置规格如下：

支持任何语言、文字、数字、空格或符号（_.:/=+-@）。

大小写敏感，且长度在 1~128 个字符内。

使用 UTF-8 编码的 Unicode 格式。

不支持设置以 volc: 开头的任何形式的 Key，例如 Volc:、VOLC: 等。
Tags.Key.description_en:
Key information for labels. Configuration specifications:

Supports any language, character, number, space, or symbol (_.:/=+-@)

Case sensitive; length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Uses Unicode format with UTF-8 encoding

Setting keys that start with volc: in any form, such as Volc: or VOLC:, is not supported

Tags.Value.description_cn:
标签的值信息。配置规格如下：

支持任何语言、文字、数字、空格或符号（_.:/=+-@）。

大小写敏感，且长度在 0~256 个字符内。

使用 UTF-8 编码的 Unicode 格式。
Tags.Value.description_en:
Label value information
Configuration specifications:

• Supports any language, character, number, space, or symbol (_.:/=+-@)
• Case sensitive; length from 0 to 256 characters
• Uses Unicode format with UTF-8 encoding

TaskName.description_cn:
任务名称。命名规则：

- 以字母开头且不能为空。
- 长度需在 64 个字符内。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线（\_）和中划线（-）。
TaskName.description_en:
Task name rules:

- Must start with a letter and cannot be empty
- Maximum length is 64 characters
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_) and hyphens (-) are allowed

TaskType.description_cn:
任务类型。取值如下：

- `DataMigration`：表示创建数据迁移任务。
- `DataSubscription`：表示创建数据订阅任务。
- `DataSynchronization`：表示创建数据同步任务。
- `MigrationAssessment`：表示创建迁移评估任务。
目前仅支持创建公网自建 MySQL/专有网络 MySQl 至火山引擎版 MySQL 的数据迁移评估任务。
TaskType.description_en:
Task type. Available values:

- `DataMigration`: Create a data migration task
- `DataSubscription`: Create a data subscription task
- `DataSynchronization`: Create a data synchronization task
- `MigrationAssessment`: Create a migration assessment task
Currently, only migration assessment tasks from public network self-built MySQL or VPC MySQL to Volcano Engine MySQL are supported.

TrafficSpec.description_cn: 任务链路规格。支持 `Compact` 和 `Standard` 取值。关于链路规格的详细信息，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6390/79112)。

SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_cn:
主键冲突处理。当目标库已存在同主键值的行时的处理方法，取值如下：

ThrowError：表示冲突报错，表示预检查时提示相关报错，需手动修改相关数据，否则同步任务无法启动。

Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。

Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。

注意

在取值为 Ignore 时，可能会导致数据不一致，给业务带来风险，请谨慎选择。
SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_en:
Primary Key Conflict Handling

Choose how to handle rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually update the affected data; otherwise, the sync task cannot start.

Ignore: Skips rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database during pre-check. The sync task can start normally.

Override: Overwrites target database data with source database data. The sync task can start normally.

Note

Using Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Proceed with caution.

SolutionSettings.MySQL2MySQLSettings.Pol.description_cn:
主键冲突处理。当目标库已存在同主键值的行时的处理方法，取值如下：

ThrowError：表示冲突报错，表示预检查时提示相关报错，需手动修改相关数据，否则同步任务无法启动。
Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。
Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。
注意

在取值为 Ignore 时，可能会导致数据不一致，给业务带来风险，请谨慎选择。
SolutionSettings.MySQL2MySQLSettings.Pol.description_en:
Primary Key Conflict Handling

Choose how to handle rows in the target database that have the same primary key value:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually modify the conflicting data; otherwise, the synchronization task cannot start.
Ignore: Skips rows in the target database that have the same primary key value during pre-check. The synchronization task can start normally.
Override: Overwrites the target database data with data from the source database. The synchronization task can start normally.

Note

Selecting Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Please choose carefully.

MySQL2Kafka：表示实例类型为 MySQL 的源实例订阅到 Kafka。

MySQL2RocketMQ：表示实例类型为 MySQL 的源实例订阅到消息队列 RocketMQ 版。

PG2PG：表示实例类型为 PostgreSQL 的源实例迁移至实例类型为 PostgreSQL 的目标实例。

PG2RocketMQ：表示实例类型为 PostgreSQL 的源实例订阅到消息队列 RocketMQ 版。

Redis2Redis：表示实例类型为 Redis 的源实例迁移至实例类型为 Redis 的目标实例。
SolutionSettings.SolutionType.description_en:
Task type. The available values are:

MySQL2MySQL: Migration or synchronization from a MySQL source instance to a MySQL target instance
MySQL2ES: Synchronization from a MySQL source instance to an ElasticSearch target instance
MySQL2Kafka: Subscription from a MySQL source instance to Kafka
MySQL2RocketMQ: Subscription from a MySQL source instance to RocketMQ message queue edition
PG2PG: Migration from a PostgreSQL source instance to a PostgreSQL target instance
PG2Kafka: Subscription from a PostgreSQL source instance to Kafka
PG2RocketMQ: Subscription from a PostgreSQL source instance to RocketMQ message queue edition
Mongo2Mongo: Migration from a MongoDB source instance to a MongoDB target instance
Redis2Redis: Migration from a Redis source instance to a Redis target instance
Redis2TOS: Synchronization from a Redis source instance to a TOS object storage target instance

Tags.Key.description_cn:
标签的键信息。配置规格如下：

- 支持任何语言、文字、数字、空格或符号（`_.:/=+-@`）。
- 大小写敏感，且长度在 1~128 个字符内。
- 使用 UTF-8 编码的 Unicode 格式。
- 不支持设置以 `volc:` 开头的任何形式的 Key，例如 `Volc:`、`VOLC:` 等。
Tags.Key.description_en:
Key information for the label. Configuration specifications:

- Supports any language, character, number, space, or symbol (`_.:/=+-@`)
- Case sensitive; must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Uses Unicode format with UTF-8 encoding
- Keys starting with `volc:` in any form, such as `Volc:` or `VOLC:`, are not supported

Tags.Value.description_cn:
标签的值信息。配置规格如下：

- 支持任何语言、文字、数字、空格或符号（`_.:/=+-@`）。
- 大小写敏感，且长度在 0~256 个字符内。
- 使用 UTF-8 编码的 Unicode 格式。
Tags.Value.description_en:
Label value information. Configuration specifications:

- Supports any language, character, number, space, or symbol (`_.:/=+-@`)
- Case sensitive, with length between 0 and 256 characters
- Uses Unicode format with UTF-8 encoding

Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。

Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。

注意

在取值为 Ignore 时，可能会导致数据不一致，给业务带来风险，请谨慎选择。
SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_en:

Choose how to handle rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually update the affected data; otherwise, the sync task cannot start.

Ignore: Skips rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database during pre-check. The sync task can start normally.

Override: Overwrites target database data with source database data. The sync task can start normally.

Note

Using Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Proceed with caution.

Override: Overwrites the target database data with data from the source database. The synchronization task can start normally.

Note

Selecting Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Please choose carefully.

SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_cn:
主键冲突处理。当目标库已存在同主键值的行时的处理方法，取值如下：

ThrowError：表示冲突报错，表示预检查时提示相关报错，需手动修改相关数据，否则同步任务无法启动。

Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。

Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。

注意

在取值为 Ignore 时，可能会导致数据不一致，给业务带来风险，请谨慎选择。
SolutionSettings.MySQL2ESSettings.Policy.description_en:
Primary Key Conflict Handling

Choose how to handle rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually update the affected data; otherwise, the sync task cannot start.

Ignore: Skips rows with duplicate primary key values in the target database during pre-check. The sync task can start normally.

Override: Overwrites target database data with source database data. The sync task can start normally.

Note

Using Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Proceed with caution.

SolutionSettings.MySQL2MySQLSettings.Pol.description_cn:
主键冲突处理。当目标库已存在同主键值的行时的处理方法，取值如下：

ThrowError：表示冲突报错，表示预检查时提示相关报错，需手动修改相关数据，否则同步任务无法启动。
Ignore：表示冲突忽略，表示预检查时会跳过对目标数据库中存在同主键值的行，同步任务可正常启动。
Override：表示冲突覆盖，表示使用源库数据覆盖目标库数据，同步任务可正常启动。
注意

在取值为 Ignore 时，可能会导致数据不一致，给业务带来风险，请谨慎选择。
SolutionSettings.MySQL2MySQLSettings.Pol.description_en:
Primary Key Conflict Handling

Choose how to handle rows in the target database that have the same primary key value:

ThrowError: Reports a conflict error during pre-check. You must manually modify the conflicting data; otherwise, the synchronization task cannot start.
Ignore: Skips rows in the target database that have the same primary key value during pre-check. The synchronization task can start normally.
Override: Overwrites the target database data with data from the source database. The synchronization task can start normally.

Note

Selecting Ignore may cause data inconsistency and pose risks to your business. Please choose carefully.
