AutoRenew.description_cn: 是否自动续期
AutoRenew.description_en: Whether to auto-renew

BillingPeriod.description_cn: 账单周期，报年包月需要传：MONTHLY
BillingPeriod.description_en: Billing cycle. For annual or monthly subscriptions, you need to pass: MONTHLY

BillingType.description_cn: 账单类型：POST（按量）,PRE（包年包月）, MIX(弹性资源池) 变配的时候只要涉及计费类型转换才需要传，例如从按量转到包月
BillingType.description_en: Billing type: POST (pay-as-you-go), PRE (annual/monthly subscription), MIX (elastic resource pool). Required only when changing billing type, such as switching from pay-as-you-go to subscription

DirectoryId.description_cn: 草稿作业所属的文件夹 ID

ProjectId.description_en: Project ID

State.description_cn: 状态
State.description_en: Status

AddressDetailList.description_cn: 地址列表，携带详细地址信息。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Manual`时生效。
AddressDetailList.description_en: Address list with detailed address information. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is Manual.

AddressDetailList.Address.description_cn:
地址簿中地址的详细信息，具体内容取决于地址簿类型。
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ip`时，填写 IPv4 地址或 CIDRv4 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ipv6`时，填写 IPv6 地址或 CIDRv6 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`port`时，填写端口信息，支持单个端口（如 `22`）或端口范围（如`100/200`）；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`domain`时，填写域名信息。
AddressDetailList.Address.description_en:
The detailed information for addresses in the address book depends on the address book type.
- If `GroupTyp` is `ip`, enter IPv4 address or CIDRv4 information.
- If `GroupTyp` is `ipv6`, enter IPv6 address or CIDRv6 information.
- If `GroupTyp` is `port`, enter port information. You can enter a single port (such as `22`) or a port range (such as `100/200`).
- If `GroupTyp` is `domain`, enter domain name information.

AddressDetailList.Description.description_cn: 对地址簿中单个地址的详细描述信息，用于说明该地址的具体用途或其他相关信息。
AddressDetailList.Description.description_en: Detailed description for a single address in the address book, used to specify its purpose or other relevant information
AddressDetailList.Description.example_cn: 公司内部服务器 IP 地址

AddressList.description_cn:
地址簿中的地址列表，具体内容取决于地址簿类型。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Manual`且`AddressDetailList`不为空时生效。
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ip`时，填写 IPv4 地址或 CIDRv4 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ipv6`时，填写 IPv6 地址或 CIDRv6 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`port`时，填写端口信息，支持单个端口（如 `22`）或端口范围（如`100/200`）；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`domain`时，填写域名信息。
AddressList.description_en:
Address list in the address book; the specific content depends on the address book type. Takes effect when `AutoUpdateType` is `Manual` and `AddressDetailList` is not empty
- If `GroupTyp` is `ip`, enter IPv4 address or CIDRv4 information
- If `GroupTyp` is `ipv6`, enter IPv6 address or CIDRv6 information
- If `GroupTyp` is `port`, enter port information; supports a single port (such as `22`) or a port range (such as `100/200`)
- If `GroupTyp` is `domain`, enter domain name information

AutoUpdateType.description_cn:
地址簿的自动更新类型，默认值为 `Manual`。支持的取值如下所示。
- `Manual`：手动更新；
- `Tag`：标签地址簿。有新匹配标签的资产，会自动加入到当前地址簿，当前仅支持互联网边界。
AutoUpdateType.description_en:
Automatic update type for the address book. The default value is `Manual`. Supported values are as follows: 
- `Manual`: Manual update
- `Tag`: Tag address book. Assets with newly matched tags are automatically added to the current address book. Currently, this is only supported for internet boundaries.

CloudFirewallId.description_cn: 云防火墙实例的唯一标识符，用于指定地址簿所属的云防火墙实例。
CloudFirewallId.description_en: Unique identifier for the cloud firewall instance, used to specify which cloud firewall instance the address book belongs to

Description.description_cn: 对地址簿的详细描述信息，用于说明地址簿的用途或其他相关信息。
Description.description_en: Detailed description for the address book, used to explain its purpose or other relevant information
Description.example_cn: 用于存储公司内部服务器的IP地址
Description.example_en: Stores IP addresses of internal company servers

GroupName.description_cn:
地址簿的名称，需要满足以下要求：
- 中文字符、大小写英文字母、`-` 和 `_`。
- 最大长度为 `64` 个字符。
GroupName.description_en:
Address book names must meet the following requirements:
- Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, `-`, and `_`.
- Maximum length is `64` characters.

GroupType.description_cn:
地址簿的类型，用于指定地址簿中存储的地址类型。
- `ip`：IPv4 地址；
- `ipv6`：IPv6 地址；
- `port`：端口信息；
- `domain`：域名信息。
GroupType.description_en:
Type of address book, used to specify the type of addresses stored in the address book
- `ip`: IPv4 address
- `ipv6`: IPv6 address
- `port`: Port information
- `domain`: Domain information

InstanceTypeList.description_cn:
资产类型列表，用于指定地址簿中包含的资产类型。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。支持的取值如下所示。
- `EcsInstance`：云服务器；
- `NetworkInterface`：网卡；
- `HaVip`：高可用虚拟 IP；
- `Nat`：NAT 网关；
- `ClbInstance`：负载均衡；
- `AlbInstance`：应用型负载均衡；
- `VpnGateway`：VPN 网关。
InstanceTypeList.description_en:
Asset type list, used to specify the asset types included in the address book. Takes effect when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`. Supported values are as follows:
- `EcsInstance`: ECS instance
- `NetworkInterface`: Network interface
- `HaVip`: High-availability virtual IP
- `Nat`: NAT gateway
- `ClbInstance`: Load balancer
- `AlbInstance`: Application load balancer
- `VpnGateway`: VPN gateway

ResourceType.description_cn:
标签类型，用于指定地址簿中资源的类型。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。支持的取值如下所示。
- `Eip`：公网 IP；
- `InternetAsset`：公网资产。
ResourceType.description_en:
Tag type, used to specify the type of resources in the address book. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`. Supported values are as follows:
- `Eip`: Public IP
- `InternetAsset`: Public asset

TagRelation.description_cn:
标签之间的逻辑关系，用于指定多个标签之间的组合方式。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。支持的取值如下所示。
- `And`：与关系，表示所有标签必须同时满足；
- `Or`：或关系，表示满足任意一个标签即可。
TagRelation.description_en:
Logical relationships between tags, used to specify how multiple tags are combined. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`. Supported values:
- `And`: All tags must be satisfied at the same time
- `Or`: Satisfying any one tag is sufficient

Tags.description_cn: 标签列表，用于对地址簿进行分类或标记。每个标签包含键值对。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。
Tags.description_en: Tag list used to categorize or mark the address book. Each tag contains key-value pairs. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`.

Tags.Key.description_cn: 标签键，根据[标签键查询接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450)获取标签键信息并传入。
Tags.Key.description_en: Tag key: Obtain the tag key information using the [Tag Key Query API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450) and enter it

Tags.Value.description_cn: 标签值，根据[标签键查询接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450)获取标签键对应的标签值信息并传入。
Tags.Value.description_en: Tag value: Obtain the tag value information corresponding to the tag key using the [Tag Key Query API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450) and enter it

Action.description_cn:
访问控制策略的动作：

- accept：放行
- deny：阻断
- monitor：观察
Action.description_en:
Actions for Access Control Policies:

- Accept: Allow
- Deny: Block
- Monitor: Observe

Description.description_cn: 描述信息
Description.description_en: Description info

DestPort.description_cn:
访问控制策略中的目的端口。格式为单个端口22，端口范围100/200：

- 当协议类型为ICMP/ALL时，取值为空
- 当DestPortType为group时，取值为端口地址簿的uuid列表，多个地址簿通过英文逗号分隔
- 当DestPortType为port时，取值为端口范围
DestPort.description_en:
Destination port in access control policies. Format: single port, such as 22, or port range, such as 100/200

- If the protocol type is ICMP or ALL, leave this field blank
- If DestPortType is group, enter a list of UUIDs from the port address book, separated by commas
- If DestPortType is port, enter a port range

DestPortType.description_cn:
访问控制策略的目的端口类型：

- port：端口
- group：端口地址簿
DestPortType.description_en:
Destination port types for access control policies:

- Port: Port
- Group: Port address book

Destination.description_cn:
访问控制策略中的目的地址：

- 当DestinationType为net时，Destination为目的CIDR地址。例如：192.168.0.2/32
- 当DestinationType为group时，Destination为目的址簿的uuid列表，多个地址簿用英文逗号分隔。例如：f04ac7ce-628b-4cb7-be61-310222b7****, f04ac7ce-628b-4cb7-be61-310222b7****
- 当DestinationType为location时，Destination为目的区域，多个地域用英文逗号分隔。例如：BJ11, ZB
- 当DestinationType为Domain时，Destination为目的域名。例如：www.baidu.com
Destination.description_en:
Destination address in access control policies:

- If DestinationType is net, Destination is the target CIDR address. Example: 192.168.0.2/32
- If DestinationType is group, Destination is a list of target address book UUIDs, separated by commas. Example: f04ac7ce-628b-4cb7-be61-310222b7****, f04ac7ce-628b-4cb7-be61-310222b7****
- If DestinationType is location, Destination is the target region, with multiple regions separated by commas. Example: BJ11, ZB
- If DestinationType is Domain, Destination is the target domain name. Example: www.baidu.com

DestinationType.description_cn:
访问控制策略中的目的地址类型：

- net：目的网段(CIDR)
- group：目的地址簿
- location：目的区域
- domain：目的域名
DestinationType.description_en:
Destination Address Types in Access Control Policies:

- net: Destination Subnet (CIDR)
- group: Destination Address Book
- location: Destination Region
- domain: Destination Domain Name

Direction.description_cn:
策略方向： 
- in - 入方向 
- out - 出方向
Direction.description_en:
Strategy Direction:
- in - Entry Direction
- out - Exit Direction

DomainResolutionMode.description_cn: 域名解析模式： - fqdn - 完整域名解析 - dns - 动态DNS解析
DomainResolutionMode.description_en: Domain Name Resolution Modes: - fqdn - Full Domain Name Resolution - dns - Dynamic DNS Resolution

EndTime.description_cn:
策略生效截止日期，Unix 时间戳，支持精确到设定日期的 23:59:00。 - 当 RepeatType 为 Permanent（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写。 - 当 RepeatType 为 Once（单时间段生效）或 Daily、Weekly、Monthly（重复生效）时，需填写该字段，字段需要精确到设定日期的 23:59:00。
例如 2024.11.30 截止，则取值为 1732982340，实际截止时间为 2024.11.30 23:59:00。
EndTime.description_en:
Policy expiration date as a Unix timestamp, accurate to 23:59:00 on the specified date - Leave this field blank if RepeatType is Permanent (always active) - If RepeatType is Once (single period) or Daily, Weekly, Monthly (recurring), enter the timestamp accurate to 23:59:00 on the specified date
For example, if the expiration date is 2024.11.30, use 1732982340. The actual expiration time is 2024.11.30 23:59:00

InternetFirewallId.description_cn: 互联网边界防火墙实例ID，获取方式可参考[AssetList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)。
InternetFirewallId.description_en: Internet boundary firewall instance ID. For instructions on how to obtain it, see [AssetList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)

IpType.description_cn:
IP 版本，用于指定访问控制策略的 IP 地址类型。
- `v4`：IPv4；
- `v6`：IPv6。

默认值为 `v4`。
IpType.description_en:
IP version, used to specify the IP address type for access control policies
- `v4`: IPv4
- `v6`: IPv6

Default is `v4`

IpsAction.description_cn:
策略动作，用于指定访问控制策略对匹配流量的处理方式。
- `accept`：放行；
- `deny`：阻断；
- `monitor`：观察。
IpsAction.description_en:
Policy actions specify how the access control policy handles matching traffic
- `accept`: Allow
- `deny`: Block
- `monitor`: Monitor

IpsBlock.description_cn:
是否启用 IPS 封禁功能。
- `true`：启用 IPS 封禁；
- `false`：不启用 IPS 封禁。

默认值为 `false`。
IpsBlock.description_en:
Whether to enable IPS blocking
- `true`: Enable IPS blocking
- `false`: Do not enable IPS blocking

Default value: `false`

IpsDir.description_cn:
策略方向，用于指定访问控制策略的流量方向。
- `in`：入方向；
- `out`：出方向。

对 `vfw` 该字段无意义。
IpsDir.description_en:
Policy direction, used to specify the traffic direction for access control policies
- `in`: incoming direction
- `out`: outgoing direction

This field is not applicable to `vfw`

IpsDstIP.description_cn: 目的IP地址，用于指定访问控制策略中流量的目标地址。
IpsDstIP.description_en: Destination IP address, used to specify the destination address for traffic in an access control policy

IpsDstPort.description_cn: 目的端口号，用于指定访问控制策略中流量的目标端口。取值范围为 `0` 及以上整数。
IpsDstPort.description_en: Destination port number, used to specify the target port for traffic in an access control policy. Valid values are integers of `0` or greater

Prio.description_cn:
策略的优先级，数值越小优先级越高。
- `0`：最低优先级；
- `1`：最高优先级；
- 其他数值：其他优先级。默认值为 `0`（最低优先级）。
Prio.description_en:
Strategy priority: Lower values indicate higher priority
- `0`: Lowest priority
- `1`: Highest priority
- Other values: Other priority levels. Default is `0` (lowest priority)

Proto.description_cn:
协议类型，用于指定访问控制策略的传输协议。
- `ICMP`：互联网控制报文协议；
- `TCP`：传输控制协议；
- `UDP`：用户数据报协议；
- `ANY`：任意协议。

当 `DestinationType` 为 `domain` 时，协议类型只能为 `TCP`。
Proto.description_en:
Protocol type, used to specify the transport protocol for access control policies
- `ICMP`: Internet Control Message Protocol
- `TCP`: Transmission Control Protocol
- `UDP`: User Datagram Protocol
- `ANY`: Any protocol

When `DestinationType` is set to `domain`, the protocol type must be `TCP`

RepeatDays.description_cn:
重复生效周期。
- 当 RepeatType 为 Daily（每日重复）时，无需填写。
- 当 RepeatType 为 Weekly（每周重复）、Monthly（每月重复）时，需要填写。
	- 当 RepeatType 为 Weekly 时，取值范围[0, 6] 
	- 当 RepeatType 为 Monthly 时，取值范围[1, 31]
RepeatDays.description_en:
Repeat cycle
- No input required for Daily
- Input required for Weekly or Monthly
    - For Weekly, valid values: [0, 6]
    - For Monthly, valid values: [1, 31]

RepeatEndTime.description_cn:
重复生效截止时间。当 RepeatType 为 Daily、Weekly、Monthly（重复生效）时，需要填写。
精确到分钟，格式为 hh:mm。例如：12:00。
RepeatEndTime.description_en: Repeat End Time. Required when Repeat Type is Daily, Weekly, or Monthly (repeated effect). Enter the time in hh:mm format, accurate to the minute. Example: 12:00

RepeatStartTime.description_cn:
重复生效起始时间。当重复生效时，需要填写。
精确到分钟，格式为 hh:mm。例如：12:00。
RepeatStartTime.description_en:
Recurring effective start time. Required when recurrence is enabled
Enter time in hh:mm format, e.g. 12:00

RepeatType.description_cn:
重复类型： 
- Permanent：始终生效 
- Once：单次生效 
- Daily：每日重复
- Weekly：每周重复
- Monthly：每月重复
RepeatType.description_en:
Recurrence Type:
- Permanent: Always effective
- Once: Effective once
- Daily: Repeats daily
- Weekly: Repeats weekly
- Monthly: Repeats monthly

Source.description_cn:
源地址: 
- 当SourceType为net时，Source为源CIDR地址。例如：180.\*.\*.1/32 
- 当SourceType为group时，Source为源地址簿的uuid。例如：f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************ 
- 当SourceType为区域时，Source为区域代码。例如：BJ11
Source.description_en:
Source Address: 
- When SourceType is net, Source is the source CIDR address. Example: 180.*.*.1/32 
- When SourceType is group, Source is the UUID of the source address book. Example: f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************ 
- When SourceType is region, Source is the region code. Example: BJ11

SourceType.description_cn:
源地址类型: 
- net：网段(CIDR) 
- group：地址簿
- location：区域
SourceType.description_en:
Source Address Type:
- net: Network Segment (CIDR)
- group: Address Book
- location: Region

StartTime.description_cn:
策略生效起始日期，Unix 时间戳，支持精确到设定日期的 00:00:00。

- 当 RepeatType 为 Permanent（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写。
- 当 RepeatType 为 Once（单时间段生效）或 Daily、Weekly、Monthly（重复生效）时，需填写该字段，字段需要精确到设定日期的 00:00:00。
例如 2024.10.01 开始，则取值为 1727712000，实际起始时间为 2024.10.01 00:00:00。
StartTime.description_en:
Policy start date, in Unix timestamp format. Supports precision to 00:00:00 of the specified date.

- If RepeatType is Permanent (always effective), this field does not need to be filled in.
- If RepeatType is Once (single period), Daily, Weekly, or Monthly (recurring), this field is required and should be set to 00:00:00 of the specified date.
For example, if the start date is 2024-10-01, enter 1727712000. The actual start time will be 2024-10-01 00:00:00.

Status.description_cn:
策略启用状态。默认为false，关闭。

- true：开启
- false：关闭
Status.description_en:
Strategy activation status. Default is false (disabled)

- true: enabled
- false: disabled

Description.description_cn: 策略描述信息，可用于说明策略的用途、作用等。
Description.description_en: Policy description information. Use this field to explain the policy's purpose, function, and more

Destination.description_cn:
访问目的，可以是域名或域名地址簿的唯一标识 ID。当前仅支持一个地址簿。
- 当 `DestinationTyple`为`domain`时：填写域名；
- 当 `DestinationTyple`为`group`时：填写域名地址簿名称。
Destination.description_en:
Purpose of access can be a domain or the unique ID of a domain address book. Only one address book is supported. 
- If `DestinationTyple` is `domain`: enter the domain name
- If `DestinationTyple` is `group`: enter the domain address book name

DestinationType.description_cn:
目的类型，用于指定访问目的的类型。
- `domain`：域名；
- `group`：地址簿。
DestinationType.description_en:
Purpose type, used to specify the type of purpose for access.
- `domain`: Domain name
- `group`: Address book.

InternetFirewallId.description_cn: 互联网边界防火墙实例ID，获取方式可参考[AssetList - 查询互联网边界资产列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)。
InternetFirewallId.description_en: Internet Border Firewall Instance ID. To obtain it, see [AssetList - Query Internet Border Asset List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)

Source.description_cn: 访问源：VPC列表，获取方式可参考[DescribeVpcs-查询VPC列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)。
Source.description_en: Access Source: VPC List. To obtain the VPC list, see [DescribeVpcs - Query VPC List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126).

Source.Region.description_cn: VPC 地域信息，获取方式可参考[DescribeVpcs-查询VPC列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)。
Source.Region.description_en: To obtain VPC region information, see [DescribeVpcs - Query VPC List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126).

Source.VpcId.description_cn: VPC ID，获取方式可参考[DescribeVpcs-查询VPC列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)。
Source.VpcId.description_en: VPC ID. For instructions on how to obtain it, see [DescribeVpcs - Query VPC List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)

Action.description_cn:
策略动作：
- `accept`： 放行
- `deny`： 阻断
- `monitor`： 观察
Action.description_en:
Strategy Actions:
- `accept`: Allow
- `deny`: Block
- `monitor`: Monitor

asset_type.description_en:
Precisely query asset types; multiple selections allowed. Supported asset types:

- `CLB`: load balancer

SrcCandidateList.description_cn:
网络连接实例列表。

* 当 PolicyType 为 one_to_one 时，该列表长度限制为 2。
* 当 PolicyType 为 end_to_end 时，该列表长度限制为 1。
* 当 PolicyType 为 fullmesh 时，该列表长度限制范围：2~20。

* PolicyType 取值为 end_to_end 时，需要同时设置 `SrcCandidateList` 和 `DstCandidateList` 参数。
* PolicyType 取值为 one_to_one、fullmesh 时，无需设置 `DstCandidateList` 参数。
SrcCandidateList.description_en:
Network connection instance list

* When PolicyType is one_to_one, the list length limit is 2.
* When PolicyType is end_to_end, the list length limit is 1.
* When PolicyType is fullmesh, the list length limit is 2~20.

* When PolicyType is end_to_end, you must set both `SrcCandidateList` and `DstCandidateList` parameters.
* When PolicyType is one_to_one or fullmesh, you do not need to set the `DstCandidateList` parameter.

RegionCode.description_cn: 精确查询资产所在的地域，支持多选。例如 `cn-beijing` 表示北京地域，更多地域信息可参考[地域和可用区列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1462739#%E5%9C%B0%E5%9F%9F%E5%92%8C%E5%8F%AF%E7%94%A8%E5%8C%BA%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)。
RegionCode.description_en: Precisely query assets by region; multiple selections supported. For example, `cn-beijing` represents the Beijing region. For more region information, see the [Region and Availability Zone List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1462739#%E5%9C%B0%E5%9F%9F%E5%92%8C%E5%8F%AF%E7%94%A8%E5%8C%BA%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8).

RouteMode.description_cn:
VPC 边界防火墙实例的路由模式，支持多选。
- `manual`：手动模式；
- `auto`：自动模式。
RouteMode.description_en:
Routing mode for VPC edge firewall instances (supports multiple selections)
- `manual`: Manual mode
- `auto`: Automatic mode

RoutePolicyStatus.description_cn:
引流状态，表示 VPC 边界防火墙实例的流量引流状态，支持多选。
- `opened`：开启；
- `closed`：关闭；
- `pending`：配置中。
RoutePolicyStatus.description_en:
Traffic diversion status indicates the traffic diversion state of the VPC border firewall instance. Multiple selections are supported
- `opened`: Open
- `closed`: Closed
- `pending`: Configuring

TransitRouterId.description_cn: 中转路由器实例的唯一标识符，用于指定查询的特定中转路由器实例。
TransitRouterId.description_en: Unique identifier for the transit router instance, used to specify a particular instance when querying

TransitRouterName.description_cn: 中转路由器实例的名称，用于标识特定的中转路由器实例。
TransitRouterName.description_en: Name of the transit router instance, used to identify a specific transit router instance

VpcFirewallName.description_cn: VPC 边界防火墙实例名称。

InternetFirewallId.description_cn: 互联网边界防火墙实例ID，获取方式可参考[AssetList - 查询互联网边界资产列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)。
InternetFirewallId.description_en: Internet boundary firewall instance ID. To obtain it, see [AssetList – Query Internet Boundary Asset List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)

AnalyzeTypeList.description_en: Detection Type: - NoTraffic - No Traffic Detected - SameSrcDst - Same Source and Destination - NoBlockCover - Missing Fallback Block Policy - HighRiskPort - High-Risk Port - LooseLimit - Loose Limit - Deep - Deep Analysis

ConflictType.description_cn: 冲突类型: - Same - 重复冗余 - Diff - 业务冲突
ConflictType.description_en: Conflict Type: - Same - Duplicate/Redundant - Diff - Business Conflict

AnalyzeTypeList.description_en: Detection Types: - NoTraffic - No traffic detected - SameSrcDst - Source and destination are identical - NoBlockCover - Missing fallback blocking policy - HighRiskPort - High-risk port - LooseLimit - Loose restriction - Deep - Deep analysis

FirewallTypeList.description_cn: 检测的防火墙类型: - internet_firewall - 互联网边界防火墙 - vpc_firewall - VPC边界防火墙 - nat_firewall - NAT边界防火墙

AnalyzeTypeList.description_en: Detection Type: - NoTraffic - No Traffic Detected - SameSrcDst - Same Source and Destination - NoBlockCover - Missing Fallback Block Policy - HighRiskPort - High-Risk Port - LooseLimit - Loose Restriction - Deep - Deep Analysis

FirewallTypeList.description_cn: 检测的防火墙类型: - internet_firewall - 互联网边界防火墙 - vpc_firewall - VPC边界防火墙 - nat_firewall - NAT边界防火墙
FirewallTypeList.description_en: Detected Firewall Types: - internet_firewall - Internet Perimeter Firewall - vpc_firewall - VPC Perimeter Firewall - nat_firewall - NAT Perimeter Firewall

DestinationType.description_cn:
访问目的地址类型：

* net：IP 地址
* domain：域名
DestinationType.description_en:
Destination address type:

* net: IP address
* domain: domain name

Direction.description_cn:
方向：

* in：入向（默认值）
* out：出向
Direction.description_en:
Direction:

* in: inbound (default)
* out: outbound

ForceCheck.description_cn: 强制检测，开启后无论是否引流都会检测，默认为 false
ForceCheck.description_en: Force check: When enabled, detection occurs regardless of traffic redirection. Default is false

ForceMatch.description_cn: 强制匹配，开启后会返回所有命中的规则，否则仅返回第一条命中的规则
ForceMatch.description_en: Forced matching. When enabled, all matched rules are returned; otherwise, only the first matched rule is returned

Protocol.description_cn:
访问协议：

* ICMP
* TCP
* UDP

* DestinationType 取值为 domain 时，Protocol 只支持 TCP 类型。
* Protocol 取值为 TCP、UDP 时，DestPort 不能为空。
* FirewallType 取值为 nat_firewall 并且 Direction 取值为 in 时，Protocol 不能为 ICMP。
Protocol.description_en:
Access protocol:

* ICMP
* TCP
* UDP

* When DestinationType is domain, Protocol only supports TCP.
* When Protocol is TCP or UDP, DestPort cannot be empty.
* When FirewallType is nat_firewall and Direction is in, Protocol cannot be ICMP.

Source.description_cn: 访问源地址
Source.description_en: Visit Source Address

AddressDetailList.description_cn: 地址列表，携带详细地址信息。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Manual`时生效。
AddressDetailList.description_en: Address list includes detailed address information. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is set to Manual

AddressDetailList.Address.description_cn:
地址簿中地址的详细信息，具体内容取决于地址簿类型。
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ip`时，填写 IPv4 地址或 CIDRv4 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ipv6`时，填写 IPv6 地址或 CIDRv6 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`port`时，填写端口信息，支持单个端口（如 `22`）或端口范围（如`100/200`）；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`domain`时，填写域名信息。
AddressDetailList.Address.description_en:
The detailed information for addresses in the address book depends on the address book type.
- If `GroupTyp` is `ip`, enter IPv4 address or CIDRv4 information.
- If `GroupTyp` is `ipv6`, enter IPv6 address or CIDRv6 information.
- If `GroupTyp` is `port`, enter port information. You can enter a single port (such as `22`) or a port range (such as `100/200`).
- If `GroupTyp` is `domain`, enter domain name information.

AddressDetailList.Description.description_cn: 对地址簿中单个地址的详细描述信息，用于说明该地址的具体用途或其他相关信息。
AddressDetailList.Description.description_en: Detailed description for a single address in the address book, used to specify its purpose or other relevant information
AddressDetailList.Description.example_cn: 公司内部服务器 IP 地址

AddressList.description_cn:
地址簿中的地址列表，具体内容取决于地址簿类型。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Manual`且`AddressDetailList`不为空时生效。
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ip`时，填写 IPv4 地址或 CIDRv4 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ipv6`时，填写 IPv6 地址或 CIDRv6 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`port`时，填写端口信息，支持单个端口（如 `22`）或端口范围（如`100/200`）；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`domain`时，填写域名信息。
AddressList.description_en:
Address list in the address book; the specific content depends on the address book type. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Manual` and `AddressDetailList` is not empty.
- When `GroupTyp` is `ip`, enter IPv4 addresses or CIDRv4 information.
- When `GroupTyp` is `ipv6`, enter IPv6 addresses or CIDRv6 information.
- When `GroupTyp` is `port`, enter port information; supports single ports (e.g., `22`) or port ranges (e.g., `100/200`).
- When `GroupTyp` is `domain`, enter domain name information.

AutoUpdateType.description_cn:
地址簿的自动更新类型，默认值为 `Manual`。支持的取值如下所示。
- `Manual`：手动更新；
- `Tag`：标签地址簿。有新匹配标签的资产，会自动加入到当前地址簿，当前仅支持互联网边界。
AutoUpdateType.description_en:
Auto-update type for the address book. The default value is `Manual`. Supported values are as follows:
- `Manual`: Manual update
- `Tag`: Tag address book. Assets with newly matched tags are automatically added to the current address book. Currently, only the internet boundary is supported.

CloudFirewallId.description_cn: 云防火墙实例的唯一标识 ID，用于指定需要修改地址簿的云防火墙实例。
CloudFirewallId.description_en: Unique ID of the cloud firewall instance, used to specify which cloud firewall instance's address book to modify

Description.description_cn: 地址簿的描述信息，用于详细说明地址簿的用途或内容。
Description.description_en: Description for the address book, used to describe in detail its purpose or contents
Description.example_cn: 用于存储内部服务器IP地址
Description.example_en: Used to store internal server IP addresses

GroupName.description_cn:
地址簿的名称，需要满足以下要求：

- 中文字符、大小写英文字母、`-` 和 `_`。
- 最大长度为 `64` 个字符。
GroupName.description_en:
Address book names must meet the following requirements:

- Only Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase English letters, '-', and '_' are allowed
- Maximum length is 64 characters

GroupUuid.description_cn: 地址簿唯一标识ID，获取方式可参考[DescribeAddressBook - 查询访问控制地址簿](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223834)。
GroupUuid.description_en: Address Book Unique ID. For details on how to obtain it, see [DescribeAddressBook – Query Access Control Address Book](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223834)

InstanceTypeList.description_cn:
资产类型列表，用于指定地址簿中包含的资产类型。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。支持的取值如下所示。
- `EcsInstance`：云服务器；
- `NetworkInterface`：网卡；
- `HaVip`：高可用虚拟 IP；
- `Nat`：NAT 网关；
- `ClbInstance`：负载均衡；
- `AlbInstance`：应用型负载均衡；
- `VpnGateway`：VPN 网关。
InstanceTypeList.description_en:
Asset type list, used to specify the asset types included in the address book. Takes effect when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`. Supported values are as follows:
- `EcsInstance`: cloud server
- `NetworkInterface`: network interface
- `HaVip`: high-availability virtual IP
- `Nat`: NAT gateway
- `ClbInstance`: load balancer
- `AlbInstance`: application load balancer
- `VpnGateway`: VPN gateway

IpsDir.description_cn: 方向。0-入向，1-出向, 对vfw该字段无意义
IpsDir.description_en: Direction: 0 - Inbound, 1 - Outbound; this field is not applicable to vfw

ResourceType.description_cn:
标签类型，用于指定地址簿中资源的类型。标签类型，用于指定地址簿中资源的类型。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。支持的取值如下所示。
- `Eip`：公网 IP；
- `InternetAsset`：公网资产。
ResourceType.description_en:
Label type, used to specify the type of resources in the address book
Takes effect when `AutoUpdateType` is `Tag`
Supported values are as follows:
- `Eip`: Public IP
- `InternetAsset`: Public asset

TagRelation.description_cn:
标签之间的逻辑关系，用于指定多个标签之间的组合方式。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。支持的取值如下所示。
- `And`：与关系，表示所有标签必须同时满足；
- `Or`：或关系，表示满足任意一个标签即可。
TagRelation.description_en:
Logical relationship between tags, used to specify how multiple tags are combined. Takes effect when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`. Supported values are as follows:
- `And`: All tags must be satisfied at the same time.
- `Or`: Satisfying any one tag is sufficient.

Tags.description_cn: 标签列表，用于对地址簿进行分类或标记。每个标签包含键值对。当`AutoUpdateType`为`Tag`时生效。
Tags.description_en: Tag list used to categorize or mark the address book. Each tag contains key-value pairs. Effective when `AutoUpdateType` is set to `Tag`.

Tags.Key.description_cn: 标签键，根据[标签键查询接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450)获取标签键信息并传入。
Tags.Key.description_en: Tag key: Obtain the tag key information using the [Tag Key Query API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450) and enter it

Tags.Value.description_cn: 标签值，根据[标签键查询接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450)获取标签键对应的标签值信息并传入。
Tags.Value.description_en: Tag value: Obtain the tag value information corresponding to the tag key using the [Tag Key Query API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1130450) and enter it

地址簿中地址的详细信息，具体内容取决于地址簿类型。
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ip`时，填写 IPv4 地址或 CIDRv4 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`ipv6`时，填写 IPv6 地址或 CIDRv6 信息；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`port`时，填写端口信息，支持单个端口（如 `22`）或端口范围（如`100/200`）；
- 当`GroupTyp`为`domain`时，填写域名信息。
AddressDetailList.Address.description_en:
The detailed information for addresses in the address book depends on the address book type.
- If `GroupTyp` is `ip`, enter IPv4 address or CIDRv4 information.
- If `GroupTyp` is `ipv6`, enter IPv6 address or CIDRv6 information.
- If `GroupTyp` is `port`, enter port information. You can enter a single port (such as `22`) or a port range (such as `100/200`).
- If `GroupTyp` is `domain`, enter domain name information.

AddressDetailList.Description.description_cn: 对地址簿中单个地址的详细描述信息，用于说明该地址的具体用途或其他相关信息。
AddressDetailList.Description.description_en: Detailed description for a single address in the address book, used to specify its purpose or other relevant information
AddressDetailList.Description.example_cn: 公司内部服务器 IP 地址

CloudFirewallId.description_cn: 云防火墙实例的唯一标识符，用于指定需要修改地址簿的云防火墙实例。
CloudFirewallId.description_en: Unique identifier of the cloud firewall instance whose address book needs to be modified

GroupUuid.description_cn: 地址簿的唯一标识 ID，用于指定需要修改的地址簿。
GroupUuid.description_en: Unique ID of the address book used to specify which address book to modify

ModifyType.description_cn:
指定对地址簿的修改类型。支持的取值如下所示。
- `Add`：添加地址；
- `Remove`：删除地址。
ModifyType.description_en:
Specify the type of modification for the address book. Supported values:
- `Add`: Add address
- `Remove`: Remove address

Action.description_cn:
策略动作： 
- accept - 放行 
- deny - 阻断 
- monitor - 观察
Action.description_en:
Policy Actions:
- Accept - Allow
- Deny - Block
- Monitor - Observe

Description.description_cn: 策略的描述信息，用于说明该访问控制策略的用途或备注。
Description.description_en: Description for the policy, used to specify the purpose or remarks for this access control policy
Description.example_cn: 允许来自内部网络的访问

DestPort.description_cn:
目的端口，格式为单个端口或端口范围。

- 当协议类型为 `ICMP` 或 `ALL` 时，取值为空；
- 当 `DestPortType` 为 `group` 时，取值为端口地址簿的 `UUID` 列表，多个地址簿通过英文逗号分隔；
- 当 `DestPortType` 为 `port` 时，取值为端口范围。
DestPort.description_en:
Destination port, formatted as a single port or port range

- If the protocol type is `ICMP` or `ALL`, leave this field empty
- If `DestPortType` is `group`, enter a list of port address book `UUIDs`, separated by commas
- If `DestPortType` is `port`, enter a port range

DestPortType.description_cn:
目的端口类型，取值如下所示。
- `port`：端口；
- `group`：端口地址簿。
DestPortType.description_en:
Destination port type. Possible values:
- `port`: Port
- `group`: Port address book

Destination.description_cn:
目的地址，根据 `DestinationType` 的不同取值有不同的格式要求。
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `net` 时，格式为目的 `CIDR` 地址，例如：`180.*.*.1/32`；
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `group` 时，格式为目的地址簿的 `UUID` 列表，多个地址簿用英文逗号分隔，例如：`f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************, f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`；
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `location` 时，格式为目的区域代码，多个地域用英文逗号分隔，例如：`BJ11, ZB`；
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `domain` 时，格式为目的域名，例如：`*****.com`。
Destination.description_en:
Destination address format requirements vary based on the value of `DestinationType`:
- If `DestinationType` is `net`, enter the destination `CIDR` address, for example: `180.*.*.1/32`
- If `DestinationType` is `group`, enter a list of destination address book `UUIDs` separated by commas, for example: `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************, f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`
- If `DestinationType` is `location`, enter the destination region codes separated by commas, for example: `BJ11, ZB`
- If `DestinationType` is `domain`, enter the destination domain name, for example: `*****.com`

DestinationType.description_cn:
目的地址类型，用于指定目的地址的格式和来源。

- `net`：目的网段（CIDR格式）；
- `group`：目的地址簿（UUID列表）；
- `location`：目的区域代码；
- `domain`：目的域名。
DestinationType.description_en:
Destination address type, used to specify the format and source of the destination address

- `net`: destination network segment (CIDR format)
- `group`: destination address book (UUID list)
- `location`: destination region code
- `domain`: destination domain name

Direction.description_cn:
策略方向，用于指定访问控制策略的流量方向。

- `in`：入方向（外部到内部）；
- `out`：出方向（内部到外部）。
Direction.description_en:
Policy direction, used to specify the traffic direction for access control policies

- `in`: inbound (external to internal)
- `out`: outbound (internal to external)

DomainResolutionMode.description_cn: 域名解析模式： - fqdn - 完整域名解析 - dns - 动态DNS解析
DomainResolutionMode.description_en: Domain Name Resolution Modes: - fqdn - Full Domain Name Resolution - dns - Dynamic DNS Resolution

EndTime.description_cn:
策略生效截止日期，Unix 时间戳，支持精确到设定日期的 `23:59:00`。

- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Permanent`（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写。
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Once`（单时间段生效）或 `Daily`、`Weekly`、`Monthly`（重复生效）时，需填写该字段，字段需要精确到设定日期的 `23:59:00`。
EndTime.description_en:
Policy effective end date, Unix timestamp. The value must be precise to 23:59:00 on the specified date.

- If `RepeatType` is `Permanent`, this field does not need to be filled in.
- If `RepeatType` is `Once`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, this field must be filled in and must be precise to 23:59:00 on the specified date.

InternetFirewallId.description_cn: 互联网边界防火墙实例ID，获取方式可参考[AssetList - 查询互联网边界资产列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)。
InternetFirewallId.description_en: Internet boundary firewall instance ID. For instructions on how to obtain it, see [AssetList – Query Internet Boundary Asset List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)

IpType.description_cn:
IP 版本，用于指定访问控制策略适用的 IP 协议类型。
- `v4`：IPv4 协议；
- `v6`：IPv6 协议。
IpType.description_en:
IP version, used to specify the IP protocol type for access control policies
- `v4`: IPv4 protocol
- `v6`: IPv6 protocol

Proto.description_cn:
协议类型，用于指定访问控制策略的流量协议。当 `DestinationType` 为 `domain` 时，只能选择 `TCP` 协议。可选值如下所示。
- `ICMP`：ICMP协议；
- `TCP`：TCP协议；
- `UDP`：UDP协议；
- `ANY`：任何协议。
Proto.description_en:
Protocol type, used to specify the traffic protocol for access control policies. When `DestinationType` is set to `domain`, only the `TCP` protocol can be selected. Available options:
- `ICMP`: ICMP protocol
- `TCP`: TCP protocol
- `UDP`: UDP protocol
- `ANY`: Any protocol

RepeatDays.description_cn:
重复生效周期，用于指定策略在每周或每月的具体生效日期。

- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly`（每周重复）时，取值范围为 `[0, 6]`，分别对应：
  - `0`：周日
  - `1`：周一
  - `2`：周二
  - `3`：周三
  - `4`：周四
  - `5`：周五
  - `6`：周六
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Monthly`（每月重复）时，取值范围为 `[1, 31]`，对应每月的具体日期。

注意：
- 仅当 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly` 或 `Monthly` 时需填写此字段；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`（每日重复）时无需填写；
- 多个日期需以数组形式提供。
RepeatDays.description_en:
Recurrence dates. Use this field to specify the exact dates when the policy takes effect each week or month.

- If `RepeatType` is `Weekly`, the value range is `[0, 6]`, where:
  - `0`: Sunday
  - `1`: Monday
  - `2`: Tuesday
  - `3`: Wednesday
  - `4`: Thursday
  - `5`: Friday
  - `6`: Saturday
- If `RepeatType` is `Monthly`, the value range is `[1, 31]`, representing the specific day of the month.

Note:
- Fill in this field only if `RepeatType` is `Weekly` or `Monthly`
- Do not fill in this field if `RepeatType` is `Daily`
- Provide multiple dates as an array

RepeatEndTime.description_cn: 重复生效截止时间。当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly`、`Monthly`（重复生效）时，需要填写。精确到分钟，格式为 `hh:mm`。例如：`17:30`。
RepeatEndTime.description_en: Repeat effective end time. Required when `RepeatType` is `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly` (repeating effect). Enter the time to the minute in the format `hh:mm`, for example: `17:30`.

RepeatStartTime.description_cn: 重复生效起始时间。当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly`、`Monthly`（重复生效）时，需要填写。精确到分钟，格式为 `hh:mm`。例如：`08:00`。
RepeatStartTime.description_en: Repeat effective start time. Required when `RepeatType` is set to `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`. Enter the time in hh:mm format, accurate to the minute. For example: `08:00`

RepeatType.description_cn:
访问控制策略的重复类型，用于精确查询策略的执行频率。
- `Permanent`：永久有效；
- `Once`：单次执行；
- `Daily`：每天执行；
- `Weekly`：每周执行；
- `Monthly`：每月执行。
RepeatType.description_en:
Recurrence types for access control policies, used to precisely query policy execution frequency
- Permanent: Permanently valid
- Once: Executes once
- Daily: Executes every day
- Weekly: Executes every week
- Monthly: Executes every month

RuleId.description_cn: 访问控制策略唯一标识 ID，获取方式可参考[DescribeControlPolicy - 查询互联网边界流量控制网关策略](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223854)。
RuleId.description_en: Unique access control policy ID. For instructions on how to obtain it, see [DescribeControlPolicy – Query Internet Boundary Traffic Control Gateway Policy](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223854)

Source.description_cn:
源地址，根据 `SourceType` 的不同取值有不同的格式要求。
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `net` 时，格式为源 `CIDR` 地址，例如：`180.*.*.1/32`；
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `group` 时，格式为源地址簿的 `UUID` 列表，最多支持 `50` 个地址簿，多个地址簿用英文逗号分隔，例如：`f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************；
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `location` 时，格式为源区域代码，多个地域用英文逗号分隔，例如：`BJ11, ZB`。
Source.description_en:
Source address. The required format depends on the value of `SourceType`.
- If `SourceType` is `net`, use the source `CIDR` address format. For example: `180.*.*.1/32`.
- If `SourceType` is `group`, use a list of source address book `UUIDs`. Up to 50 address books are supported. Separate multiple address books with English commas. For example: `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`.
- If `SourceType` is `location`, use the source region code format. Separate multiple regions with English commas. For example: `BJ11, ZB`.

SourceType.description_cn:
源地址类型，用于指定源地址的格式和来源。
- `net`：源网段（CIDR格式）；
- `group`：源地址簿（UUID列表）；
- `location`：源区域代码。
SourceType.description_en:
Source address type, used to specify the format and origin of the source address
- `net`: Source network segment (CIDR format)
- `group`: Source address book (UUID list)
- `location`: Source region code

StartTime.description_cn:
策略生效起始日期，Unix 时间戳，支持精确到设定日期的 `00:00:00`。

- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Permanent`（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Once`（单时间段生效）或 `Daily`、`Weekly`、`Monthly`（重复生效）时，需填写该字段，字段需要精确到设定日期的 `00:00:00`。
StartTime.description_en:
The policy start date, in Unix timestamp format, must be precise to `00:00:00` on the specified date.

- If `RepeatType` is set to `Permanent` (always effective), this field is not required
- If `RepeatType` is set to `Once` (effective for a single period), `Daily` (repeats daily), `Weekly` (repeats weekly), or `Monthly` (repeats monthly), you must enter this field, specifying the date with precision to `00:00:00` on the specified date

Status.description_cn:
访问控制策略的开关状态，用于精确查询策略的启用状态。
- `false`：关闭；
- `true`：开启。
Status.description_en:
Switch status of the access control policy, used to accurately query whether the policy is enabled
- `false`: Disabled
- `true`: Enabled

Direction.description_cn:
访问控制策略的方向，表示流量的传输方向，取值如下所示。
- `in`：入方向；
- `out`：出方向。
Direction.description_en:
The direction in access control policies indicates the direction of traffic transmission. Possible values:
- `in`: inbound direction
- `out`: outbound direction

InternetFirewallId.description_cn: 互联网边界防火墙实例ID，获取方式可参考[AssetList - 查询互联网边界资产列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)。
InternetFirewallId.description_en: Internet Boundary Firewall Instance ID. To obtain it, see [AssetList - Query Internet Boundary Asset List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)

NewPrio.description_cn: 为互联网边界防火墙IPv4访问控制策略设置一个新的优先级。优先级使用数字表示，输入数字`1`表示优先级最高，数字越大优先级越低。
NewPrio.description_en: Set a new priority for the IPv4 access control policy on the internet border firewall. Priority is indicated by a number; enter '1' for the highest priority. Larger numbers mean lower priority.

RuleId.description_cn: 访问控制策略唯一标识ID，获取方式可参考[DescribeControlPolicy - 查询互联网边界流量控制网关策略](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223854)。
RuleId.description_en: Unique ID of the access control policy. For details on how to obtain it, see [DescribeControlPolicy - Query Internet Border Traffic Control Gateway Policy](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223854)

Description.description_cn: 访问控制策略的描述信息，用于说明该策略的用途或备注信息。
Description.description_en: Description for the access control policy, used to specify its purpose or add remarks
Description.example_cn: 禁止访问外部恶意域名
Description.example_en: Block Access to External Malicious Domains

Destination.description_cn: 访问目的，可以是域名或域名地址簿的唯一标识 ID。当前仅支持一个地址簿。
Destination.description_en: For access purposes, you can use a domain name or the unique ID of a domain address book. Only one address book is supported.

DestinationType.description_cn:
访问目的的类型，用于指定 `Destination` 字段的内容类型。支持的取值如下所示。
- `domain`：表示 `Destination` 为域名；
- `group`：表示 `Destination` 为域名地址簿的唯一标识 ID。
DestinationType.description_en:
Type of access purpose, used to specify the content type of the `Destination` field. Supported values:
- `domain`: Indicates that `Destination` is a domain name
- `group`: Indicates that `Destination` is the unique identifier (ID) of a domain address book

InternetFirewallId.description_cn: 互联网边界防火墙实例ID，获取方式可参考[AssetList - 查询互联网边界资产列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)。
InternetFirewallId.description_en: Internet boundary firewall instance ID. To obtain it, see [AssetList – Query Internet Boundary Asset List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1223860)

RuleId.description_cn: 访问控制策略唯一标识ID，获取方式可参考[DescribeDnsControlPolicy-查询域名黑名单访问控制策略列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400124)。
RuleId.description_en: Unique identifier for the access control policy. For instructions on how to obtain it, see [DescribeDnsControlPolicy – Query domain blacklist access control policy list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400124).

Source.description_cn: 访问源：VPC列表，获取方式可参考[DescribeVpcs-查询VPC列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)。
Source.description_en: Access source: VPC list. Refer to [DescribeVpcs - Query VPC List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126) for how to obtain it

Source.Region.description_cn: VPC 地域信息，获取方式可参考[DescribeVpcs-查询VPC列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)。
Source.Region.description_en: To obtain VPC region information, see [DescribeVpcs - Query VPC List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126).

Source.VpcId.description_cn: VPC ID，获取方式可参考[DescribeVpcs-查询VPC列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)。
Source.VpcId.description_en: VPC ID. For instructions on how to obtain it, see [DescribeVpcs - Query VPC List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1400126)

Status.description_cn:
访问控制策略的开关状态。支持的取值如下所示。
- `false`：关闭；
- `true`：开启。
Status.description_en:
Switch status for the access control policy. Supported values:
- `false`: Off
- `true`: On

Action.description_cn:
策略动作。
- `accept`： 放行
- `deny`： 阻断
- `monitor`： 观察
Action.description_en:
Policy Actions
- `accept`: Allow
- `deny`: Block
- `monitor`: Monitor

Description.description_cn: 策略描述信息，可用于说明策略的用途、作用等。
Description.description_en: Policy description information. Use this to explain the policy’s purpose, function, etc.

DestPort.description_cn:
目的端口，其格式和内容取决于 `DestPortType` 和 `Proto` 字段的取值。

- 当协议类型为 `ICMP` 或 `ALL` 时，取值为空；
- 当 `DestPortType` 为 `group` 时，取值为端口地址簿的 UUID 列表，多个地址簿通过英文逗号分隔；
- 当 `DestPortType` 为 `port` 时，取值为端口范围，格式为单个端口（如 `22`）或端口范围（如 `100/200`）。
DestPort.description_en:
Destination port. The format and content depend on the values of the `DestPortType` and `Proto` fields.

- If the protocol type is `ICMP` or `ALL`, the value is empty.
- If `DestPortType` is `group`, the value is a list of UUIDs from the port address book, separated by English commas (,).
- If `DestPortType` is `port`, the value is a port range, formatted as a single port (such as `22`) or a port range (such as `100/200`).

DestPortType.description_cn:
访问控制策略的目的端口类型，用于指定 `DestPort` 字段的格式和内容。支持的取值如下所示。
- `port`：端口或端口范围；
- `group`：端口地址簿。
DestPortType.description_en:
Destination port type for access control policies, used to specify the format and content of the `DestPort` field. Supported values:
- `port`: Port or port range
- `group`: Port address book

Destination.description_cn:
访问控制策略的目的地址，其格式和内容取决于 `DestinationType` 字段的取值。支持的取值如下所示。
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `net` 时，格式为 CIDR 地址（如 `192.168.0.2/32`）；
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `group` 时，格式为目的地址簿的 UUID（如 `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`）。
Destination.description_en:
The destination address for an access control policy depends on the value of the `DestinationType` field. Supported values are as follows:
- If `DestinationType` is `net`, the format is a CIDR address (for example, `192.168.0.2/32`)
- If `DestinationType` is `group`, the format is the UUID of the destination address book (for example, `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`)

DestinationType.description_cn:
目的地址的类型，用于指定 `Destination` 字段的格式和内容。支持的取值如下所示。
- `net`：网段（CIDR）；
- `group`：地址簿；
DestinationType.description_en:
Destination address type, used to specify the format and content of the `Destination` field. Supported values:
- `net`: network segment (CIDR)
- `group`: address book

Direction.description_cn:
策略方向，用于指定访问控制策略的流量方向。支持的取值如下所示。
- `in`：入向；
- `out`：出向。
Direction.description_en:
Policy direction specifies the traffic direction for the access control policy. Supported values:
- `in`: incoming
- `out`: outgoing

DomainResolutionMode.description_cn: 域名解析模式： - fqdn - 完整域名解析 - dns - 动态DNS解析
DomainResolutionMode.description_en: Domain Name Resolution Modes: - fqdn - Full Domain Name Resolution - dns - Dynamic DNS Resolution

EndTime.description_cn:
策略生效截止日期，Unix 时间戳，支持精确到设定日期的 `23:59:00`。
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Permanent`（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写。
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Once`（单时间段生效）或 `Daily`、`Weekly`、`Monthly`（重复生效）时，需填写该字段，字段需要精确到设定日期的 `23:59:00`。
EndTime.description_en:
Policy end date, Unix timestamp, supports precision up to 23:59:00 on the specified date
- If `RepeatType` is `Permanent`, this field is not required
- If `RepeatType` is `Once`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, you must enter this field and the value must be precise up to 23:59:00 on the specified date

NatFirewallId.description_cn: NAT 边界防火墙实例 ID。获取方式可参考[DescribeNatFirewallList - 查询NAT边界防火墙实例列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387361)。
NatFirewallId.description_en: NAT boundary firewall instance ID. For details on how to obtain it, see [DescribeNatFirewallList - Query NAT Boundary Firewall Instance List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387361)

Proto.description_cn:
协议类型，用于指定访问控制策略的流量协议。当 `DestinationType` 为 `domain` 时，`Proto` 只能是 `TCP`。支持的取值如下所示。
- `ICMP`：ICMP 协议；
- `TCP`：TCP 协议；
- `UDP`：UDP 协议；
- `ANY`：任何协议。
Proto.description_en:
Protocol type, used to specify the traffic protocol for access control policies. When `DestinationType` is set to `domain`, `Proto` can only be `TCP`. Supported values are:
- `ICMP`: ICMP protocol
- `TCP`: TCP protocol
- `UDP`: UDP protocol
- `ANY`: Any protocol

RepeatDays.description_cn:
重复生效的日期列表，仅在 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly` 或 `Monthly` 时有效。
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly` 时，取值范围为 `[0, 6]`，其中 `0` 表示周日，`1` 表示周一，以此类推；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Monthly` 时，取值范围为 `[1, 31]`，表示每月的具体日期。
RepeatDays.description_en:
List of dates on which the repeat takes effect. Only valid when `RepeatType` is set to `Weekly` or `Monthly`.
- For `Weekly`, values range from `[0, 6]`, where `0` represents Sunday, `1` represents Monday, and so on.
- For `Monthly`, values range from `[1, 31]`, representing specific dates in each month.

RepeatEndTime.description_cn:
重复生效截止时间。当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly` 或 `Monthly`（重复生效）时，必须填写该字段。

精确到分钟，格式为 `hh:mm`。例如：`23:59` 表示每天晚上 23:59 结束生效。
RepeatEndTime.description_en:
Recurring End Time
Required when `RepeatType` is set to `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly` (recurring activation)
Enter the time in `hh:mm` format, accurate to the minute. For example, `23:59` means the effect ends at 23:59 each night

RepeatStartTime.description_cn: 重复生效的开始时间，精确到分钟，格式为 `hh:mm`。当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly` 或 `Monthly` 时，必须填写该字段。例如：`08:00` 表示每天早上 8 点开始生效。
RepeatStartTime.description_en: Start time for recurring activation, accurate to the minute, in the format `hh:mm`. This field is required when `RepeatType` is set to `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`. For example, `08:00` means activation starts every day at 8 a.m.

RepeatType.description_cn:
策略的重复生效类型，用于指定策略生效的时间模式。支持的取值如下所示。
- `Permanent`：始终生效；
- `Once`：单次生效；
- `Daily`：每日重复；
- `Weekly`：每周重复；
- `Monthly`：每月重复。
RepeatType.description_en:
Policy recurrence type specifies the time pattern for when a policy becomes effective. Supported values are as follows:
- `Permanent`: always effective
- `Once`: effective once
- `Daily`: repeats daily
- `Weekly`: repeats weekly
- `Monthly`: repeats monthly

RuleId.description_cn: 访问控制策略唯一标识 ID。获取方式可参考[DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy - 查询 NAT 边界防火墙访问控制策略列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387366)。
RuleId.description_en: Access control policy unique ID. Refer to [DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy – Query NAT firewall access control policy list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387366) for details on how to obtain it

Source.description_cn:
访问控制策略的源地址，其格式和内容取决于 `SourceType` 字段的取值。支持的取值如下所示。
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `net` 时，格式为 CIDR 地址（如 `192.168.1.1/32`）；
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `group` 时，格式为源地址簿的 UUID（如 `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`）；
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `location` 时，格式为区域代码（如 `BJ11`）。
Source.description_en:
The format and content of the source address for access control policies depend on the value of the `SourceType` field. Supported values are as follows:
- If `SourceType` is `net`, use a CIDR address (for example, `192.168.1.1/32`)
- If `SourceType` is `group`, use the UUID of the source address book (for example, `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`)
- If `SourceType` is `location`, use a region code (for example, `BJ11`)

SourceType.description_cn:
源地址的类型，用于指定 `Source` 字段的格式和内容。支持的取值如下所示。
- `net`：网段（CIDR）；
- `group`：地址簿；
- `location`：区域。
SourceType.description_en:
Source address type. Specifies the format and content of the `Source` field. Supported values:
- `net`: network segment (CIDR)
- `group`: address book
- `location`: region

StartTime.description_cn:
策略生效的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳格式，精确到设定日期的 00:00:00。具体规则如下：
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Permanent`（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Once`（单时间段生效）时，需填写精确到分钟的 Unix 时间戳；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly` 或 `Monthly`（重复生效）时，需填写设定日期的 00:00:00 对应的时间戳。
StartTime.description_en:
Policy start time uses the Unix timestamp format and must be set to 00:00:00 of the selected date. The rules are as follows:
- If `RepeatType` is `Permanent`, leave this field blank
- If `RepeatType` is `Once`, enter a Unix timestamp accurate to the minute
- If `RepeatType` is `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, enter the Unix timestamp for 00:00:00 of the selected date

Status.description_cn:
VPC 边界防火墙访问控制策略的开关状态，默认值为 `false`。支持的取值如下所示。
- `true`：开启；
- `false`：关闭。
Status.description_en:
Switch status for the VPC boundary firewall access control policy. Default value is `false`. Supported values:
- `true`: Enabled
- `false`: Disabled

Direction.description_cn:
访问控制策略的方向，支持的取值如下所示。
- `in`：入向；
- `out`：出向。
Direction.description_en:
Direction of access control policy. Supported values:
- `in`: inbound
- `out`: outbound

NatFirewallId.description_cn: NAT 边界防火墙实例 ID。获取方式可参考[DescribeNatFirewallList - 查询NAT边界防火墙实例列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387361)。
NatFirewallId.description_en: NAT edge firewall instance ID. Refer to [DescribeNatFirewallList – Query NAT edge firewall instance list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387361)

NewPrio.description_cn:
新优先级。
更新前请先确认已有优先级，避免冲突。
NewPrio.description_en:
New Priority
Check existing priorities before updating to avoid conflicts

RuleId.description_cn: 访问控制策略唯一标识 ID。获取方式可参考[DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy - 查询 NAT 边界防火墙访问控制策略列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387366)。
RuleId.description_en: Access control policy unique ID. For details on how to obtain it, see [DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy – Query NAT Firewall Access Control Policy List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6516/1387366)

Bandwidth.description_cn: VPC防火墙带宽,单位为mbps
Bandwidth.description_en: VPC Firewall Bandwidth (Unit: Mbps)

Action.description_cn:
策略动作： 
- accept - 放行 
- deny - 阻断 
- monitor - 观察
Action.description_en:
Strategy Actions:
- Allow – 放行
- Block – 阻断
- Monitor – 观察

Description.description_cn: 访问控制策略的描述信息，用于说明该策略的用途或备注信息。
Description.description_en: This is the description for the access control policy; use it to specify its purpose or provide remarks
Description.example_cn: 允许财务部门访问生产数据库
Description.example_en: Allow Finance Department to Access Production Database

DestPort.description_cn:
目的端口，格式为单个端口（如 `22/22`）或端口范围（如 `100/200`）。具体取值规则如下：
- 当协议类型为 `ICMP` 或 `ALL` 时，该字段为空；
- 当 `DestPortType` 为 `group` 时，该字段为端口地址簿的 UUID 列表；
- 当 `DestPortType` 为 `port` 时，该字段为端口范围。
DestPort.description_en:
Destination port. Format: single port (such as `22/22`) or port range (such as `100/200`). Value rules:
- If the protocol type is `ICMP` or `ALL`, this field is empty
- If `DestPortType` is `group`, this field is a list of UUIDs from the port address book
- If `DestPortType` is `port`, this field is a port range

DestPortType.description_cn:
目的端口类型，用于指定 `DestPort` 字段的取值格式。支持的取值如下所示。
- `port`：端口或端口范围；
- `group`：端口地址簿的 UUID 列表。
DestPortType.description_en:
Destination port type, used to specify the value format for the `DestPort` field. Supported values:
- `port`: Port or port range
- `group`: List of UUIDs from the port address book

Destination.description_cn:
目的地址，其格式和内容取决于 `DestinationType` 的取值。支持的格式如下所示。
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `net` 时，该字段为 CIDR 格式的网段地址，例如 `192.168.1.2/32`；
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `group` 时，该字段为目的地址簿的 UUID，例如 `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`；
- 当 `DestinationType` 为 `domain` 时，该字段为目的域名，例如 `example.com`。
Destination.description_en:
Destination address. The format and content depend on the value of `DestinationType`. Supported formats are as follows:
- If `DestinationType` is `net`, this field uses a CIDR network address, such as `192.168.1.2/32`
- If `DestinationType` is `group`, this field uses the UUID of the destination address book, such as `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`
- If `DestinationType` is `domain`, this field uses the destination domain name, such as `example.com`

DestinationType.description_cn:
目的地址的类型，用于指定 `Destination` 字段的格式和内容。支持的取值如下所示。
- `net`：网段（CIDR 格式）；
- `group`：地址簿的 UUID；
- `domain`：域名。
DestinationType.description_en:
Destination address type specifies the format and content of the `Destination` field. Supported values:
- `net`: network segment (CIDR format)
- `group`: address book UUID
- `domain`: domain name

DomainResolutionMode.description_cn: 域名解析模式： - fqdn - 完整域名解析 - dns - 动态DNS解析
DomainResolutionMode.description_en: Domain Name Resolution Mode: - fqdn - Full Domain Name Resolution - dns - Dynamic DNS Resolution

EndTime.description_cn:
策略生效的截止时间，使用 Unix 时间戳格式，精确到设定日期的 23:59:00。具体规则如下：
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Permanent`（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Once`（单时间段生效）时，需填写精确到分钟的 Unix 时间戳；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly` 或 `Monthly`（重复生效）时，需填写设定日期的 23:59:00 对应的时间戳。
EndTime.description_en:
Policy effective end time uses the Unix timestamp format and must be precise to 23:59:00 on the specified date. The rules are as follows:
- If `RepeatType` is `Permanent` (always effective), leave this field blank
- If `RepeatType` is `Once` (effective for a single time period), enter a Unix timestamp accurate to the minute for the specified period
- If `RepeatType` is `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly` (effective for repeated periods), enter the Unix timestamp corresponding to 23:59:00 on the specified date for each repeated period

IpType.description_cn: IP版本： - v4 - IPv4 - v6 - IPv6
IpType.description_en: IP Version: - v4 - IPv4 - v6 - IPv6

Proto.description_cn:
访问控制策略的协议类型。当 `DestinationType` 为 `domain` 时，该字段仅支持 `TCP`。支持的协议类型如下所示。
- `ICMP`：ICMP 协议；
- `TCP`：TCP 协议；
- `UDP`：UDP 协议；
- `ANY`：任何协议。
Proto.description_en:
Protocol type for access control policies. When `DestinationType` is set to `domain`, only `TCP` is supported for this field. Supported protocol types are as follows:
- `ICMP`: ICMP protocol
- `TCP`: TCP protocol
- `UDP`: UDP protocol
- `ANY`: Any protocol

RepeatDays.description_cn:
策略重复生效的具体日期，仅在 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly` 或 `Monthly` 时有效。
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly` 时，取值范围为 `[0, 6]`，分别对应周日到周六；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Monthly` 时，取值范围为 `[1, 31]`，对应每月的具体日期。
RepeatDays.description_en:
The specific date for recurring strategy activation is only valid when `RepeatType` is set to `Weekly` or `Monthly`.
- If `RepeatType` is `Weekly`, the value range is `[0, 6]`, corresponding respectively to Sunday through Saturday.
- If `RepeatType` is `Monthly`, the value range is `[1, 31]`, representing the specific day of the month.

RepeatEndTime.description_cn: 策略重复生效的结束时间，格式为 `hh:mm`。仅在 `RepeatType` 为 `Weekly` 或 `Monthly` 时有效，表示策略在重复生效周期内的每日结束时间。
RepeatEndTime.description_en: End time for each day the strategy is active during its recurring period, format: `hh:mm`. Only valid when `RepeatType` is set to `Weekly` or `Monthly`.

RepeatStartTime.description_cn: 策略重复生效的起始时间，格式为 `hh:mm`。仅在 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly` 或 `Monthly` 时有效，表示策略在重复生效周期内的每日开始时间。
RepeatStartTime.description_en: Start time for recurring activation of the policy, format: `hh:mm`. Only valid when `RepeatType` is set to `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`. Specifies the daily start time during each recurring effective period.

RepeatType.description_cn:
重复类型，用于指定策略生效的时间周期。
- `Permanent`：始终生效；
- `Once`：单次生效；
- `Daily`：每日重复；
- `Weekly`：每周重复；
- `Monthly`：每月重复。
RepeatType.description_en:
Recurrence type, used to specify the time cycle during which a policy is effective.
- `Permanent`: Always active
- `Once`: Effective once
- `Daily`: Repeats daily
- `Weekly`: Repeats weekly
- `Monthly`: Repeats monthly

Source.description_cn:
访问控制策略的源地址，具体取值取决于 `SourceType` 字段的类型：
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `net` 时，源地址为 `CIDR` 格式的 `IP` 地址段，例如 `192.0.XX.XX/24`；
- 当 `SourceType` 为 `group` 时，源地址为源地址簿的 `UUID` 列表，例如 `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`。
Source.description_en:
The source address for an access control policy depends on the type specified in the `SourceType` field:
- If `SourceType` is `net`, the source address is an IP address range in CIDR format, such as `192.0.XX.XX/24`.
- If `SourceType` is `group`, the source address is a list of UUIDs from the source address book, such as `f04ac7ce-****-****-****-************`.

SourceType.description_cn:
源地址的类型，用于指定 `Source` 字段的格式和内容。支持的取值如下所示。
- `net`：网段（CIDR 格式）；
- `group`：地址簿的 UUID。
SourceType.description_en:
Source address type, used to specify the format and content of the `Source` field. Supported values:
- `net`: network segment (CIDR format)
- `group`: address book UUID

StartTime.description_cn:
策略生效的起始时间，使用 Unix 时间戳格式，精确到设定日期的 00:00:00。具体规则如下：
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Permanent`（始终生效）时，该字段无需填写；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Once`（单时间段生效）时，需填写精确到分钟的 Unix 时间戳；
- 当 `RepeatType` 为 `Daily`、`Weekly` 或 `Monthly`（重复生效）时，需填写设定日期的 00:00:00 对应的时间戳。
StartTime.description_en:
The policy start time uses the Unix timestamp format. The required precision depends on the RepeatType value, as explained below:
- If `RepeatType` is `Permanent`, leave this field blank
- If `RepeatType` is `Once`, enter a Unix timestamp accurate to the minute
- If `RepeatType` is `Daily`, `Weekly`, or `Monthly`, enter the Unix timestamp for 00:00:00 of the specified date

EndpointConfigurations.Weight.description_cn:
终端节点的权重。
终端节点权重是终端节点组内不同的终端节点接入访问流量的比例。
全球加速会计算终端节点组中各个终端节点的权重之和，然后根据每个终端节点的权重与总权重之比将流量转发到对应的终端节点上。
终端节点权重的取值范围：1~100。
若终端节点组内某一终端节点健康检查异常，则访问流量会按照比例转发到组内其他健康检查正常的终端节点上。
EndpointConfigurations.Weight.description_en:
Endpoint weight
Endpoint weight determines the proportion of traffic each endpoint in an endpoint group receives.
Global Accelerator calculates the total weight of all endpoints in the group, then forwards traffic to each endpoint based on its weight ratio to the total weight.
Endpoint weight range: 1~100
If an endpoint in the group fails the health check, traffic will be distributed proportionally to other healthy endpoints in the group.

HealthyConfig.HealthCheckInterval.description_cn:
健康检查间隔时间，即发起健康检查请求的时间间隔，单位为秒。
默认间隔为2秒，指每2秒对终端节点进行一次健康检查。
请合理设置检测间隔，以免健康检查请求对终端节点造成过多负担。可设置的检测间隔范围为1～50秒。
HealthyConfig.HealthCheckInterval.description_en: Health check interval is the time between health check requests, measured in seconds. The default interval is 2 seconds, meaning a health check is performed on the endpoint every 2 seconds. Please set the interval appropriately to avoid placing excessive load on the endpoint. You can set the interval from 1 to 50 seconds.

HealthyConfig.HealthCheckPort.description_cn: 健康检查端口，端口输入范围为1~65535。默认为80端口。
HealthyConfig.HealthCheckPort.description_en: Health check port, valid port range: 1~65535. Default is port 80

HealthyConfig.HealthCheckProtocol.description_cn: 健康检查协议，当前仅支持 TCP 协议。
HealthyConfig.HealthCheckProtocol.description_en: Currently, only the TCP protocol is supported for health checks

HealthyConfig.HealthResponseTimeOut.description_cn:
健康检查超时时间，即等待健康检查响应的时间上限。
如果后端服务器在指定时间内没有正确响应，则判定本次健康检查异常。
默认响应超时时间为2秒，可设置的超时时间范围为1～50秒。
HealthyConfig.HealthResponseTimeOut.description_en: Health check timeout is the maximum time allowed to wait for a health check response. If the backend server does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is marked as abnormal. The default response timeout is 2 seconds, and you can set the timeout between 1 and 50 seconds.

HealthyConfig.HealthyThreshold.description_cn:
健康阈值，即连续健康检查请求成功的次数，系统以此来判断终端节点是否健康。
健康阈值默认为3次，指连续3次健康检查请求成功，才能判定终端节点状态健康。
允许设置的健康阈值为2～10次。
HealthyConfig.HealthyThreshold.description_en:
Health threshold refers to the number of consecutive successful health check requests. The system uses this value to determine whether an endpoint is healthy.
The default health threshold is 3, meaning an endpoint is considered healthy only after 3 consecutive successful health check requests.
You can set the health threshold to any value from 2 to 10.

EndpointGroups.EndpointConfigurations.We.description_cn:

全球加速会计算终端节点组中各个终端节点的权重之和，然后根据每个终端节点的权重与总权重之比将流量转发到对应的终端节点上。

HealthyConfig.HealthResponseTimeOut.description_en: Health check timeout is the maximum time allowed to wait for a health check response. If the backend server does not respond correctly within the specified time, the health check is marked as abnormal. The default response timeout is 2 seconds, and you can set the timeout between 1 and 50 seconds.

HealthyConfig.HealthyThreshold.description_cn:
健康阈值，即连续健康检查请求成功的次数，系统以此来判断终端节点是否健康。
健康阈值默认为3次，指连续3次健康检查请求成功，才能判定终端节点状态健康。
允许设置的健康阈值为2～10次。
HealthyConfig.HealthyThreshold.description_en:
Health threshold refers to the number of consecutive successful health check requests. The system uses this value to determine whether an endpoint is healthy.
The default health threshold is 3, meaning an endpoint is considered healthy only after 3 consecutive successful health check requests.
You can set the health threshold to any value from 2 to 10.

KeepClientIPMethod.description_cn:

- Proxy Protocol v2：通过报文添加 Proxy Protocol v2报头（二进制格式）传递客户端源IP。
KeepClientIPMethod.description_en:

- Proxy Protocol v1: Only effective when Protocol is TCP. Passes the client source IP by adding a Proxy Protocol v1 header (ASCII format) to the packet
- Proxy Protocol v2: Passes the client source IP by adding a Proxy Protocol v2 header (binary format) to the packet

Pool.AddrType.description_cn:
地址池的目标地址类型。如果您不设置该参数，云调度 GTM 会自动判断地址池的目标地址类型。

- ipv4：IPv4 地址。
- ipv6：IPv6 地址。
- host：域名。
Pool.AddrType.description_en:
Target address type for the address pool. If you do not set this parameter, Cloud Scheduling GTM automatically determines the target address type for the address pool

- ipv4: IPv4 address
- ipv6: IPv6 address
- cname: Domain name

Pool.Addresses.Capacity.description_cn: 地址的容量。默认为 1000。取值范围是 [1,100000]。

Pool.Addresses.Mode.description_cn:
目标地址是否可用的判断机制。

- auto：（默认）自动模式。云调度 GTM 根据健康检查结果判断地址是否可用。
- always\_on：地址永远可用。
- always\_off：地址永远不可用。
Pool.Addresses.Mode.description_en:
Target address availability detection mechanism

- auto (default): Automatic mode. Cloud scheduling GTM determines address availability based on health check results.
- always_on: Address is always available.
- always_off: Address is always unavailable.

Pool.Addresses.RectifiedGeos.description_cn: 需要订正的目标地址归属区域。您需要在该参数中填入线路代号。例如，default 表示全部区域。参见 [线路代号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155148#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E7%BA%BF%E8%B7%AF) 了解线路代号与具体归属区域（即线路）的对应关系。如果您不设置该参数，那么云调度 GTM 不订正归属区域。
Pool.Addresses.RectifiedGeos.description_en: Region to which the target address belongs that needs to be corrected. Enter the route code for this parameter; for example, default indicates all regions. See [Route Codes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155148#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E7%BA%BF%E8%B7%AF) for details on route codes and their corresponding regions (routes). If you do not set this parameter, Cloud Scheduling GTM will not correct the region.

Pool.Addresses.Weight.description_cn: 地址的权重。默认为 1。取值范围参见 [功能版本规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358)。只有 GTM 实例的策略是基础路由，且开启了负载均衡时，该参数才有效。
Pool.Addresses.Weight.description_en: Address weight. Default is 1. For the range of valid values, see [Feature Version Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358). This parameter is only effective when the GTM instance policy is basic routing and load balancing is enabled.

Pool.Capacity.description_cn: 地址池的容量。默认为 1000。取值范围是 [1,100000]。只有 GTM 实例的策略是智能路由，且路由策略是容量优先时，该参数才有效。
Pool.Capacity.description_en: Address pool capacity. Default is 1000. Valid range: [1, 100000]. This parameter is only effective when the GTM instance policy is smart routing and the routing strategy is capacity first.

Pool.CapacityMode.description_cn:
在容量优先或负载反馈路由模式下，选择配置地址池或目标地址的容量。

- address：（默认）配置目标地址的容量。选择 address 后，您只能设置每个目标地址的 Capacity 参数。地址池 Capacity 参数的值由目标地址 Capacity 的值自动相加得出，您无法修改。在负载反馈路由模式下，您也只能上报目标地址的容量。
- pool：配置地址池的容量。选择 pool 后，您只能设置地址池的 Capacity 参数。每个目标地址的 Capacity 参数的值由地址池的 Capacity 参数的值自动平均分配。您无法修改。在负载反馈路由模式下，您也只能上报地址池的容量。
Pool.CapacityMode.description_en:
In capacity priority or load feedback routing mode, choose to configure the capacity for either the address pool or target addresses.

- address (default): Configure the capacity for each target address. When you select address, you can only set the Capacity parameter for each target address. The Capacity value for the address pool is automatically calculated as the sum of all target address Capacity values and cannot be modified. In load feedback routing mode, you can only report the capacity of target addresses.
- pool: Configure the capacity for the address pool. When you select pool, you can only set the Capacity parameter for the address pool. The Capacity value for each target address is automatically distributed evenly based on the address pool Capacity value and cannot be modified. In load feedback routing mode, you can only report the capacity of the address pool.

Pool.Name.description_cn: 地址池的名称。UTF-8 格式。最大长度为 64 个 UTF-8 字符。
Pool.Name.description_en: Address pool name in UTF-8 format, up to 64 UTF-8 characters

Pool.Remark.description_cn: 地址池的备注。UTF-8 格式。最大长度为 128 个 UTF-8 字符。默认为空字符串。
Pool.Remark.description_en: Address pool remark. UTF-8 format. Maximum length: 128 UTF-8 characters. Default is an empty string.

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 UUID。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can get the UUID using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606).

PolicyType.description_cn:
路由规则对应的策略类型。

- geo：基础路由。
- perf：智能路由。
PolicyType.description_en:
Policy types for routing rules

- geo: Basic routing
- perf: Smart routing

Rule.Disable.description_cn:
是否禁用该路由规则。默认值：false。

- true：禁用该路由规则。
- false：（默认）启用该路由规则。
Rule.Disable.description_en:
Disable this routing rule?

- true: Disable this routing rule
- false (default): Enable this routing rule

Rule.EffectivePoolSetIndex.description_cn: 生效的地址池集合的索引，从 0 开始。默认为 0。索引对应了地址池在 `PoolSets` 参数中的地址池集合数组中的位置。您把 `PoolSetMode` 设置为 `manual` 时，如果当前地址池集合不可用，无论该参数设置的地址池集合是否可用，云调度 GTM 都会切换到该参数设置的地址池集合。
Rule.EffectivePoolSetIndex.description_en: Index of the active address pool set, starting from 0. Default is 0. The index matches the position of the address pool set in the array of address pool sets in the `PoolSets` parameter. When you set `PoolSetMode` to `manual`, if the current address pool set is unavailable, GTM cloud scheduling switches to the address pool set specified by this parameter, regardless of whether the address pool set specified by this parameter is available.

Rule.Line.description_cn: 路由规则适用的线路。您可以通过调用 [ListLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155112) 获取可用的线路名称。您必须填入 API 返回的 `value` 字段的值。
Rule.Line.description_en: Network lines to which routing rules apply. Call the [ListLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155112) to get available line names. Enter the value from the API's `value` field.

Rule.PoolSetMode.description_cn:
地址池集合的生效模式。

- （默认）auto：自动设置生效的地址池集合。优先级最高的可用地址池自动生效。如果所有地址池都不可用，则优先级最高的地址池生效。
- manual：手动设置生效的地址池集合。在该模式下，您需要在 `EffectivePoolSetIndex` 参数中设置生效的地址池集合的索引。
Rule.PoolSetMode.description_en:
Activation modes for address pool sets

- (Default) auto: Automatically activates the address pool set. The available address pool with the highest priority becomes active. If no address pools are available, the address pool with the highest priority is activated.
- manual: Manually activate the address pool set. In this mode, set the index of the active address pool set using the `EffectivePoolSetIndex` parameter.

Rule.PoolSets.description_cn: 一个或多个地址池集合。数组的顺序代表了地址池集合的优先级。
Rule.PoolSets.description_en: One or more address pool sets. The order of the array represents the priority among the sets

Rule.PoolSets.ActiveAddrThr.description_cn: 地址池集合判定为可用的最小可用地址数。例如，您将该参数设为 1。如果存在 1 个或更多可用地址，则该地址池集合可用。否则，该地址池集合不可用。默认值为 1。当健康检查未启用时，每个地址池集合都默认可用。
Rule.PoolSets.ActiveAddrThr.description_en: The minimum number of available addresses required for an address pool set to be considered available. For example, if you set this parameter to 1, the address pool set is available if there is 1 or more available address. Otherwise, the address pool set is unavailable. The default value is 1. When health checks are not enabled, each address pool set is considered available by default.

Rule.PoolSets.Name.description_cn: 地址池集合的名称。UTF-8 格式。最大长度为 32 个 UTF-8 字符。
Rule.PoolSets.Name.description_en: Name of the address pool collection. UTF-8 format. Maximum length: 32 UTF-8 characters.

Rule.PoolSets.Pools.description_cn: 地址池集合包含的一个或多个地址池。
Rule.PoolSets.Pools.description_en: The address pool collection includes one or more address pools

Rule.PoolSets.Pools.PoolId.description_cn: 地址池的 ID。在您通过 [CreatePool API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121956) 创建地址池时，可以通过返回值获取地址池的 ID。您也可以通过 [ListPools API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121953) 获取地址池的 ID。
Rule.PoolSets.Pools.PoolId.description_en: Address pool ID. When you create an address pool using the [CreatePool API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121956), you can get the address pool ID from the response. You can also obtain the address pool ID using the [ListPools API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121953).

Rule.PoolSets.Pools.Weight.description_cn: 地址池的权重。取值范围参见 [功能版本规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358)。默认值为 1。
Rule.PoolSets.Pools.Weight.description_en: Weight of the address pool. For the range of valid values, see [Feature Version Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358). Default value is 1

Rule.Probe.description_cn: 路由规则的健康检查参数。
Rule.Probe.description_en: Health check parameters for routing rules

Rule.Probe.AdvisedNodeCount.description_cn: 该参数无实际意义。您可以忽略该参数。
Rule.Probe.AdvisedNodeCount.description_en: Recommended Number of Health Check Probe Points

Rule.Probe.Disable.description_cn:
是否关闭健康检查。取值：

- true：关闭健康检查。
- false：（默认）开启健康检查。
Rule.Probe.Disable.description_en:
Is Health Check disabled

- true: Disabled
- false: Not disabled

Rule.Probe.FailedCount.description_cn: 单个目标地址是否被判定为故障的健康检查失败次数阈值。例如，如果您将该参数设为 3，单个目标地址连续出现 3 次健康检查失败，则该地址被判定为故障地址。默认值为 3。
Rule.Probe.FailedCount.description_en: The health check failure threshold for a single target address. For example, if you set this parameter to 3, the address is marked as faulty after 3 consecutive health check failures. The default value is 3.

Rule.Probe.Host.description_cn: 健康检查目标地址的完整域名。该参数仅在健康检查协议设置为 HTTP 或 HTTPS 时有效。
Rule.Probe.Host.description_en: Domain name of the health check target address. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS.

Rule.Probe.HttpHeader.description_cn: 健康检查使用的 HTTP 请求头。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `http` 或 `https`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Rule.Probe.HttpHeader.description_en: HTTP request headers used for health checks. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS.

Rule.Probe.HttpMethod.description_cn:
健康检查使用的 HTTP 请求方法。取值：

- get
- post
- head
- put

如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `http` 或 `https`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Rule.Probe.HttpMethod.description_en: HTTP request method. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS.

Rule.Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.description_cn: 自定义健康检查的 HTTP 状态码判定规则，可配置一组或多组。探测点发起检查后，若目标地址返回的状态码不满足此处规则，则该探测点判定为失败。未配置时默认：状态码在 200~399 视为健康，其余视为失败。
Rule.Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.description_en: Customize the range of HTTP status codes. After a probe point initiates a health check, if the target address returns an HTTP status code outside the specified range, the health check for that probe point fails. If you do not set the `HttpUsabilityCodes` parameter for the routing rule, this parameter will not be returned.

Rule.Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.Codes.description_cn: HTTP 状态码列表，取值范围 100~599。当 `Operator` 为 `interval` 时须填 2 个值，分别表示区间的下限与上限（如 `[100,200]` 表示 100~200）；当 `Operator` 为 `include` 或 `exclude` 时须至少填 1 个值。

Rule.Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.Operator.description_cn:
状态码匹配操作符，与 `Codes` 配合判定探测是否成功。取值：
- `interval`：（匹配区间内的状态码）
- `include`：（匹配列表内的状态码）
- `exclude`：（匹配列表以外的状态码）。
Rule.Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.Operator.description_en:
Operators

- Interval: Match values within a range
- Include: Match specified values
- Exclude: Match values other than the specified ones

Rule.Probe.Interval.description_cn:
健康检查的时间间隔（秒）。时间间隔越短，云调度 GTM 探测到不可用地址并触发故障转移的速度越快，但计费也越高。参见 [计费说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/111491)。该参数仅支持以下值：

- 60：（默认）健康检查的时间间隔是 60 秒。
- 15：健康检查的时间间隔是 15 秒。
Rule.Probe.Interval.description_en: Interval between health checks, in seconds

Rule.Probe.IsManualNodes.description_cn: 该参数无实际意义。您可以忽略该参数。
Rule.Probe.IsManualNodes.description_en:
Do you want to manually configure the health check probe?

- true: Manually configure the health check probe
- false: Use the recommended health check probe

Rule.Probe.Nodes.description_cn: 该参数无实际意义。您可以忽略该参数。

Rule.Probe.PingCount.description_cn: 发包数量。如果您将该参数设置为 10，每次 ping 检查会同时发出 10 个数据包。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `ping`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Rule.Probe.PingCount.description_en: Packet count. If you set this parameter to 10, each ping check sends 10 packets at the same time. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to ping.

Rule.Probe.PingLossPercent.description_cn:
判定为异常的丢包率阈值。单位为百分比。如果丢包率大于该参数的值，则判定为结果异常。例如，如果该参数为 10，且健康检查时的丢包率为 11%，则判定为结果异常。
如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `ping`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Rule.Probe.PingLossPercent.description_en: Packet loss rate. Unit: percentage. If the packet loss rate exceeds this value, the result is considered abnormal. For example, if this value is 10 and the packet loss rate during a health check is 11%, the result is considered abnormal. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to ping.

Rule.Probe.Port.description_cn: 健康检查目标地址的端口。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `http` 或 `https`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Rule.Probe.Port.description_en:
Port of the health check target address
This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS

Rule.Probe.Protocol.description_cn:
健康检查使用的协议。取值：

- `ping`：ICMP 协议。
- `tcp`：TCP 协议。
- `http`：HTTP 协议。
- `https`：HTTPS 协议。
Rule.Probe.Protocol.description_en:
Protocols used for health checks

- ping: ICMP protocol
- tcp: TCP protocol
- http: HTTP protocol
- https: HTTPS protocol

Rule.Probe.Timeout.description_cn:
健康检查任务的超时时间。单位为秒。

- `ping`：如果延时大于 `Timeout` 的值，则判定为丢包。
- `http`/`https`：如果延时大于 `Timeout` 的值，则判定为结果异常。
Rule.Probe.Timeout.description_en:
Timeout for health check tasks (in seconds)

- ping: If the delay exceeds the `Timeout` value, it is considered packet loss
- http/https: If the delay exceeds the `Timeout` value, it is considered an abnormal result

Rule.Probe.Url.description_cn: 健康检查目标地址的 path 部分，以 `/` 开头。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `http` 或 `https`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Rule.Probe.Url.description_en: The path of the health check target address must start with /. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS.

Rule.Remark.description_cn: 路由规则的备注。默认为空字符串。UTF-8 格式。最大长度为 128 个 UTF-8 字符。
Rule.Remark.description_en: Remarks for the routing rule. Default is an empty string. UTF-8 format. Maximum length is 128 UTF-8 characters.

Rule.UsePolicyProbeNodes.description_cn:
是否继承实例级别的健康检查节点。默认值：false。
- true：继承
- false：（默认）不继承

Rule.UseRuleProbeConfig.description_cn:
是否使用路由规则级别的拨测配置。默认值：false。
- true：使用
- false：（默认）不使用
Rule.UseRuleProbeConfig.description_en: Enable routing rule-level dial test configuration

Rule.Weight.description_cn: 路由规则的权重。取值范围参见 [功能版本规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358)。默认值为 1。
Rule.Weight.description_en: Weight of the routing rule. For valid value range, see [Feature Version Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358). Default value is 1.

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 `GtmId`。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can obtain the `GtmId` using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606).

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 UUID。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can get the UUID using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606)

PoolId.description_cn: 地址池的 ID。您可以通过 [CreatePool API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 或 [ListPools API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121953) 获取地址池的 ID。
PoolId.description_en: Address pool ID. You can obtain the address pool ID using the [CreatePool API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) or [ListPools API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121953)

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 UUID。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can get the UUID using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606).

PolicyType.description_cn:
路由规则对应的策略类型。

- geo：基础路由。
- perf：智能路由。
