Strategy types for routing rules

- geo: Basic routing
- perf: Smart routing

RuleId.description_cn: 路由规则的 ID。您在调用 [CreateRule API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121988) 时，返回参数中包含路由规则的 ID。
RuleId.description_en: Routing rule ID. When you call the [CreateRule API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121988), the response includes the routing rule ID

Detail.description_cn: 是否返回拨测、地址池、路由规则等信息。
Detail.description_en: Whether to return information such as probe test, address pool, routing rule, etc.

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 `GtmId`。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can obtain the `GtmId` using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606)

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 `GtmId`。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance (`GtmId`). You can obtain the `GtmId` using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606).

Strategy Type
- geo: Basic Routing
- perf: Smart Routing

GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can get the UUID using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606)

健康检查对应的策略类型。

- geo：基础路由。
- perf：智能路由。
PolicyType.description_en:
Strategy types for health checks.

TagFilters.description_cn:
GTM 实例的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，云调度 GTM 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的 GTM 实例。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，云调度 GTM 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Tags for GTM instances. You need to specify:

- N: The index of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N should be consecutive numbers in ascending order.
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, Cloud Scheduling GTM will query GTM instances that contain all specified tag keys.
- Tag values: For example, `Values["v1", "v2"]`. The array length must be between 1 and 3.

You can omit `Values`; it will not be used as a query condition. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, Cloud Scheduling GTM will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, the relationship between them is logical OR.

Ttl.description_en: Cache expiration time for scheduling DNS resolution records in the GTM instance

Statistics.AddrValue.description_cn: 目标地址。可以是 IP 地址或域名。对于域名，负载会平均分配到域名所映射的所有 IP 地址。如果您在添加流量目标时，负载上报维度是地址，那么您需要设置 `AddrValue` 参数。
Statistics.AddrValue.description_en: Target address. Can be an IP address or domain name. For domain names, load is evenly distributed across all IP addresses mapped to the domain. If the load reporting dimension is set to address when adding a traffic target, you need to configure the `AddrValue` parameter.

Statistics.Capacity.description_cn: 容量。默认为目标负载值的 120%。容量不能小于 `TargetLoad` 参数的值。最大值为 100000。
Statistics.Capacity.description_en: Capacity. The default is 120% of the target load value. Capacity cannot be less than the value of the `TargetLoad` parameter. Maximum value is 100000.

Statistics.CurrentLoad.description_cn: 当前的实时负载。您需要自行获取 IDC 机房的实时负载。最大值为 100000。
Statistics.CurrentLoad.description_en: Current real-time load. You need to obtain the real-time load for the IDC. The maximum value is 100000.

Statistics.PoolName.description_cn: 地址池的名称。负载会平均分配到地址池中每个状态为可用的目标地址。如果您在添加流量目标时，负载上报维度是地址池，那么您需要设置 `PoolName` 参数。
Statistics.PoolName.description_en: Address pool name. Load is distributed evenly across all available target addresses in the pool. If you set the load reporting dimension to address pool when adding traffic targets, you need to configure the `PoolName` parameter.

Statistics.TargetLoad.description_cn: 目标负载值。目标负载值不能大于 `Capacity` 参数的值。最大值为 100000。
Statistics.TargetLoad.description_en: Target load value. The target load value cannot exceed the value of the `Capacity` parameter. The maximum value is 100000.

Timestamp.description_cn: 负载的时间。格式是 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
Timestamp.description_en: Load time. Format: Unix timestamp in seconds

GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can get the GtmId using the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606).

Policy.AlarmOnly.description_cn:
如果当前地址池集合不可用，云调度 GTM 是否仅触发告警通知而不自动切换到可用的地址池。该参数仅在 `PolicyType` 设置为 `geo` 时生效。

- true：云调度 GTM 仅触发告警通知。
- false：（默认）云调度 GTM 会自动切换到可用的地址池。
Policy.AlarmOnly.description_en:
If the current address pool set is unavailable, does Cloud Scheduling GTM only send an alert without automatically switching to an available address pool? This parameter is effective only when `PolicyType` is set to `geo`.

- true: Cloud Scheduling GTM only sends an alert
- false (default): Cloud Scheduling GTM automatically switches to an available address pool

Policy.RoutingMode.description_cn:
路由模式。该参数取值为：

- lb：基于负载均衡，把用户流量按比例路由到不同 IDC 机房。
- geo：基于用户的地理位置和运营商，把用户流量路由到相同运营商线路下距离用户最近的 IDC 机房。
- geo-lb（默认）：先基于用户的地理位置和运营商，把用户流量路由到相同运营商下的最近 IDC 机房的接入线路。再基于负载均衡把用户流量按比例路由到多个 IDC 机房。
Policy.RoutingMode.description_en:
Routing mode. This parameter supports the following values:

- lb: Routes user traffic proportionally to different IDC data centers based on load balancing
- geo: Routes user traffic to the nearest IDC data center on the same ISP network, based on the user's location and ISP
- geo-lb (default): First routes user traffic to the access line of the nearest IDC data center on the same ISP network, based on the user's location and ISP. Then, routes user traffic proportionally to multiple IDC data centers using load balancing

Policy.Targets.description_cn: 智能路由策略的流量目标。
Policy.Targets.description_en: Traffic target of intelligent routing strategy

PolicyType.description_cn:
您需要更新的策略类型。

- geo：基础路由。
- perf：智能路由。
PolicyType.description_en:
Strategy types you need to update

- geo: basic routing
- perf: smart routing

GtmId.description_cn: GTM 实例的 UUID。您可以通过 [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) 获取 UUID。
GtmId.description_en: UUID of the GTM instance. You can get the UUID via the [ListGtms API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606)

Pool.AddrType.description_cn:
地址池的目标地址类型。如果您不设置该参数，云调度 GTM 会自动判断地址池的目标地址类型。

- ipv4：IPv4 地址。
- ipv6：IPv6 地址。
- host：域名。
Pool.AddrType.description_en:
Target address type for the address pool. If you do not set this parameter, Cloud Scheduling GTM automatically determines the target address type for the address pool

- ipv4: IPv4 address
- ipv6: IPv6 address
- cname: Domain name

Pool.Addresses.Capacity.description_cn: 地址的容量。默认为 1000。取值范围是 [1,100000]。

Pool.Addresses.Mode.description_cn:
目标地址是否可用的判断机制。

- auto：（默认）自动模式。云调度 GTM 根据健康检查结果判断地址是否可用。
- always\_on：地址永远可用。
- always\_off：地址永远不可用。
Pool.Addresses.Mode.description_en:
Target address availability detection mechanism

- auto (default): Automatic mode. Cloud scheduling GTM determines address availability based on health check results.
- always_on: Address is always available.
- always_off: Address is always unavailable.

Pool.Addresses.RectifiedGeos.description_cn: 需要订正的目标地址归属区域。您需要在该参数中填入线路代号。例如，default 表示全部区域。参见 [线路代号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155148#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E7%BA%BF%E8%B7%AF) 了解线路代号与具体归属区域（即线路）的对应关系。如果您不设置该参数，那么云调度 GTM 不订正归属区域。
Pool.Addresses.RectifiedGeos.description_en: Region to which the target address belongs that needs to be corrected. Enter the route code for this parameter; for example, default indicates all regions. See [Route Codes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155148#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E7%BA%BF%E8%B7%AF) for details on route codes and their corresponding regions (routes). If you do not set this parameter, Cloud Scheduling GTM will not correct the region.

Pool.Addresses.Weight.description_cn: 地址的权重。默认为 1。取值范围参见 [功能版本规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358)。只有 GTM 实例的策略是基础路由，且开启了负载均衡时，该参数才有效。
Pool.Addresses.Weight.description_en: Address weight. Default is 1. For the range of valid values, see [Feature Version Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358). This parameter is only effective when the GTM instance policy is basic routing and load balancing is enabled.

Pool.Capacity.description_cn: 地址池的容量。默认为 1000。取值范围是 [1,100000]。只有 GTM 实例的策略是智能路由，且路由策略是容量优先时，该参数才有效。
Pool.Capacity.description_en: Address pool capacity. Default is 1000. Valid range: [1, 100000]. This parameter is only effective when the GTM instance policy is smart routing and the routing strategy is capacity first.

Pool.CapacityMode.description_cn:
在容量优先或负载反馈路由模式下，选择配置地址池或目标地址的容量。

- address：（默认）配置目标地址的容量。选择 address 后，您只能设置每个目标地址的 Capacity 参数。地址池 Capacity 参数的值由目标地址 Capacity 的值自动相加得出，您无法修改。在负载反馈路由模式下，您也只能上报目标地址的容量。
- pool：配置地址池的容量。选择 pool 后，您只能设置地址池的 Capacity 参数。每个目标地址的 Capacity 参数的值由地址池的 Capacity 参数的值自动平均分配。您无法修改。在负载反馈路由模式下，您也只能上报地址池的容量。
Pool.CapacityMode.description_en:
In capacity priority or load feedback routing mode, choose to configure the capacity for either the address pool or target addresses.

- address (default): Configure the capacity for each target address. When you select address, you can only set the Capacity parameter for each target address. The Capacity value for the address pool is automatically calculated as the sum of all target address Capacity values and cannot be modified. In load feedback routing mode, you can only report the capacity of target addresses.
- pool: Configure the capacity for the address pool. When you select pool, you can only set the Capacity parameter for the address pool. The Capacity value for each target address is automatically distributed evenly based on the address pool Capacity value and cannot be modified. In load feedback routing mode, you can only report the capacity of the address pool.

Pool.Name.description_en: Address pool name in UTF-8 format, up to 64 UTF-8 characters

Pool.Remark.description_cn: 地址池的备注。UTF-8 格式。最大长度为 128 个 UTF-8 字符。默认为空字符串。

PoolId.description_en: Address pool ID. You can get the address pool ID using the [CreatePool API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121606) or [ListPools API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121953).

- post

Probe.HttpMethod.description_en: HTTP request method. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to HTTP or HTTPS.

Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.description_en: Customize the range of HTTP status codes. After a probe point initiates a health check, if the target address returns an HTTP status code outside the specified range, the health check for that probe point fails. If you do not set the `HttpUsabilityCodes` parameter for the routing rule, this parameter will not be returned.

- `exclude`：（匹配列表以外的状态码）。
Probe.HttpUsabilityCodes.Operator.description_en:

- Interval: Match values within a range

- Exclude: Match values other than the specified ones

- 60：（默认）健康检查的时间间隔是 60 秒。
- 15：健康检查的时间间隔是 15 秒。

如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `ping`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。
Probe.PingLossPercent.description_en: Packet loss rate. Unit: percentage. If the packet loss rate exceeds this value, the result is considered abnormal. For example, if this value is 10 and the packet loss rate during a health check is 11%, the result is considered abnormal. This parameter is only valid when the health check protocol is set to ping.

Probe.Port.description_cn: 健康检查目标地址的端口。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为 `http` 或 `https`，则该参数为必填参数。如果您将 `Protocol` 参数设置为其他值，则该参数无效。

- `http`/`https`：如果延时大于 `Timeout` 的值，则判定为结果异常。

Rule.EffectivePoolSetIndex.description_cn: 生效的地址池集合的索引，从 0 开始。默认为 0。索引对应了地址池在 `PoolSets` 参数中的地址池集合数组中的位置。您把 `PoolSetMode` 设置为 `manual` 时，如果当前地址池集合不可用，无论该参数设置的地址池集合是否可用，云调度 GTM 都会切换到该参数设置的地址池集合。
Rule.EffectivePoolSetIndex.description_en: Index of the active address pool set, starting from 0. Default is 0. The index matches the position of the address pool set in the array of address pool sets in the `PoolSets` parameter. When you set `PoolSetMode` to `manual`, if the current address pool set is unavailable, GTM cloud scheduling switches to the address pool set specified by this parameter, regardless of whether the address pool set specified by this parameter is available.

Rule.Line.description_cn: 路由规则适用的线路。您可以通过调用 [ListLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155112) 获取可用的线路名称。您必须填入 API 返回的 `value` 字段的值。
Rule.Line.description_en: Network lines to which routing rules apply. Call the [ListLines API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/155112) to get available line names. Enter the value from the API's `value` field.

Rule.PoolSetMode.description_cn:
地址池集合的生效模式。

- （默认）auto：自动设置生效的地址池集合。优先级最高的可用地址池自动生效。如果所有地址池都不可用，则优先级最高的地址池生效。
- manual：手动设置生效的地址池集合。在该模式下，您需要在 `EffectivePoolSetIndex` 参数中设置生效的地址池集合的索引。
Rule.PoolSetMode.description_en:
Activation modes for address pool sets

- (Default) auto: Automatically activates the address pool set. The available address pool with the highest priority becomes active. If no address pools are available, the address pool with the highest priority is activated.
- manual: Manually activate the address pool set. In this mode, set the index of the active address pool set using the `EffectivePoolSetIndex` parameter.

Rule.PoolSets.description_cn: 一个或多个地址池集合。数组的顺序代表了地址池集合的优先级。
Rule.PoolSets.description_en: One or more address pool sets. The order of the array represents the priority among the sets

Rule.PoolSets.ActiveAddrThr.description_cn: 地址池集合判定为可用的最小可用地址数。例如，您将该参数设为 1。如果存在 1 个或更多可用地址，则该地址池集合可用。否则，该地址池集合不可用。默认值为 1。当健康检查未启用时，每个地址池集合都默认可用。
Rule.PoolSets.ActiveAddrThr.description_en: The minimum number of available addresses required for an address pool set to be considered available. For example, if you set this parameter to 1, the address pool set is available if there is 1 or more available address. Otherwise, the address pool set is unavailable. The default value is 1. When health checks are not enabled, each address pool set is considered available by default.

Rule.UsePolicyProbeNodes.description_cn:
是否继承实例级别的健康检查节点。默认值：false。
- true：继承
- false：（默认）不继承

Rule.UseRuleProbeConfig.description_cn:
是否使用路由规则级别的拨测配置。默认值：false。
- true：使用
- false：（默认）不使用
Rule.UseRuleProbeConfig.description_en: Enable routing rule-level dial test configuration

Rule.Weight.description_cn: 路由规则的权重。取值范围参见 [功能版本规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358)。默认值为 1。
Rule.Weight.description_en: Weight of the routing rule. For valid value range, see [Feature Version Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/171358). Default value is 1.

RuleId.description_cn: 路由规则的 ID。您可以通过 [ListRules API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121987) 获取路由规则的 ID。
RuleId.description_en: Routing rule ID. You can get the routing rule ID through the [ListRules API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/1121987)

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定标签的实例 ID。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
- 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。单次最多同时传入 20 个实例 ID，单个实例最多绑定 50 个标签。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to be tagged

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all HBase instances in the target region, including instance IDs
- You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). You can specify up to 20 instance IDs per request, and each instance can have up to 50 tags

Tags.description_cn: 需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。  - 支持一次传入多组标签键值对像，多组标签键值对像间用英文逗号（,）分隔。单次最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对，单个实例最多绑定 50 个标签。 - 标签键值需满足设置规则，具体规则请参见[标签设置规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1155049#%E6%A0%87%E7%AD%BE%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99)。
Tags.description_en:
An array object containing the tag keys and tag values to be bound
- You can enter multiple sets of tag key-value pairs at once, separated by commas (,)
- You can enter up to 20 sets of tag key-value pairs at a time; each instance can bind up to 50 tags
- Tag keys and values must follow the configuration rules. For details, see [Tag configuration rules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1155049#%E6%A0%87%E7%AD%BE%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99)

Tags.Key.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.Key.description_en: Tag key of the tag bound to instance

Tags.TagKey.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.TagKey.description_en: Tag key of the tag bound to instance

Tags.TagValue.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.TagValue.description_en: Tag key of the tag bound to instance

Tags.Value.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签值。
Tags.Value.description_en: Tag value of the tag bound to instance

AllowListIds.description_cn:
需要绑定实例的白名单 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个白名单 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即仅允许一次将多个实例同时绑定到同一个白名单，或将一个实例同时绑定到多个白名单。
AllowListIds.description_en:
The Allowlist ID to be associated with the instance is required.
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) API to query all allowlist information in the specified region, including allowlist IDs.
* You can provide multiple allowlist IDs at once, separated by commas (,).
* You cannot provide multiple instance IDs and allowlists at the same time. You can only associate multiple instances with the same allowlist at once, or associate a single instance with multiple allowlists at once.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定白名单的实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即仅允许一次将多个实例同时绑定到同一个白名单，或将一个实例同时绑定到多个白名单。
InstanceIds.description_en:
The instance ID to be associated with the allowlist is required.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all HBase instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* You can provide multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,).
* You cannot provide multiple instance IDs and allowlists at the same time. You can only associate multiple instances with the same allowlist at once, or associate a single instance with multiple allowlists at once.

AllowList.description_cn:
输入 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的 IP 地址段。
* 每个白名单中最多可包含 300 个 IP 地址或 IP 地址段。不允许设置重复的地址，多个地址间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* 设置 `127.0.0.1`，表示禁止所有地址访问。
* 设置 CIDR `192.168.1.0/24`，表示允许该网段内的 IP 地址访问。
* 设置 `192.168.1.1`，表示仅允许该 IP 地址访问。
* 禁止设置 `0.0.0.0/0`。
AllowList.description_en:
Enter an IP address or a CIDR-formatted IP address range.
* Each allowlist can contain up to 300 IP addresses or IP address ranges. Duplicate addresses are not allowed. Separate multiple addresses with commas (,)
* Setting `127.0.0.1` denies access from all addresses
* Setting the CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from all IP addresses in that subnet
* Setting `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address
* Setting `0.0.0.0/0` is not allowed

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单的备注信息，长度不可超过 200 个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Whitelist remark cannot exceed 200 characters

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称，名称需同时满足如下要求：

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
* 长度需为 1~32 个字符。
* 不允许与已有白名单名称重名。
AllowListName.description_en:
Allowlist name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be 1–32 characters in length
* Cannot duplicate an existing allowlist name

AllowListType.description_cn: 白名单内的 IP 地址类型。当前仅支持 IPv4 地址，默认取值为 `IPv4`。
AllowListType.description_en: IP address type in the whitelist. Only IPv4 addresses are supported; the default value is `IPv4`.

ProjectName.description_en: default

Area.description_cn: 公共服务区或者售卖区。

AutoRenew.description_cn:
预付费场景下是否自动续费。取值：
- `true`：自动续费。
- `false`：不自动续费（默认）。
仅当 `ChargeType` 为 PrePaid 时有效。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to enable auto-renewal in the prepaid scenario. Values:
- `true`: Auto-renewal enabled
- `false`: Auto-renewal disabled (default)
Only effective when `ChargeType` is set to PrePaid

ChargeType.description_cn:
计费类型，取值：
- `PostPaid`：按量计费（后付费）。
- `PrePaid`：包年包月（预付费）。
ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type, values:
- `PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go (postpaid)
- `PrePaid`: annual/monthly subscription (prepaid)

ColdStorage.description_cn: 设置容量型存储空间大小，取值范围：800GiB~1,000,000GiB，步长为 10GiB。
ColdStorage.description_en: Set the size of capacity-type storage space. Range: 800 GiB to 1,000,000 GiB; increment: 10 GiB

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
实例删除保护功能开关状态。取值范围：
- `enabled`：已开启。
- `disabled`：未开启（默认）。
关于实例删除保护的更多信息，请参见[实例删除保护](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/147035)。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Instance Deletion Protection switch status. Possible values:
- `enabled`: Enabled
- `disabled`: Disabled (default)
For more information about instance deletion protection, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/147035).

EnableAuth.description_cn:
是否开启登录认证。取值：
- `true`：开启登录认证。实例创建成功后，您需要立即为实例创建数据库账号，详情请参见 [CreateDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1246239)。
- `false`：不开启登录认证（默认）。
- 仅当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `false`（单可用区部署）时，支持开启登录认证。
- 开启登录认证后，仅对 Java 客户端生效，Thrift 连接依旧采用直连方式。
EnableAuth.description_en:
Enable login authentication. Values:
- `true`: Enable login authentication. After the instance is successfully created, you must immediately create a database account for the instance. For details, see [CreateDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1246239).
- `false`: Do not enable login authentication (default).
- Login authentication can only be enabled when `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `false` (single availability zone deployment).
- After login authentication is enabled, it only applies to Java clients. Thrift connections will continue to use direct connection.

EnableCloudStorage.description_cn:
是否开通存储型容量，取值：
- `true`：开通容量型存储。
- `false`：不开通容量型存储（默认）。
- 容量型存储的详细介绍，请参见[冷热分离介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1181837)。
- 仅当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `false`（单可用区部署）时，支持冷热分离功能。
EnableCloudStorage.description_en:
Whether to enable capacity storage. Options:
- `true`: Enable capacity storage.
- `false`: Do not enable capacity storage (default).
- For details about capacity storage, see [Hot-Cold Data Separation](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1181837).
- Hot-cold data separation is supported only when `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `false` (single availability zone deployment).

EngineVersion.description_cn: HBase 数据库引擎版本。当前仅支持 HBase 2.0 版本，取值为 `HBase_2.0`。
EngineVersion.description_en: HBase database engine version. Only HBase 2.0 is supported; set the value to `HBase_2.0`.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。名称需同时满足如下要求：
- 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
- 长度需要在 1~128 个字符内。

若该参数留空，实例 ID 会默认作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Must be 1 to 128 characters long

If this field is left blank, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

InstanceType.description_cn: 实例类型。当前仅支持标准型，取值默认为 `Standard`。
InstanceType.description_en: Instance type. Only Standard is currently supported; the default value is `Standard`

MasterSpec.description_cn:
Master 节点的规格码。
- 关于 Master 节点所支持的规格信息，请参见[实例规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/111795)。
- Master 节点数量为固定值，且不支持增减。
MasterSpec.description_en:
Specification code for Master nodes
- For supported Master node specifications, see [Instance specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/111795)
- The number of Master nodes is fixed and cannot be changed

MultiAZ.description_cn:
实例的部署方式，取值：
- `true`：多可用区部署。
- `false`：单可用区部署（默认）。
多可用区部署为邀测功能，如需使用，请[提交工单](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/)联系技术支持申请。关于可用区部署方案的更多详情，请参见 [多可用区同城容灾解决方案](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1337143)。
MultiAZ.description_en:
Instance deployment options:
- `true`: Deploy across multiple availability zones
- `false`: Deploy in a single availability zone (default)
Multi-availability zone deployment is available by invitation only. To request access, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/) to contact technical support and apply. For more details about the availability zone deployment solution, see [Multi-Availability Zone Disaster Recovery Solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/1337143).

ProjectName.description_cn: 选择实例所属的项目。若该参数留空，新建的实例默认加入 `default` 项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Select the project for the instance. If left blank, the new instance will be added to the `default` project.

PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration, unit: month. Valid values: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`, `12`, `24`, `36`.
This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

RSCount.description_cn:
RegionServer 节点数量。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `false`（单可用区部署）时，取值范围为 2~100 之间的整数。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `true`（多可用区部署）时，取值范围为 4~100 之间的偶数整数，节点数量平均分配至主/备可用区。
RSCount.description_en:
RegionServer node count
- If `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `false` (single availability zone), the value must be an integer between 2 and 100
- If `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `true` (multi-availability zone), the value must be an even integer between 4 and 100; nodes are evenly distributed across primary and standby availability zones

RSSpec.description_cn:
RegionServer 节点的规格码。
关于 RegionServer 节点所支持的规格信息，请参见[实例规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/111795)。
RSSpec.description_en:
RegionServer Node Spec Code
For supported specifications of RegionServer nodes, see [Instance Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/111795).

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152921) 接口查询 HBase 实例所有可用的地域资源信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152921) API to query all available region resource information for HBase instances, including region IDs.

StorageCapacity.description_cn:
存储空间大小，步长为 10GiB。

- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `false`（单可用区部署）时，取值范围为 100~20,000。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `true`（多可用区部署）时，取值范围为 200~20,000。
多可用区采用主副本架构，实际可用容量为总容量的一半。
StorageCapacity.description_en:
Storage size, step size: 10 GiB

- When `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `false` (single availability zone), the range is 100–20,000 GiB
- When `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `true` (multi-availability zone), the range is 200–20,000 GiB
Multi-availability zone uses a primary-replica architecture. Usable capacity is half of the total capacity.

StorageType.description_cn:
实例的存储类型，取值：
- `HdfsHdd`：HDD 文件存储（默认）。
- `HdfsSsd`：SSD 文件存储。
StorageType.description_en:
Storage type for the instance. Options:
- `HdfsHdd`: HDD file storage (default)
- `HdfsSsd`: SSD file storage

SubnetId.description_cn:
子网 ID。子网必须属于所选的可用区。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `false`（单可用区部署）时，只需输入一个子网 ID。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `true`（多可用区部署）时，则需要输入两个不同的子网 ID。第一个为主可用区的子网 ID，第二个为备可用区的子网 ID，多个子网 ID 之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
- 子网是私有网络内的 IP 地址块私有网络中的所有云资源都必须部署在子网内，子网为云资源分配私网 IP 地址，您可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建子网。
- 您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定可用区内的所有子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID. The subnet must belong to the selected availability zone.
- If `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `false` (single availability zone deployment), you only need to enter one subnet ID.
- If `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `true` (multi-availability zone deployment), you need to enter two different subnet IDs. The first is for the primary availability zone, and the second is for the secondary availability zone. Separate multiple subnet IDs with an English comma (,).
- A subnet is an IP address block within a private network. All cloud resources in a private network must be deployed in a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can use the [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) API to create a subnet.
- You can use the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query the list of all subnets in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_cn: 需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
Tags.description_en: Array object of tag keys and values to bind

Tags.Key.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.Key.description_en: Tag key bound to the instance

Tags.TagKey.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.TagKey.description_en: Tag key bound to the instance

Tags.TagValue.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.TagValue.description_en: Tag key bound to the instance

Tags.Value.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签值。
Tags.Value.description_en: Tag value bound to the instance

VpcId.description_cn:
私有网络 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询可创建 HBase 实例的私有网络信息，包括私有网络 ID。
VpcId.description_en:
Private Network ID
You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to query private network information available for creating HBase instances, including the private network ID.

ZoneId.description_cn:
可用区 ID。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `false`（单可用区部署）时，则只需输入一个可用区 ID。
- 当 `MultiAZ`（部署方式）取值为 `true`（多可用区部署）时，则需要输入两个不同的可用区 ID，第一个为主可用区 ID，第二个为备可用区 ID，多个可用区 ID 之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用 [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152922) 接口查询 HBase 实例指定地域下所有可用区的资源信息，包括可用区 ID。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability Zone ID
- If `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `false` (single availability zone deployment), enter one Availability Zone ID.
- If `MultiAZ` (deployment mode) is set to `true` (multi-availability zone deployment), enter two different Availability Zone IDs. The first is the primary Availability Zone ID, and the second is the backup Availability Zone ID. Separate multiple Availability Zone IDs with a comma (,).
You can call the [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152922) API to query resource information for all availability zones in the specified region of your HBase instance, including Availability Zone IDs.

AllowListId.description_cn:
白名单 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
AllowListId.description_en:
Allowlist ID
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) API to query all allowlist information in a specified region, including the allowlist ID

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information about all HBase instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。

Allowlist ID

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。

Instance ID

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152921) 接口查询 HBase 实例所有可用的地域资源信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152921) API to query all available region resources for HBase instances, including region IDs

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all HBase instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

CreateTimeEnd.description_cn:
查询结束时间，系统会查询创建时间等于或早于查询结束时间的所有实例。格式为 *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z（UTC 时间）。
若同时传入了查询开始时间（`CreateTimeStart`）和查询结束时间（`CreateTimeEnd`），查询开始时间需早于结束时间。
CreateTimeEnd.description_en:
Query end time. The system will query all instances created at or before the end time. Format: *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z (UTC time)
If both query start time (`CreateTimeStart`) and query end time (`CreateTimeEnd`) are provided, the start time must be earlier than the end time

CreateTimeStart.description_cn:
查询开始时间，系统会查询创建时间等于或晚于查询开始时间的所有实例。格式为 *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z（UTC 时间）。
若同时传入了查询开始时间（`CreateTimeStart`）和查询结束时间（`CreateTimeEnd`），查询开始时间需早于结束时间。
CreateTimeStart.description_en:
Query start time. The system will return all instances whose creation time is equal to or later than the query start time. Format: *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z (UTC time)
If both query start time (`CreateTimeStart`) and query end time (`CreateTimeEnd`) are provided, the start time must be earlier than the end time

InstanceId.description_cn: 指定需要查询的实例 ID。支持模糊查询。
InstanceId.description_en: Specify the instance ID to query. Supports fuzzy search.

InstanceName.description_cn: 指定需要查询的实例名称。支持模糊查询。
InstanceName.description_en: Specify the instance name to query. Fuzzy search is supported

InstanceStatus.description_cn: 指定需要查询的实例状态。
InstanceStatus.description_en: Specify the instance status to query

OrderKey.description_cn: 排序依据，可选。范围：enum OrderKey，如不传，则默认CreateTime
OrderKey.description_en: Sort by (optional). Range: enum OrderKey; defaults to CreateTime if not specified

OrderType.description_cn: 排序方式，可选。范围：enum OrderType，如不传，则默认DESC
OrderType.description_en: Sort order (optional). Valid values: enum OrderType. Defaults to DESC if not specified

PageNumber.description_cn: 实例信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the instance information list, with a minimum value of 1 and not exceeding the maximum value for the Integer data type

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~100 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records Per Page (integer from 1 to 100)

ProjectName.description_cn: 指定实例所属的项目名称，若该参数留空，则表示查询所有项目下符合筛选条件的实例。
ProjectName.description_en: Specify the project name for the instance. If this parameter is left blank, instances in all projects that meet the filter criteria will be queried.

TagFilters.Values.description_en: tag values. Multiple values are in an OR relationship. If values are empty, all instances bound to the target key will be filtered

Tags.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键值对数组。
单次最多支持同时传入 10 组标签键值对进行查询筛选。
Tags.description_en:
Array of tag key-value pairs used for query filtering
A maximum of 10 tag key-value pairs can be passed in for query filtering at a time

Tags.Key.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.Key.description_en: Tag key bound to the instance

Tags.TagKey.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.TagKey.description_en: Tag key bound to the instance

Tags.TagValue.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签键。
Tags.TagValue.description_en: Tag key bound to the instance

Tags.Value.description_cn: 实例所绑定标签的标签值。
Tags.Value.description_en: Tag value bound to the instance

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要查询已绑定标签的实例 ID。

- 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个实例之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 50 个实例 ID。
- 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
You need to query instance IDs with bound tags.

- You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 50 instance IDs can be entered at the same time.
- You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all HBase instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

PageNumber.description_cn: 实例标签信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the instance tag information list. The value must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The starting value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records Per Page (Range: 1–1000)

TagFilters.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键值对数组。

- 当需要使用标签对查询结果进行筛选时，标签键（Key）必填，标签值（Value）可不填，不填标签值表示不对标签值作限制，会搜索所有绑定了指定标签键的实例。
- 单次最多支持同时传入 10 组标签键值对进行查询筛选。
TagFilters.description_en:
Array of tag key-value pairs for query filtering

- When using tags to filter query results, the tag key is required. The tag value is optional. If you leave the tag value blank, all instances with the specified tag key will be searched
- You can specify up to 10 tag key-value pairs per query

TagFilters.Key.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键。

- 如需使用标签对实例进行查询筛选，该参数必填。
- 允许传入重复的标签键。
- 单次最多支持同时传入 10 个标签进行查询筛选。
TagFilters.Key.description_en:
Tag key used for filtering instances.

- This parameter is required if you want to filter instances by tag.
- Duplicate tag keys are allowed.
- You can specify up to 10 tags for filtering at a time.

TagFilters.Value.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键所对应的标签值。

- 若该参数留空，表示不对标签值作限制，会筛选所有绑定了指定标签键的实例。
- 若传入空字符串，表示筛选对应标签键下，标签值为空的实例。
TagFilters.Value.description_en:
The tag value corresponding to the tag key used for filtering instances.

- If this parameter is left empty, all instances bound to the specified tag key will be filtered, without restricting tag value.
- If an empty string is provided, only instances with an empty tag value under the specified tag key will be filtered.

AllowListIds.description_cn:
需要解绑实例的白名单 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个白名单 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即每次仅允许将一个白名单中的多个实例同时解绑，或将一个实例同时从多个白名单中解绑。
AllowListIds.description_en:
You need the allowlist ID to unbind the instance.
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) API to query all allowlist information in the specified region, including allowlist IDs.
* You can pass multiple allowlist IDs at once, separated by commas (,).
* You cannot pass multiple instance IDs and allowlists at the same time. Each request can only unbind multiple instances from a single allowlist, or unbind a single instance from multiple allowlists at once.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑白名单的实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即每次仅允许将一个白名单中的多个实例同时解绑，或将一个实例同时从多个白名单中解绑。
InstanceIds.description_en:
You need the instance ID to unbind from the allowlist.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all HBase instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* You can pass multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,).
* You cannot pass multiple instance IDs and allowlists at the same time. Each request can only unbind multiple instances from a single allowlist, or unbind a single instance from multiple allowlists at once.

AllowList.description_cn:
输入 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的 IP 地址段。
* 每个白名单中最多支持设置 300 个 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的 IP 地址段。不允许设置重复的地址，多个地址间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* 设置 `127.0.0.1`，表示禁止所有地址访问。
* 设置 CIDR `192.168.1.0/24`，表示允许该网段内的 IP 地址访问。
* 设置 `192.168.1.1`，表示仅允许该 IP 地址访问。
* 禁止设置 `0.0.0.0/0`。
AllowList.description_en:
Enter an IP address or a CIDR-formatted IP address range.
* Each Allowlist supports up to 300 IP addresses or CIDR-formatted IP address ranges. Duplicate addresses are not allowed. Separate multiple addresses with commas (,).
* Setting `127.0.0.1` blocks access from all addresses.
* Setting CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from all IP addresses in that subnet.
* Setting `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address.
* Setting `0.0.0.0/0` is not allowed.

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单的备注信息，长度不可超过 200 个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en: The remark for the whitelist cannot exceed 200 characters.

AllowListId.description_cn:
白名单 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
AllowListId.description_en:
Allowlist ID.
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) API to query all Allowlist information in a specified region, including Allowlist IDs.

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称。
* 若需修改原白名单的 IP 地址，直接输入原白名单的名称即可。您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单名称。
* 若需修改白名单名称，直接输入新的白名单名称即可。名称需同时满足如下要求：
   * 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
   * 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
   * 长度需为 1~32 个字符。
AllowListName.description_en:
Allowlist name.
* To modify the IP address of an existing Allowlist, simply enter the original Allowlist name. You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) API to query all Allowlist information in a specified region, including Allowlist names.
* To modify the Allowlist name, simply enter the new Allowlist name. The name must meet the following requirements:
   * Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-).
   * Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
   * Must be 1–32 characters in length.

ApplyInstanceNum.description_cn:
当前白名单所绑定的实例个数。
* 当需要修改 `AllowList` 参数时，该参数必填。
* 该参数用于确认本次修改的影响范围，避免因误操作引发故障，您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单下绑定的实例总数。
ApplyInstanceNum.description_en:
Number of instances currently bound to the Allowlist.
* This parameter is required when you need to modify the `AllowList` parameter.
* This parameter helps confirm the scope of the modification to avoid failures caused by accidental operations. You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152934) API to query all Allowlist information in a specified region, including the total number of instances bound to each Allowlist.

ModifyMode.description_cn:
修改方式，取值范围如下：
- `Cover`（默认值）：使用 `AllowList` 参数中的值覆盖原白名单。
- `Append`：在原白名单中增加 `AllowList` 参数中输入的 IP 地址。
- `Delete`：在原白名单中删除 `AllowList` 参数中输入的 IP 地址。至少需要保留一个 IP 地址。
ModifyMode.description_en:
Modification mode. Available options:
- `Cover` (default): Overwrite the existing whitelist with the values from the `AllowList` parameter
- `Append`: Add the IP addresses entered in the `AllowList` parameter to the existing whitelist
- `Delete`: Remove the IP addresses entered in the `AllowList` parameter from the existing whitelist. At least one IP address must remain.

ProjectName.description_en: Project

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters

实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all HBase instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

InstanceName.description_cn:
修改后的实例新名称。名称需同时满足以下要求：

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
* 长度需要在 1~128 个字符内。
InstanceName.description_en:
New instance name after modification. The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a digit or a hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be between 1 and 128 characters in length

AutoRenew.description_cn:
是否开启自动续费，取值范围如下：

* `false`：不开启自动续费（默认）。
* `true`：开启自动续费。

* 仅当 `ChargeType` 取值为 `PrePaid` 时，该参数生效。
* 选择 `true` 开启自动续费后，系统默认续费时长为 1 个月。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

* `false`: Auto-renewal is disabled (default)
* `true`: Auto-renewal is enabled

* This parameter takes effect only when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.
* When you select `true` to enable auto-renewal, the system sets the renewal period to 1 month by default.

ChargeType.description_cn:
计费类型，取值：

- `PostPaid`：按量计费（后付费）。
- `PrePaid`：包年包月（预付费）。
ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type, options:

- `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go (postpaid)
- `PrePaid`: Yearly or monthly subscription (prepaid)

PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration. Unit: month. Valid values: `1` (default), `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`, `12`, `24`, `36`.
This parameter takes effect only when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
开启或关闭实例删除保护功能。取值范围：

* `enabled`：开启。
* `disabled`：关闭。

关于实例删除保护的更多信息，请参见[实例删除保护](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/147035)。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Enable or disable instance deletion protection. Value options:

* `enabled`: Enable
* `disabled`: Disable

For more information about instance deletion protection, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/147035).

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有 HBase 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query the basic information of all HBase instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

All.description_cn:
是否解绑指定实例上的所有标签。取值范围：

- `true`：解绑指定实例上的所有标签。
- `false`（默认值）：不解绑指定实例上的所有标签。

仅当 `TagKeys` 取值为空时，`All` 参数才生效。
All.description_en:
Whether to unbind all tags from the specified instance. Value options:

- `true`: Unbind all tags from the specified instance
- `false` (default): Do not unbind all tags from the specified instance

The `All` parameter takes effect only when `TagKeys` is empty.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑标签的实例 ID。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) 接口查询目标地域下所有实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
- 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个实例 ID 之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 个实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to unbind tags from

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6695/152923) API to query basic information for all instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
- Supports passing multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 instance IDs can be specified at the same time.

TagKeys.description_cn:
需要解绑的标签键。

- 支持一次传入多个标签键，多个标签键间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 个标签键。
- 当 `InstanceIds` 为多个实例 ID 时，所有实例存在传入标签键的标签都会被解绑，请谨慎操作。
TagKeys.description_en:
Tag keys to be unbound

- Supports passing multiple tag keys at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 tag keys can be specified at the same time.
- When `InstanceIds` contains multiple instance IDs, all tags matching the specified tag keys will be unbound from all instances. Please operate with caution.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ProviderOptions.AutoLinking.description_en: Automatic account linking strategy. Default is undefined. Users can define AUTO_LINKING_OPTION_UNSPECIFIED | AUTO_LINKING_OPTION_EMAIL | AUTO_LINKING_OPTION_PHONE | AUTO_LINKING_OPTION_PHONE_OR_EMAIL | AUTO_LINKING_OPTION_USERNAME

ProviderOptions.IsAutoCreation.description_cn: 是否允许用户第一次登录时创建新的用户账号在用户池。如果false 的话然后用户外部身份不在用户池的话，不允许用户登录。默认值是true。
ProviderOptions.IsAutoCreation.description_en: Allow users to create a new user account in the user pool when logging in for the first time. If set to false and the user's external identity is not in the user pool, login is not allowed. Default value is true.

ProviderOptions.IsAutoUpdate.description_cn: 是否用外部身份提供商的信息自动更新账号信息。默认是true。如果false 的话，用户使用外部身份提供商登录方式时，外部身份提供商返回的用户信息不回更新或覆盖存在用户池内的用户信息和属性。
ProviderOptions.IsAutoUpdate.description_en: Automatically update account information using data from external identity providers. Default is true. If set to false, when users log in via external identity providers, the information returned by the provider will not update or overwrite the existing user information and attributes in the user pool.

ProviderOptions.IsCreationAllowed.description_cn: 是否允许用户第一次登录或注册时创建新的用户账号在用户池。如果false 的话然后用户外部身份不在用户池的话，不允许用户登录或注册。默认值是true。
ProviderOptions.IsCreationAllowed.description_en: Allow users to create a new user account in the user pool when logging in or registering for the first time. If set to false and the user's external identity is not in the user pool, login or registration is not allowed. Default value is true.

ProviderOptions.IsLinkingAllowed.description_cn: 是否允许账号关联。默认是不开通（false）。如果开的话，会按照AutoLinking 字段的配置来进行账号关联。
ProviderOptions.IsLinkingAllowed.description_en: Allow account linking. Default is disabled (false). If enabled, account linking follows the configuration of the AutoLinking field.

ProviderOptions.UserLinkingPromptEnabled.description_cn: Whether user linking prompt is enabled | 是否开启用户联动提示
ProviderOptions.UserLinkingPromptEnabled.description_en: Whether to enable user linking prompt

ScopesList.description_cn: 请求的 OAuth 范围和作用域列表。Identity 用户池会用这个列表请求授权来获取用户信息。这个列表会影响Identity 用户池能获取到的用户信息。

SoleProviderConnection.description_cn: Whether this is the sole enabled built-in provider connection for the provider within the user pool | 是否为该用户池内该内置提供商的唯一连接

TokenEndpoint.description_cn: OAuth 令牌端点 URL。Identity 用户池会访问这个端点来获取OAuth 提供商在授权流程中生成的 access token。

UserEndpoint.description_cn: 获取用户信息的端点 URL。Identity 用户池获取提供商生成的 access token 过后，会用access token 来访问这个端点和获取用户信息。

IdpMetadata.example_cn:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
  <md:IDPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
    <!-- Signing Certificate -->
    <md:KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <ds:KeyInfo xmlns:ds="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#">
        <ds:X509Data>
          <ds:X509Certificate>
MIID7TCCAtWgAwIBAgIJANn3qP9lF7M3MA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBCwUAMIGMMQswCQYDVQQGEwJV...
          </ds:X509Certificate>
        </ds:X509Data>
      </ds:KeyInfo>
    </md:KeyDescriptor>
    <!-- Supported NameID Format -->
    <md:NameIDFormat>
      urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
    </md:NameIDFormat>
    <!-- Single Sign-On Service Endpoint -->
    <md:SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" 
                            Location="https://example.com"/>
    <!-- Single Logout Service Endpoint -->
    <md:SingleLogoutService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" 
                            Location="https://example.com"/>
  </md:IDPSSODescriptor>
</md:EntityDescriptor>

    • "email"
    • "phone_number"

◦ 支持值：
    • "email"
    • "phone_number"

如果是WEB_APPLICATION 或 SINGLE_PAGE_APPLICATION 类型的话需要输入http(s) 的链接。
如果是MOBILE_APPLICATION需要输入非HTTP 的链接。MACHINE_TO_MACHINE类型的客户端不需要输入这个参数。

ClientType.description_cn:
应用类型。该参数决定是否生成客户端密钥，以及默认启用哪些 OAuth 授权类型。
支持值：
    • WEB_APPLICATION：服务端 Web 应用。返回客户端密钥。
    • SINGLE_PAGE_APPLICATION：浏览器端公共应用。不返回有效客户端密钥。
    • MOBILE_APPLICATION：原生或移动端公共应用。不返回有效客户端密钥。
    • MACHINE_TO_MACHINE：服务间调用应用。返回客户端密钥，并支持客户端凭证授权。

PartitionNumber.description_en: Default number of partitions for automatically created Topic

AllowListIds.description_en: Whitelist ID Pending Binding

AccessPolicy.description_cn:
规则的访问策略。
- 资源类型为Topic时，支持指定“Read”或者“Write”。
- 资源类型为Group时，仅支持“Read”。
- 多个规则之间用“,”分隔。例如：“Read,Write”。

资源类型（ResourceType）为 Group 时，仅支持设置为 Read 权限，不支持 Write 权限。
AccessPolicy.description_en:
Access policy for rules
- When the resource type is Topic, you can specify 'Read' or 'Write'
- When the resource type is Group, only 'Read' is supported
- Separate multiple rules with a comma, for example: 'Read,Write'

When the resource type (ResourceType) is Group, only Read permission is supported; Write permission is not allowed

Ip.description_cn: 规则允许访问的 IP 地址或网段。支持指定为“*”，表示允许任意 IP 访问。多个 IP 之间使用“,”分隔。
Ip.description_en: Specify allowed IP addresses or ranges. Use '*' to allow access from any IP. Separate multiple IPs with commas

PatternType.description_cn:
规则的匹配方式。
- Literal：完全匹配方式。ACL 策略仅匹配名称完全一致的资源。此时需要设置资源名称。
- Prefixed：前缀匹配方式。ACL 策略匹配指定前缀的资源。此时需要设置资源名称前缀。
PatternType.description_en:
Rule Matching Types
- Literal: Exact match. The ACL policy matches resources whose names are exactly the same. In this case, you need to set the resource name.
- Prefixed: Prefix match. The ACL policy matches resources with the specified prefix. In this case, you need to set the resource name prefix.

Resource.description_cn:
绑定的 Topic 或 Group 的资源名称或名称前缀。
- 资源名称匹配方式（PatternType）为完全匹配（Literal）时，此字段用于指定资源名称，表示指定用户对某个资源具备权限。支持设置为“*”，表示 Topic 或 Group类型的全部资源。
- 资源名称匹配方式（PatternType）为前缀匹配（Prefixed）时，此字段用于指定用户对哪些名称前缀的资源具备权限。
Resource.description_en:
Resource name or name prefix for the bound Topic or Group
- When the resource name match type (PatternType) is set to exact match (Literal), use this field to specify the resource name. This grants the specified user permission for that resource. You can set this field to "*" to grant permission for all resources of the Topic or Group type
- When the resource name match type (PatternType) is set to prefix match (Prefixed), use this field to specify which resource name prefixes the user has permission for

ResourceType.description_cn: 规则绑定的资源类型。支持配置“Topic”或者“Group”。
ResourceType.description_en: Resource type bound to the rule. You can configure "Topic" or "Group".

UserName.description_cn: 规则允许访问的 SASL 用户。支持指定为“*”，表示允许任意用户访问。
UserName.description_en: Rules allow access for specified SASL users. You can use '*' to allow access for any user

AllowList.description_cn:
白名单规则列表。
- 支持指定为 IP 地址或者 IP 网段。
- 多个 IP 地址或网段之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
- 每个白名单最多可配置 300 个 IP 地址或网段。
AllowList.description_en:
Whitelist rule list
- Specify IP addresses or IP ranges
- Separate multiple IP addresses or ranges with commas
- Each whitelist can include up to 300 IP addresses or ranges

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单描述。长度不超过200个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en:
Whitelist description
No more than 200 characters

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单规则名称。
- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist Rule Name
- 1–128 characters
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Must be unique within the current region

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name

Description.description_cn: 消费组描述信息。长度不超过 128 个字符。
Description.description_en: Consumer group description. Maximum length: 128 characters

GroupId.description_cn:
待创建的消费组 ID。
- 长度为 3～128 个字符。
- 只能包含大小写字母、数字、连字符（-）、特殊字符(@)和下划线(_)。
- 至少包含一个字母或数字。
GroupId.description_en:
Consumer group ID to be created
- Must be 3–128 characters long
- Can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-), special character (@), and underscores (_)
- Must contain at least one letter or number

Tags.description_cn:
云资源标签。可以将 Group 通过标签进行归类，便于 Group 的识别和管理。
标签设置规则请参见[标签设置规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1222945#b055b6e8)。
Tags.description_en: Cloud Resource Tags. Use tags to categorize Groups for easier identification and management. For tag setting rules, see [Tag Setting Rules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1222945#b055b6e8).

ChargeInfo.description_cn: Kafka 实例的计费类型等计费信息。
ChargeInfo.description_en: Billing type and other billing information for the Kafka instance

ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_cn:
包年包月实例到期后是否自动续费。
- true：自动续费。
- false：（默认）不自动续费。到期后需要手动续费，否则实例将被关停。
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即 ChargeType 指定为 PrePaid 时必选。
ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_en:
Auto-renewal after subscription instance expiration?
- true: Auto-renew
- false (default): Do not auto-renew. You must renew manually after expiration, or the instance will be stopped
Required only for subscription (PrePaid) instances; when ChargeType is set to PrePaid, this option must be specified

ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_cn:
实例的计费类型。支持的类型包括：
- PostPaid ：按量付费
- PrePaid：包年包月
目前仅支持按量付费实例转为包年包月实例.
ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type for instances. Supported types:
- PostPaid: Pay-As-You-Go
- PrePaid: Annual/Monthly Subscription
Currently, only pay-as-you-go instances can be converted to annual/monthly subscription instances

ChargeInfo.Period.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的购买时长。默认为 1。
- PeriodUnit 指定为 Month 时，取值范围为 1~9。
- PeriodUnit 指定为 Year 时，取值范围为 1~3。
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即 ChargeType 指定为 PrePaid 时必选。
ChargeInfo.Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for subscription-based instances. Default is 1
- If PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1–9
- If PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1–3
Required only for subscription-based instances, that is, when ChargeType is set to PrePaid

ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的生命周期单位，即指定以月或以年为单位购买。支持设置为：
- Month：包月
- Year：包年
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即 ChargeType 指定为 PrePaid 时必选。
ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_en:
Lifecycle unit for annual/monthly subscription type instances, specifying purchase by month or year. Supported options:
- Month: monthly subscription
- Year: annual subscription
This must be specified only for annual/monthly subscription type instances, i.e., when ChargeType is set to PrePaid.

保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。 该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。 
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938)。
ClientToken.description_en: Idempotency identifier for client requests. This identifier is a case-sensitive ASCII string of 1 to 64 characters, generated by the client. Make sure the identifier is unique for each request. For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938).

ComputeSpec.description_cn: 实例的计算规格。您可以通过文档[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)查看计算规格列表。
ComputeSpec.description_en: Instance computing specifications. You can view the list of computing specifications in the [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239) documentation.

DiskEncrypted.description_en: Enable Disk Encryption? (Only for Whitelisted Financial Users)

EipId.description_cn:
EIP 的 ID。
- 指定 EipId 表示开启实例的公网访问。
-  EIP 提供独立的公网 IP 资源，包括公网 IP 地址与公网出口带宽服务。指定此参数开启公网访问后，公网地址将绑定您的弹性公网 IP（EIP），费用由 EIP 收取。
EipId.description_en:
EIP ID
- Specify EipId to enable public access for the instance
- EIP provides dedicated public IP resources, including public IP addresses and outbound bandwidth services. After you specify this parameter to enable public access, the public address will be bound to your Elastic Public IP (EIP), and charges will be billed to the EIP.

InstanceDescription.description_cn: Kafka 实例的简单描述。长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
InstanceDescription.description_en: Brief description of the Kafka instance; length must be between 1 and 128 characters

InstanceName.description_cn:
Kafka 实例的名称。 需满足以下要求：
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字和连字符（-）开头。
- 长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
如果创建实例时未指定名称，则默认将实例ID作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Kafka instance name. Must meet the following requirements:
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
If you do not specify a name when creating the instance, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

IpWhiteList.description_cn:
实例绑定的白名单 ID 列表。绑定白名单后，仅配置在白名单中的 IP 地址与地址段才能访问此实例。
若未设置此参数，新 Kafka 实例将绑定白名单 default，对应 IP 地址为 0.0.0.0，表示允许所有地址访问该 Kafka 实例。
IpWhiteList.description_en: Whitelist ID list bound to the instance. After binding, only IP addresses and address ranges in the whitelist can access this instance. If you do not set this parameter, the new Kafka instance binds to the default whitelist with IP address 0.0.0.0, allowing all addresses to access the Kafka instance.

MetaGroup.description_cn: 元数据组，不同组的实例不能在一个zk上。
MetaGroup.description_en: Metadata group: Instances from different groups cannot be on the same zk

NetworkTypes.description_cn: 网络类型。多选，以逗号分隔。仅innerapi可见。
NetworkTypes.description_en: Network Type. Select multiple options, separated by commas. Visible to innerapi only.

Parameters.description_cn:
Kafka 实例的初始参数配置。
当前支持的参数列表及参数默认值，请参考下表。您也可以通过文档[修改参数配置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156)查看各参数的详细信息。
通过 Postman 等方式调用 API 时，应注意转义，例如 `{\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MessageTimestampType\":\"CreateTime\",\"OffsetRetentionMinutes\":\"4320\"}`。

Parameters 参数说明

- `"MessageMaxByte":"10"`：最大消息大小。单位为MB，取值范围为1～12。默认为10。
- `"LogRetentionHours":"72"`：消息保留时长。单位为小时，取值范围为0～2160，即消息最久保留90天。默认为72。
- `"OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"`：消费位点保留时长。单位为分钟，取值范围为1～10080，即消费位点最久保留7天。默认为4320。
- `"MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime"`：消息时间类型，支持设置为`LogAppendTime`和`CreateTime`。LogAppendTime 表示消息写入到服务端的时间；CreateTime 表示Producer 创建消息的时间。
Parameters.description_en:
Initial parameter configuration for Kafka instances

Refer to the table below for the list of supported parameters and their default values. For detailed information on each parameter, see the documentation at [Modify Parameter Configuration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156).

When calling the API using Postman or similar tools, make sure to escape parameters properly. For example: {"LogRetentionHours":"72","MessageMaxByte":"10","MessageTimestampType":"CreateTime","OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"}

Parameter descriptions

- "MessageMaxByte":"10": Maximum message size in MB. Valid range: 1–12. Default: 10
- "LogRetentionHours":"72": Message retention period in hours. Valid range: 0–2160 (up to 90 days). Default: 72
- "OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320": Offset retention period in minutes. Valid range: 1–10080 (up to 7 days). Default: 4320
- "MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime": Message timestamp type. Can be set to LogAppendTime or CreateTime. LogAppendTime indicates the time the message is written to the server; CreateTime indicates the time the producer creates the message

PartitionNumber.description_cn:
分区数量。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，您可以通过文档[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)查看指定计算规格支持的分区数量范围。
不同规格提供数量不同的免费分区额度，超过免费额度的部分将另外收取分区费用。每个规格可创建的分区数量范围请参考产品规格，分区的计费方式请参考[计费项](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781)。
PartitionNumber.description_en:
Partition quantity. The available range depends on the selected compute specification. For details on the supported partition range for each specification, see the documentation at [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239).

Different specifications offer varying free partition quotas. Additional partition fees apply if you exceed the free quota. For the partition quantity range of each specification, refer to Product Specifications. For partition billing details, see [Billing Items](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781).

ProjectName.description_cn: 当前创建的 Kafka 实例所属的 IAM 项目。如果未指定 IAM 项目，消息队列 Kafka版会将新实例添加到名为 `default` 的 IAM 项目中。
ProjectName.description_en: The IAM project for the Kafka instance you are creating. If you do not specify an IAM project, Message Queue for Kafka adds the new instance to the IAM project named `default`.

Region.description_cn: 创建实例的时候检查region是否为请求中携带的region, 不填该参数表示不检查。
Region.description_en: Check if the region matches the region in the request when creating an instance; leave this parameter empty to skip the check

SkipCheckVPC.description_cn: 是否跳过vpc检查，内部服务使用。
SkipCheckVPC.description_en: Skip VPC Check? (For internal service use)

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例的存储空间。单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。
取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，您可以通过文档[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)查看指定计算规格支持的存储空间范围和默认存储空间大小。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance storage space. Unit: GiB; must be set as a multiple of 100.
The available range depends on the selected compute specification. See the documentation [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239) for supported storage ranges and default storage size for each compute specification.

StorageType.description_cn:
Kafka 实例数据存储的云盘类型。可设置为 ESSD_FlexPL 或 ESSD_PL0，默认为 ESSD_FlexPL。关于不同存储类型的详细性能说明，请参考[云盘规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101839)。
- 对于峰值流量超过 100MB/s 的规格，应使用 ESSD_FlexPL。
- 创建实例后不支持修改存储类型，请谨慎选择。
StorageType.description_en:
Cloud disk type for Kafka instance data storage. You can choose ESSD_FlexPL or ESSD_PL0; ESSD_FlexPL is the default. For detailed performance information about different storage types, see [Cloud Disk Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101839).
- Use ESSD_FlexPL for specifications with peak traffic over 100 MB/s.
- You cannot change the storage type after the instance is created, so choose carefully.

SubnetId.description_cn: 实例所在的 VPC 子网 ID。

AccessPolicy.description_cn:

- `Read`：即从 Topic 消费消息或加入消费组、离开消费组、重置消费位点等。

- `Read`: Consume messages from a topic, join or leave a consumer group, reset consumer offsets, and more

- `Read,Write`: Includes both `Read` and `Write` permissions

When the resource type (ResourceType) is Group, only Read permission is supported; Write permission is not available.

Parameters.description_cn:
Kafka 实例新的参数配置。
当前支持的参数列表及参数默认值，请参考下表 Parameters 参数说明。您也可以通过文档[修改参数配置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156)查看各参数的详细信息。
通过 Postman 等方式调用API时，应注意转义，例如`{\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MessageTimestampType\":\"CreateTime\",\"OffsetRetentionMinutes\":\"4320\"}`。

Parameters 参数说明

- `"MessageMaxByte":"10"`：最大消息大小。单位为MB，取值范围为1～12。默认为10。
- `"LogRetentionHours":"72"`：消息保留时长。单位为小时，取值范围为0～2160，即消息最久保留90天。默认为72。
- `"OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"`：消费位点保留时长。单位为分钟，取值范围为1～10080，即消费位点最久保留7天。默认为4320。
- `"MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime"`：消息时间类型，支持设置为`LogAppendTime`和`CreateTime`。LogAppendTime 表示消息写入到服务端的时间；CreateTime 表示Producer 创建消息的时间。
- `"AutoDeleteGroup":"false"`：是否自动删除 Group。默认为 false。`true`表示如果消费者组中的所有消费者处于 Empty 状态，超出消费位点保留时长后，后端服务会自动删除该消费者组；`false`表示消费进度的自动删除不影响消费组的状态，Empty 状态的 Group 不会被自动删除。
Parameters.description_en:
New Kafka instance parameter configuration

For the list of supported parameters and their default values, see the table below: Parameters Description. You can also view detailed information for each parameter in the documentation [Modify Parameter Configuration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156).

When calling the API using Postman or similar tools, make sure to escape parameters, for example: `{"LogRetentionHours":"72","MessageMaxByte":"10","MessageTimestampType":"CreateTime","OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"}`.

Parameters Description

- "MessageMaxByte":"10": Maximum message size in MB. Valid values: 1–12. Default is 10
- "LogRetentionHours":"72": Message retention period in hours. Valid values: 0–2160 (up to 90 days). Default is 72
- "OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320": Offset retention period in minutes. Valid values: 1–10080 (up to 7 days). Default is 4320
- "MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime": Message timestamp type. Supports 'LogAppendTime' and 'CreateTime'. LogAppendTime is the time the message is written to the server; CreateTime is the time the Producer creates the message
- "AutoDeleteGroup":"false": Whether to automatically delete the group. Default is false. If set to true, when all consumers in the group are in Empty status and the offset retention period is exceeded, the backend service will automatically delete the consumer group. If set to false, automatic deletion of consumption progress does not affect the group status; groups in Empty status will not be automatically deleted

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。 该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。 
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938)。
ClientToken.description_en: Identifier to ensure idempotency for client requests. This identifier is an ASCII string of 1–64 characters, case-sensitive, generated by the client. Make sure the identifier is unique for each request. For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938).

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例变更后的计算规格。如需升级计算规格，此参数必选。消息队列 Kafka版实例提供的计算规格清单，请参考[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
ComputeSpec.description_en:
Compute specification after the instance is changed. To upgrade the compute specification, this parameter is required. For a list of available compute specifications for Message Queue for Kafka instances, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239).
Only instance specification upgrades are supported; downgrades are not supported.

NeedRebalance.description_cn:
是否开启再均衡（Rebalance）。
- true ：（推荐）消息队列 Kafka版会对分区进行再均衡分配。
- false：（默认）若未启用再均衡，您需要为原有的Topic手动增加分区，以使用升配后的新资源。
变更实例的计算规格时才需要选择是否再均衡，仅升级存储规格时无需再均衡。即此参数仅在指定 ComputeSpec 参数时生效。
NeedRebalance.description_en:
Enable Rebalance
- true (recommended): Kafka message queue will redistribute partitions
- false (default): If rebalance is not enabled, you need to manually add partitions to existing topics to use the upgraded resources
Only select whether to enable rebalance when changing the compute specification of an instance. You do not need to enable rebalance when upgrading storage specification. This parameter only takes effect when the ComputeSpec parameter is specified.

PartitionNumber.description_cn:
分区数量。如需提高分区数量，此参数必选。
取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)。
- 仅支持增加分区数量。
- 升级实例规格时增加的分区将额外收取分区费用，分区的计费方式请参考[计费项](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781)。
PartitionNumber.description_en:
Partition quantity. This parameter is required if you need to increase the number of partitions.
The value range depends on the current compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239).
- Only increasing the partition quantity is supported.
- Additional partitions added when upgrading the instance specification will incur extra partition fees. For partition billing methods, see [Billing Items](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781).

RebalanceTime.description_cn:
自动再均衡的执行时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，例如 2023-01-02 15:04:05。应晚于当前时间 5 分钟以上。
- 此参数仅在 NeedRebalance 为 true 时生效。若未设置此参数，更配完成后将立即执行再均衡任务。
- 推荐选择夜晚等业务低峰时进行再均衡，以减少数据迁移对业务的影响。
- 若不指定此参数，表示升级结束后立即执行再均衡。
RebalanceTime.description_en:
Execution time for automatic rebalancing. Use the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, for example, 2023-01-02 15:04:05. The time must be at least 5 minutes later than the current time.
- This parameter takes effect only when NeedRebalance is set to true. If you do not set this parameter, the rebalancing task runs immediately after configuration is complete.
- We recommend scheduling rebalancing during off-peak hours, such as at night, to minimize the impact of data migration on your business.
- If you do not specify this parameter, rebalancing runs immediately after the upgrade.

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例变更后的存储空间。如需扩容存储空间，此参数必选。
单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。

Unit: GiB; must be a multiple of 100. The valid range depends on the selected compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)
Only instance upgrades are supported; downgrades are not allowed

Topic name
You cannot change TopicName after creating the topic.

CleanupPolicy.description_cn:
Topic 的消息清理策略，支持以下三种取值方式：

- ["delete"]：默认的消息清理策略。在磁盘容量充足的情况下，保留在最长保留时间范围内的消息；在磁盘容量不足时，将提前删除旧消息，以保证服务可用性。
说明

Kafka 实例默认的磁盘清理水位为 90%，具体以实际为准，详情请参见设置磁盘清理水位。


- ["compact"]：COMPACT 消息清理策略针对每个消息的 Key 进行整合，对于有相同 Key 的消息，只保留最新的 value 值，旧的记录则会被清除。
- ["delete","compact"]：同时配置 DELETE 和 COMPACT 两种消息清理策略。只要消息满足任一条清理策略时，都将被清除。


如果消息没有 Key，不支持启用 COMPACT 消息清理策略。
CleanupPolicy.description_en:
Topic message cleanup policies support the following three options:

- ["delete"]: The default message cleanup policy. When disk space is sufficient, messages are retained within the maximum retention period. If disk space is low, older messages are deleted early to ensure service availability.

Note

The default disk cleanup threshold for Kafka instances is 90%. Actual values may vary. For details, see Setting Disk Cleanup Threshold.


- ["compact"]: The COMPACT cleanup policy consolidates messages by key. For messages with the same key, only the latest value is kept; older records are removed.
- ["delete","compact"]: Enables both DELETE and COMPACT cleanup policies. Messages are deleted if they meet the criteria of either policy.

The COMPACT cleanup policy cannot be enabled for messages without a key.

Parameters.description_cn:
Kafka 在 Topic 级别的参数配置。
当前支持的参数列表及参数默认值，请参考下表 Topic Parameters 参数说明。您也可以通过文档[修改参数配置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156)查看各参数的详细信息。
通过 Postman 等方式调用 API 时，应注意转义，例如`{\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MinInsyncReplicaNumber\":\"2\"}`。

Parameters 参数说明

- `"MinInsyncReplicaNumber":"2"`：最小同步副本个数。当同步副本个数小于配置值时，消息将无法写入对应 Topic。配置值越大，数据可靠性增加，但是可用性将会降低。默认值为副本数减 1。考虑到 Topic 的可用性，建议设置为副本数减 1。
- `"MessageMaxByte":"10"`：最大消息大小。单位为 MB，取值范围为 1～12。默认沿用实例的最大消息大小设置。
- `"LogRetentionHours":"72"`：消息保留时长。单位为小时，取值范围为 0～2160，即消息最久保留 90 天。默认沿用实例的消息保留时长设置。
Parameters.description_en:
Kafka topic-level parameter configuration

For the list of supported parameters and their default values, see the table below: Topic Parameters. For detailed information on each parameter, refer to the documentation [Modify Parameter Configuration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156).

When calling the API using Postman or similar tools, make sure to escape characters as shown: {\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MinInsyncReplicaNumber\":\"2\"}.

Parameter descriptions

- "MinInsyncReplicaNumber":"2": Minimum number of in-sync replicas. If the number of in-sync replicas falls below this value, messages cannot be written to the topic. Increasing this value improves data reliability but reduces availability. The default is the number of replicas minus one. For better topic availability, set this to the number of replicas minus one.
- "MessageMaxByte":"10": Maximum message size in MB. Valid range: 1–12. By default, this follows the instance's maximum message size setting.
- "LogRetentionHours":"72": Message retention period in hours. Valid range: 0–2160 (up to 90 days). By default, this follows the instance's message retention period setting.

PartitionNumber.description_cn:
此 Topic 的分区数量。分区数量越大，消费的并发度越大。
该参数只能调大不能调小，且不可超出 Kakfa 实例的剩余可用分区数。
PartitionNumber.description_en: Number of partitions for this topic. The greater the number of partitions, the higher the consumption concurrency. You can only increase this value; you cannot decrease it. Do not exceed the remaining available partition count in the Kafka instance.

ReplicaNumber.description_cn:
分区的副本个数，表示对应数量的副本上备份数据。当其中一个 Broker 故障时仍可保障数据可用性，副本数越大可靠性越高。
- 增加副本数会占用实例磁盘容量，请确保容量充足。
- 增加副本时会占用实例带宽资源，建议在业务低峰期操作。
- 减少副本数会降低数据可用性，请谨慎操作。
- 1 副本 Topic 无法保障数据可靠性且实例升级期间无法进行读写操作，建议选择 2 副本或 3 副本
ReplicaNumber.description_en:
The number of replicas for a partition indicates how many copies of the data are backed up. If one broker fails, data remains available. A higher replica count increases reliability.
- Increasing the replica count uses more instance disk capacity; make sure you have enough capacity.
- Adding replicas consumes instance bandwidth resources; we recommend making changes during business off-peak hours.
- Reducing the replica count lowers data availability; proceed with caution.
- Topics with only 1 replica cannot ensure data reliability and are unavailable for read/write operations during instance upgrades; we recommend using 2 or 3 replicas.

需要重置消费位点的分区编号。
- 不指定 PartitionId 时，重置指定 Topic 下的所有分区。
- 当 TopicName 指定为 * 时，不支持设置 PartitionId。
ResetOffsetsInfo.PartitionId.description_en:
Reset the partition number for the consumption position
- If PartitionId is not specified, reset all partitions under the specified Topic
- When TopicName is set to *, PartitionId cannot be set

ResetOffsetsInfo.ResetOffset.description_cn:
重置消费位点到指定 Offset。仅在 ResetType 为 Offset 时需要设置。未指定此参数时，表示重置到最新的消息位置。 
取值范围： 
- -1：（默认）将消费位点重置到最新的一条消息。 
- -2：将消费位点重置到最早的一条消息。 
- 其他整型数值：指定重置消费位点到指定 Topic 的指定分区中某个具体的 Offset 位置，取值范围为分区的最小 Offset 和最大 Offset 之间，即 [StartOffset,EndOffset]。 
 
- 仅在指定 TopicName 和 PartitionId 时，可以将 ResetOffset 指定为其他整型数值。 
- 您可以通过 DescribeTopicPartitions 查看 StartOffset 和 EndOffset。
ResetOffsetsInfo.ResetOffset.description_en:
Reset the consumer offset to a specified Offset. Only set this parameter when ResetType is Offset. If not specified, the offset will be reset to the latest message position.
Value range:
- -1 (default): Reset the consumer offset to the latest message
- -2: Reset the consumer offset to the earliest message
- Other integer values: Reset the consumer offset to a specific Offset within the specified topic and partition. The value must be between the partition's minimum and maximum offsets, that is, [StartOffset, EndOffset]
- You can only specify other integer values for ResetOffset when both TopicName and PartitionId are set
- Use DescribeTopicPartitions to view StartOffset and EndOffset

ResetOffsetsInfo.ResetTimestamp.description_cn:
重置消费位点到指定的时间点。时间戳格式，单位为毫秒。仅在 ResetType 为 Timestamp 时需要设置。 
- 消费时间戳为消息存储到服务端的时间。 
- 可重置的时间点范围由 Topic 的消息保留时间决定，即此参数的取值范围为 [当前时间-实例消息保留时长, 当前时间]。 
- 若指定时间不存在消息，则会重置到最近的消息位置。
ResetOffsetsInfo.ResetTimestamp.description_en:
Reset the consumption offset to the specified time point. The value should be a timestamp in milliseconds. Only required when ResetType is set to Timestamp. 
- The consumption timestamp is when the message was stored on the server. 
- The valid reset range is determined by the topic's instance message retention duration; you can set this parameter between [current time - instance message retention duration, current time]. 
- If no message exists at the specified time, the offset resets to the nearest message position.

ResetOffsetsInfo.ResetType.description_cn:
消费位点重置的方式，默认为 Offset。可设置为：
- Offset：（默认）根据指定 offset 重置消费位点，即 Group 在当前分区中从指定位点开始消费。此时默认重置到最新的 Offset，也可以通过参数 ResetOffset 指定 Offset。
- Timestamp：根据指定时间重置消费位点，即从过去的某个指定时段内选择一个时间点开始消费。此时需要通过参数 ResetTimestamp 设置时间点。
ResetOffsetsInfo.ResetType.description_en:
Consumer position reset method defaults to Offset. The options are:
- Offset (default): Reset consumer position based on the specified offset. The group starts consuming from the designated position in the current partition. By default, resets to the latest offset, or you can specify an offset using the ResetOffset parameter
- Timestamp: Reset consumer position based on a specified time. The group starts consuming from a selected time point within a past time range. Set the time point using the ResetTimestamp parameter

ResetOffsetsInfo.TopicName.description_cn:
Topic 名称。
当参数值指定为“*”时，表示重置 Group 消费的所有分区。
ResetOffsetsInfo.TopicName.description_en:
Topic Name
When the parameter value is set to "*", this indicates that all partitions consumed by the Group will be reset
