BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.AmountT.description_cn: 完成任务后，单个观众可获得的积分值，单位为 0.1 积分。取值范围为 [1, 500,000]。若该值设为 10，则每位观众可获得 1 积分。
BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.AmountT.description_en: After completing the task, the number of points a single viewer can earn. The unit is 0.1 point. Value range: [1, 500,000]. If this value is set to 10, each viewer will receive 1 point.

BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.LimitCo.description_cn:
该奖励可被领取的总份数。可取值：

* `-1`：无限制
* [1，100,000] 之间的整数：表示具体奖励份数
BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.LimitCo.description_en:
Total number of times this reward can be claimed. Possible values:

* `-1`: Unlimited
* An integer between [1, 100,000]: Specifies the exact number of reward claims

BonusList.SubBonusType.description_cn:
完成任务后，观众获得的奖励类型。取值如下：

* `1`：积分
* `2`：现金
* `3`：优惠券
* `4`：奖品
BonusList.SubBonusType.description_en:
Reward type received by viewers after completing the task. Possible values:

* `1`: Points
* `2`: Cash
* `3`: Coupon
* `4`: Prize

BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.description_cn:
观看时长任务的详细信息。
当且仅当 `SubBonusType` 参数取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.description_en:
Details of the watch duration task
This parameter is effective if and only if the `SubBonusType` parameter is set to `1`

BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.Watc.description_cn:
当任务类型为观看时长时，指定的直播状态。默认为` [1]`，即仅统计观看直播的时长，不包括预告和回放视频。支持填入以下取值：

* `1`：直播中
* `2`：预告视频
* `3`：回放视频

当且仅当 `SubBonusType` 参数取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.Watc.description_en:
When the task type is watch duration, specify the live stream status. The default is `[1]`, which counts only the duration of watching live streams and excludes preview and replay videos. The following values are supported:

* `1`: Live
* `2`: Preview video
* `3`: Replay video

This parameter is effective only when the `SubBonusType` parameter is set to `1`.

BonusList.SubTaskCondition.description_cn:
完成该子任务的数量要求，取值范围为 [1,500]。
示例：若 `SubTaskType` 取值为 `1`，`SubTaskCondition` 取值为 `30`，则表示获奖条件为“观看直播 `30` 分钟”。
BonusList.SubTaskCondition.description_en:
Required quantity to complete this subtask. Value range: [1,500]
Example: If `SubTaskType` is `1` and `SubTaskCondition` is `30`, the reward condition is 'Watch live stream for `30` minutes'

BonusList.SubTaskType.description_cn:
子任务的类型。取值如下：

* `1`：观看时长。您还可以通过 `WatchDurationStatusList` 参数指定统计范围，包括：直播中、预告和回放。默认仅统计直播中的观看时长。
* `2`：聊天次数
* `3`：点赞次数
* `4`：邀请人数
* `5`：商品点击次数
* `6`：打赏次数
* `7`：投票次数
* `8`：完成问卷次数
* `9`：签到次数
* `10`：答题次数
* `11`：答对次数
BonusList.SubTaskType.description_en:
Sub-task types. The available values are:

* `1`: Watch duration. You can also use the `WatchDurationStatusList` parameter to specify the scope, including: live, preview, and playback. By default, only the watch duration during live is counted.
* `2`: Number of chats
* `3`: Number of likes
* `4`: Number of people invited
* `5`: Number of product clicks
* `6`: Number of tips
* `7`: Number of votes
* `8`: Number of completed questionnaires
* `9`: Number of check-ins
* `10`: Number of answered questions
* `11`: Number of correct answers

EndTime.description_cn:
福利任务的结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。结束时间取值需大于 `StartTime` 的取值，且与 `StartTime` 的差值最大为 604,800，即 7 天。
当 `TaskRunningType` 为 `2` 时，该参数生效且必填。
EndTime.description_en:
End time of the bonus task. Unix timestamp in seconds. The end time must be greater than the value of `StartTime`, and the difference between `EndTime` and `StartTime` must not exceed 604,800 seconds (7 days).
This parameter is required and takes effect when `TaskRunningType` is set to `2`.

Icon.description_cn: 福利任务图标的 URL，需要包含协议头。不传则使用默认图标。支持传入 PNG、JPG、JPEG 格式的图片，尺寸不超过 160×160px，大小不超过 2 MB。
Icon.description_en: The URL for the bonus task icon must include the protocol. If not provided, the default icon will be used. Supports PNG, JPG, and JPEG image formats. Image size must not exceed 160×160px and 2 MB.

Name.description_cn: 直播福利任务的名称，长度不超过 20 个字符，不能为空。
Name.description_en: Name of the livestream bonus task. Must not exceed 20 characters and cannot be empty.
Name.example_en: Watch the livestream and claim rewards

StartTime.description_cn:
福利任务的开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。开始时间取值需大于当前时间。
当 `TaskRunningType` 为 `2` 时，该参数生效且必填。
StartTime.description_en:
Start time of the bonus task. Unix timestamp in seconds. The start time must be greater than the current time.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `TaskRunningType` is set to `2`.

TaskRunningType.description_cn:
直播福利任务开启方式。取值如下：

* `1`：手动开启：任务创建后，您可以随时手动开启任务。
* `2`：计划开启：设置一个具体的开始和结束时间，任务将按计划自动开启。
TaskRunningType.description_en:
How to start the livestream bonus task. Available values:

* `1`: Manual start—After creating the task, you can start it manually at any time.
* `2`: Scheduled start—Set a specific start and end time, and the task will start automatically as scheduled.

ActivityCoupons.description_cn: 卡券互动工具信息列表。
ActivityCoupons.description_en: Cards and Coupons Interactive Tool Information List

ActivityCoupons.AllowCloseIcon.description_cn:
观看页的卡券图标是否支持关闭。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：
- `true`：支持
- `false`：不支持
ActivityCoupons.AllowCloseIcon.description_en:
Whether disabling the card coupon icon on the viewing page is supported. Default value: `false`. Options: 
- `true`: Disabling is supported 
- `false`: Disabling is not supported

ActivityCoupons.AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送卡券的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
当 `SendCouponType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
ActivityCoupons.AutoSendTime.description_en:
The scheduled time to send the coupon. Unix timestamp, in seconds.
This parameter is required when `SendCouponType` is set to `1`.

ActivityCoupons.Count.description_cn: 发放的卡券个数。取值范围为 -1 和 [1,1000000]。取值为 `-1` 表示无限制。
ActivityCoupons.Count.description_en: Number of coupons issued. Valid values: -1 or any number from 1 to 1,000,000. Use -1 for unlimited.

ActivityCoupons.CouponId.description_cn:
卡券 ID。您可通过调用 [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保卡券对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityCoupons.CouponId.description_en:
Coupon ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) API.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the coupon is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityCoupons.CutOffTime.description_cn:
定时截止时间，需晚于当前时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
当 `Rule` 取值为 `3` 时，该参数必选。
ActivityCoupons.CutOffTime.description_en:
Scheduled deadline time must be later than the current time. Unix timestamp, measured in seconds.
When `Rule` is set to `3`, this parameter is required.

ActivityCoupons.Duration.description_cn:
倒计时。取值范围为 [1,300]。单位为分钟。
当 `Rule` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选。
ActivityCoupons.Duration.description_en:
Countdown. Value range: [1,300]. Unit: minutes.
When `Rule` is set to `2`, this parameter is required.

ActivityCoupons.IsViewerLevelLimit.description_cn:
是否开启观众等级参与条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不开启。卡券的领取不受观众等级限制。
* `1`：开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，满足观众等级条件的用户才能看见并领取卡券。
ActivityCoupons.IsViewerLevelLimit.description_en:
Enable audience level participation requirement. Default value is `0`. The options are:

* `0`: Disabled. Coupon redemption is not restricted by audience level.
* `1`: Enabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, only users who meet the audience level requirement can see and redeem the coupon.

ActivityCoupons.IsWatchLiveLimit.description_cn:
是否开启观看直播参与条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，观众可直接领取卡券，而无需先观看直播。
* `1`：开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，观众必须先观看直播，才能领取卡券。
ActivityCoupons.IsWatchLiveLimit.description_en:
Enable live stream participation requirement. Default value is `0`. Options:

* `0`: Disabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, viewers can claim the coupon directly without watching the live stream first.
* `1`: Enabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, viewers must watch the live stream before they can claim the coupon.

ActivityCoupons.Rule.description_cn:
领取卡券的截止时间。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：无时间限制。卡券互动工具被发送至观看页后，观众可随时领取卡券
- `1`：卡券在手动停止发放前，均支持领取
- `2`：卡券互动工具被发送至观看页后的指定分钟数内，均支持领取卡券
- `3`：卡券在截止时间前，均支持领取
ActivityCoupons.Rule.description_en:
Coupon claim deadline. Default value is `0`. The options are:
- `0`: No time limit. After the coupon interactive tool is sent to the viewing page, viewers can claim coupons at any time
- `1`: Coupons can be claimed until manual distribution is stopped
- `2`: Coupons can be claimed within the specified number of minutes after the coupon interactive tool is sent to the viewing page
- `3`: Coupons can be claimed before the deadline

ActivityCoupons.SendCouponType.description_cn:
卡券发送方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。后续可调用 [SendActivityCoupon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357829) 接口发送卡券。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime` 参数选择定时发送的时间。
ActivityCoupons.SendCouponType.description_en:
Coupon sending method. The default value is `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual send. You can call the [SendActivityCoupon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357829) API to send the coupon later.
* `1`: Scheduled send. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled sending time.

ActivityCoupons.ViewerLevelConfigIds.description_cn:
开启观众等级参与条件后，观众需满足的观众等级的 ID 列表。
传入观众等级 ID 之前，请确保当前直播间已绑定观众等级库，且传入的观众等级 ID 属于该等级库。
建议先调用 [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) 接口，获取当前直播间绑定的等级库 ID （`BindAccountLevelGroupId`）；再调用 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口，获取等级库中的等级 ID（`LevelId`）。
当 `IsViewerLevelLimit` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
ActivityCoupons.ViewerLevelConfigIds.description_en: After enabling viewer level participation requirements, this is the list of viewer level IDs required for participation. Before providing viewer level IDs, make sure the current live room is bound to a viewer level library, and that the IDs you provide belong to this library. It is recommended to first call the [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the ID of the viewer level library bound to the current live room (`BindAccountLevelGroupId`). Then, call [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) to get the level IDs (`LevelId`) in the library. When `IsViewerLevelLimit` is set to `1`, this parameter is required.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Questionnaire.description_cn: 问卷的配置信息，包含问卷题目、选项等。
Questionnaire.description_en: Questionnaire configuration information, including questionnaire title, options, and more.

Questionnaire.Description.description_cn: 问卷的详细描述或说明，将显示在问卷标题下方。最多支持输入 200 个字符。不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Description.description_en: Detailed description or instructions for the questionnaire, displayed below the questionnaire title. Up to 200 characters allowed. Cannot be only spaces.

Questionnaire.IsRealNameEnable.description_cn:
是否将问卷设为实名问卷。默认为匿名问卷。支持以下取值：

* `0`：匿名问卷，用户无需登录即可提交问卷，且可以重复提交问卷。
* `1`：实名问卷。如果您需要获取填写问卷的观众昵称，且不允许观众重复提交问卷，可选择**实名问卷**。

实名问卷用于保证观众填写问卷时已登录直播间，无法保证观众使用真实姓名。如果您在**观看限制**中将**评论限制**设置为**公开**，则观众提交实名问卷时需选择输入昵称或手机号登录。
Questionnaire.IsRealNameEnable.description_en:
Whether to set the questionnaire as a real-name questionnaire. The default is anonymous. The following values are supported:

* `0`: Anonymous questionnaire. Users can submit without logging in and can submit multiple times.
* `1`: Real-name questionnaire. If you need to obtain the nickname of viewers who fill out the questionnaire and do not allow repeated submissions, choose **real-name questionnaire**.

Real-name questionnaires ensure viewers are logged in when filling out the questionnaire, but do not guarantee the use of real names. If you set **Comment Restriction** to **Public** under **Viewing Restriction**, viewers must log in with a nickname or phone number when submitting a real-name questionnaire.

Questionnaire.Questions.description_cn: 问卷中的问题列表。最多可添加 20 个问题。
Questionnaire.Questions.description_en: Question list in the questionnaire. You can add up to 20 questions.

Questionnaire.Questions.IsRequire.description_cn:
问题是否为必填，默认为非必填。支持以下取值：

* `0`：非必填
* `1`：必填
Questionnaire.Questions.IsRequire.description_en:
Is the question required? Default is not required. Supported values:

* `0`: Not required
* `1`: Required

Questionnaire.Questions.Options.description_cn:
选择题中的选项列表。至少需包含两个选项。
当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `select` 时，该参数必选且生效。
Questionnaire.Questions.Options.description_en:
Option list for selection questions. Must include at least two options.
When `QuestionTag` is set to `select`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

Questionnaire.Questions.Options.OptionNa.description_cn: 选项内容，最多支持输入 50 个字符，不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Questions.Options.OptionNa.description_en: Option content can contain up to 50 characters and cannot consist solely of spaces

Questionnaire.Questions.Question.description_cn: 问题内容，最多支持输入 50 个字符，不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Questions.Question.description_en: Question content. Maximum 50 characters. Cannot be only spaces.
Questionnaire.Questions.Question.example_cn: 您在网购时，收货方式是？
Questionnaire.Questions.Question.example_en: What is your delivery method when shopping online?

Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionSubTag.description_cn:
问题子类型。取值情况如下。

* 当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `personal_info` 时，支持以下取值： 
   * `phone_number`：手机号码。系统会校验手机号格式。
   * `email`：邮箱，系统会校验邮箱格式。
   * `nickname`：昵称。如果用户已登录，则系统会自动填充昵称且用户无法更改。
* 当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `blank_filling` 时，该参数仅支持 `text` 取值，表示填空题。最多支持观众填入 200 个字符。
* 当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `select` 时，支持以下取值：
   * `radio`：单选题。
   * `checkbox`：多选题。
Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionSubTag.description_en:
Question subtype. Supported values:

* When `QuestionTag` is set to `personal_info`, supported values:
   * `phone_number`: Phone number. The system will validate the phone number format.
   * `email`: Email. The system will validate the email format.
   * `nickname`: Nickname. If the user is logged in, the system will auto-fill the nickname and the user cannot change it.
* When `QuestionTag` is set to `blank_filling`, this parameter only supports the value `text`, indicating a fill-in-the-blank question. Audience can enter up to 200 characters.
* When `QuestionTag` is set to `select`, supported values:
   * `radio`: Single choice question.
   * `checkbox`: Multiple choice question.

Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionTag.description_cn:
问题类型。支持以下取值：

* `personal_info`：个人信息。支持手机号、邮箱和昵称。
* `blank_filling`：填空题。
* `select`：选择题。支持单选和多选。
Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionTag.description_en:
Question type. Supported values:

* `personal_info`: Personal information. Supports phone number, email, and nickname.
* `blank_filling`: Fill-in-the-blank question.
* `select`: Selection question. Supports single choice and multiple choice.

Questionnaire.SendTime.description_cn:
定时发送问卷的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。设定时间必须晚于当前时间至少 1 分钟。 
当 `TriggerTime` 取值为 `auto_send` 时，该参数必选且生效。
Questionnaire.SendTime.description_en:
Scheduled time to send the questionnaire. Unix timestamp in seconds. The set time must be at least 1 minute later than the current time.
When `TriggerTime` is set to `auto_send`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

Questionnaire.Title.description_cn: 问卷的标题。最多支持输入 60 个字符。不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Title.description_en: Questionnaire title. Up to 60 characters allowed. Cannot be only spaces.

Questionnaire.TriggerTime.description_cn:
问卷的发送时机。支持以下取值：

* `live_page_in`：当观众进入直播间时弹出问卷
* `live_end`：当直播结束时弹出问卷
* `manual`：手动发送问卷，问卷发送后在观看页弹出
* `auto_send`：定时发送问卷，问卷将在指定时间在观看页弹出
Questionnaire.TriggerTime.description_en:
Timing for sending the questionnaire. The following values are supported:

* `live_page_in`: Show the questionnaire when viewers enter the live room
* `live_end`: Show the questionnaire when the live stream ends
* `manual`: Manually send the questionnaire; it will pop up on the viewing page after sending
* `auto_send`: Schedule the questionnaire to pop up on the viewing page at the specified time

ActivityID.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityID.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Animation.description_cn: 红包动效 0-标准动效 1-关闭动效
Animation.description_en: Red Envelope Animation Effects 0 - Standard Animation 1 - Disable Animation

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送红包的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
当 `SendRedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled red packet sending time. Unix timestamp, in seconds.
This parameter is required when `SendRedPacketType` is set to `1`.

AwardCondition.description_cn:
参与条件配置。
观众只有在同时满足开启的参与条件后，才能参与抢红包。
如果开启问卷、投票、签到、答题或简答参与条件，观众必须在本场直播期间完成相关活动，才能被视为有效参与。也就是说，直播间必须处于**直播中**状态，且活动必须在本场直播期间完成。
AwardCondition.description_en:
Participation requirements setup
Viewers can join the red envelope event only if they meet all enabled participation requirements
If survey, poll, check-in, quiz, or short answer requirements are enabled, viewers must complete the related activities during this live session for their participation to count. The live room must be in **Live** status, and activities must be completed during this session

AwardCondition.CheckIn.description_cn:
签到参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启签到参与条件
- `all`：提交全部签到。全部签到指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部签到
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的签到
AwardCondition.CheckIn.description_en:
Check-in participation requirements. The default value is empty. Options:
- Empty: No check-in participation requirements
- `all`: Submit all check-ins. All check-ins refer to every check-in sent from the start of this livestream up to the time of participating in this red envelope draw
- `1-999`: Submit at least the number of check-ins specified by the parameter value

AwardCondition.Questionnaire.description_cn:
问卷参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启问卷参与条件
- `all`：提交全部问卷。全部问卷指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部问卷
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的问卷
AwardCondition.Questionnaire.description_en:
Survey participation criteria. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: No participation criteria enabled
- `all`: Submit all surveys. All surveys refer to those sent from the start of this livestream up to and during participation in this red envelope event
- `1-999`: Submit at least the number of surveys specified by the parameter value

AwardCondition.Quiz.description_cn:
答题或简答参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启答题或简答参与条件
- `all`：提交全部答题或简答。全部答题或简答指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部答题或简答
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的答题或简答
AwardCondition.Quiz.description_en:
Question or short answer participation criteria. Default is empty. Possible values:
- Empty: Participation criteria for questions or short answers are not enabled
- `all`: Submit all questions or short answers. This means submitting every question or short answer sent from the start of this livestream until the period of participating in this red envelope event
- `1-999`: Submit at least the number of questions or short answers specified by the parameter value

AwardCondition.RightQuiz.description_cn:
答题或简答参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启答题或简答参与条件
- `all`：答对全部答题或简答。全部答题或简答指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部答题或简答
- `1-999`：至少答对参数值指定个数的答题或简答
AwardCondition.RightQuiz.description_en:
Question or short answer participation criteria. Default is empty. Possible values:
- Empty: Participation criteria for questions or short answers are not enabled
- `all`: Must answer all questions or short answers correctly. This refers to all questions or short answers sent from the start of the live session until the period of participating in the red envelope event
- `1-999`: Must answer at least the specified number of questions or short answers correctly

AwardCondition.Vote.description_cn:
投票参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启投票参与条件
- `all`：提交全部投票。全部投票指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部投票
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的投票
AwardCondition.Vote.description_en:
Voting participation criteria. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: No voting participation criteria enabled
- `all`: Submit all votes. All votes refer to every vote sent from the start of this livestream until participation in this red envelope event
- `1-999`: Submit at least the specified number of votes

BarragePwd.description_cn: 弹幕口令。传入该参数后，将开启弹幕参与条件，观众必须发送该弹幕口令，才能参与抢红包。
BarragePwd.description_en: Barrage code. Enter this parameter to enable the barrage participation condition. Viewers must send the barrage code to participate in grabbing red envelopes.

BlackUserInfoId.description_cn:
中奖黑名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口获取 ID。
中奖黑名单，即无法中奖的人员名单。如果某观众被同时添加进优先中奖名单和中奖黑名单，则该观众无法中奖。
BlackUserInfoId.description_en: Winning blacklist ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API. The winning blacklist is a list of users who cannot win prizes. If a viewer is added to both the priority winning list and the winning blacklist, that viewer cannot win prizes.

ClaimFailureText.description_cn: 观众未抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，默认为**很遗憾，您没有抢到红包**。
ClaimFailureText.description_en: Message shown when the audience fails to grab a red envelope. Length: 1 to 100 characters. If this parameter is not provided, the default is **Unfortunately, you didn't get a red envelope**.
ClaimFailureText.example_cn: 很遗憾，您没有抢到红包
ClaimFailureText.example_en: Sorry, you weren’t able to claim a red envelope

ClaimSuccessText.description_cn: 观众抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，现金红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到现金红包**，积分红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到积分红包**。
ClaimSuccessText.description_en: Prompt message shown when a viewer grabs a red envelope. Length must be between 1 and 100 characters. If not specified, the default for cash red envelopes is 'Congratulations, you grabbed a cash red envelope', and for points red envelopes is 'Congratulations, you grabbed a points red envelope'.
ClaimSuccessText.example_en: Congratulations! You received a cash red envelope

CustomRedirectUrl.description_cn:
自定义地址。长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
CustomRedirectUrl.description_en:
Custom address (1–500 characters)
This field is required and takes effect when `EnableCustomRedirect` is set to true

DeadLine.description_cn:
开奖倒计时。取值范围为 `[1,999]`，单位为分钟。默认值为 `5`。
当 `OpenRedPacketType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
DeadLine.description_en:
Draw countdown. Value range: `[1,999]`, unit: minutes. Default: `5`.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `OpenRedPacketType` is set to `0`.

EnableCustomRedirect.description_cn:
是否开启自定义地址提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，观众点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至 `CustomRedirectUrl` 配置的自定义地址页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 和 `EnableMiniApp` 的取值均为 `true` 时，则：
- 在移动端微信环境下，观众会跳转至微信小程序页面
- 在其他环境下，观众会跳转至自定义地址页面
EnableCustomRedirect.description_en:
Enable custom address withdrawal redirect. Default value is `false`. Options: 
- `true`: Enabled. When enabled, viewers who click **Withdraw Now** will be redirected to the custom address page specified by `CustomRedirectUrl`. You are responsible for distributing the prize amount and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on that page
- `false`: Disabled
If both `EnableCustomRedirect` and `EnableMiniApp` are set to `true`:
- In the mobile WeChat environment, viewers will be redirected to the WeChat Mini Program page
- In other environments, viewers will be redirected to the custom address page

EnableMiniApp.description_cn:
是否开启微信小程序提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，移动端观众在微信环境下点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至指定微信小程序页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
EnableMiniApp.description_en:
Enable WeChat Mini Program withdrawal redirection. Default value is `false`. Options:
- `true`: Enable. When enabled, mobile users in the WeChat environment can tap **Withdraw Now** to be redirected to the specified WeChat Mini Program page. You are responsible for distributing prize money and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on that page.
- `false`: Disable

IsOpenSmsNotification.description_cn:
是否开启短信提醒。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启。开启后，通过手机号登录直播间的观众，在中奖时会收到企业直播发送的红包中奖提醒短信
IsOpenSmsNotification.description_en:
Enable SMS reminders. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On. When enabled, viewers who log in to the live room with their mobile number will receive a red packet winning notification SMS from Enterprise Live if they win

MiniAppId.description_cn:
微信小程序的 App ID，跳转后的页面属于该微信小程序。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
完成以下步骤，获取 App ID。
1. 使用微信小程序账号登录[微信公众平台](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/)。
2. 在左侧导航栏，选择**设置**。
3. 在**基本设置**页签下查看 App ID。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppId.description_en:
App ID for the WeChat Mini Program. The redirected page belongs to this Mini Program. Length must be between 1 and 100 characters.

Follow these steps to get the App ID:
1. Log in to the [WeChat Official Platform](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/) using your Mini Program account
2. In the left navigation bar, select **Settings**
3. Under the **Basic Settings** tab, view the App ID

This parameter is required and takes effect when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`

MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_cn:
跳转后的页面在微信小程序中的相对路径。 长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_en:
Relative path of the redirected page within the WeChat Mini Program. Must be 1–500 characters long.
This parameter is required and takes effect only when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.

Name.description_cn:
自定义红包名称。最多支持输入 20 个字符。如果不传值，则：

* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为正整数（即红包个数为指定数量）时，则展示总金额数，如 “1000.00元”或 “3000积分”。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1`（即红包个数为无限制）时，积分红包的名称为 “99999积分”，现金红包的名称为 “99999元”。
Name.description_en:
Custom red packet name. Supports up to 20 characters. If not provided:

* When `RewardPointNumber` is a positive integer (i.e., the number of red packets is specified), the total amount is displayed, such as "1000.00 yuan" or "3000 points".
* When `RewardPointNumber` is `-1` (i.e., unlimited number of red packets), the name for points red packets is "99999 points", and for cash red packets is "99999 yuan".

OpenRedPacketType.description_cn:
开奖方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：自动开奖
- `1`：手动开奖
OpenRedPacketType.description_en:
Draw method. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Automatic draw
- `1`: Manual draw

RangeStatus.description_cn:
中奖条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：所有观众的中奖概率相同
* `1`：未中奖观众优先，即加大在当前直播间 30 天未中奖观众的中奖概率
* `2`：重复中奖限制

当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1` 时，该参数仅支持设为 `0`。表示当红包配置中存在不限制红包个数的金额时，则中奖条件仅支持设置为所有观众的中奖概率相同。
RangeStatus.description_en:
Winning conditions. Default value is `0`. Options:

* `0`: All viewers have the same chance of winning
* `1`: Priority for viewers who haven't won—viewers who haven't won in the current livestream in the past 30 days have a higher chance of winning
* `2`: Limit repeat winners

When `RewardPointNumber` is set to `-1`, this parameter can only be set to `0`. This means that if the red packet configuration includes an amount for which the number of packets is unlimited, the winning condition can only be set so that all viewers have the same chance of winning.

RedPacketCoverImage.description_cn: 观看页展示的红包图标的 URL，包含协议头。不传该参数，则使用默认红包图标。
RedPacketCoverImage.description_en: URL for the red envelope icon shown on the viewing page, including protocol header. If not provided, the default red envelope icon is used

RedPacketNumber.description_cn:
金额随机时，设置的红包个数。取值范围为 `[1,2000]`。
当 `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RedPacketNumber.description_en:
When the amount is random, set the number of red packets. Value range: `[1,2000]`.
This parameter is required and effective when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.

RedPacketType.description_cn:
红包类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：现金红包
* `1`：积分红包 

您可以进行二次开发，按照红包中奖结果，向抢到红包的观众发放积分或让观众完成现金红包提现。详见[接入流程](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B)。
RedPacketType.description_en:
Red Envelope type. Default value is `0`. Available options:

* `0`: Cash Red Envelope
* `1`: Points Red Envelope

You can perform secondary development to, according to the red envelope winning result, distribute points to viewers who win Red Envelopes or allow viewers to withdraw Cash Red Envelopes. See [Integration Process](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B).

RepeatedAwardLimit.description_cn:
同一观众在当前直播间 30 天内允许中奖（包括实时抽奖和红包）的次数。取值范围为 `[1,99]`，默认值为 `1`。
当 `RangeStatus` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RepeatedAwardLimit.description_en:
Number of times a single viewer can win (including real-time draws and red packets) in this livestream room within 30 days. Range: [1,99], default: 1
This parameter is required and takes effect when `RangeStatus` is set to `2`.

RewardsPointsConfig.AmountCalculationTyp.description_cn:
金额计算方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：随机金额
- `1`：指定金额
RewardsPointsConfig.AmountCalculationTyp.description_en:
Amount calculation method. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Random amount
- `1`: Specified amount

RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_cn:
指定金额的红包配置。最多支持配置 6 对金额和红包个数的组合。
当 `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_en:
Configure red packets with specified amounts. You can set up to 6 combinations of amount and number of red packets.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `1`.

RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_cn:
现金红包或积分红包的金额。

* 当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `0` 时，参数取值范围为 `[10,20000]`。单位为分
* 当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，参数取值范围为 `[1,100000]`。单位可通过 `RewardsPointsUnit` 参数配置
RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_en:
Amount for cash red packets or points red packets.

* When `RedPacketType` is `0`, the parameter range is `[10,20000]`. Unit: fen (Chinese cent)
* When `RedPacketType` is `1`, the parameter range is `[1,100000]`. The unit can be configured via the `RewardsPointsUnit` parameter

RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_cn:
红包个数。取值如下：

* `-1`：不限制个数
* `1-2000`：红包个数
RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_en:
Number of red packets. Values:

* `-1`: No limit on quantity
* `1-2000`: Number of red packets

RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsBatch.description_cn:
批次号，用于区分不同批次的积分。观众参与抢红包后，您可根据批次号和中奖金额，向抢到红包的观众发送积分。
当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsBatch.description_en:
Batch number, used to distinguish points from different batches. After viewers participate in the red packet event, you can send points to viewers who grabbed a red packet based on the batch number and winning amount.
This parameter is effective when `RedPacketType` is set to 1.

RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsUnit.description_cn:
积分单位。默认为**积分**。
当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsUnit.description_en:
Points unit. Default: **Points**
This parameter is required and effective when `RedPacketType` is set to 1.

SendRedPacketType.description_cn:
红包的发送方式，默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime` 参数选择定时发送的时间。
SendRedPacketType.description_en:
Red packet sending method. Default value is `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual sending
* `1`: Scheduled sending. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled sending time.

TotalAmount.description_cn:
金额随机时，红包总金额或总积分。
* 当  `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
* 对于不同红包类型，其金额或积分单位不同：
   * 现金红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `0`）时，取值范围为 `[10,2000000]`，单位为分
   * 积分红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `1`）时，取值范围为 `[1,100000]`，单位可通过 `RewardsPointsUnit` 参数配置
TotalAmount.description_en:
When the amount is random, total red packet amount or total points.
* This parameter is required and effective when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.
* For different red packet types, the unit for amount or points varies:
   * Cash red packet (`RedPacketType` is `0`): value range `[10,2000000]`, unit is cents
   * Points red packet (`RedPacketType` is `1`): value range `[1,100000]`, unit can be configured via the `RewardsPointsUnit` parameter

VipUserInfoId.description_cn:
优先中奖名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口获取 ID。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1` 时，该参数不生效。表示当红包配置中存在不限制红包个数的金额时，不支持设置优先中奖名单。
* 当优先中奖名单中的人数大于红包数量，则在优先中奖名单中随机抽奖。
* 当红包数量大于优先中奖名单中的人数时，则优先中奖名单中的观众全部中奖且优先获得较大金额的红包，多出的红包在普通观众中随机抽奖。
* 优先中奖名单中，已登录的观众（仅输入昵称的观众除外）无需手动参与抢红包，如果开奖时正在观看直播，即可收到中奖弹窗通知。
VipUserInfoId.description_en:
Priority winner list ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API.
* When `RewardPointNumber` is `-1`, this parameter is not effective. This means that when the red packet configuration allows unlimited quantity, setting a priority winner list is not supported.
* If the number of users in the priority winner list exceeds the number of red packets, winners are randomly selected from the priority list.
* If the number of red packets exceeds the number of users in the priority winner list, all users in the priority list win and receive larger red packets first. The remaining red packets are randomly awarded to regular viewers.
* Viewers in the priority winner list who are logged in (excluding those who only entered a nickname) do not need to manually participate in grabbing red packets. If they are watching the live stream when the draw occurs, they will receive a winning notification popup.

Coupons.Description.description_cn: 卡券描述，长度为 1 到 500 个字符。

Coupons.IsBlockRepeatPickup.description_cn: 卡券领取限制 0-无限制 1-9999对应领取的限制次数
Coupons.IsBlockRepeatPickup.description_en: Coupon claim limit: 0 means no limit; 1–9999 specify the maximum number of claims allowed

Coupons.IsRepeatPickupEnable.description_cn:
卡券是否允许重复领取。默认值为 `1`。取值如下：
- `0`：不允许。观众只能领取一次当前卡券，领取后，在任一直播间点击该卡券，均会提示已领取过该卡券。
- `1`：允许。观众可以在任一直播间多次领取当前卡券。
Coupons.IsRepeatPickupEnable.description_en:
Allow multiple claims for coupons. Default value is `1`. Options:
- `0`: Not allowed. Each viewer can claim this coupon only once. After claiming, clicking the coupon in any live room will show that it has already been claimed.
- `1`: Allowed. Viewers can claim this coupon multiple times in any live room.

Coupons.Name.description_cn: 卡券名称，长度为 1 到 100 个字符。

Coupons.OwnerSubAccountName.description_cn:
新增卡券所归属的子账号的账号。长度为 1 到 64 个字符。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，获取子账号的账号。
仅在使用主账号调用接口时该参数生效。调用接口后，主账号会替该子账号新增卡券，即接口新增的卡券归属于该参数指定的子账号。
- 如果该子账号无卡券库的可编辑权限，则无法编辑或删除该新增卡券。
- 如果不传该参数或传空值，新增卡券归属于调用接口的主账号。
Coupons.OwnerSubAccountName.description_en:
Account of the sub-account to which the new card or coupon will belong. Must be 1 to 64 characters long. You can get the sub-account's account by calling the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API.

This parameter is only effective when the API is called using the main account. After the call, the main account will create the new card or coupon for the specified sub-account, so the new card or coupon will belong to the sub-account specified by this parameter.

- If the sub-account does not have edit permissions for the card or coupon library, it cannot edit or delete the new card or coupon.
- If this parameter is not provided or is left empty, the new card or coupon will belong to the main account that calls the API.

Coupons.Pic.description_cn:
卡券图片的 URL，需包含协议头。
支持配置大小不超过 2 MB 的 JPG 或 PNG 格式的图片。建议图片尺寸为 160*160。
Coupons.Pic.description_en:
Coupon image URL must include protocol header
Supports JPG or PNG images up to 2 MB
Recommended image size: 160 x 160

Coupons.ThirdPartyId.description_cn:
关联卡券 ID，即您自有商城系统中的卡券 ID。长度为 1 到 200 个字符。
通过该 ID，可将当前卡券绑定您商城系统中的卡券，方便后续卡券的发放以及在商城内的核销。
Coupons.ThirdPartyId.description_en:
Associated coupon ID from your own mall system. Length: 1 to 200 characters
Use this ID to link the current coupon to the one in your own mall system, making it easier to distribute and redeem coupons within your mall system

CoverImage.description_cn: 高光智剪任务的封面图片 URL，需包含协议头。
CoverImage.description_en: Cover image URL for the Highlight Smart Clip task. Must include the protocol header.

HighlightClipConfig.AspectRatio.description_cn:
导出视频的画面宽高比。取值如下：

* `16:9`：横屏
* `9:16`：竖屏
* `1:1`：方形
HighlightClipConfig.AspectRatio.description_en:
Exported video aspect ratio. Available values:

* `16:9`: Landscape
* `9:16`: Portrait
* `1:1`: Square

HighlightClipConfig.Definition.description_cn: 导出视频的清晰度。支持 `1080p` 和 `720p`。

HighlightClipConfig.DurationMax.description_cn: 单个高光片段的最大时长，单位为秒，取值不得超过原视频时长。
HighlightClipConfig.DurationMax.description_en: Maximum duration for a single highlight clip, in seconds. Value must not exceed the original video duration.

HighlightClipConfig.DurationMin.description_cn: 单个高光片段的最小时长，单位为秒，取值须大于或等于 `0`。
HighlightClipConfig.DurationMin.description_en: Minimum duration for a single highlight clip, in seconds. Value must be greater than or equal to `0`.

HighlightClipConfig.SourceEndTime.description_cn: 剪辑范围在原视频中的结束时间，单位为秒。
HighlightClipConfig.SourceEndTime.description_en: End time of the clip range in the original video, in seconds.

HighlightClipConfig.SourceStartTime.description_cn: 剪辑范围在原视频中的开始时间，单位为秒。
HighlightClipConfig.SourceStartTime.description_en: Start time of the clip range in the original video, in seconds.

Scene.description_cn:
高光智剪场景。取值如下：

* `1`：商品讲解，爆款卖点智能截取
* `2`：核心知识点汇总，梳理关键内容
* `3`：行情分析复盘，提炼合规观点
* `100`：自定义，自定义提示词剪辑视频
Scene.description_en:
Highlight Smart Clip scenario. Valid values:

* `1`: Product explanation, automatically extract key selling points
* `2`: Summary of core knowledge points, organize key content
* `3`: Market analysis review, extract compliant viewpoints
* `100`: Custom, use custom prompts to clip video

Title.description_en: Name of the Highlight Smart Clip task.

UserPrompt.description_cn:
用于指导高光内容识别和剪辑的提示词。
仅在参数 `Scene` 取值为 `100` 时，该参数生效且必填。
UserPrompt.description_en:
Prompt words used to guide highlight content recognition and clipping.
This parameter is only required and takes effect when the `Scene` parameter is set to `100`.
UserPrompt.example_cn: 过滤视频中的重复表述、长时间沉默、卡顿口误、空镜头、闲聊内容，提取整场直播全部有效核心信息，剪辑成精简高光视频。
UserPrompt.example_en: Filter out duplicate statements, long silences, stutters or slips, empty shots, and casual conversations in the video. Extract all valid core information from the entire live stream and edit it into a concise highlight video.

Vid.description_cn: 待剪辑的原视频 Vid。您可通过调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) 接口获取视频的 `Vid`。
Vid.description_en: Original video Vid to be clipped. You can obtain the video's `Vid` by calling the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) interface.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CoverImage.description_cn: 直播频道封面图。需要包含协议头。不传则为直播封面图。
CoverImage.description_en: Live channel cover image. Must include protocol prefix. If not provided, the live cover image will be used.

LineLanguage.description_cn:
频道的页面默认语言。观看页可根据观众的 PC 端浏览器语言或移动端系统语言，判断默认播放哪个频道的直播内容。例如频道 A 的语言是简中，PC 端浏览器语言为简中的观众在进入直播间时，观看页会默认播放频道 A 的直播内容。支持以下取值：默认取值为 `other`。
- `cn`：简中
- `en`：英文
- `jp`：日文
- `hant`：繁中
- `ko`：韩文
- `other`：其他
LineLanguage.description_en:
Default language for the channel page. The viewing page selects which channel's live stream to play by detecting the viewer's PC browser language or mobile device system language. For example, if Channel A uses Simplified Chinese and a viewer's PC browser language is set to Simplified Chinese, the viewing page will automatically play Channel A's live stream when the viewer enters the live room. Supported values: Default is `other`.
- `cn`: Simplified Chinese
- `en`: English
- `jp`: Japanese
- `hant`: Traditional Chinese
- `ko`: Korean
- `other`: Other

LineName.description_cn: 直播频道名称。最多支持输入 100 个字符。
LineName.description_en:
Live Channel Name
Up to 100 characters allowed

LlsType.description_cn:
是否开启超低延时功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以 1 秒以内的超低延时观看直播内容。详见[超低延时直播](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662)。
- `2`：关闭
LlsType.description_en:
Whether to enable ultra-low latency. Supported values are as follows; the default is `2`.
- `1`: Enable. Viewers in this channel can watch live content with ultra-low latency of less than 1 second. For details, see [Ultra-Low Latency Live Streaming](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662)
- `2`: Disable

MainBackupType.description_cn:
是否开启主备流功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。
- `1`：开启，则企业直播会推送该频道的两路直播流至主地址和备地址，同时优先播放主地址的直播流。当主地址的推流断流后，可自动切换至备地址，以保证直播的稳定性。
- `2`：关闭
MainBackupType.description_en:
Enable primary/backup stream feature. Supported values; default is `2`
- `1`: Enable. The enterprise live stream pushes two streams for this channel to the primary and backup addresses, prioritizing playback from the primary address. If the primary stream is interrupted, it can automatically switch to the backup address to help ensure stable streaming
- `2`: Disable

MobileDefaultResolution.description_cn:
移动端观看页的智能清晰度。移动端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值，如未进行特殊配置，默认取值为 `sd`。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
MobileDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart Clarity for Mobile Viewing Page
When viewers enter a live stream on mobile, content will play in smart clarity by default. The following options are supported; if no special configuration is set, the default value is `sd`.
- `origin`: Original picture
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

PCDefaultResolution.description_cn:
PC 端观看页的智能清晰度。PC 端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值，如未进行特殊配置，默认取值为 `hd`。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
PCDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart resolution for PC viewing page. When PC viewers enter the livestream room, the stream plays in smart resolution by default. The following options are supported; if no special configuration is set, the default value is `hd`.
- `origin`: original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

Resolution.description_cn:
频道的可选清晰度。观众仅可在您选择的范围内切换清晰度。清晰度越高，对网络环境要求越高。支持以下取值，默认选择 `auto` 且不支持删除。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
- `auto`：智能
Resolution.description_en:
Selectable channel resolutions. Viewers can only switch between the resolutions you choose. Higher resolutions require better network conditions. The following options are supported; the default is `auto` and it cannot be removed.
- `origin`: Original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD
- `auto`: Auto

TimeShiftType.description_cn:
是否开启直播时移功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以拖动进度条跳转至 8 小时内任意过去时间点观看直播内容。详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
- `2`：关闭
开启多商品讲解功能期间，无法开启直播时移功能。
TimeShiftType.description_en:
Whether to enable live time-shift. Supported values (default: `2`):
- `1`: Enable. Viewers of this channel can drag the progress bar to jump to any point within the past 8 hours to watch live content. See [Live Time-Shift](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810) for details.
- `2`: Disable
Live time-shift cannot be enabled while multi-product explanation is active.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-Account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EmojiSet.description_cn:
自定义表情专辑的配置信息列表。
最多支持配置 10 个自定义表情专辑。
EmojiSet.description_en:
Custom emoji album configuration list
You can configure up to 10 custom emoji albums

EmojiSet.EmojiSetIcon.description_cn:
表情专辑聊天页图标的链接，需包含协议头。聊天页图标是指展示在聊天互动菜单表情列表的图标。支持配置大小不超过 100 KB、尺寸为 50\*50 的 PNG 格式的图片。
新增自定义表情专辑时，该参数必传。
EmojiSet.EmojiSetIcon.description_en:
The link to the chat page icon for the emoji album must include the protocol header. The chat page icon refers to the icon displayed in the emoji list of the chat interaction menu. You can configure PNG images up to 100 KB and 50×50 pixels.
This parameter is required when adding a custom emoji album.

EmojiSet.EmojiSetId.description_cn:
自定义表情专辑 ID。
- 新增自定义表情专辑：不传该参数或传入该参数且取值为 `0`。
- 更新自定义表情专辑信息：传入待更新信息的自定义表情专辑 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityCustomEmojiSets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222878) 接口查询 ID。
EmojiSet.EmojiSetId.description_en:
Custom emoji album ID
- To add a custom emoji album: Do not pass this parameter, or pass this parameter with a value of `0`
- To update a custom emoji album: Pass the ID of the album you want to update. You can find the ID using the [ListActivityCustomEmojiSets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222878) API

EmojiSet.EmojiSetName.description_cn:
表情专辑名称。最多支持输入 50 个字符。
新增自定义表情专辑时，该参数必传。
EmojiSet.EmojiSetName.description_en:
Emoji album name
You can enter up to 50 characters
This field is required when creating a custom emoji album

EmojiSet.EmojiSetType.description_cn:
表情专辑中表情图片的尺寸类型。支持以下取值：
- `1`：60\*60
- `2`：240\*240
- 新增自定义表情专辑时，该参数必传。
- 更新自定义表情专辑信息时，不支持更新该参数。
EmojiSet.EmojiSetType.description_en:
Image size type for emoji images in an emoji album. Supported values:
- `1`: 60×60
- `2`: 240×240
- This parameter is required when adding a custom emoji album
- You cannot update this parameter when updating the information of a custom emoji album

EmojiSet.Emojis.description_cn:
表情专辑中表情图片的配置信息列表。
- 新增自定义表情专辑时，该参数必传。
- 每个表情专辑最多支持配置 120 张表情图片。
- 更新自定义表情专辑信息时，需传入该专辑的所有表情图片。
EmojiSet.Emojis.description_en:
List of configuration information for emoji images in the emoji album
- This parameter is required when adding a custom emoji album
- Each emoji album supports configuring up to 120 emoji images
- When updating custom emoji album information, you must provide all emoji images in the album

EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiId.description_cn:
表情图片 ID。
- 新增表情图片：不传该参数或传入该参数且取值为 `0`。
- 更新表情图片：传入待更新的表情图片 ID。
- 删除表情图片：不传已有表情图片的 ID。
为避免当前自定义表情专辑中已有表情图片被误删，您必须将不需要删除和更新的表情图片 ID 及其配置信息作为请求参数传入该接口。您可以通过 [GetActivityCustomEmojiSetDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222892) 接口，通过返回参数 `Emojis` 获取当前表情专辑中的所有表情图片信息。
EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiId.description_en:
Emoji image ID
- To add a new emoji image: leave this parameter empty or set it to `0`
- To update an emoji image: enter the ID of the emoji image you want to update
- To delete an emoji image: do not include the ID of the existing emoji image
To prevent accidental deletion of emoji images in your current custom emoji set, you must include the IDs and configuration details of all emoji images you do not want to delete or update as request parameters. You can use the [GetActivityCustomEmojiSetDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222892) API to retrieve all emoji image information in the current emoji set from the `Emojis` response parameter.

EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiImage.description_cn:
表情图片的链接，需包含协议头。支持配置大小不超过 500 KB 的 JPG、PNG 和 GIF 格式的图片。尺寸大小具体要求如下：
- 当 `EmojiSetType` 取值为 `1` 时，尺寸为 60*60。
- 当 `EmojiSetType` 取值为 `2` 时，尺寸为 240*240。
EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiImage.description_en:
The emoji image link must include the protocol header. You can configure JPG, PNG, and GIF images up to 500 KB. Size requirements are as follows:
- When `EmojiSetType` is 1, size must be 60×60
- When `EmojiSetType` is 2, size must be 240×240

EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiLocation.description_cn: 表情图片在表情专辑中的排序号。该参数取值为从 `1` 开始的连续且不重复的整数，如 `1`、`2`、`3`。取值范围为 [1,120]，取值越小，在主持人和观众看到的界面中位置越靠前。
EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiLocation.description_en: The sort order of the emoji image in the emoji album. This parameter must be a consecutive, non-repeating integer starting from `1`, such as `1`, `2`, `3`. Valid values are [1,120]. Lower values appear closer to the front in the interface seen by hosts and viewers.

EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiName.description_cn:
表情图片的含义词。最多支持输入 50 个字符。
- 不支持配置冒号（:）。
- 同一专辑中不同表情图片的含义词不能重复。
EmojiSet.Emojis.EmojiName.description_en:
Meaning word for emoji image. Up to 50 characters allowed.
- Colons (:) are not supported
- Meaning words for different emoji images in the same album must be unique

Name.description_cn:
子账号的账号，是子账号的唯一标识。长度为 1 到 64 个字符。支持以下字符： - 大写字母 A - Z - 小写字母 a - z - 数字 - 下划线（_）、短横线（-）、句点（.）、@ 和加号（+） 仅手机号支持加号（+）。 参数值根据 `Type` 取值的不同而不同。
- 当 `Type` 取值为 `1` 时，参数值为邮箱，且必须符合邮箱的格式：`user@example.com`。 - 当 `Type` 取值为 `2` 时，参数值为手机号。目前仅支持中国内地手机号，因此参数值必须以 +86 开头。 - 当 `Type` 取值为 `3` 时，参数值为使用您飞书应用的用户的 `union_id`。`union_id` 是用户在同一应用服务商所开发的多个应用下的身份标识。详见[飞书官方文档](https://open.feishu.cn/document/server-docs/contact-v3/user/field-overview)。 您必须提供您的飞书租户信息以及应用信息，完成相关申请，才可以获取用户的 `union_id`。 - 当 `Type` 取值为 `6` 时，参数值为火山引擎 IAM 用户的用户名。您必须先在火山引擎的**访问控制**页面，或调用 [CreateUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65004) 接口创建 IAM 用户。
Name.description_en:
The sub-account username is the unique identifier for the sub-account. Length must be between 1 and 64 characters. The following characters are supported: - Uppercase letters A–Z - Lowercase letters a–z - Numbers - Underscore (_), hyphen (-), period (.), @, and plus sign (+) Only phone numbers support the plus sign (+). The parameter value varies depending on the value of `Type`.
- If `Type` is `1`, the parameter value must be an email address in the format: `user@example.com`. - If `Type` is `2`, the parameter value must be a phone number. Only mainland China phone numbers are supported, so the value must start with +86. - If `Type` is `3`, the parameter value must be the `union_id` of a user in your Feishu app. The `union_id` is the user's identifier across multiple apps developed by the same service provider. See the [Feishu official documentation](https://open.feishu.cn/document/server-docs/contact-v3/user/field-overview) for details. You must provide your Feishu tenant and app information and complete the required application process to obtain a user's `union_id`. - If `Type` is `6`, the parameter value must be the username of a Volcengine IAM user. You must first create an IAM user on the Volcengine **Access Control** page or by calling the [CreateUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65004) API.

NickName.description_cn:
子账号的昵称。长度为 1 到 16 个字符。支持以下字符：
- 大写字母 A - Z
- 小写字母 a - z
- 数字
- 中文
当 `Type` 取值为 `6` 时，如果该参数取值与 IAM 用户的显示名不同，则子账号创建后，会同步更新 IAM 用户的显示名。
NickName.description_en:
Nickname for the sub-account. Must be 1 to 16 characters long. Supports the following characters:
- Uppercase letters A–Z
- Lowercase letters a–z
- Numbers
- Chinese characters
When `Type` is set to `6`, if this value is different from the IAM user's display name, the IAM user's display name will be updated to match after the sub-account is created.

OrganizationId.description_cn: 子账号所属组织的 ID。默认子账号不属于任何组织。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccountOrganizations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377763) 接口获取 ID。
OrganizationId.description_en: Organization ID for the sub-account. By default, sub-accounts do not belong to any organization. You can get the ID by calling the [ListSubAccountOrganizations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377763) API.

RoleIds.description_cn:
子账号所属角色的 ID。不传该参数，则默认设置为**默认子账号**角色。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) 接口获取 ID。
当 `Type` 取值为 `3` 时，如果未设置**默认子账号**角色，则在创建子账号时，会自动添加**默认子账号**角色。
每个子账号最多可被赋予 100 个角色。
RoleIds.description_en:
Role ID for the sub-account. If you do not provide this parameter, the **Default Sub-Account** role is assigned by default. You can get the ID by calling the [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) API.
When `Type` is set to `3`, if the **Default Sub-Account** role is not assigned, it will be automatically added when creating the sub-account.
Each sub-account can be assigned up to 100 roles

Type.description_cn:
子账号的类型。取值如下：
- `1`：邮箱
- `2`：手机号
- `3`：飞书成员
- `6`：自定义

当取值为 `1`、`2` 或 `3` 时，子账号创建后，会同步创建 IAM 用户。
Type.description_en:
Sub-account type. Possible values:
- `1`: Email
- `2`: Phone number
- `3`: Feishu member
- `6`: Custom

When the value is `1`, `2`, or `3`, an IAM user is created synchronously after the sub-account is created.

AwardUserInfoList.description_cn:
用户信息列表。
企业直播按照以下优先级顺序匹配名单中的观众：`UserId`（用户 ID）、`UserTel`（手机号）、`UserName`（用户昵称）。例如配置了 `UserId`，则无论是否能匹配到观众，均不再按 `UserTel` 或 `UserName` 进行匹配。因此，选择其中之一配置即可。
AwardUserInfoList.description_en:
User information list
Enterprise live streaming matches audience members from the list in the following priority order: `UserId` (user ID), `UserTel` (phone number), `UserName` (nickname). For example, if you configure `UserId`, the system will not match by `UserTel` or `UserName`, regardless of whether a match can be found. You only need to configure one of these fields.

AwardUserInfoList.UserId.description_cn: 用户 ID。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。

AwardUserInfoList.UserName.description_cn:
昵称。长度为 1 到 60 个字符。
- 如果在优先中奖名单中仅配置了昵称，且该昵称在当前直播间的观众中并非唯一，则会从昵称相同的观众中随机抽奖。
- 如果在中奖黑名单中仅配置了昵称，且该昵称在当前直播间的观众中并非唯一，则昵称相同的所有观众均无法中奖。
AwardUserInfoList.UserName.description_en:
Nickname. Length: 1 to 60 characters.
- If only a nickname is set in the priority winner list and that nickname is not unique among viewers in the current live stream, a winner will be randomly selected from viewers with the same nickname.
- If only a nickname is set in the winner blacklist and that nickname is not unique among viewers in the current live stream, all viewers with that nickname cannot win a prize.

AwardUserInfoList.UserTel.description_cn:
手机号。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
如果是海外地区或中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾地区的手机号，请按照以下格式：“+” + 国际电话区号 + 手机号，例如 +1XXXXXXXXXX 为北美手机号。
AwardUserInfoList.UserTel.description_en:
Mobile number. Length: 1 to 20 characters.
If the mobile number is from an overseas region or from China Hong Kong, China Macau, or China Taiwan, use the following format: “+” followed by the international dialing code and the mobile number. For example, +1XXXXXXXXXX is a North American mobile number.

`LineId` 和 `LineIndex` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`LineId` 的优先级更高。
LineIndex.description_en:

At least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex` must be provided. If both are provided, `LineId` takes priority.

- `1`：删除所有手机号

Options:
- `0`: Delete some phone numbers
- `1`: Delete all phone numbers

DeletePhoneList.description_cn:

- 海外地区和中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾地区的手机号请遵循以下格式：“+” + 国际电话区号 + 手机号，例如 +1XXXXXXXXXX 表示北美手机号。
DeletePhoneList.description_en:
List of phone numbers to delete.
- This parameter is only effective when `DeleteAll` is set to 0.
- For phone numbers from overseas regions, China Hong Kong, China Macau, and China Taiwan, use the following format: “+” followed by the international country code and phone number. For example, +1XXXXXXXXXX represents a North American phone number.

VideoRoomId.description_en: The ID of the video room. You can call the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) API to obtain the ID.

LevelIds.description_cn: 需要删除的等级 ID 的集合。可通过 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口获取等级 ID。删除后剩余等级维持原有顺序，序号从 1 开始递增。
LevelIds.description_en: Set of level IDs to delete. You can obtain level IDs using the [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) API. After deletion, the remaining levels keep their original order, and sequence numbers start from 1 and increase sequentially.

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号拥有对等级库的可编辑权限。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容，您也可通过不传或将该参数设置为 `0` 来指定默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer level library ID. You can obtain it via the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the level library. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can also omit this parameter or set it to `0` to use the default level library (includes 3 default level configurations).

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号对指定等级库有编辑权限。您可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口判断子账号是否可编辑指定等级库。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 不支持删除系统默认等级库。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Audience Level Library ID. You can obtain it using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the specified level library. You can check whether the sub-account can edit the specified level library using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* Deleting the system default level library is not supported.

DeleteAll.description_cn:
是否删除名单中的全部用户信息。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：根据 `DeleteUserList` 删除指定用户信息
- `1`：删除全部用户信息
如果不传 `DeleteUserList`，该参数必须取值为 `1`。
DeleteAll.description_en:
Whether to delete all user information in the list. Default value is `0`. Available values:
- `0`: Delete specified user information based on `DeleteUserList`
- `1`: Delete all user information
If `DeleteUserList` is not provided, this parameter must be set to `1`.

DeleteUserList.description_cn:
名单中待删除的用户信息。单次接口调用最多支持删除 2100 条用户信息。
您必须先调用 [GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471379) 获取用户信息，再将待删除的用户信息传入该接口。请确保传入的用户信息与 `GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo` 接口返回的用户信息一致。
当 `DeleteAll` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
DeleteUserList.description_en:
User information to be deleted from the list. You can delete up to 2,100 user records per API call.
You must first call [GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471379) to retrieve user information, then pass the user information to be deleted to this API. Make sure the user information you provide matches the data returned by the `GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo` API.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `DeleteAll` is set to `0`.

Id.description_cn: 优先中奖名单 ID 或中奖黑名单 ID。您可调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口，通过返回参数的 `VipUserInfoId` 或 `BlackUserInfoId` 获取 ID。
Id.description_en: Priority winner list ID or winner blacklist ID. You can call the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API and obtain the ID from the response parameters VipUserInfoId or BlackUserInfoId.

VodPlayerConfigId.description_cn: 点播播放器 ID。您可以通过 [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) 接口查询 ID。
VodPlayerConfigId.description_en: VOD player ID. You can query the ID using the [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) API

Domain.description_cn: 待删除的 Web SDK 域名配置，即域名 URL，不包含协议头。例如 `www.example.com` 或泛域名  `*.example.com`。
Domain.description_en: Web SDK domain configuration pending deletion, i.e., domain URL without the protocol header, such as `www.example.com` or wildcard domain `*.example.com`

ActivityId.description_cn:

DeleteAll.description_cn:
是否删除所有的观众白名单。取值如下：

- `1`：删除所有白名单

Do you want to delete all audience whitelist entries?
Values:
- `0`: Delete some audience whitelist entries only
- `1`: Delete all audience whitelist entries

DeleteUserList.description_cn:
待删除的白名单信息列表。白名单信息即观众的邮箱、手机号等信息，长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
该参数仅在 `DeleteAll` 取值为 `0` 时生效。
DeleteUserList.description_en:
List of whitelist entries to delete. Whitelist entries include viewer email addresses, phone numbers, and similar information, with a length of 1 to 100 characters
This parameter is only effective when `DeleteAll` is set to 0

PermissionOrder.description_cn:

PermissionOrder.description_en:
Primary and secondary viewing restriction type. Values:
 - `1`: Remove audience whitelist from primary viewing restriction
 - `2`: Remove audience whitelist from secondary viewing restriction

ActivityID.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityID.description_en:
Live room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055).
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the visibility range for sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

RedPacketID.description_cn:
红包 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 或 [CreateActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1468057) 接口获取 ID。
红包开奖时，请确保：

* 红包为已发送状态。即调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 接口获取红包 ID 时，`RedPacketStatus` 的取值为 `1`。
* 红包的开奖方式为手动开奖，即调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 接口获取红包 ID 时，`OpenRedPacketType` 的取值为 `1`。
RedPacketID.description_en:
Red packet ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) or [CreateActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1468057) APIs.
When drawing a red packet, make sure that:

* The red packet has been sent. That is, when you call [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) to get the red packet ID, the value of `RedPacketStatus` is `1`.
* The red packet draw method is set to manual. That is, when you call [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) to get the red packet ID, the value of `OpenRedPacketType` is `1`.

Comment.Content.description_cn: 评论内容。长度为 1 到 200 个字符。
Comment.Content.description_en: Comment content. Length must be between 1 and 200 characters

Comment.Id.description_cn: 评论 ID。您可通过调用 [ListInteractionScriptComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413347) 接口获取 ID。
Comment.Id.description_en:
Comment ID
You can get the ID by calling the [ListInteractionScriptComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413347) API

Comment.Nickname.description_cn:
用户昵称。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
当 `Role` 取值为 `2` 时，字符长度无限制，但建议不传该参数，从而确保发送评论的主持人昵称与直播间的主持人昵称一致。
Comment.Nickname.description_en:
User nickname. Must be 1 to 20 characters long.
When `Role` is set to `2`, there is no character limit. However, we recommend not passing this parameter to ensure the host nickname used to send comments matches the host nickname in the live room.

Comment.Role.description_cn:
发送评论的用户身份。取值如下：
* `1`：观众
* `2`：主持人
* `3`：助教
Comment.Role.description_en:
User role when posting a comment. Possible values:
* `1`: Audience
* `2`: Host
* `3`: Assistant

InteractionScriptId.description_cn:

InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interactive Script ID. How to obtain:

* To get the Interactive Script ID for videos in the video library or temporarily stored live videos, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) API.

FloatingStatus.description_cn:

- `2`：非浮窗展示

DataType.description_cn:
直播间数据类型。目前仅支持取值 `1`，即直播间的以下基础数据。
- 页面访问数据：访问人次、访问人数、访问人数峰值、累计访问时长、人均访问时长、人均访问次数
- 播放器观看数据：预告、直播、回放和总观看的观看人次、观看人数、观看人数峰值、累计观看时长、人均观看时长和人均观看次数
DataType.description_en:
Live room data type. Currently, only the value `1` is supported, which provides the following basic live room metrics:
- Page visit data: total visits, unique visitors, peak visitor count, total visit duration, average visit duration per user, average visits per user
- Player viewing data: For each of preview, live, replay, and overall viewing, the following metrics are provided: total views, unique viewers, peak viewer count, total viewing duration, average viewing duration per user, and average views per user

EndTime.description_cn:
切片的结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。结束时间取值需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于 `StartTime` 的取值，且与 `StartTime` 的差值最大为 86,400，即 24 小时。
- 小于等于当前时间。
EndTime.description_en:
End time of the slice. Unix timestamp in seconds. The end time must meet all of the following conditions:
- Greater than the value of `StartTime`, and the difference from `StartTime` must not exceed 86,400 seconds (24 hours)
- Less than or equal to the current time

IsBackup.description_cn:
是否为备流，默认为主流。支持以下取值。有关如何开启主备流功能，详见[直播频道管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66779)。
- `ture`：是
- `false`：否
IsBackup.description_en:
Is this a backup stream? The default is main stream. Supported values are as follows. For details on enabling the main/backup stream feature, see [Live Channel Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66779).
- `ture`: Yes
- `false`: No

LineId.description_cn: 直播频道 ID。您可以通过 [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) 接口查询 ID。
LineId.description_en: Live Channel ID. You can query the ID using the [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) API.

StartTime.description_cn:
切片的开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。开始时间取值需同时满足以下条件：

- 大于等于`当前时间 - 1,209,600`，即当前时间 14 天及之前的某个时间点。
- 小于 `EndTime` 的取值，且与 `EndTime` 的差值最大为 86,400，即 24 小时。
StartTime.description_en:
Start time of the slice. Unix timestamp in seconds. The start time must meet both of the following conditions:

- Greater than or equal to `current time - 1,209,600`, which means any time within the past 14 days
- Less than `EndTime`, and the difference between start time and `EndTime` must not exceed 86,400 seconds (24 hours)

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID 或点播间 ID。获取方式如下：

* 您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) 接口获取直播间 ID
* 您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取点播间 ID

使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间或点播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live streaming room ID or video-on-demand room ID. You can obtain it as follows:

* Call the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) to get the live streaming room ID
* Call the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) to get the video-on-demand room ID

When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live streaming room or video-on-demand room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility range of sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Vid.description_cn:
直播间或点播间中的视频 `Vid`。获取方式如下：

* 要获取直播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) 接口获取视频的 `Vid` 和视频关联的直播间信息
* 要获取点播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) 接口获取指定点播间视频的 `Vid`
Vid.description_en:
Video `Vid` in a live streaming room or video-on-demand room. You can obtain it as follows:

* To get the video `Vid` in a live streaming room, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) to obtain the video's `Vid` and the associated live streaming room information
* To get the video `Vid` in a video-on-demand room, call the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) to obtain the `Vid` of the specified video-on-demand room video

TimeRange.description_en:
View statistics for a specified time range
- `7day`: Last 7 days

ExternalId.description_cn:
关联用户 ID，即观众在第三方平台的唯一标识。
观众通过不同方式登录直播间，关联用户 ID 的取值如下所示。

* 微信：观众在企业直播微信服务号的 OpenID。
* 企业微信：绑定企业直播的企业内部成员 OpenID。
* 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
* OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
* 飞书：绑定企业直播的飞书企业成员 Open ID。
* 手机号：观众通过手机号注册企业直播后生成的 passport_id。
* 白名单：观众输入的白名单校验信息。

* 如果您集成了观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式，关联用户 ID 的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时、或调用 [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153) 后生成 JWT 时，传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
* 至少传入 `UserId` 和 `ExternalId` 其中之一。如果同时传入，则 `UserId` 优先级更高。
ExternalId.description_en:
Associated User ID is the unique identifier for a viewer on a third-party platform.
Viewers can log in to the livestream room in different ways. The value of the associated user ID is as follows:

* WeChat: The viewer's OpenID for the enterprise livestream WeChat service account
* WeCom: The OpenID of an internal member bound to the enterprise livestream
* Custom: The value passed in via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)
* OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system
* Feishu: The Open ID of a Feishu enterprise member bound to the enterprise livestream
* Mobile Number: The passport_id generated after the viewer registers for enterprise livestream with a mobile number
* Allowlist: The allowlist verification information entered by the viewer

* If you have integrated the Audience SDK and the SDK authentication mode is set to custom, the value of the associated user ID is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed in when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) interface or when generating a JWT after calling [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153)
* You must provide at least one of `UserId` or `ExternalId`. If both are provided, `UserId` takes precedence

PageItemCount.description_cn: 使用分页查询时，分页查询数量，取值范围为 [1,2000]，默认值为 `1000`。当取值大于 2000 时，默认只返回 2000 条足迹数据。
PageItemCount.description_en: When using pagination query, the number of items per page. The value range is [1,2000], and the default value is `1000`. If the value is greater than 2000, only 2000 footprint records will be returned by default

PageNo.description_cn:
使用分页查询时，分页查询的页码，默认值为 `1`。
接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount`≤ 10,000。
PageNo.description_en:
When using pagination query, the page number for pagination. The default value is `1`
The API supports up to 10,000 query results, that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000

ScrollId.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。如需使用滚动查询方式，查询方式如下：
首次调用接口查询数据时，该参数传`空值`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `ScrollId` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `ScrollId` 的值，依次类推。
* 当返回参数中的 `UserTrackData` 参数为空时，表示已查询到最后一页。
* 返回参数中 `ScrollId` 值的失效时间为 20 分钟，即超过 20 分钟该 `ScrollId` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
* 滚动查询方式的优先级更高，即当传入`ScrollId` 参数时，`PageNo` 参数将不再生效。
ScrollId.description_en:
Scroll query ID. The scroll query method is suitable for scenarios where you need to query more than 10,000 records. To use the scroll query method, follow these steps:
When you call the API for the first time, set this parameter to `null`. For the second call, set this parameter to the `ScrollId` value returned from the first query. For the third call, set this parameter to the `ScrollId` value returned from the second query, and so on.
* If the `UserTrackData` parameter in the response is empty, it means you have reached the last page
* The `ScrollId` value in the response expires after 20 minutes. If more than 20 minutes pass, the `ScrollId` value becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query
* The scroll query method has higher priority. When the `ScrollId` parameter is provided, the `PageNo` parameter will no longer take effect

UserId.description_cn:

UserId.description_en:

当观看限制为自定义时，建议同时传入 `ExternalId` 和 `WatchType`以便更准确地定位到具体观众。
WatchType.description_en:
Custom viewing restriction login account app refers to the name of your own account system. You can call the [GetViewingRestrictionInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1333841) API and use the `CustomApp` parameter to get the login account app.
When the viewing restriction is set to custom, we recommend providing both `ExternalId` and `WatchType` to more accurately identify the specific viewer.

Channel.description_en: Filter by channel identifier. By default, all channel data is queried. You can use the [ListChannelAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/166063) to query channel identifiers.

PageAdvertiseTypes.description_cn:
营销推广类型。支持以下取值，默认查询所有类型。
- `1`：页头广告
- `2`：页中广告
- `3`：浮标广告
- `4`：商品卡片
- `5`：商品列表（即商品卡片菜单）

支持同时查询多种类型，类型之间通过英文逗号隔开。例如同时查询页头广告和页中广告，则取值为 `1,2`。
PageAdvertiseTypes.description_en:
Marketing promotion type. Supports the following values: all types are queried by default.
- `1`: header ad
- `2`: mid-page ad
- `3`: floating icon ad
- `4`: product card
- `5`: product list (product card menu)

You can query multiple types at once by separating values with commas. For example, to query both header and mid-page ads, use `1,2`.

PageNumber.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认取值为 `1`。
- 使用滚动查询时，不需要传入该参数。
- 未使用滚动查询时，接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNumber`×`PageSize`≤10,000。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries, defaults to `1`
- You do not need to provide this parameter when using scroll queries
- If not using scroll queries, the API can return up to 10,000 results (`PageNumber` × `PageSize` ≤ 10,000)

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量。取值范围为 [1,1000]，默认取值为 `10`。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page. Range: [1,1000], default: `10`

PageToken.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。
使用滚动查询方式时，首次调用接口查询数据时将该参数值设置为 `init`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，依次类推。当查询到最后分页，没有更多数据时，返回 `finish`。
- 返回参数中 `PageToken` 值的失效时间为 3 分钟，即超过 3 分钟该 `PageToken` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
- 滚动查询过程中，请勿变更除 `PageSize` 参数外的查询条件，否则会导致接口查询失败。如需变更滚动查询条件，则需重新进行滚动查询。
PageToken.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll query for scenarios where you need to retrieve more than 10,000 records.
When using scroll query, set this parameter to `init` for the first API call. For the second call, set it to the `PageToken` value returned from the first query. For the third call, use the `PageToken` from the second query, and so on. When you reach the last page and there is no more data, the response returns `finish`.
- The `PageToken` in the response expires after 3 minutes. If you wait longer than 3 minutes, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
- During scroll queries, do not change any query conditions except for the `PageSize` parameter. Changing other conditions will cause the query to fail. If you need to modify the scroll query conditions, start a new scroll query.

SortField.description_cn: 排序维度。取值固定为 `ClickTime`，即观众点击广告或商品卡片等的时间。
SortField.description_en: Sorting Dimension. Value is fixed as `ClickTime`, which is the time when a viewer clicks an ad, product card, or similar item

SortMode.description_cn:
排序模式。默认取值为 `desc`。

- `asc`：升序
- `desc`：降序
SortMode.description_en:
Sort mode. Default value: `desc`

- `asc`: Ascending
- `desc`: Descending

ExternalId.description_cn:
分享人的关联用户 ID，即在第三方平台的唯一标识。
您可以根据该 ID 识别企业自身的用户身份，以便于按需实现用户洞察和进行数据分析。
该参数的取值与分享人自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值一致。有关 `UserId` 的详细信息，详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
您必须传入该参数或该接口的 `UserId` 参数。如果同时传入两者，则仅 `UserId` 生效。
ExternalId.description_en:
The associated user ID of the sharer serves as a unique identifier on third-party platforms. You can use this ID to identify your enterprise's users, so you can gain user insights and perform data analysis as needed. This parameter matches the value passed through `UserId` during the sharer's custom login. For details about `UserId`, see [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578).
You must provide either this parameter or the `UserId` parameter for this API. If both are provided, only `UserId` will take effect.

UserId.description_cn:
