您必须传入该参数或 `ExternalId` 参数。如果同时传入两者，则仅 `UserId` 生效。
UserId.description_en:
User ID, the unique identifier for the user who shares in enterprise live broadcast.
You must provide either this parameter or the `ExternalId` parameter. If you provide both, only `UserId` will be used.

UnionId.description_cn: 飞书子账号。您可在[企业直播控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/)的**账户中心** > **权限管理** > **用户管理**页面，获取子账号。
UnionId.description_en: Feishu sub-account. You can obtain a sub-account on the [Enterprise Live Streaming Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) by navigating to Account Center > Permission Management > User Management.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityCreator.description_cn:
创建直播间的账号。
- 本参数和 `ActivityIds` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，则 `ActivityIds` 参数的优先级更高，即仅查询 `ActivityIds` 字段中直播间的连麦时长使用情况。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，如果未传入 `ActivityIds`，则默认查询该子账号创建的所有直播间的连麦时长使用情况，该参数不生效。
ActivityCreator.description_en:
Account that created the live streaming room.
- You must provide at least one of these parameters: this parameter or `ActivityIds`. If both are provided, the `ActivityIds` parameter takes precedence; only the connection duration usage for live streaming rooms specified in the `ActivityIds` field will be queried.
- When calling the API with a sub-account, if `ActivityIds` is not provided, the query will default to all live streaming rooms created by the sub-account, and this parameter will not take effect.

ActivityCreator.IsMainAccount.description_cn:
是否为主账号，即是否查询主账号创建的所有直播间的连麦时长使用情况。取值如下：
- `true`：是
- `false`：否。您必须传入 `SubAccountName`，查询指定子账号创建的所有直播间的连麦时长使用情况。
仅在使用主账号调用接口时，该参数生效。
ActivityCreator.IsMainAccount.description_en:
Indicates whether this is the main account (i.e., whether to query the linked mic duration usage for all live rooms created by the main account). Possible values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No. You must provide `SubAccountName` to query the linked mic duration usage for all live rooms created by the specified sub-account.
This parameter is only effective when the API is called using the main account.

ActivityCreator.SubAccountName.description_cn:
子账号的账号，即查询该子账号创建的所有直播间的连麦时长使用情况。您可调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，通过参数 `Name` 获取子账号的账号。
仅在使用主账号调用接口，且 `IsMainAccount` 取值为 `false` 时，该参数必选且生效。
ActivityCreator.SubAccountName.description_en:
Sub-account account. Use this to query the connection duration usage for all live rooms created by the sub-account. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API and use the Name parameter to obtain the sub-account account.
This parameter is required and takes effect only when you call the API with the main account and set IsMainAccount to false.

ActivityIds.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
- 最多支持同时查询 100 个直播间。
- 本参数和 `ActivityCreator` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，则本参数的优先级更高，即仅查询该字段中直播间的连麦时长使用情况。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，如需传入该参数，请确保直播间对于该子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityIds.description_en:
Live room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
- You can query up to 100 live rooms at the same time.
- You must provide at least one of this parameter or the `ActivityCreator` parameter. If both are provided, this parameter takes priority, and only the co-hosting duration usage for the live rooms specified in this field will be queried.
- When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account if you need to pass this parameter. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EndDay.description_cn:
查询结束日期（UTC+8）。格式为 `yyyymmdd`。查询结束日期需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于等于 `StartDay` 的取值。
- 小于等于 `T-1`，其中 T 表示当前日期。
EndDay.description_en:
Query end date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The end date must meet both of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to the value of `StartDay`
- Less than or equal to `T-1`, where T is the current date

StartDay.description_cn:
查询开始日期（UTC+8）。格式为 `yyyymmdd`。查询开始日期需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于等于 `T-31`，其中 T 表示当前日期。
- 小于等于 `EndDay` 的取值。
StartDay.description_en:
Query start date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The start date must meet both of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `T-31`, where T is the current date
- Less than or equal to the value of `EndDay`

ActivityCreator.description_cn:
创建直播间的账号。
- 本参数和 `ActivityIds` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，则 `ActivityIds` 参数的优先级更高，即仅查询 `ActivityIds` 字段中直播间的直播流量使用情况。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，如果未传入 `ActivityIds`，则默认查询该子账号创建的所有直播间的直播流量使用情况，该参数不生效。
ActivityCreator.description_en:
Account that creates the live streaming room.
- You must provide either this parameter or the `ActivityIds` parameter. If both are provided, `ActivityIds` takes precedence, and only the live streaming usage for rooms listed in `ActivityIds` will be queried.
- When using a sub-account to call the API, if `ActivityIds` is not provided, the API will query the live streaming usage for all rooms created by the sub-account by default. This parameter will not take effect.

ActivityCreator.IsMainAccount.description_cn:
是否为主账号，即是否查询主账号创建的所有直播间的直播流量使用情况。取值如下：
- `true`：是
- `false`：否。您必须传入 `SubAccountName`，查询指定子账号创建的所有直播间的直播流量使用情况
仅在使用主账号调用接口时，该参数生效。
ActivityCreator.IsMainAccount.description_en:
Is main account. Determines whether to query live stream usage for all rooms created by the main account. Possible values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No. You must provide `SubAccountName` to query live stream usage for all rooms created by the specified sub-account
This parameter is only effective when the API is called by the main account.

ActivityCreator.SubAccountName.description_cn:
子账号的账号，即查询该子账号创建的所有直播间的直播流量使用情况。您可调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，通过参数 `Name` 获取子账号的账号。
- 使用主账号调用接口时，仅在 `IsMainAccount` 取值为 `false` 时，该参数必选且生效。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，默认查询该子账号创建的所有直播间的直播流量使用情况，该参数不生效。
ActivityCreator.SubAccountName.description_en:
Sub-account ID. Use this to query live stream usage for all rooms created by the sub-account. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API and use the `Name` parameter to get the sub-account ID.
- When using the main account to call the API, this parameter is required and takes effect only if `IsMainAccount` is set to `false`.
- When using a sub-account to call the API, the system automatically queries live stream usage for all rooms created by that sub-account. This parameter is ignored.

ActivityIds.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
- 最多支持同时查询 100 个直播间。

- 使用子账号调用接口时，如需传入该参数，请确保直播间对于该子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityIds.description_en:

For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)

- 小于等于 `T-1`，其中 T 表示当前日期。
EndDay.description_en:
Query end date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The query end date must simultaneously meet the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `StartDay`
- Less than or equal to `T-1`, where T is the current date

StartDay.description_cn:
查询开始日期（UTC+8）。格式为 `yyyymmdd`。查询开始日期需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于等于 `T-31`，其中 T 表示当前日期。
- 小于等于 `EndDay` 的取值。
StartDay.description_en:
Query start date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The query start date must meet both of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `T-31`, where T is the current date
- Less than or equal to the value of `EndDay`

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID 或点播间 ID。获取方式如下：

* 您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取点播间 ID

ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID or on-demand room ID. How to obtain:

* You can call the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) interface to obtain the live room ID
* You can call the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) interface to obtain the on-demand room ID

When using a sub-account to call the interface, ensure that the live room or on-demand room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the visibility range of sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Vid.description_cn:

* 要获取点播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) 接口获取指定点播间视频的 `Vid`
Vid.description_en:

* To get the `Vid` of a live room video, you can call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) interface to obtain the video's `Vid` and the associated live room information
* To get the `Vid` of an on-demand room video, you can call the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) interface to obtain the `Vid` of the specified on-demand room video

PriceHidden.description_cn:
是否隐藏商品售卖价格。商品价格隐藏后，观看页的商品**售卖价**将以“待开价￥???”的文案展示。取值如下：

* `0`：不隐藏价格
* `1`：隐藏价格

若商品为售罄状态，则不支持隐藏商品的售卖价格。您可调用 [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) 接口，获取商品是否为售罄状态。调用 [UpdateProductOutOfStock](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1827282) 接口，更新商品的售罄状态。
PriceHidden.description_en:

* `0`: Show price
* `1`: Hide price

If the product is sold out, hiding the product sale price is not supported. You can call the [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) API to check if the product is sold out. Call the [UpdateProductOutOfStock](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1827282) API to update the sold out status.

For example, when `ActivityName` is set to `直播间 A`, the returned list includes live rooms with names such as `直播间 ABC`, `直播间 a`, and `企业直播间 ab` that contain the keyword `直播间 A`.

EndLiveTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
`EndLiveTime` 取值需大于等于 `StartLiveTime`，且与 `StartLiveTime` 的差值最大为 15,552,000，即 180 天。
EndLiveTime.description_en: Query end time. Use a Unix timestamp in seconds. `EndLiveTime` must be greater than or equal to `StartLiveTime`, and the difference between `EndLiveTime` and `StartLiveTime` must not exceed 15,552,000 seconds (180 days).

PageNumber.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认取值为 `1`。
- 使用滚动查询时，不需要传入该参数。
- 未使用滚动查询时，接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNumber`×`PageSize`≤10,000。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries; default value is `1`
- You do not need to provide this parameter when using scroll queries
- If you are not using scroll queries, the API supports up to 10,000 results in total per request, that is, `PageNumber` × `PageSize` ≤ 10,000

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量，取值范围为 [1,1000]，默认取值为 `20`。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page, range: [1,1000], default: `20`

PageToken.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。
使用滚动查询方式时，首次调用接口查询数据时将该参数值设置为 `init`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，依次类推。当查询到最后分页，没有更多数据时，返回 `finish`。
- 返回参数中 `PageToken` 值的失效时间为 3 分钟，即超过 3 分钟该 `PageToken` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
- 滚动查询过程中，请勿变更除 `PageSize` 参数外的查询条件，否则会导致接口查询失败。如需变更滚动查询条件，则需重新进行滚动查询。
PageToken.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll query for scenarios where you need to retrieve more than 10,000 records.
When using scroll query, set this parameter to `init` for the first API call. For the second call, set it to the `PageToken` value returned from the first query. For the third call, use the `PageToken` from the second query, and so on. When you reach the final page and there is no more data, the response returns `finish`.
- The `PageToken` in the response expires after 3 minutes. If you wait longer than 3 minutes, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
- During scroll queries, do not change any query conditions except for the `PageSize` parameter. Changing other conditions will cause the query to fail. If you need to modify the scroll query conditions, start a new scroll query.

`StartLiveTime` 取值需小于等于 `EndLiveTime`，且与 `EndLiveTime` 的差值最大为 15,552,000，即 180 天。
StartLiveTime.description_en:

`StartLiveTime` must be less than or equal to `EndLiveTime`, and the difference between `StartLiveTime` and `EndLiveTime` cannot exceed 15,552,000 seconds (180 days)

BanStatus.description_cn:
根据观众的封禁状态进行筛选。已封禁的观众无法进入当前主账号及其子账号的任一直播间。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：查询所有观众
* `1`：查询已封禁的观众
* `2`：查询未封禁的观众
BanStatus.description_en:
Filter viewers by ban status. Banned viewers cannot enter any live room under the current main account or its sub-accounts. The default value is `0`. Available options:

* `0`: All viewers
* `1`: Banned viewers
* `2`: Unbanned viewers

KeyWord.description_cn: 根据观众昵称或手机号进行筛选。观众昵称支持模糊搜索。最多支持输入 1,000 个字符。
KeyWord.description_en: Filter by viewer nickname or phone number. Viewer nickname supports fuzzy search. Supports up to 1,000 characters

PageNumber.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认值为 `1`。

* 使用滚动查询时，不需要传入该参数。
* 未使用滚动查询时，接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNumber`×`PageSize`≤10,000。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries; default value is `1`

* This parameter is not required when using scroll queries
* When not using scroll queries, the API supports returning up to 10,000 results (`PageNumber` × `PageSize` ≤ 10,000)

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量，取值范围为 [1,1000]，默认值为 `20`。
PageSize.description_en: The number of items per page can be set from 1 to 1000. The default value is `20`.

PageToken.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。
使用滚动查询方式时，首次调用接口查询数据时将该参数值设置为 `init`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，依次类推。当查询到最后分页，没有更多数据时，返回 `finish`。
* 返回参数中 `PageToken` 值的失效时间为 3 分钟，即超过 3 分钟该 `PageToken` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
* 滚动查询过程中，请勿变更除 `PageSize` 参数外的查询条件，否则会导致接口查询失败。如需变更滚动查询条件，则需重新进行滚动查询。
PageToken.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll queries when retrieving more than 10,000 records.

When using a scroll query, set this parameter to `init` for the first API call. For the second call, set it to the `PageToken` value returned from the first query. For the third call, use the `PageToken` from the second query, and so on. When you reach the last page and there is no more data, the response will return `finish`.

* The `PageToken` value in the response expires after 3 minutes. If more than 3 minutes pass, the `PageToken` becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
* During a scroll query, do not change any query parameters except for `PageSize`. Changing other parameters will cause the API call to fail. If you need to modify the scroll query conditions, start a new scroll query.

SearchKeyWord.description_cn:
根据观众的唯一标识或用户 ID 进行查询。唯一标识支持模糊查询。

观众通过不同方式登录直播间，其唯一标识的取值如下所示。
- 公开：观众昵称。	
- 密码：观众昵称。	
- 邀请码：观众昵称。	
- 白名单：观众登录时输入的白名单信息。	
- 飞书：飞书昵称。	
- 微信：观众昵称。	
- 企业微信：观众昵称。	
- 手机号：观众登录时输入的手机号。	
- 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578#%E5%9B%9E%E8%B0%83%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0)。	
- OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
如果您集成了 Web 观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式（即 `mode` = `2`），唯一标识的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
SearchKeyWord.description_en:
Query by viewer’s unique identifier or user ID. Fuzzy search is supported for unique identifiers.

The viewer’s unique identifier varies depending on the login method:
- Public: Viewer’s nickname
- Password: Viewer’s nickname
- Invitation code: Viewer’s nickname
- Whitelist: Whitelist information entered by the viewer during login
- Feishu: Feishu nickname
- WeChat: Viewer’s nickname
- WeCom: Viewer’s nickname
- Mobile number: Mobile number entered by the viewer during login
- Custom: Value passed via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578#%E5%9B%9E%E8%B0%83%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0)
- OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system
If you have integrated the Web Viewer SDK and set the authentication mode to custom (`mode` = `2`), the unique identifier is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) interface.

CommentId.description_cn:
评论 ID。您可以调用 [AddInteractionScriptComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413348) 接口，通过返回参数 `LatestCommentId` 获取评论 ID。
如传入该参数，则会定位到与 ID 对应的评论所在的页码，并相应地改变返回的 `PageNumber` 参数值。
传入的参数不同，返回结果中定位的页码也存在差异。规则如下所示：
1. 当传入 `CommentId` 且该 `CommentId` 存在时，则根据 `CommentId` 进行定位。
2. 当未传入 `CommentId` 或传入的 `CommentId` 不存在时，则根据 `SendTime` 进行定位。
3. 当未传入 `SendTime` 时，则根据 `PageNumber` 进行定位。
CommentId.description_en:
Comment ID. You can call the [AddInteractionScriptComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413348) API and use the `LatestCommentId` returned to get the comment ID. 
If you pass this parameter, the system locates the page containing the comment with the specified ID and updates the returned `PageNumber` value accordingly.
Different input parameters will result in different page numbers in the response. The rules are as follows:
1. If you pass `CommentId` and it exists, the system locates the page by `CommentId`.
2. If you do not pass `CommentId` or the provided `CommentId` does not exist, the system locates the page by `SendTime`.
3. If you do not pass `SendTime`, the system locates the page by `PageNumber`.

InteractionScriptId.description_cn:

* 要获取录播直播视频的互动脚本 ID，调用 [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) 接口。
InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interactive script ID. How to obtain:

* To get the interactive script ID for media library or temporarily stored live videos, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) interface.
* To get the interactive script ID for recorded live videos, call the [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) interface.

PageNumber.description_cn:
定位到的评论所在的页码。默认值为 `1`。取值大于等于 1。
传入的参数不同，返回结果中定位的页码也存在差异。规则如下所示：
1. 当传入 `CommentId` 且该 `CommentId` 存在时，则根据 `CommentId` 进行定位。
2. 当未传入 `CommentId` 或传入的 `CommentId` 不存在时，则根据 `SendTime` 进行定位。
3. 当未传入 `SendTime` 时，则根据 `PageNumber` 进行定位。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number where the comment is located. Default value is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.
The page number may vary depending on the parameters you provide. The rules are as follows:
1. If you provide `CommentId` and it exists, the page is determined by `CommentId`.
2. If you do not provide `CommentId` or it does not exist, the page is determined by `SendTime`.
3. If you do not provide `SendTime`, the page is determined by `PageNumber`.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的评论数量。默认值为 `10`。取值范围为 [1, 1000]。
PageSize.description_en: Number of comments per page. Default value: `10`. Range: [1, 1000]

SendTime.description_cn:
评论的发送时间。单位为秒。例如参数取值为 `10`，则会定位到视频播放开始后第 10 秒及之后发送的第一条评论所在的页码，并相应地改变返回的 `PageNumber` 参数值。
传入的参数不同，返回结果中定位的页码也存在差异。规则如下所示：
1. 当传入 `CommentId` 且该 `CommentId` 存在时，则根据 `CommentId` 进行定位。
2. 当未传入 `CommentId` 或传入的 `CommentId` 不存在时，则根据 `SendTime` 进行定位。
3. 当未传入 `SendTime` 时，则根据 `PageNumber` 进行定位。
SendTime.description_en:
Time when the comment was sent, measured in seconds. For example, if the parameter value is `10`, the system locates the page containing the first comment sent at or after the 10th second of video playback, and updates the `PageNumber` parameter accordingly.
The page number returned depends on the input parameters. The rules are as follows:
1. If `CommentId` is provided and exists, the system locates the page by `CommentId`.
2. If `CommentId` is not provided or does not exist, the system locates the page by `SendTime`.
3. If `SendTime` is not provided, the system locates the page by `PageNumber`.

The API supports returning up to 10,000 query results, that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000.

SearchFollowerUserName.description_cn:
创建点播间的账号。默认获取所有账号创建的点播间。
如需获取主账号创建的点播间，可将参数值设置为 `admin@bytedance.com`。如需获取子账号创建的点播间，可将参数值设置为子账号的账号。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760?lang=zh) 接口，获取子账号的账号。
SearchFollowerUserName.description_en:
Account that created the video room. By default, retrieves video rooms created by all accounts.
To retrieve video rooms created by the main account, set the parameter value to `admin@bytedance.com`. To retrieve video rooms created by a sub-account, set the parameter value to the sub-account's account. You can obtain sub-account information by calling the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760?lang=zh) API.

SearchVideoRoomId.description_cn: 点播间 ID。您可以通过当前接口返回的 `VideoRoomId` 获取点播间 ID。
SearchVideoRoomId.description_en: Video room ID. You can obtain the video room ID from the `VideoRoomId` returned by this API.

SearchVideoRoomName.description_cn:
点播间名称。支持模糊查询。
例如，`Name` 取值为 `点播间 A` 时，则返回直播间名称为 `点播间 ABC`、`点播间 a`、`企业点播间 ab` 等包含 `点播间 A` 关键词的点播间列表。
SearchVideoRoomName.description_en:
Video room name. Supports fuzzy search.
For example, if `Name` is set to `Video Room A`, the returned list will include video rooms whose names contain the keyword `Video Room A`, such as `Video Room ABC`, `Video Room a`, and `Enterprise Video Room ab`.
SearchVideoRoomName.example_en: Python Data Analysis: From Introduction to Application

SortBy.description_cn: 点播间排序规则。默认值为 `CreateTime`。目前仅支持传入 `CreateTime`，表示按照点播间的创建时间排序。
SortBy.description_en: Video room sorting rule. Default value: `CreateTime`. Currently, only `CreateTime` is supported, which sorts video rooms by creation time.

SortOrder.description_cn:
点播间排序规则的顺序。默认值为 `Desc`。取值如下：

* `Desc`：倒序
* `Asc`：正序
SortOrder.description_en:
Order for video room sorting rule. Default value: `Desc`. Available values:

* `Desc`: descending order
* `Asc`: ascending order

PageNumber.description_cn: 分页查询页码。默认取值为 `1`。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for paginated queries. Default value is `1`

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量。取值范围为 [1,1000]。默认取值为 `10`。
PageSize.description_en: Number of items per page. Valid range: [1, 1000]. Default: `10`.

SearchKey.description_cn: 根据点播播放器名称进行模糊搜索。最多支持输入 100 个字符。
SearchKey.description_en: Search by on-demand player name using fuzzy matching. Up to 100 characters allowed

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream Room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

PageItemCount.description_cn:
分页查询数量。默认值为 100。取值范围为 [1,1000]。
接口最多支持返回 1000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 1000。
PageItemCount.description_en:
Items per page. Default: 100. Range: [1, 1000].
The API supports up to 1000 results per query; that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 1000.

PageNo.description_cn:
分页查询页码。默认值为 1。取值范围为 [1,1000]。
接口最多支持返回 1000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 1000。
PageNo.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries. Default is 1. Valid range: [1, 1000].
The API can return up to 1000 results. That is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 1000.

Domain.description_cn: 按域名 URL 筛选。不包含协议头。例如 `www.example.com` 或泛域名  `*.example.com`。支持模糊搜索。
Domain.description_en: Filter by domain URL. Do not include the protocol (e.g., http:// or https://). For example, `www.example.com` or wildcard domain `*.example.com`. Supports fuzzy search.

PageNumber.description_cn: 分页查询页码。默认值为 `1`。取值大于等于 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for paginated queries. Default value is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量。默认值为 `10`。取值范围为 [1,500]。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page. Default: `10`. Range: [1, 500]

Status.description_cn:
按域名配置状态筛选。默认值为`0`。取值如下：

* `0`：全部状态
* `1`：配置中，即已添加 Web SDK 域名配置，但域名尚未加入白名单。
* `2`：已生效，即域名已加入白名单。
* `3`：已失效，即域名白名单已过期或出现异常。
Status.description_en:
Filter by domain configuration status. Default value is `0`. Possible values:

* `0`: All statuses
* `1`: Configuring—Web SDK domain configuration added, but the domain is not yet whitelisted
* `2`: Active—domain is whitelisted
* `3`: Expired—domain whitelist has expired or is abnormal

EndTime.description_cn: 视频剪辑的结束时间，即该时间之后的视频将被裁剪。单位为秒。
EndTime.description_en: End time for video editing; video content after this time will be removed. Unit: seconds

MediaName.description_cn: 剪辑生成的视频名称。名称默认为：剪辑文件 + "_" + 年月日 + 时分。
MediaName.description_en: Name of the video generated from editing. The default name is: Edited File + '_' + YYYYMMDD + HHMM

StartTime.description_cn: 视频剪辑的开始时间，即该时间之前的视频将被裁剪。单位为秒。
StartTime.description_en: Start time for video trimming; video before this time will be removed. Unit: seconds

Vid.description_cn:
视频 Vid。您可通过 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口获取 Vid。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保视频对子账号可见且子账号具备**媒资库** > **视频管理** > **直播暂存**或**视频库** > **可编辑**权限。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围和权限，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Vid.description_en:
Video Vid. You can get the Vid using the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the video is visible to the sub-account and that it has **Media Library** > **Video Management** > **Live Temporary Storage** or **Video Library** > **Editable** permissions. For details on configuring sub-account visibility and permissions, see [Sub-Account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EmojiSetLocations.description_cn:
自定义表情专辑信息列表。
- 确保传入该直播间已添加的全部自定义表情专辑。
- 最多支持配置 10 个自定义表情专辑。
EmojiSetLocations.description_en:
Custom Emoji Album Information List
- Make sure to provide all custom emoji albums added to this live room
- You can configure up to 10 custom emoji albums

EmojiSetLocations.EmojiSetId.description_cn: 自定义表情专辑 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityCustomEmojiSets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222878) 接口查询 ID。
EmojiSetLocations.EmojiSetId.description_en: Custom emoji album ID. You can find the ID using the [ListActivityCustomEmojiSets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222878) API.

EmojiSetLocations.EmojiSetLocation.description_cn:
自定义表情专辑的排序号。
该参数取值为从 `1` 开始的连续且不重复的整数，如 `1`、`2`、`3`。取值范围为 [1,10]，取值越小，在主持人和观众看到的界面中位置越靠前。
EmojiSetLocations.EmojiSetLocation.description_en:
Sort order for custom emoji albums
This parameter must be a consecutive, non-repeating integer starting from `1`, such as `1`, `2`, `3`. Valid values are [1,10]. Lower numbers appear closer to the top of the interface for hosts and viewers.

Menus.description_cn:
菜单展示列表。
- 该列表中的菜单将被设置为启用状态，并按照配置的顺序展示在观看页。
- 未在该列表中的菜单将被设置为非启用状态。
Menus.description_en:
Menu Display List
- Menus in this list will be enabled and displayed on the viewing page in the configured order
- Menus not in this list will be disabled

Menus.ToolId.description_cn:
图文介绍菜单、商品卡片菜单或内嵌链接菜单的唯一标识。
当 `Type` 取值为 `1`、`2` 和 `7` 时，返回菜单的唯一标识，否则无需关注该参数。
Menus.ToolId.description_en:
Unique identifier for the graphic/text introduction menu, product card menu, or embedded link menu.
When `Type` is set to `1`, `2`, or `7`, the unique identifier for the menu is returned; otherwise, you can ignore this parameter.

Menus.Type.description_cn:
菜单类别。支持以下取值：
- `1`：图文介绍
- `2`：商品卡片
- `3`：聊天互动
- `4`：互动工具
- `5`：聚合直播
- `6`：互动问答
- `7`：内嵌链接
- `8`：私聊互动
Menus.Type.description_en:
Menu Category. Supports the following values:
- `1`: Image and Text Introduction
- `2`: Product Card
- `3`: Chat Interaction
- `4`: Interactive Tool
- `5`: Aggregated Live Streaming
- `6`: Interactive Q&A
- `7`: Embedded Link
- `8`: Private Chat Interaction

AudienceGroupId.description_cn:
分组 ID。您可以通过 [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) 接口查询 ID。
**未分组**分组不支持更新分组名称。
AudienceGroupId.description_en:
Group ID. You can query the ID using the [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) API
The **Unassigned** group does not support updating the group name.

AudienceGroupName.description_cn: 分组名称。最多支持输入 60 个字符。

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。

ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream room ID. You can query the ID via the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

QuestionnaireId.description_cn: 问卷 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) 接口获取问卷 ID。
QuestionnaireId.description_en: Questionnaire ID. You can obtain the questionnaire ID via the [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) API.

QuestionnairePublishId.description_cn:
当问卷为手动发送或者定时发送时，问卷的发送 ID。
* 当问卷为手动发送或者定时发送时，该参数生效且必传。您可以调用 [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) 接口，通过 `TriggerTime` 参数获取问卷的发送时机。
* 通过手动或定时发送的问卷，下线后不支持再次发布。
* 当问卷发送时机为观众进入直播时发送或直播结束发送时，则无需传入该参数。且该类问卷下线后，可调用 [PublishActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372070?lang=zh) 接口再次发布。
QuestionnairePublishId.description_en:
When the questionnaire is sent manually or scheduled, the questionnaire send ID.
* This parameter is required and takes effect only when the questionnaire is sent manually or scheduled. You can call the [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) API and use the `TriggerTime` parameter to get the questionnaire send timing.
* For questionnaires sent manually or scheduled, you cannot republish them after taking them offline.
* If the questionnaire is sent when viewers enter the livestream or after the livestream ends, you do not need to provide this parameter. For these questionnaires, you can call the [PublishActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372070?lang=zh) API to republish after taking them offline.

直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。

Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

QuestionnaireId.description_cn: 问卷 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) 接口获取问卷 ID。
QuestionnaireId.description_en: Questionnaire ID. You can obtain the questionnaire ID using the [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) API.

VideoRoomId.description_cn: 点播间的 ID。您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取 ID。
VideoRoomId.description_en: ID of the video room. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) API.

VodReorderIndex.description_cn: 视频顺序配置。建议传入全部视频及其对应 `Index` 以确保排序结果一致。
VodReorderIndex.description_en: Video order configuration. It is recommended to provide all videos and their corresponding `Index` values to ensure consistent sorting results.

VodReorderIndex.Index.description_cn: 视频的排序权重，视频展示顺序将按 `Index` 从小到大排列。
VodReorderIndex.Index.description_en: The sorting weight of videos determines the display order, which is arranged in ascending order of Index.

VodReorderIndex.MediaId.description_cn: 当前点播间内视频列表中的视频 ID。您可通过调用 [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) 接口，获取 `MediaId` 的值。
VodReorderIndex.MediaId.description_en: Video ID in the current video room's video list. You can obtain the MediaId value by calling the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) API.

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号拥有对等级库的可编辑权限。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容，您也可通过不传或将该参数设置为 `0` 来指定默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer level library ID. You can obtain it using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the level library. For details on configuring sub-account permission scopes, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can also leave this parameter empty or set it to `0` to use the default level library (which includes 3 default level configurations).

ViewerLevelOrderedIds.description_cn:
所有等级配置 ID 的集合，入参顺序即为新的展示次序。可通过 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口获取所有等级配置 ID。
在一个观众等级库中，观众等级的顺序越靠前，对应的等级越低。
ViewerLevelOrderedIds.description_en:
A collection of all level configuration IDs. The order of the input parameters determines the new display sequence. You can get all level configuration IDs through the [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) API.
In a viewer level library, the closer a viewer level is to the front of the list, the lower the level.

Amount.description_cn:
本次下单的人数，默认值为 `1`，需填写 ≥ 1 的整数。

* 当 `Amount` 取值为 `1` 时，表示本次调用产生 1 人下单。
* `Amount` 取值为 `3` 时，表示本次调用产生 3 人下单。

企业直播服务端会每 5 秒统计并向观播端的聊天区推送一次当前下单的总人数。
例如：在 5 秒内您调用了 10 次本接口，且每次 `Amount` 均为 `1` ，则累计下单人数为 10，聊天区将显示“xxx 等 10 人已下单 x 号商品”。
Amount.description_en:
Number of people placing an order in this transaction. The default value is `1`. Please enter an integer ≥ 1.

* When `Amount` is set to `1`, this call records 1 person placing an order.
* When `Amount` is set to `3`, this call records 3 people placing an order.

The enterprise live streaming server counts and pushes the total number of people who have placed an order to the chat area on the viewer side every 5 seconds.
For example: If you call this API 10 times within 5 seconds and each time `Amount` is `1`, the total number of people placing an order will be 10. The chat area will display: "xxx and 10 people have placed an order for product x".

BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_en:
Custom URL. Length: 1 to 500 characters.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `IsCustomRedirectUrlEnable` is set to `true`.

BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_cn:
是否开启自定义地址提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：开启。开启后，观众点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至 `CustomRedirectUrl` 配置的自定义地址页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
* `false`：关闭

当 `IsCustomRedirectUrlEnable` 和 `IsWeChatMiniAppEnable` 的取值均为 `true` 时，则：
在移动端微信环境下，观众会跳转至微信小程序页面
在其他环境下，观众会跳转至自定义地址页面
BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_en:
Enable custom URL withdrawal redirect feature. Default value is `false`. The options are:

* `true`: Enable. When enabled, viewers can tap **Withdraw Now** to be redirected to the custom URL page configured in `CustomRedirectUrl`. You need to distribute the prize amount and implement the red packet withdrawal logic on your page
* `false`: Disable

When both `IsCustomRedirectUrlEnable` and `IsWeChatMiniAppEnable` are set to `true`:
In the mobile WeChat environment, viewers will be redirected to the WeChat Mini Program page
In other environments, viewers will be redirected to the custom URL page

BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_cn:
是否开启微信小程序提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：开启。开启后，移动端观众在微信环境下点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至指定微信小程序页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
* `false`：关闭
BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_en:
Enable WeChat Mini Program withdrawal redirect feature. Default value is `false`. The options are:

* `true`: Enable. When enabled, mobile viewers in the WeChat environment can tap **Withdraw Now** to be redirected to the specified WeChat Mini Program page. You need to distribute the prize amount and implement the red packet withdrawal logic on your page
* `false`: Disable

BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_cn:
微信小程序的 App ID，跳转后的页面属于该微信小程序。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
完成以下步骤，获取 App ID。

1. 使用微信小程序账号登录[微信公众平台](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/)。
2. 在左侧导航栏，选择**设置**。
3. 在**基本设置**页签下查看 App ID。

当 `IsWeChatMiniAppEnable` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_en:
The App ID of the WeChat Mini Program. The redirected page belongs to this Mini Program. Length: 1 to 100 characters.
Follow these steps to obtain the App ID:

1. Log in to the [WeChat Official Platform](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/) with your WeChat Mini Program account.
2. In the left navigation bar, select **Settings**.
3. On the **Basic Settings** tab, view the App ID.

This parameter is required and takes effect when `IsWeChatMiniAppEnable` is set to `true`.

BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_cn:
跳转后的页面在微信小程序中的相对路径。 长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
当 `IsWeChatMiniAppEnable` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
BonusList.SubBonus.CashSubBonus.Withdraw.description_en:
The relative path of the redirected page within the WeChat Mini Program. Length: 1 to 500 characters.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `IsWeChatMiniAppEnable` is set to `true`.

BonusList.SubBonus.CouponSubBonus.description_cn:
卡券奖励。
当且仅当 `SubBonusType` 参数取值为 `3` 时，该参数生效且必填。
BonusList.SubBonus.CouponSubBonus.description_en:
Coupon reward
This parameter is required and effective if and only if the SubBonusType parameter is set to 3

BonusList.SubBonus.CouponSubBonus.Coupon.description_cn:
卡券 ID。您可通过调用 [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保卡券对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
BonusList.SubBonus.CouponSubBonus.Coupon.description_en:
Coupon ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) API.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the coupon is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

BonusList.SubBonus.CouponSubBonus.LimitC.description_cn:
该奖励可被领取的总份数。可取值：

* `-1`：无限制
* [1，100,000] 之间的整数：表示具体奖励份数
BonusList.SubBonus.CouponSubBonus.LimitC.description_en:
Total number of times this reward can be claimed. Possible values:

* `-1`: No limit
* An integer between [1, 100,000]: Specifies the exact number of times the reward can be claimed

BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.description_cn:
积分奖励。
当且仅当 `SubBonusType` 参数取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效且必填。
BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.description_en:
Points reward
This parameter is required and effective if and only if the SubBonusType parameter is set to 1

BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.AmountT.description_cn: 完成任务后，单个观众可获得的现金值，单位为 0.1 元。取值范围为 [1, 50,000]。若该值设为 10，则每位观众可获得 1 元。
BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.AmountT.description_en: After completing the task, each viewer can receive a cash amount, with the unit being 0.1 yuan. The value range is [1, 50,000]. If this value is set to 10, each viewer can receive 1 yuan.

BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.LimitCo.description_cn:
该奖励可被领取的总份数。可取值：

* `-1`：无限制
* [1，100,000] 之间的整数：表示具体奖励份数
BonusList.SubBonus.PointSubBonus.LimitCo.description_en:
Total number of rewards that can be claimed. Possible values:

* `-1`: Unlimited
* Integer between [1, 100,000]: Specifies the exact number of rewards that can be claimed

BonusList.SubBonusType.description_cn:
完成任务后，观众获得的奖励类型。取值如下：

* `1`：积分
* `2`：现金
* `3`：优惠券
* `4`：奖品
BonusList.SubBonusType.description_en:
Reward type received by viewers after completing the task. The values are as follows:

* `1`: Points
* `2`: Cash
* `3`: Coupon
* `4`: Prize

BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.description_cn:
观看时长任务的详细信息。
当且仅当 `SubBonusType` 参数取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.description_en:
Details of the watch duration task.
This parameter is effective only when the `SubTaskType` parameter is set to `1`.

BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.Watc.description_cn:
当任务类型为观看时长时，指定的直播状态。默认为 `[1]`，即仅统计观看直播的时长，不包括预告和回放视频。支持填入以下值：

* `1`：直播中
* `2`：预告视频
* `3`：回放视频

当且仅当 `SubBonusType` 参数取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
BonusList.SubTask.WatchDurationTask.Watc.description_en:
When the task type is watch duration, specify the live stream status. The default is `[1]`, which only counts the duration of watching live streams and excludes preview and replay videos. The following values are supported:

* `1`: Live
* `2`: Preview video
* `3`: Replay video

This parameter is effective if and only if the `SubBonusType` parameter is set to `1`.

BonusList.SubTaskCondition.description_cn:
完成该子任务的数量要求，取值范围为 [1,500]。
示例：若 `SubTaskType` 取值为 `1`，`SubTaskCondition` 取值为 `30`，则表示获奖条件为“观看直播 `30`分钟”。
BonusList.SubTaskCondition.description_en:
Required quantity to complete this subtask. Value range: [1,500]
Example: If `SubTaskType` is `1` and `SubTaskCondition` is `30`, the reward condition is to watch live stream for 30 minutes

BonusList.SubTaskType.description_cn:
子任务的类型。取值如下：

* `1`：观看时长。您还可以通过 `WatchDurationStatusList` 参数指定统计范围，包括：直播中、预告和回放。默认仅统计直播中的观看时长。
* `2`：聊天次数
* `3`：点赞次数
* `4`：邀请人数
* `5`：商品点击次数
* `6`：打赏次数
* `7`：投票次数
* `8`：完成问卷次数
* `9`：签到次数
* `10`：答题次数
* `11`：答对次数
BonusList.SubTaskType.description_en:
Sub-task types. The available values are:

* `1`: Watch duration. You can also use the `WatchDurationStatusList` parameter to specify the scope, including: live, preview, and playback. By default, only the watch duration during live is counted.
* `2`: Number of chats
* `3`: Number of likes
* `4`: Number of people invited
* `5`: Number of product clicks
* `6`: Number of tips
* `7`: Number of votes
* `8`: Number of completed questionnaires
* `9`: Number of check-ins
* `10`: Number of answered questions
* `11`: Number of correct answers

EndTime.description_cn:
福利任务的结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。结束时间取值需大于 `StartTime` 的取值，且与 `StartTime` 的差值最大为 604,800，即 7 天。
若不传入该值，则不更新结束时间。
EndTime.description_en:
Bonus task end time. Unix timestamp in seconds. The end time must be greater than the value of `StartTime`, and the difference between `EndTime` and `StartTime` can be up to 604,800 seconds (7 days).
If this value is not provided, the end time will not be updated.

Icon.description_cn: 福利任务图标的 URL，需要包含协议头。不传则使用默认图标。支持传入 PNG、JPG、JPEG 格式的图片，尺寸不超过 160×160px，大小不超过 2 MB。
Icon.description_en: The URL for the welfare task icon must include the protocol. If not provided, the default icon will be used. Supports PNG, JPG, and JPEG image formats. Image dimensions must not exceed 160×160px, and file size must not exceed 2 MB.

Id.description_cn: 直播福利任务 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityBonusTasks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2121529) 接口查询 ID。
Id.description_en: Live bonus task ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityBonusTasks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2121529) interface.

Name.description_cn:
直播福利任务的名称，长度不超过 20 个字符，不能为空。
若不传入该值，则不更新任务名称。
Name.description_en:
Name of the live bonus task, up to 20 characters, cannot be empty.
If this value is not provided, the task name will not be updated.
Name.example_en: Watch the live stream and get great rewards

StartTime.description_cn:
福利任务的开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。开始时间取值需大于当前时间。
若不传入该值，则不更新开始时间。
StartTime.description_en:
Bonus task start time. Unix timestamp in seconds. The start time must be greater than the current time.
If this value is not provided, the start time will not be updated.

TaskRunningType.description_cn:
直播福利任务开启方式。取值如下：

* `1`：手动开启：任务创建后，您可以随时手动开启任务。
* `2`：计划开启：设置一个具体的开始和结束时间，任务将按计划自动开启。

若不传入该值，则不更新开启方式。
TaskRunningType.description_en:
Live bonus task activation method. The values are:

* `1`: Manual activation: After the task is created, you can manually activate it at any time.
* `2`: Scheduled activation: Set a specific start and end time, and the task will be automatically activated as scheduled.

If this value is not provided, the activation method will not be updated.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the livestream is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CommentConfig.description_cn: 聊天互动菜单的基础配置信息。
CommentConfig.description_en: Basic configuration information for the chat interaction menu

CommentConfig.HotListCount.description_cn:
热门条数，即热门评论列表中最多可以显示多少条热门评论。取值范围为 [10,50]。
该参数仅在 `IsHotListEnable` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
CommentConfig.HotListCount.description_en:
Hot Comment Count specifies the maximum number of hot comments displayed in the list. Value range: [10,50]
This parameter only takes effect when `IsHotListEnable` is set to `1`

CommentConfig.HotListName.description_cn:
热门评论列表的名称。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
该参数仅在 `IsHotListEnable` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
CommentConfig.HotListName.description_en:
Hot Comments List Name (1–100 characters)
This parameter is only effective when `IsHotListEnable` is set to 1

CommentConfig.InputBoxPrompt.description_cn: 观看页评论输入框内的默认文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
CommentConfig.InputBoxPrompt.description_en: Default placeholder text in the comment input box on the viewing page; length: 1–100 characters
CommentConfig.InputBoxPrompt.example_en: How about we chat with everyone?

CommentConfig.IsAutoSilenceAllEnable.description_cn:
是否开启仅直播时允许聊天功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启后，观众无法在直播开始前和结束后发送评论
CommentConfig.IsAutoSilenceAllEnable.description_en:
Enable chat only during live stream. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled, viewers cannot send comments before the live stream starts or after it ends

CommentConfig.IsBulletScreenEnable.description_cn:
是否开启弹幕功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
CommentConfig.IsBulletScreenEnable.description_en:
Enable bullet chat feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

CommentConfig.IsCommentLLMAnalyzeEnable.description_cn:
是否开启聊天 AI 分析功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。功能开启且观众在观看页发送聊天内容后，会产生聊天 AI 分析结果。更多有关聊天 AI 分析的内容，详见[聊天 AI 分析](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1408242)。

* 您必须先联系商务购买大模型资源包并开通聊天 AI 分析功能，取值为 `1` 才能生效。
* 如果您对该功能有任何定制化需求，可联系企业直播技术支持。
CommentConfig.IsCommentLLMAnalyzeEnable.description_en:
Enable chat AI analysis feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled and viewers send chat messages on the viewing page, chat AI analysis results will be generated. For more details about chat AI analysis, see [Chat AI Analysis](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1408242).

* You must first contact sales to purchase a large model resource package and activate the chat AI analysis feature for the value `1` to take effect.
* If you have any customization needs for this feature, please contact Enterprise Live technical support.

CommentConfig.IsCommentTranslateEnable.description_cn:
是否开启评论翻译功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。仅在开启页面语言时评论翻译功能生效，您可调用 [UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100060) 接口，开启页面语言

目前仅支持简体中文、英文、日文、韩文之间的相互转换，以及将繁体中文转换成简体中文、英文、日文、韩文。
CommentConfig.IsCommentTranslateEnable.description_en:
Enable comment translation feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. Comment translation is only available when page language is enabled. You can call the [UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100060) to enable page language.

Currently, only mutual translation between Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean is supported, as well as conversion from Traditional Chinese to Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.

CommentConfig.IsHotListEnable.description_cn:
是否开启热门评论功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
CommentConfig.IsHotListEnable.description_en:
Enable popular comments feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

CommentConfig.IsImageCommentEnable.description_cn:
是否开启图片评论功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
CommentConfig.IsImageCommentEnable.description_en:
Enable image comment feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

CommentConfig.IsLikeNumberShowEnable.description_cn:
是否在观看页显示评论点赞图标和热门评论的点赞数。取值如下：

* `0`：不显示
* `1`：显示

该参数仅在 `IsHotListEnable` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
CommentConfig.IsLikeNumberShowEnable.description_en:
Show comment like icon and like count for popular comments on the viewing page. Values:

* `0`: Do not show
* `1`: Show

This parameter only takes effect when `IsHotListEnable` is set to `1`.

CommentConfig.IsManualHotListEnable.description_cn:
是否开启手动筛选热门评论功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启

该参数仅在 `IsHotListEnable` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
CommentConfig.IsManualHotListEnable.description_en:
Enable manual selection of popular comments. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

This parameter only takes effect when `IsHotListEnable` is set to `1`.

CommentConfig.IsQuickCommentEnable.description_cn:
是否开启快捷评论功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。功能开启且已输入预设评论后，观众可在观看页点击快捷评论一键发送。详见[快捷评论](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2191791)。
CommentConfig.IsQuickCommentEnable.description_en:
Enable quick comment feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled and preset comments are entered, viewers can send quick comments with one click on the viewing page. See [Quick Comment](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2191791) for details.

CommentConfig.IsSendCommentEnable.description_cn:
是否开启全体禁言功能。取值如下：

* `0`：开启
* `1`：关闭
CommentConfig.IsSendCommentEnable.description_en:
Enable mute all feature. Values:

* `0`: On
* `1`: Off

CommentConfig.IsViewInPurchaseEnable.description_cn:
是否开启查看商品消息。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启后，每当有观众点击商品卡片，跳转至商品详情页时，观看页会展示查看商品信息。为确保观看页能够展示查看商品消息，必须同时满足以下条件：
   * 调用 [ModifyActivityMenus](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131810) 接口，启用商品卡片和聊天互动菜单。
   * 调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804#uainfos) 接口，完成以下配置：
      * 将 `EnableStatus` 的参数值设置为 `1`，上架商品卡片
      * 将 `IsOrderMsgEnable` 的参数值设置为 `1`，开启商品卡片的下单消息

更多有关查看商品消息的内容，详见[展示查看商品消息和下单购买消息](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149738#%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B%E5%95%86%E5%93%81%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%E5%92%8C%E4%B8%8B%E5%8D%95%E8%B4%AD%E4%B9%B0%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF)。
如果同时触发了查看商品消息和下单购买消息，则优先展示下单购买消息。
CommentConfig.IsViewInPurchaseEnable.description_en:
Enable viewing product messages. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled, whenever a viewer clicks a product card and goes to the product details page, the viewing page will display the product message. To ensure product messages are shown on the viewing page, all of the following conditions must be met:
   * Call the [ModifyActivityMenus](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131810) API to enable product cards and chat interaction menus.
   * Call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804#uainfos) API and complete the following configurations:
      * Set the `EnableStatus` parameter to `1` to list the product card
      * Set the `IsOrderMsgEnable` parameter to `1` to enable order messages for the product card

For more details about viewing product messages, see [Display Product View and Purchase Messages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149738#%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B%E5%95%86%E5%93%81%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%E5%92%8C%E4%B8%8B%E5%8D%95%E8%B4%AD%E4%B9%B0%E6%B6%81%E6%81%AF).
If both product view and purchase messages are triggered at the same time, purchase messages will be displayed first.

CommentConfig.IsViewOrderEnable.description_cn:
是否开启下单购买消息。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启后，每当有观众下单购买商品，您需调用 [SendProductOrderMessage](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1400417) 接口，发送下单购买消息。更多有关下单购买消息的内容，详见[展示查看商品消息和下单购买消息](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149738#%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B%E5%95%86%E5%93%81%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%E5%92%8C%E4%B8%8B%E5%8D%95%E8%B4%AD%E4%B9%B0%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF)。

如果同时触发了查看商品消息和下单购买消息，则优先展示下单购买消息。
CommentConfig.IsViewOrderEnable.description_en:
Enable order purchase message. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled, each time a viewer places an order to purchase a product, you need to call the [SendProductOrderMessage](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1400417) API to send an order purchase message. For more details about order purchase messages, see [Display Product View Messages and Order Purchase Messages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149738#%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B%E5%95%86%E5%93%81%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF%E5%92%8C%E4%B8%8B%E5%8D%95%E8%B4%AD%E4%B9%B0%E6%B6%88%E6%81%AF).

If both product view messages and order purchase messages are triggered at the same time, order purchase messages will be displayed first.

CommentConfig.IsViewerDeleteCommentsEnab.description_cn:
是否开启允许观众删除评论功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启后，观众可以将自己发送的文字评论、图片评论和表情从观看页的聊天互动评论区删除
CommentConfig.IsViewerDeleteCommentsEnab.description_en:
Enable viewers to delete comments. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled, viewers can delete their own text comments, image comments, and emojis from the chat interaction comment section on the viewing page

CommentConfig.IsWelcomeMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启欢迎语功能。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启后，观众进入直播间时系统会自动发送聊天欢迎语
CommentConfig.IsWelcomeMessageEnable.description_en:
Enable welcome message feature. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. When enabled, the system automatically sends a chat welcome message when viewers enter the livestream room

CommentConfig.MenuName.description_cn: 聊天互动菜单的名称。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
CommentConfig.MenuName.description_en: Chat Interaction Menu Name. Length: 1–20 characters

CommentConfig.PresenterName.description_cn: 主持人昵称。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。

CommentConfig.VoiceInterval.description_cn: 主持人和观众的最短发言间隔。取值范围为 [1,300]。单位为秒。例如将最短发言间隔设置为 3 秒，主持人和观众在自己发送评论后的 3 秒内，无法再次发送评论。
CommentConfig.VoiceInterval.description_en: Minimum comment interval for hosts and audience members. Range: [1, 300] seconds. For example, if you set the minimum interval to 3 seconds, hosts and audience members cannot post another comment within 3 seconds after posting their own comment.

CommentConfig.WelcomeMessageContent.description_cn: 欢迎语的内容。长度为 1 到 150 个字符。
CommentConfig.WelcomeMessageContent.description_en: Welcome message content. Must be 1 to 150 characters long

CommentConfig.WelcomeMessageTitle.description_cn: 欢迎语的标题。长度为 1 到 15 个字符。

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream Room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AllowCloseIcon.description_cn:
观看页的卡券图标是否支持关闭。取值如下：
- `true`：支持
- `false`：不支持
AllowCloseIcon.description_en:
Whether viewers can close the coupon icon on the viewing page. If not provided, the original configuration remains unchanged. Available values:

* `true`: Supported
* `false`: Not supported

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送卡券的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
当 `SendCouponType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled coupon delivery time. Unix timestamp in seconds.
This parameter is required when `SendCouponType` is set to `1`.

Count.description_cn: 发放的卡券个数。取值范围为 -1 和 [1,1000000]。取值为 `-1` 表示无限制。
Count.description_en: Number of issued coupons. Valid values: -1 or any integer from 1 to 1,000,000. -1 means unlimited

CouponId.description_cn:
卡券 ID。您可通过调用 [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) 接口获取 ID。

使用子账号调用接口时，确保卡券对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
CouponId.description_en:
Coupon ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) API.

When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the coupon is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope for sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CutOffTime.description_cn:
定时截止时间，需晚于当前时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
该参数仅在 `Rule` 取值为 `3` 时生效。
CutOffTime.description_en:
Scheduled deadline time must be later than the current time. Enter as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
This parameter is only effective when `Rule` is set to 3.

Duration.description_cn:
倒计时。取值范围为 [1,300]。单位为分钟。
该参数仅在 `Rule` 取值为 `2` 时生效。
Duration.description_en:
Countdown. Value range: [1, 300]. Unit: minutes.
This parameter is only effective when `Rule` is set to 2.

Id.description_cn:
卡券互动工具 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) 接口获取 ID。
仅未发送状态的卡券互动工具支持更新，即 [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) 接口中返回参数 `Status` 的取值为 `0` 时。
Id.description_en:
Coupon interaction tool ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) API.
Only coupon interaction tools in the unsent state can be updated. This means the `Status` parameter returned by the [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) API must be `0`.

IsViewerLevelLimit.description_cn:
是否开启观众等级参与条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不开启。卡券的领取不受观众等级限制。
* `1`：开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，满足观众等级条件的用户才能看见并领取卡券。
IsViewerLevelLimit.description_en:
Enable audience level participation condition. Default value is `0`. The options are:

* `0`: Disabled. Coupon claiming is not restricted by audience level.
* `1`: Enabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, only users who meet the audience level condition can see and claim the coupon.

IsWatchLiveLimit.description_cn:
是否开启观看直播参与条件。取值如下：
- `0`：不开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，观众可直接领取卡券，而无需先观看直播。
- `1`：开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，观众必须先观看直播，才能领取卡券。
IsWatchLiveLimit.description_en:
Whether to enable the livestream participation requirement.
Options:
- `0`: Disabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, viewers can claim the coupon directly without watching the livestream first.
- `1`: Enabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, viewers must watch the livestream before they can claim the coupon.

Rule.description_cn:
领取卡券的截止时间。取值如下：
- `0`：无时间限制。卡券互动工具被发送至观看页后，观众可随时领取卡券
- `1`：卡券在手动停止发放前，均支持领取
- `2`：卡券互动工具被发送至观看页后的指定分钟数内，均支持领取卡券
- `3`：卡券在截止时间前，均支持领取
Rule.description_en:
Coupon collection deadline. If not provided, the original configuration remains unchanged. Available values:

* `0`: No time limit. After the coupon interaction tool is sent to the viewing page, viewers can collect coupons at any time
* `1`: Viewers can collect coupons until you manually stop the distribution
* `2`: Viewers can collect coupons within the specified number of minutes after the coupon interaction tool is sent to the viewing page
* `3`: Viewers can collect coupons before the deadline

SendCouponType.description_cn:
卡券发送方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。后续可调用 [SendActivityCoupon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357829) 接口发送卡券。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime`参数选择定时发送的时间。
SendCouponType.description_en:
Coupon delivery method. The default value is `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual delivery. You can call the [SendActivityCoupon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357829) API to send coupons later
* `1`: Scheduled delivery. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled delivery time

ViewerLevelConfigIds.description_cn:
开启观众等级参与条件后，观众需满足的观众等级的 ID 列表。
传入观众等级 ID 之前，请确保当前直播间已绑定观众等级库，且传入的观众等级 ID 属于该等级库。
建议先调用 [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) 接口，获取当前直播间绑定的等级库 ID （`BindAccountLevelGroupId`）；再调用 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口，获取等级库中的等级 ID（`LevelId`）。
当 `IsViewerLevelLimit` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
ViewerLevelConfigIds.description_en: After enabling viewer level participation requirements, viewers must have the viewer level IDs listed here. Before entering viewer level IDs, make sure the current livestream is already bound to a viewer level library, and that the viewer level IDs you enter belong to that library. It is recommended to first call the [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the ID of the viewer level library that is bound to the current livestream (`BindAccountLevelGroupId`), then call [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) to get the level IDs (`LevelId`) in the library. When `IsViewerLevelLimit` is set to `1`, this parameter is required.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EmojiSetId.description_cn: 自定义表情专辑 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityCustomEmojiSets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222878) 接口查询 ID。
EmojiSetId.description_en: Custom emoji album ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityCustomEmojiSets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1222878) API

EmojiSetStatus.description_cn:
自定义表情专辑的启用状态。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭
EmojiSetStatus.description_en:
Custom emoji album enable status. Supported values:
- `1`: Enabled
- `2`: Disabled

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EmbeddedUrlConfig.description_cn: 内嵌链接菜单的配置信息列表。
EmbeddedUrlConfig.description_en: Configuration information for the Embedded Link menu.

EmbeddedUrlConfig.MobileUrl.description_cn: 移动端内嵌链接。包含协议头。
EmbeddedUrlConfig.MobileUrl.description_en: Embedded link on mobile. Includes protocol header.

EmbeddedUrlConfig.PCUrl.description_cn: PC 端内嵌链接。包含协议头。
EmbeddedUrlConfig.PCUrl.description_en: Embedded link on PC side. Includes protocol header

VerticalIconUrl.description_cn: 竖屏直播中内嵌链接菜单图标的 URL，需要包含协议头。不传则为默认图标。支持上传大小不超过 2 MB 的 PNG 格式的图片。建议尺寸 100*100px。
VerticalIconUrl.description_en: The URL for the embedded link menu icon in vertical live streaming must include the protocol (e.g., http:// or https://). If not provided, the default icon will be used. You can upload PNG images up to 2 MB. Recommended size: 100×100px.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

HostAccountId.description_cn:
待与直播间关联的主播账号 ID。您可以通过 [ListHostAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1265790) 接口查询 ID。
- 当 `IsBusinessAccountEnable` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
- 如需开启观众关注主播功能，请将直播间的观看限制设置为**自定义**。详见[自定义账号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
HostAccountId.description_en:
Host account ID to be associated with the live room. You can query the ID using the [ListHostAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1265790) API.
* This parameter is required and takes effect only when `IsBusinessAccountEnable` is set to `1`.
* To enable the viewer follow host feature, set the live room's viewing restriction to **Custom**. See [Custom Account](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578) for details.

IsBusinessAccountEnable.description_cn:
是否开启账号设置功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `0`。
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启，观看页即可展示主播账号的相关信息。
IsBusinessAccountEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable the account settings feature. Supported values: `0` (default) and `1`.
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On; displays broadcaster account information on the viewing page

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream Room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

BanStatus.description_cn:
封禁或解禁 IP 地址。取值如下：
- `0`：解禁
- `1`：封禁
BanStatus.description_en:
Block or unblock IP addresses. Values:
- `0`: Unblock
- `1`: Block

Ips.description_cn: 封禁或解禁的 IP 地址列表。您可调用 [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) 接口，通过返回参数 `IP` 获取 IP 地址。
Ips.description_en: List of blocked or unblocked IP addresses. You can call the [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) API and obtain IP addresses from the returned IP parameter.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。用于指定需要更新直播质检配置的直播间。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. Specifies the live room whose quality inspection configuration needs to be updated. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility range of sub-accounts, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

LiveInspectConfig.AutoInspectionEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启自动质检。取值如下：

* `true`：开启。开启自动质检后，直播开始时，系统会按配置的项目和场景启动直播质检任务，对直播间内容进行质检；直播结束后，任务自动结束。
* `false`：关闭。
LiveInspectConfig.AutoInspectionEnabled.description_en:
Enable automatic quality inspection. Values:

* `true`: Enabled. When automatic quality inspection is enabled, the system starts a live streaming quality inspection task based on the configured projects and scenarios when the stream begins, inspecting the content in the live room. The task ends automatically when the stream ends.
* `false`: Disabled.

LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.description_cn: 直播质检配置。用于指定自动质检使用的项目、场景等。
LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.description_en: Live streaming quality inspection configuration. Used to specify the projects, scenarios, etc. for automatic quality inspection.

LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.MuteEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启违规消音。取值如下：

* `true`：开启。违规消音支持对直播过程中命中敏感词的声音进行消音。详见[违规消音](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2627847?lang=zh)。
* `false`：关闭违规消音。
LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.MuteEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable violation muting. The options are:

* `true`: Enable. Violation muting mutes audio that contains sensitive words during live streaming. For details, see [Violation Muting](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2627847?lang=zh).
* `false`: Disable violation muting.

LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.ProjectName.description_cn: 质检项目 ID。您可通过调用 [ListProjects](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1529688) 接口获取项目 ID。
LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.ProjectName.description_en: Quality inspection project ID. You can obtain the project ID by calling the [ListProjects](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1529688) API.

LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.ScenarioId.description_cn: 审核场景 ID。您可通过调用 [ListScenarios](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1529692) 接口获取 ID。请选择所选项目下包含的质检场景。
LiveInspectConfig.TaskConfig.ScenarioId.description_en: Review scenario ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListScenarios](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1529692) API. Please select a quality inspection scenario included in the selected project.

Id.description_cn:
视频 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保视频对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Id.description_en:
Video ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the video is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account visibility scope, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

InteractionScriptId.description_cn:
视频绑定的互动脚本 ID。您可调用 [CreateInteractionScript](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413345) 接口创建空白互动脚本并获取互动脚本 ID。
绑定互动脚本后，在视频作为录播直播播放到指定时间节点时，会按照脚本中配置的上下架时间、讲解起止时间和商品信息展示商品，从而降低运营人力成本、提高商品曝光率、丰富直播带货场景。
一个互动脚本仅支持绑定一个媒资库视频或录播直播视频。
InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interaction script ID bound to the video. You can call the [CreateInteractionScript](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413345) API to create a blank interaction script and obtain the interaction script ID. If not provided, the original configuration will not be updated.
After binding an interaction script, when the video is played as a recorded livestream at the specified time node, products will be displayed according to the script's configured shelf times, explanation start and end times, and product information. This reduces operational workforce costs, increases product exposure, and enriches livestream shopping scenarios.
An interaction script can only be bound to one media library video or recorded livestream video.

Name.description_cn: 视频名称。

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account visibility scope, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsCustomMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启自定义消息。取值如下：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭
您可调用 [SendCustomSystemMessageAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/126052) 接口，发送自定义消息。
IsCustomMessageEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable custom messages
Values:
- `1`: Enable
- `2`: Disable
You can call the [SendCustomSystemMessageAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/126052) API to send custom messages.

IsDynamicEmojiMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启动态表情包消息。取值如下：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭
IsDynamicEmojiMessageEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable dynamic emoji messages
- `1`: Enable
- `2`: Disable

IsEntryMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启进场消息。取值如下：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭
IsEntryMessageEnable.description_en:
Enable entry messages. Values:
- `1`: Enable
- `2`: Disable

IsGiftMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启送礼消息。取值如下：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭

IsLotteryMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启抽奖通知。取值如下：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭
IsLotteryMessageEnable.description_en:
Enable lottery notifications? Values:
- `1`: Enable
- `2`: Disable

IsRedPacketMessageEnable.description_cn:
是否开启红包通知。取值如下：
- `1`：开启
- `2`：关闭
IsRedPacketMessageEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable red packet notifications. Values:
- `1`: Enable
- `2`: Disable

PosterConfig.CanInvite.description_cn:
是否开启邀请海报。取值如下：
- `1`：不开启
- `2`：开启
PosterConfig.CanInvite.description_en:
Enable invitation poster? Values:
- `1`: Do not enable
- `2`: Enable

PosterConfig.CanShare.description_cn:
是否开启分享。取值如下：
- `1`：不开启
- `2`：开启
PosterConfig.CanShare.description_en:
Whether to enable sharing. Values:
- `1`: Disabled
- `2`: Enabled

PosterConfig.CustomAddress.description_cn:
自定义分享地址，包含协议头。该参数应用于分享链接和二维码（包含海报上的二维码），适用于对直播分享地址有自身品牌特殊要求的场景。
自定义分享地址不支持通过微信的卡片消息进行分享。
PosterConfig.CustomAddress.description_en:
Custom share URL, including protocol header. This parameter applies to share links and QR codes (including QR codes on posters), and is suitable for scenarios where your brand has specific requirements for the live stream share URL.
Custom share URLs cannot be shared via WeChat card messages.

PosterConfig.CustomDesc.description_cn:
分享描述。在观众通过微信分享直播间的卡片消息中作为描述展示。
观众必须通过二维码扫码进入直播间，并选择分享直播间至微信好友或朋友圈，才会展示分享卡片消息。
PosterConfig.CustomDesc.description_en:
Share description. Displayed as the description in the card message when viewers share the livestream room via WeChat.
Viewers must scan the QR code to enter the livestream room and choose to share it with WeChat friends or Moments for the share card message to appear.

PosterConfig.CustomImage.description_cn:
分享图标的 URL。在观众通过微信分享直播间的卡片消息中作为图片展示或者在浏览器地址栏、书签、标签页等位置作为直播间网页图标展示。
观众必须通过二维码扫码进入直播间，并选择分享直播间至微信好友或朋友圈，才会展示分享卡片消息。
PosterConfig.CustomImage.description_en:
Share icon URL. Displayed as an image in the WeChat share card message when viewers share the livestream room, or as the webpage icon in browser address bars, bookmarks, and tabs.
Viewers must scan the QR code to enter the livestream room and choose to share the livestream room to WeChat friends or Moments for the share card message to appear.

PosterConfig.CustomTitle.description_cn:
分享标题。在观众通过微信分享直播间的卡片消息中作为标题展示。
观众必须通过二维码扫码进入直播间，并选择分享直播间至微信好友或朋友圈，才会展示分享卡片消息。
PosterConfig.CustomTitle.description_en:
Share Title. Displayed as the title in the card message when viewers share the livestream room via WeChat.
Viewers must scan the QR code to enter the livestream room and choose to share the livestream room to WeChat friends or Moments; only then will the share card message appear.

PosterConfig.InviteListEnable.description_cn:
是否开启邀请榜单。取值如下：
- `1`：不开启
- `2`：开启
观众只有在登录直播间后，才能分享自己的专属链接、二维码或海报邀请其他人观看直播。当新用户通过某观众分享的专属链接、二维码或海报首次进入并登录直播间后，该观众的邀请人数增加 1 人。当邀请人数相同时，先达到该邀请人数的观众排名更高。
PosterConfig.InviteListEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable invitation leaderboard. Values:
- `1`: Disabled
- `2`: Enabled
Viewers can share their unique link, QR code, or poster to invite others only after logging in to the live room. When a new user enters and logs in to the live room for the first time using a viewer's shared link, QR code, or poster, that viewer's invite count increases by 1. If multiple viewers have the same invite count, the one who reached it first ranks higher.

PosterConfig.IsForceLogin.description_cn:
是否开启强制登录。取值如下：
- `1`：不开启 
- `2`：开启。开启后，PC 端观众必须先登录直播间才能获取邀请海报，移动端观众必须先登录直播间才能获取邀请海报、分享二维码和链接
PosterConfig.IsForceLogin.description_en:
Forced login:
- `1`: Disabled
- `2`: Enabled. When enabled, PC audience must log in to the live room before they can get the invitation poster. Mobile audience must log in to the live room before they can get the invitation poster, share QR code and link

PosterConfig.LiveStartTime.description_cn: 直播时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
PosterConfig.LiveStartTime.description_en: Live broadcast time. Unix timestamp in seconds

PosterConfig.LiveType.description_cn:
直播方式。取值如下：
- `1`：竖屏直播，即通过分享的链接、二维码或海报进入的是竖屏直播间
- `2`：横屏直播，即通过分享的链接、二维码或海报进入的是横屏直播间
PosterConfig.LiveType.description_en:
Live Streaming Mode. Possible values:
- `1`: Vertical live streaming room—users enter a vertical live streaming room via shared link, QR code, or poster
- `2`: Horizontal live streaming room—users enter a horizontal live streaming room via shared link, QR code, or poster

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope for sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EnableViewCart.description_cn:
是否在移动端商品卡片导航栏全局展示**查看购物车**图标。取值如下：

* `0`：不展示
* `1`：展示
EnableViewCart.description_en:
Whether to globally display the **View Cart** icon in the navigation bar of the product card on mobile. Values:

* `0`: Do not display
* `1`: Display

EnableViewOrder.description_cn:
是否在移动端商品卡片导航栏全局展示**查看订单**按钮。取值如下：

* `0`：不展示
* `1`：展示
EnableViewOrder.description_en:
Whether to globally display the **View Order** button in the navigation bar of the product card on mobile. Values:

* `0`: Do not display
* `1`: Display

ProductConfig.description_cn:
商品卡片菜单的配置信息。
最多支持配置 5 个商品卡片菜单。
ProductConfig.description_en:
Product Card Menu Configuration
You can configure up to 5 product card menus

ProductConfig.DisplayEnable.description_cn:
商品卡片在观看页的入口。取值如下：
