- `1`：观看页支持展示商品卡片菜单和浮窗商品卡片。移动端观看页可同步展示购物车图标
		- 移动端竖屏直播间仅支持展示购物车图标和浮窗商品卡片。
	- 仅在启用聊天互动菜单后，移动端横屏直播间才会展示购物车图标。
	
- `2`：观看页仅支持展示浮窗商品卡片
ProductConfig.DisplayEnable.description_en:
Product card entry point on the viewing page. Options:
- `1`: The viewing page supports displaying the product card menu and floating product card. The shopping cart icon can also be shown on mobile viewing pages
    - On mobile portrait live rooms, only the shopping cart icon and floating product card are supported
  - The shopping cart icon is shown in mobile landscape live rooms only when the chat interaction menu is enabled
  
- `2`: The viewing page supports displaying only the floating product card

ProductConfig.EnableFloating.description_cn:
是否开启浮层展示。取值如下：
- `true`：开启。观众在移动端点击商品卡片后，在当前观看页以浮层形式展示商品详情页。观众可以在观看直播的同时查看商品详情页，实现边看边买
- `false`：关闭。观众点击商品卡片后，页面自动跳转至新的浏览器标签页展示商品详情页。观众无法同时观看直播与商品详情页
ProductConfig.EnableFloating.description_en:
Enable floating layer display. Options:
- `true`: Enabled. When viewers tap a product card on mobile, the product details page appears as a floating layer on the current livestream page. Viewers can watch the livestream and shop at the same time
- `false`: Disabled. When viewers tap a product card, the page automatically jumps to a new browser tab to display the product details page. Viewers cannot watch the livestream and view product details simultaneously

ProductConfig.EnableMiniApp.description_cn:
是否开启微信小程序跳转功能。该功能仅移动端支持。取值如下：
- `true`：开启
- `false`：关闭
ProductConfig.EnableMiniApp.description_en:
Whether to enable WeChat Mini Program redirection. This feature is supported on mobile devices only. Possible values:
- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable

ProductConfig.EnableUA.description_cn:
是否开启直达链接功能。该功能仅移动端支持。取值如下：
- `true`：开启
- `false`：关闭
ProductConfig.EnableUA.description_en:
Enable the direct link feature. This feature is only supported on mobile. Available values:
- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable

ProductConfig.MiniAppId.description_cn:
跳转的微信小程序的原始 ID。
该参数仅在 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.MiniAppId.description_en:
Original ID of the WeChat Mini Program to which the user will be redirected
This parameter is only effective when `EnableMiniApp` is set to true

ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_cn:
点击加购按钮后打开的加购页面链接。
* 该参数仅在 `EnableAddCart` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
* 若此值为空，则观众点击按钮时，客户端不会打开加入购物车页面。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_en:
Link to the add-to-cart page opened after clicking the add-to-cart button.
* This parameter is only effective when `EnableAddCart` is set to `1`.
* If this value is empty, the client will not open the add-to-cart page when viewers click the button.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_cn:
点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域后跳转的兜底链接。
如果观众无法跳转至直达链接或微信小程序，则会跳转至该链接。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_en:
Fallback link for redirecting after viewers tap the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas.
If viewers cannot be redirected to the direct link or WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to this link.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_cn:
微信小程序链接。当观众在移动端微信环境点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该微信小程序。
该参数仅在 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_en:
WeChat Mini Program link. When viewers tap the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas in the mobile WeChat environment, they will be redirected to this WeChat Mini Program.
This parameter is only effective when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_cn:
当观众在环境 UA 匹配成功的移动端平台上点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该链接。
该参数仅在 `EnableUA` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.AddCartUr.description_en:
When viewers tap the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas on a mobile platform where the UA matches successfully, they will be redirected to this link.
This parameter is only effective when `EnableUA` is set to `true`.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.CustomCon.description_cn: 需要透传的自定义扩展信息，可用于展示更多商品信息等。仅用于信息透传，不做其他处理。最大支持 512 个字符。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.CustomCon.description_en: Custom extension information to be passed through, which can be used to display additional product details and more. Used only for information passthrough; no other processing is performed. Supports up to 512 characters.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_cn: 点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域后跳转的链接。若未配置该项，观众点击商品信息区域后会跳转至 `RedirectUrl` 中配置的链接。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_en: Link redirected to after clicking the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas. If this item is not configured, viewers will be redirected to the link specified in `RedirectUrl` after clicking the product information area.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_cn:
点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域后跳转的兜底链接。
如果观众无法跳转至直达链接或微信小程序，则会跳转至该链接。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_en:
The fallback link after clicking the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas.
If viewers cannot be redirected to the direct link or WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to this link.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_cn:
微信小程序链接。当观众在移动端微信环境点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该微信小程序。
该参数仅在 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_en:
WeChat Mini Program link. When viewers click the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas in the mobile WeChat environment, they are redirected to this WeChat Mini Program.
This parameter is only effective when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_cn:
当观众在环境 UA 匹配成功的移动端平台上点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该链接。
该参数仅在 `EnableUA` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.DetailRed.description_en:
When viewers click the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas on a mobile platform where UA environment matching is successful, they are redirected to this link.
This parameter is only effective when `EnableUA` is set to `true`.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.DirectUrl.description_cn:
直达链接，包含协议头。当观众在环境 UA 匹配成功的移动端平台上点击跳转图时，即可跳转至该链接。
* 该参数仅在 `EnableUA` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
* 如果观众无法跳转至直达链接，则会跳转至 `RedirectUrl` 中传入的链接。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.DirectUrl.description_en:
Direct link, including the protocol header. When viewers click the redirect image on a mobile platform where the UA environment matches successfully, they will be redirected to this link.
* This parameter is only effective when `EnableUA` is set to `true`.
* If viewers cannot be redirected to the direct link, they will be redirected to the link provided in `RedirectUrl`.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.EnableAdd.description_cn:
是否开启商品的加入购物车功能，展示加购按钮。取值如下：

* `0`：不展示
* `1`：展示
ProductConfig.Product.Products.EnableAdd.description_en:
Enable the add-to-cart feature for products and display the add-to-cart button. Available values:

* `0`: Do not display
* `1`: Display

ProductConfig.Product.Products.EnableSta.description_cn:
是否上架商品。取值如下：
- `0`：下架
- `1`：上架
ProductConfig.Product.Products.EnableSta.description_en:
Product Listing Status
Values:
- `0`: Delisted
- `1`: Listed

ProductConfig.Product.Products.ExplainSt.description_cn:
商品讲解状态。取值如下：
- `0`：未讲解
- `1`：讲解中
- `2`：讲解结束
仅在开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。更多有关直播时移的信息，详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.ExplainSt.description_en:
Product explanation status. Possible values:
- `0`: Not explained
- `1`: Explaining
- `2`: Explanation ended
This parameter is only effective when live stream time-shifting is enabled. For more information about live stream time-shifting, see [Live Stream Time-Shifting](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810).

ProductConfig.Product.Products.ExplainTi.description_cn: 最近一次修改商品讲解状态的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。取值为 `0` 表示未修改过商品讲解状态。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.ExplainTi.description_en: Time of last product explanation status modification. Unix timestamp in seconds. A value of `0` means the product explanation status has never been modified.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.FloatingS.description_cn:
是否浮窗展示商品卡片。取值如下：
- `1`：浮窗展示
- `其他值`：非浮窗展示
仅在未开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.FloatingS.description_en:
Whether to display the product card in a floating window. Possible values:
- `1`: Floating window display
- `Other values`: Non-floating window display
This parameter is effective only when the live stream shift feature is disabled

ProductConfig.Product.Products.FloatingT.description_cn:
最近一次浮窗展示商品卡片的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。取值为 `0` 表示商品卡片从未浮窗展示过。
仅在未开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.FloatingT.description_en:
Time when the product card was last shown in the floating window. Unix timestamp in seconds. A value of `0` means the product card has never been shown in the floating window.
This parameter is only effective when live rewind is disabled.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Highlight.description_cn: 商品的售卖价，即当前价格。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.Highlight.description_en: The sale price of the product, i.e., its current price

ProductConfig.Product.Products.HotSale.description_cn:
热卖提醒数量。
该参数仅在 `ReminderType` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.HotSale.description_en:
Hot Sale Reminder Quantity
This parameter is only effective when `ReminderType` is set to 1

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Index.description_cn: 商品卡片的序号。取值范围为 [0,499]。

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Introduce.description_cn: 商品图的 URL，包含协议头。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.Introduce.description_en: Product image URL, including protocol prefix

ProductConfig.Product.Products.IsOrderMs.description_cn:
是否开启下单消息。取值如下：
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启
ProductConfig.Product.Products.IsOrderMs.description_en:
Enable order messages:
Values:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On

ProductConfig.Product.Products.MiniAppDi.description_cn:
点击跳转图后的微信小程序链接，需包含协议头。当观众在移动端微信环境点击跳转图时，即可跳转至该微信小程序。
* 该参数仅在 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
* 如果观众无法跳转至微信小程序，则会跳转至 `RedirectUrl` 中传入的链接。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.MiniAppDi.description_en:
WeChat Mini Program link after clicking the redirect image, which must include the protocol header. When viewers click the redirect image in the mobile WeChat environment, they will be redirected to this WeChat Mini Program.
* This parameter is only effective when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.
* If viewers cannot be redirected to the WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to the link provided in `RedirectUrl`.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.OutOfStoc.description_cn:
商品是否售罄。商品售罄后，观看页的商品图和跳转图将展示“已抢光”的文案。取值如下：

* `0`：未售罄
* `1`：已售罄
ProductConfig.Product.Products.OutOfStoc.description_en:
Product sold-out status. After a product is sold out, the product image and redirect image on the viewing page will display the message 'Sold Out'. Values:

* `0`: Not sold out
* `1`: Sold out

ProductConfig.Product.Products.PriceHidd.description_cn:
商品售卖价格是否为隐藏状态。商品价格隐藏后，观看页的商品**售卖价**将以“待开价￥???”的文案展示。取值如下：

* `0`：未隐藏
* `1`：已隐藏
ProductConfig.Product.Products.PriceHidd.description_en:
Indicates whether the product selling price is hidden. When hidden, the product selling price on the viewing page will display as 'To be priced ￥???'. Possible values:

* `0`: Not hidden
* `1`: Hidden

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Promotion.description_cn:
活动标签类型。取值如下：
- `0`：无
- `1`：自定义
- `2`：超值购
- `3`：惊喜特惠
- `4`：低价秒杀
ProductConfig.Product.Products.Promotion.description_en:
Activity Tag Type. Possible values:
- `0`: None
- `1`: Custom
- `2`: Value Deal
- `3`: Surprise Special Offer
- `4`: Low Price Flash Sale

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Promotion.description_cn: 活动标签的 URL，包含协议头。

ProductConfig.Product.Products.RedirectI.description_cn: 跳转图的 URL，包含协议头。

ProductConfig.Product.Products.RedirectU.description_cn:
跳转兜底链接，即商品详情页的链接，包含协议头。
* 如果观众无法跳转至直达链接或微信小程序，则会跳转至该链接。
* 若未配置 `DetailRedirectUrl`，观众点击商品信息区域后，也会跳转至该链接。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.RedirectU.description_en:
Fallback redirect link, which is the product detail page link and includes the protocol header.
* If viewers cannot be redirected to the direct link or WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to this link.
* If `DetailRedirectUrl` is not configured, viewers will also be redirected to this link after clicking the product information area.

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Remark.example_cn: 超级好吃的玫瑰慕斯蛋糕

ProductConfig.Product.Products.ReminderT.description_cn:
在商品讲解期间的浮窗商品卡片和商品卡片菜单中，动效展示的提醒类型。取值如下：
- `0`：无
- `1`：热卖
- `2`：库存
ProductConfig.Product.Products.ReminderT.description_en:
Types of notification animations displayed on floating product cards and product card menus during product presentations. The values are:
- `0`: None
- `1`: Hot Sale
- `2`: Stock

ProductConfig.Product.Products.SellingPo.description_cn: 卖点标签。卖点间以分号（；）相隔。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.SellingPo.description_en:
Selling Point Tags
Separate selling points with semicolons (;)
ProductConfig.Product.Products.SellingPo.example_en: Buy 2 Get 1 Free; Spend ¥50, Get ¥20 Off

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Stock.description_cn:
库存提醒数量。
该参数仅在 `ReminderType` 取值为 `2` 时生效。
ProductConfig.Product.Products.Stock.description_en:
Inventory reminder quantity
This parameter is only effective when the value of `ReminderType` is 2

ProductConfig.Product.Products.Strikethr.description_en: The reference price of a product is its original price

ProductConfig.ProductsPosition.description_cn:
浮窗商品卡片在 PC 端观看页的展示位置。取值如下：
- `0`：播放器右上角
- `1`：播放器左上角
- `2`：播放器左下角
- `3`：播放器右下角
ProductConfig.ProductsPosition.description_en:
Display position of the floating product card on the PC viewing page. Values:
- `0`: top right of the player
- `1`: top left of the player
- `2`: bottom left of the player
- `3`: bottom right of the player

ProductConfig.UAInfo.description_cn:
直达链接的配置信息。
该参数仅在 `EnableUA` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.UAInfo.description_en:
Direct Link Configuration Information
This parameter is only effective when `EnableUA` is set to `true`.

ProductConfig.UAInfo.UAInfos.description_cn:
直达链接的配置信息。
该参数仅在 `EnableUA` 取值为 `true` 时生效。
ProductConfig.UAInfo.UAInfos.description_en:
Direct link configuration information
This parameter is only effective when `EnableUA` is set to `true`.

ProductConfig.UAInfo.UAInfos.UAAddress.description_cn: 环境 UA，与 `UAName` 一一对应。
ProductConfig.UAInfo.UAInfos.UAAddress.description_en: Each environment UA has a one-to-one correspondence with `UAName`

ProductConfig.UAInfo.UAInfos.UAName.description_cn: 环境名称，与 `UAAddress` 一一对应。

VerticalIconUrl.description_cn: 移动端观看页的购物车图标 URL，需包含协议头。不传该参数，则为默认图标。支持上传大小不超过 2 MB 的 PNG 格式的图片。建议尺寸为 100*100 px。
VerticalIconUrl.description_en: Shopping cart icon URL for the mobile viewing page must include the protocol header (e.g., http:// or https://). If not provided, the default icon is used. Supports uploading PNG images up to 2 MB. Recommended size: 100 × 100 px

ViewCartUrl.description_cn:
点击移动端**查看购物车**图标后，跳转的商城购物车页面 URL。最大支持 500 个字符。需包含协议头。
* 该参数仅在 `EnableViewCart` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
* 若此值为空，则用户点击购物车图标时，客户端不会打开购物车页面。
ViewCartUrl.description_en:
After clicking the **View Cart** icon on mobile, the URL of the store cart page to redirect to. Supports up to 500 characters. Must include the protocol header.
* This parameter is only effective when `EnableViewCart` is set to `1`.
* If this value is empty, clicking the cart icon will not open the cart page in the client.

ViewOrderUrl.description_cn:
点击**查看订单**图标后，跳转的商城订单页面 URL。最大支持 500 个字符。需包含协议头。
* 该参数仅在 `EnableViewOrder` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
* 若此值为空，则用户点击订单按钮时，客户端不会打开订单页面。
ViewOrderUrl.description_en:
After clicking the **View Order** icon, the URL of the store order page to redirect to. Supports up to 500 characters. Must include the protocol header.
* This parameter is only effective when `EnableViewOrder` is set to `1`.
* If this value is empty, clicking the order button will not open the order page in the client.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Questionnaire.description_cn: 问卷的配置信息，包含问卷 ID、题目、选项等。
Questionnaire.description_en: Questionnaire configuration information, including questionnaire ID, questions, options, and more.

Questionnaire.Description.description_cn: 问卷的详细描述或说明，将显示在问卷标题下方。最多支持输入 200 个字符。不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Description.description_en: Detailed description or instructions for the questionnaire, displayed below the questionnaire title. Up to 200 characters allowed. Cannot be only spaces.

Questionnaire.Id.description_cn: 问卷 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) 接口获取问卷 ID。
Questionnaire.Id.description_en: Questionnaire ID. You can obtain the questionnaire ID via the [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) API.

Questionnaire.IsRealNameEnable.description_cn:
是否将问卷设为实名问卷。默认为匿名问卷。支持以下取值：

* `0`：匿名问卷，用户无需登录即可提交问卷，且可以重复提交问卷。
* `1`：实名问卷。如果您需要获取填写问卷的观众昵称，且不允许观众重复提交问卷，可选择**实名问卷**。

实名问卷用于保证观众填写问卷时已登录直播间，无法保证观众使用真实姓名。如果您在**观看限制**中将**评论限制**设置为**公开**，则观众提交实名问卷时需选择输入昵称或手机号登录。
Questionnaire.IsRealNameEnable.description_en:
Whether to set the questionnaire as a real-name questionnaire. The default is anonymous. Supported values:

* `0`: Anonymous questionnaire. Users can submit without logging in and may submit multiple times.
* `1`: Real-name questionnaire. If you need to collect viewers' nicknames and prevent repeated submissions, choose **real-name questionnaire**.

A real-name questionnaire ensures viewers are logged in when submitting, but does not guarantee the use of their real names. If you set **Comment Restriction** to **Public** under **Viewing Restriction**, viewers must log in with a nickname or phone number when submitting a real-name questionnaire.

Questionnaire.Questions.description_cn: 问卷中的问题列表。最多可添加 20 个问题。传入该参数时，将以该列表全量覆盖原有问题。
Questionnaire.Questions.description_en: List of questions in the questionnaire. Up to 20 questions can be added. When this parameter is provided, the list will fully overwrite the existing questions.

Questionnaire.Questions.IsRequire.description_cn:
问题是否为必填，默认为非必填。支持以下取值：

* `0`：非必填
* `1`：必填
Questionnaire.Questions.IsRequire.description_en:
Is the question required? Default is not required. Supported values:

* `0`: Not required
* `1`: Required

Questionnaire.Questions.Options.description_cn:
选择题中的选项列表。至少需包含两个选项。
当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `select` 时，该参数必选且生效。
Questionnaire.Questions.Options.description_en:
Option list for multiple-choice questions. Must include at least two options.
When `QuestionTag` is set to `select`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

Questionnaire.Questions.Options.OptionNa.description_cn: 选项内容，最多支持输入 50 个字符，不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Questions.Options.OptionNa.description_en: Option content can be up to 50 characters and cannot be only spaces

Questionnaire.Questions.Question.description_cn: 问题内容，最多支持输入 50 个字符，不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Questions.Question.description_en: Question content, up to 50 characters. Cannot be only spaces.
Questionnaire.Questions.Question.example_cn: 您在网购时，收货方式是？
Questionnaire.Questions.Question.example_en: What is your delivery method when shopping online?

Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionSubTag.description_cn:
问题子类型。取值情况如下。

* 当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `personal_info` 时，支持以下取值： 
   * `phone_number`：手机号码。系统会校验手机号格式。
   * `email`：邮箱，系统会校验邮箱格式。
   * `nickname`：昵称。如果用户已登录，则系统会自动填充昵称且用户无法更改。
* 当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `blank_filling` 时，该参数仅支持 `text` 取值，表示填空题。最多支持观众填入 200 个字符。
* 当 `QuestionTag` 取值为 `select` 时，支持以下取值：
   * `radio`：单选题。
   * `checkbox`：多选题。
Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionSubTag.description_en:
Question subtype. Supported values are as follows.

* When `QuestionTag` is set to `personal_info`, the following values are supported:
   * `phone_number`: Mobile number. The system will validate the phone number format.
   * `email`: Email. The system will validate the email format.
   * `nickname`: Nickname. If the user is logged in, the system will auto-fill the nickname and the user cannot change it.
* When `QuestionTag` is set to `blank_filling`, this parameter only supports the value `text`, indicating a fill-in-the-blank question. Audience can enter up to 200 characters.
* When `QuestionTag` is set to `select`, the following values are supported:
   * `radio`: Single-choice question.
   * `checkbox`: Multiple-choice question.

Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionTag.description_cn:
问题类型。支持以下取值：

* `personal_info`：个人信息。支持手机号、邮箱和昵称。
* `blank_filling`：填空题。
* `select`：选择题。支持单选和多选。
Questionnaire.Questions.QuestionTag.description_en:
Question type. Supported values:

* `personal_info`: Personal information. Supports mobile number, email, and nickname.
* `blank_filling`: Fill-in-the-blank question.
* `select`: Multiple-choice question. Supports single-choice and multiple-choice questions.

Questionnaire.SendTime.description_cn:
定时发送问卷的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。设定时间必须晚于当前时间至少 1 分钟。 
当 `TriggerTime` 取值为 `auto_send` 时，该参数必选且生效。
Questionnaire.SendTime.description_en:
Scheduled questionnaire dispatch time. Unix timestamp in seconds. The scheduled time must be at least 1 minute later than the current time.
When `TriggerTime` is set to `auto_send`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

Questionnaire.Title.description_cn: 问卷的标题。最多支持输入 60 个字符。不可为纯空格。
Questionnaire.Title.description_en: Questionnaire title. Up to 60 characters allowed. Cannot be only spaces.

Questionnaire.TriggerTime.description_cn:
问卷的发送时机。支持以下取值：

* `live_page_in`：当观众进入直播间时弹出问卷
* `live_end`：当直播结束时弹出问卷
* `manual`：手动发送问卷，问卷发送后在观看页弹出
* `auto_send`：定时发送问卷，问卷将在指定时间在观看页弹出
Questionnaire.TriggerTime.description_en:
Questionnaire dispatch timing. Supported values:

* `live_page_in`: Display the questionnaire when viewers enter the live room
* `live_end`: Display the questionnaire when the live stream ends
* `manual`: Manually send the questionnaire; it will pop up on the viewing page after being sent
* `auto_send`: Schedule the questionnaire to be sent; it will pop up on the viewing page at the specified time

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送题目的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。该时间至少需在当前时间的一分钟之后。
仅在 `QuizType` 取值为 `0` 且 `SendType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled send time for the quiz. Unix timestamp in seconds. This time must be at least one minute after the current time.
This parameter is only effective when `QuizType` is set to `0` and `SendType` is set to `1`.

Deadline.description_cn:
答题或简答限时。单位为秒。最小取值为 `10`。
仅在 `QuizResultType` 取值为 `0` 或 `1` 时，该参数生效。
Deadline.description_en:
Time limit for answering or short answers. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: `10`.
This parameter is only effective when `QuizResultType` is set to `0` or `1`.

Id.description_cn:
答题或简答 ID。

* 要创建答题或简答，请不传或传 `0`。
* 要更新答题或简答的配置信息，您需通过调用 [ListActivityQuizConfigs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1337940) 接口获取 ID。
Id.description_en:
Quiz or short answer ID.

* To create a quiz or short answer, do not pass this parameter or set it to `0`.
* To update the configuration of a quiz or short answer, you need to obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityQuizConfigs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1337940) interface.

QuizOptions.description_cn: 选项信息。数组元素数量上限为 8。
QuizOptions.description_en:
Option Information
The maximum number of array elements is 8

QuizOptions.OptionName.description_cn:
选项内容。默认为空。
该参数仅在 `QuizType` 取值为 `0` 时生效。
QuizOptions.OptionName.description_en:
Option content. Default is empty.
This parameter only takes effect when `QuizType` is set to 0.

QuizResultType.description_cn:
公布答案时机。取值如下：

* `0`：提交后自动公布答案
* `1`：答题时间结束自动公布答案
* `2`：手动公布答案
QuizResultType.description_en:
Answer reveal timing. Possible values:

* `0`: Automatically reveal the answer after submission
* `1`: Automatically reveal the answer when the quiz time ends
* `2`: Manually reveal the answer

QuizTitle.description_cn: 答题或简答标题。默认为空。
QuizTitle.description_en: Answer or short response title (default: empty)

QuizTitleType.description_cn:
题目类型。取值如下：

* `0`：单选
* `1`：多选
QuizTitleType.description_en:
Quiz type. Possible values:

* `0`: Single choice
* `1`: Multiple choice

QuizType.description_cn:
类型。取值如下：

* `0`：答题
* `1`：简答
QuizType.description_en:
Type. Possible values:

* `0`: Quiz
* `1`: Short answer

RightOptions.description_cn:
正确答案。确保取值与本次调用中的某个 `OptionSite` 的取值相同。
要创建答题或简答，该参数必填。
RightOptions.description_en:
Correct answer. Make sure the value matches one of the `OptionSite` values in this request.
This parameter is required when creating a quiz or short answer.

SendType.description_cn:
题目的发送方式。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送，由管理员手动操作发送题目
* `1`：定时发送，设置一个特定的时间点，系统将在设置的时间自动发送答题

仅在 `QuizType` 取值为 `0` 时该参数生效。
SendType.description_en:
Quiz sending method. Possible values:

* `0`: Manual send, the administrator manually sends the quiz
* `1`: Scheduled send, set a specific time and the system will automatically send the quiz at the scheduled time

This parameter is only effective when `QuizType` is set to `0`.

ActivityID.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityID.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Animation.description_cn: 红包动效 0-标准动效 1-关闭动效
Animation.description_en: Red packet animation effect 0 - Standard animation 1 - Animation off

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送红包的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
仅当 `SendRedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled red packet sending time. Unix timestamp in seconds.
This parameter is required only when `SendRedPacketType` is set to `1`.

AwardCondition.description_cn:
参与条件配置。
观众只有在同时满足开启的参与条件后，才能参与抢红包。
如果开启问卷、投票、签到、答题或简答参与条件，观众必须在本场直播期间完成相关活动，才能被视为有效参与。也就是说，直播间必须处于**直播中**状态，且活动必须在本场直播期间完成。
AwardCondition.description_en:
Participation Requirement Settings
Viewers can join the red envelope event only if they meet all enabled participation requirements.
If survey, poll, check-in, quiz, or short answer requirements are enabled, viewers must complete the related activities during the current live stream for their participation to count. The live room must be in **Live** status, and activities must be completed within the same live session.

AwardCondition.CheckIn.description_cn:
签到参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启签到参与条件
- `all`：提交全部签到。全部签到指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部签到
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的签到
AwardCondition.CheckIn.description_en:
Check-in participation criteria. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: Check-in participation criteria not enabled
- `all`: Submit all check-ins. All check-ins means every check-in sent from the start of this live stream until the period of participating in this red envelope event
- `1-999`: Submit at least the specified number of check-ins

AwardCondition.Questionnaire.description_cn:
问卷参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启问卷参与条件
- `all`：提交全部问卷。全部问卷指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部问卷
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的问卷
AwardCondition.Questionnaire.description_en:
Questionnaire participation criteria. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: Questionnaire participation criteria are not enabled
- `all`: Submit all questionnaires. All questionnaires refer to those sent from the start of this livestream until the period of participating in this red envelope draw
- `1-999`: Submit at least the specified number of questionnaires

AwardCondition.Quiz.description_cn:
答题或简答参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启答题或简答参与条件
- `all`：提交全部答题或简答。全部答题或简答指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部答题或简答
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的答题或简答
AwardCondition.Quiz.description_en:
Participation conditions for answering questions or providing short answers. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: No participation conditions for answering questions or short answers
- `all`: Submit all answers or short responses sent from the start of this livestream up to and during participation in the red envelope event
- `1-999`: Submit at least the specified number of answers or short responses

AwardCondition.RightQuiz.description_cn:
答题或简答参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启答题或简答参与条件
- `all`：答对全部答题或简答。全部答题或简答指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部答题或简答
- `1-999`：至少答对参数值指定个数的答题或简答
AwardCondition.RightQuiz.description_en:
Question or short answer participation criteria. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: Participation criteria for questions or short answers are not enabled
- `all`: Must answer all questions or short answers correctly. This includes all questions or short answers sent from the start of this livestream up to and during the red envelope participation period
- `1-999`: Must answer at least the specified number of questions or short answers correctly

AwardCondition.Vote.description_cn:
投票参与条件。默认为空值。取值如下：
- 空值：不开启投票参与条件
- `all`：提交全部投票。全部投票指从本场直播开始至参与本次抢红包期间发送的全部投票
- `1-999`：至少提交参数值指定个数的投票
AwardCondition.Vote.description_en:
Voting participation criteria. Default is empty. Options:
- Empty: Voting participation criteria not enabled
- `all`: Submit all votes. All votes refers to every vote sent from the start of this livestream until the period of participating in this red envelope event
- `1-999`: Submit at least the specified number of votes

BarragePwd.description_cn: 弹幕口令。传入该参数后，将开启弹幕参与条件，观众必须发送该弹幕口令，才能参与抢红包。
BarragePwd.description_en: Barrage Code. After you enter this parameter, viewers must send the barrage code to participate in grabbing red envelopes

BlackUserInfoId.description_cn:
中奖黑名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口获取 ID。
中奖黑名单，即无法中奖的人员名单。如果某观众被同时添加进优先中奖名单和中奖黑名单，则该观众无法中奖。
BlackUserInfoId.description_en: Winner blacklist ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API. The winner blacklist is a list of users who cannot win prizes. If a viewer is added to both the priority winner list and the winner blacklist, the viewer cannot win.

ClaimFailureText.description_cn: 观众未抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，默认为**很遗憾，您没有抢到红包**。
ClaimFailureText.description_en: Prompt message shown when the audience fails to grab a red envelope. Length: 1 to 100 characters. If this parameter is not provided, the default is **Unfortunately, you didn't get a red envelope**.
ClaimFailureText.example_cn: 很遗憾，您没有抢到红包
ClaimFailureText.example_en: Sorry, you didn't manage to grab a red envelope

ClaimSuccessText.description_cn: 观众抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，现金红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到现金红包**，积分红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到积分红包**。
ClaimSuccessText.description_en: Prompt message shown when a viewer claims a red envelope. Length: 1 to 100 characters. If this parameter is not provided, the default message for a cash red envelope is **Congratulations, you have claimed a cash red envelope**, and for a points red envelope is **Congratulations, you have claimed a points red envelope**.
ClaimSuccessText.example_en: Congratulations, you grabbed a cash red envelope

CustomRedirectUrl.description_cn:
自定义地址。长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
CustomRedirectUrl.description_en:
Custom address (1–500 characters)
This field is required and takes effect when `EnableCustomRedirect` is set to true

DeadLine.description_cn:
开奖倒计时。取值范围为 `[1,999]`，单位为分钟。默认值为 `5`。
当 `OpenRedPacketType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
DeadLine.description_en:
Draw countdown. Value range: [1,999] (minutes). Default: 5
This parameter is required and active when OpenRedPacketType is set to 0.

EnableCustomRedirect.description_cn:
是否开启自定义地址提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，观众点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至 `CustomRedirectUrl` 配置的自定义地址页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 和 `EnableMiniApp` 的取值均为 `true` 时，则：
- 在移动端微信环境下，观众会跳转至微信小程序页面
- 在其他环境下，观众会跳转至自定义地址页面
EnableCustomRedirect.description_en:
Enable custom withdrawal redirect. Default value is `false`. Options: 
- `true`: Enabled. When enabled, viewers who click **Withdraw Now** are redirected to the custom address page specified by `CustomRedirectUrl`. You are responsible for distributing the prize amount and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on this page
- `false`: Disabled
If both `EnableCustomRedirect` and `EnableMiniApp` are set to `true`:
- On mobile WeChat, viewers are redirected to the WeChat Mini Program page
- In other environments, viewers are redirected to the custom address page

EnableMiniApp.description_cn:
是否开启微信小程序提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，移动端观众在微信环境下点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至指定微信小程序页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
EnableMiniApp.description_en:
Enable WeChat Mini Program withdrawal redirect. Default value is `false`. Options:
- `true`: Enable. When enabled, mobile users in the WeChat environment can tap **Withdraw Now** to go to the specified WeChat Mini Program page. You are responsible for distributing prize money and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on that page.
- `false`: Disable

IsOpenSmsNotification.description_cn:
是否开启短信提醒。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启。开启后，通过手机号登录直播间的观众，在中奖时会收到企业直播发送的红包中奖提醒短信
IsOpenSmsNotification.description_en:
Enable SMS notifications. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On. When enabled, viewers who log in to the live room with their phone number will receive a red packet winning notification SMS from Enterprise Live when they win

MiniAppId.description_cn:
微信小程序的 App ID，跳转后的页面属于该微信小程序。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
完成以下步骤，获取 App ID。
1. 使用微信小程序账号登录[微信公众平台](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/)。
2. 在左侧导航栏，选择**设置**。
3. 在**基本设置**页签下查看 App ID。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppId.description_en:
App ID for the WeChat Mini Program. The redirected page belongs to this Mini Program. Length must be between 1 and 100 characters.

Follow these steps to get the App ID:
1. Log in to the [WeChat Official Platform](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/) using your WeChat Mini Program account.
2. In the left navigation bar, select **Settings**.
3. On the **Basic Settings** tab, view the App ID.
This parameter is required and will take effect when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.

MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_cn:
跳转后的页面在微信小程序中的相对路径。 长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_en:
Relative path of the redirected page in the WeChat Mini Program. Length must be between 1 and 500 characters
This parameter is required and takes effect when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`

Name.description_cn:
自定义红包名称。最多支持输入 20 个字符。如果不传值，则：

* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为正整数（即红包个数为指定数量）时，则展示总金额数，如 “1000.00元”或 “3000积分”。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1`（即红包个数为无限制）时，积分红包的名称为 “99999积分”，现金红包的名称为 “99999元”。
Name.description_en:
Custom red packet name. Supports up to 20 characters. If not provided:

* When `RewardPointNumber` is a positive integer (i.e., the number of red packets is a specified quantity), the total amount is displayed, such as "1000.00 yuan" or "3000 points"
* When `RewardPointNumber` is `-1` (i.e., unlimited number of red packets), the name for points red packets is "99999 points", and for cash red packets is "99999 yuan"

OpenRedPacketType.description_cn:
开奖方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：自动开奖
- `1`：手动开奖
OpenRedPacketType.description_en:
Draw method. Default value is `0`. Available options:
- `0`: Automatic draw
- `1`: Manual draw

RangeStatus.description_cn:
中奖条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：所有观众的中奖概率相同
- `1`：未中奖观众优先，即加大在当前直播间 30 天未中奖观众的中奖概率
- `2`：重复中奖限制
RangeStatus.description_en:
Winning conditions. Default value: `0`
- `0`: All viewers have an equal chance of winning
- `1`: Priority for viewers who haven't won, i.e. viewers who haven't won in the past 30 days in this livestream have a higher chance of winning
- `2`: Restriction on repeat winning

RedPacketCoverImage.description_cn:
观看页展示的红包图标的 URL。不传该参数，则使用默认红包图标。
通常情况下，需要传入带协议头的 URL 作为参数值。但如果您获取到了通过[企业直播控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/)上传的图片的 URL（例如通过调用 [GetActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471375) 获取到了某直播间通过控制台上传的红包图标 URL），则该不带有协议头的 URL 可作为该参数的参数值。
RedPacketCoverImage.description_en: URL for the red packet icon displayed on the viewing page. If you do not provide this parameter, the default red packet icon is used. Normally, provide a URL that includes the protocol header. However, if you have obtained a URL for an image uploaded via the [Enterprise Live Streaming Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) (for example, by calling [GetActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471375) to get the red packet icon URL uploaded via the console for a specific live stream), you can use the URL without the protocol header as the parameter value.

RedPacketID.description_cn: 红包 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 接口获取 ID。
RedPacketID.description_en: Red Packet ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) API.

RedPacketNumber.description_cn:
金额随机时，设置的红包个数。取值范围为 `[1,2000]`。
当 `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RedPacketNumber.description_en:
When the amount is random, set the number of red packets. Value range: `[1,2000]`.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.

RedPacketType.description_cn:
红包类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：现金红包
- `1`：积分红包
您可以进行二次开发，按照红包中奖结果，向抢到红包的观众发放积分或让观众完成现金红包提现。详见[接入流程](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B)。
RedPacketType.description_en:
Red packet type. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Cash red packet
- `1`: Points red packet
You can further develop the feature so that, based on the red packet winning result, you can award points to viewers who grab a red packet or allow viewers to withdraw cash red packets. For details, see [Integration Process](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B).

RepeatedAwardLimit.description_cn:
同一观众在当前直播间 30 天内允许中奖（包括实时抽奖和红包）的次数。取值范围为 `[1,99]`。默认值为 `1`。
当 `RangeStatus` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RepeatedAwardLimit.description_en:
Number of times a single viewer can win prizes (including real-time draws and red packets) in this live stream room within 30 days. Value range: `[1,99]`. Default: `1`.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `RangeStatus` is set to `2`.

RewardsPointsConfig.AmountCalculationTyp.description_cn:
金额计算方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：随机金额
- `1`：指定金额
RewardsPointsConfig.AmountCalculationTyp.description_en:
Amount calculation method. Default value: `0`. Possible values:
- `0`: Random amount
- `1`: Specified amount

RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_cn:
指定金额的红包配置。最多支持配置 6 对金额和红包个数的组合。
当 `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_en:
Red packet configuration with specified amounts. Supports up to 6 combinations of amount and number of red packets.
When `AmountCalculationType` is set to `1`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_cn:
现金红包或积分红包的金额。

* 当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `0` 时，参数取值范围为 `[10,20000]`，表示 0.1 元到 200 元。单位为分
* 当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，参数取值范围为 `[1,100000]`。单位可通过 `RewardsPointsUnit`参数配置
RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_en:
Amount for cash red packets or points red packets.

* When `RedPacketType` is `0`, the parameter range is `[10,20000]`, representing 0.1 yuan to 200 yuan. Unit: fen
* When `RedPacketType` is `1`, the parameter range is `[1,100000]`. The unit can be configured via the `RewardsPointsUnit` parameter

RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_cn:
红包个数。取值如下：

* `-1`：不限制个数
* `1-2000`：红包个数
RewardsPointsConfig.FixedRewardPointConf.description_en:
Number of red packets. Value options:

* `-1`: No limit on the number of red packets
* `1-2000`: Number of red packets

RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsBatch.description_cn:
批次号，用于区分不同批次的积分。观众参与抢红包后，您可根据批次号和中奖金额，向抢到红包的观众发送积分。
当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsBatch.description_en:
Batch number, used to distinguish points from different batches. After viewers participate in the red packet grab, you can send points to viewers who received a red packet based on the batch number and winning amount.
When `RedPacketType` is set to `1`, this parameter takes effect.

RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsUnit.description_cn:
积分单位。默认为**积分**。
当 `RedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RewardsPointsConfig.RewardsPointsUnit.description_en:
Points unit. Default is **points**.
When `RedPacketType` is set to `1`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

SendRedPacketType.description_cn:
红包的发送方式，默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime`参数选择定时发送的时间。
SendRedPacketType.description_en:
Red packet sending method. Default value: `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual send
* `1`: Scheduled send. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled sending time

TotalAmount.description_cn:
金额随机时，红包总金额或总积分。
* 当  `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
* 对于不同红包类型，其金额或积分单位不同：
   * 现金红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `0`）时，取值范围为 `[10,2000000]`，单位为分
   * 积分红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `1`）时，取值范围为 `[1,100000]`，单位可通过 `RewardsPointsUnit` 参数配置
TotalAmount.description_en:
When the amount is random, total red packet amount or total points.
* This parameter is required and takes effect when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.
* For different red packet types, the unit for amount or points varies:
   * Cash red packet (`RedPacketType` set to `0`): value range `[10,2000000]`, unit is fen (Chinese cent)
   * Points red packet (`RedPacketType` set to `1`): value range `[1,100000]`, unit can be configured via the `RewardsPointsUnit` parameter

VipUserInfoId.description_cn:
优先中奖名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378)接口获取 ID。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1` 时，该参数不生效。表示当红包配置中存在不限制红包个数的金额时，不支持设置优先中奖名单。
* 当优先中奖名单中的人数大于红包数量，则在优先中奖名单中随机抽奖。
* 当红包数量大于优先中奖名单中的人数时，则优先中奖名单中的观众全部中奖且优先获得较大金额的红包，多出的红包在普通观众中随机抽奖。
* 优先中奖名单中，已登录的观众（仅输入昵称的观众除外）无需手动参与抢红包，如果开奖时正在观看直播，即可收到中奖弹窗通知。
VipUserInfoId.description_en:
Priority winner list ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API.
* When `RewardPointNumber` is set to `-1`, this parameter is not effective. If the red packet configuration allows unlimited red packet quantity, setting a priority winner list is not supported.
* If the number of users in the priority winner list exceeds the number of red packets, winners are randomly selected from the priority winner list.
* If the number of red packets exceeds the number of users in the priority winner list, all users in the priority winner list win and receive the larger red packets first. The remaining red packets are randomly awarded to regular viewers.
* Logged-in viewers in the priority winner list (excluding those who only entered a nickname) do not need to manually participate in the red packet draw. If they are watching the live stream during the draw, they will receive a winning notification popup.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ReplayPlayerConfig.IsProgressBarEnable.description_cn:
是否显示进度条。取值如下：
- `0`：不显示
- `1`：显示
`IsProgressBarEnable`、`IsResolutionEnable` 和 `IsSpeedControlEnable` 至少有一个必选。
ReplayPlayerConfig.IsProgressBarEnable.description_en:
Show progress bar. Possible values:
- `0`: Do not show
- `1`: Show
At least one of `IsProgressBarEnable`, `IsResolutionEnable`, or `IsSpeedControlEnable` is required.

ReplayPlayerConfig.IsResolutionEnable.description_cn:
是否显示清晰度选择按钮。取值如下：
- `0`：不显示
- `1`：显示
`IsProgressBarEnable`、`IsResolutionEnable` 和 `IsSpeedControlEnable` 至少有一个必选。
ReplayPlayerConfig.IsResolutionEnable.description_en:
Whether to show the resolution selection button. Values:
- `0`: Do not show
- `1`: Show
At least one of `IsProgressBarEnable`, `IsResolutionEnable`, or `IsSpeedControlEnable` is required.

ReplayPlayerConfig.IsSpeedControlEnable.description_cn:
是否显示倍速选择按钮。取值如下：
- `0`：不显示
- `1`：显示
`IsProgressBarEnable`、`IsResolutionEnable` 和 `IsSpeedControlEnable` 至少有一个必选。
ReplayPlayerConfig.IsSpeedControlEnable.description_en:
Whether to display the speed selection button. Values:
- `0`: Do not display
- `1`: Display
At least one of `IsProgressBarEnable`, `IsResolutionEnable`, or `IsSpeedControlEnable` is required

ActivityId.description_cn: 直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID
You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface

RobotCommentConfig.IsRobotEnable.description_cn:
是否开启机器人评论库。取值如下：
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启
将参数值设置为 `1` 后，可调用 [AddRobotComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1321483) 和 [AddRobotNickNames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1321486) 接口添加机器人评论和昵称，机器人会按照发送规则，随机使用添加的昵称自动发送添加的评论内容。
RobotCommentConfig.IsRobotEnable.description_en:
Enable Robot Comment Library. Available values:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On
When set to `1`, you can use the [AddRobotComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1321483) and [AddRobotNickNames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1321486) APIs to add robot comments and nicknames. The robot will automatically send the added comments using the added nicknames, selecting them at random according to the sending rules.

RobotCommentConfig.RobotCommentRepositor.description_cn:
机器人评论库 ID。您可通过调用 [AddActivityRobotCommentRepository](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1451797) 接口获取 ID。
默认值为 `0`，即默认评论库。
RobotCommentConfig.RobotCommentRepositor.description_en: Robot comment repository ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [AddActivityRobotCommentRepository](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1451797) API. The default value is `0`, which is the default comment repository.

RobotCommentConfig.RobotCommentRepositor.description_cn: 机器人评论库的名称。长度为 1 到 10 个字符。不传该参数，则不更新评论库名称。
RobotCommentConfig.RobotCommentRepositor.description_en: The name of the robot comment library must be 1–10 characters long. If this parameter is not provided, the comment library name will not be updated.

RobotCommentConfig.RobotSendNum.description_cn:
取值范围为 [1,60]。
每当直播间内有 `RobotSendUnit` 参数指定的在线人数时，每分钟将自动发送 `RobotSendNum` 参数指定的评论条数，即直播间内每分钟自动发送的机器人评论总数 = 当前在线人数 ÷ `RobotSendUnit`（取整数部分） × `RobotSendNum`。
例如，`RobotSendUnit` 取值为 `30`，`RobotSendNum` 取值为 `5`，当直播间内有 100 在线人数时，每分钟将自动发送 15 条评论（100 ÷ 30（取整数部分）× 5）。
直播间内每分钟最多支持自动发送 60 条机器人评论。
RobotCommentConfig.RobotSendNum.description_en:
Value range: [1, 60]
For every group of online users specified by the `RobotSendUnit` parameter, the system automatically sends the number of comments specified by the `RobotSendNum` parameter per minute. The total number of robot comments sent per minute = current online users ÷ `RobotSendUnit` (integer part only) × `RobotSendNum`.
For example, if `RobotSendUnit` is set to 30 and `RobotSendNum` is set to 5, when there are 100 online users in the live room, 15 comments will be sent automatically per minute (100 ÷ 30 [integer part] × 5).
A maximum of 60 robot comments can be sent automatically per minute in the live room.

RobotCommentConfig.RobotSendUnit.description_cn:
取值范围为 [1,999]。
每当直播间内有 `RobotSendUnit` 参数指定的在线人数时，每分钟将自动发送 `RobotSendNum` 参数指定的评论条数，即直播间内每分钟自动发送的机器人评论总数 = 当前在线人数 ÷ `RobotSendUnit`（取整数部分） × `RobotSendNum`。
例如，`RobotSendUnit` 取值为 `30`，`RobotSendNum` 取值为 `5`，当直播间内有 100 在线人数时，每分钟将自动发送 15 条评论（100 ÷ 30（取整数部分）× 5）。
直播间内每分钟最多支持自动发送 60 条机器人评论。
RobotCommentConfig.RobotSendUnit.description_en:
Value range: [1,999]
For every group of online users in the live room as specified by the `RobotSendUnit` parameter, the system automatically sends the number of comments specified by the `RobotSendNum` parameter each minute. The total number of automated robot comments sent per minute = current online users ÷ `RobotSendUnit` (integer part only) × `RobotSendNum`.
For example, if `RobotSendUnit` is set to 30 and `RobotSendNum` is set to 5, and there are 100 online users in the live room, 15 comments will be sent automatically each minute (100 ÷ 30 [integer part only] × 5).
A maximum of 60 automated robot comments can be sent per minute in the live room.

BanStatus.description_cn:
封禁或解除封禁。取值如下：
- `0`：解除封禁
- `1`：封禁
当 `BanType` 取值为 `0` 或未传入 `BanType` 时，该参数必选且生效。
BanStatus.description_en:
Ban or unban. Possible values:
- `0`: Unban
- `1`: Ban
When `BanType` is set to `0` or not provided, this parameter is required and will take effect.

BanType.description_cn:
操作类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：封禁或解除封禁
- `1`：踢出
BanType.description_en:
Operation type. Default value is `0`. Possible values:
- `0`: Ban or unban
- `1`: Kick out

Cookies.description_cn:
封禁、踢出或解除封禁的设备 ID 列表。您可调用 [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) 接口，通过返回参数 `Cookie` 获取设备 ID。
建议仅在观众未登录直播间时，使用设备 ID 进行封禁。
* 由于获取的设备 ID 为 Long 类型，请先将取值从 Long 类型转换为 String 类型，再传入该参数。
* `UserIds` 、`Cookies`  和 `ExternalUserIds` 至少有一个必选。
Cookies.description_en:
List of device IDs that are banned, kicked out, or unbanned. You can call the [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) API and get the device ID from the returned `Cookie` parameter.
We recommend using device IDs for banning only when viewers are not logged in to the live room.
* Since the device ID is of type Long, convert the value from Long to String before passing it to this parameter.
* At least one of `UserIds`, `Cookies`, or `ExternalUserIds` is required

ExternalUserIds.description_cn:
封禁、踢出或解除封禁的关联用户 ID 列表。关联用户 ID 是观众在第三方平台的唯一标识。您可以根据该 ID 识别企业自身的用户身份，以便于按需实现用户洞察和进行数据分析。观众通过不同方式登录直播间时，关联用户 ID 取值不同，具体取值情况详见[数据统计](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/148172#%E8%A7%82%E4%BC%97%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE)。
最多支持传入 50 个关联用户 ID。
ExternalUserIds.description_en:
List of associated user IDs that have been banned, kicked out, or unbanned. An associated user ID uniquely identifies a viewer on a third-party platform. You can use this ID to identify your organization's users as needed for user insights and data analysis. The value of the associated user ID varies depending on how the viewer logs in to the live room. For details, see [Data Statistics](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/148172#%E8%A7%82%E4%BC%97%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE).
Up to 50 associated user IDs are supported.

UserIds.description_cn:
封禁、踢出或解除封禁的用户 ID 列表。您可调用 [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) 接口，通过返回参数 `UserId` 获取用户 ID。
除观众未登录直播间的情况外，均推荐使用用户 ID 进行封禁。
`UserIds` 、`Cookies`  和 `ExternalUserIds` 至少有一个必选。
UserIds.description_en:
List of user IDs to ban, kick, or unban. You can call the [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) API and obtain user IDs from the returned `UserId` parameter.
Except when viewers have not logged into the live room, we recommend using user IDs for banning.
At least one of `UserIds`, `Cookies`, or `ExternalUserIds` is required.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID 或点播间 ID。获取方式如下：

* 您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) 接口获取直播间 ID
* 您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取点播间 ID

使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间或点播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID or on-demand room ID. Obtain as follows:

* You can get the live room ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) interface
* You can get the on-demand room ID by calling the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) interface

When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure the live room or on-demand room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the visibility scope of a sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsBilingualEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启中英双语生成。支持以下取值：

* `true`：开启。开启后，后续 AI 总结将自动生成中英双语的视频摘要和知识点总结。观众的观看页将默认显示当前 PC 端浏览器默认语言或移动端系统语言的内容
* `false`：关闭

本参数和 `PublishMode` 参数至少需要传一个。未传入的参数将保持当前配置不变。
IsBilingualEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable bilingual (Chinese and English) generation. Supported values:

* `true`: Enable. When enabled, subsequent AI summaries will automatically generate bilingual video summaries and key point summaries. The viewer page will display content in the default language of the current PC browser or mobile system
* `false`: Disable

At least one of this parameter or the `PublishMode` parameter must be provided. Parameters not provided will retain their current configuration.

PublishMode.description_cn:
视频总结生成后是否自动发布。支持以下取值：

* `1`：自动发布。AI 生成内容后直接发布
* `2`：手动发布。设为手动发布后，您可以在 AI 生成内容后继续编辑内容

本参数和 `IsBilingualEnabled` 参数至少需要传一个。未传入的参数将保持当前配置不变。
PublishMode.description_en:
Whether to automatically publish the video summary after it is generated. Supported values:

* `1`: Auto publish. The AI-generated content will be published directly
* `2`: Manual publish. When set to manual, you can continue editing the content after the AI generates it

At least one of this parameter or the `IsBilingualEnabled` parameter must be provided. Parameters not provided will retain their current configuration.

ExternalUserId.description_cn:
观众的关联用户 ID，即在第三方平台的唯一标识。观众通过不同方式登录直播间，关联用户 ID 的取值如下所示。

* 微信：观众在企业直播微信服务号的 OpenID。
* 企业微信：绑定企业直播的企业内部成员 OpenID。
* 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
* OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
* 飞书：绑定企业直播的飞书企业成员 Open ID。
* 手机号：观众通过手机号注册企业直播后生成的 passport_id。
* 白名单：观众输入的白名单校验信息。

* 如果您集成了观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式，关联用户 ID 的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时、或调用 [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153) 后生成 JWT 时，传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
* 本参数和 `UserId` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，`UserId` 参数的优先级更高。
ExternalUserId.description_en:
The associated user ID of the viewer, which is the unique identifier on a third-party platform. The value of the associated user ID depends on how the viewer logs in to the live room:

* WeChat: The viewer's OpenID in the Enterprise Live WeChat service account.
* WeCom: The OpenID of an internal member bound to Enterprise Live.
* Custom: The value passed in via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578).
* OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system.
* Feishu: The Open ID of a Feishu enterprise member bound to Enterprise Live.
* Mobile number: The passport_id generated after the viewer registers for Enterprise Live with a mobile number.
* Allowlist: The allowlist verification information entered by the viewer.

* If you have integrated the Viewer SDK and the SDK authentication mode is custom, the value of the associated user ID is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed in when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) API or after generating a JWT via [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153).
* You must provide at least one of this parameter or `UserId`. If both are provided, the `UserId` parameter takes precedence.

AttentionDetectionConfigArray.description_cn: 认真度检测配置信息列表。

AttentionDetectionConfigArray.AttentionD.description_cn:
认真度检测类型。支持以下取值：

* `1`：观看前提示
* `2`：切屏检测提醒
* `3`：静音停播提醒
* `4`：无互动检测提醒
* `5`：无互动检测踢出
* `6`：静音停播检测踢出
AttentionDetectionConfigArray.AttentionD.description_en:
Engagement detection type. Supports the following values:

* `1`: Pre-viewing prompt
* `2`: Screen switching detection alert
* `3`: Mute and pause alert
* `4`: No interaction detection alert
* `5`: No interaction detection removal
* `6`: Mute and pause detection removal

AttentionDetectionConfigArray.DetectionR.description_cn: 认真度检测的触发时间。达到该字段指定的时长后，根据 `AttentionDetectionType` 对应的检测类型，对观众弹窗提醒或踢出。例如观众静音播放或暂停播放达到指定时长后，触发静音停播检测提醒或踢出。单位为秒。
AttentionDetectionConfigArray.DetectionR.description_en: Trigger time for attention detection. After the specified duration elapses, the system displays a popup reminder or removes the viewer based on the detection type defined by `AttentionDetectionType`. For example, if a viewer mutes or pauses playback for the specified duration, the system triggers a mute or pause detection reminder or removal. Unit: seconds.

AudienceGroupUsers.AudienceGroupId.description_cn:
