AudienceGroupUsers.AudienceGroupId.description_en:
ID of the live streaming group you want to move to. You can query the ID using the [ListAudienceGroupUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263529) API.
You must provide at least one of `AudienceGroupName` or `AudienceGroupId`. If both are provided, `AudienceGroupId` takes priority.

AudienceGroupUsers.AudienceGroupName.description_cn:
期望移动到的直播分组的名称。若分组不存在，会自动创建该分组。您可以通过 [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) 接口查询分组名称。
`AudienceGroupName` 和 `AudienceGroupId` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`AudienceGroupId` 的优先级更高。
AudienceGroupUsers.AudienceGroupName.description_en:
Name of the target live stream group. If the group does not exist, it will be created automatically. You can query group names using the [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) API.
You must provide at least one of `AudienceGroupName` or `AudienceGroupId`. If both are provided, `AudienceGroupId` takes priority.

AudienceGroupUsers.FlagId.description_cn:
观众的唯一标识。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
- 如果观众已进入直播间，您可调用 [ListAudienceGroupUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263529) 接口获取唯一标识。
- 如果观众还未进入直播间，您可将参数值设置为以下取值。观众通过输入昵称或其他方式登录直播间后，即可自动进入您期望移动到的直播分组。
	观众通过不同方式登录直播间，其唯一标识的取值如下所示。
	- 公开：观众昵称。
	- 密码：观众昵称。
	- 邀请码：观众昵称。
	- 白名单：观众登录时输入的白名单信息。
	- 飞书：飞书昵称。
	- 微信：观众昵称。
	- 企业微信：观众昵称。
	- 手机号：观众登录时输入的手机号。
	- 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
	- OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
- 如果您集成了 Web 观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式（即 `mode` = `2`），唯一标识的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
- `UserId` 和 `FlagId` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`UserId` 的优先级更高。
AudienceGroupUsers.FlagId.description_en:
Unique audience identifier. Must be 1–100 characters long
- If the audience has already joined the live room, you can call the [ListAudienceGroupUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263529) API to obtain the unique identifier
- If the audience has not yet joined the live room, you can set the parameter value as one of the following options. After the audience logs in to the live room by entering a nickname or other method, they will automatically join the live group you specify
  The unique identifier varies based on the login method:
  - Public: Audience nickname
  - Password: Audience nickname
  - Invitation code: Audience nickname
  - Whitelist: Whitelist information entered by the audience at login
  - Feishu: Feishu nickname
  - WeChat: Audience nickname
  - WeCom: Audience nickname
  - Mobile number: Mobile number entered by the audience at login
  - Custom: Value passed via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)
  - OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system
- If you have integrated the Web Audience SDK and the SDK authentication mode is custom (`mode` = `2`), the unique identifier is the `UserIdStr` (audience ID) passed when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) API
- You must provide at least one of `UserId` or `FlagId`. If both are provided, `UserId` takes precedence

AudienceGroupUsers.UserId.description_cn:
用户 ID。您可以通过 [ListAudienceGroupUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263529) 接口查询 ID。
`UserId` 和 `FlagId` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`UserId` 的优先级更高。
AudienceGroupUsers.UserId.description_en:
User ID. You can query the ID using the [ListAudienceGroupUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263529) API.
You must provide at least one of `UserId` or `FlagId`. If both are provided, `UserId` takes priority.

AwardItem.AwardItemAmounts.description_cn:
每位中奖观众可获得的积分数额。取值范围为 [0,99999]。
仅在 `AwardItemType` 取值为 `3` 且 `DeliveryMethod` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AwardItem.AwardItemAmounts.description_en:
Number of points awarded to each winning viewer. Value range: [0,99999]
Only required and effective when `AwardItemType` is set to `3` and `DeliveryMethod` is set to `2`

AwardItem.AwardItemIcon.description_cn:
奖品图片的 URL，需包含协议头。
支持配置大小不超过 2 MB 的 JPG 或 PNG 格式的图片。建议图片尺寸为 160*160。
AwardItem.AwardItemIcon.description_en:
Prize image URL must include protocol header
Supports uploading JPG or PNG images up to 2 MB
Recommended image size: 160 × 160

AwardItem.AwardItemName.description_cn:
奖品名称，长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
如需新增奖品，该参数必选。
AwardItem.AwardItemName.description_en:
Prize Name, 1–20 characters
Required when adding a new prize

AwardItem.AwardItemNum.description_cn: 积分的奖品批次号。长度为 1 到 256 个字符。您可根据该批次号识别企业积分，向观众发放积分。
AwardItem.AwardItemNum.description_en: Points reward batch number. Length: 1 to 256 characters. Use this batch number to identify company points and distribute points to viewers.

AwardItem.AwardItemStock.description_cn:
奖品库存。取值范围为 [1,100000]。取值 `-1` 表示不限库存。
如需新增奖品，该参数必选。
AwardItem.AwardItemStock.description_en:
Prize Inventory. Value range: [1,100000]. `-1` means unlimited inventory.
This parameter is required when adding a new prize.

AwardItem.AwardItemType.description_cn:
奖品类型。取值如下：

* `1`：实物奖品
* `2`：虚拟奖品
* `3`：自定义奖品
* `4`：奖券奖品

如需新增奖品，该参数必选。
AwardItem.AwardItemType.description_en:
Prize type. Available values:

* `1`: Physical prize
* `2`: Virtual prize
* `3`: Custom prize
* `4`: Voucher prize

This parameter is required when adding a new prize.

AwardItem.AwardLotteryTicketAddr.description_cn:
奖券奖品的领奖链接。长度为 1 到 256 个字符。
仅在 `AwardItemType` 取值为 `4` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AwardItem.AwardLotteryTicketAddr.description_en:
Prize claim link for lottery ticket prizes. Length must be between 1 and 256 characters
This parameter is required and effective only when `AwardItemType` is set to 4

AwardItem.DeliveryMethod.description_cn:
自定义奖品的分类。取值如下：

* `1`：卡券
* `2`：积分

当 `AwardItemType` 取值为 `3` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AwardItem.DeliveryMethod.description_en:
Custom prize category. Possible values:

* `1`: Voucher
* `2`: Points

When `AwardItemType` is set to `3`, this parameter is required and takes effect.

AwardItem.Id.description_cn:
奖品 ID。

* 新增奖品：不传该参数或传入该参数且取值为 `0`。奖品库奖品数量上限为 10000。
* 更新奖品信息：传入待更新信息的奖品 ID。您可通过调用 [GetAwardItemList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1351387)接口获取 ID。
AwardItem.Id.description_en:
Prize ID

* To add a new prize: Leave this parameter empty or set it to `0`. The prize library can hold up to 10,000 prizes.
* To update prize information: Pass the Prize ID of the prize you want to update. You can get the ID by calling the [GetAwardItemList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1351387) API.

AwardItem.WinnerInfoType.description_cn:
实物或虚拟奖品的中奖人填写信息类型。取值如下：

* `1`：收货地址
* `2`：手机号
* `3`：收件人
* `4`：邮箱

* 仅在 `AwardItemType` 取值为 `1` 或 `2` 时，该参数必选且生效。
* 当 `AwardItemType` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数仅支持取值为 `2`。
AwardItem.WinnerInfoType.description_en:
Information type required from winners of physical or virtual prizes. Possible values:

* `1`: Shipping address
* `2`: Mobile phone number
* `3`: Recipient name
* `4`: Email address

* This parameter is required and valid only when `AwardItemType` is set to `1` or `2`
* When `AwardItemType` is set to `2`, this parameter only supports the value `2`

CallbackUrls.description_cn:
回调地址，必须以 HTTPS 或 HTTP 开头。用于接收指定类型的回调消息。
* 每个回调生效账号最多可配置 10 个回调地址，每个回调地址之间通过分号（;）分隔。
* 至少传入 `CallbackUrls` 和 `SubAccountName` 其中之一。
CallbackUrls.description_en:
Callback URL. Must start with HTTPS or HTTP. Used to receive specified types of callback messages.
* Each enabled account can configure up to 10 callback URLs. Separate multiple URLs with a semicolon (;)
* You must provide at least one of `CallbackUrls` or `SubAccountName`

Id.description_cn:
回调配置的唯一标识符。您可通过调用 [ListCallbackConfigs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1756927) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保回调配置对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Id.description_en:
Unique identifier for the callback configuration. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCallbackConfigs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1756927) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the callback configuration is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

SubAccountName.description_cn:
回调生效账号。参数取值为子账号的账号。您可调用  [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，通过参数 `Name` 获取子账号的账号。
仅在使用主账号调用接口时该参数生效。调用接口后，主账号会替该子账号新增对应回调消息类型的回调配置，
如果子账号为回调生效账号，则仅当该子账号的资源触发回调时，才会向回调地址发送回调消息。例如，您为卡券领取批量聚合回调设置子账号 A 作为回调生效账号，则只有当观众在子账号 A 创建的直播间领取卡券时，企业直播才会发送回调消息到对应的回调地址。
* 如果该子账号无开发集成的可编辑权限，则无法编辑或删除该回调配置。
* 如果不传该参数或传空值，回调生效账号为调用接口的账号。
* 至少传入 `CallbackUrls` 和 `SubAccountName` 其中之一。
SubAccountName.description_en:
Callback effective account. Set this parameter to the account of a sub-account. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API and use the `Name` parameter to get the sub-account's account.

This parameter only takes effect when you call the API using the main account. After you call the API, the main account adds the corresponding callback configuration for the specified callback message type on behalf of the sub-account.

If a sub-account is set as the callback effective account, callback messages are only sent to the callback URL when resources under that sub-account trigger a callback. For example, if you set sub-account A as the callback effective account for batch card claim aggregation callbacks, only when viewers claim cards in live rooms created by sub-account A will Enterprise Live send callback messages to the specified callback URL.

* If the sub-account does not have editable permissions for development integration, you cannot edit or delete this callback configuration.
* If you do not set this parameter or leave it empty, the callback effective account defaults to the account used to call the API.
* You must provide at least one of `CallbackUrls` or `SubAccountName`.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream room ID. You can obtain the ID via the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, ensure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。该时间至少需在当前时间的一分钟之后。
仅当 `SendType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效且必填。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled send time. Unix timestamp, in seconds. This time must be at least one minute after the current time.
This parameter is effective and required only when `SendType` is set to `1`.

CannotWatchLivePrompt.description_cn:
踢出提示文案。默认值为 `因长时间未签到，已暂停观看`。长度为 1 到 50 个字符。
仅当 `CannotWathcLiveWhenNotCheckIn` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
CannotWatchLivePrompt.description_en:
Kick-out prompt text. Default value: `Paused viewing due to prolonged failure to check in`. Length: 1 to 50 characters.
This parameter is effective only when `CannotWatchLiveWhenNotCheckIn` is set to `1`.
CannotWatchLivePrompt.example_cn: 因长时间未签到，已暂停观看
CannotWatchLivePrompt.example_en: Viewing paused due to not checking in for a long time

CannotWatchLiveWhenNotCheckIn.description_cn:
未按时签到的观众是否会被踢出直播间。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不被踢出
* `1`：被踢出，将无法继续观看直播
CannotWatchLiveWhenNotCheckIn.description_en:
Whether viewers who do not check in on time will be kicked out of the livestream room. Default value: `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Not kicked out
* `1`: Kicked out and unable to continue watching the livestream

CheckInId.description_cn:
签到 ID。

* 要新增签到时，不传该参数或将该参数设为空。
* 要更新签到配置时，传入待更新的签到 ID。您可以通过 [GetCheckInListAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171603?lang=zh) 接口获取 ID。
CheckInId.description_en:
Check-in ID.

* To add a new check-in, do not pass this parameter or set it to empty.
* To update check-in settings, pass the check-in ID to be updated. You can obtain the ID via the [GetCheckInListAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171603?lang=zh) interface.

CheckInInfo.description_cn: 签到提示文案。默认值为 `请输入姓名`。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
CheckInInfo.description_en: Check-in prompt text. Default value: `Please enter your name`. Length: 1 to 20 characters.

CheckInName.description_cn: 签到名称。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。

CommentContent.description_cn:
签到后自动发送的评论文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。默认值为 `#用户昵称#已签到`。您可以在文案中插入以下变量，每个变量仅允许使用一次：

* `#用户昵称#`：观众的实际昵称。例如：如果用户昵称为“观众 A”，则该用户签到后默认发送的文案为“观众 A已签到”。
* `#签到时间#`：观众完成签到的时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`，例如 2024-03-12 10:32。
* `#签到标题#`：当前签到的名称（即 `CheckInName` 的值）。

仅当 `IsSendComment` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
CommentContent.description_en:
Comment text automatically sent after check-in. Length: 1 to 100 characters. Default value: `#UserNickname# checked in`. You can insert the following variables in the text, each variable can be used only once:

* `#UserNickname#`: The viewer's actual nickname. For example, if the user's nickname is "Viewer A", the default comment sent after check-in will be "Viewer A checked in".
* `#CheckInTime#`: The time the viewer completed check-in, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`, for example 2024-03-12 10:32.
* `#CheckInTitle#`: The name of the current check-in (i.e., the value of `CheckInName`).

This parameter is effective only when `IsSendComment` is set to `1`.

Deadline.description_cn:
签到倒计时中的分钟数。取值范围为 `[0,999]`，单位为分钟。默认值为 `0`。
总倒计时时长为 `Deadline` 和 `DeadlineSecond` 两个参数设置的时间之和。
Deadline.description_en:
Number of minutes in the check-in countdown. Value range: `[0,999]`, unit: minutes. Default value: `0`.
The total countdown duration is the sum of the times set by the `Deadline` and `DeadlineSecond` parameters.

DeadlineSecond.description_cn:
签到倒计时中的秒数。取值范围为 `[0,59]`，单位为秒。默认值为 `0`。
* 当 `Deadline`取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效，且取值范围为 `[30,59]`。
* 总倒计时时长为 `Deadline` 和 `DeadlineSecond` 两个参数设置的时间之和。
DeadlineSecond.description_en:
Seconds in the check-in countdown. Value range: `[0,59]`, unit: seconds. Default value: `0`.
* When `Deadline` is set to `0`, this parameter is required and effective, and the value range is `[30,59]`.
* The total countdown duration is the sum of the times set by the `Deadline` and `DeadlineSecond` parameters.

IsSendComment.description_cn:
签到后是否会在聊天区发送评论。默认值为`0`，即不发送。取值如下：

* `0`：不发送
* `1`：发送
IsSendComment.description_en:
Whether to send a comment in the chat area after check-in. Default value: `0`, meaning do not send. Available values:

* `0`: Do not send
* `1`: Send

NeedPersonInfo.description_cn:
是否需要用户填写签到信息。默认值为`0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不需要
* `1`：需要
NeedPersonInfo.description_en:
Whether users are required to fill in check-in information. Default value: `0`. Values:

* `0`: Not required
* `1`: Required

SendType.description_cn:
签到发送类型。默认值为`0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送
* `1`：自动发送
SendType.description_en:
Check-in send type. Default value: `0`. Values:

* `0`: Manual send
* `1`: Automatic send

Description.description_cn: 卡券描述，长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
Description.description_en: The coupon description must be between 1 and 500 characters long.

Id.description_cn:
卡券 ID。您可通过调用 [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) 接口获取 ID。

使用子账号调用接口时，确保卡券对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Id.description_en:
Coupon ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) API.

When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the coupon is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsBlockRepeatPickup.description_cn: 卡券领取限制 0-无限制 1-9999对应领取的限制次数
IsBlockRepeatPickup.description_en: Coupon redemption limit: 0 means no restriction; 1–9999 corresponds to the allowed number of redemptions

IsRepeatPickupEnable.description_cn:
卡券是否允许重复领取。取值如下：
- `0`：不允许。观众只能领取一次当前卡券，领取后，在任一直播间点击该卡券，均会提示已领取过该卡券。
- `1`：允许。观众可以在任一直播间多次领取当前卡券。
IsRepeatPickupEnable.description_en:
Allow multiple claims for coupons. Values:
- `0`: Not allowed. Viewers can claim this coupon only once. After claiming, clicking the coupon in any live room will show a message indicating it has already been claimed.
- `1`: Allowed. Viewers can claim this coupon multiple times in any live room.

Name.description_cn: 卡券名称，长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
Name.description_en: Card name must be 1 to 100 characters long

Pic.description_cn:
卡券图片的 URL，需包含协议头。
支持配置大小不超过 2 MB 的 JPG 或 PNG 格式的图片。建议图片尺寸为 160*160。
Pic.description_en:
Coupon image URL must include the protocol header
Supports JPG or PNG format images up to 2 MB
Recommended image size: 160 x 160 pixels

ThirdPartyId.description_cn:
关联卡券 ID，即您自有商城系统中的卡券 ID。长度为 1 到 200 个字符。
通过该 ID，可将当前卡券绑定您商城系统中的卡券，方便后续卡券的发放以及在商城内的核销。
ThirdPartyId.description_en:
Associated coupon ID from your e-commerce system (1–200 characters)
Use this ID to bind the current coupon to one in your e-commerce system, making subsequent coupon distribution and redemption within your e-commerce system easier

VodPlayerConfigId.description_cn: 点播播放器 ID。您可以通过 [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) 接口查询 ID。
VodPlayerConfigId.description_en: VOD player ID. You can query the ID using the [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) API.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account's visibility scope, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EnableFloating.description_cn:
是否开启浮层展示。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `false`。
- `true`：开启。点击浮标广告后，将在当前直播页面展开广告，观众可在看直播的同时查看广告。该选项仅在移动端观看页面生效。
- `false`：关闭。点击浮标广告后，将打开新的浏览器标签页展示广告，观众无法同时观看直播与广告。
EnableFloating.description_en:
Enable floating layer display. Supports the following values; the default is `false`.
- `true`: Enabled. After clicking the floating ad, the ad expands on the current live stream page, allowing viewers to watch the stream and view the ad at the same time. This option is only effective on mobile viewing pages.
- `false`: Disabled. After clicking the floating ad, a new browser tab opens to display the ad, and viewers cannot watch the stream and view the ad simultaneously.

HomeUrl.description_cn: 浮标广告的跳转链接。需要包含 https 协议头。
HomeUrl.description_en: Redirect link for floating ad. Must start with https://

ImageUrl.description_cn:
浮标广告图片地址。需要包含 https 协议头。
首次通过该接口更新浮标广告配置信息时，该参数必传。
ImageUrl.description_en:
Floating ad image URL: must start with https://
This parameter is required when updating the floating ad configuration for the first time through this interface

IsCloseEnable.description_cn:
观众是否可以关闭浮标广告。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `0`。
- `0`：可以关闭
- `1`：不可以关闭
IsCloseEnable.description_en:
Can viewers close floating ads? Supported values (default is `0`):
- `0`: Can be closed
- `1`: Cannot be closed

IsEnable.description_cn:
是否开启浮标广告。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `0`。
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启
IsEnable.description_en: Enable floating ad. Supported values: `0` (Off), `1` (On). Default is `0`

CoverImage.description_cn: 高光智剪任务的封面图片 URL。
CoverImage.description_en: Cover image URL of the Highlight Smart Editing Task.

HighlightClipVideoList.description_cn: 更新后的高光片段列表。

HighlightClipVideoList.EndTime.description_cn: 高光片段在原视频中的结束时间，单位为毫秒。
HighlightClipVideoList.EndTime.description_en: End time of the highlight segment in the original video, in milliseconds.

HighlightClipVideoList.StartTime.description_cn: 高光片段在原视频中的开始时间，单位为毫秒。
HighlightClipVideoList.StartTime.description_en: Start time of the highlight segment in the original video, in milliseconds.

HighlightClipVideoList.VideoDesc.description_en: Description of the highlight segment content.

Title.description_en: Name of the Highlight Smart Editing Task.

GetFollowDataUrl.description_cn: 查询接口 URL。您需要自行开发该接口，用于查询用户是否关注主播。详见[关注主播接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234)。
GetFollowDataUrl.description_en: Query API URL. You need to develop this API to check whether a user follows the streamer. See [Follow Streamer API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234) for details.

UpdateFollowDataUrl.description_cn: 更新接口 URL。您需要自行开发该接口，用于更新用户关注主播状态。详见[关注主播接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234)。
UpdateFollowDataUrl.description_en: Update API URL. You need to develop this API to update the user's follow status for streamers. See [Follow Streamer API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234) for details.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope of the sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Advertisements.description_cn:
页中广告信息。
* 单次接口调用新增和更新的页中广告总数上限为 30。
* 页中广告在观看页的播放顺序与数组中的顺序一致。
Advertisements.description_en:
In-page ad information
* You can add or update a combined total of up to 30 in-page ads per API call
* In-page ads play in the same order as they appear in the array on the viewing page

Advertisements.HomeUrl.description_cn: 页中广告的跳转链接，需包含协议头。
Advertisements.HomeUrl.description_en: Redirect links for in-page ads must include a protocol prefix

Advertisements.Id.description_cn: 页中广告 ID，用于新增、更新或删除页中广告。详见[接口行为](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1722714#%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA)。
Advertisements.Id.description_en: In-page ad ID, used for adding, updating, or deleting in-page ads. See [API behavior](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1722714#%E6%8E%A5%E5%8F%A3%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA) for details.

Advertisements.ImageUrl.description_cn: 页中广告的图片地址，需包含协议头。
Advertisements.ImageUrl.description_en: Image URL for in-page ads must include protocol prefix

EnableFloating.description_cn:
是否开启浮层展示。取值如下：

* `true`：开启。观众在移动端点击页中广告后，在当前观看页以浮层形式展示广告页面。观众可以在观看直播的同时查看广告。
* `false`：关闭。观众点击页中广告后，页面自动跳转至新的浏览器标签页展示广告页面。观众无法同时观看直播与广告。
EnableFloating.description_en:
Enable floating layer display. Options:

* `true`: Enable. When viewers tap an in-page ad on mobile, the ad page appears as a floating layer over the current stream. Viewers can watch the live stream and view the ad at the same time.
* `false`: Disable. When viewers tap an in-page ad, the ad page opens in a new browser tab. Viewers cannot watch the live stream and view the ad simultaneously.

IsEnable.description_cn:
是否开启页中广告。开启后，观看页展示页中广告。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
IsEnable.description_en:
Enable in-page ads. When enabled, in-page ads are shown on the viewing page. Available options:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Config.description_cn:
互动脚本录制配置。
直播期间无法更新互动脚本录制配置，请在直播开始前完成配置。
Config.description_en:
Interactive Script Recording Settings
You cannot update interactive script recording settings during a live stream. Please complete your settings before the stream starts.

Config.EnableComment.description_cn:
直播开始后，是否会将直播期间的聊天作为脚本录制到回放视频中。取值如下：
- `true`：录制
- `false`：不录制
Config.EnableComment.description_en:
Indicates whether chat messages during the live stream will be recorded as a script in the playback video after the stream starts. Options:
- `true`: Record
- `false`: Do not record

Config.EnableCoupon.description_cn:
直播开始后，是否会将直播期间的卡券信息作为脚本录制到回放视频中。取值如下：

* `true`：录制
* `false`：不录制
Config.EnableCoupon.description_en:
After the livestream starts, will the coupon information during the livestream be recorded as a script in the playback video? Possible values:

* `true`: Record
* `false`: Do not record

Config.EnableProductCard.description_cn:
直播开始后，是否会将直播期间的商品信息作为脚本录制到回放视频中。取值如下：
- `true`：录制
- `false`：不录制
Config.EnableProductCard.description_en:
After the live stream starts, will the product information shown during the stream be recorded as a script in the playback video? Options:
- `true`: Record
- `false`: Do not record

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CoverImage.description_cn: 直播频道封面图。需要包含协议头。
CoverImage.description_en: Live Channel Cover Image Must Include the Protocol Header

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。您可以通过 [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) 接口查询 ID。
`LineId` 和 `LineIndex` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`LineId` 的优先级更高。
LineId.description_en:
Live channel ID. You can query the ID using the [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) API.
You must provide at least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex`. If both are provided, `LineId` takes precedence.

LineIndex.description_cn:
直播频道的索引值。索引值越小,位置越靠前。取值范围为 [0,19]。
`LineId` 和 `LineIndex` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`LineId` 的优先级更高。
LineIndex.description_en:
Index value of the live channel. Lower values appear earlier in the list. Valid range: [0, 19]
You must provide at least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex`. If both are provided, `LineId` takes priority.

LineLanguage.description_cn:
频道的页面默认语言。观看页可根据观众的 PC 端浏览器语言或移动端系统语言，判断默认播放哪个频道的直播内容。例如频道 A 的语言是简中，PC 端浏览器语言为简中的观众在进入直播间时，观看页会默认播放频道 A 的直播内容。支持以下取值：
- `cn`：简中
- `en`：英文
- `jp`：日文
- `hant`：繁中
- `ko`：韩文
- `other`：其他
LineLanguage.description_en:
Default language for the channel page. The viewing page will automatically play the default channel's live stream based on the viewer's PC browser language or mobile device system language. For example, if Channel A's language is Simplified Chinese and a viewer's PC browser language is set to Simplified Chinese, the viewing page will default to playing Channel A's live stream when the viewer enters. Supported values:
- `cn`: Simplified Chinese
- `en`: English
- `jp`: Japanese
- `hant`: Traditional Chinese
- `ko`: Korean
- `other`: Other

LineName.description_cn: 直播频道名称。最多支持输入 100 个字符。
LineName.description_en:
Live Channel Name
You can enter up to 100 characters

LlsType.description_cn:
是否开启超低延时功能。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以 1 秒以内的超低延时观看直播内容。详见[超低延时直播](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662)。
- `2`：关闭
LlsType.description_en:
Whether to enable ultra-low latency. Supported values:
- `1`: Enable. Viewers in this channel can watch live content with latency under 1 second. See [Ultra-Low Latency Live Streaming](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662) for details.
- `2`: Disable

MainBackupType.description_cn:
是否开启主备流功能。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启，则企业直播会推送该频道的两路直播流至主地址和备地址，同时优先播放主地址的直播流。当主地址的推流断流后，可自动切换至备地址，以保证直播的稳定性。
- `2`：关闭
MainBackupType.description_en:
Enable main/backup stream feature. Supported values:
- `1`: Enable. The enterprise live broadcast will push two streams for this channel to both the main and backup addresses. The main address stream is played first. If the main stream is interrupted, it will automatically switch to the backup address to ensure live broadcast stability
- `2`: Disable

MobileDefaultResolution.description_cn:
移动端观看页的智能清晰度。移动端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值：
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
MobileDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart quality for mobile viewing pages. When mobile viewers enter a live room, the stream plays by default in smart quality. Supported values:
- `origin`: Original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

PCDefaultResolution.description_cn:
PC 端观看页的智能清晰度。PC 端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值：
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
PCDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart clarity for PC viewing page. When viewers enter a livestream room on PC, the stream defaults to smart clarity mode. Supported values:
- `origin`: Original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

Resolution.description_cn:
频道的可选清晰度。观众仅可在您选择的范围内切换清晰度。清晰度越高，对网络环境要求越高。支持以下取值，默认选择 `auto` 且不支持删除。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
- `auto`：智能
Resolution.description_en:
Selectable channel video quality. Viewers can only switch between the quality levels you choose. Higher quality requires better network conditions. The following options are supported; `auto` is selected by default and cannot be removed.
- `origin`: Original picture
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD
- `auto`: Smart

TimeShiftType.description_cn:
是否开启直播时移功能。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以拖动进度条跳转至 8 小时内任意过去时间点观看直播内容。详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
- `2`：关闭
开启多商品讲解功能期间，无法开启直播时移功能。
TimeShiftType.description_en:
Enable live stream time-shift. Supported values:
- `1`: Enable. Viewers can drag the progress bar to jump to any point within the past 8 hours to watch previous live content. See [Live Stream Time-Shift](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810) for details
- `2`: Disable
You cannot enable live stream time-shift while multi-product presentation is active

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsStartAllLine.description_cn:
是否开启当前直播间所有直播频道的录播直播。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：全部开启
* `false`：仅开启当前直播频道

* 当 `IsStartLoopVideo` 取值为 `2` 时，无需传入该参数。
* 未传入 `LineId` 参数时，本参数必传且取值必须为 `true`。
* `LineId` 和 `IsStartAllLine` 同时传入时，`IsStartAllLine` 的优先级更高。
IsStartAllLine.description_en:
Enable recorded/live playback for all live channels in the current live room. Default value is `false`. Options:

* `true`: Enable for all live channels
* `false`: Enable only for the current live channel

* If `IsStartLoopVideo` is set to `2`, you do not need to provide this parameter
* If the `LineId` parameter is not provided, this parameter is required and must be set to `true`
* If both `LineId` and `IsStartAllLine` are provided, `IsStartAllLine` takes precedence

IsStartLoopVideo.description_cn:
是否开始录播直播。取值如下：

* `1`：开始
* `2`：关闭
IsStartLoopVideo.description_en:
Whether to start recording live stream. Values:

* `1`: Start
* `2`: Close

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。您可通过调用 [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059) 接口获取 ID。
确保直播间内仅存在一个直播频道。
LineId.description_en:
Live Channel ID. You can get the ID by calling the [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059) interface.
Make sure there is only one live channel in the live room.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account's visibility scope, see [Sub-Account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AutoEndTime.description_cn:
录播直播自动结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。支持精确到分钟级开播。
在录播直播自动开始和结束的时间段内，录播直播视频列表会循环播放。
该参数取值需大于 `AutoStartTime` 的取值，且与 `AutoStartTime` 的差值最大为 259,200，即 72 小时。
当 `PlayType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AutoEndTime.description_en:
Set the automatic end time for recorded live streams using a Unix timestamp in seconds. The stream supports minute-level precision for its start time.

During the period between the automatic start and end times, the recorded live stream video list will loop.

This value must be greater than `AutoStartTime`, and the difference between this value and `AutoStartTime` cannot exceed 259,200 seconds (72 hours).

This parameter is required and takes effect when `PlayType` is set to `1`.

AutoStartTime.description_cn:
录播直播自动开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。支持精确到分钟级开播。
在录播直播自动开始和结束的时间段内，录播直播视频列表会循环播放。
该参数取值需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于等于`当前时间 + 300`，即当前时间 5 分钟及之后的某个时间点。
- 小于 `AutoEndTime` 的取值，且与 `AutoEndTime` 的差值最大为 259,200，即 72 小时。
当 `PlayType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AutoStartTime.description_en:
Recorded live stream auto start time. Unix timestamp in seconds. Supports starting at minute-level precision.
During the auto start and end time period, the recorded live stream video list will loop playback.
This parameter must meet all of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `current time + 300`, which means at least 5 minutes after the current time
- Less than the value of `AutoEndTime`, and the difference between this value and `AutoEndTime` must not exceed 259,200 seconds (72 hours)
This parameter is required and takes effect when `PlayType` is set to `1`

IsShowProgram.description_cn:
是否在观看页展示节目单，即录播直播视频列表。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：不展示  
- `1`：展示。仅在视频列表中存在 2 个及以上视频时，支持展示节目单
IsShowProgram.description_en:
Show program list on viewing page (recorded and live video list). Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Do not show
- `1`: Show. Program list can only be displayed when there are two or more videos in the list

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。您可通过调用 [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059)接口获取 ID。
确保直播间内仅存在一个直播频道。
LineId.description_en:
Live channel ID. You can get the ID by calling the [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059) interface.
Make sure there is only one live channel in the streaming room.

LoopNumber.description_cn:
录播直播次数。默认值为 `1`。取值范围为 [1,50]。例如，参数取值为 `3`，则录播直播开始后，录播直播视频列表会循环播放 3 次。
当 `PlayType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
LoopNumber.description_en:

PlayType.description_cn:
录播直播类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：  
- `0`：按次数录播直播
- `1`：按时间段录播直播
如果您在控制台的**观看页管理** > **基础信息**页面打开**自动开播**开关并选择**开始录播直播**，或者调用 [UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100060) 接口并将 `IsAutoStartEnable` 和 `AutoStartType` 的参数值均设置为 `1`，则：
- 当 `PlayType` 取值为 `0` 时，将按照**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）自动开始录播直播。
- 当 `PlayType` 取值为 `1` 时，将根据以下规则进行处理：
	- 如果**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）小于等于当前接口的 `AutoStartTime`（录播直播自动开始时间），则根据直播时间或 `LiveTime` 自动开始录播直播，并在到达 `AutoEndTime`（录播直播自动结束时间）时自动结束录播直播。
	- 如果**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）大于当前接口的 `AutoStartTime`（录播直播自动开始时间）且小于 `AutoEndTime`（录播直播自动结束时间），则根据 `AutoStartTime` 和 `AutoEndTime` 开始和结束录播直播。
	- 如果**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）大于等于当前接口的 `AutoEndTime`（录播直播自动结束时间），则不进行录播直播。
PlayType.description_en:
Recorded live streaming type. Default value is `0`. Options:  
- `0`: Recorded live streaming by number of sessions
- `1`: Recorded live streaming by time period
If you enable **Auto Start** and select **Start Recorded Live Streaming** on the **Watch Page Management** > **Basic Info** page in the console, or call the [UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100060) and set both `IsAutoStartEnable` and `AutoStartType` to `1`, then:
- When `PlayType` is `0`, recorded live streaming will automatically start at the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` specified in the API.
- When `PlayType` is `1`, the following rules apply:
	- If the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` in the API is less than or equal to the current API's `AutoStartTime`, recorded live streaming will start automatically at that time and end automatically at `AutoEndTime`.
	- If the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` in the API is greater than `AutoStartTime` and less than `AutoEndTime`, recorded live streaming will start and end according to `AutoStartTime` and `AutoEndTime`.
	- If the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` in the API is greater than or equal to `AutoEndTime`, recorded live streaming will not start.

SecurityControlCommonConfig.TickerConfig.description_cn: 跑马灯功能的配置信息。

全屏水印内容。最多支持输入 20 个字符。默认为#用户昵称#变量。
支持插入用户昵称或关联用户 ID 变量，以便为不同的观众展示独特的水印内容。例如水印内容为企业直播#用户昵称#，则昵称为用户 A 的观众看到的水印内容为企业直播用户 A。
- 插入变量的跑马灯内容，将根据观众的登录状态、变量类型等有所不同，具体如下：
	- 观众登录直播间前
		跑马灯内容为**版权所有，严禁传播！**。
	- 观众登录直播间后
		- 用户昵称变量：变量为观众昵称，但以下观看限制除外：
			- 手机号：变量为观众昵称 + 手机号后四位。有关如何将观看限制设置为手机号，详见[手机号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93581)。
			- 白名单：变量为白名单信息。有关如何将观看限制设置为白名单，详见[白名单](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/137674)。
		- 关联用户 ID 变量：变量为观众的关联用户 ID。如果观众不存在关联用户 ID，则变量为观众昵称。
- 若同时配置用户昵称和关联用户 ID 变量时，跑马灯内容中的观众昵称仅显示一次。
SecurityControlCommonConfig.TickerConfig.description_en:
Full-screen watermark content. Supports up to 20 characters. The default is the #UserNickname# variable.

You can insert user nickname or associated user ID variables to display unique watermark content for each viewer. For example, if the watermark content is Enterprise Live #UserNickname#, a viewer with the nickname User A will see Enterprise Live User A as the watermark.

- The content of the marquee with inserted variables will vary based on the viewer's login status and variable type:
  - Before the viewer logs in to the live room
    The marquee displays **Copyright protected, do not distribute!**
  - After the viewer logs in to the live room
    - User nickname variable: Displays the viewer's nickname, except for the following viewing restrictions:
      - Mobile number: Displays the viewer's nickname plus the last four digits of their mobile number. For details on setting viewing restrictions by mobile number, see [Mobile Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93581).
      - Whitelist: Displays whitelist information. For details on setting viewing restrictions by whitelist, see [Whitelist](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/137674).
    - Associated user ID variable: Displays the viewer's associated user ID. If the viewer does not have an associated user ID, displays the viewer's nickname.
- If both user nickname and associated user ID variables are configured, the viewer's nickname will only appear once in the marquee content.

			- 手机号：变量为观众昵称 + 手机号后四位。有关如何将观看限制设置为手机号，详见[手机号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93581)。
			- 白名单：变量为白名单信息。有关如何将观看限制设置为白名单，详见[白名单](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/137674)。
		- 关联用户 ID 变量：变量为观众的关联用户 ID。如果观众不存在关联用户 ID，则变量为观众昵称。
- 若同时配置用户昵称和关联用户 ID 变量时，跑马灯内容中的观众昵称仅显示一次。
SecurityControlCommonConfig.WatermarkCon.description_en:
Full-screen watermark content. Supports up to 20 characters. The default is the #UserNickname# variable.
You can insert the user nickname or associated user ID variable to display unique watermark content for each viewer. For example, if the watermark content is Enterprise Live #UserNickname#, a viewer with the nickname User A will see Enterprise Live User A as the watermark.
- The content of the marquee with inserted variables will vary based on the viewer's login status and variable type:
	- Before the viewer logs in to the live room
		The marquee displays **Copyright reserved, sharing is strictly prohibited!**
	- After the viewer logs in to the live room
		- User nickname variable: The variable displays the viewer's nickname, except in the following viewing restrictions:
			- Mobile number: The variable displays the viewer's nickname plus the last four digits of their mobile number. For details on setting viewing restrictions by mobile number, see [Mobile Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93581).
			- Whitelist: The variable displays whitelist information. For details on setting viewing restrictions by whitelist, see [Whitelist](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/137674).
		- Associated user ID variable: The variable displays the viewer's associated user ID. If the viewer does not have an associated user ID, the variable displays the viewer's nickname.
- If both user nickname and associated user ID variables are configured, the viewer's nickname will only appear once in the marquee content.

SecurityControlCommonConfig.WatermarkCon.description_cn: 全屏水印字体的颜色。遵循 RGB 色彩模型。默认取值为 `#737A87`。
SecurityControlCommonConfig.WatermarkCon.description_en: Fullscreen watermark font color. Uses the RGB color model. Default value: `#737A87`
Font size for fullscreen watermark. Supported values: `12`, `16`, `20`, `24`, `28`, `32`, `36`. Default is `24`.

SecurityControlCommonConfig.WatermarkCon.description_cn: 全屏水印字体的不透明度。取值范围为 [0,100]，默认取值为 `10`。
SecurityControlCommonConfig.WatermarkCon.description_en: Opacity of fullscreen watermark font. Range: [0,100], default: `10`

Action.description_cn:
操作类型。取值如下：

* `1`: 新增商品卡片
* `2`: 更新商品卡片配置信息
* `3`: 删除商品卡片
Action.description_en:
Operation type. Possible values:

* `1`: Add product card
* `2`: Update product card configuration information
* `3`: Delete product card

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Product.description_cn:
商品卡片的配置信息。
* 当 `Action` 取值为 `2` 时，为保证商品卡片配置信息的参数值不被清空或替换为默认值，即便参数在该接口中为非必选，也必须传入对应的参数值。您可调用 [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) 接口，通过返回参数 `Product` 获取商品卡片配置信息。
* 当 `Action` 取值为 `3` 时，商品卡片配置信息中，仅 `Id` 参数生效。
Product.description_en:
Product card configuration information
* When `Action` is set to `2`, you must provide the corresponding parameter values for the product card configuration, even if the parameters are optional in this API. This ensures that the parameter values are not cleared or replaced with default values. You can call the [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) API and retrieve product card configuration information from the `Product` response parameter.
* When `Action` is set to `3`, only the `Id` parameter in the product card configuration is effective.

Product.AddCartUrl.description_cn:
点击加购按钮后打开的加购页面链接。
* 该参数仅在 `EnableAddCart` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
* 若此值为空，则观众点击按钮时，客户端不会打开加入购物车页面。
Product.AddCartUrl.description_en:
The link to the add-to-cart page that opens after clicking the add-to-cart button.
* This parameter is only effective when `EnableAddCart` is set to `1`.
* If this value is empty, the client will not open the add-to-cart page when users click the button.

Product.AddCartUrl.Default.description_cn:
点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域后跳转的兜底链接。
如果观众无法跳转至直达链接或微信小程序，则会跳转至该链接。
Product.AddCartUrl.Default.description_en:
The fallback link to redirect to after clicking the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas.
If viewers cannot be redirected to the direct link or the WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to this link.

Product.AddCartUrl.MiniApp.description_cn:
微信小程序链接。当观众在移动端微信环境点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该微信小程序。
该参数仅在商品卡片菜单开启微信小程序跳转功能后生效。您可调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) 接口，将 `EnableMiniApp` 参数取值设置为 `true`，开启微信小程序跳转功能。
Product.AddCartUrl.MiniApp.description_en:
WeChat Mini Program link. When viewers click the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas in the mobile WeChat environment, they will be redirected to this WeChat Mini Program.
This parameter only takes effect after the WeChat Mini Program redirect feature is enabled in the product card menu. You can call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) API and set the `EnableMiniApp` parameter to `true` to enable the WeChat Mini Program redirect feature.

Product.AddCartUrl.UAList.description_cn:
当观众在环境 UA 匹配成功的移动端平台上点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该链接。
该参数仅在商品卡片菜单开启直达链接功能后生效。您可调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) 接口，将 `EnableUA` 参数取值设置为 `true`，开启直达链接功能。
Product.AddCartUrl.UAList.description_en:
When viewers click the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas on a mobile platform where UA environment matching is successful, they will be redirected to this link.
This parameter only takes effect after the direct link feature is enabled in the product card menu. You can call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) API and set the `EnableUA` parameter to `true` to enable the direct link feature.

Product.CustomContent.description_cn: 需要透传的自定义扩展信息，可用于展示更多商品信息等。仅用于信息透传，不做其他处理。
Product.CustomContent.description_en: Custom extension information to be passed through, which can be used to display additional product details. Used only for information passthrough, no other processing.

Product.DetailRedirectUrl.description_cn: 点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域后跳转的链接。若未配置该项，观众点击商品信息区域后会跳转至 `RedirectUrl` 中配置的链接。
Product.DetailRedirectUrl.description_en: The link that opens when users click the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas. If this option is not configured, users will be redirected to the link specified in `RedirectUrl` when clicking the product information area.

Product.DetailRedirectUrl.Default.description_cn:
点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域后跳转的兜底链接。
如果观众无法跳转至直达链接或微信小程序，则会跳转至该链接。
Product.DetailRedirectUrl.Default.description_en:
Fallback link for redirecting after viewers tap the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas.
If viewers cannot be redirected to the direct link or WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to this link.

Product.DetailRedirectUrl.MiniApp.description_cn:
微信小程序链接。当观众在移动端微信环境点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该微信小程序。
该参数仅在商品卡片菜单开启微信小程序跳转功能后生效。您可调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) 接口，将 `EnableMiniApp` 参数取值设置为 `true`，开启微信小程序跳转功能。
Product.DetailRedirectUrl.MiniApp.description_en:
WeChat Mini Program link. When viewers tap the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas in the WeChat mobile environment, they are redirected to the corresponding WeChat Mini Program.
This parameter is only effective after enabling the WeChat Mini Program redirect feature in the product card menu. You can call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) API and set the `EnableMiniApp` parameter to `true` to enable the WeChat Mini Program redirect feature.

Product.DetailRedirectUrl.UAList.description_cn:
当观众在环境 UA 匹配成功的移动端平台上点击商品图、商品名称、商品价格等商品信息区域时，即可跳转至该链接。
该参数仅在商品卡片菜单开启直达链接功能后生效。您可调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) 接口，将 `EnableUA` 参数取值设置为 `true`，开启直达链接功能。
Product.DetailRedirectUrl.UAList.description_en:
When viewers tap the product image, product name, product price, or other product information areas on a mobile platform where UA matches successfully, they are redirected to this link.
This parameter is only effective after enabling the direct link feature in the product card menu. You can call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) API and set the `EnableUA` parameter to `true` to enable the direct link feature.

Product.DirectUrls.description_cn:
直达链接，包含协议头。当观众在环境 UA 匹配成功的移动端平台上点击商品卡片时，即可跳转至该链接。
该参数仅在商品卡片菜单开启直达链接功能后生效。您可调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) 接口，将 `EnableUA` 参数取值设置为 `true`，开启直达链接功能。
Product.DirectUrls.description_en:
Direct link with protocol header. When viewers tap a product card on a mobile platform where the environment UA matches successfully, they are redirected to this link.
This parameter is only effective after you enable the direct link feature in the product card menu. You can call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) API and set the `EnableUA` parameter to `true` to enable the direct link feature.

Product.EnableAddCart.description_cn:
是否开启商品的加入购物车功能，展示加购按钮。取值如下：

* `0`：不展示
* `1`：展示
Product.EnableAddCart.description_en:
Enable the add-to-cart feature for the product and display the add-to-cart button. Options:

* `0`: Do not display
* `1`: Display

Product.EnableStatus.description_cn:
是否上架商品。取值如下：

* `0`：下架
* `1`：上架
Product.EnableStatus.description_en:
Product listing status. Possible values:

* `0`: Delisted
* `1`: Listed

Product.ExplainStatus.description_cn:
商品讲解状态。取值如下：

* `0`：未讲解
* `1`：讲解中
* `2`：讲解结束

仅在开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。更多有关直播时移的信息，详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
Product.ExplainStatus.description_en:
Product explanation status. Possible values:

* `0`: Not explained
* `1`: Explaining
* `2`: Explained

This parameter is only effective when live stream time-shifting is enabled. For more information, see [Live Stream Time-Shifting](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810).

Product.ExplainTime.description_cn: 最近一次修改商品讲解状态的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。取值为 `0` 表示未修改过商品讲解状态。
Product.ExplainTime.description_en: Time of last product explanation status modification. Unix timestamp in seconds. A value of `0` means the product explanation status has never been modified.

Product.FloatingStatus.description_cn:
是否浮窗展示商品卡片。取值如下：

* `1`：浮窗展示
* `其他值`：非浮窗展示

仅在未开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。
Product.FloatingStatus.description_en:
Whether to display the product card in a floating window. Possible values:

* `1`: Floating window display
* `Other values`: Non-floating window display

This parameter is only effective when the live stream shift function is disabled.

Product.FloatingTime.description_cn: 最近一次浮窗展示商品卡片的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。取值为 `0` 表示商品卡片从未浮窗展示过。
Product.FloatingTime.description_en: Time of last floating window product card display. Unix timestamp in seconds. A value of `0` means the product card has never been displayed in a floating window.

Product.Highlight.description_cn: 商品的售卖价，即当前价格。
Product.Highlight.description_en: The sale price of the product, i.e. its current price

Product.HotSale.description_cn:
热卖提醒数量。
该参数仅在 `ReminderType` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
Product.HotSale.description_en:
Hot Sale Reminder Quantity
This parameter is only effective when `ReminderType` is set to 1.

Product.Index.description_cn: 商品卡片的序号。取值范围为 [0,499]。

Product.IntroduceImage.description_cn: 商品图的 URL，包含协议头。

Product.IsOrderMsgEnable.description_cn:
是否开启下单消息。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
Product.IsOrderMsgEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable order notifications. Available values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

Product.MiniAppDirectUrl.description_cn:
微信小程序链接，包含协议头。当观众在移动端微信环境点击商品卡片时，即可跳转至该微信小程序。
该参数仅在商品卡片菜单开启微信小程序跳转功能后生效。您可调用 [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) 接口，将 `EnableMiniApp` 参数取值设置为 `true`，开启微信小程序跳转功能。
Product.MiniAppDirectUrl.description_en:
WeChat Mini Program link, including protocol header. When viewers tap the product card in the WeChat mobile environment, they can jump to the corresponding Mini Program.
This parameter only takes effect after the Mini Program redirect feature is enabled in the product card menu. You can call the [UpdateActivityProduct](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131804) API and set the `EnableMiniApp` parameter to `true` to enable the Mini Program redirect feature.

Product.OutOfStock.description_cn:
商品是否售罄。商品售罄后，观看页的商品图和跳转图将展示“已抢光”的文案。取值如下：

* `0`：未售罄
* `1`：已售罄
Product.OutOfStock.description_en:
Product sold-out status. When a product is sold out, the product image and redirect image on the viewing page will display the 'Sold Out' label. Values:

* `0`: Not sold out
* `1`: Sold out

Product.PriceHidden.description_cn:
商品售卖价格是否为隐藏状态。商品价格隐藏后，观看页的商品**售卖价**将以“待开价￥???”的文案展示。取值如下：

* `0`：未隐藏
* `1`：已隐藏
Product.PriceHidden.description_en:
Indicates whether the product selling price is hidden. When hidden, the product's selling price on the viewing page will display 'To be priced ¥???'. Possible values:

* `0`: Not hidden
* `1`: Hidden

Product.PromotionTagType.description_cn:
活动标签类型。取值如下：

* `0`：无
* `1`：自定义
* `2`：超值购
* `3`：惊喜特惠
* `4`：低价秒杀
Product.PromotionTagType.description_en:
Activity Tag Type. Values:

* `0`: None
* `1`: Custom
* `2`: Great Value Deal
* `3`: Surprise Special Offer
* `4`: Low-price Flash Sale

Product.PromotionTagUrl.description_cn: 活动标签的 URL，包含协议头。
Product.PromotionTagUrl.description_en: Activity tag URL (including protocol prefix, e.g., http:// or https://)

Product.RedirectImage.description_cn: 跳转图的 URL，包含协议头。
Product.RedirectImage.description_en: Redirect image URL, including http:// or https://

Product.RedirectUrl.description_cn: 跳转链接，即商品详情页的链接，包含协议头。如果观众无法跳转至直达链接或微信小程序，则会跳转至该链接。
Product.RedirectUrl.description_en: A redirect link is the product detail page link, including the protocol header. If viewers cannot access the direct link or WeChat Mini Program, they will be redirected to this link.

Product.Remark.example_cn: 超级好吃的玫瑰慕斯蛋糕

Product.ReminderType.description_cn:
在商品讲解期间的浮窗商品卡片和商品卡片菜单中，动效展示的提醒类型。取值如下：

* `0`：无
* `1`：热卖
* `2`：库存
Product.ReminderType.description_en:
Notification animation types shown on floating product cards and product card menus during product presentations. The available values are:

* `0`: None
* `1`: Hot Sale
* `2`: Stock

Product.SellingPointTag.description_cn: 卖点标签。卖点间以分号（；）相隔。
Product.SellingPointTag.description_en: Selling Point Tags. Separate selling points with semicolons (;)
Product.SellingPointTag.example_en: Buy 2, get 1 free; Get 20 off when you spend 50

Product.Stock.description_cn:
库存提醒数量。
该参数仅在 `ReminderType` 取值为 `2` 时生效。
Product.Stock.description_en:
Inventory Reminder Quantity
This parameter is effective only when `ReminderType` is set to `2`.

Product.Strikethrough.description_en: The reference price of a product is its original price.

ProductConfigId.description_cn: 商品卡片菜单 ID。您可调用 [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) 接口，根据返回参数 `Id`获取 ID。
ProductConfigId.description_en: Product Card Menu ID. Call the [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) API and get the ID from the returned 'Id' parameter

ReorderIndex.description_cn:
新增或更新商品卡片时，如果商品卡片的序号（`Index` 取值）与当前商品卡片菜单下已有的商品卡片序号相同，是否重新排序菜单下的商品卡片。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：重新排序商品卡片，将已有的商品卡片的序号向后顺延。例如，当前商品卡片菜单下存在商品卡片 A、B 和 C，序号分别为 1、2 和 3，当新增一个序号为 2 的商品卡片，则商品卡片 A 的序号为 1，新增商品卡片的序号为 2，商品卡片 B 的序号为 3，商品卡片 C 的序号为 4。
* `false`：不重新排序商品卡片，可能存在相同序号的商品卡片。相同序号的商品卡片排序随机。
ReorderIndex.description_en:
When adding or updating a product card, if the card's index (`Index` value) matches the index of an existing product card in the current menu, choose whether to reorder the product cards in the menu. The default value is `false`. Options:

* `true`: Reorder product cards and shift the indexes of existing cards back. For example, if the menu contains product cards A, B, and C with indexes 1, 2, and 3, and you add a new product card with index 2, card A will have index 1, the new card will have index 2, card B will have index 3, and card C will have index 4
* `false`: Do not reorder product cards. Cards with the same index may exist, and their order will be random

Name.description_cn: 子账号的账号，是子账号的唯一标识。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口获取账号。
Name.description_en: A sub-account's ID is its unique identifier. You can retrieve the account ID by calling the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API.

NickName.description_cn:
子账号的昵称。长度为 1 到 16 个字符。支持以下字符：
- 大写字母 A - Z
- 小写字母 a - z
- 数字
- 中文

昵称更新后，IAM 用户的昵称（显示名）也会同步更新。
NickName.description_en:
Sub-account nickname. Length: 1–16 characters. Supported characters:
- Uppercase letters A–Z
- Lowercase letters a–z
- Numbers
- Chinese characters

After the nickname is updated, the IAM user's nickname (display name) will also be updated synchronously.

OrganizationId.description_cn: 子账号所属组织的 ID。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccountOrganizations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377763) 接口获取 ID。
OrganizationId.description_en: The ID of the organization to which the sub-account belongs. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListSubAccountOrganizations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377763) API.

RoleIds.description_cn:
子账号所属角色的 ID。如传入空数组，则自动更新为**默认子账号**角色。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) 接口获取 ID。
对于飞书成员类型（`Type` 取值为 `3`）的子账号而言，如果参数值不包含**默认子账号**角色，则会自动添加**默认子账号**角色。
每个子账号最多可被赋予 100 个角色。
RoleIds.description_en:
The IDs of the roles assigned to the sub-account. If you pass an empty array, the system will automatically assign the Default Sub-Account Role. You can obtain role IDs by calling the [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) API.

For sub-accounts of the Lark member type (where `Type` is set to `3`), if the parameter does not include the Default Sub-Account Role, the system will automatically add it.

Each sub-account can have up to 100 roles assigned.

ActivityId.description_cn:

TeachAssistantAccount.TeachAssistantFeat.description_cn:
直播助教的功能权限。
- `1`：观众聊天：**直播控制**页面的聊天互动菜单。详见[聊天互动](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149733)。
		直播助教的聊天互动菜单中，不支持聊天审核、导出聊天、机器人评论和管理系统消息功能。
	
- `2`：直播画面：控制台播放器。
		如果当前直播间配置了多个直播频道，则频道选择入口固定放置于播放器内。有关如何配置直播频道，详见[直播频道管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66779)。
	
- `3`：观众列表。直播控制页面的观众列表。详见[观众列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/152956)。
		直播助教的观众列表中，不支持查看详情和导出数据功能。
	
- `4`：互动工具：**直播控制**页面的互动工具菜单。详见[互动工具](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149734)。
- `5`：商品管控：**直播控制**页面的商品卡片菜单。详见[商品卡片](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149738)。
- `6`：直播中断：锁定预告。详见[锁定预告](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66786)。
- `7`：互动问答：**直播控制**页面的互动问答菜单。详见[互动问答](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149737)。
		直播助教的互动问答菜单中，不支持聊天审核和导出聊天功能。
	
- `8`：私聊：**直播控制**页面的私聊互动菜单。详见[私聊互动](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149735)。
仅在同时满足以下条件时，直播助教才可以使用观众聊天、互动工具、商品管控、互动问答或私聊功能。
- 配置了对应功能权限。
- 在**菜单管理**模块启用了对应菜单。
TeachAssistantAccount.TeachAssistantFeat.description_en:
Live Assistant Functional Permissions
- `1`: Audience Chat: Chat Interaction menu in the Live Control page. See [Chat Interaction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149733).
    The Chat Interaction menu for Live Assistants does not support chat moderation, chat export, bot comments, or managing system messages.
  
- `2`: Live Stream Screen: Console player.
    If multiple live channels are configured for the current live room, the channel selection entry is always located within the player. For details on configuring live channels, see [Live Channel Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66779).
  
- `3`: Audience List: Audience List in the Live Control page. See [Audience List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/152956).
    The Audience List for Live Assistants does not support viewing details or exporting data.
  
- `4`: Interactive Tools: Interactive Tools menu in the Live Control page. See [Interactive Tools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149734).
- `5`: Product Management: Product Card menu in the Live Control page. See [Product Card](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149738).
- `6`: Live Interruption: Lock Announcement. See [Lock Announcement](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66786).
- `7`: Q&A Interaction: Q&A Interaction menu in the Live Control page. See [Q&A Interaction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149737).
    The Q&A Interaction menu for Live Assistants does not support chat moderation or chat export.
  
- `8`: Private Chat: Private Chat menu in the Live Control page. See [Private Chat Interaction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1149735).
Live Assistants can use Audience Chat, Interactive Tools, Product Management, Q&A Interaction, or Private Chat only when both of the following conditions are met:
- The corresponding functional permission is configured.
- The corresponding menu is enabled in the Menu Management module.

* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号拥有对等级库的可编辑权限。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容，您也可通过不传或将该参数设置为 `0` 来指定默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer Level Library ID. You can obtain it using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the level library. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can also leave this parameter empty or set it to `0` to use the default level library (includes 3 default level configurations).

GroupDescription.description_cn: 等级库描述，不可超过 100 个字符。
GroupDescription.description_en: Level library description cannot exceed 100 characters.
GroupDescription.example_cn: 包含白银会员及以下的等级配置，适用于新注册用户及低频次互动用户
GroupDescription.example_en: Includes Silver Member and lower tiers; suitable for newly registered users and users who interact infrequently

GroupName.description_cn:
等级库名称，不可超过 100 个字符。
要新增等级库，该参数必填。
GroupName.description_en:
Level library name, cannot exceed 100 characters
This parameter is required to add a new level library

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
根据以下情况传值：

* 要新增一个等级库，将该参数值设置为 `0` 或不传值。
* 要更新指定等级库，传入指定等级库的 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
      使用子账号更新指定等级库时，确保子账号对指定等级库有编辑权限。您可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口判断子账号是否可编辑指定等级库。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Pass the parameter based on the following scenarios:

* To create a new level group, set the parameter value to `0` or leave it empty.
* To update an existing level group, enter the ID of the target level group. You can get the ID using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
      When updating a level group with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the target level group. You can check if the sub-account can edit the level group using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.Angle.description_en: Tilt angle of the watermark. Valid range: [-90, 90]. For example, if `Angle` is set to `15`, the watermark tilts 15 degrees upward to the right; if `Angle` is set to `-15`, it tilts 15 degrees downward to the right.

VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.Content.description_cn: 跑马灯内容。最多支持输入 20 个字符。
VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.Content.description_en: Marquee content. Up to 20 characters supported

VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.FontColo.description_cn: 跑马灯颜色。遵循 RGB 色彩模型。
VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.FontColo.description_en: Marquee color. Follow the RGB color model.

VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.IsPlayPa.description_cn:

- `1`：开启
VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.IsPlayPa.description_en: Enable full-screen watermark feature? Supported values: - `0`: Off - `1`: On

VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.Opacity.description_cn: 跑马灯字体的不透明度。取值范围为 [0,100]。
VodPlayerConfig.WatermarkConfig.Opacity.description_en: Opacity of marquee text font Range: [0, 100]

VodPlayerConfig.ZoomConfig.ZoomMode.description_cn:
画面缩放模式。支持以下取值：
- `1`：等比适配，即保持视频原有宽高比例填充点播播放器，视频的宽高会填满点播播放器的宽高。如果视频宽高比与点播播放器宽高比不同，视频会缩放显示。推荐在 PC 和手机横屏模式时使用该设置。
- `2`：等比填满，即保持视频原有宽高比例填充点播播放器，视频的宽高会填满点播播放器的宽高。如果视频宽高比与点播播放器宽高比不同，会有部分视频内容被裁剪掉。推荐在手机竖屏模式时使用该设置。
- `3`：拉伸填满，即视频内容完全填充点播播放器，但视频宽高比可能发生变化。
VodPlayerConfig.ZoomConfig.ZoomMode.description_en:
Screen scaling mode. The following options are supported:
- `1`: Aspect Ratio Fit—fills the player as much as possible while maintaining the video's original aspect ratio. If the video and player aspect ratios differ, the video is scaled to fit. Recommended for PC and mobile landscape mode.
- `2`: Aspect Ratio Fill—fills the player while maintaining the video's original aspect ratio. If the video and player aspect ratios differ, some video content may be cropped. Recommended for mobile portrait mode.
- `3`: Stretch to Fill—the video completely fills the player, but the aspect ratio may change.
