Records.RecordID.description_en:
Record ID. You can obtain it using the following APIs:

- [CreateRecord API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163682)
- [ListRecords API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163694)

Records.Remark.description_cn: 备注。支持 UTF-8 编码，长度不超过 16 个字符。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Records.Remark.description_en: Note: Supports UTF-8 encoding, up to 16 characters. If you do not set this parameter, its value will remain unchanged.

Records.TTL.description_cn: 解析记录的过期时间。单位为秒。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Records.TTL.description_en: Expiration time for the parsing record, in seconds. If you do not set this parameter, its value will not change.

Records.Type.description_cn: 解析记录类型。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Records.Type.description_en: Record type. If you do not set this parameter, its value will remain unchanged

Records.Value.description_cn: 记录值。参见 [解析记录类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499)。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Records.Value.description_en: Record value. See [Record types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499). If you do not set this parameter, its value will not change.

Records.Weight.description_cn: 记录值的权重。只有域名开启了负载均衡后，记录值的权重才会生效。参见 [更新域名配置 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163106) 了解如何为域名开启或关闭负载均衡。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Records.Weight.description_en: Record weight. The weight only takes effect after load balancing is enabled for the domain. See [Update Domain Configuration API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163106) to learn how to enable or disable load balancing for a domain. If you do not set this parameter, its value will not change.

ZID.description_cn:
域名 ID。您可以通过以下 API 获取：

- [CreatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [ListPrivateZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)
ZID.description_en:
Domain ID. You can obtain it using the following APIs:

- [CreatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [ListPrivateZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)

RuleID.description_cn:
转发规则的 ID。您可以从以下 API 的响应中获取：

- [CreateResolverRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978342)
- [ListResolverRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978346)
RuleID.description_en:
ID of the forwarding rule. You can obtain it from the response of the following APIs:

- [CreateResolverRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978342)
- [ListResolverRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978346)

RuleTrn.description_cn: 转发规则的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:private_zone::accountId::rule/rule-ruleId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对转发规则所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
RuleTrn.description_en: The TRN of the forwarding rule is described [here](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319). The format is `trn:private_zone::accountId::rule/rule-ruleId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the forwarding rule is located, you need to provide this parameter.

VpcTrns.description_cn: 转发规则所关联的一个或多个 VPC 的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对转发规则所关联的 VPC 所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
VpcTrns.description_en: The [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319) of one or more VPCs associated with the forwarding rule. The format is `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the VPC associated with the forwarding rule is located, you need to provide this parameter.

Vpcs.description_cn: 与域名绑定的一个或多个 VPC。您需要绑定至少一个 VPC。您添加的地域必须和终端节点所在的地域相同。
Vpcs.description_en: One or more VPCs bound to the domain name. You must bind at least one VPC. The region you add must match the endpoint's region.

VpcTrns.description_cn: 域名所关联的一个或多个 VPC 的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对域名关联的 VPC 所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
VpcTrns.description_en: The [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319) of one or more VPCs associated with the domain name. Format: `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`. To verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate in the project of the VPC associated with the domain name, provide this parameter.

Vpcs.description_cn: 与域名关联的一个或多个 VPC。您需要关联至少一个 VPC。BindVPC API 支持关联当前火山引擎账号下的 VPC 或跨账号关联 VPC。
Vpcs.description_en: One or more VPCs associated with the domain name. You need to associate at least one VPC. The BindVPC API supports associating VPCs under your current Volcano Engine account or associating VPCs across accounts.

ZID.description_cn:
标识域名的唯一 ID。您可以通过以下 API 获取：

- [添加域名 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [获取域名列表 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)
ZID.description_en:
Unique ID that identifies the domain name. You can obtain it using the following APIs:

- [Add Domain API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [Get Domain List API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)

AccountID.description_cn: 需要添加授权的火山引擎账号。
AccountID.description_en: You need to add an authorized Volcengine account.

AuthType.description_cn:
验证方式。

- 0：使用企业组织验证。如果您使用企业组织验证，调用该 API 的火山引擎账号必须是火山引擎企业组织服务的管理员账号。需要添加授权的火山引擎账号必须和管理员账号属于同一个企业组织。
- 1：使用验证码验证。
AuthType.description_en:
Verification Methods

- 0: Use enterprise organization verification. If you use enterprise organization verification, the VolcEngine account calling this API must be an administrator account for VolcEngine enterprise organization services. The VolcEngine account to be authorized must belong to the same enterprise organization as the administrator account.
- 1: Use verification code.

VerifyCode.description_cn: 验证码。该参数在 `AuthType` 被设置为 `1` 时为必填参数。
VerifyCode.description_en: Verification code. This parameter is required when `AuthType` is set to `1`.

IPSegments.description_cn: 一个或多个自定义线路的 CIDR 地址块。支持 IPv4 地址和 IPv6 地址。例如，`192.168.1.0/24` 或 `2001:db8::/103`。单条自定义线路最多可添加 1000 个 CIDR 地址块；不同自定义线路之间的 CIDR 地址块不能重叠。
IPSegments.description_en: One or more custom route CIDR address blocks. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. For example, `192.168.1.0/24` or `2001:db8::/103`. You can add up to 1000 CIDR address blocks.

NameCN.description_cn: 自定义线路的名称。UTF-8 格式，最大长度为 32 个 UTF-8 字符。
NameCN.description_en: Name for custom route in UTF-8 format, up to 32 UTF-8 characters

Remark.description_cn: 自定义线路的备注。UTF-8 格式，最大长度为 64 个 UTF-8 字符。默认为空字符串。
Remark.description_en: Custom route remark. UTF-8 format. Maximum length: 64 UTF-8 characters. Default: empty string.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于确保请求的幂等性。如果您设置了该参数，在相同的请求参数下，无论该 API 被调用多少次，返回的结果都是相同的。该参数仅允许 ASCII 字符且不能超过 64 个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. If you set this parameter, the API will always return the same result for identical request parameters, no matter how many times it is called. Only ASCII characters are allowed, and the parameter cannot exceed 64 characters.

LineMode.description_cn:
是否开启智能解析。打开后不可再关闭。

支持取值：
- 0：关闭智能解析。
- 1：该参数已废弃。
- 2：该参数已废弃。
- 3：该参数已废弃。
- 4：开启智能解析。打开智能解析后，支持根据不同请求来源或者权重返回解析记录值，打开后不可再关闭。
LineMode.description_en:
Enable intelligent resolution? Once enabled, it cannot be disabled.

- 0: Disable intelligent resolution
- 1: This parameter is deprecated
- 2: This parameter is deprecated
- 3: This parameter is deprecated
- 4: Intelligent resolution: supports weighted routing, AZ routes, custom routes

NodataFallback.description_cn:
针对私网域名在解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析为空的场景，是否回退到公网递归解析。
只有开启递归解析开关时（RecursionMode = true），该参数才生效。


- true：当该私网域名及其子域名的解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析返回为空时，触发公网递归解析规则，由公网递归 DNS 服务器返回查询结果。
- false：（默认）上述场景下不触发公网递归解析，直接返回空结果。
NodataFallback.description_en: When resolving private network domain names, if the resolution status code is noerror and local resolution returns empty, public recursive resolution will be performed; you must enable the recursion switch for this to take effect

ProjectName.description_cn: 域名所属项目的名称。默认为 `default`。
ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project the domain belongs to. Default is `default`

RecursionMode.description_cn:
是否开启递归解析。

- true：开启递归解析。
- false（默认）：不开启递归解析。
RecursionMode.description_en:
Enable recursive parsing

- true: Enable recursive parsing
- false (default): Do not enable recursive parsing

Remark.description_cn: 备注。默认为空字符串。
Remark.description_en: Note: Default is an empty string

Tags.description_cn: 域名所属的一个或多个标签。一个资源最多能关联 50 个标签。
Tags.description_en: One or more tags associated with the domain. Each resource can be associated with up to 50 tags.

VpcTrns.description_cn: 域名所关联的一个或多个 VPC 的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对域名关联的 VPC 所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
VpcTrns.description_en: The [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319) of one or more VPCs associated with the domain name. Format: `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the VPC associated with the domain name is located, you must provide this parameter.

Vpcs.description_cn: 域名关联的 VPC，只能关联当前账号的或跨账号授权的 VPC。新建时可以不关联 VPC。
Vpcs.description_en: Domain name resolution is only effective in associated VPCs. We recommend associating at least one VPC; if no VPC is associated, the domain name will not be effective in any VPC.

ZoneName.description_cn: 域名。可以是二级域名或多级域名。私网解析 PrivateZone 不支持以 `ivolces.com` 或 `privatelink.volces.com` 结尾的域名。
ZoneName.description_en: Domain name. Can be a second-level domain or multi-level domain. PrivateZone does not support domain names ending with `ivolces.com` or `privatelink.volces.com` for private network resolution.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于确保请求的幂等性。如果您设置了该参数，在相同的请求参数下，无论该 API 被调用多少次，返回的结果都是相同的。该参数仅允许 ASCII 字符且不能超过 64 个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. If you set this parameter, the result will always be the same for repeated API calls with identical request parameters. Only ASCII characters are allowed, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.

Host.description_cn: 子域名的域名前缀。参见 [添加解析记录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162461) 了解域名前缀的格式要求。
Host.description_en: Domain prefix for the subdomain. See [Add DNS record](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162461) for format requirements.

Line.description_cn:
为该解析记录指定生效线路。当客户端发起 DNS 查询时，PrivateZone 会根据客户端源 IP 所属的线路匹配对应的解析结果。 取值范围由域名是否开启智能解析决定： | 域名是否开启智能解析（[CreatePrivateZone](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105) 时 `LineMode`） | 取值说明 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | **未开启**（`LineMode=0`） | 不传 / `default` | 仅支持默认线路。未传时按 `default` 处理。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | `default` | 默认线路。在未命中任何 AZ 线路或自定义线路时返回。建议至少为该域名保留一条 `default` 线路的记录作为兜底。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | AZ 线路 | 按地域及可用区划分的线路。取值来自 [ListAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520845?lang=zh) 返回的 `AzLine` 参数，格式为 `region;az`，例如 `cn-beijing;cn-beijing-a`。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | 自定义线路 | 您创建的自定义线路，用于将解析结果与自定义的 IP 网段绑定。取值来自 [ListCustomLines](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520846?lang=zh) 返回的 `Line` 参数，例如 `custom-101`。
如果您尚未创建任何自定义线路，请先调用 [CreateCustomLine](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520850) 创建后再在本接口引用。 |
Line.description_en: The route for parsing records can only be the default route `default`.

Remark.description_cn: 备注。支持 UTF-8 字符。不能超过 16 个字符。默认值为空字符串。
Remark.description_en: Note: Supports UTF-8 characters. Cannot exceed 16 characters. Default value is an empty string.

TTL.description_cn: 解析记录的过期时间。单位为秒。默认值为 600。
TTL.description_en: Expiration time for parsing records. Unit: seconds. Default value: 600

Type.description_cn:
记录类型。关于不同类型的记录，参见 [解析记录类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499)。该参数的取值如下：

- A：A 记录。
- AAAA：AAAA 记录。
- CNAME：CNAME 记录。
- TXT：TXT 记录。
- MX：MX 记录。
- PTR：PTR 记录。
Type.description_en:
Record type. For details on different types of records, see [Parsing record types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499). The parameter values are as follows:

- A: A record
- AAAA: AAAA record
- CNAME: CNAME record
- TXT: TXT record
- MX: MX record
- PTR: PTR record
- A: A record
- AAAA: AAAA record
- CNAME: CNAME record
- TXT: TXT record
- MX: MX record
- PTR: PTR record

Value.description_cn: 记录值。参见 [解析记录类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499)。

Weight.description_cn: 记录值的权重。只有域名开启了负载均衡后，记录值的权重才会生效。参见 [UpdatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163106) 了解如何为域名开启或关闭负载均衡。默认值为 1。
Weight.description_en: Weight of the record value. The weight only takes effect after load balancing is enabled for the domain name. See [UpdatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163106) to learn how to enable or disable load balancing for a domain name. Default value is 1.

ZID.description_cn:
域名 ID。您可以通过以下 API 获取：

- [CreatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [ListPrivateZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)
ZID.description_en:
Domain ID. You can obtain it using the following APIs:

- [CreatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [ListPrivateZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)

Direction.description_cn:
终端节点的 DNS 请求转发方向。

- OUTBOUND：（默认）出站终端节点，把来自 VPC 内的 DNS 查询请求转发到外部的 DNS 服务器。
- INBOUND：入站终端节点，把来自外部的 DNS 查询请求转发到解析器。
Direction.description_en:
DNS request forwarding direction for endpoint nodes

- OUTBOUND (default): Outbound endpoint nodes forward DNS queries from within the VPC to external DNS servers
- INBOUND: Inbound endpoint nodes forward DNS queries from external sources to the resolver

EndpointType.description_cn:
终端节点类型。
- IPv4：IPv4 节点。
- DualStack：双栈节点。
EndpointType.description_en:
Terminal node type
- IPv4: IPv4 node
- DualStack: Dual-stack node

IpConfigs.description_cn: 终端节点的可用区、子网和 IP 配置。
IpConfigs.description_en: Endpoint Availability Zone, Subnet, and IP Configuration

IpConfigs.AzID.description_cn: 终端节点 IP 地址所在的可用区。
IpConfigs.AzID.description_en: Availability zone where the terminal node IP address is located

IpConfigs.IP.description_cn: 终端节点的 IPv4 地址。
IpConfigs.IP.description_en: The IPv4 address of the endpoint.

IpConfigs.IPv6.description_cn: 终端节点的 IPv6 地址。

IpConfigs.SubnetID.description_cn: 终端节点 IP 地址所在的子网 ID。
IpConfigs.SubnetID.description_en: Subnet ID where the endpoint IP address is located

Name.description_cn: 终端节点的名称。支持 UTF-8 格式。
Name.description_en: Terminal node name. Supports UTF-8 format

ProjectName.description_cn: 终端节点所属的项目名称。默认为 `default`。
ProjectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the terminal node belongs. The default is `default`.

SecurityGroupID.description_cn:
适用于终端节点 IP 地址的安全组 ID。终端节点默认会使用预设安全组：

- 对于出站终端节点：入方向拒绝流量通行；出方向放通 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 TCP 53 端口和 UDP 53 端口
- 对于入站终端节点：入方向放通 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 TCP 53 端口和 UDP 53 端口；出方向拒绝流量通行。
SecurityGroupID.description_en:
Security group ID for endpoint IP addresses. Endpoints use a default security group:

- For outbound endpoints: inbound traffic is denied; outbound traffic is allowed for TCP port 53 and UDP port 53 to `0.0.0.0/0`
- For inbound endpoints: inbound traffic is allowed for TCP port 53 and UDP port 53 from `0.0.0.0/0`; outbound traffic is denied

Tags.description_cn: 终端节点所属的一个或多个标签。一个资源最多能关联 50 个标签。
Tags.description_en:
One or more tags associated with the terminal node
A resource can be associated with up to 50 tags

VpcID.description_cn: 终端节点所在的 VPC 的 ID。
VpcID.description_en: ID of the VPC where the endpoint is located

VpcRegion.description_cn: 终端节点所在的 VPC 的地域。
VpcRegion.description_en: Region of the VPC where the endpoint is located

VpcTrns.description_cn: 域名所关联的一个或多个 VPC 的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对域名关联的 VPC 所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
VpcTrns.description_en: The [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319) of one or more VPCs associated with the domain. Format: `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the VPC associated with the domain is located, you must provide this parameter.

EndpointID.description_cn:
终端节点的 ID。该参数仅在 `Type` 参数是 `OUTBOUND` 时有效且为必选参数。您可以从以下 API 的响应中获取：

- [CreateResolverEndpoint](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978333)
- [ListResolverEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978341)
EndpointID.description_en:
Endpoint ID. This parameter is only valid and required when the `Type` parameter is set to `OUTBOUND`. You can obtain it from the response of the following APIs:

- [CreateResolverEndpoint](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978333)
- [ListResolverEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978341)

EndpointTrn.description_cn: 终端节点的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对终端节点所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
EndpointTrn.description_en: TRN of the endpoint ([TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)). Format: `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId`. To verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the endpoint is located, you must provide this parameter.

ForwardIPs.description_cn: 外部的 DNS 服务器的 IP 地址和端口。您最多只能添加 10 个 IP 地址。该参数仅在 Type 参数是 OUTBOUND 时有效且为必选参数。
ForwardIPs.description_en:
IP address and port of the external DNS server
You can add up to 10 IP addresses
This parameter is only valid and required when the Type parameter is set to OUTBOUND

ForwardIPs.IP.description_cn: VPC 外部的 DNS 服务器的 IP 地址。
ForwardIPs.IP.description_en: IP address of DNS server outside the VPC

ForwardIPs.Port.description_cn: VPC 外部的 DNS 服务器的端口。
ForwardIPs.Port.description_en: Port of DNS server outside the VPC

Line.description_cn:
递归 DNS 服务器的出口 IP 地址的运营商。该参数仅在 `Type` 参数是 `LINE` 时有效。 支持的取值：
- `移动`：中国移动
- `电信`：中国电信
- `联通`：中国联通
Line.description_en:
ISP of the outbound IP address for the recursive DNS server. This parameter is only valid when the `Type` parameter is set to `LINE`.
Supported values:
- `移动`: China Mobile
- `电信`: China Telecom

TagFilters.description_cn:
域名的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的域名。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Domain name tags. You need to specify:

- N: The sequence number of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N must be consecutive numbers in ascending order.
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query domain names that contain all specified tag keys.
- Tag values: For example, `Values["v1", "v2"]`. The length of the tag values array must be between 1 and 3.

You can omit `Values`, which means it will not be used as a query condition. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags with empty `Values`. If `Values` contains multiple values, the values are combined using a logical OR.

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project Name
If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition

RecordIDs.description_cn:
解析记录 ID。您可以通过 [添加解析记录 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163682) 获取解析记录 ID。您可以输入多个解析记录 ID，例如 `RecordIDs.1=1234567&RecordIDs.2=2345678`。您最多输入 100 个解析记录 ID。您需要确保 RecordIDs 后的数字 N 从小到大且是连续的。
您必须传入 `ZID` 或 `RecordIDs` 至少一个参数，否则返回的 `Records` 将为空。
RecordIDs.description_en:
Record ID. You can obtain the record ID through the [Add Record API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163682). You can enter multiple record IDs, for example, `RecordIDs.1=1234567&RecordIDs.2=2345678`. You can enter up to 100 record IDs. Make sure the numbers after RecordIDs are consecutive and in ascending order.
You must provide at least one parameter: `ZID` or `RecordIDs`. Otherwise, the returned `Records` will be empty.

RecordIDs.N.description_cn:
解析记录 ID。您可以通过 [添加解析记录 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163682) 获取解析记录 ID。您可以输入多个解析记录 ID，例如 `RecordIDs.1=1234567&RecordIDs.2=2345678`。您最多输入 100 个解析记录 ID。您需要确保 RecordIDs 后的数字 N 从小到大且是连续的。
您必须传入 `ZID` 或 `RecordIDs` 至少一个参数，否则返回的 `Records` 将为空。
RecordIDs.N.description_en:
Record ID. You can obtain the record ID through the [Add Record API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163682). You can enter multiple record IDs, for example, `RecordIDs.1=1234567&RecordIDs.2=2345678`. You can enter up to 100 record IDs. Make sure the numbers after RecordIDs are consecutive and in ascending order.
You must provide at least one parameter: `ZID` or `RecordIDs`. Otherwise, the returned `Records` will be empty.

SearchMode.description_cn:
查询模式，用于搜索 `Host` 参数。包括以下模式：

- LIKE（默认）：模糊查询。
- EXACT：精确查询。

如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
SearchMode.description_en:
Search mode for the `Host` parameter. Available modes:

- LIKE (default): Fuzzy search
- EXACT: Exact search

If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a search condition.

Type.description_cn:
记录类型。

- A：A 记录。
- AAAA：AAAA 记录。
- CNAME：CNAME 记录。
- TXT：TXT 记录。
- MX：MX 记录。
- PTR：PTR 记录。

记录类型的详细信息参考 [解析记录类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499)。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
Type.description_en:
Record type

- A: A record
- AAAA: AAAA record
- CNAME: CNAME record
- TXT: TXT record
- MX: MX record
- PTR: PTR record

For more details about record types, see [DNS record types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499). If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

Value.description_cn: 记录值。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
Value.description_en: Record value. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

ZID.description_cn:
域名的 ID。您可以通过以下 API 获取：
- [CreatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [ListPrivateZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)
您必须传入 `ZID` 或 `RecordIDs` 至少一个参数，否则返回的 `Records` 将为空。
ZID.description_en:
Domain ID. You can obtain it through the following APIs:
- [CreatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)
- [ListPrivateZones API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)
You must provide at least one parameter: `ZID` or `RecordIDs`. Otherwise, the returned `Records` will be empty.

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不作为查询条件。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project Name
If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition

Tag.description_cn:
服务类型。

- ecs：ECS 主机名同步功能支持的地域列表。
- resolver：解析器 Resolver 支持的地域列表。

如果您不设置该参数，私网解析 PrivateZone 会返回默认的支持地域列表。
Tag.description_en:
Service types

- ecs: List of regions supported by ECS hostname synchronization
- resolver: List of regions supported by Resolver

If you do not set this parameter, private network resolution PrivateZone will return the default list of supported regions.

Direction.description_cn:
终端节点的 DNS 请求转发方向。如果您不设置该参数，列表中会同时包含出站终端节点和入站终端节点。
- OUTBOUND：出站终端节点，把来自 VPC 内的 DNS 查询请求转发到外部的 DNS 服务器。
- INBOUND：入站终端节点，把来自外部的 DNS 查询请求转发到解析器。
Direction.description_en:
DNS request forwarding direction for endpoint nodes. If you do not set this parameter, the list will include both outbound and inbound endpoint nodes
- OUTBOUND: Outbound endpoint node, forwards DNS queries from within the VPC to external DNS servers
- INBOUND: Inbound endpoint node, forwards DNS queries from external sources to the resolver

Name.description_cn: 终端节点的名称。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
Name.description_en: Name of the terminal node. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的域名。该参数的默认值是 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The API returns the domain names included on this page. The default value for this parameter is 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的域名数量。 系统会将获取的域名进行分页显示。页数是由获取的域名总数和 PageSize 确定。 该参数的默认值是 10，最大值是 500。
PageSize.description_en:
Number of domain names per page
The system displays the retrieved domain names in a paginated format
The number of pages is determined by the total number of domain names and the PageSize
The default value for this parameter is 10, and the maximum value is 500

ProjectName.description_cn: 终端节点所属的项目名称。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不作为查询条件。
ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project to which the terminal node belongs. If you leave this parameter blank, it will not be used as a query condition

Status.description_cn:
终端节点的状态。
- Creating：创建中。
- Running：运行中。
- Updating：更新中。
- Error：运行异常。
如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
Status.description_en:
Terminal node status
- Creating: Creating
- Running: Running
- Updating: Updating
- Error: Abnormal operation
If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition

TagFilters.description_cn:
终端节点的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的终端节点。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Tags for endpoint nodes. You need to specify:

- N: The index of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N must be consecutive and in ascending order
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query endpoint nodes that contain all specified tag keys
- Tag value: For example, `"Values":["v1", "v2"]`. The tag value array must contain 1 to 3 items

You can omit `Values` to exclude it from the query conditions. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, the relationship between them is logical OR

VpcID.description_cn: 终端节点所属的 VPC 的 ID。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不会作为查询条件。
VpcID.description_en: ID of the VPC to which the endpoint belongs. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

VpcTrns.description_cn: 域名所关联的一个或多个 VPC 的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对域名关联的 VPC 所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
VpcTrns.description_en: The [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319) of one or more VPCs associated with the domain name. Format: `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the VPC associated with the domain name is located, you need to provide this parameter.

EndpointID.description_cn:
出站终端节点的 ID。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不作为查询条件。您可以从以下 API 的响应中获取：

- [CreateResolverEndpoint](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978333)
- [ListResolverEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978341)
EndpointID.description_en:
Outbound endpoint ID. If you do not specify this parameter, it will not be used as a filter. You can obtain it from the response of the following APIs:

- [CreateResolverEndpoint](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978333)
- [ListResolverEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978341)

EndpointTrn.description_cn: 终端节点的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对终端节点所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
EndpointTrn.description_en: Endpoint's [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319), formatted as `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId` If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the endpoint is located, you need to provide this parameter.

Name.description_cn: 转发规则的名称。私网解析 PrivateZone 会按照该参数对转发规则的名称进行模糊查询。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不作为查询条件。
Name.description_en: Forwarding rule name. PrivateZone performs a fuzzy search on forwarding rule names based on this parameter. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a search condition.

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的域名。该参数的默认值是 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The API returns the domain names included on this page number. The default value for this parameter is 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的域名数量。 系统会将获取的域名进行分页显示。页数是由获取的域名总数和 PageSize 确定。 该参数的默认值是 10，最大值是 500。
PageSize.description_en:
Number of domain names per page
The system displays retrieved domain names in a paginated format
The number of pages is determined by the total number of domain names and the PageSize
The default value for this parameter is 10, and the maximum value is 500

ProjectName.description_cn: 转发规则所属的项目名称。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不作为查询条件。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name associated with the forwarding rule. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

TagFilters.description_cn:
转发规则的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的转发规则。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Tags for forwarding rules. You need to specify:

- N: The sequence number of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N must be consecutive numbers in ascending order
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query forwarding rules that contain all specified tag keys
- Tag values: For example, `Values["v1", "v2"]`. The tag values array must contain 1 to 3 items

You can omit `Values` to indicate that tag values are not used as query criteria. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, these values are combined with a logical OR

ZoneName.description_cn: 转发规则所关联的主域名。私网解析 PrivateZone 会按照该参数对主域名进行模糊查询。例如，您把该参数设置为 `example.com`，则对 `example.com` 以及 `example.com` 的所有子域名的 DNS 请求都会被转发。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不作为查询条件。
ZoneName.description_en: Primary domain name associated with the forwarding rule. PrivateZone performs a fuzzy search for the primary domain name based on this parameter. For example, if you set this parameter to `example.com`, DNS requests for `example.com` and all its subdomains will be forwarded. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的授权信息。默认值为 1。

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的授权信息数量。系统会将获取的授权信息进行分页显示，页数由授权信息总数和 PageSize 确定。默认值为 10，最大值为 500。

ZID.description_cn:
标识域名的唯一 ID。您可以通过以下 API 获取： 
- [添加域名 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105) 
- [获取域名列表 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163111)

MaxResults.description_cn: 返回值中标签的数量，默认为 10，最大为 100。
MaxResults.description_en: Number of tags in the return value; default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_cn: 分页查询凭证，用于标记分页的位置。您在初次调用该 API 时无需设置该参数。非初次调用该 API 时，该参数的取值为上一次 API 调用时该 API 返回的 NextToken 参数值。
NextToken.description_en: The pagination token parameter marks the position in paginated queries. You do not need to set this parameter when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent calls, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous API call.

ResourceIds.description_cn: 资源 ID。数组的最大长度为 50。
ResourceIds.description_en: Resource ID. Maximum array length: 50

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型。

- zone：域名。
- endpoint：终端节点。
- rule：转发规则。
ResourceType.description_en:
Resource types

- zone: Domain name
- endpoint: Endpoint
- rule: Forwarding rule

TagFilters.description_cn:
资源的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的资源。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values`，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Resource tags. You need to specify:

- N: The index of the `TagFilters`, with a value range of 1–10. N must be in ascending order and must be consecutive numbers.
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query resources that contain all specified tag keys.
- Tag value: For example, `"Values":["v1", "v2"]`. The length of the tag value array must be between 1 and 3.

You can omit `Values` to indicate that tag values are not used as query criteria. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, the relationship between them is logical OR.

TagType.description_cn:
标签类型。

- custom：用户标签。
- system：系统标签。

如果您不传入该参数，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询全部类型的标签。
TagType.description_en:
Tag types

- custom: User tag
- system: System tag

If you do not provide this parameter, private network resolution PrivateZone will query all tag types

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。页数由获取的 VPC 总数和 PageSize 确定。默认为 1。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number
The number of pages is determined by the total number of VPCs retrieved and the page size
Default is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的 VPC 的数量。默认为 20，最大不能超过 100。
PageSize.description_en: Number of VPCs per page. Default is 20; maximum cannot exceed 100

Region.description_en: VPC region

ZID.description_en:
Domain name ID. You can obtain it using the following APIs:

RecordID.description_en:
Record ID. You can obtain it using the following APIs:

- [ListRecords API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163694)

ZID.description_cn:
标识域名的唯一 ID。您可以通过以下 API 获取：

Unique domain name ID. You can obtain it through the following APIs:

- [Add Domain Name API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105)

EndpointID.description_cn:
终端节点的 ID。您可以从以下 API 的响应中获取：

- [CreateResolverEndpoint](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978333)

EndpointID.description_en:
Endpoint ID. You can obtain it from the response of the following APIs:

- [CreateResolverEndpoint](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978333)
- [ListResolverEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978341)

EndpointTrn.description_cn: 终端节点的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对终端节点所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
EndpointTrn.description_en: TRN of the endpoint. See [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319). Format: `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the endpoint is located, you need to provide this parameter.

RuleID.description_cn:
转发规则的 ID。您可以从以下 API 的响应中获取：

RuleID.description_en:
Forwarding rule ID. You can obtain it from the response of the following APIs:

- [CreateResolverRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978342)
- [ListResolverRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978346)

RuleTrn.description_cn: 转发规则的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:private_zone::accountId::rule/rule-ruleId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对转发规则所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。
RuleTrn.description_en: TRN of the forwarding rule [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319). Format: `trn:private_zone::accountId::rule/rule-ruleId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the forwarding rule resides, you must provide this parameter.

AccountID.description_cn: 需要验证的火山引擎账号。

EcsRegions.description_cn: 需要同步的地域和火山引擎账号。

Remark.description_cn: 自定义线路的备注。UTF-8 格式。最大长度为 64 个 UTF-8 字符。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不变。
Remark.description_en: Remark for the custom route. UTF-8 format. Maximum length is 64 UTF-8 characters. If you do not set this parameter, its value remains unchanged.

LineMode.description_cn:
是否开启智能解析。打开后不可再关闭。

支持取值：
- 0：关闭智能解析。
- 1：该参数已废弃。
- 2：该参数已废弃。
- 3：该参数已废弃。
- 4：开启智能解析。打开智能解析后，支持根据不同请求来源或者权重返回解析记录值，打开后不可再关闭。
LineMode.description_en:
Enable intelligent parsing. Once enabled, it cannot be disabled

- 0: Disable intelligent parsing
- 1: This parameter is deprecated
- 2: This parameter is deprecated
- 3: This parameter is deprecated
- 4: Intelligent parsing: supports weight, Availability Zone routes, custom routes

NodataFallback.description_cn:
针对私网域名在解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析为空的场景，是否回退到公网递归解析。
只有开启递归解析开关时（RecursionMode = true），该参数才生效。


- true：当该私网域名及其子域名的解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析返回为空时，触发公网递归解析规则，由公网递归 DNS 服务器返回查询结果。
- false：（默认）上述场景下不触发公网递归解析，直接返回空结果。
NodataFallback.description_en: When resolving private network domain names, if the resolution status code is noerror and local resolution returns empty, external recursive resolution will be performed; you must enable the recursion switch for it to take effect

RecursionMode.description_cn:
开启或关闭递归解析。

- true：开启递归解析。
- false：不开启递归解析。

如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会变化。
RecursionMode.description_en:
Enable or disable recursive parsing

- true: Enable recursive parsing
- false: Do not enable recursive parsing

If you do not set this parameter, its value will remain unchanged

Host.description_cn: 子域名的域名前缀（主机记录）。参见 [添加解析记录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162461) 了解域名前缀的格式要求。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Host.description_en: Domain prefix (host record) of the subdomain. See [Add DNS record](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162461) for format requirements of the domain prefix. If you do not set this parameter, its value will remain unchanged.

Line.description_cn:
为该解析记录指定生效线路。当客户端发起 DNS 查询时，PrivateZone 会根据客户端源 IP 所属的线路匹配对应的解析结果。 取值范围由域名是否开启智能解析决定： | 域名是否开启智能解析（[CreatePrivateZone](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105) 时 `LineMode`） | 取值说明 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | **未开启**（`LineMode=0`） | 不传 / `default` | 仅支持默认线路。未传时按 `default` 处理。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | `default` | 默认线路。在未命中任何 AZ 线路或自定义线路时返回。建议至少为该域名保留一条 `default` 线路的记录作为兜底。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | AZ 线路 | 按地域及可用区划分的线路。取值来自 [ListAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520845?lang=zh) 返回的 `AzLine` 参数，格式为 `region;az`，例如 `cn-beijing;cn-beijing-a`。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | 自定义线路 | 您创建的自定义线路，用于将解析结果与自定义的 IP 网段绑定。取值来自 [ListCustomLines](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520846?lang=zh) 返回的 `Line` 参数，例如 `custom-101`。
如果您尚未创建任何自定义线路，请先调用 [CreateCustomLine](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520850) 创建后再在本接口引用。 |
Line.description_en: The route for parsing records can only be the default route `default`

TTL.description_en: Expiration time for the parsing record, in seconds. If you do not set this parameter, its value will not change.

Value.description_en: Record value. See [DNS record types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162499). If you do not set this parameter, its value will not change.

Weight.description_cn: 记录值的权重。只有域名开启了负载均衡后，记录值的权重才会生效。参见 [UpdatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163106) 了解如何为域名开启或关闭负载均衡。如果您不设置该参数，该参数的值不会改变。
Weight.description_en: Weight of the record value. The weight only takes effect after load balancing is enabled for the domain. See [UpdatePrivateZone API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163106) for information on enabling or disabling load balancing for a domain. If you do not set this parameter, its value will not change.

EndpointTrn.description_en: Endpoint [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319). Format: `trn:private_zone::accountId::endpoint/ep-endpointId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the endpoint is located, you need to provide this parameter.

EndpointType.description_cn:

- IPv4：IPv4 节点。
- DualStack：双栈节点。
EndpointType.description_en:
Terminal node type

- IPv4: IPv4 node
- DualStack: Dual-stack node

IpConfigs.description_cn: 终端节点的可用区、子网和 IP 配置。 如果您不传入该参数，该参数的值不会变化。
IpConfigs.description_en: Availability zone, subnet, and IP configuration of the endpoint node. If you do not provide this parameter, its value will remain unchanged.

IpConfigs.AzID.description_cn: 终端节点 IP 地址所在的可用区。
IpConfigs.AzID.description_en: Availability zone where the terminal node IP address is located

IpConfigs.IP.description_cn: 终端节点的 IPv4 地址。
IpConfigs.IP.description_en: The IPv4 address of the endpoint.

IpConfigs.IPv6.description_cn: 终端节点的 IPv6 地址。

IpConfigs.SubnetID.description_cn: 终端节点 IP 地址所在的子网 ID。

Name.description_en: Terminal node name. Supports UTF-8 format. If you do not provide this parameter, its value will not change.

ForwardIPs.description_cn: VPC 外部的 DNS 服务器的 IP 地址和端口。您最多只能添加 10 个 IP 地址。该参数仅在 `Type` 参数是 `OUTBOUND` 时有效。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不会被更新。

ForwardIPs.IP.description_cn: VPC 外部的 DNS 服务器的 IP 地址。

ForwardIPs.Port.description_cn: VPC 外部的 DNS 服务器的端口。

Line.description_cn:
递归 DNS 服务器的出口 IP 地址的运营商。该参数仅在 `Type` 参数是 `LINE` 时有效。 支持的取值：
- `移动`：中国移动
- `电信`：中国电信
- `联通`：中国联通
如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不会被更新。

Name.description_cn: 转发规则的名称。支持 UTF-8 格式。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不会被更新。

RuleID.description_cn:
转发规则的 ID。您可以从以下 API 的响应中获取：

- [CreateResolverRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978342)
- [ListResolverRules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/978346)

RuleTrn.description_cn: 转发规则的 [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319)。格式为 `trn:private_zone::accountId::rule/rule-ruleId`。如果您需要验证子用户是否对转发规则所在的项目有操作权限，您需要传入该参数。

Vpcs.description_cn: 转发规则所关联的 VPC。转发规则在关联的 VPC 中生效。`Type` 参数是 `OUTBOUND` 时，VPC 的地域必须和终端节点所在的地域相同。

ZoneName.description_cn:
转发规则所关联的域名。您可以输入一个或多个域名。多个域名之间使用英文逗号（`,`）分隔，例如：`example.com,volcengine.com`。
- 最多支持输入 500 个域名。
- 该参数仅在`Type`参数是`OUTBOUND`时有效且为必选参数。
- 如果您把该参数设置为`*`，则转发规则适用于 VPC 关联的所有域名。

PermitAccountId.description_cn:
待添加服务白名单的账号ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155900)接口，查询终端节点所属账号的ID。
PermitAccountId.description_en: Account ID to be added to the service allowlist. You can call the [DescribeVpcEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155900) API to query the account ID of the VPC endpoint.

ServiceId.description_cn:
终端节点服务的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcEndpointServices](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155889)接口，获取终端节点服务的ID。
ServiceId.description_en: VPC endpoint service ID. You can call the [DescribeVpcEndpointServices](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155889) API to get the endpoint service ID.

EndpointId.description_cn:
终端节点的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155900)接口，获取终端节点的ID。
EndpointId.description_en: ID of the endpoint. You can call the [DescribeVpcEndpoints](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155900) API to get the endpoint ID.

PrivateIpAddress.description_cn: 终端节点网卡的私网IPv4地址，应属于子网IPv4网段内。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口，获取子网的网段。
PrivateIpAddress.description_en: The private IPv4 address of the endpoint network interface must be within the IPv4 subnet range. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to get the subnet range.

PrivateIpv6Address.description_cn:
终端节点网卡的私网IPv6地址，应属于子网IPv6网段内。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口，获取子网的网段。
该参数正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
PrivateIpv6Address.description_en:
The private IPv6 address of the endpoint network interface must be within the IPv6 subnet range. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to get the subnet range.
This parameter is currently in invitation-only testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

SubnetId.description_cn:
终端节点网卡所属子网的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口，获取子网ID。

IpAddressVersions.description_cn:
终端节点服务的IP协议类型。

* ipv4（默认值）
* ipv6：该取值正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

* 仅传入**ipv4**时，表示该终端节点服务为IPv4类型，仅支持提供IPv4服务。
* 同时传入**ipv4**和**ipv6**时，表示该终端节点服务为双栈类型，支持提供IPv4和IPv6服务，系统自动为其分配IPv6地址。
     如需传入**ipv6**，请确保满足以下条件：
   * 已开通私网连接服务的IPv6功能。
   * 指定的服务资源支持双栈。
* 目前不支持仅传入**ipv6**。
IpAddressVersions.description_en:
IP protocol type for the endpoint service.

* ipv4 (default)
* ipv6: This option is currently in invitation testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

* If you specify **ipv4** only, the endpoint service is IPv4 type and supports only IPv4 services.
* If you specify both **ipv4** and **ipv6**, the endpoint service is dual-stack, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 services. The system automatically assigns an IPv6 address.
     To specify **ipv6**, make sure you meet the following requirements:
   * IPv6 feature for Private Network Connection Service is enabled.
   * The specified service resource supports dual-stack.
* Specifying **ipv6** only is not supported at this time.

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ are allowed

Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated

Tags.N.Value.description_en:

IpAddressVersions.description_cn:
接口终端节点的IP协议类型。取值为**ipv4**和**ipv6**。

* 接口终端节点默认为**ipv4**，若仅为**ipv4**，请勿传入本参数。
* 若接口终端节点为双栈（**ipv4&ipv6**），则需要传入本参数。传入之前，请确保满足以下条件：
   * 您的账号已开通私网连接服务的IPv6功能。
   * 接口终端节点所属子网已开启IPv6网段。
   * 接口终端节点关联的终端节点服务为双栈类型。
* 参数-N：表示接口终端节点IP协议类型的序号，取值范围为1～2，两个IP协议类型的序号之间用&分隔。
* 当前暂不支持仅传入**ipv6**。

私网连接服务的IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
IpAddressVersions.description_en:
The IP protocol type of the interface endpoint. Valid values are **ipv4** and **ipv6**.

* The default protocol for interface endpoints is **ipv4**. If only **ipv4** is used, do not pass this parameter.
* If the interface endpoint is dual-stack (**ipv4&ipv6**), you must pass this parameter. Before passing it, make sure the following conditions are met:
   * Your account has enabled the IPv6 feature for PrivateLink.
   * The subnet to which the interface endpoint belongs has enabled the IPv6 CIDR block.
   * The endpoint service associated with the interface endpoint is dual-stack.
* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the interface endpoint IP protocol type. The value range is 1–2. Use & to separate the sequence numbers of the two IP protocol types.
* Currently, only passing IPv6 is not supported.

The IPv6 feature for PrivateLink is currently in invitation testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

   * 接口终端节点所属子网已开启IPv6网段。
   * 接口终端节点关联的终端节点服务为双栈类型。
* 参数-N：表示接口终端节点IP协议类型的序号，取值范围为1～2，两个IP协议类型的序号之间用&分隔。
* 当前暂不支持仅传入**ipv6**。

私网连接服务的IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

PrivateDNSEnabled.description_cn:
是否启用私有DNS名称。

* false（默认值）：不启用。
* true：启用。

* 终端节点服务的私有DNS名称验证状态为 Verified 时才可以启用。您可以调用[DescribeVpcEndpointServiceAttributes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155883)接口查看终端节点服务的私有DNS名称验证状态。
* 启用后，终端节点的私有DNS名称默认为其关联的终端节点服务的私有DNS名称。
PrivateDNSEnabled.description_en: Enable private DNS name * false (default): Disabled * true: Enabled  * You can enable this option only when the private DNS name verification status of the endpoint service is **verified**. Call the [DescribeVpcEndpointServiceAttributes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155883) API to check the private DNS name verification status of the endpoint service. * After enabling, the private DNS name of the endpoint defaults to the private DNS name of its associated endpoint service.

ProjectName.description_cn: 终端节点所属项目的名称。
ProjectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the endpoint belongs.

SecurityGroupIds.description_cn:
终端节点需要绑定的安全组的ID。 
您可以调用[DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753)接口，获取安全组ID。

* 参数-N：表示安全组ID的序号，取值范围为1～5。
* 多个安全组ID之间使用&分隔。
SecurityGroupIds.description_en:
ID of the security group to bind to the endpoint. You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) API to get the security group ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the security group ID, with a value range of 1–5.
* Use & to separate multiple security group IDs.

SecurityGroupIds.N.description_cn:
终端节点需要绑定的安全组的ID。 
您可以调用[DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753)接口，获取安全组ID。

* 参数-N：表示安全组ID的序号，取值范围为1～5。
* 多个安全组ID之间使用&分隔。
SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
ID of the security group to bind to the endpoint. You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) API to get the security group ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the security group ID, with a value range of 1–5.
* Use & to separate multiple security group IDs.

ServiceId.description_cn:
待关联终端节点服务的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcEndpointServices](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155889)接口，获取终端节点服务的ID。
ServiceId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint service to be associated. You can call the [DescribeVpcEndpointServices](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155889) API to get the endpoint service ID.

ServiceManaged.description_cn:
是否为托管终端节点。

* false（默认值）：非托管终端节点。
* true：托管终端节点。

该参数正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

ServiceName.description_cn: 待关联终端节点服务的名称。格式为：com.volces.privatelink.*<地域ID>*.*<终端节点服务ID>*。
ServiceName.description_en: Name of the endpoint service to associate. Format: com.volces.privatelink.*<Region ID>*.*<Endpoint Service ID>*.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
终端节点用户标签的标签键。

* 长度限制为1～128个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
* 不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the endpoint user tag.

* Length limit: 1–128 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ are allowed

Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
终端节点用户标签的标签值。

* 长度限制为0～255个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the endpoint user tag.

* Length limit: 0–256 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ are allowed

If this parameter is provided, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`.

VpcId.description_cn:
终端节点所属VPC的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口，获取VPC ID。
VpcId.description_en: ID of the VPC to which the endpoint belongs. Call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to get the VPC ID.

Zones.N.PrivateIpAddress.description_cn:
终端节点网卡的私网IPv4地址，应属于子网IPv4网段内。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口获取子网的网段。

* 参数-N：表示私网IPv4地址的序号，取值范围为1～10。
* 多个私网IPv4地址之间使用&分隔。
Zones.N.PrivateIpAddress.description_en:
The private IPv4 address of the endpoint network interface. It must belong to the IPv4 CIDR block of the subnet. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to get the subnet CIDR block.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the private IPv4 address. The value range is 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple private IPv4 addresses.

Zones.N.PrivateIpv6Address.description_cn:
终端节点网卡的私网IPv6地址，应属于子网IPv6网段内。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口获取子网的网段。

* 参数-N：表示私网IPv6地址的序号，取值范围为1～10。
* 多个私网IPv6地址之间使用&分隔。
* 不填默认在子网IPv6网段内随机分配IPv6地址。
Zones.N.PrivateIpv6Address.description_en:
The private IPv6 address of the endpoint network interface must belong to the IPv6 subnet range. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to get the subnet range.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the private IPv6 address, with a value range of 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple private IPv6 addresses.
* If not specified, an IPv6 address will be randomly assigned within the IPv6 subnet range by default.

Zones.N.SubnetId.description_cn:
待创建的终端节点网卡所属子网的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口，获取子网ID。

* 参数-N：表示子网ID的序号，取值范围为1～10。
* 多个子网ID之间使用&分隔。
Zones.N.SubnetId.description_en:
ID of the subnet to which the endpoint network interface will belong. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to get the subnet ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the subnet ID, with a value range of 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple subnet IDs.

Zones.N.ZoneId.description_cn:
待创建的终端节点网卡所属可用区的ID。更多可用区信息请参见[地域与可用区](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155774)。

* 参数-N：表示可用区的序号，取值范围为1～10。
* 多个可用区ID之间使用&分隔。
Zones.N.ZoneId.description_en:
ID of the availability zone to which the endpoint network interface will belong. For more information about availability zones, see [Regions and Availability Zones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155774).

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the availability zone, with a value range of 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple availability zone IDs.

AutoAcceptEnabled.description_cn:
是否自动接受终端节点连接。取值如下：

* true：终端节点服务自动接受终端节点连接。
* false（默认值）：终端节点服务不会自动接受终端节点连接，需要调用[EnableVpcEndpointConnection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155911)接口手动接受。
AutoAcceptEnabled.description_en:
Whether to automatically accept endpoint connections. Values:

* true: The endpoint service automatically accepts endpoint connections.
* false (default): The endpoint service does not automatically accept endpoint connections. You need to manually accept by calling the [EnableVpcEndpointConnection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155911) API.

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

* 该参数值由客户端自动生成，确保不同请求的取值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 取值仅支持ASCII字符，最大不超过64个字符。
* 未指定该参数值时，不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure idempotency of requests.

* The client automatically generates this parameter value to ensure that each request is unique, preventing duplicate operations caused by multiple retries when API calls time out or internal server errors occur.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters.
* If this parameter is not specified, idempotency verification is not performed.

Description.description_cn:
终端节点服务的描述，默认值为空字符串。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、中划线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ～ 255个字符。
Description.description_en:
Description of the endpoint service. The default value is an empty string.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can contain letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length limit: 0–255 characters.

IpAddressVersions.description_cn:
终端节点服务的IP协议类型。取值为**ipv4**和**ipv6**。

* 终端节点服务默认为**ipv4**，若仅为**ipv4**，请勿传入本参数。
* 若终端节点服务为双栈（**ipv4&ipv6**），则需要传入本参数。传入之前，请确保满足以下条件：
   * 已开通私网连接服务的IPv6功能。
   * 指定的服务资源支持双栈。
* 参数 - N：表示终端节点服务IP协议类型的序号，取值范围为1～2，两个IP协议类型的序号之间用&分隔。
* 当前暂不支持仅传入IPv6。

私网连接服务的IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
IpAddressVersions.description_en:
IP protocol type for the endpoint service. Valid values are **ipv4** and **ipv6**.

* The default for endpoint service is **ipv4**. If only **ipv4** is used, do not provide this parameter.
* If the endpoint service is dual stack (**ipv4&ipv6**), you must provide this parameter. Before providing it, make sure the following conditions are met:
   * IPv6 functionality for Private Network Connect Service is enabled.
   * The specified service resource supports dual stack.
* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the endpoint service IP protocol type. Valid values are 1–2. Use & to separate the sequence numbers of the two IP protocol types.
* Currently, only providing IPv6 is not supported.

IPv6 functionality for Private Network Connect Service is currently in invitation testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

* 若终端节点服务为双栈（**ipv4&ipv6**），则需要传入本参数。传入之前，请确保满足以下条件：

* 参数 - N：表示终端节点服务IP协议类型的序号，取值范围为1～2，两个IP协议类型的序号之间用&分隔。
* 当前暂不支持仅传入IPv6。

私网连接服务的IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
IpAddressVersions.N.description_en:
IP protocol type for the endpoint service. Valid values are **ipv4** and **ipv6**.

* If the endpoint service is dual stack (**ipv4&ipv6**), you must provide this parameter. Before providing it, make sure the following conditions are met:
   * IPv6 functionality for Private Network Connect Service is enabled.
   * The specified service resource supports dual stack.
* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the endpoint service IP protocol type. Valid values are 1–2. Use & to separate the sequence numbers of the two IP protocol types.

IPv6 functionality for Private Network Connect Service is currently in invitation testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

Payer.description_cn:
私网连接的付费账号。

* Endpoint（默认值）：终端节点账号。
* EndpointService：终端节点服务账号。

因账号欠费导致终端节点服务被回收时，终端节点服务关联的终端节点将被一并删除。

PrivateDNSEnabled.description_cn:
是否为终端节点服务启用私有DNS名称。

* false（默认值）：不启用。
* true：启用。
PrivateDNSEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable private DNS name for the endpoint service.

* false (default): Not enabled.
* true: Enabled.

PrivateDNSName.description_cn:
私有DNS名称，即通过私网连接访问服务时希望使用的自定义域名，仅支持公网域名。
公网域名不支持传入已配置全局解析的内网域名，以及私网连接使用的域名（包括终端节点服务域名和终端节点域名）。
* 参数`PrivateDNSEnabled`取值为**true**时，必须传入该参数。
* 若传入域名为泛域名 `*.www.example.com`，则该泛域名及其根域名 `www.example.com` 均支持解析。
PrivateDNSName.description_en:
Private DNS name, which is the custom domain name you want to use when accessing the service via private network connection. Only public domain names are supported.
Public domain names do not support passing internal domain names with global resolution configured, nor domain names used for private network connections (including endpoint service domain names and endpoint domain names).

* When `PrivateDNSEnabled` is set to **true**, this parameter is required.
* If a wildcard domain name such as `*.www.example.com` is provided, both the wildcard domain and its root domain `www.example.com` are supported for resolution.

PrivateDNSType.description_cn:
私有DNS名称的域名类型。

* public（默认值）：公网。

参数`PrivateDNSEnabled`取值为**true**时，该参数生效。
PrivateDNSType.description_en:
Domain type of the private DNS name.

* public (default): Public network.

* This parameter takes effect when `PrivateDNSEnabled` is set to **true**.

ProjectName.description_cn: 终端节点服务所属项目的名称。
ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project to which the endpoint service belongs.

Resources.N.ResourceId.description_cn:
待添加到终端节点服务中的服务资源ID。
您可以调用[DescribeLoadBalancers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71772)接口，获取CLB实例的ID。

* N：表示服务资源的序号，取值范围为1～20。
* 多个服务资源间使用&分隔。
Resources.N.ResourceId.description_en:
Service resource ID to be added to the endpoint service. You can call the [DescribeLoadBalancers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71772) API to get the CLB instance ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the service resource, value range is 1–20.
* Use & to separate multiple service resources.

Resources.N.ZoneIds.description_cn:
负载均衡提供服务的可用区。

* ServiceResourceType取值为**ALB**时，该参数为必填。
   * 第一个N：表示资源的序号，取值范围为1～20。
   * 第二个N：表示资源提供服务的可用区序号，取值范围为1～服务支持的最大可用区数。
* ServiceResourceType取值为**CLB**时，无需填写该参数，默认使用CLB实例的主可用区。
Resources.N.ZoneIds.description_en:
Availability zone where the load balancer provides service.

* When ServiceResourceType is **ALB**, this parameter is required.
   * The first N: Indicates the resource sequence number, valid values are 1–20.
   * The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the availability zone where the resource provides service, valid values are 1–the maximum number of supported availability zones.
* When ServiceResourceType is **CLB**, you do not need to provide this parameter. The main availability zone of the CLB instance is used by default.

Resources.N.ZoneIds.N.description_cn:
负载均衡提供服务的可用区。

* ServiceResourceType取值为**ALB**时，该参数为必填。
   * 第一个N：表示资源的序号，取值范围为1～20。
   * 第二个N：表示资源提供服务的可用区序号，取值范围为1～服务支持的最大可用区数。
* ServiceResourceType取值为**CLB**时，无需填写该参数，默认使用CLB实例的主可用区。
Resources.N.ZoneIds.N.description_en:
Availability zone where the load balancer provides service.

* When ServiceResourceType is **ALB**, this parameter is required.
   * The first N: Indicates the resource sequence number, valid values are 1–20.
   * The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the availability zone where the resource provides service, valid values are 1–the maximum number of supported availability zones.
* When ServiceResourceType is **CLB**, you do not need to provide this parameter. The main availability zone of the CLB instance is used by default.

ServiceNameManaged.description_cn:
是否为托管终端节点服务。

* false（默认值）：非托管终端节点服务。
* true：托管终端节点服务。

该参数正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
ServiceNameManaged.description_en: The service name of the service-managed instance.

ServiceNameSuffix.description_cn:
终端节点服务的名称后缀。
设置名称后缀后，系统会按照**com.volces.privatelink.<地域ID>.<名称后缀>​**的格式生成终端节点服务的名称。
该参数正在邀测中，如需使用不同名称后缀区分业务，请联系客户经理。
ServiceNameSuffix.description_en:
Endpoint service name suffix.
After setting the name suffix, the system generates the endpoint service name in the format **com.volces.privatelink.<region ID>.<name suffix>**.
This parameter is currently in invitation testing. To use different name suffixes to distinguish businesses, please contact your account manager.

ServiceOwner.description_cn:
终端节点服务的所有者。

* volcengine：火山引擎服务。
* normal：普通服务。

* 该参数正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
* 该参数传入volcengine时，系统会自动为您开通自定义域名功能、自定义名称后缀功能和泛域名功能。
ServiceOwner.description_en: The service owner of the service instance.

ServiceResourceType.description_cn:
服务资源的类型。取值如下：

* CLB：负载均衡CLB。
* ALB：应用型负载均衡ALB。

私网连接支持ALB类型服务资源的功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
ServiceResourceType.description_en:
Type of service resource. Values:

* CLB: Load Balancer CLB.

* Service provider role TRN: `trn:iam/{Custom role name in the service provider account}`

TagFilters.N.Values.description_en:
Tag value for the endpoint service tag. Each tag key can specify up to 3 tag values.

* If this parameter is not provided, queries all endpoint services associated with all tag values under the specified tag key.
* If this parameter is empty, queries endpoint services associated with tags under the specified tag key that have empty tag values.
* If multiple tag values are specified for the same tag key, queries the set of endpoint services associated with each tag value under that tag key.

If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `TagFilters.N.Key`.

TagFilters.N.Values.description_cn:

* 未传入该参数时，表示查询指定标签键下所有标签值对应的标签所关联的终端节点或终端节点服务实例。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`TagFilters.N.Key`。
TagFilters.N.Values.description_en: Specifies the tag values when querying resources by tag. You can specify up to 3 tag values for each tag key. * If this parameter is not provided, all resources associated with all tag values under the specified tag key will be queried. * If this parameter is empty, resources associated with tags whose value is empty under the specified tag key will be queried. * If multiple tag values are specified for the same tag key, the set of resources associated with each tag value under that tag key will be queried.  If you provide this parameter, you must first specify TagFilters.N.Key.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can contain letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)

IpAddressVersions.description_cn:
终端节点服务的IP协议类型。

* ipv4
* ipv6：该取值正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

* 仅传入**ipv4**时，表示该终端节点服务转换为IPv4类型，仅支持提供IPv4服务。
* 同时传入**ipv4**和**ipv6**时，表示该终端节点服务转换为双栈类型，支持提供IPv4和IPv6服务，系统自动为其分配IPv6地址。
     如需传入**ipv6**，请确保满足以下条件：
   * 已开通私网连接服务的IPv6功能。
   * 指定的服务资源支持双栈。
* 目前不支持仅传入**ipv6**。
* 不更改该参数取值时，保持原有配置不变。
IpAddressVersions.description_en:
IP protocol type of the endpoint service.

* ipv4
* ipv6: This value is currently in invitation testing. To use it, please contact your account manager.

* If you enter only **ipv4**, the endpoint service is converted to IPv4 type and supports only IPv4 services.
* If you enter both **ipv4** and **ipv6**, the endpoint service is converted to dual-stack type, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 services. The system automatically assigns an IPv6 address.
     To enter **ipv6**, make sure the following conditions are met:
   * IPv6 feature for PrivateLink service is enabled.
   * The specified service resource supports dual-stack.
* Currently, entering only **ipv6** is not supported.
* If you do not change this parameter value, the original configuration remains unchanged.

     如需传入**ipv6**，请确保满足以下条件：

IpAddressVersions.description_cn:
接口终端节点的IP协议类型。

* ipv4
* ipv6：该取值正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

* 仅传入**ipv4**时，表示该接口终端节点转换为IPv4类型，仅支持处理IPv4请求。
* 同时传入**ipv4**和**ipv6**时，表示该接口终端节点转换为双栈类型，支持处理IPv4和IPv6请求，系统自动为其分配IPv6地址。
     如需传入**ipv6**，请确保满足以下条件：
   * 已开通私网连接双栈功能的白名单权限。
   * 接口终端节点所属子网已开启IPv6网段。
   * 接口终端节点关联的终端节点服务为双栈类型。
* 目前不支持仅传入**ipv6**。
IpAddressVersions.description_en:
IP protocol type of the interface endpoint.

* ipv4
* ipv6: This value is currently in beta. To use it, contact your account manager.

* If you only specify **ipv4**, the interface endpoint is converted to IPv4 type and only supports IPv4 requests.
* If you specify both **ipv4** and **ipv6**, the interface endpoint is converted to dual-stack type, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 requests. The system automatically assigns an IPv6 address.
     To specify **ipv6**, make sure the following conditions are met:
   * Allowlist permission for PrivateLink dual-stack feature is enabled.
   * The subnet of the interface endpoint has IPv6 enabled.
   * The endpoint service associated with the interface endpoint is dual-stack type.
* Specifying only **ipv6** is not supported at this time.

PrivateDNSName.description_cn:
私有DNS名称，即通过私网连接访问服务时希望使用的自定义域名，仅支持公网域名。
公网域名不支持传入已配置全局解析的内网域名，以及私网连接使用的域名（包括终端节点服务域名和终端节点域名）。

* 参数`PrivateDNSEnabled`取值为**true**时，必须传入该参数。
* 若传入的域名为泛域名 `*.www.example.com`，则该泛域名及其根域名 `www.example.com` 均支持解析。
PrivateDNSName.description_en:
Private DNS name, which is the custom domain name you want to use when accessing the service via PrivateLink. Only public domain names are supported.
Public domain names do not support internal domain names that have been configured for global resolution, nor domain names used by PrivateLink (including endpoint service domain names and endpoint domain names).

* When the `PrivateDNSEnabled` parameter is set to **true**, this parameter is required.
* If the entered domain name is a wildcard domain `*.www.example.com`, both the wildcard domain and its root domain `www.example.com` are supported for resolution.

PrivateDNSType.description_en:

ResourceReplaceMode.description_cn:
更换服务资源的模式。

* grace：平滑更换。当前终端节点网卡与旧的服务资源连接保持不变，终端节点新建一张网卡，通过该网卡与新的服务资源建立连接。新增流量默认发往新连接，待旧连接无流量后，您需要调用[DisableVpcEndpointConnection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155916)接口，手动断开旧连接。

平滑切换是通过终端节点新增一张网卡建立连接的方式，请充分评估业务影响后，谨慎操作。


* force：立即更换。终端节点网卡立即与原有服务资源断开连接，并与新的服务资源建立连接。
ResourceReplaceMode.description_en:
Mode for replacing service resources.

* grace: Smooth replacement. The current endpoint network interface remains connected to the old service resource. The endpoint creates a new network interface to connect to the new service resource. New traffic is sent to the new connection by default. After the old connection has no traffic, you need to call the [DisableVpcEndpointConnection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155916) API to manually disconnect the old connection.

Smooth switchover is achieved by creating a new network interface for the endpoint. Please carefully evaluate the business impact before proceeding.


* force: Immediate replacement. The endpoint network interface immediately disconnects from the original service resource and connects to the new service resource.

VpcLinkName.description_cn:

ZoneId.description_en: ID of the availability zone to which the endpoint network interface (ENI) belongs. For more information about availability zones, see [Regions and Availability Zones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6980/155774).

* Separate multiple resource IDs with &.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。

* 长度限制为1～128个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
* 不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tag.

* Length limit: 1–128 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ are allowed

Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。

* 长度限制为0～255个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tag.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ are allowed

If this parameter is provided, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`.

AllowList.description_cn:
IP 地址列表，表示允许这些 IP 地址访问。

- 多个 IP 地址请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复。
- 支持以下两种格式：

	- IP 地址形式，例如：`10.23.12.xx`。
	- CIDR 形式，例如：`10.23.12.x/xx`。

- 当 IP 较多时，建议合并为 IP 段填入，例如`10.23.12.x/24`。
- 每个实例最多添加 300 个 IP 或 IP 段，即所有 IP 白名单分组内的 IP 或 IP 段总和不能超过 300。
AllowList.description_en:
IP address list that allows access from these IP addresses

- Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,) and do not repeat any addresses
- Supports the following two formats:

- IP address format, for example: 10.23.12.xx
- CIDR format, for example: 10.23.12.x/xx

- If you have many IP addresses, we recommend combining them into IP ranges, such as 10.23.12.x/24
- Each instance can add up to 300 IP addresses or IP ranges; the total number of IP addresses or IP ranges in all allowlist groups cannot exceed 300

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单描述，长度不超过 200 个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Allowlist description. Maximum 200 characters.

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称，限制说明如下：

- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线或连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Allowlist name

- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Allowlist name must be unique within the current region

AllowListType.description_cn: IP 地址类型，当前仅支持设置为 IPv4。
AllowListType.description_en: IP address type; currently, only IPv4 can be set

ChargeInfo.description_cn: RabbitMQ 实例的计费类型等计费信息。
ChargeInfo.description_en: Billing type and other billing information for the RabbitMQ instance.

ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_cn:
包年包月实例到期后是否自动续费。
- `true`：自动续费。
- `false`：不自动续费。到期后需要手动续费，否则实例将被关停。
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether the subscription instance will automatically renew after expiration
- true: Auto-renew
- false: Do not auto-renew. You must renew manually when the instance expires, or it will be shut down
This option is required only for subscription instances (when ChargeType is set to PrePaid)

ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_cn:
实例的计费类型。支持的类型包括：
- `PostPaid` ：按量付费
- `PrePaid`：包年包月
指定为`PrePaid`时，应同时指定`AutoRenew`、`PeriodUnit`和`Period`参数。
ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_en:
Instance billing type. Supported types include:
- PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: Yearly/monthly subscription
If you select PrePaid, you should also specify the AutoRenew, PeriodUnit, and Period parameters.

ChargeInfo.Period.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的购买时长。
- `PeriodUnit`指定为`Month`时，取值范围为 1~9。
- `PeriodUnit`指定为`Year`时，取值范围为 1~3。
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for subscription-based instances.
- When PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are 1–9.
- When PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are 1–3.
This is required only for subscription-based instances; it is mandatory when ChargeType is set to PrePaid.

ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的生命周期单位，即指定以月或以年为单位购买。支持设置为：
- `Month`：包月
- `Year`：包年
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_en:
Lifecycle unit for subscription-based instances, specifying whether to purchase by month or year. Supported settings:
- Month: Monthly subscription
- Year: Annual subscription
Required only for subscription-based instances (when ChargeType is set to PrePaid).

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。
该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](/docs/6451/1160443)。
ClientToken.description_en:
Idempotency token for client requests.
This token is a 1–64 character ASCII string, case-sensitive, generated by the client. Ensure the token is unique for each request.
For how to use idempotency tokens, see [Request Idempotency](/docs/6451/1160443).

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例的计算规格。
消息队列 RabbitMQ版实例提供的计算规格清单，请参考[产品规格](/docs/6451/72249)。
ComputeSpec.description_en:
Instance compute specification.
For the list of compute specifications provided by Message Queue for RabbitMQ instances, see [Product Specifications](/docs/6451/72249).

EipId.description_cn:
EIP的ID。
- 指定 EipId 表示开启实例的公网访问。
-  EIP 提供独立的公网 IP 资源，包括公网 IP 地址与公网出口带宽服务。指定此参数开启公网访问后，公网地址将绑定您的弹性公网 IP（EIP），费用由 EIP 收取。
EipId.description_en:
EIP ID.
- Specifying EipId enables public network access for the instance.
- EIP provides independent public IP resources, including public IP addresses and outbound bandwidth services. After enabling public network access by specifying this parameter, the public address will be bound to your Elastic Public IP (EIP), and EIP charges will apply.

InstanceDescription.description_cn: RabbitMQ 实例的简单描述。长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
InstanceDescription.description_en: Brief description of the RabbitMQ instance. Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

InstanceName.description_cn:
RabbitMQ 实例的名称。 需满足以下要求：
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字和连字符（-）开头。
- 长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
如果创建实例时未指定名称，则默认将实例 ID 作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Name of the RabbitMQ instance. Must meet the following requirements:
- Can only contain Chinese Hanzi characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
If no name is specified when creating the instance, the instance ID will be used as the default name.

IsEncrypted.description_cn: 是否使用磁盘加密，仅用于开白金融用户。
IsEncrypted.description_en: Use disk encryption (only available for whitelisted financial users)

NetworkTypes.description_cn: 网络类型。多选，以逗号分隔。仅innerapi可见。
NetworkTypes.description_en: Network type. Multiple selections separated by commas. This option is only visible to innerapi users.

ProjectName.description_cn:
当前创建的 RabbitMQ 实例所属的 IAM 项目。
如果未指定 IAM 项目，消息队列 RabbitMQ版会将新实例添加到名为 default 的 IAM 项目中。
ProjectName.description_en:
The IAM project to which the currently created RabbitMQ instance belongs.
If no IAM project is specified, Message Queue for RabbitMQ will add the new instance to the IAM project named default.

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例的存储空间。
单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围及默认值取决于当前指定的计算规格。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance storage space.
Unit: GiB. Must be a multiple of 100. The value range and default value depend on the specified compute specification.

SubnetId.description_cn:
实例所在的 VPC 子网 ID。
- 实例创建完成后，不可修改对应的私有网络和子网。创建实例时请谨慎操作。
- 您可以调用私有网络（VPC）的 DescribeVpcs 接口查询可用的 VPC 和子网列表。
SubnetId.description_en:
VPC subnet ID where the instance is located.
- After the instance is created, the corresponding private network and subnet cannot be modified. Please operate carefully when creating the instance.
- You can call the DescribeVpcs API of the private network (VPC) to query the list of available VPCs and subnets.

TagMap.description_cn: 云资源标签。可以将实例通过标签进行归类，便于实例的搜索和资源聚合。详细说明请参考[标签管理]。
TagMap.description_en: Cloud resource tags. You can categorize instances by tags for easier search and resource aggregation. For details, see [Tag Management].

Tags.description_cn: 云资源标签。可以将实例通过标签进行归类，便于实例的搜索和资源聚合。详细说明请参考[标签管理](/docs/6451/166385)。

AllowList.description_cn:
IP 地址列表，表示允许这些 IP 地址访问。

- 多个 IP 地址请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复。
- 支持以下两种格式：

- IP 地址形式，例如：`10.23.12.xx`。
- CIDR 形式，例如：`10.23.12.xx/xx`。

- 当 IP 较多时，建议合并为 IP 段填入，例如 `10.23.12.x/24`。
- 每个实例最多添加 300 个 IP 或 IP 段，即所有 IP 白名单分组内的 IP 或 IP 段总和不能超过 300。
AllowList.description_en:
List of IP addresses allowed to access

- Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,) and do not include duplicate addresses
- Supports the following two formats:

- IP address format, for example: 10.23.12.xx
- CIDR format, for example: 10.23.12.xx/xx

- If you have many IP addresses, it is recommended to merge them into IP ranges, such as 10.23.12.x/24
- Each instance can add up to 300 IP addresses or IP ranges. The total number of IP addresses or IP ranges in all allowlist groups cannot exceed 300

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 修改后的白名单描述。长度不超过 200 个字符。默认值为空，若修改时不设置，则描述会被设置为空字符串。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Updated allowlist description. Maximum length is 200 characters. Default value is empty; if not set during modification, the description will be set to an empty string.

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称，约束限制如下：

- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线或连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Allowlist name

- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Can contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Allowlist name must be unique within the current region

ApplyInstanceNum.description_cn: 已应用实例数量，即当前该白名单所绑定的实例数。主要目的是确认本次修改的影响范围，避免误操作引发故障。
ApplyInstanceNum.description_en: Number of applied instances, which is the current number of instances bound to this allowlist. The main purpose is to confirm the scope of this modification and prevent failures caused by incorrect operations.

ModifyMode.description_cn:
白名单修改方式，默认值为 Cover。支持设置为：

- `Cover`：使用`AllowList`参数的值覆盖原白名单。
- `Append`：在原白名单中增加`AllowList`参数中输入的 IP 地址。
- `Delete`：在原白名单中删除`AllowList`参数中输入的 IP 地址。至少需要保留一个 IP 地址。
ModifyMode.description_en:
Allowlist modification mode. The default value is Cover. You can set:

- Cover: Overwrite the original allowlist with the value of the AllowList parameter
- Append: Add the IP addresses entered in the AllowList parameter to the original allowlist
- Delete: Remove the IP addresses entered in the AllowList parameter from the original allowlist. At least one IP address must remain
