NetworkType.description_cn: 网络类型，"Classic"-经典网络，"VPC"-私有网络，默认"VPC"
NetworkType.description_en: Network type: "Classic" – classic network, "VPC" – private network. Default: "VPC"

NoAuthMode.description_cn:
为新建实例开启或关闭免密访问功能。取值范围如下：

* `open`：开启免密访问。
* `close`（默认值）：关闭免密访问。

* 参数取值不区分大小写。
* 实例创建成功后，您还可以调用 [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) 接口开启或关闭免密访问功能。关于免密访问的更多信息，请参见[免密访问](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/94328)。
NoAuthMode.description_en:
Enable or disable passwordless access for the new instance. Value options:

* `open`: Enable passwordless access
* `close` (default): Disable passwordless access

* Parameter values are case-insensitive.
* After the instance is created, you can also call the [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) API to enable or disable passwordless access. For more information, see [Passwordless Access](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/94328).

NodeCpus.description_en: Node CPU cores: Only 2, 4, or 8 are allowed

NodeNumber.description_cn:
每个分片中的节点数。取值范围为 1~6。
* 每个账号在每个地域下默认最多可创建 4 个 256 MiB 规格（即 `ShardCapacity` 取值为 `256`）的节点，若您需要调整 256 MiB 规格节点的购买配额 （上限为 10 个），请参见[账号配额](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)。
* 取值为`1`时，表示创建单节点实例；取值大于`1`时，表示创建主备实例。单节点实例和主备实例支持的功能特性不同，关于两种类型实例的功能特性差异详情，请参见[功能特性差异](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/97275#%E4%B8%BB%E5%A4%87%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%92%8C%E5%8D%95%E8%8A%82%E7%82%B9%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%B7%AE%E5%88%AB%EF%BC%9F)。
NodeNumber.description_en:
Number of nodes per shard. Value range: 1–6
* By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of the 256 MiB specification (that is, `ShardCapacity` set to `256`) in each region. To adjust the purchase quota for 256 MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Account Quota](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)
* When the value is `1`, a single-node instance is created; when greater than `1`, a master-replica instance is created. Single-node and master-replica instances support different features. For details on the differences, see [Feature Differences](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/97275#%E4%B8%BB%E5%A4%87%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%92%8C%E5%8D%95%E8%8A%82%E7%82%B9%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%B7%AE%E5%88%AB%EF%BC%9F)

ParameterGroupId.description_cn:
需要应用到新实例的参数模板。
* 缓存数据库 Redis 版为每个数据库版本都创建了一份默认的系统参数模板，模板中包含了该版本支持设置的所有参数和默认参数值。若该参数留空，默认会根据您设置的数据库版本 （即 `EngineVersion`），以及实例类型是否为单节点（即 `NodeNumber` 是否为 `1`）为新建实例选择并应用对应版本的系统参数模板。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下的所有参数模板的基本信息，包括参数模板 ID。
ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template to be applied to the new instance.
* Redis provides a default system parameter template for each database version, which includes all configurable parameters and their default values for that version. If this parameter is left blank, the system will select and apply the corresponding version's system parameter template based on your specified database version (`EngineVersion`) and whether the instance is single-node (`NodeNumber` is `1`).
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to query basic information about all parameter templates under your account and region, including parameter template IDs.

Password.description_cn:
设置默认数据库 default 账号的密码。设置的密码需同时满足如下要求：

* 长度为 8~64 个字符。
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意 2 种。
* 支持如下特殊字符：

```Plain Text
()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
```

* 若该参数留空，表示不为 default 账号设置密码，此时系统会自动为 default 账号生成一个密码来保证实例访问安全性。任何账号都无法获取该随机密码，因此在连接实例前，您需通过 [ModifyDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71733) 接口重置 default 账号的密码。
* 您还可以根据业务需要，通过 [CreateDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/69656) 接口设置新的账号和密码。
* 若需使用免密访问功能，您需要先通过 [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) 接口开启免密访问。
Password.description_en:
Set the password for the default database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

* Length: 8–64 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* Supports the following special characters:

```Plain Text
()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
```

* If this parameter is left blank, no password will be set for the default account. In this case, the system will automatically generate a password for the default account to ensure instance security. No account can retrieve this random password, so you must reset the default account password via the [ModifyDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71733) API before connecting to the instance.
* You can also set a new account and password as needed via the [CreateDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/69656) API.
* To use passwordless access, you must first enable passwordless access via the [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) API.

PointBasicTosPrefix.description_cn: 备份点的basic tos prefix,批量创建实例时，用于实例context设置
PointBasicTosPrefix.description_en: The basic tos prefix of the backup point is used to set the instance context during batch instance creation

Port.description_cn:
自定义私网连接地址的端口号，取值范围：1024~65535。
* 若该参数留空，私网连接地址默认使用 6379 端口。
* 实例创建成功后，您还可以修改私网地址的端口号。端口号修改方法，请参见[修改端口号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/81348)。
Port.description_en:
Customize the port number for the private network connection address. Value range: 1024~65535.
* If this parameter is left blank, the private network connection address uses port 6379 by default.
* After the instance is created, you can also modify the port number of the private network address. For instructions, see [Modify Port Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/81348).

ProjectName.description_cn:
选择实例所属的项目。若该参数留空，新建实例会加入默认（即`default`）项目。
项目是一个虚拟的概念，包括一组资源、用户和角色。通过项目可以对一组资源进行统一的查看和管理，并且控制项目内用户和角色对这些资源的权限。更多详情，请参见[资源管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333)。
ProjectName.description_en:
Select the project to which the instance belongs. If this parameter is left blank, the new instance will be added to the default (i.e., `default`) project.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects allow unified viewing and management of resources, and control the permissions of users and roles within the project for those resources. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333).

PublicZoneConsulVisit.description_cn: 是否启用通过公共服务区功能

PublicZoneVisit.description_cn: 是否开启公共服务区访问

PurchaseMonths.description_cn:
购买时长，单位：月。取值范围如下：

* 按月购买：`1`，`2`，`3`，`4`，`5`，`6`，`7`，`8`，`9`。
* 按年购买：`12`，`24`，`36`。

当`ChargeType`为`PrePaid`时，该参数必填。
PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration, in months. Value options:

* Monthly purchase: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`
* Annual purchase: `12`, `24`, `36`

When `ChargeType` is `PrePaid`, this parameter is required.

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) 接口查询 Redis 实例支持的所有地域信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID.
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) API to query all region information supported by Redis instances, including region IDs.

RestoreInfoGetFromDataBase.description_cn: 标记恢复实例数据的备份点是否需要从数据库中获取,批量创建实例时，用于实例context设置
RestoreInfoGetFromDataBase.description_en: Indicates whether to retrieve the backup point for restoring instance data from the database; used for setting instance context during batch creation

SealZoneVisit.description_en: Do you want to enable sales area access?

ShardCapacity.description_cn:
每个分片的内存容量，单位：MiB。取值范围如下：

* 未启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `0`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：256，512，1024，2048，4096，8192，16384，32768，24576，65536。
* 启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：1024，2048，4096，8192，16384。

* 当创建单节点实例（即 `NodeNumber` 取值为 `1`）时，不支持选择 256 MiB 规格的内存容量。
* 关于 Redis 产品规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. Value options:

* When sharded cluster is not enabled (`ShardedCluster` set to `0`), available values per shard: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 24576, 65536
* When sharded cluster is enabled (`ShardedCluster` set to `1`), available values per shard: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384

* When creating a single-node instance (`NodeNumber` set to `1`), 256 MiB memory capacity is not supported
* For more details on Redis product specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)

ShardNumber.description_cn:
实例中的分片数量。取值范围为 2~256。
仅当 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`（即启用分片集群）时，需要指定该参数。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the instance. Value range: 2–256.
This parameter is required only when `ShardedCluster` is set to `1` (enabled).

ShardedCluster.description_cn:
是否启用分片集群。取值范围如下：

* `0`：不启用。
* `1`：启用。

关于缓存数据库 Redis 版的产品架构更多信息，请参见[产品架构](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062)。
ShardedCluster.description_en:
Whether to enable sharded cluster. Value range:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

For more information about the product architecture of Redis, see [Product Architecture](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062).

StorageInnerVisit.description_cn: 是否存储内网访问访问

SubnetId.description_cn:
设置实例的子网 ID。
* 子网具有可用区属性，必须选择目标私有网络中与实例属于同一可用区下的子网。
* 子网是私有网络内的 IP 地址块私有网络中的所有云资源都必须部署在子网内，子网为云资源分配私网 IP 地址，您可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建子网。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定可用区内的所有子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en:
Set the subnet ID for the instance.
* Subnets have availability zone attributes. You must select a subnet in the target VPC that is in the same availability zone as the instance.
* A subnet is an IP address block within a VPC. All cloud resources in the VPC must be deployed within a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can call the [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) API to create a subnet.
* You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query all subnet list information in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
若该参数留空，新建实例默认不绑定任何标签。
Tags.description_en:
Array of tag keys and tag values to bind.
If this parameter is left empty, the new instance will not bind any tags by default.

Tags.Key.description_cn:
需要绑定标签所对应的标签键。
* 该参数留空表示新建实例不绑定任何标签。当需要为实例绑定标签时，标签键（Key）必填，标签值（Value）可不填，不填标签值表示对应标签键的标签值为空。
* 支持一次传入多组标签键值对象，多组标签键值对象间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对。
* 单个实例最多可绑定 50 个标签。标签键需满足设置规则，具体规则请参见[标签设置规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/181410#%E6%A0%87%E7%AD%BE%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99)。
Tags.Key.description_en:
The tag key to be bound.
* Leaving this parameter empty means the new instance will not be bound to any tags. When you need to bind tags to an instance, the tag key (Key) is required, while the tag value (Value) is optional. If the tag value is not provided, the corresponding tag key will have an empty value.
* You can specify multiple tag key-value objects at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 tag key-value pairs can be specified at the same time.
* Each instance can be bound to up to 50 tags. Tag keys must comply with the configuration rules. For details, see [Tag Configuration Rules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/181410#%E6%A0%87%E7%AD%BE%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99).

Tags.Value.description_cn:
需要绑定标签所对应的标签值。
* 当需要为实例绑定标签时，标签键（Key）必填，标签值（Value）可不填，不填标签值表示对应标签键的标签值为空。
* 支持一次传入多组标签键值对象，多组标签键值对象间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对。
* 单个实例最多可绑定 50 个标签。标签值需满足设置规则，具体规则请参见[标签设置规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/181410#%E6%A0%87%E7%AD%BE%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99)。
Tags.Value.description_en:
The tag value to be bound.
* When you need to bind tags to an instance, the tag key (Key) is required, while the tag value (Value) is optional. If the tag value is not provided, the corresponding tag key will have an empty value.
* You can specify multiple tag key-value objects at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 tag key-value pairs can be specified at the same time.
* Each instance can be bound to up to 50 tags. Tag values must comply with the configuration rules. For details, see [Tag Configuration Rules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/181410#%E6%A0%87%E7%AD%BE%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99).

VpcId.description_cn:
设置实例的私有网络 ID。
* 建议 Redis 实例与需要连接的 ECS 实例在同一私有网络，否则它们无法通过内网互通来实现最佳性能。您可以调用 [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) 接口创建私有网络。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询符合指定条件的私有网络信息，包括私有网络 ID。
VpcId.description_en:
Set the instance's VPC ID.
* It is recommended that the Redis instance and the ECS instance to be connected are in the same VPC; otherwise, they cannot communicate over the internal network for optimal performance. You can create a VPC using the [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) API.
* You can query VPC information that meets specified criteria, including VPC ID, using the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API.

AllowListIds.description_cn:
白名单 ID 列表。新建实例会被绑定到指定白名单。
您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1393071) 接口查询当前账号下指定地域内的所有 IP 白名单信息，包括白名单 ID 信息。关于企业版白名单的更多信息，请参见[创建白名单](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255848)。
AllowListIds.description_en:
Whitelist ID list. The system binds newly created instances to the specified whitelist.
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1393071) API to query all IP whitelist information, including whitelist IDs, for the specified region under your account. For more details about enterprise edition whitelists, see [Create Whitelist](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255848).

AutoRenew.description_cn:
是否开启自动续费。取值范围如下： 

* `true`：开启。 
* `false`（默认值）：不开启。

仅当 `ChargeType` 为 `PrePaid` 时，该参数生效。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

* `true`: Enable
* `false` (default): Disable

This parameter is effective only when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

ChargeType.description_cn:
计费类型。取值范围如下： 

* `PostPaid`：按量计费。 
* `PrePaid`：包年包月。

关于计费类型的更多信息，请参见[计费类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1355136)。
ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type. Available options:

* `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go
* `PrePaid`: Subscription (annual/monthly)

For more information about billing types, see [Billing types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1355136).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value. It must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ConfigureNodes.description_cn: 节点所属的可用区列表。
ConfigureNodes.description_en: List of availability zones for the node

DataLayout.description_cn:
指定新建实例的数据存储形态，取值范围如下： 

* `RAM`：内存型。 
* `Hybrid`：混存型。 

关于企业版实例数据存储形态的更多信息，请参见[数据存储形态](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81)。
DataLayout.description_en:
Specify the data storage type for the new instance. Available options:

* `RAM`: Memory type
* `Hybrid`: Hybrid type

For more information about data storage types for enterprise edition instances, see [Data Storage Types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81).

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
开启或关闭实例删除保护功能。取值范围如下： 

* `disabled`（默认值）：关闭。 
* `enabled`：开启。

若该参数不填，默认关闭实例删除保护功能。关于实例删除保护的更多信息，请参见[实例删除保护](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255845)。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Enable or disable instance deletion protection. Valid values:

* `disabled` (default): Disabled
* `enabled`: Enabled

If this parameter is not specified, instance deletion protection is disabled by default. For more information, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255845).

FlashPerShard.description_cn:
设置单分片的高速存储容量，单位：MiB。 
取值范围：10240~30720（即 10GiB~30GiB），步长为 10240MiB，（即 10GiB）。
仅当实例的数据存储形态为混存型（即 `DataLayout` 为 `Hybrid`）时，该参数生效。
FlashPerShard.description_en:
Set the high-speed storage capacity for a single shard in MiB.
Range: 10240–30720 (10GiB–30GiB), increment: 10240MiB (10GiB).
This parameter is only effective when the instance data storage type is hybrid (i.e., `DataLayout` is set to `Hybrid`).

Initiator.description_cn: 请求发起者，为空表示SDK发起，"WEB"表示前端页面调用
Initiator.description_en: Leave blank to indicate the request is initiated by the SDK. Enter 'WEB' to indicate the request is initiated by the frontend page.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。名称需同时满足如下要求： 

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。 
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。 
* 长度需要在 1~128 个字符内。

若该参数留空，默认将实例 ID 作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name
The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be 1–128 characters long

If this parameter is left blank, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

MaintenanceTime.description_cn: 实例的可维护时间段, xx:00-yy:00，最小2小时
MaintenanceTime.description_en: Instance maintenance window, xx:00-yy:00, minimum 2 hours

Modules.description_cn:
设置需要加载的模块。支持的模块类型如下： 

* `RedisJSON`
* `RedisBloom`
* `RediSearch`
* `RedisTimeSeries`

* 仅当创建数据存储类型为内存型实例（即 `DataLayout` 为 `RAM`）时，支持使用 `RediSearch` 和 `RedisTimeSeries` 模块。
* 若该参数留空，默认不会加载任何模块。更多关于 Redis 模块的详情，请参见[数据模块](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97)。
Modules.description_en:
Set the modules to load. Supported module types:

* `RedisJSON`
* `RedisBloom`
* `RediSearch`
* `RedisTimeSeries`

* `RediSearch` and `RedisTimeSeries` modules are only available when the data store type is an in-memory instance (that is, when `DataLayout` is set to `RAM`).
* If this parameter is left blank, no modules will be loaded by default. For more details about Redis modules, see [Data Modules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97).

MultiAZ.description_cn:
设置实例的可用区部署方案。取值范围如下： 

* `disabled`（默认值）：单可用区部署方案。 
* `enabled`：多可用区部署方案。

关于可用区部署方案的更多说明，请参见[多可用区同城容灾解决方案](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1285437)。
MultiAZ.description_en:
Set the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Valid values:

* `disabled` (default): Single availability zone deployment
* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment

For more details about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-availability zone same-city disaster recovery solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1285437).

NeedRecoverPoint.description_cn: 是否需要恢复数据,是否需要做种数据
NeedRecoverPoint.description_en: Do we need to restore data? Do we need to seed data?

Password.description_cn:
设置默认数据库 default 账号的密码。密码需同时满足如下要求： 

* 长度为 8~32 个字符。 
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意 2 种。 
* 支持如下特殊字符：
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```


* 若该参数留空，表示不为 default 账号设置密码，此时系统会自动为 default 账号生成一个密码来保证实例访问安全性。任何账号都无法获取该随机密码，因此在连接实例前，您需先[重置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255833) default 账号的密码。
* 您也可以在实例创建后，根据业务需要创建新的账号和密码，具体操作步骤，请参见[创建与管理账号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1262348)。
Password.description_en:
Set the password for the default database account. The password must meet all of the following requirements:

* Length must be 8–32 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* The following special characters are supported:
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```

* If you leave this field blank, no password will be set for the default account. The system will automatically generate a password to secure instance access. No account can retrieve this random password, so you must [reset](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255833) the default account password before connecting to the instance.
* After the instance is created, you can also create new accounts and passwords as needed. For detailed steps, see [Create and manage accounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1262348).

ProjectName.description_cn:

ProjectName.description_en:

NodesNumberToDecrease.description_cn:
设置单分片中需要减少的节点数。
每个分片支持 2~6 个节点，即 2 <= （当前节点数 - 减少节点数） <= 6。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括每个分片中当前节点数。
* 每个账号在每个地域下默认最多可创建 4 个 256MiB 规格的节点，若您需要调整 256MiB 规格节点的购买配额 （上限为 10 个），请参见[约束与使用限制](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)。
NodesNumberToDecrease.description_en:
Set the number of nodes to remove from a single shard
Each shard supports 2 to 6 nodes. After reducing nodes, the total must satisfy: 2 <= (current node count - nodes to remove) <= 6
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details for a specific instance, including the current node count in each shard
* By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of the 256MiB specification per region. To adjust the purchase quota for 256MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Constraints and usage limits](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)

NodesToRemove.description_en: Set Updated Availability Zones for Node

NodesToRemove.AZ.description_cn:
设置减少节点所属的可用区。
实例的减少节点数（即 `NodesNumberToDecrease` 参数值）以及可用区部署方案（即 `MultiAZ` 参数值）都会影响当前参数的填写情况，其中：

* 当实例部署方案为多可用区部署（即 `MultiAZ` 取值为 `enabled`）时，**该参数必填**，且**传入的可用区数量必须等于需要减少的单分片节点数量**（即 `NodesNumberToDecrease` 参数值）。

例如，您需要为多可用区实例的每个分片中再减少 2 个节点，这两个节点分别属于可用区 A 和 B，那么您可以参考如下设置：
```JavaScript
"NodesNumberToDecrease":2,
"NodesToRemove": [
    {
        "AZ": "cn-beijing-a"
    },
    {
        "AZ": "cn-beijing-b"
    }
]    
```


* 当实例部署方案为单可用区部署（即 `MultiAZ` 取值为 `disabled`）时，无需设置该参数。需要减少的节点所在的可用区即为实例当前所在的可用区。

* 每个主备实例至少保留 2 个节点，且针对部署了多可用区方案的实例，剩余节点需至少部署在 2 个不同的可用区内。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65753) 接口查询目标地域下的可用区信息，包括可用区 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括是否设置了多可用区部署方案。
NodesToRemove.AZ.description_en:
Configure the availability zone for node reduction.
The number of nodes to reduce (that is, the value of the `NodesNumberToDecrease` parameter) and the availability zone deployment scheme (that is, the value of the `MultiAZ` parameter) both affect how you fill in this parameter. Specifically:

* If the instance is deployed across multiple availability zones (that is, `MultiAZ` is set to `enabled`), **this parameter is required**, and **the number of availability zones provided must equal the number of nodes to reduce per shard** (that is, the value of `NodesNumberToDecrease`).

For example, if you need to reduce 2 nodes from each shard of a multi-availability zone instance, and these two nodes belong to availability zone A and B respectively, you can configure as follows:
```JavaScript
"NodesNumberToDecrease":2,
"NodesToRemove": [
    {
        "AZ": "cn-beijing-a"
    },
    {
        "AZ": "cn-beijing-b"
    }
]    
```

* If the instance is deployed in a single availability zone (that is, `MultiAZ` is set to `disabled`), you do not need to set this parameter. The availability zone for the nodes to reduce is the current availability zone of the instance.

* Each primary/standby instance must retain at least 2 nodes, and for instances deployed across multiple availability zones, the remaining nodes must be distributed across at least 2 different availability zones.
* You can call the [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65753) API to query availability zone information in the target region, including availability zone IDs.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of a specified instance, including whether multi-availability zone deployment is enabled.

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为待删除实例的最终备份设置备份名称。若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 该参数仅对**按量计费**的**主备实例**生效，即实例的 `InstanceClass` 为 `PrimarySecondary` 且 `ChargeType` 为 `PostPaid`。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型和计费类型。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the final backup of the instance to be deleted. If you do not specify a backup name, the backup ID will be used by default.

To set a backup name, make sure the name meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Contains 1–128 characters
* Consists of Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter applies only to **pay-as-you-go** **primary-secondary instances**, where `InstanceClass` is `PrimarySecondary` and `ChargeType` is `PostPaid`.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to view details of a specific instance, including instance type and billing type.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client must generate this parameter value, which must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_cn:
删除实例时是否创建一个最终备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`（默认值）：创建。
* `false`：不创建。

* 该参数仅对主备节点实例生效。单节点实例不支持持久性和备份功能，删除单节点实例时默认不会创建任何备份，删除后所有数据将被彻底清除且不可再恢复，请谨慎操作。关于单节点实例的更多详情，请参见[产品架构](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062#%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84)。
* 若该参数留空，删除主备实例时默认会创建一个最终备份来保存删除前的所有数据，您可以在实例删除后，调用 [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) 接口查看该实例的所有备份集（包括已删除实例的备份集）信息。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Create a final backup when deleting an instance. Possible values:

* `true` (default): Create a backup
* `false`: Do not create a backup

* This parameter applies only to master-replica node instances. Single-node instances do not support persistence or backup. When you delete a single-node instance, no backup is created by default. All data will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Please proceed with caution. For more details about single-node instances, see [Product Architecture](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062#%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84).
* If you leave this parameter empty, a final backup will be created by default when deleting a master-replica instance to save all data before deletion. After the instance is deleted, you can call the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) API to view all backup sets for the instance, including backups of deleted instances.

Initiator.description_cn: 请求发起者，为空表示SDK发起，"WEB"表示前端页面调用
Initiator.description_en: Request initiator. Leave blank for SDK-initiated requests; enter 'WEB' for requests from the frontend page

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为待删除实例的最终备份设置备份名称。如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 该参数仅当**按量计费**实例选择了在删除实例前创建全量备份（即 `CreateBackup` 为 `true` ）时生效；包年包月实例删除前创建的最终备份名称即为备份 ID。
* 若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the final backup of the instance to be deleted. If you want to set a backup name, make sure it meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective for pay-as-you-go instances when you choose to create a full backup before deleting the instance (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`). For subscription instances, the final backup name created before deletion is the backup ID.
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the default name.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_cn:
是否在删除实例前创建全量备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`（默认值）：创建备份。
* `false`：不创建。

* 该参数仅对**按量计费**（即  `ChargeType` 为 `PostPaid`）的实例生效；包年包月（即  `ChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`）实例删除前必须创建一个最终备份，不支持设置该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1168033) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型和计费类型。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Whether to create a full backup before deleting the instance. Valid values:

* `true` (default): Create a backup
* `false`: Do not create

* This parameter applies only to **Pay-As-You-Go** instances (where `ChargeType` is `PostPaid`). For Subscription instances (where `ChargeType` is `PrePaid`), a final backup must be created before deletion and this parameter cannot be set.
* You can call the [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1168033) API to query details of a specified instance, including instance type and billing type.

ParameterGroupId.description_cn:
参数模板 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下所有的参数模板基本信息，包括参数模板 ID。
* 仅自定义参数模板（即 `Source` 取值为 `User`）支持删除，系统参数模板（即 `Source` 取值为 `System`）不可删除。
* 模板删除后无法恢复，建议谨慎操作。更多详情，请参见[删除参数模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1131869)。
ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template ID.
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to query basic information for all parameter templates under your account and region, including the parameter template ID.
* Only custom parameter templates (where `Source` is `User`) can be deleted; system parameter templates (where `Source` is `System`) cannot be deleted.
* Deleted templates cannot be restored. It is recommended to proceed with caution. For more details, see [Delete Parameter Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1131869).

AllowListId.description_cn:

您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询当前账号下在指定地域内的所有白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。

ProjectName.description_en: ProjectName is used for Project authentication processing and filtering

IPAddress.description_cn:
根据 IP 地址筛选出满足条件的白名单。
使用 `IPAddress` 查询时，会精确匹配该 IP 地址以及包含该 IP 地址的 IP 地址段进行筛选。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用 IP 地址对查询结果进行筛选。
* 支持同时传入多个 IP 地址，最多同时传入 50 个 IP 地址。多个 IP 地址间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
IPAddress.description_en:
Filter the whitelist that meets the criteria by IP address.
When you query with `IPAddress`, the system matches the exact IP address and any IP address ranges that include it.
* Leave this parameter blank to disable IP address filtering
* You can enter up to 50 IP addresses at once, separated by English commas (,)

IPSegment.description_cn:
根据 IP 地址段筛选出满足条件的白名单。
使用 `IPSegment` 查询时，会精确匹配该 IP 地址段进行筛选。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用 IP 地址段对查询结果进行筛选。
* 支持同时传入多个 IP 地址段，最多同时传入 50 个 IP 地址段。多个 IP 地址段间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
IPSegment.description_en:
Filter the whitelist by IP address range
When you query with `IPSegment`, the filter precisely matches entries within the specified IP address range
* If you leave this parameter blank, the results are not filtered by IP address range
* You can enter up to 50 IP address ranges at once, separated by commas (,)

* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。

ProjectName.description_en:
Whitelist Project Name

QueryDefault.description_cn:
根据白名单类型筛选是否仅查询默认白名单。取值范围如下：

* `true`：是，仅查询默认白名单。
* `false`：否，仅查询普通白名单。

若该参数留空，表示不使用白名单类型条件进行筛选，即会返回所有类型的白名单信息。
QueryDefault.description_en:
Filter by whitelist type to determine whether to query only the default whitelist. Valid values:

* `true`: Yes, query only the default whitelist
* `false`: No, query only the regular whitelist

If this parameter is left empty, whitelist type filtering is not applied and information for all whitelist types is returned

RegionId.description_en:
Region ID

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

BackupType.description_cn:
恢复方式。取值范围如下：

* `Full`（默认值）：全量恢复，即按备份集恢复。
* `Inc`：增量恢复，即按时间点恢复。

* 若需要按时间点恢复（即 `BackupType` 为 `Inc`），需先开启数据闪回功能。更多详情，请参见[按时间点恢复到原实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/79880#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B)。
* 您可以调用 [StartContinuousBackup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71803) 接口为指定实例开启数据闪回功能。
BackupType.description_en:
Recovery mode. Available options:

* `Full` (default): Full recovery, restores from the backup set
* `Inc`: Incremental recovery, restores to a specific point in time

* To restore to a specific point in time (`BackupType` set to `Inc`), you must enable the data flashback feature first. For details, see [Restore to original instance by point in time](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/79880#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B).
* You can call the [StartContinuousBackup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71803) API to enable data flashback for a specified instance.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。

您可以调用  [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) 接口查看指定实例的备份集信息列表，包括各备份文件的备份 ID 信息。

Backup ID of the target backup file

InstanceBasicInfo.description_en: Instance information for the specified backup point; backuppointinfo returns this field

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID

PointPrefix.description_cn: 备份点基础路径，backuppointinfo会返回该字段，可能为空

PointStartTime.description_cn: 指定备份点的channeldate，用于openapi的新增参数，与BasicChannelDate的作用和赋值是一致的
PointStartTime.description_en: Specifies the channeldate of the backup point. It is used as a new parameter in openapi, with the same function and assignment as BasicChannelDate.

BackupPointId.description_cn:
备份文件的备份 ID。支持模糊查询。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份 ID 筛选。
BackupPointId.description_en:
Backup file backup ID. Fuzzy search supported.
* This parameter is valid only when the query scope is the current account (`Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup ID filtering is not applied.

BackupPointName.description_cn:
备份名称，支持模糊查询。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为 `OneInstance`）时，该参数不生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份名称筛选。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Backup name, supports fuzzy search.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (that is, when `Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is not applicable.
* If this parameter is left blank, the backup name will not be used for filtering.

BackupStrategyList.description_cn:
备份方式列表。取值范围如下：

* `ManualBackup`：手动备份。
* `AutomatedBackup`：自动备份。

* 支持同时传入多个备份方式，多个备份方式间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份方式筛选。
BackupStrategyList.description_en:
Backup method list. The value range is as follows:

* `ManualBackup`: Manual backup
* `AutomatedBackup`: Automated backup

* Multiple backup methods can be specified at the same time, separated by commas (,).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup method filtering is not applied.

EndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了查询开始时间（即 `StartTime`），该参数必填。
* 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。
EndTime.description_en:
Query end time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If a query start time (`StartTime`) is set, this parameter is required.
* The query end time must be later than the start time.
* If this parameter is left blank, time range filtering is not applied.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为`OneInstance`）时，该参数必填。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例 ID 筛选。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (`Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is required.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* If this parameter is left blank, instance ID filtering is not applied.

OrderBy.description_cn: 排序依据，取值：OrderBy_E的string值，当前仅支持StartTime和InstanceId，替换掉原来的常量
OrderBy.description_en: Sorting basis. Value: string value of OrderBy_E. Currently, only StartTime and InstanceId are supported, replacing the previous constants

OrderType.description_cn: 排序方式，取值：枚举OrderType_E的string值，替换掉原来的常量
OrderType.description_en: Sort order. Value: string value of enum OrderType_E, replaces the original constant

PageNumber.description_cn:
备份集信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
* 若设置了该参数，每页记录数（即 `PageSize`）也必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用页码范围筛选。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for the backup set information list. The value must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The starting value is 1.
* If this parameter is set, the number of records per page (`PageSize`) is also required.
* If this parameter is left blank, page range filtering is not applied.

PageSize.description_cn:
每页记录数。取值为 1~1000 间的整数。
* 若设置了页码（即 `PageNumber`），该参数必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用每页记录数筛选。
PageSize.description_en:
Records per page. Value: integer between 1 and 1000.
* If a page number (`PageNumber`) is set, this parameter is required.
* If this parameter is left blank, records per page will not be used for filtering.

ProjectName.description_cn:
备份所属的项目。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用项目名称筛选。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the backup belongs.
* This parameter is only applicable when the query scope is the current account (that is, when `Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, the project name will not be used for filtering.

Scope.description_cn:
备份查询范围。取值范围如下：

* `OneInstance`（默认值）：查询单个实例内的备份。
* `AccountInstances`：查询当前账号下的备份。
Scope.description_en:
Backup query scope. The value range is as follows:

* `OneInstance` (default): Query backups within a single instance.
* `AccountInstances`: Query backups under the current account.

Search.description_en: Search by instance ID or name

StartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了该参数，查询结束时间（即`EndTime`）参数也必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。
StartTime.description_en:
Query start time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If this parameter is set, the query end time (`EndTime`) parameter is also required.
* If this parameter is left blank, time range filtering is not applied.

Status.description_cn:
备份状态。取值范围如下：

* `Creating`：创建中。
* `Available`：可用。
* `Unavailable`：不可用。
* `Deleting`：删除中。

更多关于备份状态的说明，请参见[备份状态](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/83041#%E5%A4%87%E4%BB%BD%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81)。
Status.description_en:
Backup status. The value range is as follows:

* `Creating`: Creating
* `Available`: Available
* `Unavailable`: Unavailable
* `Deleting`: Deleting

For more information about backup status, see [Backup Status](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/83041#%E5%A4%87%E4%BB%BD%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81).

TargetInstanceStatuses.description_en: Status of the instance to which the backup point belongs

Context.description_cn: 可选。查询上下文，首次查询为空
Context.description_en: Optional. Query context is empty on first query

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

KeyType.description_cn:
指定用于过滤大 Key 查询结果的数据类型。支持如下数据类型：

* `string`
* `list`
* `set`
* `zset`
* `hash`

若该参数留空，表示不使用数据类型进行过滤。
KeyType.description_en:
Specify the data type to filter large key query results. Supported data types:

* `string`
* `list`
* `set`
* `zset`
* `hash`

Leave this parameter blank to disable data type filtering

OrderBy.description_cn:
指定查询结果的排序条件。支持如下排序条件：

* `ValueSize`（默认值）：按内存占用对大 Key 查询结果进行排序。
* `ValueLen`：按元素数量对大 Key 查询结果进行排序。
OrderBy.description_en:
Specify the sorting criteria for query results. The following options are supported:

* `ValueSize` (default): Sorts large key query results by memory usage
* `ValueLen`: Sorts large key query results by number of elements

OrderType.description_en: Optional. Sort order: desc or asc. Default is desc

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~100 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page must be an integer between 1 and 100

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 24 小时。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query end time defaults to the current time
* The end time must be later than the start time, and the time range cannot exceed 24 hours

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 最多支持查看最近 15 天内的大 Key 分布情况。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 24 小时前的时间。
   例如，当前时间为 2023 年 03 月 27 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2023 年 03 月 26 号 16:30:00。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 24 小时。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* You can view the distribution of large keys for up to the past 15 days
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query start time defaults to 24 hours before the current time
  For example, if the current time is March 27, 2023, 16:30:00, and `QueryStartTime` is not set, the actual query start time will be March 26, 2023, 16:30:00
* The query end time must be later than the query start time, and the time range cannot exceed 24 hours

ExcludeCompleted.description_cn:
是否查询已处于完成（包括切换完成 `SWITCHOVER_COMPLETED`和删除完成`DELETE_COMPLETED`）状态的蓝绿部署任务。取值范围如下：

* `false`（默认值）：不查询。
* `true`：查询。
ExcludeCompleted.description_en:
Whether to query blue-green deployment tasks that are already completed (including switchover completed `SWITCHOVER_COMPLETED` and delete completed `DELETE_COMPLETED`). Value options are as follows:

* `false` (default): Do not query
* `true`: Query

InstanceId.description_cn:
已创建蓝绿部署任务的蓝色或绿色实例的实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID of the blue or green instance with a created blue-green deployment task
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs

Context.description_cn: 分页上下文。首次查询可为空；查询下一页时传入上一次响应中的 Context。为空或不传时表示首次分页查询。
Context.description_en: Pagination context. Can be empty for the first query; for subsequent pages, use the Context value from the previous response. Empty or not provided indicates the first paginated query

Filter.description_cn: 过滤条件列表，用于按客户端连接属性筛选会话快照。不传或为空列表时不过滤。每个过滤项包含 FilterKey 和 FilterValue。
Filter.description_en: Filter condition list, used to filter session snapshots by client connection attributes. No filtering is applied if not provided or if the list is empty. Each filter item includes FilterKey and FilterValue

Filter.FilterKey.description_cn:
过滤条件的 Key。取值：

* `ClientId`：按 Redis client session ID 过滤。
* `ClientAddr`：按客户端地址和端口过滤。
* `NodeId`：按 Proxy 节点 ID 过滤。
Filter.FilterKey.description_en:
Filter key. Options:

* `ClientId`: Filter by Redis client session ID.
* `ClientAddr`: Filter by client address and port.
* `NodeId`: Filter by Proxy node ID.

Filter.FilterValue.description_cn: 过滤条件的 Key 对应的 Value.
Filter.FilterValue.description_en: Value corresponding to the filter key.

InstanceId.description_cn: Redis 实例 ID，用于指定要查询客户端会话快照的实例。不能为空，服务端会校验实例存在性和账号归属。
InstanceId.description_en: Redis instance ID, used to specify the instance for which to query client session snapshots. Cannot be empty; the server will verify instance existence and account ownership

OrderBy.description_cn: 排序字段。可为空；非空时必须为 ClientSessionOrderBy 支持的枚举值，如 `ClientAddr`、`SessionAge`、`SessionIdle`、`SessionFlags`、`SessionDb`、`SessionSub`、`SessionPsub`、`SessionMulti` 或 `SessionCmd`。
OrderBy.description_en: Sort field. Can be empty; if not empty, must be one of the enumerated values supported by ClientSessionOrderBy, such as `ClientAddr`, `SessionAge`, `SessionIdle`, `SessionFlags`, `SessionDb`, `SessionSub`, `SessionPsub`, `SessionMulti`, or `SessionCmd`

OrderType.description_cn: 排序方向。可为空；非空时必须为服务端支持的排序类型。无默认值，通常与 OrderBy 配合使用。
OrderType.description_en: Sort direction. Can be empty; if not empty, must be a sort type supported by the server. No default value; typically used with OrderBy

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值范围为 1～1000，默认值为 500。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page. Value range: 1–1000; default is 500

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* QueryStartTime 和 QueryEndTime 所限定的时间跨度不得超过 5 分钟。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* The time span defined by QueryStartTime and QueryEndTime must not exceed 5 minutes.

QueryStartTime.description_en: Query start time, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

BackupPointId.description_cn:
备份时间点当时的备份 ID。支持模糊查询。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份 ID 筛选。
BackupPointId.description_en:
Backup ID at the backup time point. Supports fuzzy search.
* This parameter is only effective when the query scope is the current account (i.e., `Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup ID filtering is not applied.

BackupPointName.description_cn:
备份时间点当时的备份名称，支持模糊查询。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为 `OneInstance`）时，该参数不生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份名称筛选。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Backup name at the backup time point; supports fuzzy search.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (i.e., `Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is not effective.
* If this parameter is left blank, backup name filtering is not applied.

BackupStrategyList.description_cn:
备份方式列表。取值范围如下：

* `ManualBackup`：手动备份。
* `AutomatedBackup`：自动备份。

* 支持同时传入多个备份方式，多个备份方式间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份方式筛选。
BackupStrategyList.description_en:
Backup type list. The available values are:

* `ManualBackup`: Manual backup.
* `AutomatedBackup`: Automated backup.

* Multiple backup types can be entered at the same time, separated by commas (,).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup type filtering is not applied.

EndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了查询开始时间（即 `StartTime`），该参数必填。
* 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。
EndTime.description_en:
Query end time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If a query start time (`StartTime`) is set, this parameter is required.
* The end time must be later than the start time.
* If this parameter is left blank, no time range filter is applied.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。精确查询。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为`OneInstance`）时，该参数必填。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例 ID 条件进行筛选。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. Exact search.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (i.e., `Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is required.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information of all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* If this parameter is left blank, instance ID filtering is not applied.

OrderBy.description_cn: 排序依据，取值：OrderBy_E的string值，当前仅支持StartTime和InstanceId，替换掉原来的常量
OrderBy.description_en: Sort by. Value: string value of OrderBy_E; currently only supports StartTime and InstanceId, replaces the original constant

OrderType.description_cn: 排序方式，取值：枚举OrderType_E的string值，替换掉原来的常量
OrderType.description_en: Sort order. Value: string value of enum OrderType_E, replaces the original constant

PageNumber.description_cn:
备份集信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
* 若设置了该参数，每页记录数（即 `PageSize`）也必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用页码范围筛选。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number of the backup set information list. The value must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type; the starting value is 1.
* If this parameter is set, the number of records per page (`PageSize`) is also required.
* If this parameter is left blank, page number filtering is not applied.

PageSize.description_cn:
每页记录数。取值为 1~100 间的整数。
* 若设置了页码（即 `PageNumber`），该参数必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用每页记录数筛选。
PageSize.description_en:
Number of records per page. Enter an integer between 1 and 100.
* If a page number (`PageNumber`) is set, this parameter is required.
* If this parameter is left blank, page size filtering is not applied.

ProjectName.description_cn:
备份时间点当时所属的项目。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用项目名称筛选。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the backup belonged at the backup time point.
* This parameter is only effective when the query scope is the current account (i.e., `Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, project name filtering is not applied.

Scope.description_cn:
备份查询范围。取值范围如下：

* `OneInstance`（默认值）：查询单个实例内的备份。
* `AccountInstances`：查询当前账号下的备份。
Scope.description_en:
Backup query scope. The available values are:

* `OneInstance` (default): Query backups within a single instance.
* `AccountInstances`: Query backups under the current account.

Search.description_en: Search by instance ID or name

StartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了该参数，查询结束时间（即`EndTime`）参数也必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。
StartTime.description_en:
Query start time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If this parameter is set, the query end time (`EndTime`) parameter is also required.
* If this parameter is left blank, no time range filter is applied.

Status.description_cn:
备份状态。取值范围如下：

* `Creating`：创建中。
* `Available`：可用。
* `Unavailable`：不可用。
* `Deleting`：删除中。

更多关于备份状态的说明，请参见[备份状态](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/83041#%E5%A4%87%E4%BB%BD%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81)。
Status.description_en:
Backup status. Possible values:

* `Creating`: The backup is being created.
* `Available`: The backup is available.
* `Unavailable`: The backup is unavailable.
* `Deleting`: The backup is being deleted.

For more details about backup status, see [Backup Status](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/83041#%E5%A4%87%E4%BB%BD%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81).

TargetInstanceStatuses.description_en: Status of the instance to which the backup point belongs

EngineVersion.description_cn:
Redis 数据库大版本号，取值范围如下：

* `7.0`：Redis 7.0。
* `6.0`：Redis 6.0。
* `5.0`：Redis 5.0。

若该参数留空，默认查询所有 Redis 数据库大版本支持的小版本列表。
EngineVersion.description_en:
Redis database major version number. The available values are:

* `7.0`: Redis 7.0
* `6.0`: Redis 6.0
* `5.0`: Redis 5.0

If this parameter is left empty, the default query returns the list of minor versions supported by all Redis database major versions.

InstanceId.description_cn:

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。

Instance ID

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

Category.description_cn:
指定需要查询的命令类别。
* 每次仅允许查询一个命令类别下的命令支持列表。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceAclCategories](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1347919) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例支持的命令类别详情。
Category.description_en:
Specify the command category to query.
* You can only query the list of supported commands for one command category at a time
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAclCategories](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1347919) API to view details about the command categories supported by the target Redis instance

PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the parameter information list. The value must not exceed the maximum for the Integer data type. Starts at 1

Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ArchType.description_cn:
Redis 实例的架构类型。取值范围如下：

* `Cluster`：启用分片集群（即分片数大于 1）。
* `Standard`：不启用分片集群（即分片数为 1）。

* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例的架构类型条件进行筛选。
* 关于产品架构的更多信息，请参见[产品架构](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062)。
ArchType.description_en:
Architecture type of the Redis instance. Available options:

* `Cluster`: Enables sharded cluster (number of shards greater than 1)
* `Standard`: Does not enable sharded cluster (number of shards is 1)

* If this parameter is left blank, architecture type will not be used as a filtering condition
* For more information about product architecture, see [Product Architecture](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062)

InstanceClass.description_cn:
Redis 实例的类型。取值范围如下：

* `PrimarySecondary`：主备实例。
* `Standalone`：单节点实例。

* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例类型条件进行筛选。
* 关于实例类型的更多信息，请参见[产品架构](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062)。
InstanceClass.description_en:
Type of Redis instance. Available values:

* `PrimarySecondary`: Primary-secondary instance
* `Standalone`: Single-node instance

* Leave this parameter blank to ignore instance type when filtering
* For more information about instance types, see [Product Architecture](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062)

ChargeType.description_cn:
实例的计费类型。取值范围如下：

* `PostPaid`：按量计费。
* `PrePaid`：包年包月。

* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例的计费类型条件进行筛选。
* 关于计费类型的更多信息，请参见[计费类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/77755)。
ChargeType.description_en:
Instance billing type. Valid values:

* `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go

* 若该参数留空，表示不使用数据存储形态进行筛选。
DataLayout.description_en:

TagFilters.description_en:
Array of tag key-value pairs for query filtering.
If this parameter is left empty, the tag condition will not be used for filtering.

TagFilters.Key.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键。
* 当需要使用标签对查询结果进行筛选时，标签键（Key）必填，标签值（Value）可不填，不填标签值表示不对标签值作限制，会搜索所有绑定了指定标签键的实例。
* 单次最多支持同时传入 10 组标签键值对进行查询筛选。
* 允许传入重复的标签键。
TagFilters.Key.description_en:
Tag key used for query filtering
* When you need to filter query results by tags, the tag key (Key) is required. The tag value (Value) is optional. If the tag value is not specified, there is no restriction on tag value, and all instances bound to the specified tag key will be searched.
* Up to 10 tag key-value pairs can be passed in a single query for filtering.
* Duplicate tag keys are allowed.

TagFilters.Value.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键所对应的标签值。
* 若该参数留空，表示不对标签值作限制，会筛选所有绑定了指定标签键的实例。
* 若传入空字符串，表示筛选对应标签键下，标签值为空的实例。
TagFilters.Value.description_en:
Tag value corresponding to the tag key used for query filtering.
* If this parameter is left blank, no restriction is applied to tag values, and all instances bound to the specified tag key will be filtered.
* If an empty string is entered, instances with an empty tag value under the corresponding tag key will be filtered.

Context.description_cn:
Fatlog 日志记录查询结果的上下文，需要加载更多 Fatlog 日志记录时使用。
调用 DescribeFatLogs 接口后，您可以根据返回参数 `ListOver` 的值来确定是否还有未加载的 Fatlog 日志记录：

* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `false`，表示还有符合查询条件的 Fatlog 日志记录未加载完，您可以再次调用 DescribeFatLogs 接口，并使用上一次接口调用时返回参数中的 `Context` 值来查看剩余的 Fatlog 日志记录。
* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `true`，表示已加载完全部符合查询条件的 Fatlog 日志记录。
Context.description_en:
The context of the Fatlog log query result, used when loading more Fatlog log records.
After calling the DescribeFatLogs API, you can determine whether there are remaining Fatlog log records to load based on the value of the returned parameter `ListOver`:

* If `ListOver` is `false`, there are still Fatlog log records matching the query conditions that have not been loaded. You can call the DescribeFatLogs API again and use the `Context` value returned in the previous API call to view the remaining Fatlog log records.
* If `ListOver` is `true`, all Fatlog log records matching the query conditions have been loaded.

FatLogType.description_cn:
Fatlog 的类型。取值：

* `proxy`：Proxy 节点。
* `server`：Server 节点。

不传值时则不指定 Fatlog 的类型，proxy 和 server 都返回。
FatLogType.description_en:
Fatlog type. Valid values:

* `proxy`: Proxy node
* `server`: Server node

If no value is specified, the Fatlog type is not set. Both proxy and server logs are returned.

NodeIds.description_cn:
需要查询 Fatlog 日志的节点 ID。
* 若该参数留空，默认查询目标实例内所有节点的 Fatlog 日志详情。
* 支持同时传入多个节点 ID 进行查询，多个节点 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下所有的节点 ID 信息。
* `NodeIds` 的字符串总长度不可以超过 1024 个字节，建议传入的节点数量不超过 8 个。
NodeIds.description_en:
Node ID to query Fatlog logs.
* If this parameter is left empty, the Fatlog log details for all nodes in the target instance are queried by default.
* You can query multiple node IDs at the same time. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).
* You can call the [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) API to query all node ID information for the target Redis instance.
* The total length of the `NodeIds` string must not exceed 1024 bytes. It is recommended to query no more than 8 nodes at a time.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page. Value range: 1–1000.

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If this parameter is left empty, the actual query end time defaults to the current time.
* The query end time must be later than the query start time.

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 3 天前的时间。
例如，当前时间为 2026 年 03 月 04 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2026 年 03 月 01 号 16:30:00。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
If this parameter is left empty, the actual query start time defaults to 3 days before the current time.
For example, if the current time is March 4, 2026, 16:30:00, and `QueryStartTime` is not specified, the actual query start time is March 1, 2026, 16:30:00.

* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 15 天。

* The query end time must be later than the query start time, and the time interval cannot exceed 15 days

QueryStartTime.description_cn:

* 若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 1 小时前的时间。
   例如，当前时间为 2023 年 03 月 27 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2023 年 03 月 27 号 15:30:00。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 15 天。
QueryStartTime.description_en:

* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query start time defaults to one hour before the current time
  For example, if the current time is 2023-03-27 16:30:00 and `QueryStartTime` is not set, the actual query start time will be 2023-03-27 15:30:00
* The query end time must be later than the query start time, and the time range cannot exceed 15 days

ShardIds.description_en:

* Leave this parameter blank to disable shard ID filtering.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~100 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page: Enter an integer between 1 and 100

Source.description_cn:
参数模板的创建来源，取值范围如下：

* `User`：用户创建（即自定义模板）。
* `System`：系统创建（即系统模板）。

若该参数留空，表示不使用参数模板的创建来源条件进行筛选。
Source.description_en:
Parameter template creation source. Possible values:

* `User`: Created by the user (custom template)
* `System`: Created by the system (system template)

Leave this field empty to ignore the creation source when filtering parameter templates

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。模糊查询。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例 ID 条件进行筛选。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. Fuzzy search
* Leave this field blank to skip filtering by Instance ID
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the selected region, including their Instance IDs

MaxStartTime.description_cn:
需要查询的计划内事件的最晚执行时间。 格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` （UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用最晚计划执行时间进行筛选。
* 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间。
MaxStartTime.description_en:
Latest execution time for scheduled events to query. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* Leave this parameter blank to skip filtering by latest scheduled execution time
* The end time must be later than the start time

MinStartTime.description_cn:
需要查询的计划内事件的最早执行时间。 格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` （UTC）。
若该参数留空，表示不使用最早计划执行时间进行筛选。
MinStartTime.description_en:
The earliest execution time of the scheduled events to be queried. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
If this parameter is left empty, the earliest scheduled execution time will not be used for filtering

PageNumber.description_cn: 计划内事件列表的页码。取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the scheduled event list. Value must not exceed the maximum for the Integer data type. Starts at 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~1000 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page. Enter an integer between 1 and 1000

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
若该参数留空，会返回当前账号下所有可用的地域资源信息。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID.

If this parameter is left empty, all available region resource information under the current account will be returned.

Context.description_cn:
慢日志记录查询结果的上下文，需要加载更多慢日志记录时使用。
调用 DescribeSlowLogs 接口后，您可以根据返回参数 `ListOver` 的值来确定是否还有未加载的慢日志记录：

* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `false`，表示还有符合查询条件的慢日志记录未加载完，您可以再次调用 DescribeSlowLogs 接口，并使用上一次接口调用时返回参数中的 `Context` 值来查看剩余的慢日志记录。
* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `true`，表示已加载完全部符合查询条件的慢日志记录。
Context.description_en:
Context for slow log query results, used when you need to load more slow log records.
After calling the DescribeSlowLogs API, you can check the value of the returned parameter `ListOver` to see if there are more slow log records to load:

* If `ListOver` is `false`, there are still slow log records matching your query that have not been loaded. You can call the DescribeSlowLogs API again and use the `Context` value from the previous response to view the remaining slow log records.
* If `ListOver` is `true`, all slow log records matching your query have been loaded.

DBName.description_cn:
慢日志所在的数据库。
慢日志类型不同，支持的数据库取值范围不同，其中：

* Proxy 节点慢日志：0 到 256 间的任意整数。
* Server 节点慢日志：由于 Server 节点慢日志的数据库为空，故取值仅支持`-`。

若该参数留空，默认返回所有数据库上的慢日志。
DBName.description_en:
Database for slow logs
The supported database values vary by slow log type:

* Proxy node slow logs: Any integer from 0 to 256
* Server node slow logs: Since the database is empty for server node slow logs, only '-' is supported

If this parameter is left blank, slow logs from all databases are returned by default

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

NodeIds.description_cn:
需要查询慢日志的节点 ID。
* 若该参数留空，默认查询目标实例内所有节点的慢日志详情。
* 支持同时传入多个节点 ID 进行查询，多个节点 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下所有的节点 ID 信息。
* `NodeIds`的字符串总长度不可以超过 1024 个字节，建议传入的节点数量不超过 8 个。
NodeIds.description_en:
Node ID(s) required for slow log query
* If this parameter is left blank, slow log details for all nodes in the target instance are queried by default
* You can enter multiple node IDs separated by commas (,)
* To view all node IDs for the target Redis instance, call the [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) API
* The total length of the NodeIds string must not exceed 1024 bytes; it is recommended to specify no more than 8 nodes

OrderBy.description_cn: 可选。排序依据，暂未使用
OrderBy.description_en: Optional Sort Criteria (not currently in use)

OrderType.description_cn: 可选。排序方式，暂未使用
OrderType.description_en: Optional. Sorting method not currently in use

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page (range: 1–1000)

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query end time defaults to the current time
* The query end time must be later than the query start time

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 3 天前的时间。
例如，当前时间为 2022 年 08 月 01 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2022 年 07 月 29 号 16:30:00。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
If this parameter is left blank, the actual query start time defaults to three days before the current time.
For example, if the current time is August 1, 2022, 16:30:00, and `QueryStartTime` is not set, the actual query start time will be July 29, 2022, 16:30:00.

SlowLogType.description_cn:
慢日志的类型。取值范围如下：

* `Server`：Server 节点慢日志。
* `Proxy`：Proxy 节点慢日志。

* 若该参数留空，默认返回所有节点类型的慢日志。
* 若同时传入 `NodeIds` 和 `SlowLogType`，以 `NodeIds` 取值为准。
SlowLogType.description_en:
Type of slow log. Valid values:

* `Server`: Slow log for Server node
* `Proxy`: Slow log for Proxy node

* If this parameter is left empty, slow logs for all node types are returned by default
* If both `NodeIds` and `SlowLogType` are provided, `NodeIds` takes precedence

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要查询已绑定标签的实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个实例之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 50 个实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
You need to query instance IDs with bound tags.
* You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by English commas (,). Up to 50 instance IDs can be entered at the same time.
* To view basic information for all Redis instances in a specific region, including instance IDs, call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API.

PageNumber.description_cn: 实例标签信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the instance tag information list. Value must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type and starts at 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page, range: 1–1000

TagFilters.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键值对数组。
若该参数留空，表示不使用标签条件进行筛选。
TagFilters.description_en:
Array of tag key-value pairs for query filtering
Leave this parameter empty to disable tag-based filtering

TagFilters.Key.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键。
* 当需要使用标签对查询结果进行筛选时，标签键（Key）必填，标签值（Value）可不填，不填标签值表示不对标签值作限制，会搜索所有绑定了指定标签键的实例。
* 允许传入重复的标签键。
* 单次最多支持同时传入 10 个标签进行查询筛选。
TagFilters.Key.description_en:
Tag key for query filtering.
* When you need to filter query results by tags, the tag key (Key) is required. The tag value (Value) is optional. If you leave the tag value empty, there is no restriction on the tag value, and all instances bound to the specified tag key will be searched.
* Duplicate tag keys are allowed.
* You can specify up to 10 tags at a time for query filtering.

TagFilters.Value.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键所对应的标签值。
* 若该参数留空，表示不对标签值作限制，会筛选所有绑定了指定标签键的实例。
* 若传入空字符串，表示筛选对应标签键下，标签值为空的实例。
TagFilters.Value.description_en:
Tag value corresponding to the tag key for query filtering.
* If this parameter is left empty, there is no restriction on the tag value, and all instances bound to the specified tag key will be filtered.
* If an empty string is entered, only instances where the tag value is empty under the corresponding tag key will be filtered.

CreationEndTime.description_cn:
以任务创建时间进行查询时的时间范围的终点，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
若未指定 `TaskId`，则必须同时传入 `CreationStartTime` 和 `CreationEndTime`。
CreationEndTime.description_en:
End time of the time range for querying by task creation time, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
If `TaskId` is not specified, both `CreationStartTime` and `CreationEndTime` must be provided.

CreationStartTime.description_cn:
以任务创建时间进行查询时的时间范围的起点，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
若未指定 `TaskId`，则必须同时传入 `CreationStartTime` 和 `CreationEndTime`。
CreationStartTime.description_en:
Start time for querying based on task creation time, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
If `TaskId` is not specified, you must provide both `CreationStartTime` and `CreationEndTime`.

InstanceName.description_cn: 实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en: Instance Name

PageNumber.description_cn: 任务列表页码，取值为大于等于 1 的正整数。
PageNumber.description_en: Task list page number. Must be an integer greater than or equal to 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~100 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Number of records per page. Must be an integer between 1 and 100.

ProjectName.description_en: Project name.

TaskId.description_cn:
任务 ID。用于查询具体某个任务。
若未指定 `TaskId`，则必须同时传入 `CreationStartTime` 和 `CreationEndTime`。
TaskId.description_en:
Task ID. Used to query a specific task.
If `TaskId` is not specified, you must provide both `CreationStartTime` and `CreationEndTime`.

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) 接口查询 Redis 实例所有可用的地域资源信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) API to query all available region resource information for Redis instances, including region IDs

AllowListIds.description_cn:
需要解绑实例的白名单 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个白名单 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即每次仅允许将一个白名单中的多个实例同时解绑，或将一个实例同时从多个白名单中解绑。
AllowListIds.description_en:
Enter the whitelist ID(s) you want to unbind from the instance
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) API to view all whitelist information in a specified region, including whitelist IDs
* You can enter multiple whitelist IDs at once, separated by commas (,)
* You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and whitelist IDs at the same time. Each operation allows you to unbind multiple instances from a single whitelist, or unbind a single instance from multiple whitelists

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑白名单的实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即每次仅允许将一个白名单中的多个实例同时解绑，或将一个实例同时从多个白名单中解绑。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs that need to be unbound from the whitelist.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by English commas (,).
* Each operation only allows you to either unbind multiple instances from one whitelist, or unbind one instance from multiple whitelists at once.

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行配置变更操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即变更。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行变更。

关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Whether to execute the configuration change immediately. Value options:

* `true`: Change immediately.
* `false`: Change during the maintenance window.

For more information about maintenance windows, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Used to ensure request idempotency and prevent duplicate submissions. This parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ConfigureNodes.description_cn:
设置节点所属的可用区列表。
若该参数留空，表示不修改实例节点所属的可用区。
ConfigureNodes.description_en:
Configure the list of availability zones for the node.
If this parameter is left blank, the node's availability zone will not be modified.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

MultiAZ.description_cn:
设置实例的可用区部署方案。取值范围如下：

* `disabled`：单可用区部署方案。
* `enabled`：多可用区部署方案。

* 若该参数留空，表示不修改实例的可用区部署方案。
* 关于可用区部署方案的更多说明，请参见[多可用区同城容灾解决方案](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70863)。
MultiAZ.description_en:
Configure the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Value options:

* `disabled`: Single availability zone deployment scheme.
* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment scheme.

* If this parameter is left blank, the instance's availability zone deployment scheme will not be modified.
* For more information about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-Availability Zone Disaster Recovery Solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70863).

NodeNumber.description_cn:
每个分片中的节点数。取值范围为 2~6。
每个账号在每个地域下默认最多可创建 4 个 256 MiB 规格（即 `ShardCapacity` 取值为 `256`）的节点，若您需要调整 256 MiB 规格节点的购买配额 （上限为 10 个），请参见[账号配额](https://vsop-online.bytedance.net/doc/manage/detail/6293/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)。
NodeNumber.description_en:
Number of nodes in each shard. Value range: 2–6.
By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of 256 MiB specification (that is, `ShardCapacity` value is `256`) in each region. If you need to adjust the purchase quota for 256 MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Account Quota](https://vsop-online.bytedance.net/doc/manage/detail/6293/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D).

ShardCapacity.description_cn:
每个分片的内存容量，单位：MiB。取值范围如下：

* 若实例为未启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `0` ），每分片内存容量可选取值为：256，512，1024，2048，4096，8192，16384，32768，24576，65536。
* 若实例为启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：1024，2048，4096，8192，16384。

* 若该参数留空，表示不修改实例的内存容量。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例是否开启分片，以及每个分片中的内存容量。
* 若需要缩小分片容量，需保证实例当前的**已用内存**不超过新内存总容量，其中新内存总容量 = 变更后的单分片内存 x 分片数。**已用内存**信息查看方法，请参见[查看实例信息](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896)。
* 每种实例规格都有对应支持的分片容量和带宽，因此修改实例分片容量的同时，也会同步修改实例的带宽和规格。关于 Redis 实例规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. The available values are as follows:

* If the instance does not enable sharded cluster (that is, `ShardedCluster` is set to `0`), the selectable memory capacity per shard is: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 24576, 65536.
* If the instance enables sharded cluster (that is, `ShardedCluster` is set to `1`), the selectable memory capacity per shard is: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384.

* If this parameter is left blank, the instance memory capacity will not be modified.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of the specified instance, including whether sharding is enabled and the memory capacity of each shard.
* If you need to reduce shard capacity, ensure that the instance's current **used memory** does not exceed the new total memory capacity, where new total memory capacity = updated memory per shard x number of shards. For information on **used memory**, see [View Instance Information](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896).
* Each instance specification supports corresponding shard capacity and bandwidth. When you modify shard capacity, the bandwidth and specification will also be updated accordingly. For more details about Redis instance specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111).

ShardNumber.description_cn:
实例中的分片数量。取值范围为 2~256。
* 仅当启用分片集群（即  `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，需要指定该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例是否已启用分片以及分片数量。
* 若需要缩减分片数量，需保证实例当前的**已用内存**不超过新内存总容量，其中新内存总容量 = 变更后的单分片内存 x 分片数。**已用内存**信息查看方法，请参见[查看实例信息](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896)。
* 若变更前的单节点实例为已启用分片集群实例且申请了直连地址，那么在变更为主备实例时，实例的分片数量不能超过 8 个。如果需要在开启直连地址的场景下增加更多的分片数量，请[提交工单](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/)联系技术支持。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the instance. Value range: 2–256.
* This parameter is required only when sharded cluster is enabled (that is, `ShardedCluster` value is `1`).
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of the specified instance, including whether sharding is enabled and the number of shards.
* To reduce the number of shards, ensure the instance's current **used memory** does not exceed the new total memory capacity, where new total memory capacity = memory per shard after change × number of shards. For information on **used memory**, see [View Instance Information](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896).
* If the single-node instance before the change is a sharded cluster instance and has applied for a direct connection address, then when changing to a primary/standby instance, the number of shards cannot exceed 8. If you need to increase the number of shards in the scenario where direct connection address is enabled, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/) to contact technical support.

ShardedCluster.description_cn:

ShardedCluster.description_en:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

If the single-node instance before the change is already a sharded cluster instance and has applied for a direct connection address, you cannot select 'Disabled' when changing to a primary-secondary instance.

This parameter is effective only if you choose to create a backup before the change (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`).

* `true`: Create a backup
