Tags.description_en: Cloud Resource Tags. Use tags to categorize instances for easier search and resource aggregation. For details, see [Tag overview](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1677223719896/63f867602dbaa10221c6b523/editor/65ae2823e386540302559854/?docLang=zh&bv=65ae2822e38654030255980c).

Version.description_cn:
支持的 RocketMQ 版本。当前支持的版本包括：
- 4.8：兼容 RocketMQ 4.x 版本系列。
- 5.x：兼容 RocketMQ 5.x 版本系列。目前 5.x 版本处于加白阶段，如需使用请联系技术支持申请开白。
Version.description_en:
Supported RocketMQ versions
Currently supported versions include:
- 4.8: Compatible with the RocketMQ 4.x series
- 5.x: Compatible with the RocketMQ 5.x series. The 5.x version is currently available by whitelist only; to use it, please contact technical support to request access

VpcId.description_cn:
实例所在的私有网络（VPC） ID。
- 实例创建完成后，不可修改对应的私有网络和子网。创建实例时请谨慎操作。
- 您可以调用私有网络（VPC）的 DescribeVpcs 接口查询可用的VPC和子网列表。
VpcId.description_en:
VPC ID where the instance resides
- After the instance is created, you cannot modify the corresponding VPC or subnet. Please be careful when creating the instance.
- You can call the DescribeVpcs API to query the list of available VPCs and subnets.

ZoneId.description_cn:
实例所在的可用区 ID。
消息队列 RocketMQ版实例支持跨 AZ 部署，查看指定可用区下提供哪些计算规格时，可以指定多个可用区。多个可用区 ID 之间以逗号（,）间隔。
您可以调用 [DescribeAvailabilityZones](/docs/6410/1112351) 查询当前提供服务的可用区列表。
ZoneId.description_en: Availability zone ID of the instance. RocketMQ message queue instances support cross-AZ deployment. When viewing which compute specifications are available in a specified availability zone, you can specify multiple availability zones. Separate multiple availability zone IDs with commas (,). You can call [DescribeAvailabilityZones](/docs/6410/1112351) to query the list of availability zones currently providing services.

Description.description_cn: Description
Description.description_en: Description

Limit.description_cn: Limit
Limit
Limit
Limit

AutoScaleQueue.description_cn: 实例规格更改时，是否自动创建队列。
AutoScaleQueue.description_en: Automatically create queue when instance specification changes?

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。
该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](/docs/6410/1160436)。
ClientToken.description_en:
Identifier to ensure idempotency of client requests
This identifier is a 1–64 character ASCII string, case-sensitive, generated by the client. It must be unique for each request.
For details on how to use the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](/docs/6410/1160436)

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例变更后的计算规格。如需升级计算规格，此参数必选。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
ComputeSpec.description_en:
Compute specifications after instance change
To upgrade compute specifications, this parameter is required
Only instance specification upgrades are supported; downgrades are not allowed

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要更新配置的实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID that requires a configuration update

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例变更后的存储空间。如需扩容存储空间，此参数必选。
单位为GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
StorageSpace.description_en: The storage space after the instance is modified. This parameter is required if you need to expand the storage space. The unit is GiB and must be specified as a multiple of 100. The value range depends on the currently specified compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397). Only instance specification upgrades are supported; downgrades are not supported.

AccountId.description_cn: 需添加白名单的账号 ID。

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定标签的实例 ID。
支持一次传入多个实例 ID，最多同时传入 50 个实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to bind tags to
You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, up to 50 at the same time

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
- 支持一次传入多组标签键值对像，多组标签键值对像间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对。
- 标签键值需满足设置规则，详细信息请参见[标签设置规则](/docs/6410/177940#标签设置规则)。
Tags.description_en:
Array of tag keys and tag values to be bound
- You can enter multiple tag key-value pairs at once, separated by commas. You can enter up to 20 pairs at once
- Tag keys and values must follow the configuration rules. For details, see [Tag configuration rules](/docs/6410/177940#标签设置规则)

AllowListIds.description_cn: 需要绑定的白名单 ID 列表。
AllowListIds.description_en: List of whitelist IDs to be bound

InstanceIds.description_cn: 需要绑定白名单的实例 ID 列表。
InstanceIds.description_en: List of Instance IDs to Bind to Whitelist

AccessKey.description_cn: 指定 RocketMQ 密钥 ID。 长度限制为 7～128 字符，字符限制为大小写字母或数字。设置 SecretKey 时必选
AccessKey.description_en: Specify the RocketMQ key ID. The length must be 7–128 characters and can only include uppercase or lowercase letters or numbers. Required when setting SecretKey

AllAuthority.description_cn:
此 RocketMQ 密钥是否默认具备所有 Topic 的读写权限。
- `ALL`：拥有发布、订阅权限
- `PUB`：拥有发布权限
- `SUB`：拥有订阅权限
- `DENY`（默认）：不具备发布和订阅权限
AllAuthority.description_en:
Does this RocketMQ key have default read and write access to all Topics? Default: Deny
- ALL: Can publish and subscribe
- PUB: Can publish
- SUB: Can subscribe
- DENY: No publish or subscribe access

Description.description_cn:
RocketMQ 密钥的描述信息，用于有效区分和管理密钥。长度限制为 0～128 个字符。
创建密钥后，推荐调用 DescribeAccessKeys 接口查看已创建的 RocketMQ 密钥列表，您可以通过`Description`参数识别出目标密钥。
Description.description_en:
Description for the RocketMQ key, used to efficiently distinguish and manage keys. Limit: 0–128 characters
After creating a key, we recommend calling the DescribeAccessKeys API to view your list of created RocketMQ keys. You can identify the target key using the Description parameter.

GroupAllAuthority.description_cn: 此 RocketMQ 密钥是否默认具备所有 Group 的读写权限。默认值为 Sub。 - SUB：拥有订阅权限 - DENY：不具备订阅权限
GroupAllAuthority.description_en:
Does this RocketMQ key have default read/write permissions for all Groups? Default value: Sub
- SUB: Has subscription permission
- DENY: No subscription permission

SecretKey.description_cn: RocketMQ 密钥。长度限制为 7～128 字符，字符限制为大小写字母或数字。设置 AccessKey 时必选
SecretKey.description_en: RocketMQ key. Length must be between 7 and 128 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters or numbers are allowed. Required when setting AccessKey

AllowList.description_cn:
IP 地址列表，表示允许这些 IP 地址访问。

- 多个 IP 地址请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复。
- 支持 IP 地址形式（例如 10.23.12.xx）和 CIDR 形式（例如 10.23.12.x/xx）。
- 当 IP 较多时，建议合并为 IP 段填入，例如 10.23.12.x/24。
- 每个实例最多添加 300 个 IP 或 IP 段，即所有 IP 白名单分组内的 IP 或 IP 段总和不能超过 300。
AllowList.description_en:
IP address allowlist. Only these IP addresses are allowed to access

- Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,) and do not repeat addresses
- Supports both IP address format (for example, 10.23.12.xx) and CIDR format (for example, 10.23.12.x/xx)
- If you have many IP addresses, consider combining them into an IP range, such as 10.23.12.x/24
- Each instance can have up to 300 IP addresses or IP ranges in total, meaning the combined total across all allowlist groups cannot exceed 300

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单描述。长度不超过 200 个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Whitelist description. Up to 200 characters

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称。

- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist name

- Must be 1–128 characters long
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Whitelist name must be unique within the current region

AllowListType.description_cn: IP 地址类型，当前仅支持设置为 IPv4。
AllowListType.description_en: Currently, only IPv4 can be set as the IP address type

Description.description_cn: Group 的简单描述。
Description.description_en: Brief Description of Group

GroupId.description_cn:
Group 的 ID。

- 长度限制为 7~120 个字符，只能包含字母、数字、短划线（-）或下划线（\_）。
- 推荐以 GID- 或 GID\_ 开头。

- 创建 Group 后无法修改 ID，请谨慎设置。
- 对于 2023 年 06 月 05 日及之前创建的 RocketMQ 实例，Group 名称不可超过 93 个字符。禁用词列表请参考[创建 Group](/docs/6410/70973)。
GroupId.description_en:
Group ID

- Must be 7–120 characters long and can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
- Recommended to start with GID- or GID_

You cannot change the ID after creating the Group. Set it carefully.
For RocketMQ instances created on or before June 5, 2023, the Group name cannot exceed 93 characters. For the list of prohibited words, see [Create Group](/docs/6410/70973)

GroupType.description_cn: Group 的协议标识，用于备注该 Group 的生产消费协议类型。可指定为 TCP。
GroupType.description_en: Protocol identifier for the Group, used to note the production and consumption protocol type for this Group; the current value is TCP

MessageModel.description_cn: 创建消费组时使用的消息类型，5.x 版本实例使用，默认为 CLUSTERING
MessageModel.description_en: Message type used when creating a consumer group, for 5.x version instances; default is CLUSTERING

TopicName.description_cn: 创建消费组时绑定的轻量消息类型主题名称，LITE_SELECTIVE 消费组必填
TopicName.description_en: Name of the lightweight message type topic bound when creating a consumer group; required for LITE_SELECTIVE consumer groups

Description.description_cn: Group 的简单描述。
Description.description_en: A Brief Description of the Group

GroupType.description_cn: 指定创建的 Group 适用的协议，取值为`TCP`。
GroupType.description_en: Specify the protocol for the created Group; value: TCP.

MessageModel.description_cn: 消费组消费模式，可选 LITE_SELECTIVE 和 CLUSTERING，对 5.x 实例生效
MessageModel.description_en: Consumer group consumption mode; options: LITE_SELECTIVE and CLUSTERING. Applies to 5.x instances

RetryMaxTimes.description_en: Number of retry attempts after consumption failure.

TopicName.description_cn: LITE_SELECTIVE 消费组所绑定的主题名称，为 LITE_SELECTIVE 时必填
TopicName.description_en: Topic name bound to the LITE_SELECTIVE consumer group; required when set to LITE_SELECTIVE

AllowListIds.description_cn:
实例绑定的白名单 ID 列表。
- 绑定白名单后，仅配置在白名单中的 IP 地址与地址段才能访问此实例。
- 如果实例未绑定任何白名单，表示禁止所有 IP 地址访问该实例。
AllowListIds.description_en: Whitelist IDs bound to the instance. After binding a whitelist, only IP addresses and address ranges in the whitelist can access this instance. If no whitelist is bound, all IP addresses are denied access to the instance.

BindTags.description_cn: 云资源标签。可以将实例通过标签进行归类，便于实例的搜索和资源聚合。详细说明请参考[标签概述](/docs/6410/177939)。
BindTags.description_en: Cloud resource tags. Use tags to categorize instances for easier search and resource aggregation. For details, see [Tag Overview](/docs/6410/177939).

ChargeInfo.description_cn: 实例的计费类型等计费信息。
ChargeInfo.description_en: Billing type and other billing information for the instance

ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_cn:
包年包月实例到期后是否自动续费。
- `true`：自动续费。
- `false`：不自动续费。到期后需要手动续费，否则实例将被关停。
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to auto-renew annual/monthly subscription instances after expiration
- true: Auto-renew
- false: Do not auto-renew. Manual renewal is required after expiration; otherwise, the instance will be stopped
Only annual/monthly subscription instances require this setting. This option is mandatory when ChargeType is set to PrePaid

ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_cn:
付费类型。取值：
- `PostPaid`：按量付费
- `PrePaid`（默认）：包年包月
ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_en:
Payment Type
- PostPaid: Pay-As-You-Go
- PrePaid (Default): Subscription (Yearly/Monthly)

ChargeInfo.Period.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的购买时长。

- `PeriodUnit`指定为`Monthly`时，取值范围为 1~9。
- `PeriodUnit`指定为`Yearly`时，取值范围为 1~3。

仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for subscription-based instances

- When PeriodUnit is set to Monthly, valid values are 1–9
- When PeriodUnit is set to Yearly, valid values are 1–3

This must be specified only for subscription-based instances (when ChargeType is set to PrePaid)

ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的生命周期单位，即指定以月或以年为单位购买。其中：
- `Monthly`：（默认）包月
- `Yearly`：包年
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_en:
Lifecycle unit for monthly/yearly subscription type instances, specifying purchase by month or year
- Monthly (default): monthly subscription
- Yearly: yearly subscription
This must be specified only for monthly/yearly subscription type instances, i.e., when ChargeType is set to PrePaid

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。
该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](/docs/6410/1160436)。
ClientToken.description_en:
Identifier to ensure idempotency of client requests
This identifier is an ASCII string of 1 to 64 characters, case-sensitive, generated by the client. Ensure the identifier is unique for each request
For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](/docs/6410/1160436)

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例的计算规格。
您可以在[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)中查看目前在售的计算规格列表。
ComputeSpec.description_en:
Instance Compute Specifications
You can view the current list of available compute specifications in [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397)

EipId.description_cn:
EIP 的 ID。
- 指定 EipId 表示开启实例的公网访问。
- EIP 提供独立的公网 IP 资源，包括公网 IP 地址与公网出口带宽服务。指定此参数开启公网访问后，公网地址将绑定您的弹性公网IP（EIP），费用由EIP收取。
EipId.description_en:
EIP ID
- Specify EipId to enable public access for the instance
- EIP provides dedicated public IP resources, including a public IP address and public outbound bandwidth service. After you specify this parameter to enable public access, the public address will be bound to your Elastic IP (EIP). You will be charged for the EIP

EnableSSL.description_cn: 是否使用 SSL 加密。

FileReservedTime.description_cn: 消息在消息队列 RocketMQ版服务端的保留时长，超过保留时长的消息将被过期清理。单位为小时，取值范围为 1~72 小时。
FileReservedTime.description_en: Messages are retained on the RocketMQ message queue server for a specified retention period. Messages that exceed the retention period are expired and deleted. The unit is hours, with a valid range of 1 to 72 hours.

IPVersionType.description_cn: IP 版本， 可选直为 IPv4 或者 DualStack。
IPVersionType.description_en: IP Version: IPv4 or DualStack available

InstanceDescription.description_cn: 实例的简单描述。长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
InstanceDescription.description_en: Brief description of the instance. Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称。 需满足以下要求：
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字和连字符（-）开头。
- 长度范围为 1~128 个字符。

如果创建实例时未指定名称，则默认将实例 ID 作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name. Must meet the following requirements:
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

If you do not specify a name when creating an instance, the instance ID is used as the instance name by default

NetworkTypes.description_cn: 实例网络类型，固定为 PrivateNetwork。
NetworkTypes.description_en: Instance network type, fixed to PrivateNetwork

ProjectName.description_cn: 当前创建的实例所属的 IAM 项目。若未设置，则会将新实例绑定到名为 default 的 IAM 项目中。
ProjectName.description_en: The IAM project that the instance being created belongs to. If not set, the new instance will be bound to the IAM project named default.

SSLMode.description_cn:
实例的公网连接策略，仅在开启公网访问时需要设置。支持设置为：
- `enforcing`：通过公网访问实例时，必须经由 SSL 认证。SSL 认证可实现数据的加密传输，相较于普通公网访问方式具备更高的安全性，但性能会有所下降。
- `permissive`：通过公网访问实例时，可以选择是否经由 SSL 认证。
创建实例后，公网访问为开启状态时，不能修改 SSL 连接策略。如需修改，需要为实例关闭并重新开启公网访问，在重新开启时再次设置 SSL 连接策略。详细说明请参考[设置公网访问与 SSL 认证策略](/docs/6410/107703)。
SSLMode.description_en:
The public network connection policy for an instance only needs to be set when public access is enabled. You can choose from:
- Enforcing: When accessing the instance over the public network, SSL authentication is required. SSL authentication encrypts data transmission, providing higher security than standard public access, but may reduce performance.
- Permissive: When accessing the instance over the public network, SSL authentication is optional.
After the instance is created and public access is enabled, you cannot change the SSL connection policy. To modify it, you must disable public access for the instance and then re-enable it, setting the SSL connection policy again during re-enablement. For details, see [Configure Public Access and SSL Authentication Policy](/docs/6410/107703).

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例的存储空间。
单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance storage space
Unit: GiB; must be a multiple of 100. The available range depends on the selected compute specification

StorageType.description_cn: 存储类型，内部使用
StorageType.description_en: Storage Type (Internal Use)

SubnetId.description_cn:
实例所在的 VPC 子网 ID。
- 实例创建完成后，不可修改对应的私有网络和子网。创建实例时请谨慎操作。
- 您可以调用私有网络（VPC）的 DescribeVpcs 接口查询可用的VPC和子网列表。
SubnetId.description_en:
VPC subnet ID of the instance
- You cannot change the private network or subnet after the instance is created. Please proceed with caution when creating the instance
- You can call the DescribeVpcs API of the private network (VPC) to view available VPCs and subnets

Tags.description_cn: 云资源标签。可以将实例通过标签进行归类，便于实例的搜索和资源聚合。详细说明请参考[标签概述](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1677223719896/63f867602dbaa10221c6b523/editor/65ae2823e386540302559854/?docLang=zh&bv=65ae2822e38654030255980c)。
Tags.description_en: Cloud resource tags. Use tags to categorize instances, making it easier to search and aggregate resources. For more details, see [Tag overview](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1677223719896/63f867602dbaa10221c6b523/editor/65ae2823e386540302559854/?docLang=zh&bv=65ae2822e38654030255980c).

Version.description_cn:
支持的 RocketMQ 版本。当前支持的版本包括：
- `4.8`：兼容 RocketMQ 4.x 版本系列。
- `5.x`：兼容 RocketMQ 5.x 版本系列。
目前 5.x 版本处于加白阶段，如需使用请联系技术支持申请开白。
Version.description_en:
Supported RocketMQ versions
Currently supported versions:
- 4.8: Compatible with the RocketMQ 4.x series
- 5.x: Compatible with the RocketMQ 5.x series. Version 5.x is currently in the whitelist phase; if you need to use it, please contact technical support to apply for whitelist access

VpcId.description_cn:
实例所在的私有网络（VPC） ID。
- 实例创建完成后，不可修改对应的私有网络和子网。创建实例时请谨慎操作。
- 您可以调用私有网络（VPC）的 DescribeVpcs 接口查询可用的VPC和子网列表。
VpcId.description_en:
VPC ID where the instance is located.
- You cannot change the VPC or subnet after the instance is created. Please proceed with caution when creating an instance.
- Use the DescribeVpcs API to view available VPCs and subnets.

ZoneId.description_cn:
实例所在的可用区 ID。
- 消息队列 RocketMQ版实例支持跨 AZ 部署，查看指定可用区下提供哪些计算规格时，可以指定多个可用区。多个可用区 ID 之间以逗号（,）间隔。
- 您可以调用 [DescribeAvailabilityZones](/docs/6410/1112351) 查询当前提供服务的可用区列表。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone ID of the instance.
RocketMQ instances support cross-AZ deployment. To view available compute specifications in specific availability zones, you can specify multiple zones. Separate multiple availability zone IDs with commas (,).
You can call [DescribeAvailabilityZones](/docs/6410/1112351) to query the list of currently available zones.

EipId.description_cn: 实例绑定的 EIP 等信息。
EipId.description_en: Instance-bound EIP and related information

SSLMode.description_cn:
实例的公网连接策略。支持设置为：

- `enforcing`：通过公网访问实例时，必须经由 SSL 认证。SSL 认证可实现数据的加密传输，相较于普通公网访问方式具备更高的安全性，但性能会有所下降。
-` permissive`：（默认）通过公网访问实例时，可以选择是否经由 SSL 认证。

创建实例后，公网访问为开启状态时，不能修改 SSL 连接策略。如需修改，需要为实例关闭并重新开启公网访问，在重新开启时再次设置 SSL 连接策略。详细说明请参考[设置公网访问与 SSL 认证策略](/docs/6410/107703)。
SSLMode.description_en:
Public network connection policy for the instance. You can set the following options:

- Enforcing: When accessing the instance over the public network, SSL authentication is required. SSL authentication encrypts data transmission, providing higher security compared to standard public network access, but may reduce performance.
- Permissive (default): When accessing the instance over the public network, you can choose whether to use SSL authentication.

After the instance is created, you cannot change the SSL connection policy while public network access is enabled. To modify the policy, disable public network access for the instance, then re-enable it and set the SSL connection policy again. For details, see [Configure Public Network Access and SSL Authentication Policy](/docs/6410/107703).

MessageType.description_cn:
消息类型。取值说明如下：

- `0`：普通消息
- `1`：事务消息
- `2`：分区顺序消息
- `3`：全局顺序消息
- `4`：延时消息

- 一个 Topic 只能承载一种消息类型。创建 Topic 后不支持修改此 Topic 承载的消息类型。
- 对于**分区顺序消息**和**全局顺序消息**类型的 Topic，服务节点异常时可能会出现短暂的消息乱序现象。
- 延迟消息支持自定义毫秒级延迟，延迟时长最长为 3 天或消息保留时长的 3 倍（两者取较小值）。
MessageType.description_en:
Message type. Value descriptions:

- 0: Standard message
- 1: Transaction message
- 2: Partitioned ordered message
- 3: Globally ordered message
- 4: Delayed message

- Each Topic supports only one message type. You cannot change the message type after the Topic is created.
- For Topics with partitioned ordered or globally ordered messages, brief message disorder may occur if service nodes fail.
- Delayed messages support custom millisecond-level delays. The maximum delay is 3 days or three times the message retention period, whichever is shorter.

QueueNumber.description_cn:
设置当前 Topic 的队列数量，最大不可超过当前实例剩余可用队列数。每个实例规格的队列数量限制请参考[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)。
在 **4.x** 版本实例中创建 Topic 时，请参考以下说明设置队列数：
- 全局顺序类型的 Topic 队列数默认为 1。其他类型 Topic 的队列数和计算规格有关，n3 及以下规格的队列数默认为 6，n3 以上规格的队列数默认是 broker 组数的两倍。
- 队列数建议设置为计算节点数的倍数，否则可能造成不同 Broker 之间数据不均衡。例如规格 rocketmq.n3.x2.medium 的计算节点数为 3，队列数建议设置为 3 的倍数，即 3、6、9 等。
在 **5.x** 版本实例中创建 Topic 时，请参考以下说明设置队列数：
- 全局顺序类型的 Topic 队列数默认为 1。
- 其他类型 Topic 的队列数默认是 broker 组数的两倍。
- 非顺序场景性能不受队列个数影响，更多队列仅用于提升顺序消费并发性能。
QueueNumber.description_en:
Set the number of queues for the current Topic. The maximum cannot exceed the remaining available queues for this instance. For queue limits of each instance specification, see [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397).

When creating a Topic in a **4.x** instance, follow these guidelines for setting the queue count:
- For globally ordered Topics, the queue count defaults to 1. For other Topic types, the queue count depends on the compute specification: n3 and below default to 6 queues; above n3, the default is twice the number of broker groups.
- Set the queue count as a multiple of the number of compute nodes to avoid data imbalance across brokers. For example, the rocketmq.n3.x2.medium specification has 3 compute nodes, so the queue count should be a multiple of 3, such as 3, 6, or 9.

When creating a Topic in a **5.x** instance, follow these guidelines for setting the queue count:
- For globally ordered Topics, the queue count defaults to 1.
- For other Topic types, the default queue count is twice the number of broker groups.
- In non-ordered scenarios, performance is not affected by the number of queues. Adding more queues only improves concurrent performance in ordered consumption scenarios.

TopicName.description_cn:
Topic 的名称。命名规则如下：
- 长度为 3~100 个字符。
- 只能包含英文、数字、连字符（-）以及下划线（\_）。
- Topic 名称中不可包含以下保留字符或特殊前缀。
  - 保留字符：RMQ\_SYS\_TRANS\_OP\_HALF\_TOPIC、BenchmarkTest、TBW102、OFFSET\_MOVED\_EVENT、SELF\_TEST\_TOPIC、RMQ\_SYS\_TRANS\_HALF\_TOPIC、SCHEDULE\_TOPIC\_XXXX、RMQ\_SYS\_TRACE\_TOPIC
  - 特殊前缀：rocketmq-broker-、%RETRY%、rmq\_sys\_、%DLQ%
- 同一实例下 Topic 名称必须唯一，不同实例间的 Topic 名称可以重复。
- 对于 2023 年 06 月 05 日及之前创建的 RocketMQ 实例，Topic 名称不可超过 100 个字符。
TopicName.description_en:
Topic name. Naming rules:
- Must be 3–100 characters long
- Only English letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are allowed
- Topic names cannot contain the following reserved keywords or special prefixes:
  - Reserved keywords: RMQ_SYS_TRANS_OP_HALF_TOPIC, BenchmarkTest, TBW102, OFFSET_MOVED_EVENT, SELF_TEST_TOPIC, RMQ_SYS_TRANS_HALF_TOPIC, SCHEDULE_TOPIC_XXXX, RMQ_SYS_TRACE_TOPIC
  - Special prefixes: rocketmq-broker-, %RETRY%, rmq_sys_, %DLQ%
- Topic names must be unique within the same instance. Topic names can be duplicated across different instances.
- For RocketMQ instances created on or before June 5, 2023, topic names cannot exceed 100 characters

PageSize.description_en: This parameter sets the number of items per page when displaying paginated query results. Allowed values are 1 to 100

GroupIds.description_cn: Group ID，若未指定，表示查看所有 Group 信息。
GroupIds.description_en: Group ID. If not specified, shows information for all groups

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Minimum page number for the list is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 列表中每一页的条目数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Set items per page in the list (1–100)

TopicName.description_cn: Topic 名称，设置此参数表示根据指定的 Topic 名称进行筛选，支持模糊匹配。
TopicName.description_en: Topic Name: Set this parameter to filter by the specified topic name; fuzzy matching is supported

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the list, minimum value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 列表中每一页的条目数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page in the list, range: 1–100

QueueIds.description_cn: 队列 ID，若未指定，表示查看所有队列信息。
QueueIds.description_en: Queue ID. If not specified, all queue information will be displayed

TopicName.description_cn: Topic 名称，设置此参数表示根据指定的 Topic 名称进行筛选，支持模糊匹配。
TopicName.description_en: Topic name. Set this parameter to filter by the specified topic name; fuzzy matching is supported.

MessageType.description_cn:
消息类型。设置此参数表示根据指定的消息类型筛选 Topic 列表。取值说明如下：
- `0`：普通消息
- `1`：事务消息
- `2`：分区顺序消息
- `3`：全局顺序消息
- `4`：延时消息
MessageType.description_en:
Message type. Set this parameter to filter the Topic list by the specified message type. The values are as follows:
- 0: Ordinary message
- 1: Transactional message
- 2: Partitioned ordered message
- 3: Globally ordered message
- 4: Delayed message

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: The minimum page number for the list is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 列表中每一页的条目数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page in the list, range: 1–100

SortBy.description_cn:
实例查询结果排序字段。默认使用 CreateTime 进行排序。可设置为：
- `CreateTime`：Topic 创建时间
- `QueueNumber`：Topic 队列数量
SortBy.description_en:
Sort field for instance query results. By default, results are sorted by CreateTime. You can set the sort field to:
- CreateTime: topic creation time
- QueueNumber: number of topic queues

SortOrder.description_cn:
实例查询使用的排序方式。默认为 Desc，即降序。
- `Asc`：升序
- `Desc`：降序
SortOrder.description_en:
Sorting method used for instance queries. Default is Desc (descending order)
- Asc: ascending order
- Desc: descending order

TopicName.description_cn: Topic 名称，设置此参数表示根据指定的 Topic 名称进行筛选，支持模糊匹配。
TopicName.description_en: Topic name: Set this parameter to filter by the specified topic name; fuzzy matching is supported

AllowListIds.description_cn: 待解绑的白名单 ID 列表。
AllowListIds.description_en: List of Whitelist IDs to Unbind

InstanceIds.description_cn: 需要解绑白名单的实例 ID 列表。
InstanceIds.description_en: Instance IDs that need to be unbound from the whitelist

Enable.description_cn:
是否开启自动创建消费组。取值说明如下：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。

Enable.description_en: Whether to enable Instance BurstTps capability

Enable.description_cn:
开启或关闭风险巡检功能。

- `true`：开启
- `false`：关闭
Enable.description_en:
Enable or disable the risk inspection feature

- true: Enable
- false: Disable

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要开启或关闭风险巡检功能的实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID for enabling or disabling the risk inspection feature

Filters.description_cn: 过滤项，支持使用 `cluster`、`topic` 和 `group` 进行过滤巡检规则。
Filters.description_en: Filter options support filtering inspection rules by `cluster`, `topic`, and `group`

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码，最小值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number, minimum value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页支持展示的巡检规则的数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: The number of inspection rules displayed per page can range from 1 to 100

Filters.description_cn:
过滤项，支持根据风险等级和处理状态进行过滤。

- 风险等级Level支持：low（低风险）、medium（中风险）和 high（高风险）。
- 处理状态Status支持：unSolved（未处理）和 Solved（已处理）。
Filters.description_en:
Filter options support filtering by risk level and status

- Risk Level options: Low (low risk), Medium (medium risk), High (high risk)
- Status options: Unsolved (not processed), Solved (processed)

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要查询巡检结果的目标实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Target instance ID for querying inspection results

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码，最小值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number: minimum value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页展示的巡检异常结果数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Number of inspection exception results displayed per page, range: 1–100

SortBy.description_cn: 排序项。目前仅支持按照巡检异常结果的发生时间进行排序。
SortBy.description_en: Sorting options. Currently, you can only sort by the time when inspection exceptions occurred.

SortOrder.description_cn:
排序方式。

- `ASC`：升序，默认排序方式。
- `DESC`：降序。
SortOrder.description_en:
Sort Order

- ASC: Ascending, default sort order
- DESC: Descending

ResultId.description_cn:
需要修改处理状态的巡检异常结果的唯一 ID。
您可以调用 [GetInstanceInspectResult](/docs/6410/1335399) 接口，获取巡检异常结果的唯一 ID。
ResultId.description_en:
You need the unique ID of the inspection exception result whose processing status you want to modify
Call the [GetInstanceInspectResult](/docs/6410/1335399) API to get the unique ID of the inspection exception result

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要执行巡检规则的目标实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Target Instance ID to Execute Inspection Rules On

Type.description_cn:
巡检规则的类型。

- `cluster`：目前支持 queueInsufficient 巡检规则，巡检实例 Queue 资源是否不足。
- `topic`：目前支持 queueBalance 巡检规则，巡检实例 Queue 分布是否不均衡。
- `group`：目前支持 subscribeConsistency 巡检规则，巡检实例 Group 组订阅是否不一致。

5.x 版本实例不支持 subscribeConsistency 巡检规则。
Type.description_en:
Types of inspection rules

- Cluster: Currently supports the queueInsufficient inspection rule, which checks if instance queue resources are insufficient
- Topic: Currently supports the queueBalance inspection rule, which checks if instance queue distribution is unbalanced
- Group: Currently supports the subscribeConsistency inspection rule, which checks if instance group subscriptions are inconsistent

Instances running version 5.x do not support the subscribeConsistency inspection rule

Body.description_cn: 需要发送的消息的具体内容。

Key.description_cn:
需要发送的消息的 Message Key。
消息发送后，您可以通过 Message Key 来查询消息。
Key.description_en: The Message Key of the message to be sent. After sending the message, you can use the Message Key to query the message.

Tag.description_cn:
自定义设置消息 Tag。
可以用来进一步对某个 Topic 下的消息进行分类，RocketMQ 允许消费者按照 Tag 对消息进行过滤。
Tag.description_en:
Customize Message Tag
Use Tag to further categorize messages under a Topic. RocketMQ allows consumers to filter messages by Tag.

Topic.description_cn: 目标 Topic 的名称，即向该 Topic 发送消息。
Topic.description_en: Target Topic Name (messages will be sent to this Topic)

AccessKey.description_cn:
待修改默认权限的 RocketMQ 密钥 AccessKey ID。
创建密钥后，推荐调用 DescribeAccessKeys 接口查看已创建的 RocketMQ 密钥列表，您可以通过 Description 参数识别出目标密钥。
AccessKey.description_en:
AccessKey ID of the RocketMQ key with default permissions to be modified
After creating a key, we recommend calling the DescribeAccessKeys API to view the list of created RocketMQ keys. You can use the Description parameter to identify the target key.

AllAuthority.description_cn:
RocketMQ 密钥的默认权限。
- `ALL`：拥有发布和订阅权限
- `PUB`：拥有发布权限
- `SUB`：拥有订阅权限
- `DENY`：不具备发布或订阅权限
AllAuthority.description_en:
Default permissions for RocketMQ keys
- ALL: Publish and subscribe access
- PUB: Publish access
- SUB: Subscribe access
- DENY: No publish or subscribe access

GroupAllAuthority.description_cn: RocketMQ 密钥的消费组默认权限。 - SUB：拥有订阅权限 - DENY：不具备发布或订阅权限
GroupAllAuthority.description_en:
Default permissions for RocketMQ key consumer groups
- SUB: Has subscription permission
- DENY: No publish or subscribe permission

AccessKey.description_cn:
待设置自定义权限的 RocketMQ 密钥 AccessKey ID。
创建密钥后，推荐调用 DescribeAccessKeys 接口查看已创建的 RocketMQ 密钥列表，您可以通过`Description`参数识别出目标密钥。
AccessKey.description_en:
AccessKey ID of the RocketMQ key to set custom permissions for
It is recommended to call the DescribeAccessKeys API to view the list of RocketMQ keys you have created. You can identify the target key using the Description parameter.

AccessPolicies.description_cn: 自定义权限配置，即设置该 AccessKey 对特定 Topic 所拥有的权限。
AccessPolicies.description_en: Custom permission configuration means setting the permissions that this AccessKey has for a specific Topic

AccessPolicies.Authority.description_cn:
AccessKey 具备该 Topic 的权限。
- `ALL`：拥有发布、订阅权限。
- `PUB`：拥有发布权限。
- `SUB`：拥有订阅权限。
- `DENY`：不具备发布或订阅权限。
AccessPolicies.Authority.description_en:
AccessKey has permissions for this Topic
- ALL: Publish and subscribe permissions
- PUB: Publish permission
- SUB: Subscribe permission
- DENY: No publish or subscribe permissions

InstanceId.description_en: Instance associated with the target key

AllowList.description_cn:
IP 地址列表，表示允许这些 IP 地址访问。

- 多个 IP 地址请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复。
- 支持 IP 地址形式（例如 10.23.12.xx）和 CIDR 形式（例如 10.23.12.x/xx）。
- 当 IP 较多时，建议合并为 IP 段填入，例如 10.23.12.x/24。
- 每个实例最多添加 300 个 IP 或 IP 段，即所有 IP 白名单分组内的 IP 或 IP 段总和不能超过 300。
AllowList.description_en:
IP address list. Only these IP addresses are allowed access

- Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. Do not enter duplicates
- Supports IP address format (for example, 10.23.12.xx) and CIDR format (for example, 10.23.12.x/xx)
- If you have many IP addresses, consider combining them into an IP range, such as 10.23.12.x/24
- Each instance can add up to 300 IP addresses or ranges. The total number of IP addresses or ranges across all whitelist groups cannot exceed 300

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 修改后的白名单描述。长度不超过 200 个字符。默认值为空，若修改时不设置，则描述会被设置为空字符串。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Modified whitelist description. Maximum length is 200 characters. Default value is empty; if not set during modification, the description will be set to an empty string.

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称。

- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线或连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist name

- Must be 1–128 characters long
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Whitelist name must be unique within the current region

ApplyDBInstanceNum.description_cn: 已应用实例数量，即当前该白名单所绑定的实例数。主要目的是确认本次修改的影响范围，避免误操作引发故障。
ApplyDBInstanceNum.description_en: Applied instance count indicates the number of instances currently bound to this whitelist. Its main purpose is to confirm the scope of impact for this change and prevent accidental operations that may cause failures.

ModifyMode.description_cn:
白名单修改方式，默认值为 Cover。支持设置为：

- `Cover`：使用`AllowList`参数的值覆盖原白名单。
- `Append`：在原白名单中增加`AllowList`参数中输入的 IP 地址。
- `Delete`：在原白名单中删除`AllowList`参数中输入的 IP 地址。至少需要保留一个 IP 地址。
ModifyMode.description_en:
Whitelist modification method. Default value: Cover. Supported options:

- Cover: Replace the original whitelist with the IP addresses specified in the AllowList parameter
- Append: Add the IP addresses specified in the AllowList parameter to the original whitelist
- Delete: Remove the IP addresses specified in the AllowList parameter from the original whitelist. At least one IP address must remain.

Description.description_cn: Description
Description.description_en: Description

InstanceName.description_cn: 实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en: Instance Name

ProductInfo.description_cn:
产品配置信息。
仅 RocketMQ 5.x 版本实例支持调整实例的 TPS 占比。
ProductInfo.description_en:
Product configuration information
Only RocketMQ 5.x instances support adjusting the TPS proportion

ProductInfo.SendReceiveRatio.description_cn:
修改读写限流比例，默认读写比例各占 50%。
假设设置为 40，表示发送的 TPS 比列为 40%，订阅比列为 60%。
仅 RocketMQ 5.x 版本实例支持调整实例的 TPS 占比。
ProductInfo.SendReceiveRatio.description_en: Adjust the read/write throttling ratio. By default, both read and write ratios are set to 50%. If you set the value to 40, the sending TPS ratio is 40% and the subscribing TPS ratio is 60%.  Only RocketMQ 5.x version instances support adjusting the instance's TPS ratio.

ChargeInfo.description_cn:
变更后的计费类型。
目前仅支持按量付费实例转为包年包月实例。
ChargeInfo.description_en:
Billing Type After Change
Currently, only pay-as-you-go instances can be converted to subscription-based instances (annual/monthly)

ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_cn:
包年包月实例到期后是否自动续费。
- `true`：自动续费。
- `false`：不自动续费。到期后需要手动续费，否则实例将被关停。
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to auto-renew annual/monthly subscription instances after expiration
- true: Auto-renew
- false: Do not auto-renew. Manual renewal is required after expiration; otherwise, the instance will be stopped
Only annual/monthly subscription instances require this setting. This option is mandatory when ChargeType is set to PrePaid

ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_cn:
付费类型。取值：
- `PostPaid`：按量付费
- `PrePaid`（默认）：包年包月
ChargeInfo.ChargeType.description_en:
Payment Type
- PostPaid: Pay-As-You-Go
- PrePaid (Default): Subscription (Yearly/Monthly)

ChargeInfo.Period.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的购买时长。

- `PeriodUnit`指定为`Monthly`时，取值范围为 1~9。
- `PeriodUnit`指定为`Yearly`时，取值范围为 1~3。

仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for subscription-based instances

- When PeriodUnit is set to Monthly, valid values are 1–9
- When PeriodUnit is set to Yearly, valid values are 1–3

This must be specified only for subscription-based instances (when ChargeType is set to PrePaid)

ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_cn:
包年包月类型实例的生命周期单位，即指定以月或以年为单位购买。其中：
- `Monthly`：（默认）包月
- `Yearly`：包年
仅包年包月类型的实例需要指定，即`ChargeType`指定为`PrePaid`时必选。
ChargeInfo.PeriodUnit.description_en:
Lifecycle unit for monthly/yearly subscription type instances, specifying purchase by month or year
- Monthly (default): monthly subscription
- Yearly: yearly subscription
This must be specified only for monthly/yearly subscription type instances, i.e., when ChargeType is set to PrePaid

AutoScaleQueue.description_cn: 实例规格更改时，是否自动创建队列。
AutoScaleQueue.description_en: Automatically create queue when instance specification changes?

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。
该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](/docs/6410/1160436)。
ClientToken.description_en:
Identifier for ensuring idempotency of client requests.
This identifier is a case-sensitive ASCII string of 1 to 64 characters, generated by the client. Make sure it is unique for each request.
For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](/docs/6410/1160436).

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例变更后的计算规格。如需升级计算规格，此参数必选。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
ComputeSpec.description_en: Compute specifications after instance change. This parameter is required to upgrade compute specifications. Only instance specification upgrades are supported; downgrades are not allowed.

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要更新配置的实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Instance IDs that require configuration update

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例变更后的存储空间。如需扩容存储空间，此参数必选。
单位为GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Storage space after instance modification. Required if you need to expand storage space
Unit: GiB. Must be a multiple of 100. The available range depends on the selected compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397)
Only instance upgrades are supported; downgrades are not supported

AccessPolicies.description_cn: 每个 RocketMQ 密钥对于当前 Topic 的权限，支持批量设置权限。若未设置，每个密钥对于当前 Topic 维持密钥的默认权限。

AccessPolicies.Authority.description_cn:
用户对于当前Topic的访问权限。
- `ALL`：拥有发布、订阅权限。
- `PUB`：拥有发布权限。
- `SUB`：拥有订阅权限。
- `DENY`：不具备发布或订阅权限。

Description.description_cn: Topic 描述。
Description.description_en: Description

GroupId.description_cn:
死信队列对应的的 Group ID。
- 一个死信队列对应一个 Group ID， 而不是对应单个消费者实例。
- 一个死信队列包含了对应 Group ID 产生的所有死信消息，不论该消息属于哪个 Topic。
GroupId.description_en:
Group ID for the dead-letter queue
- Each dead-letter queue is associated with a Group ID, not with individual consumer instances
- The dead-letter queue contains all dead-letter messages generated by the associated Group ID, regardless of which Topic the message belongs to

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。其中列表中每一页的条目数量固定为 16。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number of the list, minimum value is 1. Each page contains 16 items.

PageSize.description_cn: 最小为10，最大为100。表示查询结果的分页
PageSize.description_en: Minimum is 10, maximum is 100. Indicates pagination for query results

QueryEndTimestamp.description_cn:
消息存储时间中的结束时间戳，单位为秒。
消息存储时间指消息在投递重试达到最大次数后被发送到死信队列的时间。
QueryEndTimestamp.description_en:
End timestamp of message storage time (in seconds)
Message storage time refers to the time when a message is sent to the dead letter queue after delivery retries reach the maximum limit

QueryStartTimestamp.description_cn:
消息存储时间中的起始时间戳，单位为秒。
消息存储时间指消息在投递重试达到最大次数后被发送到死信队列的时间。
QueryStartTimestamp.description_en:
Start timestamp for message storage time (in seconds)
Message storage time refers to when a message is sent to the dead letter queue after delivery retries reach the maximum number of attempts.

Refresh.description_cn:
是否强制刷新。默认值为`false`。
- `true`：强制刷新消息缓存。若查询范围发生变化，请设置为`true`。
- `false`：不强制刷新消息缓存。
Refresh.description_en:
Whether to force refresh. Default is false.
- true: Force refreshes the message cache. Please set to true if the query range changes.
- false: Does not force refresh the message cache.

GroupId.description_cn:
死信队列对应的的 Group ID。

- 创建 Group 时，消息队列 RocketMQ版会自动为其创建一个对应的死信队列。
- 一个死信队列对应一个 Group ID， 而不是对应单个消费者实例。一个死信队列包含了对应 Group ID 产生的所有死信消息，不论该消息属于哪个 Topic。
GroupId.description_en:
Group ID for the dead-letter queue

- When you create a Group, RocketMQ message queue version automatically creates a corresponding dead-letter queue
- Each dead-letter queue is associated with a Group ID, not a single consumer instance. The dead-letter queue stores all dead-letter messages generated by the Group ID, regardless of which Topic the message belongs to

LiteTopic.description_cn: LiteTopic 名称。非 LiteTopic 查询可不填。
LiteTopic.description_en: LiteTopic Name. If not a LiteTopic query, leave blank

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。每一页的条目数量为 16。
PageNumber.description_en: The minimum page number is 1; each page shows 16 items

QueryEndTimestamp.description_cn: 需要查询的结束时间戳。单位为秒。
QueryEndTimestamp.description_en:
End timestamp to query
Unit: seconds

QueryStartTimestamp.description_cn: 需要查询的起始时间戳。单位为秒。
QueryStartTimestamp.description_en: Start timestamp to query. Unit: seconds

MessageBornTimestamp.description_cn: 消息产生的时间戳，单位秒。
MessageBornTimestamp.description_en: Timestamp when the message was generated, in seconds

NeedProduceTraceInfo.description_cn: 是否需要生产者的消息轨迹。
NeedProduceTraceInfo.description_en: Do you need the producer's message trace?

OnlyReturnSuccessProduceTraceInfo.description_cn: 仅返回发送成功的消息轨迹

- `Timestamp`：指定时间进行消费重置。
ResetType.description_en:
Consumption offset reset methods can be set as follows:
EndOffset: Default option. Resets the consumption offset to the latest message. The group will skip all currently accumulated (unconsumed) messages under this topic and start consuming from the latest message after the reset.
Timestamp: Resets consumption to a specified time.

Conditions.AgentStatus.description_en: Client status. Available values: not_installed (not installed), not_started (pending activation), starting (activating), start_failed (activation failed), online (online), offline (offline), stopping (deactivating), stop_failed (deactivation failed)

Conditions.AllHost.description_cn: 是否忽略其他筛选条件并选择全部主机。true：选择全部主机；false：按其他条件筛选；不传时默认为 false
Conditions.AllHost.description_en: Ignore other filter conditions and select all hosts. true: Select all hosts; false: Filter by other conditions; default is false if not specified

Conditions.LeafGroupIDs.description_cn: 叶子分组 ID 列表，可通过多级分组查询接口获取；不传时不限制叶子分组
Conditions.LeafGroupIDs.description_en: Leaf group ID list, can be obtained via the multi-level group query API; no value means no restriction on leaf groups

Conditions.Os.description_cn: 操作系统类型。linux：Linux 系统；windows：Windows 系统；不传时不限制
Conditions.Os.description_en: Operating system type. linux: Linux system; windows: Windows system; no value means no restriction

Conditions.Risk.description_cn: 主机安全风险筛选条件；各字段为 true 时筛选存在对应风险的主机，false 或不传时不按该风险筛选
Conditions.Risk.description_en: Host security risk filter conditions; when a field is true, filter hosts with the corresponding risk; false or no value means do not filter by that risk

Conditions.Risk.Baseline.description_cn: 是否存在高危基线风险
Conditions.Risk.Baseline.description_en: Are there any critical baseline risks

Conditions.Risk.IsRealRiskVul.description_cn: 是否存在真实风险漏洞
Conditions.Risk.IsRealRiskVul.description_en: Are there any actual risk vulnerabilities

Conditions.Risk.Vuln.description_cn: 是否存在高危漏洞风险
Conditions.Risk.Vuln.description_en: Are there any critical vulnerability risks

Conditions.SecurityEnhancement.description_cn: 安全防护开关。true：仅查询已开启安全防护的主机；false：仅查询未开启安全防护的主机；不传时不限制
Conditions.SecurityEnhancement.description_en: Security protection switch. true: Only query hosts with security protection enabled; false: Only query hosts without security protection enabled; no value means no restriction

Conditions.Status.description_cn: 防护状态。可选值：Protecting（防护中）、Unprotected（未防护）、ProtectionException（防护异常）、Offline（关机）
Conditions.Status.description_en: Protection status. Available values: Protecting (protected), Unprotected (unprotected), ProtectionException (protection exception), Offline (shut down)

Conditions.TopGroupID.description_cn: 根分组 ID，可通过多级分组查询接口获取；不传时不限制根分组
Conditions.TopGroupID.description_en: Root group ID, can be obtained via the multi-level group query API; no value means no restriction on root groups

Conditions.VirusFileAutoIsolate.description_cn: 是否排除自动隔离病毒主机。false：仅查询未开启自动隔离的主机；true 或不传：不按此字段筛选
Conditions.VirusFileAutoIsolate.description_en: Exclude hosts with automatic virus isolation. false: Only query hosts without automatic isolation enabled; true or no value: Do not filter by this field

Conditions.Visibility.description_cn: 镜像类型,private是自定义镜像，public是公共镜像
Conditions.Visibility.description_en: Image type: private is a custom image, public is a public image

Conditions.VpcIds.description_cn: VPC ID 列表，可从云环境或主机信息接口返回的 VpcId 获取
Conditions.VpcIds.description_en: VPC ID list, can be obtained from the VpcId returned by the cloud environment or host information API

IdList.description_cn: 指定主机 ID 列表，可通过 ListHostsAgentIDs 接口获取；不传时按 Conditions 筛选
IdList.description_en: Specify a list of host IDs, which can be obtained via the ListHostsAgentIDs API. If not provided, hosts are filtered according to Conditions

Tags.description_cn: 标签名称列表，必填且元素不可重复；标签不能为空字符串
Tags.description_en: Tag name list. Required and elements must be unique. Tags cannot be empty strings

AgentIDList.description_cn: 关联 Agent ID 列表，可从主机资产列表获取；不传时不按主机指定范围
AgentIDList.description_en: Associated Agent ID list, can be obtained from the host asset list; if not provided, the host scope is not specified

Description.description_cn: 备注
Description.description_en: Notes

ID.description_cn: 必填，配置 ID，可从 ListLoginConfigs 获取
ID.description_en: Required. Configuration ID, can be obtained from ListLoginConfigs

IfAllHost.description_cn: true 作用于全部主机，false 仅作用于 LeafGroupIDs 或 AgentIDList 指定范围；未传时为 false
IfAllHost.description_en: true applies to all hosts, false applies only to the specified scope of LeafGroupIDs or AgentIDList; defaults to false if not provided

LeafGroupIDs.description_cn: 叶子分组 ID 列表，可从多级分组查询接口获取；不传时不按分组指定范围
LeafGroupIDs.description_en: Leaf group ID list, can be obtained from the multi-level group query API; if not provided, the group scope is not specified

LoginConfigRules.description_cn: 必填，登录配置规则：User 用户、IP 地址、TimeInterval 时间段、Location 地理位置
LoginConfigRules.description_en: Required. Login configuration rules: User (user), IP (address), TimeInterval (time interval), Location (geographical location)

TimeIntervals.description_cn: 常用时间段，格式为 HH:mm-HH:mm；最多 5 个；LoginConfigRules 包含 TimeInterval 时必填
TimeIntervals.description_en: Common time intervals, format: HH:mm-HH:mm; up to 5; required if LoginConfigRules includes TimeInterval

TopGroupID.description_cn: 根分组 ID，可从多级分组查询接口获取
TopGroupID.description_en: Root group ID, can be obtained from the multi-level group query API

AlarmIDList.description_cn: 要处理的告警 ID 列表，可从对应告警列表获取；与 Conditions 二选一使用
AlarmIDList.description_en: List of alarm IDs to handle. Obtain from the corresponding alarm list. Use either this or Conditions, not both

Conditions.description_cn: 批量处理的条件（符合条件告警将被批量处理）
Conditions.description_en: Batch Processing Conditions (alerts that meet these conditions will be processed in bulk)

Conditions.AgentIDList.description_cn: 主机 Agent ID 列表，可从主机资产列表获取；不传时不按主机筛选
Conditions.AgentIDList.description_en: Host Agent ID list. Obtain from the host asset list. If not provided, host filtering is not applied

Conditions.LastAlarmTimeEnd.description_cn: 最近一次告警时间范围终点，秒级 Unix 时间戳
Conditions.LastAlarmTimeEnd.description_en: End time of the most recent alert range, Unix timestamp in seconds

Conditions.LastAlarmTimeStart.description_cn: 最近一次告警时间范围起点，秒级 Unix 时间戳
Conditions.LastAlarmTimeStart.description_en: Start time of the most recent alert range, Unix timestamp in seconds

Conditions.LeafGroupIDs.description_cn: 叶子分组 ID 列表，可通过多级分组查询接口获取；不传时不限制叶子分组
Conditions.LeafGroupIDs.description_en: Leaf group ID list. Obtain from the multi-level group query API. If not provided, leaf group is not restricted

Conditions.Level.description_cn: 告警级别列表：critical 严重、high 高危、medium 中危、low 低危
Conditions.Level.description_en: Alert level list: critical Severe, high High risk, medium Medium risk, low Low risk

Conditions.MlpInstanceID.description_cn: MLP 实例 ID，可从开发机资产列表获取
Conditions.MlpInstanceID.description_en: MLP instance ID. Obtain from the development machine asset list

Conditions.Status.description_cn: 告警状态列表：0 待处理、1 已处理
Conditions.Status.description_en: Alert status list: 0 Pending, 1 Processed

Conditions.TimeEnd.description_cn: 发生时间或首次告警时间范围终点，秒级 Unix 时间戳
Conditions.TimeEnd.description_en: End time of occurrence or first alert range, Unix timestamp in seconds

Conditions.TimeStart.description_cn: 发生时间或首次告警时间范围起点，秒级 Unix 时间戳
Conditions.TimeStart.description_en: Start time of occurrence or first alert range, Unix timestamp in seconds

Conditions.TopGroupID.description_cn: 根分组 ID，可通过多级分组查询接口获取；不传时不限制根分组
Conditions.TopGroupID.description_en: Root group ID. Obtain from the multi-level group query API. If not provided, root group is not restricted

Conditions.VirusType.description_cn: 病毒或恶意文件分类，按 class 字段模糊匹配，例如 Webshell
Conditions.VirusType.description_en: Virus or malicious file category. Fuzzy match by class field, e.g., Webshell

Conditions.security_intelligence_results.description_cn: 智能体研判结果：已攻陷(TRUE)/误报(FALSE)/攻击尝试(ATTEMPTED)/待补充数据(PENDING)/研判失败(ANALYSIS_FAILED)
Conditions.security_intelligence_results.description_en: AI assessment result: Compromised (TRUE)/False positive (FALSE)/Attack attempted (ATTEMPTED)/Pending data (PENDING)/Analysis failed (ANALYSIS_FAILED)

CustomTagList.description_cn: HandleMethod=10 时使用的自定义标签；其他处理方式或不传时不添加自定义标签
CustomTagList.description_en: Custom tags used when HandleMethod=10. Not added for other handling methods or if not provided

HandleMethod.description_cn: 处理方法：1 已人工处理、2 误报、6 已重复、7 真实入侵、10 自定义；未传时为 0 并因无效处理方式而失败
HandleMethod.description_en: Handling methods: 1 manually handled, 2 false positive, 6 duplicate, 7 real intrusion, 10 custom. If not provided, the value defaults to 0 and the operation fails due to an invalid handling method

Type.description_cn: 必填，告警类别：hids 主机入侵、kube 容器集群防护、rasp 应用防护、virus 病毒扫描、file_monitor 文件监控、mlp 开发机
Type.description_en: Required. Alarm types: hids host intrusion, kube container cluster protection, rasp application protection, virus scan, file_monitor file monitoring, mlp development machine

NotificationThreshold.description_cn: 离线告警阈值 10-10000分钟 默认60

FlowRateLimit.description_cn: 下载限速, 单位MB/s，取值范围（0，256]
FlowRateLimit.description_en: Download speed limit, unit: MB/s, range: (0, 256]

CronTerm.description_cn:
同步周期，默认不修改原有配置，取值范围：
Daily=每日
Monday=周一
Tuesday=周二
Wednesday=周三
Thursday=周四
Friday=周五
Saturday=周六
Sunday=周日
CronTerm.description_en:
Synchronization cycle. By default, the original configuration remains unchanged. Value range:
Daily = Every day
Monday = Monday
Tuesday = Tuesday
Wednesday = Wednesday
Thursday = Thursday
Friday = Friday
Saturday = Saturday
Sunday = Sunday

CronTime.description_cn: 同步时间，默认不修改原有配置（格式为 HH:mm，时区为 UTC+8）
CronTime.description_en: Synchronization time. By default, the original configuration remains unchanged (format: HH:mm, time zone: UTC+8)

Enabled.description_cn:
是否开启镜像同步,取值范围：
0=停用
1=启用
Enabled.description_en: Enable mirror sync? Value range: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

CleanDays.description_cn: 保留最近若干天数据，单位天；大于 99 时服务端按 99 处理，未传时为 0
CleanDays.description_en: Retain data from the most recent days, in days; if greater than 99, the server processes as 99. Defaults to 0 if not specified

CleanHours.description_cn: 每日执行清理的小时数，按 24 小时制；未传时为 0
CleanHours.description_en: Number of hours for daily cleanup, in 24-hour format; defaults to 0 if not specified

Switch.description_cn: true 启用定期清理，false 关闭；未传时为 false
Switch.description_en: true enables scheduled cleanup, false disables it; defaults to false if not specified

ClusterID.description_cn: 集群ID
ClusterID.description_en: Cluster ID

VarmorSimpleConfig.description_en: Simple configuration, required when ConfigType is Simple

VarmorSimpleConfig.AgentHostNetwork.description_cn: Agent 运行在宿主机网络

VarmorSimpleConfig.ResourceLimit.description_cn: 资源限制，前端暂时没有
VarmorSimpleConfig.ResourceLimit.description_en: Due to resource limitations, the frontend is temporarily unavailable

YAMLConfig.description_en: YAML configuration content, required when ConfigType is YAML

ClusterID.description_cn: 集群ID
ClusterID.description_en: Cluster ID

Namespace.description_cn: 命名空间
Namespace.description_en: Namespace

StorageDays.description_cn: StorageDays 存储时长 范围 30-3650 天 3650则为永久存储
StorageDays.description_en: StorageDays Storage Duration Range: 30–3650 days; 3650 means permanent storage

DestinationConfig.AutoInstallBlkNone.description_cn:
是否自动为目标实例或目标镜像安装blk-none。取值：
- true：自动安装。
- false：默认，不自动安装。
仅迁移至Linux云服务器实例、Linux云服务镜像时有效。
DestinationConfig.AutoInstallBlkNone.description_en:
Whether to automatically install blk-none on the target instance or target image
Values:
- true: Automatically install
- false: Default value, do not install automatically
Only applies when migrating to Linux cloud server instances or Linux cloud service images

DestinationConfig.AutoInstallVirtio11.description_cn:
是否自动为目标实例或目标镜像安装Virtio1.1驱动。取值：
- true：自动安装。
- false：默认，不自动安装。
仅迁移至Linux云服务器实例、Linux云服务镜像时有效。
DestinationConfig.AutoInstallVirtio11.description_en:
Whether to automatically install the Virtio1.1 driver for the target instance or target image. Values:
- true: Automatically install
- false: Default value, do not install automatically
Only valid when migrating to Linux cloud server instances or Linux cloud service images

DestinationConfig.AutoReplicate.description_cn:
迁移任务通过预检后是否自动开始迁移。取值：
* false：默认，不自动迁移。
* true：自动迁移。
仅迁移至云服务器实例、云服务镜像时有效。
DestinationConfig.AutoReplicate.description_en:
Whether the migration task automatically starts after passing the pre-check. Values:
* false: Default value; does not start migration automatically
* true: Starts migration automatically
Only valid when migrating to cloud server instances or cloud service images

DestinationConfig.DestinationSystem.description_cn:
目标操作系统。取值：
- Unknown：未知。
- VeLinux10Centos：表示迁移为veLinux 1.0 CentOS兼容版操作系统。
- VeLinux20Centos：表示迁移为veLinux 2.0 CentOS兼容版操作系统。
`DestinationConfig.DestinationType`为`ECSSystem`时，本参数必填。
DestinationConfig.DestinationSystem.description_en:
Target operating system. Possible values:
- Unknown: Unknown
- VeLinux10Centos: Indicates migration to veLinux 1.0 CentOS-compatible operating system
- VeLinux20Centos: Indicates migration to veLinux 2.0 CentOS-compatible operating system
This parameter is required when `DestinationConfig.DestinationType` is set to `ECSSystem`

DestinationConfig.DestinationType.description_cn:
目标类型，取值：
- ECSInstance：云服务器实例。
- ECSImage：云服务器镜像。
- ECSSystem：云服务器操作系统。
DestinationConfig.DestinationType.description_en:
Target type, values:
- ECSInstance: Cloud server instance
- ECSImage: Cloud server image
- ECSSystem: Cloud server operating system
- ECSTemplate: Create cloud server instance using migration template
The feature to create cloud server instances using migration templates is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

DestinationConfig.ImageName.description_cn:
镜像名称。
- 必须以字母、汉字开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、英文句号“.”。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
迁移到云服务器镜像时，本参数必填。
DestinationConfig.ImageName.description_en:
Image Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
This parameter is required when migrating to a cloud server image

DestinationConfig.InstanceId.description_cn:
目标实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466)接口查询获取。
迁移到云服务器实例时，本参数必填。
DestinationConfig.InstanceId.description_en:
Target Instance ID: You can query and obtain it using the [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) API
This parameter is required when migrating to a cloud server instance

DestinationConfig.LicenseType.description_cn:
许可证类型。取值：
- PlatformLicense：根据您源服务器操作系统类型，采用火山引擎官方渠道的许可证。
- BYOL：自带许可证（BYOL）。
- 仅当源服务器操作系统类型为RedHat、SUSE Linux Enterprise Server或Windows时，本参数生效；其他操作系统类型本参数无效。
- 各操作系统支持的取值如下：
	- Windows：支持`PlatformLicense`、`BYOL`。
	- RedHat / SUSE Linux Enterprise Server：
		- 源服务器为**火山引擎云服务器实例**：支持`PlatformLicense`、`BYOL`。
		- 源服务器为**非火山引擎云服务器实例**：仅支持`BYOL`。
DestinationConfig.LicenseType.description_en:
License type
Options:
- VolcanoEngine: Default. Uses the official Volcano Engine license based on your source server's operating system
- BYOL: Bring your own license (BYOL)

DiskConfigs.N.DestinationDiskSize.description_cn:
调整后目标云镜像磁盘容量，单位GiB。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
- 多个磁盘序号之间用`&`分隔。
- 系统盘容量大小支持范围为40 GiB ~ 2048 GiB，且需不低于迁移分区大小之和。
本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.DestinationDiskSize.description_en:
Target cloud image disk capacity after adjustment (in GiB)
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number; valid range: 0–14
- Separate multiple disk numbers with `&`
- Supported system disk capacity range: 40 GiB ~ 2048 GiB, and must not be less than the total size of all migration partitions
This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex.description_cn:
源服务器磁盘下标，从`0`开始。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
- 多个磁盘序号之间用&分隔。
参数 - N 的值不能超过源服务器实际磁盘数量。
DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex.description_en:
Source server disk index, starting from `0`
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, valid range: 0–14
- Use `&` to separate multiple disk numbers
The value of parameter - N cannot exceed the actual number of disks on the source server

DiskConfigs.N.DiskSize.description_cn:
源服务器磁盘容量，单位GB。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘序号，与`DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex`标识的磁盘序号对应，取值范围：0～14。
- 多个磁盘序号之间用&分隔。
参数 - N 的值不能超过源服务器实际磁盘数量。
DiskConfigs.N.DiskSize.description_en:
Source server disk capacity, unit: GiB.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number, corresponding to the disk sequence number identified by `DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex`. Value range: 0–14.
- Use `&` to separate multiple disk sequence numbers.
The value of parameter - N cannot exceed the actual number of disks on the source server.

DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.description_cn:
迁移时是否跳过该分区。取值：
* false：默认，不跳过。
* true：跳过。
* 仅Linux文件复制迁移到“云服务器镜像”时支持。
* 挂载点为`/`与`/boot`的分区必须迁移。
* 暂仅支持系统盘。
* 第一个N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
* 第二个N：表示分区序号。
* 多个分区配置之间用&分隔。
* 本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.description_en:
Whether to skip this partition during migration. Values:
* false: Default, do not skip
* true: Skip
* Supported only for Linux file copy migration to 'Cloud Server Image'
* Partitions with mount points `/` and `/boot` must be migrated
* Currently supports system disk only
* The first N: Disk number, value range: 0–14
* The second N: Partition number
* Use & to separate multiple partition configurations
* This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.AbortPartitio.description_cn:
迁移时是否跳过该分区。取值：
* false：默认，不跳过。
* true：跳过。
* 仅Linux文件复制迁移到“云服务器镜像”时支持。
* 挂载点为`/`与`/boot`的分区必须迁移。
* 暂仅支持系统盘。
* 第一个N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
* 第二个N：表示分区序号。
* 多个分区配置之间用&分隔。
* 本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.AbortPartitio.description_en:
Whether to skip this partition during migration. Values:
* false: Default, do not skip
* true: Skip
* Supported only for Linux file copy migration to 'Cloud Server Image'
* Partitions with mount points `/` and `/boot` must be migrated
* Currently supports system disk only
* The first N: Disk number, value range: 0–14
* The second N: Partition number
* Use & to separate multiple partition configurations
* This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.DestinationPa.description_cn:
调整后目标云镜像分区容量，单位Bytes。
- 第一个N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
- 第二个N：表示分区序号。
* 多个分区容量之间用`&`分隔。
* 调整后分区大小不能小于已使用空间，且所有分区大小之和不能大于所属磁盘大小。
* 本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.DestinationPa.description_en:
Adjusted target cloud image partition capacity (unit: Bytes)
- The first N: indicates the disk index, range: 0–14
- The second N: indicates the partition index
* Use `&` to separate multiple partition capacities
* The adjusted partition size cannot be smaller than the used space, and the total size of all partitions cannot exceed the disk size
* This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

MigrationJobDescription.description_cn:
任务描述。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
MigrationJobDescription.description_en:
Task description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), spaces, underscores (_), hyphens (-), equals signs (=), English commas (,), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。) are allowed
- Up to 255 characters

MigrationJobName.description_cn:
任务名称。
- 以字母或中文开头。

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:

- 命名规则如下：

   - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
   - 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user labels
- Parameter - N: Indicates the tag key sequence number, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with `&`
- Naming rules:
   - Must not start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
   - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
   - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:

   - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
   - 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with `&`
- Naming rules:
   - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
   - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`

CalculatePriceInfos.Action.description_cn:
询价执行的操作，大小写不敏感，取值说明如下：

- create：创建云盘前询价。
	
- extend：扩容云盘前询价。
	
- modifyChargeType：更改计费模式，例如包年包月云盘改为按量计费云盘。
	
- modifyType：更改云盘规格前询价，例如ESSD PL0改为ESSD FlexPL。
	
- renew：续费前询价。
	
- terminate：退订前询价。
按量计费云盘不支持renew（续费询价）和terminate（退订询价）。
CalculatePriceInfos.Action.description_en:
Operation for which the price quote is requested (case-insensitive). The values are as follows:

- create: Price quote before creating a cloud disk.
- extend: Price quote before expanding a cloud disk.
- modifyChargeType: Change billing mode, e.g., from subscription to pay-as-you-go.
- modifyType: Price quote before changing cloud disk specifications, e.g., from ESSD PL0 to ESSD FlexPL.
- renew: Price quote before renewal.
- terminate: Price quote before unsubscription.
Pay-as-you-go cloud disks do not support renew (renewal price quote) and terminate (unsubscription price quote).

CalculatePriceInfos.ChargeType.description_cn:
云盘的付费模式，取值说明如下：
- PostPaid：按量计费
- PrePaid：包年包月
CalculatePriceInfos.ChargeType.description_en:
Cloud disk billing mode. The values are as follows:
- PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: Subscription

CalculatePriceInfos.Count.description_en: Number of cloud disks. Default is 1.

CalculatePriceInfos.EndTime.description_cn:
云盘到期截止时间，根据时间戳进行转换。
- 仅包年包月云盘支持设置EndTime参数。
	
- 退订场景不支持EndTime参数。
	
- 如果同时设置了EndTime和Times，优先使用EndTime。
CalculatePriceInfos.EndTime.description_en:
Cloud disk expiration time, converted based on timestamp.
- Only subscription cloud disks support setting the EndTime parameter.

- The EndTime parameter is not supported in unsubscribe scenarios.

- If both EndTime and Times are set, EndTime takes priority.

CalculatePriceInfos.ExtraPerformances.Ex.description_cn:
额外性能的类型。取值如下：

- Balance：均衡型。
	
- IOPS：IOPS型。
	
- Throughput：吞吐量型。
CalculatePriceInfos.ExtraPerformances.Ex.description_en:
Type of additional performance. The values are as follows:

- Balance: Balanced
- IOPS: IOPS
- Throughput: Throughput

CalculatePriceInfos.ExtraPerformances.Ex.description_cn: 额外性能包的性能大小。
CalculatePriceInfos.ExtraPerformances.Ex.description_en: Performance size of the additional performance package.

CalculatePriceInfos.InstanceID.description_cn:
ECS实例ID。设置InstanceID后，会使用ECS实例的过期时间作为云盘的到期截止时间，无需再设置EndTime。
- 仅包年包月云盘支持设置InstanceID参数。
- InstanceID和EndTime参数只能二选一，同时传入InstanceID和EndTime参数，会报错。
- 若同时传入InstanceID和Times，优先使用InstanceID对应的实例过期时间。
CalculatePriceInfos.InstanceID.description_en:
ECS instance ID. After setting InstanceID, the expiration time of the ECS instance will be used as the expiration time of the cloud disk. You do not need to set EndTime.
- Only subscription cloud disks support the InstanceID parameter.
- InstanceID and EndTime are mutually exclusive. If both are provided, an error will occur.
- If both InstanceID and Times are provided, the expiration time of the instance corresponding to InstanceID takes precedence.

CalculatePriceInfos.Period.description_cn:
云盘购买周期类型，取值说明如下：

- monthly：按月购买。包年包月仅支持monthly。
	
- hourly：按小时购买。按量计费仅支持hourly。
Period和Times参数必须一起传入。
CalculatePriceInfos.Period.description_en:
Cloud disk purchase cycle type. Valid values are as follows:

- monthly: Purchase by month. Subscription only supports monthly.

- hourly: Purchase by hour. Pay-as-you-go only supports hourly.
The Period and Times parameters must be passed together.

CalculatePriceInfos.Region.description_cn: 地域。默认为请求的地域。
CalculatePriceInfos.Region.description_en: Region. Defaults to the requested region.

CalculatePriceInfos.Size.description_cn:
云盘容量，单位GiB。
在执行创建云盘、扩容云盘、更改云盘计费模式、变更云盘规格操作前询价时，Size参数必填。
CalculatePriceInfos.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, in GiB.
The Size parameter is required when requesting a price quote before creating, expanding, changing the billing mode, or modifying the specifications of a cloud disk.

CalculatePriceInfos.Times.description_cn:
云盘购买时长。例如Period设置为monthly，Time设置为2，表示购买2个月云盘。
Times和Period参数必须一起传入。
CalculatePriceInfos.Times.description_en:
Cloud disk purchase duration. For example, if Period is set to monthly and Time is set to 2, it means purchasing the cloud disk for 2 months.
The Times and Period parameters must be provided together.

CalculatePriceInfos.VolumeID.description_cn:
云盘ID。
创建云盘前询价无需传入该参数，其他场景必须传入。
CalculatePriceInfos.VolumeID.description_en:
Cloud disk ID.
This parameter is not required when requesting a price quote before creating a cloud disk. It must be provided in other scenarios.

CalculatePriceInfos.VolumeKind.description_cn:
云盘类型。取值说明如下：

- data：数据盘
	
- system：系统盘
	

默认为数据盘。
CalculatePriceInfos.VolumeKind.description_en:
Cloud disk type. The values are as follows:

- data: Data disk
- system: System disk

The default is data disk.

CalculatePriceInfos.VolumeType.description_cn:
云盘规格，取值说明如下：

- PTSSD：性能型SSD。

- ESSD_PL0：极速型SSD云盘，PL0规格。
	
- ESSD_FlexPL: 极速型SSD云盘，FlexPL规格。
	
- TSSD_TL0：吞吐型SSD云盘
CalculatePriceInfos.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk specification. Valid values are as follows:

- PTSSD: Performance SSD.

- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, PL0 specification.

- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, FlexPL specification.

- TSSD_TL0: Throughput SSD cloud disk

- 自动快照策略不会继承云盘的项目，即自动快照策略与云盘或快照均可以所属不同的项目。
