ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the automatic snapshot policy belongs.
- The automatic snapshot policy does not inherit the project of the cloud disk. The automatic snapshot policy, cloud disk, and snapshot can each belong to different projects.

- If you do not set ProjectName when creating an automatic snapshot policy, the policy will be added to the default project.

RepeatDays.description_cn:
按天重复创建快照，即间隔一定天数创建快照，取值范围为[1, 30] 。
- 按天为周期重复创建快照时，创建自动快照策略的当天视为第一天，并且已过去的时间点不会创建快照，若当天的所有快照创建时间点都已过，当天仍然算第一天。
- 创建自动快照策略时，必须设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数中的一个，不支持同时设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数。
RepeatDays.description_en:
Repeat snapshot creation by day, meaning snapshots are created at intervals of a specified number of days. The value range is [1, 30].
- When repeating snapshot creation on a daily cycle, the day you create the automatic snapshot policy is considered the first day. Snapshots will not be created for past time points. If all snapshot creation times for that day have passed, it is still counted as the first day.
- When creating an automatic snapshot policy, you must set either the RepeatWeekdays.N or RepeatDays parameter. Setting both RepeatWeekdays.N and RepeatDays at the same time is not supported.

RepeatWeekdays.description_cn:
按周重复创建快照，即在周一至周日之间选择一个或多个日期创建快照。说明如下：

- 取值范围为1~7，例如1表示周一。

- 当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入7个时间点。
创建自动快照策略时，必须设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数中的一个，不支持同时设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数。
RepeatWeekdays.description_en:
Create snapshots on a weekly schedule. Select one or more days from Monday to Sunday. Details:

- Value range: 1–7, where 1 represents Monday

- If you need to create multiple automatic snapshots in a week, you can specify multiple days, up to 7.
When creating an automatic snapshot policy, you must set either the RepeatWeekdays.N or RepeatDays parameter. Setting both is not supported.

RepeatWeekdays.N.description_cn:
按周重复创建快照，即在周一至周日之间选择一个或多个日期创建快照。说明如下：

- 取值范围为1~7，例如1表示周一。

- 当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入7个时间点。
创建自动快照策略时，必须设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数中的一个，不支持同时设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数。
RepeatWeekdays.N.description_en:
Create snapshots on a weekly schedule. Select one or more days from Monday to Sunday. Details:

- Value range: 1–7, where 1 represents Monday

- If you need to create multiple automatic snapshots in a week, you can specify multiple days, up to 7.
When creating an automatic snapshot policy, you must set either the RepeatWeekdays.N or RepeatDays parameter. Setting both is not supported.

RetentionDays.description_cn:
自动快照的保留时间，单位为天，取值说明如下：

- \-1：永久保存。

- 1~65536：指定保存天数。
RetentionDays.description_en:
Retention period of automatic snapshots, in days. Value description:

- -1: Keep permanently

- 1–65536: Specify the number of days to retain

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
标签的标签键。

- Tags.N.Key：N表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key.

- Tags.N.Key: N indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–20

- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
标签的标签值。

- Tags.N.Value：N表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value.

- Tags.N.Value: N indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Value range: 1–20

- Separate multiple tag values with &

TimePoints.description_cn:
自动快照的创建时间点，取值说明如下：

- 使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。

- 取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如1表示01:00。

- 当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入24个时间点。
TimePoints.description_en:
Time points for automatic snapshot creation. Value description:

- Use UTC+8 time, in hours

- Value range: 0–23, representing 00:00 to 23:00 (24 time points). For example, 1 means 01:00

- To create multiple automatic snapshots in a day, you can specify up to 24 time points

TimePoints.N.description_cn:
自动快照的创建时间点，取值说明如下：

- 使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。

- 取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如1表示01:00。

- 当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入24个时间点。
TimePoints.N.description_en:
Time points for automatic snapshot creation. Value description:

- Use UTC+8 time, in hours

- Value range: 0–23, representing 00:00 to 23:00 (24 time points). For example, 1 means 01:00

- To create multiple automatic snapshots in a day, you can specify up to 24 time points

AutoAssign.description_cn:
是否开启为云盘自动分配存储子放置组功能，在创建云盘时绑定存储放置组，并开启自动分配存储子放置组功能后，将为云盘自动分配存储子放置组，取值说明如下：
- true：开启自动分配功能。
	
- false：不开启自动分配功能。
默认为false。
如果开启自动分配功能，同时在创建云盘时设置了`SubgroupNumber`参数，将为云盘自动分配存储子放置组，`SubgroupNumber`参数则无效。
AutoAssign.description_en:
Enable automatic assignment of storage sub-placement groups for cloud disks. When creating a cloud disk, if you bind a storage placement group and enable automatic assignment, the system will automatically assign a storage sub-placement group to the cloud disk. Value options:
- true: Enable automatic assignment
- false: Do not enable automatic assignment
Default is false
If you enable automatic assignment and set the `SubgroupNumber` parameter when creating the cloud disk, the system will automatically assign a storage sub-placement group and the `SubgroupNumber` parameter will be ignored.

Description.description_cn:
存储放置组的描述信息，默认为空，说明如下：
- 首字符仅支持中文、字母或下划线（_）。
- 可包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）或点（.）。
- 长度限制为1~128字符。
Description.description_en:
Description for the storage placement group. Default is empty. Rules:
- The first character may only be a Chinese character, a letter, or an underscore (_)
- May only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Name.description_cn:
存储放置组名称，说明如下：
- 首字符仅支持中文、字母或下划线（_）。
- 可包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）或点(.)。
- 长度限制为1~128字符。
Name.description_en:
Storage placement group name instructions:
- The first character must be a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
- May contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

SubgroupCount.description_cn:
存储子放置组的个数，最小为2，最大为min{可用区集群数量, 10}。
- 如果某个可用区集群的数量少于`SubgroupCount`值时，则报错`SubGroupCountExceedClusters`，并返回当前实际可用区集群数量。
- 设置存储子放置组后，系统会自动按照数字顺序为存储子放置组进行编号。编号最小值为1，最大值为存储子放置组的个数。

ZoneId.description_cn:
存储放置组所属可用区。
存储放置组的可用区必须位于请求的地域内。
ZoneId.description_en:
Storage placement group availability zone
The availability zone of the storage placement group must be within the requested region.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用以保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。ClientToken是一个大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符的字符串。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. This string is generated by your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken is a case-sensitive string of up to 64 ASCII characters.

Description.description_cn: 快照的描述信息，默认为空，长度限制在1 ~ 255字符之间。
Description.description_en: Snapshot description. Default is empty; length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

ProjectName.description_cn:
快照所属项目。
- 快照不会继承云盘的项目，即快照与云盘可以所属不同的项目。

- 如果您在创建快照时未设置ProjectName，快照会默认加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the snapshot belongs.
- Snapshots do not inherit the project of the cloud disk, so snapshots and cloud disks can belong to different projects.

- If you do not set ProjectName when creating a snapshot, the snapshot will be added to the default project by default.

RetentionDays.description_cn:
快照保留时间，单位为天，取值说明如下：

- 空：永久保留快照 。

- 1~65536：指定保存天数。

默认为空，即默认永久保留快照。
快照保留时间从快照创建时刻开始计算。
RetentionDays.description_en:
Snapshot retention period, in days. Value description:

- Empty: retain snapshot permanently.

- 1~65536: specify the number of days to retain.

Default is empty, meaning the snapshot is retained permanently.
The snapshot retention period is calculated from the time the snapshot is created.

SnapshotName.description_cn:
创建的快照名称。命名规范如下：

- 长度限制为1~128个字符。

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号（.）。

- 为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以“auto”开头。
SnapshotName.description_en:
Snapshot name to be created. Naming rules are as follows:

- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

- To avoid conflicts with automatic snapshot names, cannot start with 'auto'.

Source.description_cn: Source
Source.description_en: Source

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
快照的标签键。

- Tags.N.Key：N表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the snapshot.

- Tags.N.Key: N indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–20.

- Use & to separate multiple tag keys.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
快照的标签值。

- Tags.N.Value：N表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value of the snapshot.

- Tags.N.Value: N indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Value range: 1–20.

- Use & to separate multiple tag values.

VolumeId.description_en: Cloud disk ID for the snapshot to be created.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。说明如下：

- 大小写敏感。

- 不超过64个ASCII字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. This string is generated by your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. Details:

- Case sensitive.

- No more than 64 ASCII characters.

Description.description_cn:
快照一致性组的描述，说明如下：

- 只能以中文、字母或下划线（\_）开头。

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号号（.）。

- 长度限制为1 ~ 255个字符。
Description.description_en:
Description of the snapshot consistency group. Details:

- Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_).

- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

- Length must be 1–255 characters.

InstanceId.description_en: ID of the ECS instance to which the cloud disk is attached.

Name.description_cn:
快照一致性组的名称，说明如下：

- 只能以中文、字母或下划线（\_）开头。

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号（.）。

- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。

如果没有设置该参数，则在控制台上快照一致性组的名称默认为-。
Name.description_en:
Name of the snapshot consistency group. Details:

- Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_).

- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

- Length must be 1–128 characters.

If this parameter is not set, the default name for the snapshot consistency group in the console is '-'.

ProjectName.description_cn:
快照一致性组所要加入的项目名称。
如果您在创建快照一致性组时未设置ProjectName，则快照一致性组默认加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en:
Name of the project to which the snapshot consistency group will be added.
If you do not set ProjectName when creating the snapshot consistency group, it will be added to the default project by default.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
快照一致性组的标签键。

- Tags.N.Key：N表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the snapshot consistency group.

- Tags.N.Key: N indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–20.

- Use & to separate multiple tag keys.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
快照一致性组的标签值。

- Tags.N.Value：N表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the snapshot consistency group.

- Tags.N.Value: N indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Value range: 1–20.

- Use & to separate multiple tag values.

VolumeIds.description_cn:
云盘ID，说明如下：

- 该云盘必须处于“已挂载”状态。

- 如果设置多个云盘，则这些云盘需要挂载在同一个ECS实例。
N表示云盘ID的序号，多个云盘ID之间用&分隔，取值范围为1～16。
VolumeIds.description_en:
Cloud disk ID. Details:

- The cloud disk must be in 'attached' status.

- If multiple cloud disks are set, they must be attached to the same ECS instance.
N indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk ID. Use & to separate multiple cloud disk IDs. Value range: 1–16.

VolumeIds.N.description_cn:
云盘ID，说明如下：

- 该云盘必须处于“已挂载”状态。

- 如果设置多个云盘，则这些云盘需要挂载在同一个ECS实例。
N表示云盘ID的序号，多个云盘ID之间用&分隔，取值范围为1～16。
VolumeIds.N.description_en:
Cloud disk ID. Details:

- The cloud disk must be in 'attached' status.

- If multiple cloud disks are set, they must be attached to the same ECS instance.
N indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk ID. Use & to separate multiple cloud disk IDs. Value range: 1–16.

ResourceIds.description_cn:
绑定标签的资源ID。说明如下：

- ResourceIds.N：`N`表示资源的序号，取值范围：1～50。
- 多个资源之间用`&`分隔。
ResourceIds.description_en:
Resource ID to bind the tag to. Details:

- ResourceIds.N: `N` indicates the resource sequence number, range: 1–50.
- Separate multiple resources with `&`.

ResourceIds.N.description_cn:
绑定标签的资源ID。说明如下：

- ResourceIds.N：`N`表示资源的序号，取值范围：1～50。
- 多个资源之间用`&`分隔。
ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID to bind the tag to. Details:

- ResourceIds.N: `N` indicates the resource sequence number, range: 1–50.
- Separate multiple resources with `&`.

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型，取值：

- volume：云盘。

- snapshot：快照。

- snapshotpolicy：自动快照策略。

- snapshotgroup：快照一致性组。
ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. Valid values:

- volume: cloud disk.
- snapshot: snapshot.
- snapshotpolicy: automatic snapshot policy.
- snapshotgroup: snapshot consistency group.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
标签的标签键。

- Tags.N.Key：`N`表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用`&`分隔。

命名规则如下：

- 不能以任何大小写形式的`volc:`或`sys:`开头，`volc:`或`sys:`开头为系统预留标签键，禁止创建。
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和特殊符号`_.:/=+-@`。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the tag.

- Tags.N.Key: `N` indicates the tag key sequence number. Range: 1–20.
- Separate multiple tag keys with `&`.

Naming rules:

- Cannot start with any case of `volc:` or `sys:`. These are reserved system tag keys and cannot be created.
- Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and special characters `_.:/=+-@`.
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
标签的标签值。

- Tags.N.Value：`N`表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用`&`分隔。

命名规则如下：

- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和特殊符号`_.:/=+-@`。
- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value of the tag.

- Tags.N.Value: `N` indicates the tag value sequence number. Range: 1–20.
- Separate multiple tag values with `&`.

Naming rules:

- Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and special characters `_.:/=+-@`.
- Can be empty. Length must be between 0 and 256 characters.

AutoRenew.description_cn: 自动续费状态
AutoRenew.description_en: Auto-Renewal Status

BurstEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启云盘性能突发。
性能突发功能当前处于邀测状态，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
BurstEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable cloud disk performance burst.
The performance burst feature is currently in invite-only testing. To use this feature, please contact your account manager.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用以保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。ClientToken是一个大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符的字符串。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. This string is generated by your client to guarantee uniqueness across requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

DeleteProtection.description_cn: 云盘是否开启删除保护。
DeleteProtection.description_en: Whether to enable delete protection for the cloud disk

DeleteProtectionRetentionDays.description_cn: 删除保护涉及的快照数据默认永久保留，您也可以选择特定的保留时间，范围为 1～65536 天（默认30天），超过设置时间后快照将自动删除。
DeleteProtectionRetentionDays.description_en: Snapshot data involved in delete protection is permanently retained by default. You can also select a specific retention period, ranging from 1 to 65536 days (default is 30 days). After the set period, the snapshot will be automatically deleted.

Description.description_cn: 云盘的描述信息，默认为空，长度限制在1 ~ 255字符之间。
Description.description_en: The cloud disk description is empty by default. If provided, it must be between 1 and 255 characters long.

DryRun.description_cn: 是否仅执行创建云盘请求的预检查。
DryRun.description_en: Whether to perform only a pre-check for the cloud disk creation request.

Encrypted.description_en: Whether the cloud disk is encrypted. Default value is false.

ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
额外IOPS性能大小，单位为次/秒，各个类型的额外性能取值范围如下：

- IOPS型额外性能: 0~50000

- Balance型额外性能: 0~50000
仅当ExtraPerformanceTypeId参数值为Balance或IOPS时，才可以配置ExtraPerformanceIOPS参数。
ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance, measured in operations per second. The value ranges for each type of extra performance are as follows:

- IOPS type extra performance: 0–50000

- Balance type extra performance: 0–50000
You can configure the ExtraPerformanceIOPS parameter only when the ExtraPerformanceTypeId parameter value is Balance or IOPS.

ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
额外吞吐性能大小，单位为MB/s。
- 不同容量的吞吐型SSD云盘，可购买的额外吞吐量不同。
- 仅ExtraPerformanceTypeId参数值为Throughput时，才可以配置ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB参数。
ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra throughput performance, measured in MB/s.
- The extra throughput available for purchase varies depending on the capacity of the throughput SSD cloud disk.
- You can configure the ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB parameter only when the ExtraPerformanceTypeId parameter value is Throughput.

ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
额外性能的类型，不同的云盘，取值不同，说明如下：

- ESSD FlexPL数据盘的额外性能取值如下：

  - Balance：均衡型额外性能。

  - IOPS：IOPS型额外性能。

  - Throughput：吞吐量型额外性能。
关于ESSD FlexPL数据盘额外性能的详细介绍，请参见[云盘额外性能](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767)。


- TSSD_TL0数据盘仅支持取值Throughput，表示为TSSD_TL0云盘配置额外吞吐量，详细介绍，请参见[云盘规格-吞吐型SSD云盘](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1262162)

- 仅500 GiB及以上的ESSD FlexPL数据盘，才支持配置额外性能。

- 仅100 GiB及以上的TSSD\_TL0数据盘，才支持配置额外性能。
ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Type of additional performance. The available values vary by cloud disk type, as follows:

- For ESSD FlexPL data disks, the available values are:

  - Balance: Balanced additional performance

  - IOPS: IOPS additional performance

  - Throughput: Throughput additional performance
For more details about additional performance for ESSD FlexPL data disks, see [Cloud Disk Additional Performance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767).


- For TSSD_TL0 data disks, only Throughput is supported, which configures additional throughput for TSSD_TL0 cloud disks. For more details, see [Cloud Disk Specifications - Throughput SSD Cloud Disk](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1262162)

- Only ESSD FlexPL data disks of 500 GiB or larger support additional performance configuration.

- Only TSSD_TL0 data disks of 100 GiB or larger support additional performance configuration.

InstanceId.description_cn:
创建云盘的同时挂载的ECS实例ID。
创建包年包月云盘时，该参数为必选参数，且挂载的ECS实例必须为包年包月实例。

- To create multiple automatic snapshots in a week, you can specify multiple days, up to 7 days.

- 长度限制为1~128字符。
Name.description_en:
Storage placement group name requirements:

- The first character must be a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
- Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

EffectiveAt.description_cn: 预留存储容量包的生效时间，日期格式遵循ISO 8601标准格式。默认为空，即立即生效。如果指定的生效时间非整点时，则在指定时间的整点生效，例如指定时间为2024-11-25 21:50:05，则实际生效时间为2024-11-25 21:00:00。
EffectiveAt.description_en: The activation time of the reserved storage capacity package. The date format follows the ISO 8601 standard. The default is empty, which means it takes effect immediately. If the specified activation time is not at the beginning of the hour, it will take effect at the beginning of the specified hour. For example, if the specified time is 2024-11-25 21:50:05, the actual activation time will be 2024-11-25 21:00:00.

Description.description_cn: 快照描述信息，长度为0~255个字符。
Description.description_en: Snapshot description. Length must be 0–255 characters

RetentionDays.description_cn: 延长快照保留时间。快照保留时间仅支持延长，不支持缩短。取值范围为N+1~65536，N为快照创建时设置的保留时间。
RetentionDays.description_en: Extend the snapshot retention period. Retention period can only be extended, not shortened. Valid range is N+1 to 65536, where N is the retention period set when the snapshot was created.

SnapshotId.description_en: ID of the snapshot to be modified

SnapshotName.description_cn:
快照名称，命名规范如下：

- 长度为1~128个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号（.）。
- 为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以“auto”开头。
SnapshotName.description_en:
Snapshot name. Naming rules are as follows:

- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- To avoid conflicts with automatic snapshot names, do not start with "auto"

Description.description_cn:
快照一致性组描述，说明如下：

- 只能以中文、字母或下划线（\_）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号号（.）。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 255个字符。
Description.description_en:
Snapshot consistency group description. Details:

- Can only start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_).
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).
- Length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

Name.description_cn:
快照一致性组名称，说明如下：

- 只能以中文、字母或下划线（\_）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号（.）。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
Name.description_en:
Snapshot consistency group name. Details:

- Can only start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_).
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

BurstEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启云盘性能突发。
性能突发功能当前处于邀测状态，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
BurstEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable cloud disk burst performance.
The burst performance feature is currently in invite-only testing. To use this feature, please contact your account manager.

DeleteProtection.description_cn: 是否开启云盘删除保护。
DeleteProtection.description_en: Whether to enable cloud disk deletion protection.

DeleteProtectionRetentionDays.description_cn: 删除保护涉及的快照数据默认永久保留，您也可以选择特定的保留时间，范围为 1～65536 天（默认30天），超过设置时间后快照将自动删除。
DeleteProtectionRetentionDays.description_en: Snapshot data involved in deletion protection is retained permanently by default. You can also specify a retention period, ranging from 1 to 65,536 days (default: 30 days). After the set period, the snapshot will be deleted automatically.

DeleteWithInstance.description_cn:
释放实例时，该云盘是否随实例一起释放，说明如下：
- true：随实例一起释放。
- false：不随实例一起释放。
DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
When releasing the instance, should this cloud disk be released along with the instance? Details:
- true: Released with the instance.
- false: Not released with the instance.

Description.description_cn: 云盘描述信息。
Description.description_en: Cloud Drive Description

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name Associated with Cloud Drive

AutoPay.description_cn:
是否自动支付。取值说明如下：

- true（默认）：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足，如果账户余额不足会生成异常订单，只能作废订单。
- false：只生成订单不扣费。如果您的账户余额不足，会生成正常的未支付订单，此订单可登录ECS控制台支付。
AutoPay.description_en:
Auto-payment option. Value description:

- true (default): Auto-payment enabled. You need to make sure your account balance is sufficient. If your account balance is insufficient, the system generates an exception order, which you can only cancel.
- false: Only creates an order without charging. If your account balance is insufficient, the system generates a normal unpaid order. You can pay for this order in the ECS console.

DiskChargeType.description_cn:
云盘计费方式。取值说明如下：

- PrePaid：按量计费数据盘转换为包年包月数据盘。
- PostPaid：包年包月数据盘转换为按量计费数据盘。
DiskChargeType.description_en:
Cloud disk billing mode. Value description:

- PrePaid: Converts a pay-as-you-go data disk to a subscription data disk.
- PostPaid: Converts a subscription data disk to a pay-as-you-go data disk.

InstanceId.description_cn:
云盘挂载的实例ID。
只有挂载在包年包月实例上的按量计费数据盘才能转换为包年包月。
InstanceId.description_en:
ID of the instance to which the cloud disk is attached.
You can convert only pay-as-you-go data disks attached to subscription instances to subscription.

VolumeIds.description_cn:
待转换计费方式的云盘ID列表。
支持批量转换，只有挂载在同一包年包月实例上的数据盘才能批量转换。
VolumeIds.description_en:
List of cloud disk IDs to be converted to a different billing mode.
You can convert data disks in batch. You can convert only data disks attached to the same subscription instance in batch.

VolumeIds.N.description_cn:
待转换计费方式的云盘ID列表。
支持批量转换，只有挂载在同一包年包月实例上的数据盘才能批量转换。
VolumeIds.N.description_en:
List of cloud disk IDs to be converted to a different billing mode.
You can convert data disks in batch. You can convert only data disks attached to the same subscription instance in batch.

ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
额外IOPS性能大小，单位为次/秒，各个类型的额外性能取值范围如下：

- IOPS型额外性能: 0~50000
- Balance型额外性能: 0~50000
ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance size, measured in operations per second. The value ranges for each type of extra performance are:

- IOPS-type extra performance: 0~50000.
- Balance-type extra performance: 0~50000.

ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
额外吞吐性能大小，单位为MB/s。
- ESSD FlexPL数据盘的额外吞吐性能的取值范围为0~650。
- 不同容量的吞吐型SSD云盘，可购买的额外吞吐量不同。
ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra throughput performance size, measured in MB/s.
- The value range for extra throughput performance of ESSD FlexPL data disks is 0~650.
- The purchasable extra throughput varies depending on the capacity of the throughput-type SSD disk.

ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
额外性能的类型，不同的云盘，取值不同，说明如下：
- ESSD FlexPL数据盘的额外性能取值如下：	
	- Balance：均衡型额外性能。
	- IOPS：IOPS型额外性能。
	- Throughput：吞吐量型额外性能。
    关于ESSD FlexPL数据盘额外性能的详细介绍，请参见[云盘额外性能](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767)。
   
	
- TSSD_TL0云盘仅支持取值`Throughput`，表示为TSSD_TL0云盘配置额外吞吐量，详细介绍，请参见[云盘规格-吞吐型SSD云盘](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1262162)
ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Type of extra performance. The available values differ for each disk type, as follows:
- For ESSD FlexPL data disks, the extra performance values are:
	- Balance: Balanced extra performance.
	- IOPS: IOPS-type extra performance.
	- Throughput: Throughput-type extra performance.
    For detailed information about extra performance for ESSD FlexPL data disks, see [Cloud Disk Extra Performance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767).
   

- TSSD_TL0 disks only support the value `Throughput`, which means configuring extra throughput for TSSD_TL0 disks. For details, see [Cloud Disk Specifications - Throughput-type SSD Disk](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1262162).

VolumeId.description_cn: 待创建或修改额外性能包的所属云盘ID。
VolumeId.description_en: ID of the cloud disk to which the extra performance package to be created or modified belongs

TargetVolumeType.description_cn: 变更后的云盘规格，当前仅支持将ESSD_PL0云盘变更为ESSD_FlexPL云盘，取值为ESSD_FlexPL。
TargetVolumeType.description_en: Changed cloud disk specification. Currently, only ESSD_PL0 disks can be changed to ESSD_FlexPL disks. The value is ESSD_FlexPL.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensures request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness across different requests, preventing repeated operations caused by multiple retries when API calls time out or server internal errors occur.
Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.

EffectiveAt.description_cn: 预留存储容量包的生效时间，日期格式遵循ISO 8601标准格式。默认为空，即立即生效。如果指定的生效时间非整点时，则在指定时间的整点生效，例如指定时间为2024-11-25 21:50:05，则实际生效时间为2024-11-25 21:00:00。
EffectiveAt.description_en: Effective time of the reserved storage capacity package. The date format follows the ISO 8601 standard. The default is empty, which means it takes effect immediately. If the specified effective time is not on the hour, it will take effect at the beginning of the specified hour. For example, if the specified time is 2024-11-25 21:50:05, the actual effective time will be 2024-11-25 21:00:00.

Period.description_cn: 预留存储容量包的购买月数，取值范围为1~36。
Period.description_en: Number of months purchased for the reserved storage capacity package. The value range is 1–36.

PeriodUnit.description_cn: 预留存储容量包的购买时长单位，仅支持取值为monthly，表示购买时长以月为单位。
PeriodUnit.description_en: Unit for the purchase duration of the reserved storage capacity package. Only 'monthly' is supported, which means the purchase duration is measured in months.

ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project to which the RSC belongs.

ReservedCapacity.description_cn:
预留存储容量包的容量，单位为GiB/小时。
关于预留存储容量包的抵扣规则详细介绍，请参见[预留存储容量包](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/195378)。
ReservedCapacity.description_en:
Capacity of the reserved storage capacity package, measured in GiB/hour.
For detailed information about the deduction rules for reserved storage capacity packages, see [Reserved Storage Capacity Package](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/195378).

ReservedStorageCapacityName.description_cn: 预留存储容量包的名称。
ReservedStorageCapacityName.description_en: Name of the reserved storage capacity package.

VolumeType.description_cn:
预留存储容量包预留的云盘规格，取值说明如下：

- ESSD_PL0：极速型SSD云盘，PL0规格
- ESSD_FlexPL: 极速型SSD云盘，FlexPL规格
VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type reserved by the reserved storage capacity package. Value description:

- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, PL0 type
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, FlexPL type

ZoneId.description_cn:
预留存储容量包所在的可用区。
预留存储容量包所在地域默认为请求的Region，即Header中的Region。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone where the reserved storage capacity package is located.
The region of the reserved storage capacity package defaults to the requested Region, that is, the Region in the Header.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。说明如下：
- 大小写敏感。
- 不超过64个ASCII字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. This string is generated by your client to guarantee uniqueness between different requests. Notes:\n- Case sensitive.\n- No more than 64 ASCII characters.

InstanceId.description_cn: 快照一致性组所属的ECS实例ID。
InstanceId.description_en: ID of the ECS instance to which the snapshot consistency group belongs.

SnapshotIds.description_cn:
待回滚的快照一致性组快照列表。
N表示快照序号，多个快照用&分隔。
SnapshotIds.description_en:
List of snapshots in the snapshot consistency group to be rolled back.

N indicates the snapshot number. Use & to separate multiple snapshots.

SnapshotIds.N.description_cn:
待回滚的快照一致性组快照列表。
N表示快照序号，多个快照用&分隔。
SnapshotIds.N.description_en:
List of snapshots in the snapshot consistency group to be rolled back.

N indicates the snapshot number. Use & to separate multiple snapshots.

VolumeIds.description_cn:
待回滚的快照一致性组云盘列表。
N表示快照一致性组云盘的序号，多个快照一致性组云盘用&分隔。
VolumeIds.description_en:
List of cloud disks in the snapshot consistency group to be rolled back.

N indicates the number of the cloud disk in the snapshot consistency group. Use & to separate multiple cloud disks in the snapshot consistency group.

VolumeIds.N.description_cn:
待回滚的快照一致性组云盘列表。
N表示快照一致性组云盘的序号，多个快照一致性组云盘用&分隔。
VolumeIds.N.description_en:
List of cloud disks in the snapshot consistency group to be rolled back.

N indicates the number of the cloud disk in the snapshot consistency group. Use & to separate multiple cloud disks in the snapshot consistency group.

VolumeId.description_en: The ID of the cloud disk to be rolled back.

DurationSeconds.description_cn: 临时密钥有效时长（单位：秒），最短支持900，最长支持43200。若未传入该值或传入的值小于900，则默认按3600执行，若传入的值大于43200，则默认按43200执行。
DurationSeconds.description_en: Temporary key validity period (in seconds). Minimum supported value is 900, maximum is 43200. If this value is not provided or is less than 900, the default is 3600; if it is greater than 43200, the default is 43200.

Policy.description_cn: 角色内联策略，用于进一步限制临时凭证的权限。如果内联权限策略不为空，则临时凭证的实际权限为所扮演角色的权限策略与内联权限策略的交集。策略语法格式同普通的IAM策略，可参考[策略语法介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059)。
Policy.description_en: Role inline policy is used to further restrict the permissions of temporary credentials. If the inline permission policy is not empty, the actual permissions of the temporary credentials are the intersection of the role's permission policy and the inline permission policy. The policy syntax follows the standard IAM policy format; see [Policy Syntax Introduction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059) for details.

RoleSessionName.description_cn: 角色会话名称，长度2-64字符，支持英文、数字和.-\_@符号。对于同一个角色，在每次扮演时可以指定不同的会话名称，从而达到区分会话的目的。该字段也会在[云审计](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/7015/166040)中体现，方便从审计日志中区分不同会话的访问记录。
RoleSessionName.description_en: Role session name, 2–64 characters long; supports English letters, numbers, and .-_@ symbols. For the same role, you can specify a different session name each time you assume the role to distinguish between sessions. This field also appears in [Cloud Audit](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/7015/166040), making it easy to identify access records for different sessions in audit logs.

RoleTrn.description_cn: 需要扮演的角色Trn，格式为`trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`。其中`${AccountId}`需要填入角色所属的主账号ID，`${RoleName}`需要填入实际的角色名称。例如账号ID为2000012345的账号内角色名为myRole的角色对应的RoleTrn为`trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`
RoleTrn.description_en: Required RoleTrn format: `trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`. Enter the main account ID for `${AccountId}` and the actual role name for `${RoleName}`. For example, if the account ID is 2000012345 and the role name is myRole, the corresponding RoleTrn is `trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`

Tags.N.Key.description_cn: 标签键。至多附加50对标签。使用UTF-8编码的Unicode，长度为1~128字符，允许任何语言文字、数字、空格和_ . : / = + - @符号。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Label key
Up to 50 label pairs can be added
Use UTF-8 encoded Unicode
Length: 1–128 characters
Allows any language characters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols: _ . : / = + - @

Tags.N.Value.description_cn: 标签值。至多附加50对标签。使用UTF-8编码的Unicode，长度为0~256字符（即Value可以为空），允许任何语言文字、数字、空格和_ . : / = + - @符号。
Tags.N.Value.description_en: Tag value. Up to 50 tag pairs can be added. Use UTF-8 encoded Unicode, with a length of 0–256 characters (the value can be empty). Any language characters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: _ . : / = + - @

DurationSeconds.description_cn: 临时密钥有效时长（单位：秒），最短可设为900秒，最长可设为角色最大会话时长值（在角色信息中配置），默认值为3600秒。
DurationSeconds.description_en: The validity period of the temporary key (in seconds) can be set to a minimum of 900 seconds and a maximum equal to the role's maximum session duration (configured in role information). The default value is 3600 seconds.

OIDCToken.description_cn: 由外部 IdP 签发的 OIDC 令牌（OIDC Token）。长度：4~65536 个字符。
OIDCToken.description_en: OIDC token issued by an external IdP. Length: 4 to 65536 characters.

Policy.description_cn: 角色内联策略，用于进一步限制临时凭证的权限。长度不超过2048字符。如果内联权限策略不为空，则临时凭证的实际权限为所扮演角色的权限策略与内联权限策略的交集。策略语法格式同普通的IAM策略，可参考[策略语法介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059)。
Policy.description_en: Role inline policy, used to further restrict the permissions of temporary credentials. Maximum length is 2048 characters. If the inline permission policy is not empty, the actual permissions of the temporary credentials are the intersection of the assumed role's permission policy and the inline permission policy. The policy syntax is the same as a standard IAM policy. For details, see [Policy Syntax Introduction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059).

RoleSessionName.description_cn: 角色会话名称，长度2-64字符，支持英文、数字和.-\_@符号。对于同一个角色，在每次扮演时可以指定不同的会话名称，从而达到区分会话的目的。该字段也会在[云审计](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/7015/166040)中体现，方便从审计日志中区分不同会话的访问记录。
RoleSessionName.description_en: Role session name, 2–64 characters in length, supports English letters, numbers, and .-_@ symbols. For the same role, you can specify a different session name each time you assume it to distinguish between sessions. This field also appears in [Cloud Audit](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/7015/166040), making it easier to identify access records for different sessions in audit logs.

RoleTrn.description_cn: 需要扮演的角色Trn，格式为`trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`。其中`${AccountId}`需要填入角色所属的主账号ID，`${RoleName}`需要填入实际的角色名称。例如账号ID为2000012345的账号内角色名为myRole的角色对应的RoleTrn为`trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`
RoleTrn.description_en: The Trn of the role to be assumed should be in the format `trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`. Here, `${AccountId}` should be filled in with the primary account ID to which the role belongs, and `${RoleName}` should be filled in with the actual role name. For example, if the account ID is 2000012345 and the role name is myRole, the corresponding RoleTrn would be `trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`

DurationSeconds.description_cn: 临时密钥有效时长（单位：秒），最短可设为900秒，最长可设为角色最大会话时长值（在角色信息中配置），默认值为3600秒。
DurationSeconds.description_en: Temporary key validity period (in seconds). Minimum: 900 seconds; maximum: the role's maximum session duration (configured in role information). Default: 3600 seconds.

Policy.description_cn: 角色内联策略，用于进一步限制临时凭证的权限。长度不超过2048字符。如果内联权限策略不为空，则临时凭证的实际权限为所扮演角色的权限策略与内联权限策略的交集。策略语法格式同普通的IAM策略，可参考[策略语法介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059)。
Policy.description_en: Role inline policy, used to further restrict the permissions of temporary credentials. Maximum length is 2048 characters. If the inline permission policy is not empty, the actual permissions of the temporary credentials are the intersection of the role's permission policy and the inline permission policy. The policy syntax follows the standard IAM policy format; see [Policy Syntax Introduction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059) for details.

RoleTrn.description_cn: 需要扮演的角色Trn，格式为`trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`。其中`${AccountId}`需要填入角色所属的主账号ID，`${RoleName}`需要填入实际的角色名称。例如账号ID为2000012345的账号内角色名为myRole的角色对应的RoleTrn为`trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`

- 该参数值由客户端自动生成，确保不同请求的取值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
- 取值仅支持ASCII字符，最大不超过64个字符。
- 未指定该参数值时，不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency
- The client automatically generates this value to guarantee uniqueness for each request and prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or a server error occurs and the client retries
- The value supports only ASCII characters and must not exceed 64 characters in length
- If this parameter is not specified, idempotency is not validated

GroupIpAddress.description_en: Multicast group IP address. Valid range: 224.0.1.0–239.255.255.254

TransitRouterMulticastDomainId.description_cn: 组播域的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterMulticastDomains](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1544105)接口获取带宽包ID。
TransitRouterMulticastDomainId.description_en: Multicast domain ID. Call the [DescribeTransitRouterMulticastDomains](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1544105) API to get the bandwidth package ID.

AssociatedRouteTableId.description_cn:
Only for console. 
 The route table to associate with current attachment on local transit router.
AssociatedRouteTableId.description_en:
Only for console
Route table to associate with current attachment on local transit router

Bandwidth.description_cn:
跨地域连接的带宽，单位为Mbps。
带宽最大值不能超过指定中转路由器带宽包剩余未分配的带宽上限。
Bandwidth.description_en:
Bandwidth for cross-region connections, measured in Mbps
The maximum bandwidth cannot exceed the upper limit of the remaining unallocated bandwidth in the specified transit router bandwidth package

BandwidthType.description_cn:
跨地域连接的带宽分配方式。

* BandwidthPackage（默认值）：从带宽包分配。
* CloudDataTransfer：通过云数据传输服务按流量计费。
BandwidthType.description_en:
Bandwidth allocation method for cross-region connections.

* BandwidthPackage (default): Allocated from the bandwidth package
* CloudDataTransfer: Billed by traffic via the cloud data transfer service

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

* 该参数值由客户端自动生成，确保不同请求的取值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 取值仅支持ASCII字符，最大不超过64个字符。
* 未指定该参数值时，不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency

* This parameter is automatically generated by the client to ensure each request is unique and to prevent duplicate operations when the API times out or a server error occurs and the client retries multiple times
* Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters
* If this parameter is not specified, idempotency is not checked

Description.description_cn:
跨地域连接描述。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Cross-region connection description

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is entered, the default is an empty string
Description.example_cn: This peer attachment is used for test.
Description.example_en: This peer attachment is for testing

LineOperator.description_cn:
跨境带宽包线路的运营商。跨境互通时，该参数

* ChinaUnicom：中国联通。
* ChinaTelecom：中国电信。
LineOperator.description_en:
Carrier for the cross-border bandwidth package line. When establishing cross-border connectivity, use this parameter.

* ChinaUnicom: China Unicom
* ChinaTelecom: China Telecom

PeerTransitRouterAssociatedRouteTableId.description_cn:
Only for console. 
 The route table to associate with current attachment on peer transit router.
PeerTransitRouterAssociatedRouteTableId.description_en:
Console only
Route table to associate with the current attachment on the peer transit router

PeerTransitRouterId.description_cn: 对端中转路由器实例的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取中转路由器实例的ID。
PeerTransitRouterId.description_en: ID of the peer transit router instance. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to get the transit router instance ID.

PeerTransitRouterOwnerId.description_cn: 对端中转路由器实例所属账号的ID。
PeerTransitRouterOwnerId.description_en: ID of the account that owns the remote transit router instance

PeerTransitRouterPropagatedRouteTableId.description_cn:
Only for console. 
 The route table to propagated with current attachment on peer transit router.
PeerTransitRouterPropagatedRouteTableId.description_en: Only for console The route table will be propagated with the current attachment on the peer transit router

PeerTransitRouterRegionId.description_cn: 对端中转路由器实例所属地域的ID。您可以参考[地域介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155971)获取地域ID。
PeerTransitRouterRegionId.description_en: ID of the region to which the peer transit router instance belongs. You can refer to the [Region overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155971) to obtain the region ID.

PropagatedRouteTableId.description_cn:
Only for console. 
 The route table to propagated with current attachment on local transit router.
PropagatedRouteTableId.description_en:
Console only
The route table is propagated with the current attachment on the local transit router

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
跨地域连接用户标签的标签键。

* 长度限制为1～128个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
* 不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

* 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for cross-region connection user tags

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Allowed characters: letters, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @

* Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is entered, the default is empty

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
跨地域连接用户标签的标签值。

* 长度限制为0～255个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags in cross-region connections

* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* Case sensitive; cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @ are allowed

If this parameter is provided, you must first specify Tags.N.Key.

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_cn:
跨地域连接的名称。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为中转路由器实例的ID。
TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_en:
Name of the cross-region connection

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character; can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is provided, the default is the transit router instance ID

TransitRouterBandwidthPackageId.description_cn:
中转路由器带宽包的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取中转路由器实例的ID。
传入该参数时必须传入参数`Bandwidth`，未传入该参数时无需传入参数`Bandwidth`。
TransitRouterBandwidthPackageId.description_en: Transit router bandwidth package ID. To obtain the transit router instance ID, call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API. If you provide this parameter, you must also provide the Bandwidth parameter. If you do not provide this parameter, you do not need to provide the Bandwidth parameter.

TransitRouterId.description_cn: 本端中转路由器实例的ID。
TransitRouterId.description_en: Local Transit Router Instance ID

Description.description_cn:
TR路由表路由条目的描述信息。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Description for the TR route table route entry.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length limit: 0–255 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.
Description.example_cn: This transit router is used for test.
Description.example_en: This transit router is used for testing

DestinationCidrBlock.description_cn:
路由条目的目标网段。
该参数与`DestinationPrefixListId`不可同时传入。
DestinationCidrBlock.description_en:
Destination CIDR block of the route entry.
This parameter cannot be used together with `DestinationPrefixListId`.

DestinationPrefixListId.description_cn:
路由条目的目标前缀列表 ID，用于指定路由条目的目标地址范围。
该参数与`DestinationCidrBlock`不可同时传入。
中转路由器支持VPC前缀列表的功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
DestinationPrefixListId.description_en:
Route entry target prefix list ID, used to specify the target address range for the route entry.
This parameter cannot be used together with `DestinationCidrBlock`.
Transit router support for VPC prefix lists is currently available by invitation. To use this feature, please contact your account manager.

TransitRouterRouteEntryName.description_cn:
TR路由表路由条目的名称。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文及以下特殊字符：点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为TR路由条目的ID。
TransitRouterRouteEntryName.description_en:
Name of the TR route table route entry.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* Length limit: 1–128 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is the TR route entry ID.

TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopId.description_cn:
路由条目的下一跳ID。

* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304)接口获取VPC类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308)接口获取VPN类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992)接口获取专线网关类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781)接口获取跨地域连接的ID。
TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopId.description_en:
Next hop ID of the route entry.

* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304) API to obtain the ID of a VPC-type network instance connection.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308) API to obtain the ID of a VPN-type network instance connection.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway-type network instance connection.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region connection.

TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopType.description_cn:
路由条目的下一跳类型。取值如下：

* Attachment：网络实例，表示匹配该路由条目的流量会被转发到指定的网络实例。
* BlackHole：黑洞，表示匹配该路由条目的流量会被丢弃。
TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopType.description_en:
Next hop type of the route entry. Valid values:

* Attachment: Network instance. Traffic matching this route entry will be forwarded to the specified network instance.
* BlackHole: Black hole. Traffic matching this route entry will be dropped.

TransitRouterRouteTableId.description_cn: 中转路由器实例关联的路由表的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312)接口获取TR路由表的ID。
TransitRouterRouteTableId.description_en: The ID of the route table associated with the transit router instance. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312) API to get the TR route table ID.

ActionResult.description_cn:
路由策略条目的策略行为。取值如下：

* Permit：允许。指允许匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
* Deny：拒绝。指拒绝匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
ActionResult.description_en:
Policy action of a routing policy entry. Possible values:

* Permit: Allow. Allows routes matching this routing policy entry to pass.
* Deny: Prevents routes matching this routing policy entry from passing.

ApplyAsPathValues.description_cn:
路由策略条目设置的路由AsPath。取值范围为1～4294967295。

* N：表示路由属性的序号，取值范围1～10。
* 多个路由属性之间使用&分隔。

`ActionResult`取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
ApplyAsPathValues.description_en:
Route AsPath set for the route policy entry. Value range: 1–4294967295.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the route attribute, ranging from 1 to 10.
* Use & to separate multiple route attributes.

This parameter takes effect when `ActionResult` is set to "Permit".

ApplyAsPathValues.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目设置的路由AsPath。取值范围为1～4294967295。

* N：表示路由属性的序号，取值范围1～10。
* 多个路由属性之间使用&分隔。

`ActionResult`取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
ApplyAsPathValues.N.description_en:
Route AsPath set for the route policy entry. Value range: 1–4294967295.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the route attribute, ranging from 1 to 10.
* Use & to separate multiple route attributes.

This parameter takes effect when `ActionResult` is set to "Permit".

AsPathOperateMode.description_cn:
路由策略条目的AsPath设置方式。取值如下：

* Additive：追加AsPath。指在允许通过的路由的AsPath最前面追加指定的AsPath。
* Replace：替换AsPath。指使用指定的AsPath替换允许通过的路由的AsPath。

`ActionResult`取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
AsPathOperateMode.description_en:
AsPath setting method for routing policy entries. The available values are:

* Additive: Appends an AsPath. Adds the specified AsPath to the beginning of the AsPath of permitted routes.
* Replace: Replaces the AsPath. Uses the specified AsPath to replace the AsPath of permitted routes.

This parameter takes effect only when `ActionResult` is set to "Permit".

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

* 该参数值由客户端自动生成，确保不同请求的取值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 取值仅支持ASCII字符，最大不超过64个字符。
* 未指定该参数值时，不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token used to ensure request idempotency.

* This parameter is automatically generated by the client to ensure uniqueness across requests, preventing duplicate operations caused by repeated retries when API calls time out or server errors occur.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters.
* If this parameter is not specified, idempotency verification is not performed.

Description.description_cn:
路由策略条目的描述信息。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Description for the route policy entry.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.
Description.example_cn: This transit router is used for test.
Description.example_en: This transit router is used for testing

DestinationResourceIds.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例ID。

* 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口获取专线网关实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取跨地域TR实例的ID。

* N：表示目的实例ID的序号，取值范围1～10。多个目的实例ID之间使用&分隔。
* 参数`DestinationResourceIds.N`传入数值后，该参数为必填。
* 指定的路由策略的作用方向为“In”时，不允许传入该字段。
DestinationResourceIds.description_en:
Destination instance ID of the routing policy entry.

* You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to obtain the ID of a VPC instance.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway instance.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region TR instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the destination instance ID, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple destination instance IDs.
* After a value is provided for the parameter `DestinationResourceIds.N`, this parameter is required.
* When the routing policy direction is set to "In", this field must not be specified.

DestinationResourceIds.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例ID。

* 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口获取专线网关实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取跨地域TR实例的ID。

* N：表示目的实例ID的序号，取值范围1～10。多个目的实例ID之间使用&分隔。
* 参数`DestinationResourceIds.N`传入数值后，该参数为必填。
* 指定的路由策略的作用方向为“In”时，不允许传入该字段。
DestinationResourceIds.N.description_en:
Destination instance ID of the routing policy entry.

* You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to obtain the ID of a VPC instance.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway instance.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region TR instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the destination instance ID, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple destination instance IDs.
* After a value is provided for the parameter `DestinationResourceIds.N`, this parameter is required.
* When the routing policy direction is set to "In", this field must not be specified.

DestinationResourceTypes.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例类型。取值如下：

* 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口获取专线网关实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取跨地域TR实例的ID。

* N：表示源实例ID的序号，取值范围1～10。多个源实例ID之间使用&分隔。
* 参数`SourceResourceTypes.N`传入数值后，该参数为必填。
DestinationResourceTypes.description_en:
Destination instance type for the route policy entry. The values are as follows:

* You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to obtain the ID of a VPC instance.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway instance.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region TR instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the source instance ID, ranging from 1 to 10. Use & to separate multiple source instance IDs.
* After specifying the value for the parameter `SourceResourceTypes.N`, this parameter becomes required.

DestinationResourceTypes.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例类型。取值如下：

* 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口获取专线网关实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取跨地域TR实例的ID。

* N：表示源实例ID的序号，取值范围1～10。多个源实例ID之间使用&分隔。
* 参数`SourceResourceTypes.N`传入数值后，该参数为必填。
DestinationResourceTypes.N.description_en:
Destination instance type for the route policy entry. The values are as follows:

* You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to obtain the ID of a VPC instance.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway instance.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region TR instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the source instance ID, ranging from 1 to 10. Use & to separate multiple source instance IDs.
* After specifying the value for the parameter `SourceResourceTypes.N`, this parameter becomes required.

IpPrefixMatchMode.description_cn:
路由前缀的匹配模式。

* Include：模糊匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀包含被匹配路由的路由前缀即判定为匹配成功。例如：路由前缀为10.10.0.0/16 的策略条目可以模糊匹配到目标网段为10.10.1.0/24的路由。
* Complete（默认值）：精确匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀必须与被匹配路由的路由前缀一致，才判定为匹配成功。例如：路由前缀为10.10.0.0/16 的策略条目仅可以精确匹配到目标网段为10.10.0.0/16的路由。
IpPrefixMatchMode.description_en:
Route prefix matching modes

* Include: Fuzzy matching. A match is successful if the route prefix in the matching condition includes the route prefix of the route being matched. For example, a policy entry with the route prefix 10.10.0.0/16 can match a route whose target subnet is 10.10.1.0/24 using fuzzy matching.
* Complete (default): Exact matching. A match is successful only if the route prefix in the matching condition is identical to the route prefix of the route being matched. For example, a policy entry with the route prefix 10.10.0.0/16 can only match a route whose target subnet is 10.10.0.0/16 exactly.

IpPrefixes.description_cn:
路由策略条目的路由前缀。支持传入IPv4和IPv6网段。

* N：表示路由前缀的序号，取值范围1～200。多个路由前缀之间使用&分隔。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。

中转路由器IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the route prefix, ranging from 1 to 200. Use & to separate multiple route prefixes.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.

The IPv6 feature for transit routers is currently in beta testing. To use this feature, please contact your account manager.

Priority.description_en: Priority of the routing policy entry. Default is blank. Valid range: 1 to 10,000. Lower numbers have higher priority. Routing policy entries within the same policy cannot have duplicate priorities.

ClientToken.description_cn:

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency
- The client automatically generates this value to ensure each request has a unique value and prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs
- Only ASCII characters are supported, up to 64 characters
- If this parameter is not specified, idempotency is not checked

Description.description_cn:
路由策略的描述信息。
- 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
- 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
- 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Routing policy description
- Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. You can use letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
- If this parameter is not provided or no value is provided, the default is an empty string
Description.example_cn: 迁移业务添加ASPath的路由策略
Description.example_en: ASPath Addition Routing Policy for Migration

Direction.description_cn:
路由策略的作用方向。取值如下：
- In：收方向。指中转路由器从网络实例学习路由时，只接收符合路由策略的路由。
- Out：发方向。指中转路由器向网络实例同步路由时，只发送符合路由策略的路由。
Direction.description_en:
Routing policy direction. Available values:
- Inbound direction: The transit router only accepts routes that match the routing policy when learning routes from a network instance
- Outbound direction: The transit router only sends routes that match the routing policy when synchronizing routes to a network instance

TransitRouterId.description_cn: 中转路由器实例的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取中转路由器实例ID。
TransitRouterId.description_en: Transit router instance ID. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to get the transit router instance ID

TransitRouterRoutePolicyTableName.description_en:
Routing policy name

- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- If this parameter is not provided or left empty, the routing policy ID is used by default

Description.description_cn:

Description.description_en:
Description for the TR route table

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character; can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space, equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string
Description.example_cn: This route table is used for test.
Description.example_en: This route table is for testing

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
TR路由表用户标签的标签键。

* 长度限制为1～128个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
* 不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

* 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for TR route table user tags

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case-sensitive; cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Allowed characters: letters, numbers, space, underscore (_), period (.), colon (:), slash (/), equals sign (=), plus (+), minus (-), and @

* Tag keys for the same resource must be unique
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is empty

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
TR路由表用户标签的标签值。

* 长度限制为0～255个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for TR route table user tags

* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
* Case-sensitive; cannot start or end with a space
* Allowed characters: letters, numbers, space, underscore (_), period (.), colon (:), slash (/), equals sign (=), plus (+), minus (-), and @

If this parameter is provided, Tags.N.Key must be specified first

TransitRouterId.description_cn: 中转路由器实例的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取中转路由器实例ID。
TransitRouterId.description_en: Transit router instance ID. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the transit router instance ID.

TransitRouterRouteTableName.description_cn:
TR路由表的名称。

* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为TR路由表的ID。

* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is the TR route table ID

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

- 取值仅支持ASCII字符，最大不超过64个字符。

Description.description_cn:
标记规则的描述信息。

- 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
- 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Marking rule description
- Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
- If this parameter is not provided or no value is entered, the default is an empty string
Description.example_cn: This traffic qos marking entry is used for test.
Description.example_en: This traffic QoS marking entry is for testing

DestinationCidrBlock.description_cn:
目的地址的IP网段，支持IPv4和IPv6。
- `Protocol` 传入tcp、udp、gre或all时，该参数可传入IPv4网段或IPv6网段。
- `Protocol` 传入icmp时，该参数仅支持传入IPv4网段。
- `Protocol` 传入icmpv6时，该参数仅支持传入IPv6网段。
- 该参数传入的IP网段类型应与`SourceCidrBlock`保持一致，均为IPv4网段或均为IPv6网段。
DestinationCidrBlock.description_en:
Destination IP address range: supports IPv4 and IPv6
- When `Protocol` is set to tcp, udp, gre, or all, this parameter accepts either IPv4 or IPv6 address ranges
- When `Protocol` is set to icmp, only IPv4 address ranges are supported
- When `Protocol` is set to icmpv6, only IPv6 address ranges are supported
- The type of IP address range entered for this parameter must match the type used for `SourceCidrBlock`; both must be IPv4 or both must be IPv6

DestinationPortEnd.description_cn:
目的端口范围的结束值。取值范围为-1，1～65535。
- \-1表示不限制端口。
- `Protocol` 传入icmp、icmpv6、gre或all时，仅支持传入-1。
DestinationPortEnd.description_en:
End value of the destination port range. Valid values: -1, 1–65535
- -1 means no port restriction
- When `Protocol` is set to icmp, icmpv6, gre, or all, only -1 is supported

DestinationPortStart.description_cn:
目的端口范围的起始值。取值范围为-1，1～65535。
- \-1表示不限制端口。
- `Protocol` 传入icmp、icmpv6、gre或all时，仅支持传入-1。
DestinationPortStart.description_en:
Start value for the destination port range. Valid values: -1, 1–65535
- -1 means no port restriction
- When `Protocol` is set to `icmp`, `icmpv6`, `gre`, or `all`, only -1 is supported

MatchDscp.description_cn:
流量报文本身的DSCP值。取值范围为-1，0～63。
默认值为-1，表示流量报文的DSCP值为任意值均匹配该标记规则。
MatchDscp.description_en:
DSCP value of the traffic packet. Range: -1, 0–63
Default value is -1, which means the DSCP value of the traffic packet can be any value to match this marking rule

Priority.description_cn:
标记规则的优先级，取值范围为 1～10000。
不同标记规则的优先级不能重复。
Priority.description_en: The priority of tagging rules ranges from 1 to 10,000. Each tagging rule must have a unique priority value.

Protocol.description_cn:
协议类型。
- tcp：TCP协议。
- udp：UDP协议。
- gre：GRE协议
- icmp：ICMP协议。
- icmpv6：ICMPV6协议。
- all（默认）：支持所有协议。

- 中转路由器IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
- 开通中转路由器IPv6功能后，才可以传入ICMPV6。
Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type
- tcp: TCP protocol
- udp: UDP protocol
- gre: GRE protocol
- icmp: ICMP protocol
- icmpv6: ICMPv6 protocol
- all (default): Supports all protocols

- IPv6 for transit routers is currently in invite-only testing. To use this feature, contact your account manager.
- You can only transmit ICMPv6 after enabling IPv6 for the transit router.

RemarkingDscp.description_cn:
为目标流量报文修改的 DSCP 值。取值范围为 0～63。
目标流量成功匹配该标记规则后，流量报文的DSCP值替换为该参数的取值。
RemarkingDscp.description_en:
DSCP value to set for target traffic packets. Valid range: 0–63
When target traffic matches this marking rule, the DSCP value of the packet is replaced with the value of this parameter.

SourceCidrBlock.description_cn:
源地址的IP网段，支持IPv4和IPv6。
- `Protocol` 传入tcp、udp、gre或all时，该参数可传入IPv4网段或IPv6网段。
- `Protocol` 传入icmp时，该参数仅支持传入IPv4网段。
- `Protocol` 传入icmpv6时，该参数仅支持传入IPv6网段。
SourceCidrBlock.description_en:
Source IP address range; supports IPv4 and IPv6
- When `Protocol` is set to tcp, udp, gre, or all, you can enter either an IPv4 or IPv6 address range
- When `Protocol` is set to icmp, only IPv4 address ranges are supported
- When `Protocol` is set to icmpv6, only IPv6 address ranges are supported

SourcePortEnd.description_cn:
源端口范围的结束值。取值范围为-1，1～65535。
- \-1表示不限制端口。
- `Protocol` 传入icmp、icmpv6或gre时，仅支持传入-1。
SourcePortEnd.description_en:
End value of source port range. Valid values: -1, 1–65535
- -1 means no port restriction
- When Protocol is set to icmp, icmpv6, or gre, only -1 is supported

SourcePortStart.description_cn:
源端口范围的起始值。取值范围为-1，1～65535。
- \-1表示不限制端口。
- `Protocol` 传入icmp、icmpv6或gre时，仅支持传入-1。
SourcePortStart.description_en:
Starting value for the source port range. Valid values: -1, 1–65535
- -1 means no port restriction
- When `Protocol` is set to icmp, icmpv6, or gre, only -1 is supported

TransitRouterTrafficQosMarkingEntryName.description_cn:
标记规则的名称。

TagFilters.N.Key.description_cn:
网络实例连接标签的标签键。

* N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。多个标签键之间使用&分隔。
* 指定多个标签键时，表示查询同时包含所有指定标签键的网络实例连接。
TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the network instance connection tag.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple tag keys.
* Specifying multiple tag keys means querying network instance connections that contain all specified tag keys.

TagFilters.N.Values.description_cn:
网络实例连接标签的标签值。

* 第一个N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。
* 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
* 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。
* 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。
* 该参数传入空值时，表示查询指定标签键下标签值为空的资源。
TagFilters.N.Values.description_en:
Tag value of the network instance connection tag.

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10.
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, with a value range of 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key have an “OR” relationship, meaning resources with any of the tag values under the same tag key will be queried.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.
* If this parameter is passed, TagFilters.N.Key must be passed first.
* If this parameter is passed as an empty value, it means querying resources with empty tag values under the specified tag key.

* 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
* 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。

TagFilters.N.Values.description_en:
Tag value

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1~10
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, with a value range of 1~3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are in a logical "OR" relationship, meaning resources with any of the specified tag values under the same tag key will be queried
* Use & to separate multiple tag values


* If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be provided first
* If this parameter is empty, it queries resources where the specified tag key has an empty tag value

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the TR route table tag.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys.
* When specifying multiple tag keys, it queries TR route tables that contain all specified tag keys.

TagFilters.N.Values.description_cn:
TR路由表标签的标签值。

* 第一个N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。
* 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
* 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。
* 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。
* 该参数传入空值时，表示查询指定标签键下标签值为空的资源。
TagFilters.N.Values.description_en:
Tag value of the TR route table tag.

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10.
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, with a value range of 1–3. For the same tag key, multiple tag values have a logical 'OR' relationship, meaning it queries resources that have any of the tag values under the same tag key.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.
* If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be provided first.
* If this parameter is empty, it queries resources where the tag value under the specified tag key is empty.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_cn:
根据标签查询资源时指定的标签键。
- N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围为1～10。多个标签键之间使用&分隔。
- 指定多个标签键时，表示查询同时包含所有指定标签键的资源。
TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key specified when querying resources by tag
- N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple tag keys
- When multiple tag keys are specified, it means querying resources that contain all specified tag keys

TagFilters.N.Values.description_cn:
资源标签的标签值。
- 第一个N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。
- 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
- 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。

- 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。
- 该参数传入空值时，表示查询指定标签键下标签值为空的资源。
TagFilters.N.Values.description_en:
Tag value for resource tags.
- The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range is 1–10.
- The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range is 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are logically "OR", meaning resources with any of the tag values under the same tag key will be queried.
- Separate multiple tag values with &.

- If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be set first.
- If this parameter is empty, it queries resources where the specified tag key has an empty tag value.

- Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Length: 0 to 255 characters
- If this parameter is not provided or left empty, the default is an empty string
Description.example_cn: This multicast domain is used for test.
Description.example_en: This multicast domain is used for testing.

TransitRouterMulticastDomainId.description_cn: 组播域的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterMulticastDomains](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1544105)接口获取带宽包ID。
TransitRouterMulticastDomainId.description_en: Multicast domain ID. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterMulticastDomains](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1544105) API to get the multicast domain ID.

TransitRouterMulticastDomainName.description_cn:
组播域的名称。 
- 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：点号（.）、下划线（\\\_）和短横线（-）。 
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。 
- 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为组播域的ID。
TransitRouterMulticastDomainName.description_en:
Multicast domain name
- Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. It can contain letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified for this parameter, the multicast domain ID is used by default

Bandwidth.description_cn:
跨地域连接的带宽，单位为Mbps。
带宽最大值不能超过指定中转路由器带宽包剩余未分配的带宽上限。
Bandwidth.description_en:
Bandwidth for cross-region connections, measured in Mbps
The maximum bandwidth cannot exceed the upper limit of the remaining unallocated bandwidth in the specified transit router bandwidth package

BandwidthType.description_cn:
跨地域连接的带宽分配方式。

* BandwidthPackage：从带宽包分配。
* CloudDataTransfer：通过云数据传输服务按流量计费。
BandwidthType.description_en:
Bandwidth allocation method for cross-region connections.

* BandwidthPackage: Allocated from bandwidth package
* CloudDataTransfer: Billed by traffic through Cloud Data Transfer Service

Description.description_cn:
跨地域连接的描述信息。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，表示保持原有描述不变。
Description.description_en:

* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the original description remains unchanged
Description.example_cn: This peer attachment is used for test.
Description.example_en: Use this peer attachment for testing.

LineOperator.description_cn:
跨境带宽包线路的运营商。跨境互通时，该参数为必填。

* ChinaTelecom：中国电信。
LineOperator.description_en:

* ChinaTelecom: China Telecom

TransitRouterAttachmentId.description_cn: 跨地域连接的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781)接口获取跨地域连接的ID。
TransitRouterAttachmentId.description_en: Cross-region connection ID. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781) API to get the cross-region connection ID.

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_cn:

Direction.description_cn:
路由策略的作用方向。取值如下：
- In：收方向。指中转路由器从网络实例学习路由时，只接收符合路由策略的路由。
- Out：发方向。指中转路由器向网络实例同步路由时，只发送符合路由策略的路由。
Direction.description_en:
Direction of routing policy. Possible values:
- In: Receive direction. The transit router only receives routes that match the routing policy when learning routes from a network instance.
- Out: Send direction. The transit router only sends routes that match the routing policy when synchronizing routes to a network instance.

TransitRouterRoutePolicyTableId.description_cn: 路由策略的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterRoutePolicyTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1217296)接口获取路由策略的ID。

TransitRouterRouteTableId.description_en: Transit router route table ID. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312) API to get the transit router route table ID.

ActionResult.description_cn:
路由策略条目的策略行为。取值如下：
- Permit：允许。指允许匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
- Deny：拒绝。指拒绝匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
ActionResult.description_en:
Routing policy entry actions. Available options:
- Permit: Allow routes that match this policy entry
- Deny: Block routes that match this policy entry

ApplyAsPathValues.description_cn:
路由策略条目设置的路由AsPath。取值范围为1～4294967295。
- N：表示路由属性的序号，取值范围1～10。
- 多个路由属性之间使用&分隔。

ActionResult取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
ApplyAsPathValues.description_en:
The route AsPath set for the routing policy entry. Value range: 1–4294967295
- N: Indicates the sequence number of the route attribute. Value range: 1–10
- Use & to separate multiple route attributes

This parameter takes effect only when ActionResult is set to "Permit"

AsPathOperateMode.description_cn:
路由策略条目的AsPath设置方式。取值如下：
- Additive：追加AsPath。指在允许通过的路由的AsPath最前面追加指定的AsPath。
- Replace：替换AsPath。指使用指定的AsPath替换允许通过的路由的AsPath。

ActionResult取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
AsPathOperateMode.description_en:
AsPath setting method for routing policy entries. Available options:
- Additive: Prepends the specified AsPath to the beginning of the permitted route's AsPath
- Replace: Replaces the permitted route's AsPath with the specified AsPath

This parameter takes effect only when ActionResult is set to Permit

DestinationResourceIds.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例ID。
- 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。

- N：表示目的实例类型的序号，取值范围 1～10。多个目的实例类型之间使用&分隔。
- 指定的路由策略的作用方向为“In”时，不允许传入该字段。
DestinationResourceIds.description_en:
Destination instance ID for the routing policy entry.
- You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to get the ID of a VPC instance.
- You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to get the ID of a direct connect gateway instance.
- You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to get the ID of a cross-region transit router (TR) instance.

- N: Indicates the sequence number of the destination instance type, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple destination instance types.
- When the routing policy direction is "In", this field cannot be specified.
