若此处填写 **自定义节点池 ID**，则待添加的节点将应用自定义节点池上的 Kubernetes 配置和节点配置（包括 ECS 实例标签、标签、污点、封锁节点配置、项目、节点名称前缀等），因此 **InitializeScript**、**KubernetesConfig**、**ImageId** 参数配置将无效，上述参数仅在默认节点池中添加已有节点时有效。
NodePoolId.description_en:
Node pool ID

* If no parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to the default node pool.
* If a parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to a custom node pool. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to obtain the target custom node pool ID.

If you enter a **custom node pool ID** here, the nodes to be added will use the Kubernetes configuration and node settings from the custom node pool (including ECS instance tags, labels, taints, node blocking configuration, project, node name prefix, etc). Therefore, the **InitializeScript**, **KubernetesConfig**, and **ImageId** parameter settings will be ignored. These parameters are only valid when adding existing nodes to the default node pool.

PreScript.description_cn:
【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】部署节点前执行的脚本。输入Base64 编码后的 Shell 格式脚本。
* 参数值为空时，待添加的节点继承默认节点池配置的前置脚本 **NodeConfigRequest.PreScript**。
* 自定义填写脚本内容后，将会忽略默认节点池配置的前置脚本，使用此处输入的脚本。
* Base64 编码后长度不超过 8 KB。若同时传入 **InitializeScript** 和 **PreScript**，则两个参数的传入值总长度也不能超过 8 KB。
PreScript.description_en:
[Invite Test · Apply for Trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623) Script executed before deploying the node. Enter a Shell script in Base64 encoding.
* If the parameter value is empty, the node to be added inherits the default node pool's pre-script configuration **NodeConfigRequest.PreScript**
* If you enter a custom script, the default node pool pre-script will be ignored and the script entered here will be used
* The length after Base64 encoding must not exceed 8 KB. If both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript** are provided, the total length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB

Roles.description_cn:
节点角色，取值如下：

* Master：master 节点
* Etcd：etcd 节点
* Worker：worker 节点
Roles.description_en:
Node role. Values:

* Master: master node
* Etcd: etcd node
* Worker: worker node

SkipReplaceSystem.description_cn:
添加已有节点时是否跳过重置系统：

* **true**：跳过重置系统，即不重置已有节点对应 ECS 实例的操作系统。
* **false**：（默认值）不跳过重置系统，即重置已有节点对应 ECS 实例的操作系统。

若需要跳过重置系统（取值为`true`），请确保：

* ECS 实例状态必须为 **RUNNING**，可调用 [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) 查询实例状态。
* ECS 实例必须安装云助手 Agent 且状态为 **Running**，可调用 [DescribeCloudAssistantStatus](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/170931) 查询云助手 Agent 状态。
SkipReplaceSystem.description_en:
Skip system reset when adding existing nodes:

* **true**: Skip system reset; the operating system of the ECS instance for the existing node will not be reset
* **false** (default): Do not skip system reset; the operating system of the ECS instance for the existing node will be reset

If you need to skip system reset (set to `true`), make sure:

* The ECS instance status is **RUNNING**. You can call [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) to check the instance status
* The ECS instance has Cloud Assistant Agent installed and its status is **Running**. You can call [DescribeCloudAssistantStatus](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/170931) to check the Cloud Assistant Agent status

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: A string used to ensure request idempotency. The caller provides this string, which must be unique across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

Name.description_cn: 检查自愈规则名称。

Rules.FaultType.description_cn:
故障类型。取值：

* **GPUFault：​**GPU 故障
* **NodeFault：​**节点故障
* **SystemFault：​**系统与组件故障
* **RegisteredFault：​**自定义故障
* **XidFault：​**XID 异常
Rules.FaultType.description_en:
Fault type. Options:

* **GPUFault:** GPU fault
* **NodeFault:** Node fault
* **SystemFault:** System and component fault
* **RegisteredFault:** Custom fault
* **XidFault:** XID exception

Rules.IncidentTypes.description_cn: 自愈检查项。不同类型的故障支持不同的检查项。此处需填写 Kubernetes Event，详情请参见 [检查自愈概述](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2520840)。
Rules.IncidentTypes.description_en: Self-healing check item. Different fault types support different check items. Enter the Kubernetes Event here. For details, see [Self-Healing Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2520840).

Rules.RemedyStrategy.Type.description_cn:
策略类型。取值：

* **Notify**：提示异常
* **CordonNode**：封锁节点
* **DrainNode**：排干节点
* **Remedy**：自动修复

* 当`RemedyRule.FaultType`为`RegisteredFault`时，仅支持配置为`Remedy`。
* 当`RemedyRule.FaultType`为`XidFault`时，仅支持配置为`DrainNode`或`Remedy`。
Rules.RemedyStrategy.Type.description_en:
Policy type. Values:

* **Notify**: Notify of exception
* **CordonNode**: Cordon node
* **DrainNode**: Drain node
* **Remedy**: Automatic remediation

* When `RemedyRule.FaultType` is `RegisteredFault`, only `Remedy` is supported.
* When `RemedyRule.FaultType` is `XidFault`, only `DrainNode` or `Remedy` is supported.

AdjustmentValue.description_cn: 节点池弹性伸缩时，增加的节点数量。整数形式，取值范围为 1～500。
AdjustmentValue.description_en: Number of nodes to add during node pool elastic scaling. Must be an integer between 1 and 500.

The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the current status of the cluster.

Enabled.description_cn:
是否启用弹性预约伸缩规则，取值:

* **true**：启用
* **false**：（默认值）禁用
Enabled.description_en:
Whether to enable the scaling policy. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: (default) Disable

节点池必须处于`{Running,[*]} `状态。可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口获取节点池当前的状态。
NodePoolId.description_en:
Node pool ID.
The node pool must be in the `{Running,[*]}` state. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to get the current status of the node pool.

ScheduledInstancePolicy.description_cn: 弹性预约伸缩规则配置。

ScheduledInstancePolicy.AutoReleaseTime.description_cn:
预约实例的自动释放时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。仅当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时有效且必填。必须为 10 分钟整点。

* 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为 **预约交付** 类型时，该时间必须大于预约交付 +1 小时。
* 如果`DeliveryType`为`Immediate`，即为 **立即交付** 类型时，最早释放时间为当前时间下一个整十分钟时间点。例如：当前时间5:02，则最早自动释放时间为 5:20。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.AutoReleaseTime.description_en:
Automatic release time for reserved instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Segment Type**). Must be on a 10-minute mark.

* If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (**reservation delivery** type), this time must be greater than reservation delivery +1 hour
* If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (**immediate delivery** type), the earliest release time is the next 10-minute mark after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest automatic release time is 5:20

ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_cn:
当弹性预约实例的库存不能完全满足预约需求时，是否尽可能多的预约实例。

* **false：**（默认值）最多生成一个预约单。
* **true：​**当单个预约单无法满足需求时，会提交多个预约单。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_en:
When the inventory of elastic scheduled instances cannot fully meet the reservation demand, choose whether to reserve as many instances as possible.

* **false:** (default) Generates at most one reservation order
* **true:** If a single reservation order cannot meet the demand, multiple reservation orders will be submitted

ScheduledInstancePolicy.DeliveryType.description_cn:
弹性预约实例-时段型的交付类型，取值：

* **Reserve**：预约交付
* **Immediate**：立即交付

仅当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`取值为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时有效且必填。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.DeliveryType.description_en:
Delivery type for segmented elastic scheduled instances. Options:

* **Reserve**: Scheduled delivery
* **Immediate**: Immediate delivery

This field is required and valid only when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`, meaning the instance type is a segmented elastic scheduled instance.

ScheduledInstancePolicy.ElasticScheduled.description_cn:
弹性预约实例类型，取值：

* **Esi**：弹性预约实例-通用型
* **Segmented**：弹性预约实例-时段型
ScheduledInstancePolicy.ElasticScheduled.description_en:
Type of elastic scheduled instance. Values:

* **Esi:** Elastic Scheduled Instance - General Type
* **Segmented:** Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Segment Type

ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_cn:
弹性预约实例的交付结束时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。必须为 10 分钟整点，且与`StartDeliveryTime`的间隔为 10 分钟。取值：

* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为 `Esi`，即为 **弹性预约实例-通用型** 类型时，有效且必填：
   * 取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`后的 4～8 小时内。
* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时：
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为预约交付类型时，有效且必填。取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`的 24 小时以内。
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为立即交付类型时，无需传入该参数。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_en:
End time for delivery of elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be on a 10-minute mark, and the interval with `StartDeliveryTime` must be 10 minutes. Values:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - General Type**), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the start time of the periodic task (`LaunchTime`)
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Segment Type**):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the start time of the periodic task (`LaunchTime`)
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledInstancePolicy.StartDeliveryTim.description_cn:
弹性预约实例的交付开始时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。必须为 10 分钟整点，取值:

* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为 `Esi`，即为 **弹性预约实例-通用型** 类型时，有效且必填：
   * 取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`后的 4～8 小时内。
* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时：
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为预约交付类型时，有效且必填。取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`的 24 小时以内。
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为立即交付类型时，无需传入该参数。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.StartDeliveryTim.description_en:
Start time for delivery of elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be on a 10-minute mark. Values:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - General Type**), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the start time of the periodic task (`LaunchTime`)
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (**Elastic Scheduled Instance - Time Segment Type**):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the start time of the periodic task (`LaunchTime`)
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledPolicy.description_cn: 定时任务或周期任务配置。

ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_cn:
任务的开始时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。仅当`Type`取值为`Scheduled`或`Recurrence`时有效且必填。

* 当`Type`取值为`Scheduled`时，表示定时任务的触发时间。
* 当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时，表示周期任务的开始时间。
* 需大于当前时间，且仅支持配置自创建/修改时间起 90 日内的时间。

为保证预约扩容请求提交成功，建议配置的`LaunchTime`至少晚于当前时间 1 分钟。
ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_en:
Task start time, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Scheduled` or `Recurrence`.

* When `Type` is `Scheduled`, this is the trigger time for the scheduled task.
* When `Type` is `Recurrence`, this is the start time for the recurring task.
* Must be later than the current time, and can only be set within 90 days from the creation/modification time.

To ensure the scheduled scaling request is submitted successfully, it is recommended to set `LaunchTime` at least 1 minute later than the current time.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
周期任务的结束时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。仅当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时有效且必填。
需大于等于`LaunchTime`，且仅支持配置自创建/修改时刻起 365 日内的时间。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
End time of the recurring task, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.
Must be greater than or equal to `LaunchTime`, and can only be set within 365 days from the creation/modification time.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_cn:
周期任务的重复周期，仅当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时有效且必填。取值：

* **Daily**：每隔几天执行一次。
* **Weekly**：选择每周中的几天，每天执行一次。
* **Monthly**：选择每月中几号到几号，每天执行一次。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_en:
Recurrence period for the recurring task. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`. Options:

* **Daily**: Execute once every few days.
* **Weekly**: Select specific days of the week to execute once per day.
* **Monthly**: Select specific dates within the month to execute once per day.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_cn:
周期任务的重复执行次数。仅当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时有效且必填。

* 当`RecurrenceType`取值为`Daily`时，只能填写一个值，取值范围为 1~31。
* 当`RecurrenceType`取值为`Weekly`时，支持填入多个值，使用英文逗号`,`分隔。星期一到星期日的取值依次为：1,2,3,4,5,6,7。
* 当`RecurrenceType`取值为`Monthly`时，格式为`A-B`。A、B 的取值范围均为 1~31，且 B 必须大于等于 A。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_en:
Number of times a recurring task is executed. This field is required and only valid when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.

* When `RecurrenceType` is set to `Daily`, only one value can be entered, with a range of 1–31.
* When `RecurrenceType` is set to `Weekly`, multiple values are supported, separated by commas (`,`). Values for Monday to Sunday are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.
* When `RecurrenceType` is set to `Monthly`, the format is `A-B`. Both A and B must be in the range 1–31, and B must be greater than or equal to A.

Type.description_cn:
弹性预约伸缩规则的类型，取值：

* **Scheduled**：定时任务
* **Recurrence**：周期任务
Type.description_en:
Type of scaling policy. Values:

* **Scheduled**: Scheduled task
* **Recurrence**: Recurring task

* 产品 **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）请使用 **RetainResources** 参数。

CascadingDeleteResources.description_en:
Parameter deprecation notice:

Cascading deletion of resources associated with the component. Valid values:

* Leave empty: (default) Do not cascade delete associated resources

集群必须处于`{Running,[Ok]}`或`{Updating, [Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
ID of the cluster to which the component to be uninstalled belongs
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID
The cluster must be in `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating, [Progressing]}` status. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the current status of the cluster

Name.description_en:

The component must **not be in** `{Creating, [Progressing]}`, `{Deleting, [Progressing]}`, or `{Failed, [ClusterNotRunning]}` status. You can call the [ListAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115206) API to get the current status of the component

RetainResources.description_cn:
* **存量用户** 必须完成 [接口改造](	https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) 后，才能使用该参数。存量用户的判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）可直接使用该参数。

删除组件时，需要保留的相关资源，取值：

* 取值为空：（默认值）删除全部关联资源。
      其他外部系统的资源不支持级联删除，例如 Ingress 关联的负载均衡器、日志组件关联的日志项目（Project）和日志主题（Topic）等。
   
* **Crd**：删除组件时保留组件的 CRD（Custom Resource Definition）资源。
RetainResources.description_en:
* **Existing users** must complete the [API migration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) before using this parameter. For how to determine if you are an existing user, see the [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)
* **New users** (those who enabled and started using VKE after December 18, 2023) can use this parameter directly

Resources to retain when deleting the component. Valid values:

* Leave empty: (default) Delete all associated resources
      Resources from other external systems do not support cascading deletion, such as load balancers associated with Ingress, log projects (Project), and log topics (Topic) associated with log components
   
* **Crd**: Retain the component's CRD (Custom Resource Definition) resources when deleting the component

CascadingDeleteResources.description_cn:
参数废弃说明：

* 仅 **存量用户** 支持使用该参数。存量用户判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* 因该参数即将下线，所以 **存量用户** 仅在指定时间内可使用该参数，请尽快完成接口改造后使用新的 **RetainResources** 参数。接口改造说明，请参见 [级联删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 改造说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* 产品 **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）请使用 **RetainResources** 参数。

同步删除指定集群内的相关资源，取值：

* **DefaultNodePoolResource**：同步删除集群内默认节点池中的云服务器（ECS）实例。
   若指定的集群中，默认节点池中存在包年包月的云服务器实例，则该接口仅从集群中移除云服务器实例，不会删除实例。您可以通过 [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 或 [云服务器 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) 查询到该实例，并按需执行后续操作。
* **NodePoolResource**：同步删除集群内的所有自定义节点池、节点池内的云服务器实例及其关联的弹性块存储。
   不包含存储卷（PV）所对应的存储资源，例如云盘（EBS）、文件存储 NAS、文件存储 vePFS、对象存储（TOS）等资源。
* **Clb**：同步删除集群创建的负载均衡器（CLB）。
* **Nat**：同步删除集群创建的 NAT 网关。
* **All**：同步删除集群内上述所有类型资源，但不包括
   不包含集群内的包年包月节点、PV 对应的存储资源，日志服务关联的 Topic。

在删除过程中，若这些资源开启了删除保护，则无法被删除；未开启删除保护的资源，会被继续删除。建议在调用接口前按需调整删除保护设置。
CascadingDeleteResources.description_en:
Parameter deprecation notice:

* Only **existing users** can use this parameter. For criteria to determine existing users, see [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* As this parameter will soon be discontinued, **existing users** can only use it within a specified timeframe. Please promptly update your interface and use the new **RetainResources** parameter. For interface update instructions, see [OpenAPI update instructions for cascading cluster resource deletion](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and started using VKE after December 18, 2023) should use the **RetainResources** parameter.

Synchronously delete related resources in the specified cluster. Options:

* **DefaultNodePoolResource**: Synchronously delete ECS instances in the default node pool of the cluster.
   If the default node pool contains subscription ECS instances, this interface only removes the ECS instances from the cluster without deleting them. You can find these instances in the [ECS console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) or via the [ECS API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) and perform follow-up actions as needed.
* **NodePoolResource**: Synchronously delete all custom node pools in the cluster, ECS instances in the node pools, and their associated elastic block storage.
   Does not include storage resources corresponding to persistent volumes (PV), such as EBS, NAS file storage, vePFS file storage, object storage (TOS), etc.
* **Clb**: Synchronously delete load balancers (CLB) created by the cluster.
* **Nat**: Synchronously delete NAT gateways created by the cluster.
* **All**: Synchronously delete all the above resource types in the cluster, except for
   subscription nodes in the cluster, storage resources corresponding to PVs, and Topics associated with log services.

During deletion, resources with deletion protection enabled cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the interface.

Force.description_cn:

* `{Running,[*]}`

You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current status of the cluster.

RetainResources.description_cn:
* **存量用户** 必须完成 [接口改造](	https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) 后，才能使用该参数。存量用户的判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）可直接使用该参数。

删除集群时，需要保留的集群内相关资源，取值：

* 取值为空：（默认值）删除集群关联创建的全部资源，及添加到节点池的非包年包月类型 ECS 实例。
* **DefaultNodePoolResource**：保留集群内默认节点池中的 ECS 实例及其关联的弹性块存储、公网 IP 等资源。
* **NodePoolResource**：保留集群内的所有自定义节点池内的 ECS 实例及其关联的弹性块存储、公网 IP 等资源。
* **Clb**：保留集群内路由规则（Ingress）和服务（Service）创建的负载均衡（CLB）实例。
* **Alb**：保留集群内 Ingress 和 Service 创建的应用型负载均衡（ALB）实例。
* **Nat**：保留集群关联创建的 NAT 网关。
* **SecurityGroup**：保留集群关联创建的安全组。
* **All**：保留集群关联创建的所有资源。

在删除过程中，若这些资源开启了删除保护，则无法被删除；未开启删除保护的资源，会被继续删除。建议在调用接口前按需调整删除保护设置。
RetainResources.description_en:
* **Existing users** must complete the [API upgrade](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) before using this parameter. For how to determine existing users, see the [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and used VKE after December 18, 2023) can use this parameter directly.

When deleting a cluster, specify which resources within the cluster to retain:

* Leave blank (default): Deletes all resources created in association with the cluster, as well as non-subscription ECS instances added to the node pool.
* **DefaultNodePoolResource**: Retains ECS instances in the default node pool and their associated Elastic Block Storage, public IPs, and other resources.
* **NodePoolResource**: Retains ECS instances in all custom node pools and their associated Elastic Block Storage, public IPs, and other resources.
* **Clb**: Retains load balancer (CLB) instances created by Ingress and Service within the cluster.
* **Alb**: Retains application load balancer (ALB) instances created by Ingress and Service within the cluster.
* **Nat**: Retains NAT gateways created in association with the cluster.
* **SecurityGroup**: Retains security groups created in association with the cluster.
* **All**: Retains all resources created in association with the cluster.

If deletion protection is enabled for these resources, they cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the API.

可以调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点 ID。单次调用最多填写 100 个节点 ID。
* 节点必须处于以下任一状态：
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Stopped, [*]}`
   * `{Failed, [InitilizeFailed, NotReady, ResourceCleanupFailed, Balance, Unknown]}`
   可调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点当前的状态。
* 下线 [弹性裸金属型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/69763) 节点时，ECS 侧会根据运行状态优先正常关机，如无法正常关机，将执行强制关机。更多信息，请参见 [StopInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70468)。
* 若指定的节点池启用了 **AffinityGroupConfig** 亲和组配置（邀测），则必须确保从节点池中删除节点后，剩余节点数量是亲和组规格的整数倍。您也可以删除该节点池中的全部节点。
Ids.description_en:
Node ID list
You can call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to obtain node IDs. You can specify up to 100 node IDs per request.
* Nodes must be in one of the following states:
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Stopped, [*]}`
   * `{Failed, [InitilizeFailed, NotReady, ResourceCleanupFailed, Balance, Unknown]}`
   You can call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to check the current status of nodes.
* When decommissioning [Elastic Bare Metal](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/69763) nodes, ECS will attempt a normal shutdown based on the running status. If a normal shutdown fails, a forced shutdown will be performed. For more information, see [StopInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70468).
* If the specified node pool has **AffinityGroupConfig** affinity group configuration (preview), you must ensure that after removing nodes from the pool, the remaining number of nodes is an integer multiple of the affinity group specification. You can also remove all nodes from the node pool.

NextToken.description_en: NextToken

Body.description_cn:
请求体，必须为 JSON 格式的字符串内容，且大小不超过 1.5 MB。

- 当 **Method** 为 **GET**、**DELETE** 时可以不填。
- **Method** 为 **POST**、**PUT**、**PATCH** 时必须填写。
Body.description_en:
Request body must be a JSON-formatted string and no larger than 1.5 MB

- You can leave this blank when **Method** is **GET** or **DELETE**
- You must provide this when **Method** is **POST**, **PUT**, or **PATCH**

ClusterId.description_cn:
目标集群 ID。 可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于`{Running,[Ok]}`或`{Updating,[Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
Target Cluster ID. Call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. Call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current cluster status.

Headers.description_cn:
请求头。
当`Method=PATCH`时才生效。
Headers.description_en:
Request Header
Only takes effect when Method=PATCH

Headers.Key.description_cn:
请求头的 Key。当前仅支持设置 **Content-Type**，以使用不同的 **PATCH** 方法。
 tip
- 支持 jsonPatch、mergePatch、strategicMergePatch 三种 **PATCH** 方法。三种方法的具体差异，请参见 [Kubernetes Patch 文档](https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/tasks/manage-kubernetes-objects/update-api-object-kubectl-patch/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-json-%E5%90%88%E5%B9%B6-patch-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0-deployment)。
- 请求头的 **Key** 和 **Value** 使用方法，请参见本文下方 [jsonPatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#jsonpatch-configmap)、[mergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#mergepatch-configmap)、[strategicMergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#strategicmergepatch-configmap)。
Headers.Key.description_en:
Request header key. Only **Content-Type** is supported, allowing you to use different **PATCH** methods.
 tip
- Supports three **PATCH** methods: jsonPatch, mergePatch, and strategicMergePatch. For details on the differences between these methods, see the [Kubernetes Patch documentation](https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/tasks/manage-kubernetes-objects/update-api-object-kubectl-patch/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-json-%E5%90%88%E5%B9%B6-patch-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0-deployment).
- For instructions on setting the request header **Key** and **Value**, see [jsonPatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#jsonpatch-configmap), [mergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#mergepatch-configmap), and [strategicMergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#strategicmergepatch-configmap) below.

Headers.Value.description_cn:
请求头的 Value。当 **Key** 为 **Content-Type** 时，取值：

- **application/strategic-merge-patch+json**（默认值）
- **application/json-patch+json**
- **application/merge-patch+json**

 tip
- 支持 jsonPatch、mergePatch、strategicMergePatch 三种 **PATCH** 方法。三种方法的具体差异，请参见 [Kubernetes Patch 文档](https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/tasks/manage-kubernetes-objects/update-api-object-kubectl-patch/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-json-%E5%90%88%E5%B9%B6-patch-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0-deployment)。
- 请求头的 **Key** 和 **Value** 使用方法，请参见本文下方 [jsonPatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#jsonpatch-configmap)、[mergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#mergepatch-configmap)、[strategicMergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#strategicmergepatch-configmap)。
Headers.Value.description_en:
Value for the request header. When the **Key** is **Content-Type**, possible values are:

- **application/strategic-merge-patch+json** (default)
- **application/json-patch+json**
- **application/merge-patch+json**

 tip
- Supports three **PATCH** methods: jsonPatch, mergePatch, and strategicMergePatch. For details on the differences, see the [Kubernetes Patch documentation](https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/tasks/manage-kubernetes-objects/update-api-object-kubectl-patch/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-json-%E5%90%88%E5%B9%B6-patch-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0-deployment).
- For usage of the request header **Key** and **Value**, see [jsonPatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#jsonpatch-configmap), [mergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#mergepatch-configmap), and [strategicMergePatch ConfigMap](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/130463#strategicmergepatch-configmap) below.

ClusterId.description_cn:
需要授权给 IAM 用户或角色的集群 ID。可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
`roleDomain`为`namespace`或`cluster`时必须填写该参数值。
ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID to be authorized for the IAM user or role. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain the cluster ID.
This parameter is required when `roleDomain` is `namespace` or `cluster`.

GranteeId.description_cn:
被授权者的 ID。可以是 IAM 用户 ID，也可以是 IAM 角色 ID。可以调用 [ListUsers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65008) 或 [ListRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65019) 接口，获取 ID。
目前该参数必须填写。
GranteeId.description_en:
The grantee's ID. This can be an IAM user ID or an IAM role ID. You can call the [ListUsers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65008) or [ListRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65019) API to obtain the ID.
This parameter is currently required.

GranteeType.description_cn:
被授权者的类型，取值如下：

* **User**：IAM 用户。
* **Role**：IAM 角色。
* **All**：所有类型。
GranteeType.description_en:
Type of authorized entity. Available values:

* **User**: IAM user
* **Role**: IAM role
* **All**: All types

IsCustomRole.description_cn:
给被授权者授予的 RBAC 角色是否为自定义角色，取值如下：

* **true**：自定义角色。
* **false**：（默认值）系统预置的角色。
IsCustomRole.description_en:
Whether the RBAC role granted to the grantee is a custom role. Valid values:

* **true**: Custom role.
* **false** (default): System predefined role.

Namespace.description_cn:
需要授权给 IAM 用户或角色的名空间名称。可以登录 [容器服务控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/vke)，查看命名空间名称。
* `roleDomain`等于`namespace`时必须填写该参数值。
* `roleDomain`不等于`namespace`时，填写该参数值不生效。
Namespace.description_en:
Name of the namespace to be authorized for the IAM user or role. You can log in to the [Container Service Console](https://console.volcengine.com/vke) to view the namespace name.
* This parameter is required when `roleDomain` is equal to `namespace`.
* If `roleDomain` is not equal to `namespace`, specifying this parameter has no effect.

RoleDomain.description_cn:
为 IAM 用户或角色授予的权限类型，取值如下：

* **namespace**：授予命名空间级别的权限。
* **cluster**：授予集群级别的权限。
* **all_clusters**：授予当前账号下全部集群级别的权限。
RoleDomain.description_en:
Type of permission to be granted to the IAM user or role. Valid values:

* **namespace**: Grants namespace-level permissions.
* **cluster**: Grants cluster-level permissions.
* **all_clusters**: Grants permissions for all clusters under the current account.

RoleName.description_cn:
给被授权者授予的 RBAC 角色名称。可以授予如下 RBAC 权限：

* 自定义角色名称：您可以自定义一个角色名称，名称格式、字符串等 VKE 侧无限制，只要符合 Kubernetes 规范即可。
* 系统预置的角色名称：可授予的系统预置 RBAC 角色名称，请参见 [RBAC 权限角色说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1129837)。

* 目前必须填写该参数。
* 当`roleDomain`为`all_clusters`时，不可以自定义角色名称。
RoleName.description_en:
Name of the RBAC role to be granted to the grantee. The following RBAC permissions can be granted:

* Custom role name: You can define a custom role name. There are no restrictions on the format or string on the VKE side, as long as it complies with Kubernetes specifications.
* System predefined role name: For available system predefined RBAC role names, see [RBAC Permission Role Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1129837).

* This parameter is currently required.
* When `roleDomain` is `all_clusters`, custom role names are not allowed.

Filter.description_cn: 待查询组件的筛选条件。
Filter.description_en: Filter criteria for components to be queried

Filter.ClusterIds.description_cn:
集群 ID 列表。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。单次最多填写 100 个集群 ID。
 tip
此参数为空数组时，基于账号下指定地域的所有集群进行筛选。
Filter.ClusterIds.description_en:
Cluster ID list
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get cluster IDs. You can enter up to 100 cluster IDs at a time.
 tip
If this parameter is an empty array, all clusters in the specified region under your account will be included in the filter criteria.

Filter.CreateClientToken.description_cn: 创建成功时的 ClientToken。 ClientToken 是保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入。
Filter.CreateClientToken.description_en: ClientToken present at the time of successful creation. This string ensures request idempotency and is provided by the caller

Filter.DeployModes.description_cn:
支持的部署模式，取值：

- **Unmanaged**：查询非托管模式部署的组件。
- **Managed**：查询托管模式部署的组件。
- 为空：查询全部部署模式的组件。
Filter.DeployModes.description_en:
Supported deployment modes:

- **Unmanaged**: Query components deployed in unmanaged mode
- **Managed**: Query components deployed in managed mode
- Leave blank: Query components in all deployment modes

Filter.DeployNodeTypes.description_cn:
部署节点类型。仅`DeployMode=Unmanaged`时，才需要指定。取值：

- **Node**：查询以节点（云服务器）方式部署的组件。
- **VirtualNode**：查询以虚拟节点（弹性容器实例）方式部署的组件。
- 为空：查询全部部署节点类型的组件。
Filter.DeployNodeTypes.description_en:
Deployment node type. Specify only when `DeployMode=Unmanaged`. Options:

- **Node**: Query components deployed on nodes (cloud servers)
- **VirtualNode**: Query components deployed on virtual nodes (elastic container instances)
- Leave blank: Query components of all deployment node types

Filter.Names.description_cn:
组件名称列表。
可以调用 [ListSupportedAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115201) 接口，获取集群组件名称。单次最多填写 100 个组件名称。
 tip
此参数为空数组时，基于指定集群下的所有组件进行筛选。
Filter.Names.description_en:
Component name list
You can call the [ListSupportedAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115201) API to get cluster component names. You can enter up to 100 component names at a time.
 tip
If this parameter is an empty array, the filter will apply to all components in the specified cluster.

Filter.Statuses.description_cn:
组件状态。
单次最多填写 15 个数组元素。传入多个状态时，状态间是逻辑「或」关系。
Filter.Statuses.description_en:
Component state
You can enter up to 15 array elements at a time
If you enter multiple states, they are combined using a logical OR relationship

Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_cn:
组件当前主状态下的状态条件，即进入该主状态的原因，可以有多个原因，取值：

- **Unknown**
- **ClusterNotRunning**
- **CrashLoopBackOff**
- **ImagePullBackOff**
- **SchedulingFailed**
- **NameConflict**
- **ResourceCleanupFailed**
- **ClusterVersionUpgrading**
- **Ok**
- **Degraded**
- **Progressing**

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_en:
Status conditions under the component's current main status—these are the reasons for entering this main status. There may be multiple reasons. Possible values:

- **Unknown**
- **ClusterNotRunning**
- **CrashLoopBackOff**
- **ImagePullBackOff**
- **SchedulingFailed**
- **NameConflict**
- **ResourceCleanupFailed**
- **ClusterVersionUpgrading**
- **Ok**
- **Degraded**
- **Progressing**

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** is required; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid **Phase** and **Conditions.Type** combinations, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_cn:
组件的状态，取值：

- **Running**
- **Failed**
- **Creating**
- **Deleting**
- **Updating**

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_en:
Component status values:

- **Running**
- **Failed**
- **Creating**
- **Deleting**
- **Updating**

At least one of the parameters, **Phase** or **Conditions.Type**, must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.UpdateClientToken.description_cn:
按更新幂等token过滤，精确查询
最后一次更新成功时 ClientToken。 ClientToken 是保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入。
Filter.UpdateClientToken.description_en:
Filter by the idempotency token from when the last update succeeded for precise search
ClientToken from when the last update succeeded
ClientToken is a string that ensures request idempotency. This string is provided by the caller

PageNumber.description_cn: 分页查询时的起始页码，从 1 开始，默认为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Starting page number for paginated queries. Begins at 1; default is 1

PageSize.description_cn:
分页查询时每页显示的记录数，取值：

- 最小值：1
- 最大值：100
- 默认值：10
PageSize.description_en:
Records per page in paginated queries:

- Minimum: 1
- Maximum: 100
- Default: 10

Filter.description_cn: 待查询集群的筛选条件。
Filter.description_en: Filter criteria for clusters to be queried

Filter.CreateClientToken.description_cn:
创建集群成功时的 ClientToken。
ClientToken 是保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入。
Filter.CreateClientToken.description_en: ClientToken used in the cluster creation request. This string, provided by the caller, ensures the request is idempotent.

Filter.DeleteProtectionEnabled.description_cn:
集群删除保护，取值：

- **true**：开启
- **false**：关闭
Filter.DeleteProtectionEnabled.description_en:
Cluster Deletion Protection, values:

- **true**: Enabled
- **false**: Disabled

Filter.Ids.description_cn:
集群 ID 列表。
单次最多填写 100 个 ID。

 tip
此参数为空数组时，筛选您本账号下公共参数中指定地域的所有集群。
Filter.Ids.description_en:
Cluster ID list
Up to 100 IDs per request

 tip
If this parameter is an empty array, the system filters all clusters in the specified region under your account based on the public parameters.

Filter.Name.description_cn: 集群名称。支持模糊查询。
Filter.Name.description_en: Cluster name. Supports fuzzy search.

Filter.PodsConfig.PodNetworkMode.description_cn:
容器网络模型（Pod CNI），取值：

* **Flannel**：Flannel 网络模型，独立的 Underlay 容器网络方案，配合 VPC 的全局路由能力，实现集群高性能的网络体验。
* **VpcCniShared**：VPC-CNI 网络模型，基于私有网络的弹性网卡 ENI 实现的 Underlay 容器网络方案。
Filter.PodsConfig.PodNetworkMode.description_en:
Container network model (Pod CNI), options:

* **Flannel**: Flannel network model, an independent underlay container network solution. Works with VPC global routing to deliver high-performance networking for clusters.
* **VpcCniShared**: VPC-CNI network model, an underlay container network solution based on ENI (Elastic Network Interface) in a private network.

Filter.Statuses.description_cn:
需要筛选的集群状态数组。
数组各个元素间是逻辑「或」关系。单次最多填写 15 个状态数组元素。
Filter.Statuses.description_en:
Cluster status array to filter
Elements are connected by a logical OR
You can enter up to 15 status array elements at a time

Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_cn:
集群当前状态下的状态条件，枚举值如下：

* **Ok**: 正常
* **CreateError**: 创建失败
* **Progressing**: 处理中
* **Balance**: 欠费
* **ResourceCleanupFailed**: 删除失败
* **Unknown**: 未知错误
* **UpdatingCluster**：集群配置更新中
* **SyncingAddon**：组件变更中
* **SyncingNodePool**：节点池变更中
* **ClusterVersionUpgrading**：集群版本升级中

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合，请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_en:
Cluster status conditions in the current state. The enumerated values are as follows:

* **Ok**: Normal
* **CreateError**: Creation failed
* **Progressing**: In progress
* **Balance**: Insufficient balance
* **ResourceCleanupFailed**: Deletion failed
* **Unknown**: Unknown error
* **UpdatingCluster**: Cluster configuration update in progress
* **SyncingAddon**: Addon update in progress
* **SyncingNodePool**: Node pool update in progress
* **ClusterVersionUpgrading**: Cluster version upgrade in progress

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_cn:
集群状态，枚举值如下：

* **Creating**：创建中
* **Running**：运行中
* **Updating**：更新中
* **Stopped**：已停止
* **Deleting**：删除中
* **Failed**：异常

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合，请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_en:
Cluster status. The enumerated values are as follows:

* **Creating**: Creating
* **Running**: Running
* **Updating**: Updating
* **Stopped**: Stopped
* **Deleting**: Deleting
* **Failed**: Abnormal

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.Types.description_cn:
集群类型，精确匹配，取值：

* **Managed**：托管集群
* **Registered**：【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】注册集群
Filter.Types.description_en:
Cluster type, exact match. Values:

* **Managed**: Managed cluster
* **Registered**: [Beta · Apply for trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623) Registered cluster

Filter.UpdateClientToken.description_cn:
最后一次更新集群成功时的 ClientToken。
ClientToken 是保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入。
Filter.UpdateClientToken.description_en: The ClientToken from the last successful cluster update. ClientToken ensures request idempotency. The caller provides this string.

PageNumber.description_cn: 分页查询时的起始页码，从 1 开始，默认为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Starting page number for paginated queries. Begins at 1; default is 1

PageSize.description_cn:
分页查询时每页显示的记录数，取值：

* 最小值：1
* 最大值：100
* 默认值：10
PageSize.description_en:
Number of records displayed per page when paginating:

* Minimum: 1
* Maximum: 100
* Default: 10

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称，即按照集群所属的项目筛选查询集群。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name: filter and query clusters by the project they belong to

Tags.description_cn:
基于标签查询集群列表。

* **Tags** 中各个 **Key** 不可重复。
* **Tags** 中的 **Key**、**Value** 不允许在最前或最后输入空格。
* 单次最多支持 10 个标签。
Tags.description_en:
Query the cluster list by tags.

* Each **Key** in **Tags** must be unique.
* Leading or trailing spaces are not allowed in **Key** or **Value** in **Tags**.
* Up to 10 tags are supported per request.

Tags.Key.description_cn:
标签键。

* 不能以任何大小写形式的volc:开头。
* 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和特殊符号`_ . : / = + - @`。
* 长度限制为 1～128 个字符。
Tags.Key.description_en:
Tag key.

* Cannot start with volc: (case-insensitive).
* Only language characters, numbers, spaces, and special symbols `_ . : / = + - @` are allowed.
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

Tags.Value.description_cn:
单个标签值，用于在同一个标签键下匹配一个候选值。

* 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和特殊符号`_ . : / = + - @`。
* 长度不超过 256 个字符。
* 可以为空。

与 **Values** 同时传入时，标签值合并为同一候选值集合进行匹配，不互斥、不去重。
Tags.Value.description_en:
Single tag value, used to match a candidate value under the same tag key

* Only language characters, numbers, spaces, and special symbols `_ . : / = + - @` are allowed
* Maximum length is 256 characters
* Can be empty

When **Values** are provided at the same time, tag values are merged into the same candidate value set for matching. They are not mutually exclusive and are not deduplicated

Tags.Values.description_cn:
标签值列表，用于在同一个标签键下匹配多个候选值。

* 每个标签值需满足如下条件：
   * 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和特殊符号`_ . : / = + - @`。
   * 长度不超过 256 个字符。
* 多个标签值之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
* 可以为空。
* 传入参数值后，集群命中该列表中任意一个标签值均会被筛选。

与 **Value** 同时传入时，标签值合并为同一候选值集合进行匹配，不互斥、不去重。
Tags.Values.description_en:
Tag value list, used to match multiple candidate values under the same tag key

* Each tag value must meet the following requirements:
   * Only language characters, numbers, spaces, and special symbols `_ . : / = + - @` are allowed
   * Maximum length is 256 characters
* Separate multiple tag values with a half-width comma (,)
* Can be empty
* After parameter values are provided, any cluster that matches any tag value in this list will be included in the results

When **Value** is provided at the same time, tag values are merged into the same candidate value set for matching. They are not mutually exclusive and are not deduplicated

    - If the API caller has role permissions: Returns only the Kubeconfig information for that role

Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_cn:
按节点池当前状态下的状态条件过滤，取值：

* **Progressing**：进行中
* **Ok**：正常
* **ResourceCleanupFailed**：资源清理失败
* **Unknown**：未知原因导致创建失败
* **ClusterNotRunning**：集群异常
* **ScalingFailed**：伸缩失败
* **ClusterVersionUpgrading**：节点池中的节点版本升级中

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合，请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_en:
Filter by the current status conditions of the node pool. Possible values:

* **Progressing**: In progress
* **Ok**: Normal
* **ResourceCleanupFailed**: Resource cleanup failed
* **Unknown**: Creation failed due to unknown reasons
* **ClusterNotRunning**: Cluster not running
* **ScalingFailed**: Scaling failed
* **ClusterVersionUpgrading**: Node version upgrade in progress within the node pool

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_cn:

* **Creating**：创建中

* **Updating**：更新中
* **Deleting**：删除中
* **Scaling**：伸缩中
* **Failed**：异常

Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_en:
Filter by the status of the node pool. Possible values:

* **Creating**: Creating
* **Running**: Running
* **Updating**: Updating
* **Deleting**: Deleting
* **Scaling**: Scaling
* **Failed**: Error

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

* Only language characters, numbers, spaces, and special symbols `_ . : / = + - @` are allowed.
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

Tags.Value.description_cn:

Tags.Value.description_en:

* Can be empty

When **Values** are provided at the same time, tag values are merged into the same candidate value set for matching. They are not mutually exclusive and are not deduplicated

与 **Value** 同时传入时，标签值合并为同一候选值集合进行匹配，不互斥、不去重。

When **Value** is provided at the same time, tag values are merged into the same candidate value set for matching. They are not mutually exclusive and are not deduplicated

Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_cn:
节点池当前主状态下的状态条件，即进入该主状态的原因，可以有多个原因，取值：

* **Progressing**：处理中
* **Ok**：正常
* **Unschedulable**：不可调度
* **InitilizeFailed**：初始化失败
* **NotReady**：异常
* **Balance**：账号欠费
* **ResourceCleanupFailed**：节点关联资源移除失败
* **Unknown**：未知错误
* **ClusterVersionUpgrading**：节点版本升级中

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Conditions.Type.description_en:
Status conditions under the current main status of the node pool, indicating the reasons for entering this main status. There may be multiple reasons. Possible values:

* **Progressing**: In progress
* **Ok**: Normal
* **Unschedulable**: Unschedulable
* **InitializeFailed**: Initialization failed
* **NotReady**: Error
* **Balance**: Account overdue
* **ResourceCleanupFailed**: Failed to remove resources associated with the node
* **Unknown**: Unknown error
* **ClusterVersionUpgrading**: Node version upgrading

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_cn:
节点的状态，取值：

* **Creating**：创建中
* **Running**：运行中
* **Deleting**：删除中
* **Failed**：异常
* **Updating**：更新中

**Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 两者至少有一个参数必填，否则为无效数组元素。合法的 **Phase** 和 **Conditions.Type** 组合请参见 [资源状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979)。
Filter.Statuses.Phase.description_en:
Node status. Possible values:

* **Creating**: Creating
* **Running**: Running
* **Deleting**: Deleting
* **Failed**: Error
* **Updating**: Updating

At least one of **Phase** or **Conditions.Type** must be specified; otherwise, the array element is invalid. For valid combinations of **Phase** and **Conditions.Type**, see [Resource Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/118979).

Filter.DeployModes.description_en:
Supported deployment modes:

- **Unmanaged**: Retrieve components deployed in unmanaged mode
- **Managed**: Retrieve components deployed in managed mode
- If blank: Retrieve components from all deployment modes

Filter.DeployNodeTypes.description_cn:
部署节点类型。仅`DeployMode=Unmanaged`时，才需要指定。取值：

- **Node**：获取以节点（云服务器）方式部署的组件。
- **VirtualNode**：获取以虚拟节点（弹性容器实例）方式部署的组件。
- 为空：获取全部部署节点类型的组件。
Filter.DeployNodeTypes.description_en:
Deployment node type. Specify only when `DeployMode=Unmanaged`. Options:

- **Node**: Get components deployed on nodes (cloud servers)
- **VirtualNode**: Get components deployed on virtual nodes (elastic container instances)
- Leave blank: Get components of all deployment node types

Filter.Necessaries.description_en:

Filter.PodNetworkModes.description_cn:
组件支持的容器（Pod）网络模型（CNI），取值：

- **Flannel**：Flannel 网络模型，独立的 Underlay 容器网络方案，配合私有网络（VPC）的全局路由能力，实现集群高性能的网络体验。
- **VpcCniShared**：VPC-CNI 网络模型，基于私有网络的弹性网卡 ENI 实现的 Underlay 容器网络方案，具有较高的网络通信性能。
Filter.PodNetworkModes.description_en:
Supported container (Pod) network models (CNI):

- **Flannel**: Flannel network model. An independent underlay container network solution that works with global routing in private networks (VPC) to deliver high-performance networking for clusters
- **VpcCniShared**: VPC-CNI network model. An underlay container network solution based on elastic network interfaces (ENI) in private networks, offering high network communication performance

ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID where the node pool resides.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current status of the cluster.

Count.description_cn:
扩容节点数量，取值为大于 0 的整数。
该参数的取值上限与节点池的期望节点数配置相关：

* 节点池的期望节点数（`DesiredReplicas`）+ 扩容节点数（`Count`）总和不能超过节点池上限值 2000。
* 节点池开启弹性伸缩时，扩容后的节点总数不能超过`MaxReplicas` 参数配置。
* `DesiredReplicas`和`MaxReplicas`的配置方式，请参见 [CreateNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115194)。
Count.description_en:
Number of nodes to scale up. Must be an integer greater than 0.
The upper limit for this parameter depends on the expected node count configuration of the node pool:

* The sum of the node pool's expected node count (`DesiredReplicas`) and the number of nodes to scale up (`Count`) must not exceed the node pool limit of 2000.
* If auto scaling is enabled for the node pool, the total number of nodes after scaling must not exceed the `MaxReplicas` parameter.
* For configuration methods of `DesiredReplicas` and `MaxReplicas`, see [CreateNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115194).

Id.description_cn:
节点池 ID。
可以调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口，获取节点池 ID。
节点池必须处于`{Running,[*]}`或`{Scaling,[Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口获取节点池当前的状态。
Id.description_en:
Node pool ID.
You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to obtain the node pool ID.
The node pool must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Scaling,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to check the current status of the node pool.

DefaultDeleteAllResources.description_cn:
设置删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI（[DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188)、[DeleteNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115196)、[DeleteNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115199)、[DeleteAddon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115205)）的全局策略，将 OpenAPI 的默认行为调整为同步删除相关资源，避免资源残留：

- **false**：初始值，代表调用删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 时，继续使用旧参数 **CascadingDeleteResources**，该参数默认值为保留全部集群相关资源，不级联删除。
- **true**：代表调用删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 时，使用新参数 **RetainResources**，该参数默认值为删除全部集群相关资源，避免资源残留产生不必要费用。

为当前参数赋值 **true** 后，在 30 日内未进行二次变更，即认为已经认可新的参数配置策略。后续上述 OpenAPI 调用中将只允许传入 **RetainResources** 参数来指定删除时所需要保留的资源。
DefaultDeleteAllResources.description_en:
Configure the global policy for cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs ([DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188), [DeleteNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115196), [DeleteNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115199), [DeleteAddon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115205)). Change the default OpenAPI behavior to synchronously delete related resources to prevent resource remnants.

- **false**: Default value. When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the legacy parameter **CascadingDeleteResources** is used. By default, this parameter retains all cluster-related resources and does not perform cascading deletion.
- **true**: When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the new parameter **RetainResources** is used. By default, this parameter deletes all cluster-related resources to avoid unnecessary costs from leftover resources.

If you set this parameter to **true** and do not change it again within 30 days, the new parameter configuration policy will be considered accepted. Afterward, only the **RetainResources** parameter will be allowed in the above OpenAPI calls to specify which resources to retain during deletion.

When adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, you must meet all of the following conditions:

* Both must have the same line type
* The shared bandwidth package must be IPv4 type
* The shared bandwidth package must not have security protection configured

* **2**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on usage duration, regardless of actual traffic.

ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_cn:
公网 IP 的线路类型，取值：

* **BGP**：BGP（多线）。
ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_en:
Public IP route type options:

* **BGP**: BGP (multi-line)

ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_cn:
注册集群 API Server 公网访问配置，取值：

* **false**：（默认值）关闭
* **true**：开启
ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_en:
Registered cluster API Server public network access configuration. Values:

* **false**: Disabled
* **true**: Enabled

ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_cn: 注册集群控制面在 VPC 内网络通信使用的子网 ID 列表。
ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_en: List of subnet IDs used for network communication of the registered cluster control plane within the VPC.

ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_cn:
待注册集群的 KubeConfig（需要进行 BASE64 编码），取值范围为 0～20480。
仅`Type=Direct`时才需配置，否则会被忽略。
ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_en:
KubeConfig for the cluster to be registered (must be BASE64 encoded), value range: 0–20480
Configure only when `Type=Direct`; otherwise, it will be ignored

ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_cn:
注册集群的连接方式，取值：

* **Direct**：直连模式，基于目标集群的 KubeConfig 的直连模式进行注册并管理。
* **Agent**：代理模式，在目标集群中基于 Agent  方式进行注册并管理。
ClusterConfig.ClusterConnectorConfigRequ.description_en:
Cluster registration connection methods include:

* **Direct**: Direct connection mode—register and manage the target cluster directly using its KubeConfig
* **Agent**: Agent mode—register and manage the target cluster using the Agent method

ClusterConfig.ResourcePublicAccessDefaul.description_cn:
集群内节点、应用的公网访问配置，取值：

* **false**：（默认值）关闭
* **true**：开启
ClusterConfig.ResourcePublicAccessDefaul.description_en:
Public network access configuration for nodes and applications within the cluster. Possible values:

* **false**: Disabled
* **true**: Enabled

ClusterConfig.SubnetIds.description_cn:
集群控制面在私有网络（VPC）内通信的子网 ID。
可以调用 [私有网络API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) 获取子网 ID。
 warning
- 请确保所有指定的 SubnetIds（包括但不限于本参数）属于同一个私有网络。
- 不支持删除已配置的子网。
- 最多可选择 3 个可用区的子网，每个可用区最多允许添加 2 个子网。
- 子网可用 IP 数至少为 1。
ClusterConfig.SubnetIds.description_en:
Subnet IDs used for cluster control plane communication within the private network (VPC)
You can call the [Private Network API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) to obtain subnet IDs
 warning
- Make sure all specified SubnetIds (including but not limited to this parameter) belong to the same private network
- Deleting configured subnets is not supported
- You can select subnets from up to 3 availability zones, with a maximum of 2 subnets per zone
- Each subnet must have at least 1 available IP address

DeleteProtectionEnabled.description_cn:
集群删除保护，取值：

* **false**：关闭删除保护。
* **true**：开启删除保护，不允许直接删除集群。更新集群后，可在调用 [DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188) 时，配置`Force`参数，选择强制删除集群。
DeleteProtectionEnabled.description_en:
Cluster deletion protection. Available values:

* **false**: Disable deletion protection
* **true**: Enable deletion protection. Direct cluster deletion is not allowed. After updating the cluster, you can configure the `Force` parameter when calling [DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188) to force delete the cluster

Description.description_cn: 集群描述，长度限制为 300 个字符以内。
Description.description_en: Cluster description, up to 300 characters
Description.example_cn: A Kubernetes Cluster Managed by VKE

Id.description_cn:
待更新集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
待更新的集群必须处于`{Running,[*]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
Id.description_en:
ID of the cluster to be updated.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID.
The cluster to be updated must be in the `{Running,[*]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current status of the cluster.

IrsaEnabled.description_cn:
当前集群是否启用 IRSA (IAM Role for Service Account) 能力，实现集群内 Pod 维度的 OpenAPI 权限隔离：

* **false**：（默认值）不开启
* **true**：开启
IrsaEnabled.description_en:
Whether IRSA (IAM Role for Service Account) is enabled for the current cluster to achieve OpenAPI permission isolation at the Pod level:

* **false**: (default) Disabled
* **true**: Enabled

KubernetesConfig.AdvancedConfig.Internal.description_cn:
是否为集群开启 API Server 私网域名访问，参数值说明：

* **true**：开启，节点侧组件通过私网域名访问 API Server。
* **false**：关闭。
KubernetesConfig.AdvancedConfig.Internal.description_en:
Enable API Server private domain access for the cluster. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. Node-side components access the API Server via the private domain name.
* **false**: Disabled.

KubernetesConfig.ClusterDomain.description_cn: 集群本地域名。域名由小数点（.）分隔的两个或更多部分组成，每个部分用小写字母、数字和中划线（-），且首尾必须为小写字母或数字，长度不超过 57 个字符。
KubernetesConfig.ClusterDomain.description_en: Cluster local domain name. The domain name consists of two or more parts separated by periods (.), each part using only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-), must start and end with a lowercase letter or number, and must not exceed 57 characters in length.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.description_cn: Kubernetes 核心组件的自定义参数配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.description_en: Custom parameter configuration for Kubernetes core components.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-apiserver 组件的自定义参数配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: Custom parameter configuration for the kube-apiserver component

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-apiserver 中除默认启用的准入控制插件之外，额外启用的准入控制插件列表。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: List of additional admission control plugins enabled in kube-apiserver, apart from the default ones.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否启用 AlwaysPullImages 准入控制插件。取值：

* **true**：启用，表示修改每个 Pod 的时候都强制重新拉取镜像。
* **false**：（默认值）不启用。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the AlwaysPullImages admission control plugin. Values:

* **true**: Enabled. Forces every Pod to always pull images when modified.
* **false**: (Default) Disabled.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否启用 PodNodeSelector 准入控制插件。取值：

* **true**：启用，表示强制给 Namespace 内所有 Pod 附加节点选择器，限制只能调度到特定标签的节点。
* **false**：（默认值）不启用。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the PodNodeSelector admission control plugin. Values:

* **true**: Enabled. Forces all Pods in the Namespace to use a node selector, restricting scheduling to nodes with specific labels.
* **false**: (Default) Disabled.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否启用 PodTolerationRestriction 准入控制插件。取值：

* **true**：启用，表示统一管理 Namespace 内 Pod 的 Tolerations，防止滥用高权限污点容忍。
* **false**：（默认值）不启用。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the PodTolerationRestriction admission control plugin. Values:

* **true**: Enabled. Centrally manages Tolerations for all Pods in the Namespace to prevent abuse of high-privilege taint tolerations.
* **false**: (Default) Disabled.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
Pod 对节点`NotReady:NoExecute`污点的容忍时长。

* 单位：秒
* 取值范围：[1, 3000]
* 默认值：300
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Pod toleration duration for node `NotReady:NoExecute` taint.

* Unit: seconds
* Value range: [1, 3000]
* Default value: 300

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
Pod 对节点`Unreachable:NoExecute`污点的容忍时长。

* 单位：秒
* 取值范围：[1, 3000]
* 默认值：300
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Pod toleration duration for node `Unreachable:NoExecute` taint.

* Unit: seconds
* Value range: [1, 3000]
* Default value: 300

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-apiserver 的特性门控配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: Feature gate configuration for kube-apiserver.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 InPlacePodVerticalScaling 特性开关，支持 Pod 原地垂直伸缩。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-apiserver 自身的默认策略决定。

仅 Kubernetes v1.34 版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature gate to support in-place vertical scaling for Pods. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Default is empty, which means the feature gate is not overridden and the default policy of kube-apiserver applies.

This feature gate is only supported in VKE clusters running Kubernetes v1.34.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 MaxUnavailableStatefulSet 特性开关，支持为 StatefulSet 的滚动更新增加`maxUnavailable`配置，允许更新时同时让多个 Pod 处于不可用状态并行更新。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-apiserver 自身的默认策略决定。

仅以下版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控：

* v1.36 ≤ 集群版本
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the MaxUnavailableStatefulSet feature gate to add the `maxUnavailable` configuration for StatefulSet rolling updates, allowing multiple Pods to be unavailable and updated in parallel. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Default is empty, which means the feature gate is not overridden and the default policy of kube-apiserver applies.

This feature gate is only supported in the following VKE cluster versions:

* v1.36 ≤ Cluster Version

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 SidecarContainers 特性开关，支持原生 Sidecar 容器。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-apiserver 自身的默认策略决定。

仅以下版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控：

* v1.30 ≤ 集群版本 ≤ v1.32
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the SidecarContainers feature gate to support native sidecar containers. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Default is empty, which means the feature gate is not overridden and the default policy of kube-apiserver applies.

This feature gate is only supported in the following VKE cluster versions:

* v1.30 ≤ Cluster Version ≤ v1.32

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC 特性开关，支持 StatefulSet 自动删除 PVC。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-apiserver 自身的默认策略决定。

仅以下版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控：

* v1.28 ≤ 集群版本 ≤ v1.30
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC feature gate to allow StatefulSet to automatically delete PVCs. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Default is empty, which means the feature gate is not overridden and the default policy of kube-apiserver applies.

This feature gate is only supported in the following VKE cluster versions:

* v1.28 ≤ Cluster Version ≤ v1.30

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
请求超时时间，即处理程序保持请求打开的最长时间。

* 取值格式：`数字+s`，例如`60s`表示 60 秒。
* 取值范围：[60s, 180s]
* 默认值：60s
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Request timeout, which is the maximum duration the handler keeps the request open.

* Value format: `number+s`, for example, `60s` means 60 seconds
* Value range: [60s, 180s]
* Default value: 60s

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-controller-manager 组件的自定义参数配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: Custom parameter configuration for the kube-controller-manager component

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
允许并发同步的 HPA 对象数量。数值越大，HPA 对象处理响应越快，但会占用更多 CPU 及网络资源。

* 默认值：5
* 取值范围：正整数

仅 Kubernetes v1.26 及以上版本集群支持该参数。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Number of HPA objects allowed for concurrent synchronization. Higher values enable faster HPA object processing but consume more CPU and network resources.

* Default: 5
* Range: positive integers

This parameter is supported only in Kubernetes v1.26 and above.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
负责清理过期 Job 的 TTLAfterFinished 控制器的并发同步协程数。

* 默认值：10
* 取值范围：[1, 50]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Number of concurrent sync goroutines for the TTLAfterFinished controller responsible for cleaning up expired Jobs.

* Default: 10
* Range: [1, 50]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-controller-manager 的特性门控配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: Feature gate configuration for kube-controller-manager.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 InPlacePodVerticalScaling 特性开关，支持 Pod 原地垂直伸缩。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-controller-manager 自身的默认策略决定。

仅 Kubernetes v1.34 版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature
Supports in-place vertical scaling for Pods. Parameter values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Empty value: The feature gate is determined by the default policy of kube-controller-manager

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 MaxUnavailableStatefulSet 特性开关，支持为 StatefulSet 的滚动更新增加`maxUnavailable`配置，允许更新时同时让多个 Pod 处于不可用状态并行更新。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-controller-manager 自身的默认策略决定。

仅以下版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控：

* v1.36 ≤ 集群版本
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the MaxUnavailableStatefulSet feature
Allows adding the 'maxUnavailable' configuration for StatefulSet rolling updates, enabling multiple Pods to be unavailable and updated in parallel. Parameter values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Empty value: The feature gate is determined by the default policy of kube-controller-manager

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC 特性开关，支持 StatefulSet 自动删除 PVC。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-controller-manager 自身的默认策略决定。

仅以下版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控：

* v1.28 ≤ 集群版本 ≤ v1.30
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC feature
Allows StatefulSet to automatically delete PVCs. Parameter values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Empty value: The feature gate is determined by the default policy of kube-controller-manager

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
HPA 同步 Pod 数量的周期。

* 取值格式：`数字+s`或`数字+m`，例如`15s`表示 15 秒，`1m`表示 1 分钟。
* 默认值：15s
* 取值范围：[5s, 1m]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
HPA Pod synchronization interval.

* Value format: `number+s` or `number+m`, for example, `15s` means 15 seconds, `1m` means 1 minute
* Default: 15s
* Range: [5s, 1m]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
Pod 水平自动扩缩容（HPA）时，若实际指标与期望指标的偏差小于此容差率，则不会触发扩缩容。

* 默认值：0.1
* 取值范围： [0, 1.0]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
During Pod horizontal autoscaling (HPA), scaling is not triggered if the deviation between actual and target metrics is less than this tolerance rate.

* Default: 0.1
* Range: [0, 1.0]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
kube-controller-manager 与 APIServer 通信时的突发请求上限。

* 默认值：100
* 取值范围：[1, 10000]

**KubeApiBurst** 的取值必须大于等于 **KubeApiQps** 取值。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Burst request limit for kube-controller-manager communication with APIServer.

* Default: 100
* Range: [1, 10000]

The value of **KubeApiBurst** must be greater than or equal to **KubeApiQps**.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
kube-controller-manager 与 APIServer 通信的 QPS 限制。

* 默认值：50
* 取值范围：[1, 10000]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
QPS limit for kube-controller-manager communication with APIServer.

* Default: 50
* Range: [1, 10000]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
集群的大规模阈值，节点控制器根据此阈值判断集群是否为大规模集群，以决定 Pod 驱逐策略。

* 默认值：50
* 取值范围：[1,10000]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Large-scale cluster threshold. The node controller uses this threshold to determine whether the cluster is large-scale and to decide the Pod eviction strategy.

* Default value: 50
* Value range: [1,10000]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
节点故障场景下的 Pod 驱逐速率。当所在可用区处于健康状态时，此参数控制每秒被选中进行 Pod 驱逐的节点数。

* 默认值：0.1，表示每秒驱逐 0.1 个节点，即每 10 秒驱逐 1 个节点。
* 取值范围：[0, 1.0]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Pod eviction rate in node failure scenarios. When the availability zone is healthy, this parameter controls the number of nodes selected per second for Pod eviction.

* Default: 0.1, meaning 0.1 node evicted per second (1 node every 10 seconds)
* Range: [0, 1.0]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
节点失联后，被标记为`NotReady`或`Unknown`的时间。

* 取值格式：`数字+s`，例如`50s`表示 50 秒。
* 默认值：50s
* 取值范围：[1, 10000]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Time after node disconnection before being marked as `NotReady` or `Unknown`.

* Value format: `number+s`, for example, `50s` means 50 seconds
* Default: 50s
* Range: [1, 10000]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
大面积故障时的第二档排空节点速率。当所在可用区被判定为“不健康”（故障比例超过UnhealthyZoneThreshold配置时），且节点失效时，每秒从此参数指定数量的节点上驱逐 Pod。

* 默认值：0.01
* 取值范围：[0, 1.0]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Second-tier node draining rate during large-scale failures. When the availability zone is determined to be 'unhealthy' (failure ratio exceeds UnhealthyZoneThreshold), and nodes fail, Pods are evicted from the number of nodes specified by this parameter per second.

* Default: 0.01
* Range: [0, 1.0]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
Terminated Pod 垃圾回收阈值，即可以保留的 Terminated Pod 最大数量。

* 默认值：12500
* 取值范围：[10000, 50000]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Terminated Pod garbage collection threshold, i.e., the maximum number of terminated Pods that can be retained.

* Default: 12500
* Range: [10000, 50000]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
可用区的不健康阈值。当同一个可用区内处于 NotReady 状态的节点比例超过此数值时，控制面会判定该可用区发生了整体基础设施异常，从而触发区域级的限流驱逐策略。

* 默认值：0.55
* 取值范围：[0, 1.0]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Unhealthy threshold for an availability zone. If the proportion of nodes in NotReady state within the same zone exceeds this value, the control plane will determine that the zone has experienced a general infrastructure failure and trigger zone-level throttled eviction policies.

* Default: 0.55
* Range: [0, 1.0]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-scheduler 组件的自定义参数配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: Custom parameter configuration for the kube-scheduler component

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn: kube-scheduler 的特性门控配置。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en: Feature gate configuration for kube-scheduler

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 InPlacePodVerticalScaling 特性开关，支持 Pod 原地垂直伸缩。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-scheduler 自身的默认策略决定。

仅 Kubernetes v1.34 版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the InPlacePodVerticalScaling feature gate to support in-place vertical scaling for Pods. Options:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Default is empty, which means the feature gate is not overridden and the kube-scheduler's default policy applies.

This feature gate is only supported in VKE clusters running Kubernetes v1.34.

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
是否开启 SidecarContainers 特性开关，支持原生 Sidecar 容器。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭
* 默认空值，表示不覆盖该特性门控，由 kube-scheduler 自身的默认策略决定。

仅以下版本 VKE 集群中支持使用该特性门控：

* v1.30 ≤ 集群版本 ≤ v1.32
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Enable the SidecarContainers feature gate to support native Sidecar containers. Options:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable
* Default is empty, which means the feature gate is not overridden and the kube-scheduler's default policy applies.

This feature gate is only supported in the following VKE cluster versions:

* v1.30 ≤ Cluster Version ≤ v1.32

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
kube-scheduler 与 APIServer 通信时的突发请求上限。

* 默认值：100
* 取值范围：[1, 10000]

**KubeApiBurst** 的取值必须大于等于 **KubeApiQps** 取值。
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Burst request limit for kube-scheduler communicating with APIServer

* Default value: 100
* Value range: [1, 10000]

The value of **KubeApiBurst** must be greater than or equal to **KubeApiQps**

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
kube-scheduler 与 APIServer 通信的 QPS 限制。

* 默认值：50
* 取值范围：[1, 10000]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
QPS limit for kube-scheduler communicating with APIServer

* Default value: 50
* Value range: [1, 10000]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
kube-scheduler 在执行调度算法时同时并行执行的 Goroutine 数量。

* 默认值：16
* 取值范围：正整数
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Number of Goroutines running in parallel when kube-scheduler executes the scheduling algorithm

* Default value: 16
* Value range: positive integers

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
调度 Pod 时评估的可运行节点比例，找到指定比例的节点后停止筛选。

* 默认值：50
* 单位：%
* 取值范围：[0, 100]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Percentage of runnable nodes evaluated when scheduling Pods; filtering stops after reaching the specified percentage

* Default value: 50
* Unit: %
* Value range: [0, 100]

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
为无法调度的 Pod 设置初始退避时间。

* 默认值：1
* 单位：秒
* 取值范围：正整数
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Set the initial backoff time for unschedulable Pods

* Default value: 1
* Unit: seconds
* Value range: positive integers

KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_cn:
Pod 调度失败后最大回退秒数，两次调度间隔不会低于当前回退秒数。

* 默认值：10
* 单位：秒
* 取值范围：[0, 3600]
KubernetesConfig.ControlPlaneConfig.Kube.description_en:
Maximum backoff seconds after Pod scheduling failure; the interval between scheduling attempts will not be less than the current backoff seconds

* Default value: 10
* Unit: seconds
* Value range: [0, 3600]

KubernetesConfig.CustomSans.description_cn: 自定义签发域名或 IP 能力，支持输入符合规范的自定义 IP、域名或 URI，多个配置以半角逗号（,）分隔。支持最多 6 条自定义证书 SAN（Subject Alternative Name）。更多使用说明，请参见 [使用自定义域名连接集群](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2301380)。
KubernetesConfig.CustomSans.description_en: Supports custom domain name or IP configuration. Enter valid custom IPs, domain names, or URIs, separated by commas (,). Up to 6 custom certificate SANs (Subject Alternative Name) are supported. For more usage instructions, see [Connect to the cluster using a custom domain name](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2301380).

LoggingConfig.LogProjectId.description_cn:
集群的日志项目（Log Project）ID。
* 不可以空字符串。
* 创建集群时，若`LogProjectId`不传参数值，表示由系统自动创建新的日志项目。
* 系统自动创建日志项目，按照`k8s-log-{clusterId}-{6位随机字符}`格式自动生成项目名称。
* 如果`LogSetups.Enabled`字段取值为`false`，则不会自动创建日志项目。
* 更新集群配置时，若`LogProjectId`已指定日志项目，则不可更新为空。
* 更新集群配置时，若集群不存在任何日志配置，此时只传了`LogProjectId`且`LogSetups`为空时，`LogProjectId`将会被忽略。
* 更新`LogProjectId`会为处于开启状态的日志创建新的主题。
LoggingConfig.LogProjectId.description_en:
Cluster Log Project (Log Project) ID
* Cannot be an empty string
* When creating a cluster, if `LogProjectId` is not provided, the system will automatically create a new log project
* If the system automatically creates a log project, the project name is generated in the format `k8s-log-{clusterId}-{6 random characters}`
* If the `LogSetups.Enabled` field is set to `false`, the system will not automatically create a log project
* When updating cluster configuration, if `LogProjectId` has already specified a log project, it cannot be updated to empty
* When updating cluster configuration, if the cluster does not have any log configuration and only `LogProjectId` is provided while `LogSetups` is empty, `LogProjectId` will be ignored
* Updating `LogProjectId` will create a new topic for logs that are enabled

LoggingConfig.LogSetups.description_cn:
集群的日志选项信息。

* 空数组代表不开启任何日志。
* 首次开启日志时，日志主题（Log Topic）自动生成。
* 多个日志选项时，`LogType`不允许重复。
LoggingConfig.LogSetups.description_en:
Cluster log option information

* An empty array means no logs are enabled
* When logs are enabled for the first time, the log topic (Log Topic) is generated automatically
* When there are multiple log options, `LogType` must not be duplicated

LoggingConfig.LogSetups.Enabled.description_cn:
是否开启该日志选项，取值：

* **false**：（默认值）不开启
* **true**：开启

* 更新集群配置时，若`LogType`为`Audit`，则更改 `Enabled`会重启 APIServer。
* 更新集群配置时，若`Enabled`由`false`更换为`true`，则会创建新的日志主题。
LoggingConfig.LogSetups.Enabled.description_en:
Enable this log option. Possible values:

* **false**: Disabled
* **true**: Enabled

* When updating cluster configuration, if `LogType` is `Audit`, changing `Enabled` will restart the APIServer.
* When updating cluster configuration, if `Enabled` changes from `false` to `true`, a new log topic will be created.

LoggingConfig.LogSetups.LogTtl.description_cn:
日志在日志服务中的保存时间，超过指定的日志存储时长后，此日志主题中的过期日志会被自动清除。

* 取值范围：1～3650
* 单位：天
* 默认值：30 天
   指定为 3650 天表示永久存储。
LoggingConfig.LogSetups.LogTtl.description_en:
Log retention period in Log Service. Expired logs in this log topic will be automatically deleted after the specified storage duration.

* Value range: 1–3650
* Unit: days
   Setting 3650 days means permanent storage.

LoggingConfig.LogSetups.LogType.description_cn:
当前开启的日志类型，取值：

* **Audit**：集群审计日志
* **KubeApiServer**：kube-apiserver 组件日志
* **KubeScheduler**：kube-scheduler 组件日志
* **KubeControllerManager**：kube-controller-manager 组件日志
* **Etcd**：etcd 组件日志
* **ClusterAutoscaler**：cluster-autoscaler 组件日志
LoggingConfig.LogSetups.LogType.description_en:
Currently enabled log types include:

* **Audit**: Cluster audit logs
* **KubeApiServer**: kube-apiserver component logs
* **KubeScheduler**: kube-scheduler component logs
* **KubeControllerManager**: kube-controller-manager component logs
* **Etcd**: etcd component logs
* **ClusterAutoscaler**: cluster-autoscaler component logs

MaintenanceWindowConfig.Duration.description_cn: 运维持续时间，单位：小时；整数，取值范围为：[4,24]；运维时间不能小于4小时，不能大于24小时；
MaintenanceWindowConfig.Duration.description_en:
Duration of automated O&M, integer value, valid range is 4–24, unit: hours.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 4.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptEndDate.description_cn:
自动运维豁免窗口的结束时间，格式为`YYYYMMDD`，按北京时间（UTC +8）自然日执行。例如：配置为`20260704`时，表示截止到该日期的 23:59:59，不再执行自动运维任务。
