该日期必须晚于`ExemptStartDate`配置的日期，且最多不超过 60 天。
MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptEndDate.description_en:
End time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260704`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed up to and including 23:59:59 on that date.
This date must be later than the date configured for `ExemptStartDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptStartDate.description_cn:
自动运维豁免窗口的开始时间，格式为`YYYYMMDD`，按北京时间（UTC +8）自然日执行。例如：配置为`20260702`时，表示从该日期的 00:00:00 点起，不再执行自动运维任务。
* 该日期必须早于`ExemptEndDate`配置的日期，且最多不超过 60 天。
* 在业务重保、封网等场景下，您可以通过配置豁免窗口来禁止系统的自动运维操作。
MaintenanceWindowConfig.ExemptStartDate.description_en:
Start time of the automated O&M exemption window. Format: `YYYYMMDD`, based on Beijing time (UTC +8) calendar days. For example, if set to `20260702`, automated O&M tasks will not be performed starting from 00:00:00 on that date.
* This date must be earlier than the date configured for `ExemptEndDate` and cannot exceed 60 days.
* In scenarios such as critical business protection or network lockdown, you can configure the exemption window to disable automated O&M operations.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.StartTime.description_cn: 运维起始时间，仅开放设置一天中的整点，格式采用Golang标准时间格式；
MaintenanceWindowConfig.StartTime.description_en:
Start time for automated O&M, Golang standard time format, 24-hour clock. Valid values are whole hours from 00 to 23. For example: 01:00:00Z, 14:00:00Z.
If this parameter is not configured, the default value is 16:00:00Z, which is 16:00 UTC and 00:00:00 the next day in Beijing time (UTC +8).
* This parameter currently only supports UTC standard time. If you need to use another time zone, manually convert the time to UTC standard time.
* The `ExemptStartDate` and `ExemptEndDate` parameters default to UTC +8 time zone. When configured together with this parameter, ensure time zone consistency.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.description_cn: 运维任务配置，包含接入的所有运维类型；
MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.description_en:
Automated O&M task configuration.
If this parameter is not configured, the system only performs **routine cluster control plane O&M** tasks and does not perform other O&M tasks.

MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.Acti.description_cn:
任务类型, 取值范围如下：
    - DryRunTest: 空跑任务
    - FixClusterAPIServerTLS4Sweet32: 修复集群APIServer证书问题场景
    - AutoUpgradeAddonVersion: 自动升级Addon版本场景
MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.Acti.description_en:
Automated maintenance tasks. Options:

* **AutoUpgradeClusterMinorVersion**: Automated cluster patch version upgrade task
* **AutoUpgradeAddonVersion**: Automated component version upgrade task

MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.Grou.description_cn:
任务分组, 取值范围如下：
    - Cluster: 集群
    - Addon: 组件
    - NodePool: 节点池
MaintenanceWindowConfig.TaskConfigs.Grou.description_en:
Automated maintenance task groups. Options:

* **Cluster**: Control plane maintenance
* **Addon**: Data plane maintenance

MaintenanceWindowConfig.WeeklyCycle.description_cn:
运维窗口周期，取值范围如下：
    - Monday
    - Tuesday
    - Wednesday
    - Thursday
    - Friday
    - Saturday
    - Sunday
MaintenanceWindowConfig.WeeklyCycle.description_en:
Cycle for automated O&M. Valid values:

* **Monday**: Monday
* **Tuesday**: Tuesday
* **Wednesday**: Wednesday
* **Thursday**: Thursday
* **Friday**: Friday
* **Saturday**: Saturday
* **Sunday**: Sunday

If this parameter is not configured, the system performs O&M tasks every day.

MonitoringConfig.ComponentConfigs.Enable.description_cn:
是否开启控制面组件监控，取值：

* **true**：开启控制面组件监控。
* **flase**：（默认值）不开启控制面组件监控。
MonitoringConfig.ComponentConfigs.Enable.description_en:
Enable control plane component monitoring. Options:

* **true**: Enabled
* **false**: (default) Disabled

MonitoringConfig.ComponentConfigs.Name.description_cn: 需要监控的集群控制面组件，支持：KubeApiServer、KubeScheduler、Etcd 和 ClusterAutoscaler。
MonitoringConfig.ComponentConfigs.Name.description_en: Cluster control plane components to monitor. Options: KubeApiServer, KubeScheduler, Etcd, and ClusterAutoscaler.

MonitoringConfig.EnableMetricsExternalCo.description_cn:
是否开启外部 Promtheus 采集集群控制面组件指标，取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：（默认值）不开启

开启该功能后，您可以使用自建 Prometheus 采集集群控制面托管组件的指标，详情请参见 [使用自建 Prometheus 采集控制面组件指标](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1928314)。
MonitoringConfig.EnableMetricsExternalCo.description_en:
Enable external Prometheus collection of cluster control plane component metrics. Possible values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: (default) Disable

After enabling this feature, you can use your self-hosted Prometheus to collect metrics from managed control plane components in the cluster. For details, see [Use self-hosted Prometheus to collect control plane component metrics](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1928314).

MonitoringConfig.WorkspaceId.description_cn:
集群监控使用的托管 Prometheus 工作区 ID。
可以调用 [托管 Promethues API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/1037505) 获取工作区 ID。
MonitoringConfig.WorkspaceId.description_en:
Managed Prometheus workspace ID used for cluster monitoring.
You can call the [Managed Prometheus API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/1037505) to get the workspace ID.

Name.description_cn:
集群名称。

* 同一个地域下，名称必须唯一。
* 支持大小写英文字母、汉字、数字、短划线（-），长度限制为 2～64 个字符。
Name.description_en:
Cluster name.

* Must be unique within the same region
* Supports uppercase and lowercase English letters, Chinese characters, numbers, and hyphens (-). Length must be 2–64 characters

PodsConfig.FlannelConfig.SubnetIds.description_cn:
Flannel 容器网络模型对应的 Pod 子网 ID 列表。
`PodNetworkMode=Flannel`时才需填写，否则忽略。
可以调用 [私有网络API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) 获取子网 ID。
PodsConfig.FlannelConfig.SubnetIds.description_en:
List of Pod subnet IDs for the Flannel container network model
Only required when `PodNetworkMode=Flannel`; otherwise, ignore
You can call the [Private Network API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) to obtain subnet IDs

PodsConfig.VpcCniConfig.SubnetIds.description_cn:
VPC-CNI 容器网络模型对应的 Pod 子网 ID 列表。
`PodNetworkMode=VpcCniShared`时才需填写，否则忽略。
可以调用 [私有网络API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) 获取子网 ID。
更新集群时，仅支持在当前集群原有 Pod 子网基础上增加 Pod 子网。
PodsConfig.VpcCniConfig.SubnetIds.description_en:
List of Pod subnet IDs for the VPC-CNI container network model.
Only required when `PodNetworkMode=VpcCniShared`; otherwise, leave blank.
You can call the [Private Network API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) to obtain subnet IDs.
When updating the cluster, you can only add Pod subnets based on the existing Pod subnets in the current cluster.

PodsConfig.VpcCniConfig.VciSubnetIds.description_cn:
VPC-CNI 容器网络模型对应的 VCI Pod 子网 ID 列表。
`PodNetworkMode=VpcCniShared`时才需填写，否则忽略。
可以调用 [私有网络API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) 获取子网 ID。
VCI Pod 子网必须为 Pod 子网的子集。
PodsConfig.VpcCniConfig.VciSubnetIds.description_en:
List of VCI Pod subnet IDs for the VPC-CNI container network model.
Only required when `PodNetworkMode=VpcCniShared`; otherwise, ignore.
You can call the [Private Network API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) to obtain subnet IDs.
VCI Pod subnets must be a subset of Pod subnets.

RegisterMonitoringConfig.QueryUrl.description_cn:
注册集群使用托管 Prometheus 进行监控时，托管 Prometheus 工作区的 Query 地址。注册集群使用该地址，查询保存在工作区的监控数据。
更多工作区和地址介绍，请参见 [获取工作区地址](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/106506)。
RegisterMonitoringConfig.QueryUrl.description_en:
When registering a cluster for monitoring with managed Prometheus, use the Query address of the managed Prometheus workspace. The registered cluster uses this address to query monitoring data stored in the workspace.
For more information about workspaces and addresses, see [Get Workspace Address](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/106506).

RegisterMonitoringConfig.RemoteWriteUrl.description_cn:
注册集群使用托管 Prometheus 进行监控时，托管 Prometheus 工作区的 RemoteWrite 地址。注册集群使用该地址，将集群监控数据保存在指定的工作区中。
更多工作区和地址介绍，请参见 [获取工作区地址](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/106506)。
RegisterMonitoringConfig.RemoteWriteUrl.description_en:
When registering a cluster for monitoring with managed Prometheus, use the RemoteWrite address of the managed Prometheus workspace. The registered cluster uses this address to store monitoring data in the specified workspace.
For more information about workspaces and addresses, see [Get Workspace Address](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/106506).

RegisterMonitoringConfig.WorkspaceId.description_cn:
注册集群使用托管 Prometheus 进行监控时，托管 Prometheus 工作区的 ID。
可以调用 [托管 Promethues API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/1037505) 获取工作区 ID。
RegisterMonitoringConfig.WorkspaceId.description_en:
Managed Prometheus workspace ID when registering a cluster for monitoring with managed Prometheus
You can call the [Managed Prometheus API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6731/1037505) to obtain the workspace ID

SourceRegion.description_cn: 集群源地域信息。具体取值请参见 [地域和可用区](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/79643)。
SourceRegion.description_en: Cluster source region information. For specific values, see [Regions and Availability Zones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/79643)

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: The string used to ensure request idempotency. The caller must provide this string and ensure it is unique across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

Id.description_cn:
目标集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于`{Running,[Ok]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
Id.description_en:
Target cluster ID.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current cluster status.

IgnorePrecheckWarning.description_cn:
升级检查出现 **Warning** 时，是否停止升级过程，取值：

* **true**：升级检查结果为 **Warning** 时，忽略检查结果，继续升级集群控制面。
* **false**：（默认值）升级检查结果为 **Warning** 时，停止升级集群控制面。
IgnorePrecheckWarning.description_en:
Whether to stop the upgrade process when a **Warning** occurs during the upgrade check. Options:

* **true**: When the upgrade check result is **Warning**, ignore the check result and continue upgrading the cluster control plane.
* **false** (default): When the upgrade check result is **Warning**, stop upgrading the cluster control plane.

KubernetesVersion.description_cn: 要升级的目标 Kubernetes 版本，格式为`x.xx`。系统会自动升级到该 Kubernetes 版本对应的最新 VKE 补丁版本。容器服务已发布的 Kubernetes 版本，请参见 [Kubernetes 版本发布记录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/108841)。
KubernetesVersion.description_en: Target Kubernetes version to upgrade to, in the format `x.xx`. The system will automatically upgrade to the latest VKE patch version corresponding to this Kubernetes version. For released Kubernetes versions in Container Service, see [Kubernetes Version Release Notes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/108841).

Operation.description_cn:
执行的具体操作，取值：

* **Precheck**：（默认值）仅执行升级检查操作。
* **Upgrade**：直接执行升级任务，升级任务会包含一次升级检查，检查通过后继续执行升级操作。
Operation.description_en:
Specific operation to perform. Options:

* **Precheck** (default): Only perform the upgrade check.
* **Upgrade**: Directly execute the upgrade task. The upgrade task includes an upgrade check; after passing the check, the upgrade operation continues.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: A string used to ensure the idempotency of the request. This string is provided by the caller and must be unique across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

Enabled.description_cn:
巡检策略是否开启。取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：不开启
Enabled.description_en:
Whether the inspection policy is enabled. Values:

* **true**: enabled
* **false**: disabled

Id.description_cn:
巡检策略 ID。
可以调用 [ListInspectionPolicies](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2673957?lang=zh) 接口，获取巡检策略 ID。
Id.description_en:
Inspection policy ID.
You can call the [ListInspectionPolicies](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2673957?lang=zh) API to obtain the inspection policy ID.

Name.description_cn: 巡检策略名称。

ResourceIds.description_cn:
巡检对象 ID 列表。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
ResourceIds.description_en:
List of inspection object IDs.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain cluster IDs.

Schedule.description_cn: 巡检计划，需使用标准的 crontab 命令。例如， 0 0 13 * 5表示每月13 号和每周的星期五零点都会执行。
Schedule.description_en: Inspection schedule. You must use the standard crontab command. For example, 0 0 13 * 5 means the task will run at midnight on the 13th of each month and every Friday.

ClusterId.description_cn:
集群 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain the cluster ID.

ObservabilityComponentConfigs.description_cn:
基础观测服务配置列表。

* 每个数组元素表示一个服务的基础观测开关配置。
* 如需同时配置多个服务，可在数组中传入多个对象。
ObservabilityComponentConfigs.description_en:
Basic observability service configuration list.

* Each array element represents the basic observability switch configuration for a service.
* To configure multiple services at the same time, pass multiple objects in the array.

ObservabilityComponentConfigs.Component.description_cn:
需要开启基础观测的服务，取值：

* **vko.monitoring.container**：容器服务
* **vko.monitoring.ctrlPanel**：控制面服务
* **vko.monitoring.dns**：DNS 服务
* **vko.monitoring.cni**：CNI 网络
* **vko.monitoring.csi**：CSI 存储
* **vko.monitoring.ingress**：Ingress 服务
* **vko.monitoring.imageSpeedup**：镜像加速
* **vko.monitoring.imageRegistry**：镜像仓库
* **vko.monitoring.ai**：AI 资源
* **vko.aiopsRemediation**：检查自愈
ObservabilityComponentConfigs.Component.description_en:
Services that require basic monitoring to be enabled. Values:

* **vko.monitoring.container**: Container Service
* **vko.monitoring.ctrlPanel**: Control Plane Service
* **vko.monitoring.dns**: DNS Service
* **vko.monitoring.cni**: CNI Network
* **vko.monitoring.csi**: CSI Storage
* **vko.monitoring.ingress**: Ingress Service
* **vko.monitoring.imageSpeedup**: Image Acceleration
* **vko.monitoring.imageRegistry**: Image Registry
* **vko.monitoring.ai**: AI Resources
* **vko.aiopsRemediation**: Self-healing Check

ObservabilityComponentConfigs.Enabled.description_cn:
是否开启服务的基础观测功能，取值：

* **true**：开启，开启后系统将采集该服务的基础观测数据。
* **false**：关闭，关闭后系统不再采集该服务的基础观测数据。
ObservabilityComponentConfigs.Enabled.description_en:
Enable basic monitoring for the service. Values:

* **true**: Enable. The system will collect basic monitoring data for this service.
* **false**: Disable. The system will stop collecting basic monitoring data for this service.

AutoScaling.description_cn:
节点池伸缩策略。
默认节点池`vke-default-nodepool`不支持修改节点池伸缩策略。
AutoScaling.description_en:
Node pool scaling policy
The default node pool `vke-default-nodepool` does not support modifying the node pool scaling policy

AutoScaling.DesiredReplicas.description_cn:
配置节点池的期望节点数，取值范围：0~2000。
节点池开启弹性伸缩功能时，**DesiredReplicas** 需大于等于 **MinReplicas** 参数的值，小于等于 **MaxReplicas** 参数的值。
AutoScaling.DesiredReplicas.description_en:
Configure the desired number of nodes in the node pool. Value range: 0~2000.
When autoscaling is enabled for the node pool, **DesiredReplicas** must be greater than or equal to **MinReplicas** and less than or equal to **MaxReplicas**.

AutoScaling.Enabled.description_cn:
配置节点池弹性伸缩功能开关，取值：

* **false**：关闭。
* **true**：开启。
AutoScaling.Enabled.description_en:
Configure the autoscaling switch for the node pool. Values:

* **false**: Off
* **true**: On

AutoScaling.MaxReplicas.description_cn:
配置节点池的最大节点数，取值范围：1~2000。
仅在节点池开启弹性伸缩功能后，对该节点池生效。
AutoScaling.MaxReplicas.description_en:
Configure the maximum number of nodes in the node pool. Value range: 1~2000.
This only takes effect for the node pool after autoscaling is enabled.

AutoScaling.MinReplicas.description_cn:
配置节点池的最小节点数，取值说明：

* 最小值：0
* 最大值：小于 **MaxReplicas** 参数的值

仅在节点池开启弹性伸缩功能后，对该节点池生效。
AutoScaling.MinReplicas.description_en:
Configure the minimum number of nodes in the node pool. Value description:

* Minimum: 0
* Maximum: Less than the value of the **MaxReplicas** parameter

This only takes effect for the node pool after autoscaling is enabled.

AutoScaling.Priority.description_cn:
优先级，取值范围：0~100。
仅针对节点池开启弹性伸缩功能且扩容算法为`priority`时生效。
AutoScaling.Priority.description_en:
Priority. Value range: 0~100.
This only takes effect when autoscaling is enabled for the node pool and the scaling algorithm is set to `priority`.

AutoScaling.SubnetPolicy.description_cn:
节点池的多子网调度策略，用于在 Worker 节点扩容时按照子网优先级顺序进行调度。取值：

* **ZoneBalance**：可用区均衡策略，节点扩容时，新增的节点会分散到多个可用区的子网下，且保证各个可用区中的节点数相对均衡。
* **Priority**：子网优先级策略，按照子网列表的先后顺序调度。如果优先级最高的子网可以创建成功，则总在该子网下新增节点。
AutoScaling.SubnetPolicy.description_en:
Multi-subnet scheduling policy for the node pool, used to schedule expansion of worker nodes according to subnet priority order. Values:

* **ZoneBalance**: Availability zone balancing policy. When scaling out nodes, new nodes are distributed across subnets in multiple availability zones to ensure the number of nodes in each zone remains relatively balanced.
* **Priority**: Subnet priority policy. Scheduling follows the order of the subnet list. If the highest-priority subnet can be created successfully, new nodes are always added to that subnet.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: A string used to ensure request idempotency. The caller must provide this string and guarantee its uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

ClusterId.description_cn:
节点池所在集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于`{Running,[*]}`或 `{Updating,[Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
ID of the cluster where the node pool is located.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the current status of the cluster.

Id.description_cn:
节点池 ID。
可以调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口，获取节点池 ID。
节点池必须处于`{Running,[*]}`或`{Scaling,[Progressing]} `状态。可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口获取节点池当前的状态。
Id.description_en: Node pool ID. You can obtain the node pool ID by calling the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API.  The node pool must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Scaling,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to obtain the current status of the node pool.

KubernetesConfig.description_cn: 节点池 Kubernetes 的配置。

KubernetesConfig.AutoSyncDisabled.description_cn:
是否禁用自动同步标签污点到存量节点的功能，取值：

* **true**：禁用，即关闭自动同步。
* **false**：不禁用，即开启自动同步。
KubernetesConfig.AutoSyncDisabled.description_en:
Whether to disable automatic synchronization of labels and taints to existing nodes. Values:

* **true**: Disabled, automatic synchronization is turned off
* **false**: Not disabled, automatic synchronization is turned on

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.description_cn:
节点池 Containerd 相关配置。
默认节点池暂不支持 Containerd 配置，相关子参数的传入值不会生效。
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.description_en:
Node pool Containerd-related configuration
Default node pools do not support Containerd configuration; values for related sub-parameters will not take effect

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Concur.description_cn:
并发分块拉取单个镜像层时使用的缓冲区大小。正整数形式，单位为 Byte。
仅 containerd 为 v2.1.0 及以上版本时，支持配置该参数。
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Concur.description_en:
Buffer size used for concurrent chunked pulling of a single image layer. Must be a positive integer, in bytes.
This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Insecu.description_cn: 指定跳过证书认证的容器镜像仓库地址。

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_cn:
containerd 单次拉取镜像时可并发下载的镜像层最大数量。

* 正整数形式，默认值为 3。
* 未配置时，系统使用默认值。

仅 containerd 为 v2.1.0 及以上版本时，支持配置该参数。
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_en:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can download concurrently during a single image pull.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 3.
* If not configured, the system uses the default value.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_cn:
containerd 同时解压镜像层的最大数量。

* 正整数形式，默认值为 1。
* 仅在`UseLocalImagePull`配置为`false`时生效。

仅 containerd 为 v2.2.0 及以上版本时，支持配置该参数。
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.MaxCon.description_en:
Maximum number of image layers that containerd can decompress simultaneously.

* Must be a positive integer; default is 1.
* Takes effect only when `UseLocalImagePull` is set to `false`.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.2.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.Regist.description_cn: 容器镜像仓库代理配置。

KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.UseLoc.description_cn:
containerd 的镜像拉取模式。取值：

* **true**：（默认值）使用本地客户端拉取镜像。
* **false**：使用 Transfer Service 拉取镜像。

仅 containerd 为 v2.1.0 及以上版本时，支持配置该参数。
KubernetesConfig.ContainerdConfig.UseLoc.description_en:
Image pull mode for containerd. Values:

* **true** (default): Pull images using the local client.
* **false**: Pull images using the Transfer Service.

This parameter is supported only when containerd is version v2.1.0 or above.

KubernetesConfig.Cordon.description_cn:
封锁节点配置，取值：

* **false**：不封锁
* **true**：封锁

更新节点池（UpdateNodePoolConfig）时，若不传入参数值，则保持原有参数配置。
KubernetesConfig.Cordon.description_en:
Node blocking configuration. Values:

* **false**: Not blocked
* **true**: Blocked

When updating the node pool (UpdateNodePoolConfig), if no parameter value is provided, the original configuration is retained.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.description_cn:
节点池中节点的 kubelet 自定义参数配置，用于调整节点行为。
默认节点池暂不支持 kubelet 自定义参数配置，相关子参数的传入值不会生效。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.description_en:
Custom kubelet parameter configuration for nodes in the node pool, used to adjust node behavior.
The default node pool does not support custom kubelet parameter configuration. Values for related sub-parameters will not take effect.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.CpuCfsQuo.description_cn:
是否为设置了 CPU 限制的容器启用 CPU CFS 配额保障。

* **true**：启用
* **false**：不启用
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.CpuCfsQuo.description_en:
Enable CPU CFS quota guarantee for containers with CPU limits.

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.CpuManage.description_cn:
CPU 管理器策略。参数值说明：

* **none**：默认策略。
* **static**：允许为节点上具有某些资源特征的 Pod 赋予更强的 CPU 亲和性和独占性。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.CpuManage.description_en:
CPU manager policy. Parameter values:

* **none**: Default policy
* **static**: Allows Pods with certain resource characteristics on the node to have stronger CPU affinity and exclusivity

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.EvictionH.description_cn: 触发 Pod 驱逐操作的一组硬性门限。详细参数解释，请参见 [官方文档](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/node-pressure-eviction/)。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.EvictionH.description_en: A set of hard thresholds that trigger Pod eviction. For detailed parameter explanations, see the [official documentation](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/node-pressure-eviction/).

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.EvictionH.description_cn:
硬性门限名称。取值：
- memory.available
- nodefs.available
- nodefs.inodesFree
- imagefs.available
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.EvictionH.description_en:
Hard threshold names. Values:
- memory.available
- nodefs.available
- nodefs.inodesFree
- imagefs.available

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.EvictionH.description_cn:
硬性门限值。支持整数形式或百分比形式：

* 整数形式：表示资源的具体门限值，单位为字节，例如 100Mi。
* 百分比形式：表示资源的门限值占比，取值范围为 0%～100%，例如 20%。如果希望显式地禁用，可以在任意资源上将其阈值设置为 0% 或 100%。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.EvictionH.description_en:
Hard threshold values. Supports integer or percentage formats:

* Integer format: Specifies the exact threshold value for the resource, measured in bytes, for example 100Mi.
* Percentage format: Specifies the threshold as a percentage of the resource, ranging from 0% to 100%, for example 20%. To explicitly disable, set the threshold to 0% or 100% for any resource.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FailSwapO.description_cn:
当节点开启了 Swap 交换分区时，是否允许运行 kubelet。取值：

* **true**：禁止节点在开启 Swap 的情况下运行 kubelet。
* **false**：允许节点在开启 Swap 的情况下运行 kubelet。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FailSwapO.description_en:
Whether to allow kubelet to run when Swap is enabled on the node. Options:

* **true**: Prevent kubelet from running on nodes with Swap enabled.
* **false**: Allow kubelet to run on nodes with Swap enabled.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FeatureGa.description_cn: 特性门控，即描述 Kubernetes 特性的一组键值对。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FeatureGa.description_en: Feature gate, a set of key-value pairs that describe Kubernetes features.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FeatureGa.description_cn:
是否开启 Pod 垂直伸缩功能，取值：

* **true**：开启
* **false**：关闭

该配置仅支持在如下版本集群中使用，其余版本集群不支持配置，否则报错：

* v1.28.3-vke.17 ≤ 集群版本 < v1.36
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FeatureGa.description_en:
Enable Pod vertical scaling. Values:

* **true**: Enabled
* **false**: Disabled

This configuration is only supported in the following cluster versions. Other versions do not support this configuration and will result in an error:

* v1.28.3-vke.17 ≤ Cluster version < v1.36

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FeatureGa.description_cn:
是否启用 QoS 资源管理器，用于支持微拓扑调度。取值：

* **true**：启用 QoS 资源管理器。
* **false**：（默认）不启用 QoS 资源管理器。

该配置仅支持在以下版本的集群中使用：

* v1.24.15-vke.13 ≤ 集群版本 < v1.26
* v1.26.10-vke.13 ≤ 集群版本 < v1.28
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.FeatureGa.description_en:
Enable QoS Resource Manager to support micro-topology scheduling. Values:

* **true**: Enable QoS Resource Manager
* **false**: (Default) Disable QoS Resource Manager

This configuration is only supported in the following cluster versions:

* v1.24.15-vke.13 ≤ cluster version < v1.26
* v1.26.10-vke.13 ≤ cluster version < v1.28

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.ImageGCHi.description_cn: 镜像垃圾回收触发阈值，当磁盘使用率超过该值时，系统开始清理未使用的镜像。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.ImageGCHi.description_en: Image garbage collection trigger threshold. When disk usage exceeds this value, the system starts cleaning unused images.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.ImageGCLo.description_cn: 镜像垃圾回收停止阈值。在镜像垃圾回收执行过程中，当磁盘使用率降到该百分比以下时，停止回收。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.ImageGCLo.description_en: Image garbage collection stop threshold. During image garbage collection, when disk usage drops below this percentage, garbage collection stops.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeApiBu.description_cn: 每秒发送到 APIServer 的突发请求数量上限。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeApiBu.description_en: Maximum burst requests per second sent to the APIServer.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeApiQp.description_cn: 与 APIServer 通信的每秒查询个数。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeApiQp.description_en: Number of queries per second to the APIServer.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeReser.description_cn: 节点预留给 Kubernetes 系统组件的资源。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeReser.description_en: Resources reserved on the node for Kubernetes system components.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeReser.description_cn: 资源名称，取值为 **cpu** 或 **memory**。

指定资源的资源量。

* 当资源为 **cpu** 时，取值示例为 200m。
* 当资源为 **memory** 时，取值示例为 1G。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.KubeReser.description_en:
Specify the amount of the resource

* For the **cpu** resource, an example value is 200m
* For the **memory** resource, an example value is 1G

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.MaxPods.description_cn: 节点支持的最大 Pod 数量。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.MaxPods.description_en: Maximum number of Pods supported by the node.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.RegistryB.description_cn: 集群从镜像仓库拉取镜像的突发阈值。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.RegistryB.description_en: Burst threshold for pulling images from the image registry in the cluster.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.RegistryP.description_cn: 集群从镜像仓库拉取镜像的 QPS 阈值。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.RegistryP.description_en: QPS threshold for pulling images from the image registry in the cluster.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.Serialize.description_cn:
是否串行拉取镜像，参数值说明：

* **true**：串行拉取镜像。
* **false**：并行拉取镜像。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.Serialize.description_en:
Enable serial image pulling. Parameter values:

* **true**: Pull images serially
* **false**: Pull images in parallel

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.SystemRes.description_cn: 节点预留给操作系统的资源。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.SystemRes.description_en: Resources reserved on the node for the operating system.

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.SystemRes.description_cn: 资源名称，取值为 **cpu** 或 **memory**。

指定资源的资源量。

* 当资源为 **cpu** 时，取值示例为 200m。
* 当资源为 **memory** 时，取值示例为 1G。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.SystemRes.description_en:
Specify the amount of the resource

* For the **cpu** resource, an example value is 200m
* For the **memory** resource, an example value is 1G

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.TopologyM.description_cn:
拓扑管理策略，参数值说明：

* **none**：禁用拓扑管理策略。
* **restricted**：kubelet 仅接受在所请求资源上实现最佳 NUMA 的 Pod。
* **best-effort**：kubelet 会优先选择在 CPU 和设备资源上实现 NUMA 的 Pod。
* **single-numa-node**：kubelet 仅允许在同一个节点的 CPU 和设备资源上实现 NUMA 的 Pod。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.TopologyM.description_en:
Topology manager policy. Parameter values:

* **none**: Disable topology manager policy
* **restricted**: kubelet only accepts Pods that achieve optimal NUMA on requested resources
* **best-effort**: kubelet prefers Pods that achieve NUMA on CPU and device resources
* **single-numa-node**: kubelet only allows Pods that achieve NUMA on CPU and device resources within the same node

KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.TopologyM.description_cn:
拓扑管理策略的资源粒度，参数值说明：

* **container**：表示资源对齐粒度为容器级。
KubernetesConfig.KubeletConfig.TopologyM.description_en:
Resource granularity for the topology manager policy. Parameter values:

* **container**: Resource alignment at the container level.

KubernetesConfig.Labels.description_cn:
节点池/节点的 Kubernetes 标签（Labels）信息。最多可传入 20 个标签。

节点池会统一管理节点的标签配置信息，因此标签信息会同步到节点池内的所有节点上。当标签发生变更时，会覆盖原有的标签配置信息。
KubernetesConfig.Labels.description_en:
Kubernetes labels for node pools and nodes. You can add up to 20 labels.

Node pools manage label configuration for all nodes. Label information is synchronized to every node in the pool and will overwrite previous label settings when changed.

KubernetesConfig.NamePrefix.description_cn:
Kubernetes 中节点对象的元数据名称前缀。前缀校验规则如下：

* 支持英文小写字母、数字、中划线(`-`)和半角句号(`.`)。
* 只能以英文小写字母或者数字开头。
* 长度限制为 1~48 个字符。
KubernetesConfig.NamePrefix.description_en:
Prefix for the metadata name of node objects in Kubernetes. The prefix validation rules are as follows:

* Supports lowercase English letters, numbers, hyphens (`-`), and periods (`.`)
* Must start with a lowercase English letter or number
* Length must be between 1 and 48 characters

KubernetesConfig.NameSuffix.description_cn: Kubernetes 中节点对象的元数据名称后缀。
KubernetesConfig.NameSuffix.description_en: Suffix of node object metadata name in Kubernetes

KubernetesConfig.NameUseHostname.description_cn:
Kubernetes 中节点对象的元数据名称是否使用 ECS 主机名称，取值：

* **true**：使用 ECS 主机名称作为节点名称。
* **false**：不使用 ECS 主机名称作为节点名称。

该配置优先级高于`NamePrefix`和`NameSuffix`。
KubernetesConfig.NameUseHostname.description_en:
Whether to use the ECS host name as the metadata name for node objects in Kubernetes. Values:

* **true**: Use the ECS host name as the node name.
* **false**: Do not use the ECS host name as the node name.

This setting takes precedence over `NamePrefix` and `NameSuffix`.

KubernetesConfig.Runtime.Type.description_cn:
容器运行时类型，取值：

* **containerd**：containerd 运行时。
KubernetesConfig.Runtime.Type.description_en:
Container runtime type. Options:

* **containerd**: containerd runtime.

KubernetesConfig.Runtime.Version.description_cn:
容器运行时版本，格式为`x.x.x`。
容器服务已发布的 containerd 版本，请参见 [containerd 运行时发布记录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2228388)。
更新后的 containerd 版本仅对节点池中新扩容出的节点生效。
KubernetesConfig.Runtime.Version.description_en:
Container runtime version, format: `x.x.x`.
For released containerd versions in Container Service, see [containerd runtime release notes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2228388).
The updated containerd version only applies to newly expanded nodes in the node pool.

KubernetesConfig.Taints.description_cn:
节点池/节点的 Kubernetes 污点（Taints）信息。最多可传入 20 个污点。

节点池会统一管理节点的污点配置信息，因此污点信息会同步到节点池内的所有节点上。当污点发生变更时，会覆盖原有的污点配置信息。
KubernetesConfig.Taints.description_en:
Kubernetes taint information for node pools and nodes. You can add up to 20 taints.

Node pools manage taint configuration for all nodes in the pool. Taint information is synchronized across all nodes. When you update taints, the new configuration overwrites the previous settings.

KubernetesConfig.Taints.Effect.description_cn:
污点效果，参数值说明：

* **NoSchedule**：不调度。
* **NoExecute**：驱逐没有容忍污点的 Pod。
* **PreferNoSchedule**：尽量避免调度。
KubernetesConfig.Taints.Effect.description_en:
Taint Effect, parameter value description:

* **NoSchedule**: Do not schedule
* **NoExecute**: Evict Pods that do not tolerate the taint
* **PreferNoSchedule**: Prefer not to schedule

Management.Enabled.description_cn:
节点池是否开启托管模式。取值：

* **true**：开启。
* **false**：关闭。

节点池开启托管后，将为新扩容的实例默认安装批量作业 Agent。
Management.Enabled.description_en:
Whether managed mode is enabled for the node pool. Values:

* **true**: Enabled
* **false**: Disabled

When managed mode is enabled for the node pool, the Batch Job Agent will be installed by default on newly scaled instances.

Management.RemedyConfig.description_cn: 节点池的检查和自愈规则配置。
Management.RemedyConfig.description_en: Node pool inspection and self-healing rules configuration

Management.RemedyConfig.Enabled.description_cn:
节点池开启托管模式后，是否开启节点检查自愈。取值：

* **true**：开启。
* **false**：关闭。
Management.RemedyConfig.Enabled.description_en:
After the node pool enters managed mode, whether to enable node check self-healing. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable

Management.RemedyConfig.Id.description_cn:
节点池开启检查自愈后，待关联的节点自愈规则 ID。如果未指定，节点池将自动创建并绑定规则。
在 [容器服务控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/vke) 上目标集群的 **检查自愈** 页面查看检查自愈规则 ID。
Management.RemedyConfig.Id.description_en:
After enabling inspection self-healing for the node pool, specify the self-healing rule ID to associate with the nodes. If not specified, the node pool will automatically create and bind a rule.
Go to the **Inspection Self-Healing** page of the target cluster in the [Container Service Console](https://console.volcengine.com/vke) to view the inspection self-healing rule ID.

Name.description_cn:
节点池名称。

* 同一个集群下，节点池名称必须唯一。
* 支持大小写英文字母、汉字、数字、短划线（`-`），长度限制为 2～64 个字符。

不能使用默认节点池保留名：`vke-default-nodepool`。
Name.description_en:
Node pool name

* The node pool name must be unique within the same cluster
* Supports uppercase and lowercase English letters, Chinese characters, numbers, and hyphens (`-`); length must be between 2 and 64 characters

Cannot use the reserved default node pool name: `vke-default-nodepool`

NodeConfig.description_cn: 节点池中云服务器实例配置。
NodeConfig.description_en: Cloud Server Instance Configuration in Node Pool

NodeConfig.AdditionalContainerStorageEna.description_cn:
配置节点的第一块数据盘并格式化挂载作为容器镜像和日志的存储目录，取值范围：

- **false**：关闭
- **true**：开启
NodeConfig.AdditionalContainerStorageEna.description_en:
Configure and format the node's first data disk to mount it as the storage directory for container images and logs. Value options:

- **false**: Off
- **true**: On

NodeConfig.AffinityGroupConfig.description_cn:
【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】节点池亲和组配置。
使用该功能时，除了获取 VKE 侧功能邀测权限以外，您还需要申请 ECS 侧亲和组相关功能邀测权限。请联系您的火山引擎客户经理咨询。
NodeConfig.AffinityGroupConfig.description_en:
[Beta · Apply for Trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623) Node pool affinity group configuration.
When using this feature, in addition to obtaining Beta access for VKE features, you also need to apply for Beta access to ECS affinity group-related features. Please contact your Volcano Engine account manager for assistance.

NodeConfig.AffinityGroupConfig.Enabled.description_cn:
【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】节点池是否开启亲和组配置。参数值说明：

* **true**：开启，即以亲和组方式购买节点池内节点。
* **false**：关闭，按照非亲和组方式购买节点。
NodeConfig.AffinityGroupConfig.Enabled.description_en:
[Invited Test · Apply for Trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623): Whether affinity group configuration is enabled for the node pool. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. Nodes in the node pool are purchased as an affinity group.
* **false**: Disabled. Nodes are purchased in a non-affinity group manner.

NodeConfig.AffinityGroupConfig.Size.description_cn: 【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】节点池使用的亲和组规格。
NodeConfig.AffinityGroupConfig.Size.description_en: [Invited Test · Apply for Trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623): Affinity group specification used by the node pool.

NodeConfig.AutoRenew.description_cn:
云服务器实例到期后是否自动续费，取值如下：

* **true**：自动续费
* **false**：不自动续费

* 仅当节点池的`InstanceChargeType=PrePaid`时才可以修改。
* 仅对新扩容的节点生效，存量节点请前往  [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 手动修改。
NodeConfig.AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether the cloud server instance will be automatically renewed upon expiration. Possible values:

* **true**: Auto-renew
* **false**: Do not auto-renew

* This can only be modified when the node pool's `InstanceChargeType=PrePaid`.
* Applies only to newly added nodes. For existing nodes, please go to the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) to modify manually.

NodeConfig.AutoRenewPeriod.description_cn:
云服务器实例每次自动续费时长。取值如下，单位为月：
**1**、**2**、**3**、**6**、**12**
* 仅当节点池的`InstanceChargeType=PrePaid`时才可以修改，且仅当`AutoRenew=true`时生效。
* 仅对新扩容的节点生效，存量节点请前往  [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 手动修改。
NodeConfig.AutoRenewPeriod.description_en: Duration for each automatic renewal of cloud server instances. Available options, in months: **1**, **2**, **3**, **6**, **12**  * Modify only when the node pool's `InstanceChargeType=PrePaid`; takes effect only when `AutoRenew=true`. * Applies only to nodes added through expansion. For existing nodes, please go to the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) to modify manually.

NodeConfig.CpuMaxFrequency.description_cn:
节点 CPU 最大频率。

* 最大支持 3 位小数，取值范围为 CPU 主频到 CPU 睿频之间。
* 单位为 GHz。
NodeConfig.CpuMaxFrequency.description_en:
Maximum node CPU frequency

* Supports up to 3 decimal places; value must be between the CPU base frequency and turbo frequency
* Unit: GHz

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.description_cn:
节点的数据盘配置。
调用云服务的 [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) 接口获取云服务器实例规格族与云盘规格的匹配关系。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.description_en:
Node Data Disk Configuration
Call the cloud service's [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) API to get the mapping between instance type families and disk specifications.

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.Encrypted.description_cn:
是否开启数据盘加密功能，参数值说明：

* **true**：开启数据盘加密。
* **false**：（默认值）禁用数据盘加密。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.Encrypted.description_en:
Enable data disk encryption. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enable data disk encryption
* **false** (default): Disable data disk encryption

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.ExtraPerformanceT.description_cn: 云盘额外性能包的吞吐量。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.ExtraPerformanceT.description_en: Cloud disk extra performance package throughput

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.FileSystem.description_cn: 【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】节点池数据盘的文件系统。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.FileSystem.description_en: [Beta · Apply for Trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623) Node pool data disk file system

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.KmsKeyId.description_cn: 数据盘加密时使用的 KMS 密钥 ID。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.KmsKeyId.description_en: KMS key ID used for data disk encryption

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.MountPoint.description_cn: 磁盘格式化后的目标挂载目录。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.MountPoint.description_en: Target mount directory after disk formatting

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.PlacementGroupId.description_cn: 数据盘所属的存储放置组 ID。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.PlacementGroupId.description_en: Storage placement group ID for the data disk

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.SnapshotId.description_cn: 使用快照创建数据盘时的快照 ID。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.SnapshotId.description_en: Snapshot ID used when creating a data disk from a snapshot

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.SubgroupNumber.description_cn: 数据盘所属的存储子放置组编号。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.SubgroupNumber.description_en: Storage sub-placement group number for the data disk

NodeConfig.DataVolumes.Type.description_cn:
磁盘类型：

* 云盘：
   * **ESSD_PL0**：极速型 SSD 云盘，PL0 规格。
   * **ESSD_FlexPL**：极速型 SSD 云盘，FlexPL 规格。
   * **Ultra_Disk**：【EBS 邀测】高效型 SSD 云盘。
   * **TSSD_TL0**：吞吐型 SSD 云盘，TL0 规格。
   * **RSSD_PL0**：【EBS 邀测】弹性远程盘，PL0 规格。
* 本地盘： 
   * **LOCAL_SSD**：SSD 类型本地盘。 
   * **LOCAL_HDD**：HDD 类型本地盘。 
   * **LOCAL_LVM_SSD**：SSD LVM 逻辑本地盘。 
   * **LOCAL_SSD_SRIOV**：SSD SRIOV 本地盘。
NodeConfig.DataVolumes.Type.description_en:
Disk types:

* Cloud disk:
   * **ESSD_PL0**: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, PL0 specification
   * **ESSD_FlexPL**: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, FlexPL specification
   * **Ultra_Disk**: [EBS Beta] High-efficiency SSD cloud disk
   * **TSSD_TL0**: Throughput SSD cloud disk, TL0 specification
   * **RSSD_PL0**: [EBS Beta] Elastic remote disk, PL0 specification
* Local disk:
   * **LOCAL_SSD**: SSD type local disk
   * **LOCAL_HDD**: HDD type local disk
   * **LOCAL_LVM_SSD**: SSD LVM logical local disk
   * **LOCAL_SSD_SRIOV**: SSD SRIOV local disk

NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.description_cn:
节点 GPU 驱动配置。该配置的优先级高于`GpuDriverVersion`字段。
若未配置该参数，且节点池中的 ECS 实例为 GPU 机型时，系统会自动配置`InstallGpuDriver`为`true`，并填充推荐的 GPU 驱动版本。
NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.description_en:
Node GPU driver configuration. This configuration takes precedence over the `GpuDriverVersion` field.
If this parameter is not configured and the ECS instances in the node pool are GPU models, the system will automatically set `InstallGpuDriver` to `true` and fill in the recommended GPU driver version.

NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.GpuDriverVers.description_cn:
指定节点安装的 GPU 驱动版本号。

* 可以调用 [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2171489) 接口，获取镜像支持安装的 GPU 驱动版本列表。
* 当配置为空时，系统会按照 GPU 机型自动填充推荐的 GPU 驱动版本。

当您在节点池中指定多个 ECS 实例规格时，不同实例规格支持的 GPU 驱动可能不同，你需要指定多个实例规格共同支持的 GPU 驱动，否则会报错。
NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.GpuDriverVers.description_en:
Specify the GPU driver version to be installed on the node.

* You can call the [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2171489) API to obtain the list of GPU driver versions supported by the image.
* If this parameter is left empty, the system will automatically fill in the recommended GPU driver version based on the GPU model.

If you specify multiple ECS instance types in the node pool, supported GPU drivers may differ between instance types. You must specify a GPU driver version supported by all selected instance types; otherwise, an error will occur.

NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.InstallGpuDri.description_cn:
当节点对应的 ECS 实例为 GPU 机型，且使用公共基础镜像（例如 veLinux 1.0、Ubuntu 22.04）时，是否自动安装 GPU 驱动。取值：

* **true**：自动安装 GPU 驱动。配置为该参数时，您可以使用`GpuDriverVersion`参数指定具体的 GPU 驱动。
* **false**：不自动安装 GPU 驱动。

当 ECS 实例为非 GPU 机型时，该配置不生效。
NodeConfig.GpuDriverConfig.InstallGpuDri.description_en:
When the ECS instance corresponding to the node is a GPU model and uses a public base image (such as veLinux 1.0 or Ubuntu 22.04), specify whether to automatically install the GPU driver. Valid values:

* **true**: Automatically install the GPU driver. When set to this value, you can use the `GpuDriverVersion` parameter to specify the GPU driver version.
* **false**: Do not automatically install the GPU driver.

This configuration does not take effect when the ECS instance is not a GPU model.

NodeConfig.GpuDriverVersion.description_cn:
**【该参数已废弃，请使用 GpuDriverConfig 代替】​**指定在节点上安装的 GPU 驱动版本。
可以调用 [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2171489) 接口，获取镜像支持安装的 GPU 驱动版本列表。
NodeConfig.GpuDriverVersion.description_en:
**[This parameter is deprecated. Please use GpuDriverConfig instead]** Specifies the GPU driver version to be installed on the node.
You can call the [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2171489) API to obtain the list of GPU driver versions supported by the image.

NodeConfig.Hostname.description_cn: 节点对应的主机名称，支持定义固定增长排序和动态扩展排序，相关定义格式说明，请参见 [命名格式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428)。
NodeConfig.Hostname.description_en: The host name corresponding to the node supports defining fixed incremental ordering and dynamic expansion ordering. For details on the relevant definition formats, see [Naming format](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).

NodeConfig.HpcClusterIds.description_cn:
高性能计算集群 ID。

- 从 **GPU 计算型** 规格修改为 **高性能计算 GPU 型** 规格的节点池时，需要指定高性能计算集群ID。在 [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 的 **实例与镜像** \> **高性能计算集群** 页面获取 ID。

- 当前仅支持传入一个高性能计算集群 ID。更多介绍，请参见 [高性能计算集群概述](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6419/100905)。
- 请确保指定的高性能计算集群与 **SubnetIds** 中指定的子网同属一个可用区。

	
- 从 **高性能计算 GPU 型** 规格修改为 **GPU 计算型** 规格的节点池时，需要传入空数组将已有的高性能计算集群 ID 置空。
NodeConfig.HpcClusterIds.description_en:
High Performance Computing Cluster ID

- When changing a node pool from **GPU Compute** to **High Performance Computing GPU**, you must specify a High Performance Computing Cluster ID. Get the ID from the **Instances & Images** > **High Performance Computing Cluster** page in the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs).

- Only one High Performance Computing Cluster ID is supported. For more information, see [High Performance Computing Cluster Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6419/100905).
- Make sure the specified High Performance Computing Cluster is in the same availability zone as the subnet specified in **SubnetIds**.


- When changing a node pool from **High Performance Computing GPU** to **GPU Compute**, you need to pass in an empty array to clear the existing High Performance Computing Cluster ID.

NodeConfig.ImageId.description_cn:
节点对应的 ECS 实例使用的镜像 ID。
不同的镜像类型对应的镜像 ID 也不同，详细说明，请参见 [容器服务支持的公共镜像](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1255819#%E5%AE%B9%E5%99%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)。
* 若不传该参数，优先分配 veLinux 2.0 系列的镜像 ID。
* 当传入多个规格时，该参数必填。
NodeConfig.ImageId.description_en:
The image ID used by the ECS instance corresponding to the node.
Different image types have different image IDs. For details, see [Public images supported by Container Service](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1255819#%E5%AE%B9%E5%99%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F).

* If this parameter is not specified, a veLinux 2.0 series image ID will be assigned by default.
* When multiple instance types are specified, this parameter is required.

NodeConfig.InitializeScript.description_cn:
创建并初始化节点后执行的自定义脚本。
支持 Shell 格式且需要对脚本内容进行 Base64 编码后传入。
Base64 编码后长度不超过 8 KB。若同时传入 **InitializeScript** 和 **PreScript**，则两个参数的传入值总长度也不能超过 8 KB。
NodeConfig.InitializeScript.description_en:
Custom script executed after creating and initializing the node
Supports Shell format and requires the script content to be Base64 encoded before being provided
Base64 encoded length must not exceed 8 KB. If both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript** are provided, the total length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB.

NodeConfig.InstanceChargeType.description_cn:
节点池内节点对应 ECS 实例的计费类型，取值：

* **PostPaid**：按量计费
* **PrePaid**：包年包月

两种计费类型相互变更时，需要注意以下事项：

* **包年包月** 类型的节点池，可更改为普通 **按量计费** 节点池。
* **按量计费** 类型的节点池，满足如下条件时，可更改为 **包年包月** 节点池：
   * 未开启抢占式策略，即`SpotStrategy`为`NoSpot`。
   * 未开启弹性伸缩，即`AutoScaling·Enabled`为`false`。
   * 未启用弹性预约扩容规则，即调用[ListScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1830000) 接口查询结果为空，或者不为空但`Enabled`为`false`。

* 节点池计费类型从 **按量计费** 转成 **包年包月** 后，需要传入 **Period**、**AutoRenew**、**AutoRenewPeriod** 三个参数。
* 更新节点池内节点计费类型后，仅对新扩容的节点生效，存量节点请前往 [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 手动修改。
NodeConfig.InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing type of ECS instances in the node pool. Options:

* **PostPaid**: Pay-as-you-go
* **PrePaid**: Yearly/Monthly Subscription

When switching between these two billing types, note the following:

* Node pools with the **Yearly/Monthly Subscription** type can be changed to **Pay-as-you-go** node pools
* Node pools with the **Pay-as-you-go** type can be changed to **Yearly/Monthly Subscription** node pools if all the following conditions are met:
   * Preemptible strategy is not enabled, i.e., `SpotStrategy` is set to `NoSpot`
   * Auto scaling is not enabled, i.e., `AutoScaling·Enabled` is `false`
   * Elastic reservation scaling rules are not enabled, i.e., calling the [ListScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1830000) API returns empty, or if not empty, `Enabled` is `false`

* When changing the node pool billing type from **Pay-as-you-go** to **Yearly/Monthly Subscription**, you must provide the **Period**, **AutoRenew**, and **AutoRenewPeriod** parameters
* After updating the billing type for nodes in the node pool, the change only applies to newly added nodes. For existing nodes, please go to the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) to modify manually

NodeConfig.InstanceName.description_cn: 节点（实例）名称，支持定义固定增长排序和动态扩展排序，相关定义格式说明，请参见 [命名格式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428)。
NodeConfig.InstanceName.description_en: Node (instance) name. Supports both fixed incremental and dynamic expansion sorting. For details on the definition format, see [Naming format](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).

NodeConfig.InstanceTypeIds.description_cn:
节点对应的 ECS 实例规格 ID 列表。传入参数值，表示更新节点池的原有规格。更新规格后，支持按照新的规格扩容，存量老规格的节点不受影响。
调用 [ListSupportedResourceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115192) 接口查询集群所支持的资源类型和范围。
* 支持最多传入十个数组元素。
* 更新节点池规格时，GPU 型规格只能更换为 GPU 型规格，非 GPU 型规格只能更换为非 GPU 型规格。
* 不支持更换为云服务器（ECS）已停止售卖的规格。
NodeConfig.InstanceTypeIds.description_en:
List of ECS instance specification IDs corresponding to the node. Passing parameter values updates the original specifications of the node pool. After updating, you can scale out using the new specifications; existing nodes with old specifications are not affected.
Call the [ListSupportedResourceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115192) API to query the resource types and ranges supported by the cluster.
* Up to ten array elements are supported.
* When updating node pool specifications, GPU specifications can only be replaced with GPU specifications, and non-GPU specifications can only be replaced with non-GPU specifications.
* Specifications that are no longer available for sale in ECS cannot be used as replacements.

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.description_cn: 设置抢占式实例和按量实例的混合策略。当`SpotStrategy为SpotAsPriceGo`时，该策略生效。
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.description_en: Configure a mixed strategy for spot instances and pay-as-you-go instances. This strategy takes effect when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotAsPriceGo`.

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Capacit.description_cn:
是否开启按量实例补充抢占式容量能力。参数值说明：

* **true**：开启。抢占式实例即将被回收前，主动创建新的抢占式实例进行补偿。
* **false**：不开启。等到抢占式实例被回收后才会扩容补齐实例数。

更多说明，请参见 [抢占式实例节点池](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1419613)。
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Capacit.description_en:
Enable on-demand instance supplementation for preemptible capacity. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. Before preemptible instances are about to be reclaimed, proactively create new preemptible instances for compensation.
* **false**: Disabled. Scale up to replenish the number of instances only after preemptible instances are reclaimed.

For more information, see [Preemptible Instance Node Pool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1419613).

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Compens.description_cn:
是否启用按量实例替补功能。参数值说明：

* **true**：开启。当所有抢占式实例因库存不足等原因全部购买失败后，尝试购买按量实例。
* **false**：不开启。仅在需要扩容抢占式实例时尝试所配置的抢占式实例。
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.Compens.description_en:
Enable on-demand instance replacement. Parameter value description:

* **true**: Enabled. If all preemptible instances fail to be purchased due to insufficient inventory or other reasons, attempt to purchase on-demand instances.
* **false**: Disabled. Only attempt to purchase the configured preemptible instances when scaling up preemptible capacity.

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.OnDeman.description_cn: 按量实例基础容量的大小。
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.OnDeman.description_en: Size of the on-demand instance base capacity.

NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.OnDeman.description_cn: 节点池扣除按量实例基础容量后，其余按量实例的百分比。
NodeConfig.InstancesDistribution.OnDeman.description_en: Percentage of on-demand instances in the node pool after deducting the base capacity.

NodeConfig.NamePrefix.description_cn:
节点名称前缀。取值为空字符串时表示不启用节点命名前缀。前缀校验规则如下：

- 支持英文大小写字母、数字和中划线(-)。
- 只能以英文字母开头，英文字母或数字结尾。
- 不能连续使用中划线(-)。
- 长度限制为 2～51 个字符。
NodeConfig.NamePrefix.description_en:
Node name prefix. Leave blank to disable the node name prefix. Prefix validation rules:

- Supports uppercase and lowercase English letters, numbers, and hyphens (-)
- Must start with a letter and end with a letter or number
- Hyphens (-) cannot be used consecutively
- Length must be between 2 and 51 characters

NodeConfig.NetworkTrafficMode.description_cn:
节点间的网络通讯模式，取值如下：

* **HighPerformance**：基于 RDMA 进行数据传输的通讯方式。
* **Standard**：基于 TCP 进行数据传输的通讯方式。
NodeConfig.NetworkTrafficMode.description_en:
Network communication modes between nodes. Available options are as follows:

* **HighPerformance**: Communication mode based on RDMA for data transmission
* **Standard**: Communication mode based on TCP for data transmission

NodeConfig.Period.description_cn:
云服务器实例购买时长。取值如下，单位为月：
**1**、**2**、**3**、**4**、**5**、**6**、**7**、**8**、**9**、**12**、**24**、**36**
* 仅当节点池的`InstanceChargeType=PrePaid`时才可以修改。
* 仅对新扩容的节点生效，存量节点请前往  [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 手动修改。
NodeConfig.Period.description_en:
Cloud server instance purchase duration. Valid values (in months):
**1**, **2**, **3**, **4**, **5**, **6**, **7**, **8**, **9**, **12**, **24**, **36**
* You can modify this only when the node pool's `InstanceChargeType=PrePaid`.
* This applies only to newly added nodes. For existing nodes, please go to the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) to modify the nodes manually.

NodeConfig.PreScript.description_cn:
部署节点前执行的脚本。输入Base64 编码后的 Shell 格式脚本。
Base64 编码后长度不超过 8 KB。若同时传入 **InitializeScript** 和 **PreScript**，则两个参数的传入值总长度也不能超过 8 KB。
NodeConfig.PreScript.description_en:
Script executed before deploying nodes. Enter a Shell script encoded in Base64.
The Base64-encoded script must not exceed 8 KB. If both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript** are provided, the combined length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB.

NodeConfig.ProjectName.description_cn:
节点池中扩容出来的 ECS 所属的项目名称，一个 ECS 只能归属于一个项目。

* 只能包含英文字母、数字、下划线（`_`）、英文句点（`.`）和中划线（`-`）。
* 长度限制在 64 个字符以内。
NodeConfig.ProjectName.description_en:
Project name for ECS instances added through node pool scaling. Each ECS can belong to only one project.

* Can only contain letters, numbers, underscores (`_`), periods (`.`), and hyphens (`-`)
* Maximum length: 64 characters

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.description_cn: 为节点自动绑定 EIP 相关配置。
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.description_en: Automatically bind EIP-related configurations for nodes

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.Bandwidth.description_cn:
公网 IP 的带宽峰值，单位为 Mbps，取值：

* `BillingType=2`时：取值范围 1 ~ 500。
* `BillingType=3`时：取值范围 1 ~ 200。
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.Bandwidth.description_en:
Peak bandwidth for public IP, in Mbps. Value range:

* When `BillingType=2`: 1 ~ 500
* When `BillingType=3`: 1 ~ 200

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BandwidthP.description_cn:
共享带宽包的 ID，表示将公网 IP 加入到共享带宽包。
共享带宽包 ID 请调用 [DescribeBandwidthPackages ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) 接口获取。
公网 IP 加入到共享带宽包时，必须同时满足如下条件： 

* 二者的线路类型相同。 
* 共享带宽包为 IPv4 类型。 
* 共享带宽包未配置安全防护。
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BandwidthP.description_en:
This is the shared bandwidth package ID, which is used when adding a public IP to the shared bandwidth package.
To obtain the shared bandwidth package ID, call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) API.
When adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, you must meet all of the following conditions:

* Both must have the same line type
* The shared bandwidth package must be IPv4 type
* The shared bandwidth package must not have security protection configured

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BillingTyp.description_cn:
公网 IP 的计费类型，取值：

* **3**：按量计费-按实际流量计费，即指定带宽上限后，将按照实际使用的出公网流量计费，与使用时长无关。
* **2**：按量计费-按带宽上限计费，即指定带宽上限后，将按照使用时长计费，与实际流量无关。
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.BillingTyp.description_en:
Billing type for public IP. Options:

* **3**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by actual outbound traffic. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on actual outbound public network traffic, regardless of usage duration.
* **2**: Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap. After specifying the bandwidth cap, charges are based on usage duration, regardless of actual traffic.

NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.Isp.description_cn:
公网 IP 的线路类型，取值：

* **BGP**：BGP（多线）。
NodeConfig.PublicAccessConfig.Isp.description_en:
Public IP route type options:

* **BGP**: BGP (multi-line)

NodeConfig.PublicAccessEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启节点自动绑定公网 IP（EIP）能力，取值：

* **false**：不开启。系统不会自动为节点分配 EIP。若后续需要访问公网，请参考 [申请公网 IP 并绑定云服务器](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/95369)。
* **true**：开启。系统自动为集群下的节点分配 EIP，此时您还需要配置 **PublicAccessConfig** 参数，自定义 EIP 配置。
NodeConfig.PublicAccessEnabled.description_en:
Enable automatic public IP (EIP) binding for nodes. Options:

* **false**: Disabled. The system will not automatically assign an EIP to the node. If you need public network access later, see [Apply for a Public IP and Bind to ECS](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/95369)
* **true**: Enabled. The system automatically assigns an EIP to nodes in the cluster. You also need to configure the **PublicAccessConfig** parameter to customize EIP settings

NodeConfig.Security.Login.description_cn:
节点的访问方式配置。
支持密码方式或密钥对方式。同时传入时，优先使用密钥对。
NodeConfig.Security.Login.description_en:
Node access method configuration
Supports password or key pair authentication. If both are provided, the key pair is preferred

NodeConfig.Security.Login.Password.description_cn:
Root 用户登录密码，使用 Base64 编码格式。
请遵循云服务器对于实例密码的要求规范：

* 长度为 8～30 个字符。
* 不能以`/`和`$6$`开头
* 支持以下几项字符，且至少包含三项。
   * 小写字母`a`~`z`
   * 大写字母`A`~`Z`
   * 数字`0`~`9`
   * 特殊字符`( ) ` ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & * _ - + = | { } [ ] : ; ' < > , . ? /`
NodeConfig.Security.Login.Password.description_en:
Root user login password, encoded in Base64.
Follow the cloud server requirements for instance passwords:

* Length must be 8–30 characters
* Cannot start with `/` or `$6$`
* Must include at least three of the following character types:
   * Lowercase letters `a`~`z`
   * Uppercase letters `A`~`Z`
   * Numbers `0`~`9`
   * Special characters `( ) ` ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & * _ - + = | { } [ ] : ; ' < > , . ? /`

NodeConfig.Security.Login.SshKeyPairName.description_cn: SSH 密钥对名称。请确保该密钥对已在云服务器中创建或托管。
NodeConfig.Security.Login.SshKeyPairName.description_en:
SSH Key Pair Name
Make sure the key pair is created or hosted on the cloud server

NodeConfig.Security.SecurityGroupIds.description_cn:
节点网络所在的安全组 ID 列表。
调用私有网络的 [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) 接口，获取安全组 ID。单次最多填写 100 个安全组 ID。
* 必须与集群处于同一个私有网络内。
* 取值为空时，默认使用 **集群节点默认安全组**（命名格式为`<集群ID>-common`）。默认安全组相关说明，请参见 [安全组设置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/97726)。
* 单个节点池最多支持关联 5 个安全组（含集群节点默认安全组）。
NodeConfig.Security.SecurityGroupIds.description_en:
List of security group IDs for the node network
Call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) API in your private network to obtain security group IDs. You can enter up to 100 security group IDs at a time
* Must be in the same private network as the cluster
* If left empty, the **default cluster node security group** (named `<ClusterID>-common`) is used by default. For details about the default security group, see [Security group settings](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/97726)
* Each node pool supports up to 5 associated security groups (including the default cluster node security group)

NodeConfig.Security.SecurityStrategies.description_cn:
安全策略，取值：

* **Hids**：HIDS 主机防护
NodeConfig.Security.SecurityStrategies.description_en:
Security policy, values:

* **Hids**: HIDS host protection

NodeConfig.SpotPriceLimits.description_cn:
抢占式实例的价格上限。

* 仅当`SpotStrategy`为`SpotWithPriceLimit`时生效。
* 数组形式，每项绑定一个实例规格及其价格上限（单位：元/小时）。
NodeConfig.SpotPriceLimits.description_en:
Price limit for spot instances.

* Only takes effect when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`.
* Array format; each item binds an instance type and its price limit (unit: CNY/hour).

NodeConfig.SpotPriceLimits.SpotPriceLimi.description_cn: 该实例规格的抢占式价格上限，单位为：元/小时。
NodeConfig.SpotPriceLimits.SpotPriceLimi.description_en: Maximum spot price for this instance type (CNY/hour)

NodeConfig.SpotStrategy.description_cn:
按量计费的抢占式策略，当`InstanceChargeType=PostPaid`时，该参数生效。取值：

* **NoSpot**：正常按量计费实例。
* **SpotAsPriceGo**：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格。
* **SpotWithPriceLimit**：按实例规格设置价格上限。
NodeConfig.SpotStrategy.description_en:
Spot pricing strategy for pay-as-you-go instances. This parameter is valid when `InstanceChargeType=PostPaid`. Options:

* **NoSpot**: Standard pay-as-you-go instance.
* **SpotAsPriceGo**: System automatically bids, following the current market price.
* **SpotWithPriceLimit**: Set a price limit based on the instance type.

NodeConfig.SubnetIds.description_cn:
节点网络所属的子网 ID 列表。
可以调用 [私有网络 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) 获取子网 ID。

- 必须与集群处于同一个私有网络内。
- 若传入该参数，则必须传入全量的子网 ID 列表，且只能在节点池原有子网 ID 基础上新增子网 ID，不能减少。
- 单个节点池最多支持关联 8 个子网 ID。
NodeConfig.SubnetIds.description_en:
List of subnet IDs for the node network
You can use the [Private Network API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70484) to obtain subnet IDs

- Must be in the same private network as the cluster
- If you specify this parameter, you must provide the complete list of subnet IDs. You can only add new subnet IDs to the existing ones in the node pool; you cannot remove any
- Each node pool supports up to 8 subnet IDs

NodeConfig.SystemVolume.description_cn:
节点的系统盘配置。
调用云服务器的 [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) 接口获取云服务器实例规格族与云盘规格的匹配关系。
NodeConfig.SystemVolume.description_en:
System Disk Configuration for Node
Call the [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) API to obtain the matching relationship between cloud server instance type families and cloud disk specifications.

NodeConfig.SystemVolume.ExtraPerformance.description_cn: 云盘额外性能的吞吐量。

NodeConfig.SystemVolume.PlacementGroupId.description_cn: 系统盘所属的存储放置组 ID。
NodeConfig.SystemVolume.PlacementGroupId.description_en: ID of the storage placement group for the system disk

NodeConfig.SystemVolume.SubgroupNumber.description_cn: 系统盘所属的存储子放置组编号。
NodeConfig.SystemVolume.SubgroupNumber.description_en: ID of the storage sub-placement group for the system disk

NodeConfig.SystemVolume.Type.description_cn:
云盘类型：

* **ESSD_PL0**：极速型 SSD 云盘，PL0 规格。
* **ESSD_FlexPL**：极速型 SSD 云盘，FlexPL 规格。
* **Ultra_Disk**：【EBS 邀测】高效型 SSD 云盘。
* **TSSD_TL0**：吞吐型 SSD 云盘，TL0 规格。
NodeConfig.SystemVolume.Type.description_en:
Cloud disk types:

* **ESSD_PL0**: Extreme SSD cloud disk, PL0 specification
* **ESSD_FlexPL**: Extreme SSD cloud disk, FlexPL specification
* **Ultra_Disk**: [EBS Invitation Only] High-performance SSD cloud disk
* **TSSD_TL0**: Throughput SSD cloud disk, TL0 specification

NodeConfig.Tags.description_cn:
节点对应 ECS 实例绑定的标签信息，用于搜索、管理 ECS 实例。

- **Tags** 中各个 **Key** 不可重复。
- 资源已有相同 **Tags.Key** 的情况下，重复绑定 **Tags.Key** 不会报错，会更新为最新的 **Tags.Value**。
- 单个资源最多支持绑定 20 个 ECS 实例标签。
- **Tags** 中的 **Key**、**Value** 不允许在最前或最后输入空格。
NodeConfig.Tags.description_en:
Tag information bound to ECS instances corresponding to nodes is used for searching and managing ECS instances

- Each **Key** in **Tags** must be unique
- If a resource already has the same **Tags.Key**, binding the same **Tags.Key** again will not cause an error; the **Tags.Value** will be updated to the latest value
- Each resource supports up to 20 ECS instance tags
- Do not enter spaces at the beginning or end of **Key** or **Value** in **Tags**

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: A string used to ensure request idempotency. The caller provides this string, which must be unique across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

Id.description_cn: 检查自愈规则 ID。可以通过控制台查看检查自愈规则 ID，详情请参见 [ 配置节点检查自愈](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1148783?lang=zh#.5p-l55yL5qOA5p-l6Ieq5oSI6KeE5YiZ)。
Id.description_en: The ID of the check and self-healing rule. You can view the check and self-healing rule ID in the console. For details, see [Configure Node Check and Self-Healing](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1148783?lang=zh#.5p-l55yL5qOA5p-l6Ieq5oSI6KeE5YiZ).

Name.description_cn: 检查自愈规则名称。
Name.description_en: The name of the check and self-healing rule.

Rules.FaultType.description_cn:
故障类型。取值：

* **GPUFault：​**GPU 故障
* **NodeFault：​**节点故障
* **SystemFault：​**系统与组件故障
* **RegisteredFault：​**自定义故障
* **XidFault：​**XID 异常
Rules.FaultType.description_en:
Fault type. Options:

* **GPUFault:** GPU fault
* **NodeFault:** Node fault
* **SystemFault:** System and component fault
* **RegisteredFault:** Custom fault
* **XidFault:** XID exception

Rules.IncidentTypes.description_cn: 自愈检查项。不同类型的故障支持不同的检查项。此处需填写 Kubernetes Event，详情请参见 [检查自愈概述](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2520840)。
Rules.IncidentTypes.description_en: Self-healing check item. Different fault types support different check items. Enter the Kubernetes Event here. For details, see [Self-Healing Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2520840).

Rules.RemedyStrategy.Type.description_cn:
策略类型。取值：

* **Notify**：提示异常
* **CordonNode**：封锁节点
* **DrainNode**：排干节点
* **Remedy**：自动修复

* 当`RemedyRule.FaultType`为`RegisteredFault`时，仅支持配置为`Remedy`。
* 当`RemedyRule.FaultType`为`XidFault`时，仅支持配置为`DrainNode`或`Remedy`。
Rules.RemedyStrategy.Type.description_en:
Policy type. Values:

* **Notify**: Notify of exception
* **CordonNode**: Cordon node
* **DrainNode**: Drain node
* **Remedy**: Automatic remediation

* When `RemedyRule.FaultType` is `RegisteredFault`, only `Remedy` is supported.
* When `RemedyRule.FaultType` is `XidFault`, only `DrainNode` or `Remedy` is supported.

AdjustmentValue.description_cn: 节点池弹性伸缩时，增加的节点数量。整数形式，取值范围为 1～500。
AdjustmentValue.description_en: Number of nodes added during node pool elastic scaling. Integer value, range: 1–500.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: String used to ensure request idempotency. This string is provided by the caller and must be unique for each request. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

ClusterId.description_cn:
集群 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于`{Running,[Ok]}`或`{Updating,[Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID.

The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the current status of the cluster.

Enabled.description_cn:
是否启用伸缩规则，取值:

* **true**：启用
* **false**：禁用
Enabled.description_en:
Whether to enable the scaling rule. Values:

* **true**: Enable
* **false**: Disable.

Id.description_cn: 弹性预约伸缩规则 ID。

NodePoolId.description_cn:
节点池 ID。
节点池必须处于`{Running,[*]} `状态。可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口获取节点池当前的状态。
NodePoolId.description_en:
Node pool ID.

The node pool must be in the `{Running,[*]}` state. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to get the current status of the node pool.

ScheduledInstancePolicy.description_cn: 弹性预约伸缩规则配置。

ScheduledInstancePolicy.AutoReleaseTime.description_cn:
预约实例的自动释放时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时有效且必填。必须为 10 分钟整点。

* 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为 **预约交付** 类型时，该时间必须大于预约交付 +1 小时。
* 如果`DeliveryType`为`Immediate`，即为 **立即交付** 类型时，最早释放时间为当前时间下一个整十分钟时间点。例如：当前时间5:02，则最早自动释放时间为 5:20。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.AutoReleaseTime.description_en:
Auto-release time for reserved instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment), this is required and valid. Must be a 10-minute interval.

* If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this time must be greater than reservation delivery +1 hour
* If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), the earliest release time is the next 10-minute interval after the current time. For example, if the current time is 5:02, the earliest auto-release time is 5:20

ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_cn:
当弹性预约实例的库存不能完全满足预约需求时，是否尽可能多的预约实例。

* **false：​**最多生成一个预约单。
* **true：​**当单个预约单无法满足需求时，会提交多个预约单。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.BestEffort.description_en:
When the inventory of elastic scheduled instances cannot fully meet the reservation demand, choose whether to reserve as many instances as possible.

* **false:** Generate at most one reservation order
* **true:** If a single reservation order cannot meet the demand, multiple reservation orders will be submitted

ScheduledInstancePolicy.DeliveryType.description_cn:
弹性预约实例-时段型的交付类型，取值：

* **Reserve**：预约交付
* **Immediate**：立即交付

仅当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`取值为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时有效且必填。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.DeliveryType.description_en:
Delivery type for elastic scheduled instance - segmented type, options:

* **Reserve**: Scheduled delivery
* **Immediate**: Immediate delivery

Valid and required only when `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is set to `Segmented`, which means the instance is of the elastic scheduled - segmented type.

ScheduledInstancePolicy.ElasticScheduled.description_cn:
弹性预约实例类型，取值：

* **Esi**：弹性预约实例-通用型
* **Segmented**：弹性预约实例-时段型
ScheduledInstancePolicy.ElasticScheduled.description_en:
Elastic scheduled instance type. Options:

* **Esi:** Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose
* **Segmented:** Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment

ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_cn:
弹性预约实例的交付结束时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。必须为 10 分钟整点，且与`StartDeliveryTime`的间隔为 10 分钟。取值：

* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为 `Esi`，即为 **弹性预约实例-通用型** 类型时，有效且必填：
   * 取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`后的 4～8 小时内。
* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时：
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为预约交付类型时，有效且必填。取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`的 24 小时以内。
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为立即交付类型时，无需传入该参数。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.EndDeliveryTime.description_en:
Delivery end time for elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be a 10-minute interval, and the interval with `StartDeliveryTime` must be 10 minutes. Options:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledInstancePolicy.StartDeliveryTim.description_cn:
弹性预约实例的交付开始时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。必须为 10 分钟整点，取值:

* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为 `Esi`，即为 **弹性预约实例-通用型** 类型时，有效且必填：
   * 取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`后的 4～8 小时内。
* 当`ElasticScheduledInstanceType`为`Segmented`，即为 **弹性预约实例-时段型** 类型时：
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为预约交付类型时，有效且必填。取值为周期任务的开始时间`LaunchTime`的 24 小时以内。
   * 如果`DeliveryType`为`Reserve`，即为立即交付类型时，无需传入该参数。
ScheduledInstancePolicy.StartDeliveryTim.description_en:
Delivery start time for elastic scheduled instances, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Must be a 10-minute interval. Options:

* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Esi` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – General Purpose), this is required and valid:
   * Value must be within 4–8 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
* When `ElasticScheduledInstanceType` is `Segmented` (Elastic Scheduled Instance – Time Segment):
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Reserve` (reservation delivery type), this is required and valid. Value must be within 24 hours after the periodic task start time `LaunchTime`
   * If `DeliveryType` is `Immediate` (immediate delivery type), this parameter does not need to be provided

ScheduledPolicy.description_cn: 定时任务或周期任务配置。

ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_cn:
任务的开始时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。仅当`Type`取值为`Scheduled`或`Recurrence`时有效且必填。

* 当`Type`取值为`Scheduled`时，表示定时任务的触发时间。
* 当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时，表示周期任务的开始时间。
* 需大于当前时间，且仅支持配置自创建/修改时间起 90 日内的时间。

为保证预约扩容请求提交成功，建议配置的`LaunchTime`至少晚于当前时间 1 分钟。
ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_en:
Task start time, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Scheduled` or `Recurrence`.

* When `Type` is `Scheduled`, this is the trigger time for the scheduled task.
* When `Type` is `Recurrence`, this is the start time for the recurring task.
* Must be later than the current time, and only supports times within 90 days from creation or modification.

To ensure successful submission of the scheduled scaling request, it is recommended to set `LaunchTime` at least 1 minute later than the current time.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
周期任务的结束时间，UTC 时间，精确到分钟。仅当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时有效且必填。
需大于等于`LaunchTime`，且仅支持配置自创建/修改时刻起 365 日内的时间。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
End time of the recurring task, in UTC, accurate to the minute. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.
Must be greater than or equal to `LaunchTime`, and only supports times within 365 days from creation or modification.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_cn:
周期任务的重复周期，仅当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时有效且必填。取值：

* **Daily**：每隔几天执行一次。
* **Weekly**：选择每周中的几天，每天执行一次。
* **Monthly**：选择每月中几号到几号，每天执行一次。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_en:
Recurrence cycle of the recurring task. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`. Options:

* **Daily**: Executes once every N days.
* **Weekly**: Select specific days of the week to execute once per day.
* **Monthly**: Select specific dates within the month to execute once per day.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_cn:
周期任务的重复执行次数。仅当`Type`取值为`Recurrence`时有效且必填。

* 当`RecurrenceType`取值为`Daily`时，只能填写一个值，取值范围为 1 ~ 31。
* 当`RecurrenceType`取值为`Weekly`时，支持填入多个值，使用英文逗号`,`分隔。星期一到星期日的取值依次为：1,2,3,4,5,6,7。
* 当`RecurrenceType`取值为`Monthly`时，格式为`A-B`。A、B 的取值范围均为 1~31，且 B 必须大于等于 A。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_en:
Number of times the recurring task is executed. Only valid and required when `Type` is set to `Recurrence`.

* When `RecurrenceType` is `Daily`, only one value can be entered, ranging from 1 to 31.
* When `RecurrenceType` is `Weekly`, multiple values are supported, separated by commas. Values for Monday to Sunday are: 1,2,3,4,5,6,7.
* When `RecurrenceType` is `Monthly`, the format is `A-B`. Both A and B range from 1 to 31, and B must be greater than or equal to A.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: A string used to ensure idempotency of the request. This string is provided by the caller and must be unique across different requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

ClusterId.description_cn:
集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
待更新的集群必须处于`{Running,[*]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain the cluster ID.
The cluster to be updated must be in the `{Running,[*]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the current status of the cluster.

IgnorePrecheckWarning.description_cn:
升级检查出现 **Warning** 时，是否停止升级过程，取值：

* **true**：升级检查结果为 **Warning** 时，不停止升级节点操作。
* **false**：（默认值）升级检查结果为 **Warning** 时，停止升级节点操作。
IgnorePrecheckWarning.description_en:
Whether to stop the upgrade process when a **Warning** occurs during the upgrade check. Options:

* **true**: When the upgrade check result is **Warning**, do not stop the node upgrade operation.
* **false**: (default) When the upgrade check result is **Warning**, stop the node upgrade operation.

KubernetesVersion.description_cn:
节点的 Kubernetes 版本，格式为`<Kubernetes 版本>-<VKE 补丁版本>`。
容器服务已发布的 Kubernetes 版本，请参见 [Kubernetes 版本发布记录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/108841)。
KubernetesVersion.description_en:
Node Kubernetes version, formatted as `<Kubernetes 版本>-<VKE 补丁版本>`.
For released Kubernetes versions in Container Service, see [Kubernetes Version Release Notes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/108841).

NodePools.description_cn: 待升级的节点所在节点池信息。
NodePools.description_en: Information about the node pool containing the nodes to be upgraded.

NodePools.NodeIds.description_cn:
待升级的节点 ID 列表。可以调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点 ID。单次调用最多填写 2000 个节点 ID。

* 传入参数值：表示以节点维度升级，将对指定的节点进行升级操作。
* 参数值为空：表示以节点池维度升级，将升级指定节点池下的所有节点。

节点必须处于`{Running,[OK]}`状态。
可调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点当前的状态。
NodePools.NodeIds.description_en:
List of node IDs to be upgraded. You can call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to obtain node IDs. You can specify up to 2,000 node IDs per request.

* If you provide parameter values: upgrade will be performed at the node level, and only the specified nodes will be upgraded.
* If the parameter value is empty: upgrade will be performed at the node pool level, and all nodes in the specified node pool will be upgraded.

Nodes must be in the `{Running,[OK]}` state.
You can call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to get the current status of the nodes.

NodePools.NodePoolId.description_cn:
待升级节点所在节点池 ID。
可以调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口，获取节点池 ID。
* 节点池必须处于以下任一状态：
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Scaling,[*]}`
* 节点池中的节点处于以下状态时，对应的节点升级会被拦截，其余状态节点会完成升级。
   * `{Running,[Unschedulable]}`
   * `{Updating,[*]}`
   * `{Failed,[NotReady]}`
   * `{Failed,[Balance]}`

可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口获取节点池状态，调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点状态。
NodePools.NodePoolId.description_en:
