ID of the node pool where the nodes to be upgraded are located.
You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to obtain the node pool ID.
* The node pool must be in one of the following states:
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Scaling,[*]}`
* If nodes in the node pool are in the following states, their upgrade will be blocked. Nodes in other states will be upgraded.
   * `{Running,[Unschedulable]}`
   * `{Updating,[*]}`
   * `{Failed,[NotReady]}`
   * `{Failed,[Balance]}`

You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to get the node pool status, and call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to get the node status.

Operation.description_cn:

* **Precheck**：（默认值）仅执行升级检查操作。
* **Upgrade**：直接执行升级任务，升级任务会包含一次升级检查，检查通过后继续执行升级操作。
Operation.description_en:
Specific operation to execute. Options:

* **Precheck**: (default) Only performs the upgrade check operation.
* **Upgrade**: Directly executes the upgrade task. The upgrade task includes an upgrade check, and proceeds with the upgrade operation after passing the check.

Runtime.Version.description_en:

For containerd versions released by Container Service, see [containerd runtime release notes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2228388).

UpgradePolicy.MaxFailed.description_cn:
升级过程中允许失败的最大节点数。当失败节点数不超过该设置时，继续升级，超过该值时停止升级。

* 取值范围：[0, 2000]
* 默认值：0
UpgradePolicy.MaxFailed.description_en:
Maximum number of failed nodes allowed during the upgrade. If the number of failed nodes does not exceed this setting, the upgrade continues; if it exceeds this value, the upgrade stops.

* Value range: [0, 2000]
* Default value: 0

UpgradePolicy.MaxUnavailable.description_cn:
节点池升级时最大并发节点数。

* 取值范围：[0, 20]
* 默认值：
   * 按节点维度升级：10
   * 按节点池维度升级：20
UpgradePolicy.MaxUnavailable.description_en:
Maximum number of concurrent nodes during node pool upgrade.

* Value range: [0, 20]
* Default value:
   * Upgrade by node: 10
   * Upgrade by node pool: 20

* When calling this API, the original password must be Base64 encoded before entering it here. For example, if your original password is `admin@1234`, enter the Base64 encoded value here: `YWRtaW5AMTIzNA==`.
* Configure this parameter only when the `AuthType` is set to `BasicAuth`.

Password.description_en:
Workspace BasicAuth password.

* Supports uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Must include at least three types of characters.
* Special characters include `!@#$%^*&()_+-=`.

* When calling this API, the original password must be Base64 encoded before entering here. For example, if your original password is `admin@1234`, enter the Base64 encoded value here: `YWRtaW5AMTIzNA==`.
* Configure this parameter only when the `AuthType` parameter is set to `BasicAuth`.

主叫号码归属地城市选不到号之后是否降级至主叫号码归属地省会城市进行选号，0为否，1为是，主叫外显未指定时有效

CallerDegradeToCapital.description_en:
If no number can be selected for the caller's city of origin, should the selection downgrade to the capital city of the caller's province? 0 means No, 1 means Yes. This is effective when the caller ID display is not specified.
Downgrade order: specified city (if set) > caller's city of origin > capital city of caller's province > specified downgrade city. Duplicate cities will be removed during the downgrade process.

EndTime.description_cn:
句段的结束时间戳，单位为毫秒。要求如下：

* 必须大于或等于 `StartTime`。
* 必须大于或等于 `0`。
* 不能超过视频的总时长。

为确保后续语音合成的质量，建议设置的句段时长（即 `EndTime` - `StartTime`）不短于 500 毫秒。
EndTime.description_en:
End timestamp of the segment, in milliseconds. Requirements:

* Must be greater than or equal to `StartTime`
* Must be greater than or equal to `0`
* Cannot exceed the total video duration

To ensure the quality of subsequent speech synthesis, it is recommended that the segment duration (`EndTime` - `StartTime`) is at least 500 milliseconds

* `TargetClips`：目标片段信息
* `BackgroundClip`：背景片段信息
Additions.description_en:

* `Speakers`: Speaker information
* `SourceUtterances`: Source language text
* `SourceTracks`: Source track information
* `SourceClips`: Source clip information
* `TargetUtterances`: Target language text
* `TargetTracks`: Target track information
* `TargetClips`: Target clip information
* `BackgroundClip`: Background clip information

* Get it from the response parameters of the [SubmitAITranslationWorkflow](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1584290) API
* Obtain it by configuring the [AI translation task completion event](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1584289)

SpaceName.description_cn:
点播空间名。您可通过以下方式获取空间名称：

* 在视频点播控制台[空间管理页面](https://console.volcengine.com/vod/overview/)查看当前账号下所有空间的名称。
* 调用 [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) 接口获取当前账号下所有空间的名称。
SpaceName.description_en:
VOD space names. You can get the names of all spaces in the following ways:

* View the names of all spaces under your account on the [Space Management page](https://console.volcengine.com/vod/overview/) in the VOD console.
* Call the [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) API to get the names of all spaces under your account.

UtteranceId.description_cn: 文本句段 ID。可调用 [GetAITranslationProject](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1584291) 接口获取，返回参数中的 `SourceUtterances`（源语言文本信息）和 `TargetUtterances`（目标语言文本信息）包含此字段。
UtteranceId.description_en: Text segment ID. You can call the [GetAITranslationProject](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1584291) API to obtain it; the returned parameters include this field in `SourceUtterances` (source language text information) and `TargetUtterances` (target language text information).

Control.CallbackArgs.description_cn: 自定义字段，将在[媒体处理任务执行完成](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1283222)事件中透传返回。字段长度最大为 512 字节。
Control.CallbackArgs.description_en: The custom field will be returned as-is in the [Media Processing Task Completed](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1283222) event. Maximum field length is 512 bytes.

Control.ClientToken.description_cn: 用户请求凭证，用于区分不同请求。大小写敏感，不超过 64 个 ASCII 码可打印字符。默认情况下，视频点播转码服务在接收到触发工作流请求后，会执行幂等行为。这意味着，如果判定当前请求与之前发送的请求相同，则不会重复执行该请求。关于幂等行为、目的和条件，请参考[工作流幂等说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1218689)。若您希望跳过幂等行为，例如修改了某一工作流所绑定的媒体处理模板中的配置，想要对同一个 Vid 重新执行相同的工作流，则可以设置此参数。
Control.ClientToken.description_en: User request credential, used to distinguish different requests. Case sensitive, up to 64 printable ASCII characters. By default, after receiving a workflow trigger request, the video-on-demand transcoding service performs idempotent behavior. This means if the current request is determined to be the same as a previous request, it will not be executed again. For details on idempotent behavior, its purpose, and conditions, see [Workflow Idempotency Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1218689). If you want to skip idempotent behavior—for example, after modifying the configuration of a media processing template bound to a workflow and want to re-execute the same workflow for the same Vid—you can set this parameter.

Control.EnableLowPriority.description_cn:
是否开启闲时转码。取值如下：

- `true`：开启。
- `false`：关闭。

对于闲时转码功能的介绍和使用场景，请见[闲时转码](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/99791)。
Control.EnableLowPriority.description_en:
Enable idle-time transcoding. Possible values:

- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable

For an introduction and use cases of the idle-time transcoding feature, see [Idle-Time Transcoding](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/99791).

Control.Priority.description_cn: 任务优先级。默认值为 0。取值范围为 \[-5,5\]。数字越大，优先级越高。
Control.Priority.description_en: Task priority. Default value is 0. Range: [-5, 5]. Higher numbers indicate higher priority.

Input.DirectUrl.description_cn:
通过 DirectUrl 模式指定待处理视频的信息。您需要在调用本接口前，通过任一方式将视频[上传](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887?lang=zh)至点播空间，并获取其相关信息。
您必须设置 `Vid`、`DirectUrl` 或 `FileId` 参数之一，但不能同时设置这三个参数。
Input.DirectUrl.description_en:
Specify the information of the video to be processed using DirectUrl mode. Before calling this API, you need to [upload](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887?lang=zh) the video to the VOD space by any method and obtain its related information
You must set one of the `Vid`, `DirectUrl`, or `FileId` parameters, but you cannot set all three at the same time

Input.DirectUrl.BucketName.description_cn: 存储桶名称。可调用 [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) 获取空间所绑定的存储桶名称。
Input.DirectUrl.BucketName.description_en: Bucket name. You can call [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) to get the bucket name bound to the space.

Input.DirectUrl.FileName.description_cn: 文件路径。音视频上传至视频点播服务后，您可通过[媒资上传完成事件](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655)获取 `FileName`。
Input.DirectUrl.FileName.description_en: File path. After uploading audio or video to the video-on-demand service, you can obtain the `FileName` through the [media asset upload completion event](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655).

Input.DirectUrl.SpaceName.description_cn: 空间名称。可调用 [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) 获取当前账号下所有空间的信息。
Input.DirectUrl.SpaceName.description_en: Space Name. You can call [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) to get information about all spaces under your current account.

Transcoded Product ID Information

You must set only one of the `Vid`, `DirectUrl`, or `FileId` parameters; you cannot set more than one at the same time

Input.FileId.Vid.description_cn: 视频 ID。音视频上传至视频点播服务后，您可通过[媒资上传完成事件](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655)获取 `Vid`。

Input.Schema.description_cn: 动态输入 Schema，用于启用任务串联功能，将前一个任务的输出结果，动态地作为下一个任务的输入，例如实现“先视频生成，再对生成结果进行超分”这类链式处理流程。如需启用任务串联功能，您需将 `Schema` 参数的值设置为 `Template`，再在 `Input` 对象的其他字段（如 `Vid`, `DirectUrl.FileName`）中使用 [Go Template](https://pkg.go.dev/text/template#Template.Option) 语法来引用上游节点的输出。详细使用说明，请见[使用动态输入 Schema 实现任务串联](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1923423?lang=zh)。
Input.Schema.description_en: Dynamic input schema enables task chaining, allowing the output of the previous task to be dynamically used as the input for the next task—for example, generating a video first, then applying super-resolution to the generated result in a chained workflow. To enable task chaining, set the `Schema` parameter to `Template`, and use [Go Template](https://pkg.go.dev/text/template#Template.Option) syntax in other fields of the `Input` object (such as `Vid`, `DirectUrl.FileName`) to reference the output from upstream nodes. For detailed instructions, see [Using Dynamic Input Schema for Task Chaining](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1923423?lang=zh).

Input.Tag.description_cn:
标识输入的类型，用于区分不同场景下的输入内容。支持的取值如下：

* `FirstFrame`：视频生成任务中表示输入图片作为视频首帧。
* `LastFrame`：视频生成任务中表示输入图片使用视频尾帧。仅 doubao-seedance-lite 模型支持使用图片作为尾帧生成视频。
* `ImageSet`：OCR 提取字幕任务中表示输入为图集。
Input.Tag.description_en:

* `FirstFrame`: In video generation tasks, indicates the input image is used as the first frame of the video
* `LastFrame`: In video generation tasks, indicates the input image is used as the last frame of the video. Only the doubao-seedance-lite model supports using an image as the last frame to generate a video
* `ImageSet`: In OCR subtitle extraction tasks, indicates the input is an image set

* `FileId`: FileId 模式。此模式下，您还需设置 `FileId` 参数。

* 仅**巨量广告预审任**务支持 FileId 模式。
* **文件删除任务**仅支持 DirectUrl 模式。
Input.Type.description_en:

* `Vid`: Vid mode. In this mode, you also need to set the `Vid` parameter.
* `DirectUrl`: DirectUrl mode. In this mode, you also need to set the `DirectUrl` parameter.
* `FileId`: FileId mode. In this mode, you also need to set the `FileId` parameter.

* Only **Juliang Ads Pre-Review tasks** support FileId mode.
* **File Deletion tasks** only support DirectUrl mode.

* 单次任务最多输入 30 个文件。
* 多个输入文件的类型必须保持一致。
   * 若为 `Vid` 类型，这些文件需来自同一个空间。
   * 若为 `DirectUrl` 类型，文件则需来自同一个空间。

* Only **Highlight Smart Editing** and **Long Video Storyline Analysis** tasks support multiple input files.
* Up to 30 files can be submitted per task.
* The type of multiple input files must be consistent.
   * If the type is `Vid`, these files must come from the same space.
   * If the type is `DirectUrl`, the files must come from the same space.

Output Video Settings
Specify the output video's resolution and frame rate. If not set, the system will match the source video by default

Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.Target.description_cn: 设置输出视频的目标平均码率。该参数将决定视频的视觉质量和最终的文件体积。取值范围为 `[10, 50000]`。为确保不同场景下的画质稳定性，系统会根据视频内容的复杂度进行动态调整。实际输出码率将在您设定目标的 **0.8 倍至 1.5 倍**之间波动。请参考[不同输出分辨率的推荐码率表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/117971#692790fd)进行设置。
Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.Target.description_en: Set the target average bitrate for the output video. This parameter determines the visual quality and final file size. The valid range is `[10, 50000]`. To ensure stable image quality across different scenarios, the system dynamically adjusts based on the complexity of the video content. The actual output bitrate will fluctuate between **0.8 times and 1.5 times** your target setting. Refer to the [recommended bitrate table for different output resolutions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/117971#692790fd) for guidance.

Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.Target.description_cn: 目标帧率，单位为 fps。取值范围为 `(0, 120]`。

Target resolution. Supported values are as follows:

* `240p`
* `360p`
* `480p`
* `540p`
* `720p`
* `1080p`
* `2k`
* `4k`

Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.VideoS.description_cn:

* `-50`：轻度（高保真）。进行轻微增强，效果更贴近原片质感。
* `0`：中等。提供平衡的画质提升效果。
Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.VideoS.description_en:
Video enhancement strength. Supported values:

* `-50`: Mild (High Fidelity). Applies slight enhancement for a result closer to the original footage
* `0`: Moderate. Provides balanced image quality improvement

Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.VideoS.description_cn:
画质增强类型：

* `0`：**极速版本**。秒级响应，集成基础超分与画质修复，兼顾效率与清晰度。
* `1`：**标准版本**。采用自适应多维度增强算法，精准平衡处理速度与视觉质感。

画质增强类型不同，对应的算法强度不同，费用也不同，详细价格请参见[画质增强（升级版）](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1941013#810bf860)。
Operation.Task.Enhance.MoeEnhance.VideoS.description_en:
Image Quality Enhancement Types:

* `0`: **Ultra-Fast Version**. Second-level response, integrates basic super-resolution and image restoration, balancing efficiency and clarity
* `1`: **Standard Version**. Uses adaptive multidimensional enhancement algorithms for a precise balance between processing speed and visual quality

Different image quality enhancement types correspond to different algorithm strengths and costs. For detailed pricing, see [Image Quality Enhancement (Upgraded Version)](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1941013#810bf860).

Operation.Task.Enhance.Type.description_cn:
增强模型类型。默认为 `Custom`。

* `Moe`:（推荐）场景化增强模型。您需要通过 `MoeEnhance` 参数选择一个针对特定场景（如短剧、AIGC 等）的预设模板，系统会自动应用最优的算子组合。
Operation.Task.Enhance.Type.description_en:
Enhancement model type. Default is `Custom`.

* `Custom`: Custom enhancement model. You need to use the `Modules` parameter to manually combine one or more independent enhancement operators (such as super-resolution, frame interpolation, etc)
* `Moe`: (Recommended) Scenario-based enhancement model. You need to use the `MoeEnhance` parameter to select a preset template for a specific scenario (such as short-form drama, AIGC, etc). The system will automatically apply the optimal combination of operators.

Operation.Task.Erase.Mode.description_cn:
字幕擦除模式，取值如下：

- `Auto`：自动擦除模式。在此模式下，系统将启用 OCR 识别，并依据检测结果进行擦除操作。
- `Manual`：(Beta) 手动擦除模式。在此模式下，系统不会启用 OCR 识别，仅擦除白色字幕内容。

不同模式的用途及适用场景说明如下：

- 一般情况下，可将 `Mode` 设置为 `Auto`，再将 `Auto.Type` 设置为 `Subtitle`（仅字幕）或 `Text`（字幕和其它渲染文本），以擦除指定类型的文本。
- 若您对擦除区域有特殊需求，可通过设置 `Locations` 来指定擦除框，仅擦除框内经 OCR 识别的文本。
- 在需要擦除**中英文外的小语种字幕**的场景中，可将 `Mode` 设置为 `Manual`，并设置 `Locations` 来指定擦除框。
Operation.Task.Erase.Mode.description_en:
Subtitle erasure modes are as follows:

- `Auto`: Automatic erasure mode. In this mode, the system enables OCR recognition and erases content based on the results.
- `Manual`: (Beta) Manual erasure mode. In this mode, the system does not enable OCR recognition and only erases white subtitle content.

Usage and scenarios for each mode:

- In most cases, set `Mode` to `Auto`, then set `Auto.Type` to `Subtitle` (subtitles only) or `Text` (subtitles and other rendered text) to erase specific types of text.
- If you need to specify the erasure area, set `Locations` to define the erasure box and erase only the text recognized by OCR within the box.
- To erase subtitles in less common languages other than Chinese and English, set `Mode` to `Manual` and use `Locations` to specify the erasure box.

Operation.Task.Erase.NewVid.description_cn: 是否为擦除后的视频生成一个新的 `Vid`。
Operation.Task.Erase.NewVid.description_en: Generate a new `Vid` for the erased video?

Operation.Task.Erase.VideoOption.description_cn: 视频编码配置，用于指定字幕擦除后生成视频的编码方式。
Operation.Task.Erase.VideoOption.description_en: Video encoding configuration, used to specify the encoding method for the video generated after subtitle removal.

Operation.Task.Erase.VideoOption.EncodeM.description_cn:
编码模式，支持以下两种取值：

* `Quality`（默认值）：画质优先模式。此模式下，系统会采用较高的目标码率进行编码，以确保高画质。这通常会导致输出文件的码率显著高于源文件，文件体积也相应增大。
* `Size`：大小优先模式。在保证一定画质的前提下，使输出码率尽量向源视频码率对齐。
Operation.Task.Erase.VideoOption.EncodeM.description_en:
Encoding mode. Supports the following two options:

* `Quality` (default): Quality priority mode. In this mode, the system uses a higher target bitrate for encoding to ensure high image quality. This typically results in the output file having a significantly higher bitrate than the source file, and the file size increases accordingly.
* `Size`: Size priority mode. While maintaining a certain level of image quality, the output bitrate is aligned as closely as possible with the source video bitrate.

Operation.Task.Erase.WithEraseInfo.description_cn: 是否返回擦除信息详情

Operation.Task.FileDelete.description_cn: 文件删除任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `FileDelete` 时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Task.FileDelete.description_en: File deletion task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is `FileDelete`.

Operation.Task.FileDelete.SkipError.description_cn: 在多输入的情况下，当单个文件删除失败时，是否忽略错误继续删除剩余文件。默认值为 `false`，即终止文件删除并返回错误。
Operation.Task.FileDelete.SkipError.description_en: When multiple files are specified, if deleting a single file fails, errors can be ignored to continue deleting the remaining files. The default value is `false`, which stops file deletion and returns an error.

Operation.Task.Highlight.description_cn: 高光智剪任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `Highlight`时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Task.Highlight.description_en: Highlight smart editing task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is `Highlight`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.description_cn: 剪辑成片配置。仅当 `Mode` 为 `StorylineCuts` 时生效。配置此参数后，系统将在高光分析完成后，直接基于分析结果自动剪辑并输出高光视频，而不仅仅是返回分析数据。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.description_en: Edit Compilation Settings. Effective only when `Mode` is set to `StorylineCuts`. After configuring this parameter, once highlight analysis is complete, the system will automatically edit and output a highlight video directly based on the analysis results, rather than only returning analysis data.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 自定义剪辑参数。当 `Mode` 为 `CustomEdit` 时，此参数为必填，用于详细配置最终输出视频的参数。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Custom editing parameters. Required when `Mode` is set to `CustomEdit`; use this to configure the parameters of the final output video in detail.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 渲染画布配置。用于定义最终输出视频的宽高、背景色等参数。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Rendering canvas settings. Defines parameters such as output video width, height, and background color.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 画布颜色。RGBA 类型，默认值为 `#00000000`。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Canvas color. RGBA type, default value is `#00000000`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 输出视频的高。单位为 pixel，默认值为 1280。取值范围为 [160,8192]。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Output video height. Unit: pixel, default value: 1280, range: [160,8192]

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
设置输出视频画布的屏幕方向（横屏还是竖屏）与哪个资源保持一致。默认值为 `0|0`，即对齐第 0 个 Track 的第 0 个 Element。当 `Index` 设为 `MAX` 时，则表示跟随基准分辨率，也就是与资源中的最大分辨率保持一致。
此参数仅当 `CanvasWithRatio` 为 `true` 时生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Set which resource the output video canvas orientation (landscape or portrait) should match. The default value is `0|0`, which aligns with Track 0, Element 0. When `Index` is set to `MAX`, it follows the reference resolution, meaning it matches the highest resolution among the resources.
This parameter only takes effect when `CanvasWithRatio` is set to `true`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
输出视频画布的长边。单位为 pixel，默认值为 1280。取值范围为 [160,8192]。
此参数仅当 `CanvasWithRatio` 为 `true` 时生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Set the long side of the output video canvas. Unit: pixel, default value: 1280. Value range: [160,8192].
This parameter only takes effect when `CanvasWithRatio` is set to `true`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
输出视频画布的长短边比，默认值为 `16:9`。当 `Ratio` 设为 `-1:-1` 或者 `-1`，则表示跟随指定输入源。
此参数仅当 `CanvasWithRatio` 为 `true` 时生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Sets the aspect ratio of the video canvas. The default value is `16:9`. When `Ratio` is set to `-1:-1` or `-1`, the aspect ratio follows the specified input source.
This parameter only takes effect when `CanvasWithRatio` is set to `true`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
输出视频画布的短边。单位为 pixel，默认值为 720。取值范围为 [160,8192]。
* 此参数仅当 `CanvasWithRatio` 为 `true` 时生效。
* 同时设置短边和长边时，短边的优先级高于长边。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Set the short side of the output video canvas. Unit: pixel; default value: 720. Value range: [160,8192].
* This parameter only takes effect when `CanvasWithRatio` is set to `true`.
* When both short side and long side are set, the short side takes priority over the long side.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
输出视频的宽。单位为 pixel，默认值为 720。取值范围为 [160,8192]。
`Canvas` 还支持通过表达式来自动匹配某个 Element 的宽和高。具体请见[通过表达式指定画布宽高](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/102412#%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E8%A1%A8%E8%BE%BE%E5%BC%8F%E6%8C%87%E5%AE%9A%E7%94%BB%E5%B8%83%E5%AE%BD%E9%AB%98)。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Output video width. Unit: pixel; default: 720. Range: [160,8192]
`Canvas` also supports using expressions to automatically match the width and height of an element. For details, see [Specify canvas width and height using expressions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/102412#%E9%80%9A%E8%BF%87%E8%A1%A8%E8%BE%BE%E5%BC%8F%E6%8C%87%E5%AE%9A%E7%94%BB%E5%B8%83%E5%AE%BD%E9%AB%98).

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 编码输出配置。用于配置终输出视频的编码格式、码率、帧率、分辨率等参数。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Encoding Output Configuration
Configure parameters for the final output video, including encoding format, bitrate, frame rate, and resolution

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
输出视频中是否包含 alpha 通道。默认值为 `false`。
`Alpha` 的优先级高于 `VideoCodec`。当 `Alpha` 为 `true` 时，`VideoCodec` 默认采用 `VP9`，而不再关注您设置的 `VideoCodec` 参数。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Indicates whether the output video includes an alpha channel. Default value is `false`.
`Alpha` takes precedence over `VideoCodec`. When `Alpha` is set to `true`, `VideoCodec` defaults to `VP9` and your configured `VideoCodec` setting is ignored.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 是否进行音频反相检测。默认关闭。当片源时长较长时，该操作较为耗时。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Perform audio phase inversion detection? Default is off. This operation may take longer for lengthy media sources.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
画布分辨率是否遵循最大分辨率。默认为 `false`。如设为 `true`，画布分辨率与资源中的最大分辨率保持一致。
最大分辨率是指宽*高的值在所有资源中最大。画布分辨率相关参数的优先级按以下顺序递减：

1. Int 型的 `Canvas.Width` 和 `Canvas.Height`
2. `CanvasWithMax`
3. `CanvaswithRatio`
4. String 型的 `Canvas.Width` 和 `Canvas.Height`
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Should the canvas resolution follow the maximum resolution? The default is `false`. If set to `true`, the canvas resolution matches the maximum resolution among the resources.
Maximum resolution refers to the largest value of width * height across all resources. The priority order for canvas resolution parameters is as follows:

1. Int type `Canvas.Width` and `Canvas.Height`
2. `CanvasWithMax`
3. `CanvaswithRatio`
4. String type `Canvas.Width` and `Canvas.Height`

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 画布分辨率是否遵循长短边比。默认为 `false`。如设为 `true`，画布分辨率保持固定的长短边比。长短边比默认为 16:9。您也可以通过 `Canvas` 中的 `Long`、`Short`、`Ratio` 参数设置长、短边以及长短边比。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Should the canvas resolution follow the aspect ratio of its long and short sides? The default is `false`. If set to `true`, the canvas resolution maintains a fixed aspect ratio. The default aspect ratio is 16:9. You can also set the long side, short side, and aspect ratio using the `Long`, `Short`, and `Ratio` parameters in `Canvas`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 音视频编码参数设置。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Audio and Video Encoding Parameter Settings

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 音频编码码率。默认值为 128。单位为 kbps。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Audio encoding bitrate. Default value: 128. Unit: kbps.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 音频编码格式。默认值为 `aac`。支持的取值有 `aac`。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Audio encoding format. Default value is `aac`. Supported value: `aac`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
恒定质量因子 CRF。默认值为 `23`。
仅当 `VideoCodec` 设为 `h264`、`h265` 时生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Constant rate factor (CRF). Default value is `23`.
Effective only when `VideoCodec` is set to `h264` or `h265`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 用于调节视频编码速度和质量。默认值为 `medium`。仅当 `VideoCodec` 设为 `h264`、`h265` 时生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Adjusts video encoding speed and quality. Default value is `medium`. Only takes effect when `VideoCodec` is set to `h264` or `h265`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 视频编码码率。单位为 bps。该参数如不设置，视频编码码率通过 `Crf` 控制。设置该参数后，`Crf` 设置不生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Video encoding bitrate (unit: bps). If this parameter is not set, the video encoding bitrate is controlled by `Crf`. If you set this parameter, the `Crf` setting does not take effect.

Video encoding format. Available values:

* `h264`: (Default) H.264
* `vp9`: VP9
* `h265`: H.265

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
是否仅输出视频：

* `false`: （默认）输出音视频。
* `true`: 仅输出视频。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Output video only?

* `false`: (default) Output audio and video
* `true`: Output video only

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
是否仅输出音频：

* `false`: （默认）输出音视频。
* `true`: 仅输出音频。

`DisableVideo` 和 `DisableAudio` 同时设为 `false` 时，最终输出一个完整的音视频文件。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Output audio only:

* `false`: (default) Output both audio and video
* `true`: Output audio only

When both `DisableVideo` and `DisableAudio` are set to `false`, the final output is a complete audio and video file

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn:
输出文件的封装格式。取值如下：

* （默认）`mp4`
* `hls`
* `mp3`

* `Format` 的优先级高于 `VideoCodec`。
* 当 `Format` 设为 `hls` 时，表示以 HLS 格式输出视频，此时 `VideoCodec` 仅支持设为 `h264` 和 `h265`。
* 当 `DisableVideo` 参数取值为 `true` 时，`Format` 取值为 `mp3` 才生效，表示 MP3 音频导出专用格式。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en:
Container format for the output file. Available options:

* (Default) `mp4`
* `hls`
* `mp3`

* `Format` takes precedence over `VideoCodec`
* When `Format` is set to `hls`, the video is output in HLS format. In this case, `VideoCodec` only supports `h264` and `h265`
* When the `DisableVideo` parameter is set to `true`, only setting `Format` to `mp3` is effective, indicating a dedicated format for exporting MP3 audio

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_cn: 输出视频的帧率。单位为 fps。默认值为 30。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.CustomEdit.description_en: Output video frame rate. Unit: fps. Default: 30

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_cn: 短剧模板剪辑模式的详细参数。当 `Mode` 为 `MiniseriesEdit` 时，此参数为必填。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_en: Detailed parameters for the miniseries template editing mode. This parameter is required when `Mode` is set to `MiniseriesEdit`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_cn: 短剧提示语。画面左右两侧的一行文字，可以是概括视频核心冲突或亮点的引导性文字，也可以是类似“影视效果 请勿模仿 无不良价值观引导”的免责声明。不得超过 20 个字。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_en: Short drama tagline. A line of text displayed on the left and right sides of the screen; it can summarize the video's core conflict or highlight, or serve as a disclaimer such as "For cinematic effect only, do not imitate, does not promote negative values." Must not exceed 20 Chinese characters (or equivalent length in English).
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.example_cn: 影视效果 请勿模仿
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.example_en: For cinematic effect only, do not imitate

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_cn:
“短剧三要素”视觉模板名称。不同的模板决定了剧名、角标、提示语的位置和样式。支持的取值如下：

* `热门短剧1`
* `热门短剧2`
* `热门短剧3`
* `热门短剧4`
* `热门短剧5`

具体效果，请见[短剧三要素视觉模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1995605?lang=zh#b0c32e28)。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_en:
"Three Key Elements of Short Drama" visual template name. Different templates determine the position and style of the drama title, corner label, and tagline. Supported values are:

* `Popular Short Drama 1`
* `Popular Short Drama 2`
* `Popular Short Drama 3`
* `Popular Short Drama 4`
* `Popular Short Drama 5`

For specific effects, see [Three Key Elements of Short Drama Visual Templates](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1995605?lang=zh#b0c32e28).

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_cn: 短剧名称。在高光视频画面上展示剧名，用于品牌识别和引导用户搜索。不得超过 15 个字。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Miniseries.description_en: Short drama title. Display the drama name on the highlight video screen for brand recognition and to guide user search. Must not exceed 15 Chinese characters (or equivalent length in English).

Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Mode.description_cn:
剪辑模式。支持以下取值：

* `HighlightClips`：智能片段剪辑模式。系统将自动应用一套默认的剪辑参数，快速生成效果均衡的高光集锦视频。此模式无需额外配置。
* `CustomEdit`: 自定义剪辑模式。您可以通过 `CustomEdit` 参数，详细自定义最终输出视频的编码、分辨率等。
* `MiniseriesEdit`：短剧三要素模板剪辑。使用预设的视觉模板，为高光视频一键添加“短剧三要素”（剧名、角标、提示语）。

“短剧三要素”（`MiniseriesEdit` 模式）**仅适用于竖屏短剧**，暂不支持横屏剧。
Operation.Task.Highlight.Edit.Mode.description_en:
Editing mode. Supported values:

* `HighlightClips`: Smart highlight editing mode. The system automatically applies a set of default editing parameters to quickly generate a balanced highlight video. No additional configuration is needed for this mode.
* `CustomEdit`: Custom editing mode. Use the `CustomEdit` parameter to customize the encoding, resolution, and other details of the final output video.
* `MiniseriesEdit`: Miniseries three-element template editing. Apply a preset visual template to add the 'three elements of a miniseries' (title, corner label, prompt) to your highlight video with one click.

The 'three elements of a miniseries' (`MiniseriesEdit` mode) **are only supported for vertical miniseries** and are currently not available for horizontal series.

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.description_cn: 高光片段配置。仅当 `Model` 取值为 `Miniseries` 且 `Mode` 为 `StorylineCuts`时生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.description_en: Highlight clip configuration. Only effective when `Model` is set to `Miniseries` and `Mode` is `StorylineCuts`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_cn: 期望输出高光片段的最大时长，单位为秒。默认值为 300。若您指定最大时长，系统会将混剪结果截断至合适长度，可能不会使用全部输入视频片段。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_en: Maximum duration of highlight segments to output, in seconds. Default is 300. If you specify a maximum duration, the system will truncate the mixed editing result to an appropriate length and may not use all input video segments.

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_cn: 输出高光片段的最多片段数，默认值为 6。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Maximum number of highlight segments to output; default is 6.</SOURCE_TEXT>

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_cn:
期望输出高光片段的最小时长，单位为秒，默认值为 90。
在实际高光分析过程中，为确保剧情的连贯性并保留“钩子”剧情，算法所输出高光视频的时长可能不会与您所设置的 `MinDuration` 和 `MaxDuration` 严格相符。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_en:
Minimum duration of highlight segments to output, in seconds. Default is 90.
During actual highlight analysis, to ensure plot continuity and retain 'hook' scenes, the duration of the highlight video output by the algorithm may not strictly match the `MinDuration` and `MaxDuration` you set.

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_cn: 短剧场景下的专属配置，目前用于指定剪辑模式（顺剪/混剪）。仅在短剧模型下生效。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_en: This setting only applies to short drama scenarios and is currently used to specify the editing mode (sequential editing/mixed editing). This setting only applies to the short drama model.

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_cn:
剪辑模式，决定了视频片段的组织方式。支持的取值如下：

* `Mixed`：（默认）混剪模式。算法会打乱原始时序，优先组合最精彩、最具冲突感的片段，以达到最佳营销效果。
* `Sequential`：顺剪模式。算法会基本保持原始剧情的时间顺序进行剪辑（去除片头片尾等非正片内容）。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.M.description_en:
Editing mode determines how video clips are organized. Supported values:

* `Mixed` (default): Mixed editing mode. The algorithm shuffles the original sequence and prioritizes the most exciting and conflict-driven clips for optimal marketing impact.
* `Sequential`: Sequential editing mode. The algorithm mostly keeps the original storyline order (removing opening, ending, and other non-main content).

Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.W.description_cn:
是否在任务结果中输出详细的分镜信息。取值如下：

*  `true`：系统会在高光分析结果中包含 `Storyboard` 数组，输出算法基于分镜理解得出的视频片段信息。每个片段涵盖片段开始时间、结束时间、高光打分、字幕信息、剧情描述以及片段源自哪个输入视频等信息。
* `false`：（默认）不输出分镜信息。
Operation.Task.Highlight.HighlightCuts.W.description_en:
Whether to output detailed storyboard information in the task results. Options:

*  `true`: The system includes a `Storyboard` array in the highlight analysis results, providing video segment information based on storyboard understanding. Each segment covers start time, end time, highlight score, subtitle information, plot description, and which input video the segment comes from.
* `false`: (default) Does not output storyboard information.

Operation.Task.Highlight.MiniGame.description_cn: 小游戏分析配置。仅当 `Model` 取值为 `Game` 且 `Mode` 取值为 `MiniGame` 时生效。

Operation.Task.Highlight.OpeningHook.Min.description_cn:

Operation.Task.Highlight.OpeningHook.Min.description_en:
Set the minimum duration for a single highlight clip that makes up the featured segment at the beginning of the video. Unit: seconds; default value: `5`. The featured segment at the start of the video may be composed of multiple highlight clips. This parameter helps prevent flickering caused by stitching together too many short clips, ensuring smooth visual flow in the final video.
Make sure `MinClipDuration` is greater than `MinDuration`; otherwise, multiple separate featured segments may be generated at the beginning.

Operation.Task.Highlight.OpeningHook.Min.description_cn: 视频开头精彩片段的最小时长，单位为秒，默认为 `5`。
Operation.Task.Highlight.OpeningHook.Min.description_en: Minimum duration for the highlight at the beginning of the video, in seconds. Default is `5`.

Operation.Task.Highlight.OpeningHook.Min.description_cn: 设置构成视频开头精彩片段的单个高光片段的高光打分下限，默认值为 `3`。视频开头精彩片段可能会由多个高光片段拼接而成，此参数用于筛选高质量片段以确保开场效果。

Operation.Task.Segment.ClipFade.description_cn:

* `true`: 独立输出。如果视频中存在明显的淡入/淡出过渡，系统会将其分割成一个独立的切片。
Operation.Task.Segment.ClipFade.description_en:
Output detected fade-in/fade-out segments as separate slices

* `false`: (default) Do not output separately. Fade-in/fade-out segments are treated as part of the preceding or following scene and merged into adjacent slices
* `true`: Output separately. If there are clear fade-in/fade-out transitions in the video, the system will split them into separate slices

Operation.Task.Segment.MaxDuration.description_cn: 单个切片的最大时长，单位为秒，无默认值。系统会确保最终生成的任何切片时长都不高于此值。
Operation.Task.Segment.MaxDuration.description_en: Maximum duration for a single slice, in seconds; no default value. The system ensures that the duration of any generated slice does not exceed this value.

Operation.Task.Segment.MinDuration.description_cn: 单个切片的最小时长，单位为秒，无默认值。系统会确保最终生成的任何切片时长都不低于此值。
Operation.Task.Segment.MinDuration.description_en: Minimum duration for a single slice, in seconds; no default value. The system ensures that the duration of any generated slice is not less than this value.

Operation.Task.Segment.NoFile.description_cn:

Operation.Task.Segment.NoFile.description_en:

Operation.Task.Segment.Threshold.description_cn:
场景切分的敏感度阈值。取值范围为 `[0, 100]`。

* 取值越低，算法对场景变化的感知越敏感，切分出的片段越多。
* 取值越高，算法越倾向于将微小的变化视为同一场景，切分出的片段越少。

当您同时设置 `MinDuration`, `MaxDuration` 和 `Threshold` 时，系统会按照以下两阶段逻辑进行切分，以确保所有约束都得到满足：

1. 算法首先会根据您设置的 `Threshold` 和 `MinDuration` 进行切分。
2. 第一阶段切分完毕后，如发现有切片的时长超过您设置的 `MaxDuration`，系统会忽略 `Threshold` 的影响，再进行切分，确保最终时长都不超过 `MaxDuration`。
Operation.Task.Segment.Threshold.description_en:
Sensitivity threshold for scene segmentation. Value range: `[0, 100]`

* Lower values make the algorithm more sensitive to scene changes, resulting in more segments
* Higher values make the algorithm more likely to treat minor changes as the same scene, resulting in fewer segments

When you set `MinDuration`, `MaxDuration`, and `Threshold` together, the system uses a two-stage process to ensure all constraints are met:

1. The algorithm first segments based on your `Threshold` and `MinDuration` settings
2. After the first stage, if any segment exceeds your `MaxDuration`, the system ignores the effect of `Threshold` and further segments to ensure all final durations do not exceed `MaxDuration`

* `adaptive`: Automatically selects the most suitable aspect ratio based on the uploaded image (default for image-to-video).

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn: 生成视频的时长，单位为秒。默认值为 `5`，支持设置为 `5` 或 `10`。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en: Video duration in seconds. Default value is `5`. You can set it to `5` or `10`.

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn: 是否固定摄像头视角。默认值为 `false`，即不固定摄像头视角。若设置为 `true`，平台会在用户提示词中追加固定摄像头，但实际效果不保证。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en: Whether to fix the camera angle. Default value is `false`, meaning the camera angle is not fixed. If set to `true`, the platform will append 'fixed camera angle' to the user prompt, but the actual effect is not guaranteed.

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn: 视频生成的帧率，默认值为 `24`，当前仅支持设为 `24`。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en: The frame rate for video generation defaults to `24`; currently, only `24` is supported.

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn:
视频生成任务所使用的模型。支持的取值如下：

* `doubao-seedance-pro`：专业版模型。
* `doubao-seedance-lite`：轻量版模型。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en:
Model used for video generation tasks. Supported values:

* `doubao-seedance-pro`: Professional version model
* `doubao-seedance-lite`: Lite version model

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn:
生成视频的分辨率。支持的取值如下：

* `480p`
* `720p`（默认）
* `1080p`

使用 `doubao-seedance-lite` 并选择设置尾帧图片时，仅支持生成 `480p` 和 `720p`。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en:
Video resolution for generation. Supported values:

* `480p`
* `720p` (default)
* `1080p`

When using `doubao-seedance-lite` and setting an end frame image, only `480p` and `720p` are supported.

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn: 种子整数，用于控制生成内容的随机性。取值范围为 `[-1, 2^32-1]` 之间的整数，默认值为 `-1`。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Seed integer used to control the randomness of generated content. Valid values are integers between `[-1, 2^32-1]`, with a default value of `-1`.</SOURCE_TEXT>

Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_cn: 是否在生成的视频中包含“AI生成”水印。默认值为 `false`，即不包含水印。
Operation.Task.VideoGeneration.VideoOpti.description_en: Whether to include an "AI generated" watermark in the generated video. Default value is `false`, which means no watermark is included.

Operation.Task.VideoMatting.description_cn: 智能抠图任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `VideoMatting` 时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Task.VideoMatting.description_en: Intelligent matting task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is `VideoMatting`.

Operation.Task.VideoMatting.Model.description_cn:
抠图模型，支持的取值如下：

* `Human`：人像抠图。可从复杂场景中识别人像主体并将其抠出，适用于背景替换等场景。
* `GreenScreen`：绿幕抠图。专门用于处理在绿幕前拍摄的视频。
Operation.Task.VideoMatting.Model.description_en:
Matting model, supported values are as follows:

* `Human`: Human matting. Identifies and extracts the human subject from complex scenes, suitable for background replacement and similar scenarios.
* `GreenScreen`: Green screen matting. Specifically designed for processing videos shot in front of a green screen.

Operation.Task.VideoMatting.NewVid.description_cn:
是否生成新的 Vid：

*  `true`：为抠图后生成的视频分配一个新的 Vid。
*  `false`：（默认）不生成新的 Vid。
Operation.Task.VideoMatting.NewVid.description_en:
Generate a new Vid:

*  `true`: Assign a new Vid to the video after background removal
*  `false`: (Default) Do not generate a new Vid

Operation.Task.VideoMatting.VideoOption.description_cn: 视频生成配置。用于指定抠图后输出视频的封装格式等参数。如不传 `VideoOption` ，则默认生成 WEBM 格式视频。
Operation.Task.VideoMatting.VideoOption.description_en: Video generation settings. Use these to specify parameters such as the output video container format after background removal. If you do not provide `VideoOption`, the system will generate a WEBM format video by default.

Operation.Task.VideoMatting.VideoOption..description_cn:
输出视频的封装格式，支持的取值如下：

* `MOV`
* `WEBM`
Operation.Task.VideoMatting.VideoOption..description_en:
Output video container format. Supported values:

* `MOV`
* `WEBM`

Operation.Task.VideoSummary.description_cn: 视频分段摘要任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `VideoSummary` 时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Task.VideoSummary.description_en: Configure the video segment summary task. Set this parameter when `Type` is `VideoSummary`.

Operation.Task.VideoSummary.BestSegmentD.description_cn:
期望的视频分段时长，单位为秒，默认值为 180。
最终输出的分段视频时长可能不会与您所设置的 `BestSegmentDuration` 严格相符。
Operation.Task.VideoSummary.BestSegmentD.description_en:
Expected video segment duration in seconds, default value is 180
The final output segment duration may not strictly match the `BestSegmentDuration` you set

Operation.Task.VideoSummary.ExtraDescrip.description_cn: 补充任务提示词。默认为空。建议您在效果不达预期时，通过本字段在任务 Prompt 中补充信息。不超过 1000 字符。
Operation.Task.VideoSummary.ExtraDescrip.description_en: Supplementary task prompt words. Default is empty. It is recommended that you use this field to add information to the task prompt if results are not as expected. Maximum 1000 characters.
Operation.Task.VideoSummary.ExtraDescrip.example_cn: 本视频为医学教学视频，按照相关知识点对视频进行分段
Operation.Task.VideoSummary.ExtraDescrip.example_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>This video is a medical teaching video and is segmented according to relevant knowledge points</SOURCE_TEXT>

Operation.Task.VideoSummary.OnlyTimeline.description_cn: 是否仅输出时间线。默认为 `false`，生成的视频分段摘要中，将包含时间、阶段主题、阶段摘要、阶段细节信息。若 `OnlyTimeline` 设置为 `true`，则结果中仅返回时间段信息，即大模型仅进行分段，不生成摘要。
Operation.Task.VideoSummary.OnlyTimeline.description_en: Whether to output only the timeline. Default is `false`. When set to `false`, the generated video segment summary includes time, stage topic, stage summary, and stage details. If `OnlyTimeline` is set to `true`, only time segment information is returned—the model segments the video but does not generate a summary.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.description_cn: 视频理解任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `VideoUnderstanding` 时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.description_en: Video understanding task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is `VideoUnderstanding`.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Model..description_cn:
采样温度，控制生成文本时对每个候选词的概率分布进行平滑的程度。当取值为 `0 `时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。默认值为 `1`，取值范围为 `[0, 2]`。较高的值（如 `0.8`）会使输出更加随机，而较低的值（如 `0.2`）会使输出更加集中确定。
通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Model..description_en:
Sampling temperature controls how much the probability distribution for each candidate word is smoothed during text generation. When set to `0`, the model only considers the token with the highest log probability. The default value is `1`, and the range is `[0, 2]`. Higher values (such as `0.8`) make the output more random, while lower values (such as `0.2`) make the output more focused and deterministic.
It is generally recommended to adjust either `temperature` or `top_p`, but not both.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Model..description_cn:
采样概率阈值。模型会考虑概率质量在 `top_p` 内的 token 结果。当取值为 `0` 时模型仅考虑对数概率最大的一个 token。默认值为 `0.7`，取值范围为 `[0, 1]`。`0.1` 意味着只考虑概率质量最高的前 10% 的 token，取值越大生成的随机性越高，取值越低生成的确定性越高。
通常建议仅调整 `temperature` 或 `top_p` 其中之一，不建议两者都修改。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Model..description_en:
Sampling probability threshold. The model considers token results whose probability mass falls within `top_p`. When set to `0`, the model only considers the token with the highest log probability. The default value is `0.7`, and the valid range is `[0, 1]`. A value of `0.1` means only the top 10% of tokens by probability mass are considered. Higher values increase randomness in generation, while lower values make outputs more deterministic.
It is generally recommended to adjust either `temperature` or `top_p`, but not both.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Prompt.description_cn: 视频理解任务的提示词。使用 UTF-8 编码。长度不可超过 30000 个字符。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Prompt.description_en: Prompt for video understanding tasks. Use UTF-8 encoding. Length must not exceed 30,000 characters.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Segmen.description_cn: 单个切片的最大时长，单位为秒，无默认值。系统会确保最终生成的任何切片时长都不高于此值。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Segmen.description_en: Maximum duration for a single slice, in seconds; no default value. The system ensures that the duration of any generated slice does not exceed this value.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Segmen.description_cn:
单个切片的最小时长，单位为秒，无默认值。系统会确保最终生成的任何切片时长都不低于此值。
若处理场景变化较快的视频，建议设置切片最小时长 > =1 秒，以避免对过短的切片执行视频理解。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Segmen.description_en:
Minimum duration for a single segment, measured in seconds; no default value. The system ensures that the duration of any generated segment is not less than this value.
For videos with rapidly changing scenes, set the minimum segment duration to >= 1 second to avoid performing video understanding on segments that are too short.

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Segmen.description_cn:
场景切分的敏感度阈值。取值范围为 `[0, 100]`。

* 取值越低，算法对场景变化的感知越敏感，切分出的片段越多。
* 取值越高，算法越倾向于将微小的变化视为同一场景，切分出的片段越少。

当您同时设置 `MinDuration`, `MaxDuration` 和 `Threshold` 时，系统会按照以下两阶段逻辑进行切分，以确保所有约束都得到满足：

1. 算法首先会根据您设置的 `Threshold` 和 `MinDuration` 进行切分。
2. 第一阶段切分完毕后，如发现有切片的时长超过您设置的 `MaxDuration`，系统会忽略 `Threshold` 的影响，再进行切分，确保最终时长都不超过 `MaxDuration`。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.Segmen.description_en:
Sensitivity threshold for scene segmentation. Value range: `[0, 100]`

* Lower values make the algorithm more sensitive to scene changes, resulting in more segments
* Higher values make the algorithm more likely to treat minor changes as the same scene, resulting in fewer segments

When you set `MinDuration`, `MaxDuration`, and `Threshold` at the same time, the system uses a two-stage process to ensure all constraints are met:

1. The algorithm first segments based on your `Threshold` and `MinDuration` settings
2. After the first stage, if any segment exceeds your `MaxDuration` setting, the system ignores the `Threshold` and segments again to ensure all durations do not exceed `MaxDuration`

Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.WithSe.description_cn: 是否开启场景切分。开启后，系统会依据转场情况对输入视频进行切分，并输出切片。
Operation.Task.VideoUnderstanding.WithSe.description_en:
Enable scene segmentation
When enabled, the system segments the input video based on scene transitions and outputs segments

Operation.Task.Vision.description_cn: 视频理解任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `Vision`时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Task.Vision.description_en: Video understanding task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is `Vision`.

Operation.Task.Vision.Model.description_cn:
大模型配置。您可通过此参数配置对视频的理解模式。支持以下三种模式：

* **纯视觉理解（仅 VLM）**：适用于需要分析视频画面内容的场景（如不超过 10 分钟的短视频）。会进行视频截图，建议截图分辨率设为 240p 以获得更多截图。推荐使用支持 128k 及以上上下文的模型（如 `doubao-seed-1.6-thinking`）。
* **纯音频理解（仅LLM）**：适用于无需理解视频画面内容的场景（如演讲视频等）。
* **多模态理解（VLM+LLM）**：适用于长视频理解（最长支持 2 小时）。会将长视频切分成多个片段，使用 VLM 分别理解每个片段，最后用 LLM 汇总各片段理解结果。
Operation.Task.Vision.Model.description_en:
Large Model Configuration
You can use this parameter to configure the video understanding mode. The following three modes are supported:

* **Pure Visual Understanding (VLM Only)**: Suitable for scenarios where you need to analyze video visual content (such as short videos under 10 minutes). The system will take video screenshots; it is recommended to set the screenshot resolution to 240p to obtain more screenshots. We recommend using models that support 128k context or above (such as `doubao-seed-1.6-thinking`).
* **Pure Audio Understanding (LLM Only)**: Suitable for scenarios where video visual content does not need to be analyzed (such as speech videos).
* **Multimodal Understanding (VLM+LLM)**: Suitable for long video understanding (supports up to 2 hours). The long video will be split into multiple segments, each segment will be understood by VLM, and finally, LLM will summarize the understanding results of each segment.

Operation.Task.Vision.Model.AsrAppId.description_cn: 语音识别 (ASR) 产品的 APP ID。具体请见[开通大模型流式语音识别服务并获取 APP ID](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1478242#%E5%BC%80%E9%80%9A%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%B5%81%E5%BC%8F%E8%AF%AD%E9%9F%B3%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%B9%B6%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-app-id).
Operation.Task.Vision.Model.AsrAppId.description_en: APP ID of the speech recognition (ASR) product For details, see [Enable Large Model Streaming Speech Recognition Service and Obtain APP ID](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1478242#%E5%BC%80%E9%80%9A%E5%A4%A7%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%B5%81%E5%BC%8F%E8%AF%AD%E9%9F%B3%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E5%B9%B6%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-app-id).

Operation.Task.Vision.Model.AsrAppType.description_cn:
语音识别 (ASR) 产品中流式语音识别大模型的类型，需与您开通的服务类型保持一致。取值如下：
- `volc.bigasr.sauc.duration`: 小时版
- `volc.bigasr.sauc.concurrent`: 并发版
Operation.Task.Vision.Model.AsrAppType.description_en:
The type of large model for streaming speech recognition in the ASR product must match the service type you have enabled. Possible values:
- `volc.bigasr.sauc.duration`: Hourly version
- `volc.bigasr.sauc.concurrent`: Concurrent version

Operation.Task.Vision.Model.DoubaoTextEn.description_cn:
豆包 LLM (Large Language Model) 模型的推理接入点 ID。具体请见[开通豆包大模型并获取 Endpoint ID](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1478242#f7674b4c)。

`DoubaoVisionEndpoint` 和 `DoubaoTextEndpoint` 二选一必填。
Operation.Task.Vision.Model.DoubaoTextEn.description_en:
Inference endpoint ID for the Doubao LLM (Large Language Model) model. For details, see [Enable Doubao Large Model and Obtain Endpoint ID](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1478242#f7674b4c).

Either `DoubaoVisionEndpoint` or `DoubaoTextEndpoint` is required.

Operation.Task.Vision.Model.DoubaoVision.description_cn:
豆包 VLM (Vision Language Model) 模型的推理接入点 ID。具体请见[开通豆包大模型并获取 Endpoint ID](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1478242#f7674b4c)。

`DoubaoVisionEndpoint` 和 `DoubaoTextEndpoint` 二选一必填。
Operation.Task.Vision.Model.DoubaoVision.description_en:
Doubao VLM (Vision Language Model) inference endpoint ID. For details, see [Enable Doubao Large Model and Get Endpoint ID](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1478242#f7674b4c).

You must provide either `DoubaoVisionEndpoint` or `DoubaoTextEndpoint`.

Operation.Task.Vision.NeedAsrSpeaker.description_cn:
是否在 ASR（语音识别）结果中包含说话人信息并用于大模型的推理。默认值为 `false`。

* `true`：包含说话人信息并用于推理，需要 `AsrAppType` 为录音识别大模型 `volc.bigasr.auc_turbo` 才生效；
* `false`：不包含说话人信息。
Operation.Task.Vision.NeedAsrSpeaker.description_en:
Whether to include speaker information in ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) results and use it for large model inference. Default value is `false`.

* `true`: Includes speaker information and uses it for inference. This only takes effect if `AsrAppType` is set to the large model for recording recognition `volc.bigasr.auc_turbo`
* `false`: Does not include speaker information.

Operation.Task.Vision.Prompt.description_cn:
大模型提示词。使用 UTF-8 编码。长度不可超过 30000 个字符。根据 `Model` 参数所配置的视频理解模式，提示词中需包含相应占位符：

* **VLM + LLM 模式**：需包含以下两个占位符
   * `{{PLACEHOLDER_ASR_RESULT}}`：控制是否启用 ASR（语音识别）。
   * `{{PLACEHOLDER_VIDEO_CLIP_RESULT}}`：控制是否进行视频切片。
* **仅 VLM 或仅 LLM 模式**：只需包含 `{{PLACEHOLDER_ASR_RESULT}}`占位符。
Operation.Task.Vision.Prompt.description_en:
Large model prompts. Use UTF-8 encoding. Length must not exceed 30,000 characters. Depending on the video understanding mode set by the `Model` parameter, the prompt must include the appropriate placeholders:

* **VLM + LLM mode**: Must include the following two placeholders
   * `{{PLACEHOLDER_ASR_RESULT}}`: Controls whether ASR (automatic speech recognition) is enabled
   * `{{PLACEHOLDER_VIDEO_CLIP_RESULT}}`: Controls whether video segmentation is performed
* **VLM only or LLM only mode**: Only include the `{{PLACEHOLDER_ASR_RESULT}}` placeholder
Operation.Task.Vision.Prompt.example_cn:
# 角色
你是一个视频理解的专家，擅长理解和分析视频。

# 任务
输入的内容是从爆火网络视频中总结的视频分段描述文本和视频音频转译的文本，请根据输入的内容理解视频，并详细描述一下视频的内容.

# 视频分段描述文本
{{PLACEHOLDER_VIDEO_CLIP_RESULT}}

# 视频转音频文本
{{PLACEHOLDER_ASR_RESULT}}
Operation.Task.Vision.Prompt.example_en:
# Role
You are a video understanding expert, skilled in comprehending and analyzing videos.

# Task
The input contains summarized video segment descriptions and transcribed audio text from a viral online video. Please use the provided content to understand the video and give a detailed description of its content.

# Video Segment Descriptions
{{PLACEHOLDER_VIDEO_CLIP_RESULT}}

# Video Audio Transcription
{{PLACEHOLDER_ASR_RESULT}}

Operation.Task.Vision.ResponseFormatType.description_cn:
指定视频理解结果的输出格式。支持的取值如下：

* `""`：默认值，不产生任何效果，大模型输出的格式由 Prompt 中指定。
* `json_object`：大模型会参考 Prompt 中指定的 JSON 格式稳定输出准确的 JSON 格式。
Operation.Task.Vision.ResponseFormatType.description_en:
Specify the output format for video understanding results. Supported values:

* "": Default value; no effect. The output format of the large model is determined by the prompt
* "json_object": The large model will refer to the JSON format specified in the prompt and consistently output an accurate JSON format

Operation.Task.Vision.Segment.description_cn: 视频分段理解配置。用于指定视频理解任务的起始和结束时间。若不设置 `Start`，则默认从视频开头开始；若不设置 `End`，则默认到视频结尾结束。`End` 要大于 `Start`。
Operation.Task.Vision.Segment.description_en: Video segment understanding configuration. Used to specify the start and end times for a video understanding task. If `Start` is not set, the task begins at the start of the video by default; if `End` is not set, the task ends at the end of the video by default. `End` must be greater than `Start`.

Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.description_cn: 截图策略配置。视频理解处理过程中会对视频进行截图。默认截图策略为均匀时间间隔截图最多 50 张。若您需要更改截图策略，可传入此参数。
Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Screenshot strategy configuration. The system takes screenshots during video analysis. The default strategy captures up to 50 screenshots at evenly spaced time intervals. To change the screenshot strategy, pass this parameter.</SOURCE_TEXT>

Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_cn: 框选区域右下角相对于视频左上角在 X 轴上的偏移比例，取值范围为 [0,1]，其中 0 表示无偏移（与视频左边缘对齐），1 表示完全偏移（与视频右边缘对齐）。
Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_en: Offset ratio of the selected area's lower right corner along the X axis, measured from the video's upper left corner. Range: [0, 1], where 0 means aligned with the left edge of the video and 1 means aligned with the right edge.

Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_cn: 框选区域右下角相对于视频左上角在 Y 轴上的偏移比例，取值范围为 [0,1]，其中 0 表示无偏移（与视频上边缘对齐），1 表示完全偏移（与视频下边缘对齐）。
Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_en: Y-axis offset ratio of the bottom-right corner of the selected area relative to the top-left corner of the video, ranging from 0 to 1. 0 means no offset (aligned with the top edge of the video), and 1 means full offset (aligned with the bottom edge of the video)

Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_cn: 框选区域左上角相对于视频左上角在X轴上的偏移比例，取值范围为[0,1]，其中 0 表示无偏移（与视频左边缘对齐），1 表示完全偏移（与视频右边缘对齐）。
Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>The offset ratio of the top-left corner of the selected area relative to the top-left corner of the video along the X-axis. The value range is [0,1], where 0 means no offset (aligned with the left edge of the video) and 1 means fully offset (aligned with the right edge of the video).</SOURCE_TEXT>

Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_cn: 框选区域左上角相对于视频左上角在 Y 轴上的偏移比例，取值范围为 [0,1]，其中 0 表示无偏移（与视频上边缘对齐），1 表示完全偏移（与视频下边缘对齐）。
Operation.Task.Vision.SnapshotParam.Area.description_en: Offset ratio of the selected area's top-left corner relative to the video's top-left corner along the Y axis. Value range: [0, 1], where 0 means no offset (aligned with the top edge of the video) and 1 means fully offset (aligned with the bottom edge of the video).

Operation.Template.description_cn: 单模板任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `Template` 时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Template.description_en:
Single template task configuration
Set this parameter when `Type` is `Template`.

Operation.Template.ByteHD.description_cn: 极智超清模板任务配置。当 `Type` 取值为 `ByteHD` 时，需要设置此参数。
Operation.Template.ByteHD.description_en: ByteHD Ultra HD template task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is set to `ByteHD`.

Operation.Template.ByteHD.TemplateId.description_cn: 极智超清模板 ID。可在视频点播控制台创建模板并获取模板 ID，详见[极智超清模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/165177)。
Operation.Template.ByteHD.TemplateId.description_en: Smart Ultra HD Template ID. You can create a template and obtain the template ID in the Video on Demand console. For details, see [Smart Ultra HD Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/165177).

Operation.Template.ByteHD.WatermarkTempl.description_cn: 水印贴片模板 ID。若设置此参数，系统会在转码过程中将不同形式的水印以数据元素的形式和原视频画面融合和拼接，输出带水印的新视频文件。可在视频点播控制台创建模板并获取模板 ID，详见[水印贴片模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65686)。
Operation.Template.ByteHD.WatermarkTempl.description_en: Watermark patch template ID. If you set this parameter, the system merges and stitches different forms of watermarks as data elements into the original video during transcoding, outputting a new video file with watermarks. You can create a template and get the template ID in the Video on Demand console. For details, see [Watermark Patch Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65686).

Operation.Template.Enhance.description_cn: 画质增强模板任务配置。当 `Type` 取值为 `Enhance` 时，需要设置此参数。
Operation.Template.Enhance.description_en: Quality enhancement template task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is set to `Enhance`.

Operation.Template.Enhance.TemplateId.description_cn: 画质增强模板 ID。可在视频点播控制台创建模板并获取模板 ID，详见[画质增强模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/117971)。
Operation.Template.Enhance.TemplateId.description_en: Quality enhancement template ID. You can create a template and get the template ID in the Video on Demand Console. For details, see [Quality Enhancement Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/117971).

Operation.Template.TranscodeAudio.description_cn: 音频转码模板任务配置。当 `Type` 取值为 `TranscodeAudio` 时，需要设置此参数。
Operation.Template.TranscodeAudio.description_en: Audio transcoding template task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is set to `TranscodeAudio`.

Operation.Template.TranscodeAudio.Templa.description_cn: 音频转码模板 ID。可在视频点播控制台创建模板并获取模板 ID，详见[音频转码模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65683)。
Operation.Template.TranscodeAudio.Templa.description_en: Audio Transcoding Template ID. You can create a template and get the template ID in the Video on Demand console. For details, see [Audio Transcoding Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65683).

Operation.Template.TranscodeVideo.description_cn: 视频转码模板任务配置。当 `Type` 取值为 `TranscodeVideo` 时，需要设置此参数。
Operation.Template.TranscodeVideo.description_en: Video transcoding template task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is set to `TranscodeVideo`.

Operation.Template.TranscodeVideo.Templa.description_cn: 视频转码模板 ID。可在视频点播控制台创建模板并获取模板 ID，详见[视频转码模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65682)。
Operation.Template.TranscodeVideo.Templa.description_en: Video Transcoding Template ID. You can create a template and get the template ID in the Video on Demand Console. For details, see [Video Transcoding Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65682).

Operation.Template.TranscodeVideo.Waterm.description_cn: 水印贴片模板 ID。若设置此参数，系统会在转码过程中将不同形式的水印以数据元素的形式和原视频画面融合和拼接，输出带水印的新视频文件。可在视频点播控制台创建模板并获取模板 ID，详见[水印贴片模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65686)。
Operation.Template.TranscodeVideo.Waterm.description_en: Watermark Overlay Template ID. If you set this parameter, the system merges and splices different types of watermarks as data elements with the original video during transcoding, then outputs a new video file with watermarks. You can create templates and obtain template IDs in the Video on Demand console. For details, see [Watermark Overlay Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65686).

Operation.Template.Type.description_cn:
单模板任务类型。取值如下：

- `TranscodeVideo`：视频转码模板任务。
- `ByteHD`：极智超清模板任务。
- `TranscodeAudio`：音频转码模板任务。
- `Enhance`：画质增强模板任务。
Operation.Template.Type.description_en:
Single template task type. The available values are as follows:

- `TranscodeVideo`: Video transcoding template task
- `ByteHD`: ByteHD ultra HD template task
- `TranscodeAudio`: Audio transcoding template task
- `Enhance`: Image quality enhancement template task

Operation.Type.description_cn:
处理类型。取值如下：

- `Template`：单模板任务。
- `Task`：单任务。
- `Workflow`: 工作流任务。
Operation.Type.description_en:
Processing type. Available values:

- `Template`: single template task
- `Task`: single task
- `Workflow`: workflow task

Operation.Workflow.description_cn: 工作流任务配置。当 `Type` 为 `Workflow` 时需要设置此参数。
Operation.Workflow.description_en: Workflow task configuration. Set this parameter when `Type` is `Workflow`

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.description_cn: 媒体处理任务的输入文件信息。默认采用外层的 `Input` 或 `MultiInputs`作为工作流节点中任务的输入。若在此处进行指定，则会使用此处指定的输入。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.description_en: Input file information for media processing tasks. By default, the outer `Input` or `MultiInputs` is used as the input for the task in the workflow node. If you specify the input here, it will be used instead.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_cn:
通过 DirectUrl 模式指定待处理视频的信息。您需要在调用本接口前，通过任一方式将视频[上传](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887?lang=zh)至点播空间，并获取其相关信息。
您必须设置 `Vid`、`DirectUrl` 或 `FileId` 参数之一，但不能同时设置这三个参数。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_en:
Specify the information of the video to be processed using DirectUrl mode. Before calling this API, you need to [upload](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887?lang=zh) the video to the VOD space by any method and obtain its related information
You must set one of the `Vid`, `DirectUrl`, or `FileId` parameters, but you cannot set all three at the same time

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_cn: 存储桶名称。可调用 [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) 获取空间所绑定的存储桶名称。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_en: Bucket name. You can call [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) to get the bucket name bound to the space.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_cn: 文件路径。音视频上传至视频点播服务后，您可通过[媒资上传完成事件](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655)获取 `FileName`。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_en: File path. After uploading audio or video to the video-on-demand service, you can obtain the `FileName` through the [media asset upload completion event](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655).

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_cn: 空间名称。可调用 [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) 获取当前账号下所有空间的信息。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.DirectUrl.description_en: Space Name. You can call [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) to get information about all spaces under your current account.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.FileId.description_cn:
转码产物 ID 信息。

您必须设置 `Vid`、`DirectUrl` 或 `FileId` 参数之一，但不能同时设置这三个参数。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.FileId.description_en:
Transcoded Product ID Information

You must set only one of the `Vid`, `DirectUrl`, or `FileId` parameters; you cannot set more than one at the same time

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.FileId.Fi.description_cn: 转码产物文件 ID。可通过 [GetMediaInfos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1256363) 接口从返回参数 `TranscodeInfos` 中获取转码产物的文件 ID。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.FileId.Fi.description_en: Transcoded product file ID. You can obtain the transcoded product file ID from the `TranscodeInfos` parameter returned by the [GetMediaInfos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1256363) API.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.FileId.Vi.description_cn: 视频 ID。音视频上传至视频点播服务后，您可通过[媒资上传完成事件](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655)获取 `Vid`。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.FileId.Vi.description_en: Video ID. After uploading audio and video to the video-on-demand service, you can obtain the `Vid` through the [Media Upload Completion Event](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/4655).

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Schema.description_cn: 动态输入 Schema，用于启用任务串联功能，将前一个任务的输出结果，动态地作为下一个任务的输入，例如实现“先视频生成，再对生成结果进行超分”这类链式处理流程。如需启用任务串联功能，您需将 `Schema` 参数的值设置为 `Template`，再在 `Input` 对象的其他字段（如 `Vid`, `DirectUrl.FileName`）中使用 [Go Template](https://pkg.go.dev/text/template#Template.Option) 语法来引用上游节点的输出。详细使用说明，请见[使用动态输入 Schema 实现任务串联](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1923423?lang=zh)。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Schema.description_en: Dynamic input schema enables task chaining, allowing the output of the previous task to be dynamically used as the input for the next task—for example, generating a video first, then applying super-resolution to the generated result in a chained workflow. To enable task chaining, set the `Schema` parameter to `Template`, and use [Go Template](https://pkg.go.dev/text/template#Template.Option) syntax in other fields of the `Input` object (such as `Vid`, `DirectUrl.FileName`) to reference the output from upstream nodes. For detailed instructions, see [Using Dynamic Input Schema for Task Chaining](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1923423?lang=zh).

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Tag.description_cn:
标识输入的类型，用于区分不同场景下的输入内容。支持的取值如下：

* `FirstFrame`：视频生成任务中表示输入图片作为视频首帧。
* `LastFrame`：视频生成任务中表示输入图片使用视频尾帧。仅 doubao-seedance-lite 模型支持使用图片作为尾帧生成视频。
* `ImageSet`：OCR 提取字幕任务中表示输入为图集。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Tag.description_en:
Identifies the input type to distinguish input content in different scenarios. Supported values:

* `FirstFrame`: In video generation tasks, indicates the input image is used as the first frame of the video
* `LastFrame`: In video generation tasks, indicates the input image is used as the last frame of the video. Only the doubao-seedance-lite model supports using an image as the last frame to generate a video
* `ImageSet`: In OCR subtitle extraction tasks, indicates the input is an image set

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Type.description_cn:
输入文件类型。取值如下：

* `Vid`：Vid 模式。此模式下，您还需设置 `Vid` 参数。
* `DirectUrl`：DirectUrl 模式。此模式下，您还需设置 `DirectUrl` 参数。
* `FileId`: FileId 模式。此模式下，您还需设置 `FileId` 参数。

* 仅**巨量广告预审任**务支持 FileId 模式。
* **文件删除任务**仅支持 DirectUrl 模式。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Type.description_en:
Enter file type. Available values:

* `Vid`: Vid mode. In this mode, you also need to set the `Vid` parameter.
* `DirectUrl`: DirectUrl mode. In this mode, you also need to set the `DirectUrl` parameter.
* `FileId`: FileId mode. In this mode, you also need to set the `FileId` parameter.

* Only **Juliang Ads Pre-Review tasks** support FileId mode.
* **File Deletion tasks** only support DirectUrl mode.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Input.Vid.description_cn:
待处理视频的 Vid。您需要在调用本接口前，通过任一方式将视频[上传](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887?lang=zh)至点播空间，并获取其 `Vid`。
您必须设置 `Vid`、`DirectUrl` 或 `FileId` 参数之一，但不能同时设置这三个参数。

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 输出视频配置。用于指定输出视频的分辨率和帧率。如果不传，系统将默认保持与源视频一致。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en:
Output Video Settings
Specify the output video's resolution and frame rate. If not set, the system will match the source video by default

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 设置输出视频的目标平均码率。该参数将决定视频的视觉质量和最终的文件体积。取值范围为 `[10, 50000]`。为确保不同场景下的画质稳定性，系统会根据视频内容的复杂度进行动态调整。实际输出码率将在您设定目标的 **0.8 倍至 1.5 倍**之间波动。请参考[不同输出分辨率的推荐码率表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/117971#692790fd)进行设置。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Set the target average bitrate for the output video. This parameter determines the visual quality and final file size. The valid range is `[10, 50000]`. To ensure stable image quality across different scenarios, the system dynamically adjusts based on the complexity of the video content. The actual output bitrate will fluctuate between **0.8 times and 1.5 times** your target setting. Refer to the [recommended bitrate table for different output resolutions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/117971#692790fd) for guidance.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 目标帧率，单位为 fps。取值范围为 `(0, 120]`。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Target frame rate, unit: fps. Value range: `(0, 120]`.

Target resolution. Supported values are as follows:

* `240p`
* `360p`
* `480p`
* `540p`
* `720p`
* `1080p`
* `2k`
* `4k`

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 目标长宽限制，用于指定输出视频的长边或短边的最大像素值，取值范围为 `[64, 2160]`。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Maximum side length. Sets the maximum pixel value for the long or short side of the output video. Valid range: [64, 2160]

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 视频增强策略。用于控制视频增强的类型和强度。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Video enhancement strategy. Controls the type and intensity of video enhancement.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn:
视频增强强度，支持的取值如下：

* `-50`：轻度（高保真）。进行轻微增强，效果更贴近原片质感。
* `0`：中等。提供平衡的画质提升效果。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en:
Video enhancement strength. Supported values:

* `-50`: Mild (High Fidelity). Applies slight enhancement for a result closer to the original footage
* `0`: Moderate. Provides balanced image quality improvement

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn:
画质增强类型：

* `0`：**极速版本**。秒级响应，集成基础超分与画质修复，兼顾效率与清晰度。
* `1`：**标准版本**。采用自适应多维度增强算法，精准平衡处理速度与视觉质感。

画质增强类型不同，对应的算法强度不同，费用也不同，详细价格请参见[画质增强（升级版）](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1941013#810bf860)。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en:
Image Quality Enhancement Types:

* `0`: **Ultra-Fast Version**. Second-level response, integrates basic super-resolution and image restoration, balancing efficiency and clarity
* `1`: **Standard Version**. Uses adaptive multidimensional enhancement algorithms for a precise balance between processing speed and visual quality

Different image quality enhancement types correspond to different algorithm strengths and costs. For detailed pricing, see [Image Quality Enhancement (Upgraded Version)](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/1941013#810bf860).

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn:
增强模型类型。默认为 `Custom`。

* `Custom`: 自定义增强模型。您需要通过 `Modules` 参数，手动组合一个或多个独立的增强算子（如超分、插帧等）。
* `Moe`:（推荐）场景化增强模型。您需要通过 `MoeEnhance` 参数选择一个针对特定场景（如短剧、AIGC 等）的预设模板，系统会自动应用最优的算子组合。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en:
Enhancement model type. Default is `Custom`.

* `Custom`: Custom enhancement model. You need to use the `Modules` parameter to manually combine one or more independent enhancement operators (such as super-resolution, frame interpolation, etc)
* `Moe`: (Recommended) Scenario-based enhancement model. You need to use the `MoeEnhance` parameter to select a preset template for a specific scenario (such as short-form drama, AIGC, etc). The system will automatically apply the optimal combination of operators.

The value range is [0,1], where 0 means no offset (aligned with the left edge of the video) and 1 means fully offset (aligned with the right edge of the video).</SOURCE_TEXT>

Specifies the height of the erased text and the ratio of its distance from the center of the video width for precise control of the erasure area
Effective only when `Mode` is set to `Auto` and `Type` is set to `Subtitle`

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 文字高度最大比例，默认值为 `0.1`，即视频高度的 10%。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Maximum text height ratio. Default value is `0.1`, which means 10% of the video height.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 文字高度最小比例，默认值为 `0.01`，即视频高度的 1%。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Minimum text height ratio. Default value is `0.01`, which equals 1% of the video height.

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 文字区域中心偏离视频宽中心的比例。默认值为 `0.08`，即 8%。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: The ratio by which the center of the text area deviates from the center of the video width. The default value is `0.08`, or 8%.

- `Subtitle`: Erase text detected as subtitles by OCR
- `Text`: (Beta) Erase subtitles and other text (such as character introductions), except for scene text (e.g., palace plaques, etc.)

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Erase options. Specify subtitle erasure only for specific video segments or skip erasure for certain segments to allow more precise control

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en:

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn: 片段的起始时间，单位为秒。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Segment start time, unit: seconds

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_cn:
片段处理模式。决定了如何处理 `Clips` 数组中定义的时间片段。

* `Skip`: 跳过模式。系统将擦除整个视频，但会跳过 `Clips` 数组中指定的片段区域，使其字幕保持原样。
* `Selected`: 选中模式。系统将仅对 `Clips` 数组中指定的片段区域进行字幕擦除，视频的其他部分保持原样。
Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en:
Segment processing mode. Determines how to handle the time segments defined in the `Clips` array.

* `Skip`: Skip mode. The system erases subtitles from the entire video except for the segments specified in the `Clips` array, where subtitles remain unchanged
* `Selected`: Selected mode. The system erases subtitles only in the segments specified in the `Clips` array; subtitles in other parts of the video remain unchanged

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: Manual Erase Mode Configuration

Operation.Workflow.Nodes.Operation.Task..description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Erase box array. After adding an erase box, the system only erases text inside the box.</SOURCE_TEXT>
