AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Property.description_en:
Match Property Type Enumeration
The frontend defaults to Property=0. When the operator is an IP identification operation (17–21), the frontend automatically sets Property=5 and clears ValueString.
- 0: Value, matches by field value; the frontend uses this value except for IP identification operations
- 1: StrLen, string length, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 2: Size, size, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 3: Keys, key set, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 4: Version, version, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 5: IP, only used for IP identification operations with Operator=17–21
- 6: Country, country or region, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_cn:
匹配值.
前端校验规则:
- Opretar=17~21 时不涉及匹配内容,前端会清空 ValueString,可传空字符串
- Opretar=23/24 时填写 IP 地址组 ID,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=25/26 时填写地域编码,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=27 时填写 IP 情报标签,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=28/29 时填写 ASN,多个值以英文逗号分隔;前端会校验 ASN 范围且不允许重复
- ObjType=request.ja3-hash 且 Opretar=14/15 时,多个 JA3 Hash 以英文逗号分隔,最多 10 个且不允许重复
- 其他操作符均需按实际匹配值填写
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_en:
Matching value.
Frontend validation rules:
- When Opretar=17~21, matching content is not involved; the frontend will clear ValueString and can pass an empty string
- When Opretar=23/24, enter IP address group ID; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=25/26, enter region codes; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=27, enter IP intelligence tags; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=28/29, enter ASN; multiple values are separated by commas; the frontend will validate ASN range and duplicates are not allowed
- When ObjType=request.ja3-hash and Opretar=14/15, enter multiple JA3 Hash values separated by commas, up to 10 values and duplicates are not allowed
- All other operators require actual matching values

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.HttpObj.description_en:
Matching Objects
Fixed objects are automatically generated as HttpObj by ObjType; only custom objects require specifying a Key in HttpObj.
All modules using frontend advanced condition components support the following fixed objects:
- request.schema: Request protocol
- request.uri: Request URI
- request.method: Request method
- request.path: Request path
- request.queryargs: Request parameters
- request.header: Request header
- request.header.ua: Request User-Agent
- request.header.refer: Request Referer
- request.header.cookie: Request Cookie header
- request.header.content-length: Request body length
- request.header.content-type: Request body format
- request.header.x-forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
- request.header.clientip: Client IP
Fixed objects controlled by capability switches:
- request.ja3-hash: JA3 Hash; BP CDN regions are supported, others are not
- request.session-id: Session ID; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
- request.fp: Browser fingerprint; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
Objects not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components:
- response.header/response.body/response.code/response.header.content-type/response.header.{Key}/response.body.{Key}: Not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components, considered unsupported by frontend standards
- country/request.ja3: Not available in any frontend external modules
Custom object formats supported by all modules using frontend advanced condition components:
- request.queryargs.{Key}: Custom request parameter, Key is required
- request.header.{Key}: Custom request header, Key is required; frontend requires header words to start with a capital letter
- request.cookie.{Key}: Custom Cookie, Key is required
Note:
- When ObjType=13/14/15, you cannot directly pass request.queryargs./request.header./request.cookie.; a specific Key must be included

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_en:
Matching operator enumeration
Basic operators:
- 0: Greater than
- 1: Greater than or equal to
- 2: Equal to
- 3: Less than
- 4: Less than or equal to
- 5: Not equal to
- 6: Contains substring
- 7: Does not contain substring
- 8: Contains prefix
- 9: Does not contain prefix
- 10: Contains suffix
- 11: Does not contain suffix
- 12: Contains all in match set
- 13: Does not contain all in match set
- 14: Belongs to match set
- 15: Does not belong to match set
- 16: Regex match
IP recognition operators, only for request.header.clientip and custom objects; when used, Property is fixed at 5, ValueString does not need to be specified:
- 17: Is IP
- 18: Is IPv4
- 19: Is IPv6
- 20: Is private IP
- 21: Is public IP
Extended operators:
- 22: max, reserved value; not supported by VOLC and BP valid_check, not available for any external frontend modules
- 23: Contains address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 24: Excludes address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 25: Contains geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 26: Excludes geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 27: Contains IP intelligence, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control when TIIPTagAvailable=true; latest BP waf_available is only available for byteplus-global, VOLC waf_available has no available regions
- 28: AS number belongs to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
- 29: AS number does not belong to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
Available operators by ObjType:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: available operators: 2–16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: available operators: 0–5
- request.header.clientip: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16/17–21/23–26; 27 can only be used when TIIPTagAvailable=true and the region is available; 28/29 can only be used when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true and the region is available
- request.queryargs.{Key}/request.header.{Key}/request.cookie.{Key}: available operators: 0–21
- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN regions are supported, others are not; available operators: 2/5/14/15; for 14/15, up to 10 values can be entered and must be unique

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Property.description_cn:
匹配属性类型枚举.
前端默认填充 Property=0;当操作符为 17~21 的 IP 识别类操作时,前端自动改为 Property=5 并清空 ValueString.
- 0: Value,按字段值匹配;除 IP 识别类操作外,前端均使用该值
- 1: StrLen,字符串长度,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 2: Size,大小,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 3: Keys,Key 集合,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 4: Version,版本,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 5: IP,仅用于 Opretar=17~21 的 IP 识别类操作
- 6: Country,国家或地区,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Property.description_en:
Match Property Type Enumeration
The frontend defaults to Property=0. When the operator is an IP identification operation (17–21), the frontend automatically sets Property=5 and clears ValueString.
- 0: Value, matches by field value; the frontend uses this value except for IP identification operations
- 1: StrLen, string length, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 2: Size, size, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 3: Keys, key set, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 4: Version, version, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 5: IP, only used for IP identification operations with Operator=17–21
- 6: Country, country or region, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_cn:
匹配值.
前端校验规则:
- Opretar=17~21 时不涉及匹配内容,前端会清空 ValueString,可传空字符串
- Opretar=23/24 时填写 IP 地址组 ID,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=25/26 时填写地域编码,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=27 时填写 IP 情报标签,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=28/29 时填写 ASN,多个值以英文逗号分隔;前端会校验 ASN 范围且不允许重复
- ObjType=request.ja3-hash 且 Opretar=14/15 时,多个 JA3 Hash 以英文逗号分隔,最多 10 个且不允许重复
- 其他操作符均需按实际匹配值填写
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_en:
Matching value.
Frontend validation rules:
- When Opretar=17~21, matching content is not involved; the frontend will clear ValueString and can pass an empty string
- When Opretar=23/24, enter IP address group ID; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=25/26, enter region codes; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=27, enter IP intelligence tags; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=28/29, enter ASN; multiple values are separated by commas; the frontend will validate ASN range and duplicates are not allowed
- When ObjType=request.ja3-hash and Opretar=14/15, enter multiple JA3 Hash values separated by commas, up to 10 values and duplicates are not allowed
- All other operators require actual matching values

* `2`：观察。
ActionAfterVerification.description_en:
Follow-up action after successful challenge verification. Only effective when `ActionType` is `6` (JS challenge), `7` (CAPTCHA), or `10` (proof of work). Supported values are:

* `1`: Block
* `2`: Observe

ActionType.description_cn:
执行的动作。支持的取值如下所示：

* `0`：观察；
* `1`：限速；（仅频率限制场景，即`StatisticalType=1`时支持）
* `2`：拦截；
* `6`：JS挑战；
* `7`：人机验证；
* `10`：工作量证明；
* `11`：丢弃。
ActionType.description_en:
Action to execute. Supported values are:

* `0`: Observe
* `1`: Rate limit (supported only in frequency limit scenarios, i.e., when `StatisticalType=1`)
* `2`: Block
* `6`: JS challenge
* `7`: CAPTCHA
* `10`: Proof of work
* `11`: Drop

CronConfs.description_cn:
周期循环配置列表;数组元素为 CronConf,按 crontab 指定阈值切换.
CronEnable=1 时至少传入一项;CronEnable=0 时传空数组.
CronConfs.description_en:
Periodic cycle configuration list; array elements are CronConf, thresholds switch according to crontab specification.
When CronEnable=1, at least one item must be provided; when CronEnable=0, pass an empty array.

CronConfs.Crontab.description_cn:
crontab 表达式;与 CC 周期循环配置保持一致,需满足 confcenter 的 crontab 校验规则.
推荐格式:* <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>,例如 * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.
当前实现要求同一规则内的周配置保持一致,且小时区间不能重叠.
CronConfs.Crontab.description_en:
crontab expression; consistent with CC cycle configuration, must comply with confcenter's crontab validation rules.
Recommended format: * <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>, for example * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.
The current implementation requires the week configuration within the same rule to be consistent, and hour ranges must not overlap.

CronConfs.PathThreshold.description_cn: 命中该时段时的路径总阈值;与 Bot Frequency 主阈值一致,取值范围为 1~300000.
CronConfs.PathThreshold.description_en: Total path threshold for this time period; consistent with the main Bot Frequency threshold, value range: 1~300000.

CronConfs.SingleThreshold.description_cn: 命中该时段时的单对象阈值;与 Bot Frequency 主阈值一致,取值范围为 1~300000.
CronConfs.SingleThreshold.description_en: Single object threshold for this time period; consistent with the main Bot Frequency threshold, value range: 1~300000.

CronEnable.description_cn:
周期循环开关;省略时默认按 0 处理.仅 StatisticalType=1 的频率限制规则支持.
- 0: 永久生效,此时 CronConfs 传空数组.
- 1: 按 CronConfs 周期循环生效.
CronEnable.description_en:
Periodic cycle switch; defaults to 0 if omitted. Only supported for frequency limit rules with StatisticalType=1.
- 0: Permanent effect; CronConfs should be an empty array.
- 1: Takes effect periodically according to CronConfs.

EffectTime.description_cn:
动作生效时长，单位为秒。有效范围为 30～86400 秒。
除 `ActionType` 为 `1`（限速）外，创建和更新规则时需填写该字段。
EffectTime.description_en:
Action duration in seconds. Valid range: 30–86400 seconds.
Required when creating or updating a rule, except when `ActionType` is `1` (rate limiting).

Enable.description_cn:
启用状态。支持的取值如下所示：

* `0`：关闭；
* `1`：开启。
Enable.description_en:
Enable status. Supported values are:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

ExemptionTime.description_cn:
人机挑战、JS挑战或工作量证明的豁免时间，单位为秒。有效范围为 30～3600 秒。
仅当`ActionType`为以下值时需要填写：

* `6`：JS挑战
* `7`：人机验证
* `10`：工作量证明
ExemptionTime.description_en:
Exemption time for CAPTCHA, JS challenge, or proof of work, in seconds. Valid range: 30–3600 seconds.
Required only when `ActionType` is one of the following:

* `6`: JS challenge
* `7`: CAPTCHA
* `10`: Proof of work

Field.description_cn:
统计规则的统计对象，支持单个或多个字段，多个字段使用英文逗号分隔（最多 10 个）。多个统计对象使用英文逗号拼接，不加空格。
字段格式分为两类：无需 Key 的枚举值和需要 Key 的枚举值。

* 无需 Key 的枚举值包括：
   * `CLIENTIP`：客户端 IP （仅`StatisticalType=1`时支持）
   * `JA3HASH`：JA3 哈希值（仅 byteplus-global 地域适用）。
* 需要 Key 的枚举值包括：
   * `HEADER:{Header-Name}`：指定请求头（例如 `HEADER:X-Forwarded-For`）；
   * `ARGS:{ArgName}`：指定请求参数（例如 `ARGS:device_id`）；
   * `COOKIE:{CookieName}`：指定 Cookie（例如 `COOKIE:token`）。
Field.description_en:
Statistical objects for the rule. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas (up to 10). Combine multiple statistical objects with commas, no spaces.
Field formats are divided into two types: enumerated values without keys and enumerated values with keys.

* Enumerated values without keys include:
   * `CLIENTIP`: Client IP (supported only when `StatisticalType=1`)
   * `JA3HASH`: JA3 hash value (applicable only in byteplus-global region)
* Enumerated values with keys include:
   * `HEADER:{Header-Name}`: Specify request header (e.g., `HEADER:X-Forwarded-For`)
   * `ARGS:{ArgName}`: Specify request parameter (e.g., `ARGS:device_id`)
   * `COOKIE:{CookieName}`: Specify cookie (e.g., `COOKIE:token`)

Host.description_en: Domain name of the website to be protected.

Name.description_cn:
规则名称。

* 以中文、字母、数字开头。
* 允许字母、数字、中文、点“.”、下划线“_”和中划线“-”。
* 长度为1~128个字符
Name.description_en:
Rule Name

* Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number
* Letters, numbers, Chinese characters, dot '.', underscore '_', and hyphen '-' are allowed
* Length must be 1–128 characters

Path.description_cn: 指定规则适用的请求路径，可填写具体页面路径，也可匹配整站或某个目录下的全部路径（使用通配符*）；通配符 `*`只能出现在路径末尾。
Path.description_en: Specify the request path to which the rule applies. You can enter a specific page path, or match all paths on the site or within a directory (using the wildcard *). The wildcard `*` can only appear at the end of the path.

PathThreshold.description_cn: 当前路径的总访问次数阈值，仅当统计方式为频率限制（`StatisticalType=1`）时生效，取值范围为 1～300000 次。
PathThreshold.description_en: Total access threshold for the current path, effective only when the statistical method is frequency limit (StatisticalType=1). Value range: 1–300,000 times.

ProjectName.description_cn: 所属项目资源名称，获取方式可参考[ListProjectResources - 获取项目资源列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1131874)。
ProjectName.description_en: Name of the project resource. For how to obtain, refer to [ListProjectResources - Get project resource list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1131874).

RulePriority.description_cn: 同一路径同一高级条件下的规则生效优先级。取值范围：0～9。不同规则间的优先级不可重复。如需查询优先级，可调用[ListBotAnalyseProtectRulePriorityAvailable - 查询 bot 统计防护规则可用优先级](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6511/1275720)。
RulePriority.description_en: Rule execution priority under the same path and advanced condition. Value range: 0–9. Priorities cannot be duplicated between different rules. To query available priorities, call [ListBotAnalyseProtectRulePriorityAvailable - Query available bot statistical protection rule priorities](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6511/1275720).

SingleProportion.description_cn: 单个统计对象的占比阈值。仅当`StatisticalType`为`3`（重复占比）时启用，此时需传入该字段。取值范围为 `[0, 1)`。
SingleProportion.description_en: Proportion threshold for a single statistical object. Enabled only when `StatisticalType` is `3` (duplicate proportion); you must provide this field in this case. Value range: `[0, 1)`.

SingleThreshold.description_cn: 单个统计对象的次数阈值，单位为次。仅在统计方式为频率限制（`StatisticalType=1`）时使用。取值范围为 1～300000 次。
SingleThreshold.description_en: Threshold for the number of times a single statistical object is accessed, measured in times. Used only when the statistical method is frequency limit (StatisticalType=1). Value range: 1–300,000 times.

StatisticalDuration.description_cn:
统计时间窗口，单位为秒。不同统计场景下的取值范围不同：

* 频率限制场景（`StatisticalType=1`）：取值范围为 5~1800 秒；
* 重复统计场景（`StatisticalType=2` 或`StatisticalType=3`）：取值范围为 1~60 秒。
StatisticalDuration.description_en:
Statistical time window, in seconds. Value ranges vary by scenario:

* Frequency limit scenario (`StatisticalType=1`): 5–1800 seconds
* Duplicate statistics scenario (`StatisticalType=2` or `StatisticalType=3`): 1–60 seconds

StatisticalType.description_cn:
统计方式。支持的取值如下所示：

* `1`：访问频率；
* `2`：重复次数；
* `3`：重复占比。
StatisticalType.description_en:
Statistical type. Supported values:

* `1`: Access frequency
* `2`: Repeat count
* `3`: Repeat ratio

AccurateGroup.description_cn:
高级条件,未配置时无需此字段.
当前路径 Url 与 AccurateGroup 之间是 AND 关系,只有同时命中时规则才会生效.
CreateCCRule 和 UpdateCCRule 中,未开启高级条件或高级条件列表为空时不要传该字段;开启高级条件时必须传 Logic 和至少 1 条有效 AccurateRules.
AccurateGroup.description_en:
Advanced conditions. This field is not required if not configured.
The current path URL and AccurateGroup have an AND relationship; the rule takes effect only when both are matched.
In CreateCCRule and UpdateCCRule, do not pass this field if advanced conditions are not enabled or the advanced condition list is empty. If advanced conditions are enabled, you must pass Logic and at least one valid AccurateRules.

AccurateGroup.AccurateGroupPriority.description_cn: 高级条件组优先级;CreateCCRule 和 UpdateCCRule 请求无需传入,仅 ListCCRule 返回和 AdjustCCRulePriority 调整高级条件组优先级时使用.
AccurateGroup.AccurateGroupPriority.description_en: Advanced condition group priority. Not required for CreateCCRule and UpdateCCRule requests; used only when returned by ListCCRule and when adjusting advanced condition group priority with AdjustCCRulePriority.

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.description_cn:
高级条件中的子规则列表;数组元素为 CreateWafAccurateRule.
CreateCCRule/UpdateCCRule 和 ListCCRulePriorityAvailable 中,只有开启高级条件且列表存在有效条件时才传 AccurateGroup;每条子规则必须同时包含 HttpObj/ObjType/Property/Opretar 和 ValueString,前端最多允许添加 50 条.
典型示例:[{HttpObj:request.uri, ObjType:1, Property:0, Opretar:6, ValueString:/demo/path}].
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.description_en:
Sub-rule list in advanced conditions; array elements are CreateWafAccurateRule.
In CreateCCRule, UpdateCCRule, and ListCCRulePriorityAvailable, AccurateGroup is only passed when advanced conditions are enabled and the list contains valid conditions. Each sub-rule must include HttpObj, ObjType, Property, Opretar, and ValueString. The frontend allows up to 50 sub-rules.
Typical example: [{HttpObj:request.uri, ObjType:1, Property:0, Opretar:6, ValueString:/demo/path}].

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.HttpObj.description_cn:
匹配对象.
固定对象由 ObjType 自动生成 HttpObj;只有自定义对象需要在 HttpObj 中补具体 Key.
所有使用前端高级条件组件的模块均支持的固定对象:
- request.schema: 请求协议
- request.uri: 请求 URI
- request.method: 请求方法
- request.path: 请求路径
- request.queryargs: 请求参数
- request.header: 请求头
- request.header.ua: 请求 User-Agent
- request.header.refer: 请求 Referer
- request.header.cookie: 请求 Cookie 头
- request.header.content-length: 请求体长度
- request.header.content-type: 请求体格式
- request.header.x-forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
- request.header.clientip: 客户端 IP
能力开关控制的固定对象:
- request.ja3-hash: JA3 Hash;BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持
- request.session-id: 会话 ID;仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC waf_available 全地域可用,BP waf_available 无可用地域
- request.fp: 浏览器指纹;仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC waf_available 全地域可用,BP waf_available 无可用地域
当前前端对外高级条件组件不展示的对象:
- response.header/response.body/response.code/response.header.content-type/response.header.{Key}/response.body.{Key}: 当前前端对外高级条件组件未展示,按前端口径视为不支持
- country/request.ja3: 当前所有前端对外模块不可用
所有使用前端高级条件组件的模块均支持的自定义对象格式:
- request.queryargs.{Key}: 自定义请求参数,Key 必填
- request.header.{Key}: 自定义请求头,Key 必填;前端要求 Header 单词首字母大写
- request.cookie.{Key}: 自定义 Cookie,Key 必填
注意:
- `ObjType=13/14/15` 时,不能直接传 `request.queryargs.`/`request.header.`/`request.cookie.`,必须携带具体 Key.
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.HttpObj.description_en:
Matching Objects
Fixed objects are automatically generated as HttpObj by ObjType; only custom objects require specifying a Key in HttpObj.
All modules using frontend advanced condition components support the following fixed objects:
- request.schema: Request protocol
- request.uri: Request URI
- request.method: Request method
- request.path: Request path
- request.queryargs: Request parameters
- request.header: Request header
- request.header.ua: Request User-Agent
- request.header.refer: Request Referer
- request.header.cookie: Request Cookie header
- request.header.content-length: Request body length
- request.header.content-type: Request body format
- request.header.x-forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
- request.header.clientip: Client IP
Fixed objects controlled by capability switches:
- request.ja3-hash: JA3 Hash; BP CDN regions are supported, others are not
- request.session-id: Session ID; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
- request.fp: Browser fingerprint; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
Objects not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components:
- response.header/response.body/response.code/response.header.content-type/response.header.{Key}/response.body.{Key}: Not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components, considered unsupported by frontend standards
- country/request.ja3: Not available in any frontend external modules
Custom object formats supported by all modules using frontend advanced condition components:
- request.queryargs.{Key}: Custom request parameter, Key is required
- request.header.{Key}: Custom request header, Key is required; frontend requires header words to start with a capital letter
- request.cookie.{Key}: Custom Cookie, Key is required
Note:
- When ObjType=13/14/15, you cannot directly pass request.queryargs./request.header./request.cookie.; a specific Key must be included

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ObjType.description_cn:
匹配对象类型枚举.
支持口径以前端对外高级条件组件为准:前端不支持则该枚举视为不支持;前端按条件启用的枚举,需根据 SKILL 检查对应能力和地域条件,开启后才视为支持.
通用支持:
- 0: request.schema,请求协议
- 1: request.uri,请求 URI
- 2: request.method,请求方法
- 3: request.path,请求路径
- 4: request.queryargs,请求参数
- 5: request.header,请求头
- 6: request.header.ua,请求 User-Agent
- 7: request.header.refer,请求 Referer
- 8: request.header.cookie,请求 Cookie 头
- 9: request.header.content-length,请求体长度
- 10: request.header.content-type,请求体格式
- 11: request.header.x-forwarded-for,X-Forwarded-For
- 12: request.header.clientip,客户端 IP
- 13: request.queryargs.{Key},自定义请求参数,HttpObj 必须包含具体 Key
- 14: request.header.{Key},自定义请求头,HttpObj 必须包含具体 Key
- 15: request.cookie.{Key},自定义 Cookie,HttpObj 必须包含具体 Key
按条件支持:
- 23: request.ja3-hash,JA3 Hash;BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持
- 25: request.session-id,会话 ID,仅 BOT 防护支持;SessionProtectionAvailable 当前 VOLC 全地域可用,BP 无可用地域
- 26: request.fp,浏览器指纹,仅 BOT 防护支持;SessionProtectionAvailable 当前 VOLC 全地域可用,BP 无可用地域
当前不支持,不出现在 Swagger enums 中:
- 16: country,国家或地区
- 17: response.header,响应头
- 18: response.body,响应体
- 19: response.code,响应状态码
- 20: response.header.content-type,响应头 Content-Type
- 21: response.header.{Key},自定义响应头
- 22: response.body.{Key},响应体字段
- 24: request.ja3,保留值
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ObjType.description_en:
Object type enumeration for matching.
Support criteria are based on the frontend's advanced condition component: if the frontend does not support it, this enumeration is considered unsupported; for enumerations enabled conditionally by the frontend, SKILL must check the corresponding capability and region conditions, and only after enabling is it considered supported.
General support:
- 0: request.schema, request protocol
- 1: request.uri, request URI
- 2: request.method, request method
- 3: request.path, request path
- 4: request.queryargs, request parameters
- 5: request.header, request header
- 6: request.header.ua, request User-Agent
- 7: request.header.refer, request Referer
- 8: request.header.cookie, request Cookie header
- 9: request.header.content-length, request body length
- 10: request.header.content-type, request body format
- 11: request.header.x-forwarded-for, X-Forwarded-For
- 12: request.header.clientip, client IP
- 13: request.queryargs.{Key}, custom request parameter, HttpObj must include a specific Key
- 14: request.header.{Key}, custom request header, HttpObj must include a specific Key
- 15: request.cookie.{Key}, custom Cookie, HttpObj must include a specific Key
Conditional support:
- 23: request.ja3-hash, JA3 Hash; BP CDN regions are supported, others are not
- 25: request.session-id, session ID, only supported for BOT protection; SessionProtectionAvailable is currently available in all VOLC regions, BP has no available regions
- 26: request.fp, browser fingerprint, only supported for BOT protection; SessionProtectionAvailable is currently available in all VOLC regions, BP has no available regions
Currently unsupported, not shown in Swagger enums:
- 16: country, country or region
- 17: response.header, response header
- 18: response.body, response body
- 19: response.code, response status code
- 20: response.header.content-type, response header Content-Type
- 21: response.header.{Key}, custom response header
- 22: response.body.{Key}, response body field
- 24: request.ja3, reserved value

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_cn:
匹配操作符枚举.
基础操作符:
- 0: 大于
- 1: 大于等于
- 2: 等于
- 3: 小于
- 4: 小于等于
- 5: 不等于
- 6: 包含子串
- 7: 不包含子串
- 8: 包含前缀
- 9: 不包含前缀
- 10: 包含后缀
- 11: 不包含后缀
- 12: 包含所有匹配集合
- 13: 不包含所有匹配集合
- 14: 属于匹配集合
- 15: 不属于匹配集合
- 16: 正则匹配
IP 识别类操作符,仅用于 request.header.clientip 和自定义对象;使用时 Property 固定为 5,ValueString 无需填写:
- 17: 判断为 IP
- 18: 判断为 IPv4
- 19: 判断为 IPv6
- 20: 判断为私网 IP
- 21: 判断为公网 IP
扩展操作符:
- 22: max,保留值;VOLC 和 BP valid_check 均不支持,所有前端对外模块均不可用
- 23: 包含地址组,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 24: 排除地址组,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 25: 包含地理位置,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 26: 排除地理位置,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 27: 包含 IP 情报,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单在 TIIPTagAvailable=true 时可用;最新 BP waf_available 仅 byteplus-global 可用,VOLC waf_available 无可用地域
- 28: AS 号码属于,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单/批量控制白名单在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC 和 BP waf_available 均全地域可用
- 29: AS 号码不属于,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单/批量控制白名单在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC 和 BP waf_available 均全地域可用
按 ObjType 过滤可选操作符:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: 可用 2~16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: 可用 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: 可用 0~5
- request.header.clientip: 可用 2/5/14/15/16/17~21/23~26;27 仅在 TIIPTagAvailable=true 且地域可用时可传;28/29 仅在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 且地域可用时可传
- request.queryargs.{Key}/request.header.{Key}/request.cookie.{Key}: 可用 0~21
- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持;可用 2/5/14/15;14/15 最多填写 10 个值且不能重复
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_en:
Matching operator enumeration
Basic operators:
- 0: Greater than
- 1: Greater than or equal to
- 2: Equal to
- 3: Less than
- 4: Less than or equal to
- 5: Not equal to
- 6: Contains substring
- 7: Does not contain substring
- 8: Contains prefix
- 9: Does not contain prefix
- 10: Contains suffix
- 11: Does not contain suffix
- 12: Contains all in match set
- 13: Does not contain all in match set
- 14: Belongs to match set
- 15: Does not belong to match set
- 16: Regex match
IP recognition operators, only for request.header.clientip and custom objects; when used, Property is fixed at 5, ValueString does not need to be specified:
- 17: Is IP
- 18: Is IPv4
- 19: Is IPv6
- 20: Is private IP
- 21: Is public IP
Extended operators:
- 22: max, reserved value; not supported by VOLC and BP valid_check, not available for any external frontend modules
- 23: Contains address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 24: Excludes address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 25: Contains geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 26: Excludes geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 27: Contains IP intelligence, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control when TIIPTagAvailable=true; latest BP waf_available is only available for byteplus-global, VOLC waf_available has no available regions
- 28: AS number belongs to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
- 29: AS number does not belong to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
Available operators by ObjType:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: available operators: 2–16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: available operators: 0–5
- request.header.clientip: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16/17–21/23–26; 27 can only be used when TIIPTagAvailable=true and the region is available; 28/29 can only be used when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true and the region is available
- request.queryargs.{Key}/request.header.{Key}/request.cookie.{Key}: available operators: 0–21
- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN regions are supported, others are not; available operators: 2/5/14/15; for 14/15, up to 10 values can be entered and must be unique

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Property.description_cn:
匹配属性类型枚举.
前端默认填充 Property=0;当操作符为 17~21 的 IP 识别类操作时,前端自动改为 Property=5 并清空 ValueString.
- 0: Value,按字段值匹配;除 IP 识别类操作外,前端均使用该值
- 1: StrLen,字符串长度,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 2: Size,大小,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 3: Keys,Key 集合,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 4: Version,版本,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 5: IP,仅用于 Opretar=17~21 的 IP 识别类操作
- 6: Country,国家或地区,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Property.description_en:
Match Property Type Enumeration
The frontend defaults to Property=0. When the operator is an IP identification operation (17–21), the frontend automatically sets Property=5 and clears ValueString.
- 0: Value, matches by field value; the frontend uses this value except for IP identification operations
- 1: StrLen, string length, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 2: Size, size, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 3: Keys, key set, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 4: Version, version, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 5: IP, only used for IP identification operations with Operator=17–21
- 6: Country, country or region, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_cn:
匹配值.
前端校验规则:
- Opretar=17~21 时不涉及匹配内容,前端会清空 ValueString,可传空字符串
- Opretar=23/24 时填写 IP 地址组 ID,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=25/26 时填写地域编码,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=27 时填写 IP 情报标签,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=28/29 时填写 ASN,多个值以英文逗号分隔;前端会校验 ASN 范围且不允许重复
- ObjType=request.ja3-hash 且 Opretar=14/15 时,多个 JA3 Hash 以英文逗号分隔,最多 10 个且不允许重复
- 其他操作符均需按实际匹配值填写
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_en:
Matching value.
Frontend validation rules:
- When Opretar=17~21, matching content is not involved; the frontend will clear ValueString and can pass an empty string
- When Opretar=23/24, enter IP address group ID; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=25/26, enter region codes; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=27, enter IP intelligence tags; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=28/29, enter ASN; multiple values are separated by commas; the frontend will validate ASN range and duplicates are not allowed
- When ObjType=request.ja3-hash and Opretar=14/15, enter multiple JA3 Hash values separated by commas, up to 10 values and duplicates are not allowed
- All other operators require actual matching values

AccurateGroup.Id.description_cn: 高级条件组 ID;CreateCCRule 和 UpdateCCRule 请求无需传入,仅 ListCCRule 返回时用于分组展示和快速添加同组规则.
AccurateGroup.Id.description_en: Advanced condition group ID. Not required for CreateCCRule and UpdateCCRule requests; only returned by ListCCRule for grouping display and quick addition of rules in the same group.

AccurateGroup.Logic.description_cn:
逻辑关系:
- 1: 与(AND)
- 2: 或(OR)

AccurateGroupPriority.description_cn: 高级条件优先级;创建/更新时无需传入,仅列表展示和调整优先级时使用.
AccurateGroupPriority.description_en: Advanced condition priority. Not required for create/update; used only for list display and priority adjustment.

CCType.description_cn:
执行动作:
- 0: 观察(observe)
- 1: 限速(rate-limit)
- 2: 拦截(block)
- 6: JS 挑战(js challenge)
- 7: 人机验证(captcha)
CCType.description_en:
Action:
- 0: Observe
- 1: Rate-limit
- 2: Block
- 6: JS challenge
- 7: Captcha

CountTime.description_cn:
统计时间窗口,单位秒.
对外文档口径的取值范围为 5~1800.
CountTime.description_en: Statistics time window, in seconds. The range in external documentation is 5~1800.

CronConfs.description_cn:
定时生效配置列表;数组元素为 CronConf,按 crontab 指定阈值切换.
仅当 CronEnable=1 时需要传入.
CronConfs.description_en:
Scheduled activation configuration list. Array elements are CronConf, thresholds switch according to crontab.
Required only when CronEnable=1.

CronConfs.Crontab.description_cn:
crontab 表达式;需满足 confcenter 的 crontab 校验规则.
推荐格式:* <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>,例如 * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.
当前实现要求同一规则内的周配置保持一致,且小时区间不能重叠.
CronConfs.Crontab.description_en:
crontab expression; must comply with the crontab validation rules of confcenter.
Recommended format: * <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>, for example: * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.
The current implementation requires that the week configuration within the same rule remains consistent, and hour ranges must not overlap.

CronConfs.PathThreshold.description_cn: 命中该时段时的路径总阈值;对外文档口径的取值范围为 1~300000.
CronConfs.PathThreshold.description_en: Total path threshold for this time period; the range in external documentation is 1-300000.

CronConfs.SingleThreshold.description_cn: 命中该时段时的单对象阈值;对外文档口径的取值范围为 1~300000.
CronConfs.SingleThreshold.description_en: Single object threshold for this time period; the range in external documentation is 1-300000.

CronEnable.description_cn:
定时生效开关,默认 0,表示规则始终生效:
- 0: 关闭
- 1: 开启
开启后必须同时配置 CronConfs.
CronEnable.description_en: Scheduled activation switch, default is 0, meaning the rule is always active: - 0: Off - 1: On. When enabled, CronConfs must also be configured.

CustomResponsePageID.description_cn:
自定义响应页面 ID;为空字符串表示未配置.
当前公开文档未展开该扩展字段,使用前需确保用户已开通并有权使用对应自定义响应页面.
CustomResponsePageID.description_en: Custom response page ID; an empty string means not configured. This extended field is not detailed in the current public documentation. Before use, ensure the user has enabled and is authorized to use the corresponding custom response page.

EffectTime.description_cn:
动作生效时长,单位秒,取值范围 1~86400.
当执行动作为限速/拦截/人机验证或 JS 挑战时,建议显式传入.
EffectTime.description_en: Action duration, in seconds, range: 1~86400. When the action is rate limiting, blocking, CAPTCHA, or JS challenge, it is recommended to specify explicitly.

Enable.description_cn:
规则开关:
- 0: 关闭
- 1: 开启

ExemptionTime.description_cn:
人机验证或 JS 挑战的豁免时间,单位秒,取值范围 1~3600.
用户在豁免时间内通过验证后可正常访问;豁免时间结束后若仍处于限制时长内,将再次触发验证.
ExemptionTime.description_en: Exemption time for CAPTCHA or JS challenge, in seconds, range: 1~3600. Users can access normally after passing verification within the exemption period. If the exemption period ends but the restriction duration continues, verification will be triggered again.

Field.description_cn:
统计对象,支持单个或多个字段,多个字段使用英文逗号分隔,最多 10 个.
对外文档中的基础格式为 DataType:Value,例如 HEADER:Authorization/COOKIE:PHPSESSID/ARGS:device_id/CLIENTIP.
当前代码还支持 JA3HASH/SESSION-ID/FP 等扩展统计对象.
可选值:
- CLIENTIP: 源 IP
- HEADER:{Header-Name}: 指定请求头,Header-Name 需满足 HTTP 头 Key 规范
- ARGS:{ArgName}: 指定请求参数
- COOKIE:{CookieName}: 指定 Cookie
- JA3HASH: JA3 Hash
- SESSION-ID: 会话 ID (仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用)
- FP: 客户端指纹 (仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用)
Field.description_en: Statistics object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas, up to 10 fields. The basic format in external documentation is DataType:Value. For example: HEADER:Authorization/COOKIE:PHPSESSID/ARGS:device_id/CLIENTIP. The current code also supports extended statistics objects such as JA3HASH, SESSION-ID, and FP. Optional values: - CLIENTIP: Source IP - HEADER:{Header-Name}: Specific request header. Header-Name must comply with HTTP header key specifications - ARGS:{ArgName}: Specific request parameter - COOKIE:{CookieName}: Specific cookie - JA3HASH: JA3 Hash - SESSION-ID: Session ID (available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true) - FP: Client fingerprint (available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true)

Host.description_cn:
域名.
需要保护的网站域名;调用前请确保该域名已添加到当前 WAF 实例.
Host.description_en:
Domain name.
Website domain to be protected. Before calling, ensure the domain has been added to the current WAF instance.

Name.description_cn:
规则名称.
需以中文/字母或数字开头,允许中文/字母/数字/英文句点(.)/下划线(_)和中划线(-),长度 1~128 个字符.
Name.description_en: Rule name. Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Allows Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Length: 1~128 characters.

PathThreshold.description_cn:
当前路径下的总体阈值.
对外文档口径的取值范围为 1~300000,单位为次.
PathThreshold.description_en:
Overall threshold for the current path.
The value range in external documentation is 1–300000, unit: times.

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名称，即为当前资源关联对应项目，仅可关联当前身份下具有权限的项目。项目名称获取方式参考ListProjectResources - 获取项目资源列表，您也可以调用CreateProject - 创建项目创建新的项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name refers to the project associated with the current resource. You can only link projects under your current identity that you have permission to access. To get a project name, use ListProjectResources to get the project resource list, or call CreateProject to create a new project.

RulePriority.description_cn: 规则优先级:取值范围 0~9;0 为最高优先级,9 为最低优先级.
RulePriority.description_en: Rule priority: value range 0–9; 0 is the highest priority, 9 is the lowest priority.

RuleTag.description_cn:
规则展示 ID;创建/更新时不携带,仅用于列表展示.
CC 规则的 RuleTag 前缀固定为 E,例如 E000000003624.
RuleTag.description_en:
Rule display ID. Not included in create/update, used only for list display.
The RuleTag prefix for CC rules is always E, for example, E000000003624.

SingleThreshold.description_cn:
单个统计对象的阈值.
对外文档口径的取值范围为 1~300000,单位为次.
SingleThreshold.description_en: Threshold for a single statistics object. The range in external documentation is 1~300000, unit: times.

Url.description_cn:
请求路径.
可填写具体页面路径,也可匹配整站或某个目录下的全部路径;通配符 * 只能出现在路径末尾.
例如:/test.html//*//test/*.
Url.description_en:
Request path.
You can specify a specific page path, match the entire site, or all paths under a directory. The wildcard * can only appear at the end of the path.
For example: /test.html, /*, /test/*.

WSCdnByteThreshold.description_cn:
WebSocket 字节数阈值.
取值范围 1~10000000;为 0 表示未配置.
WSCdnByteThreshold.description_en: WebSocket byte threshold. Range: 1~10000000; 0 means not configured.

WSCdnEnable.description_cn:
WebSocket 统计防护开关:
- 0: 关闭
- 1: 开启
开启后至少需要配置 WSCdnFrameThreshold 或 WSCdnByteThreshold 其中之一,且不支持再叠加 Cron 定时配置.
WSCdnEnable.description_en: WebSocket statistics protection switch: - 0: Off - 1: On. When enabled, you must configure at least one of WSCdnFrameThreshold or WSCdnByteThreshold. Cron scheduling is not supported when enabled.

WSCdnFrameThreshold.description_cn:
WebSocket 帧数阈值.
取值范围 1~10000;为 0 表示未配置.
WSCdnFrameThreshold.description_en: WebSocket frame threshold. Range: 1~10000; 0 means not configured.

WSCdnUnit.description_cn:
WebSocket 字节数阈值单位:
- KB: KiB
- MB: MiB
- GB: GiB
WSCdnUnit.description_en: WebSocket byte threshold units: - KB: KiB - MB: MiB - GB: GiB

Accurate.AccurateRules.description_cn: 高级条件中的子规则列表; 要求必填且数组长度大于等于1，小于等于10
Accurate.AccurateRules.description_en: Subrule list in advanced conditions; required, array length must be greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 10

Accurate.AccurateRules.HttpObj.description_cn:
匹配对象.
固定对象由 ObjType 自动生成 HttpObj;只有自定义对象需要在 HttpObj 中补具体 Key.
所有使用前端高级条件组件的模块均支持的固定对象:
- request.schema: 请求协议
- request.uri: 请求 URI
- request.method: 请求方法
- request.path: 请求路径
- request.queryargs: 请求参数
- request.header: 请求头
- request.header.ua: 请求 User-Agent
- request.header.refer: 请求 Referer
- request.header.cookie: 请求 Cookie 头
- request.header.content-length: 请求体长度
- request.header.content-type: 请求体格式
- request.header.x-forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
- request.header.clientip: 客户端 IP
能力开关控制的固定对象:
- request.ja3-hash: JA3 Hash;BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持
- request.session-id: 会话 ID;仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC waf_available 全地域可用,BP waf_available 无可用地域
- request.fp: 浏览器指纹;仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC waf_available 全地域可用,BP waf_available 无可用地域
当前前端对外高级条件组件不展示的对象:
- response.header/response.body/response.code/response.header.content-type/response.header.{Key}/response.body.{Key}: 当前前端对外高级条件组件未展示,按前端口径视为不支持
- country/request.ja3: 当前所有前端对外模块不可用
所有使用前端高级条件组件的模块均支持的自定义对象格式:
- request.queryargs.{Key}: 自定义请求参数,Key 必填
- request.header.{Key}: 自定义请求头,Key 必填;前端要求 Header 单词首字母大写
- request.cookie.{Key}: 自定义 Cookie,Key 必填
注意:
- `ObjType=13/14/15` 时,不能直接传 `request.queryargs.`/`request.header.`/`request.cookie.`,必须携带具体 Key.
Accurate.AccurateRules.HttpObj.description_en:
Matching Objects
Fixed objects are automatically generated as HttpObj by ObjType; only custom objects require specifying a Key in HttpObj.
All modules using frontend advanced condition components support the following fixed objects:
- request.schema: Request protocol
- request.uri: Request URI
- request.method: Request method
- request.path: Request path
- request.queryargs: Request parameters
- request.header: Request header
- request.header.ua: Request User-Agent
- request.header.refer: Request Referer
- request.header.cookie: Request Cookie header
- request.header.content-length: Request body length
- request.header.content-type: Request body format
- request.header.x-forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
- request.header.clientip: Client IP
Fixed objects controlled by capability switches:
- request.ja3-hash: JA3 Hash; BP CDN regions are supported, others are not
- request.session-id: Session ID; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
- request.fp: Browser fingerprint; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
Objects not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components:
- response.header/response.body/response.code/response.header.content-type/response.header.{Key}/response.body.{Key}: Not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components, considered unsupported by frontend standards
- country/request.ja3: Not available in any frontend external modules
Custom object formats supported by all modules using frontend advanced condition components:
- request.queryargs.{Key}: Custom request parameter, Key is required
- request.header.{Key}: Custom request header, Key is required; frontend requires header words to start with a capital letter
- request.cookie.{Key}: Custom Cookie, Key is required
Note:
- When ObjType=13/14/15, you cannot directly pass request.queryargs./request.header./request.cookie.; a specific Key must be included

Accurate.AccurateRules.ObjType.description_cn:
匹配对象类型枚举.
支持口径以前端对外高级条件组件为准:前端不支持则该枚举视为不支持;前端按条件启用的枚举,需根据 SKILL 检查对应能力和地域条件,开启后才视为支持.
通用支持:
- 0: request.schema,请求协议
- 1: request.uri,请求 URI
- 2: request.method,请求方法
- 3: request.path,请求路径
- 4: request.queryargs,请求参数
- 5: request.header,请求头
- 6: request.header.ua,请求 User-Agent
- 7: request.header.refer,请求 Referer
- 8: request.header.cookie,请求 Cookie 头
- 9: request.header.content-length,请求体长度
- 10: request.header.content-type,请求体格式
- 11: request.header.x-forwarded-for,X-Forwarded-For
- 12: request.header.clientip,客户端 IP
- 13: request.queryargs.{Key},自定义请求参数,HttpObj 必须包含具体 Key
- 14: request.header.{Key},自定义请求头,HttpObj 必须包含具体 Key
- 15: request.cookie.{Key},自定义 Cookie,HttpObj 必须包含具体 Key
按条件支持:
- 23: request.ja3-hash,JA3 Hash;BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持
- 25: request.session-id,会话 ID,仅 BOT 防护支持;SessionProtectionAvailable 当前 VOLC 全地域可用,BP 无可用地域
- 26: request.fp,浏览器指纹,仅 BOT 防护支持;SessionProtectionAvailable 当前 VOLC 全地域可用,BP 无可用地域
当前不支持,不出现在 Swagger enums 中:
- 16: country,国家或地区
- 17: response.header,响应头
- 18: response.body,响应体
- 19: response.code,响应状态码
- 20: response.header.content-type,响应头 Content-Type
- 21: response.header.{Key},自定义响应头
- 22: response.body.{Key},响应体字段
- 24: request.ja3,保留值
Accurate.AccurateRules.ObjType.description_en:
Object type enumeration for matching.
Support criteria are based on the frontend's advanced condition component: if the frontend does not support it, this enumeration is considered unsupported; for enumerations enabled conditionally by the frontend, SKILL must check the corresponding capability and region conditions, and only after enabling is it considered supported.
General support:
- 0: request.schema, request protocol
- 1: request.uri, request URI
- 2: request.method, request method
- 3: request.path, request path
- 4: request.queryargs, request parameters
- 5: request.header, request header
- 6: request.header.ua, request User-Agent
- 7: request.header.refer, request Referer
- 8: request.header.cookie, request Cookie header
- 9: request.header.content-length, request body length
- 10: request.header.content-type, request body format
- 11: request.header.x-forwarded-for, X-Forwarded-For
- 12: request.header.clientip, client IP
- 13: request.queryargs.{Key}, custom request parameter, HttpObj must include a specific Key
- 14: request.header.{Key}, custom request header, HttpObj must include a specific Key
- 15: request.cookie.{Key}, custom Cookie, HttpObj must include a specific Key
Conditional support:
- 23: request.ja3-hash, JA3 Hash; BP CDN regions are supported, others are not
- 25: request.session-id, session ID, only supported for BOT protection; SessionProtectionAvailable is currently available in all VOLC regions, BP has no available regions
- 26: request.fp, browser fingerprint, only supported for BOT protection; SessionProtectionAvailable is currently available in all VOLC regions, BP has no available regions
Currently unsupported, not shown in Swagger enums:
- 16: country, country or region
- 17: response.header, response header
- 18: response.body, response body
- 19: response.code, response status code
- 20: response.header.content-type, response header Content-Type
- 21: response.header.{Key}, custom response header
- 22: response.body.{Key}, response body field
- 24: request.ja3, reserved value

Accurate.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_cn:
匹配操作符枚举.
基础操作符:
- 0: 大于
- 1: 大于等于
- 2: 等于
- 3: 小于
- 4: 小于等于
- 5: 不等于
- 6: 包含子串
- 7: 不包含子串
- 8: 包含前缀
- 9: 不包含前缀
- 10: 包含后缀
- 11: 不包含后缀
- 12: 包含所有匹配集合
- 13: 不包含所有匹配集合
- 14: 属于匹配集合
- 15: 不属于匹配集合
- 16: 正则匹配
IP 识别类操作符,仅用于 request.header.clientip 和自定义对象;使用时 Property 固定为 5,ValueString 无需填写:
- 17: 判断为 IP
- 18: 判断为 IPv4
- 19: 判断为 IPv6
- 20: 判断为私网 IP
- 21: 判断为公网 IP
扩展操作符:
- 22: max,保留值;VOLC 和 BP valid_check 均不支持,所有前端对外模块均不可用
- 23: 包含地址组,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 24: 排除地址组,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 25: 包含地理位置,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 26: 排除地理位置,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 27: 包含 IP 情报,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单在 TIIPTagAvailable=true 时可用;最新 BP waf_available 仅 byteplus-global 可用,VOLC waf_available 无可用地域
- 28: AS 号码属于,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单/批量控制白名单在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC 和 BP waf_available 均全地域可用
- 29: AS 号码不属于,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单/批量控制白名单在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC 和 BP waf_available 均全地域可用
按 ObjType 过滤可选操作符:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: 可用 2~16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: 可用 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: 可用 0~5
- request.header.clientip: 可用 2/5/14/15/16/17~21/23~26;27 仅在 TIIPTagAvailable=true 且地域可用时可传;28/29 仅在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 且地域可用时可传
- request.queryargs.{Key}/request.header.{Key}/request.cookie.{Key}: 可用 0~21
- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持;可用 2/5/14/15;14/15 最多填写 10 个值且不能重复
Accurate.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_en:
Matching operator enumeration
Basic operators:
- 0: Greater than
- 1: Greater than or equal to
- 2: Equal to
- 3: Less than
- 4: Less than or equal to
- 5: Not equal to
- 6: Contains substring
- 7: Does not contain substring
- 8: Contains prefix
- 9: Does not contain prefix
- 10: Contains suffix
- 11: Does not contain suffix
- 12: Contains all in match set
- 13: Does not contain all in match set
- 14: Belongs to match set
- 15: Does not belong to match set
- 16: Regex match
IP recognition operators, only for request.header.clientip and custom objects; when used, Property is fixed at 5, ValueString does not need to be specified:
- 17: Is IP
- 18: Is IPv4
- 19: Is IPv6
- 20: Is private IP
- 21: Is public IP
Extended operators:
- 22: max, reserved value; not supported by VOLC and BP valid_check, not available for any external frontend modules
- 23: Contains address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 24: Excludes address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 25: Contains geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 26: Excludes geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 27: Contains IP intelligence, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control when TIIPTagAvailable=true; latest BP waf_available is only available for byteplus-global, VOLC waf_available has no available regions
- 28: AS number belongs to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
- 29: AS number does not belong to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
Available operators by ObjType:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: available operators: 2–16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: available operators: 0–5
- request.header.clientip: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16/17–21/23–26; 27 can only be used when TIIPTagAvailable=true and the region is available; 28/29 can only be used when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true and the region is available
- request.queryargs.{Key}/request.header.{Key}/request.cookie.{Key}: available operators: 0–21
- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN regions are supported, others are not; available operators: 2/5/14/15; for 14/15, up to 10 values can be entered and must be unique

Accurate.AccurateRules.Property.description_cn:
匹配属性类型枚举.
前端默认填充 Property=0;当操作符为 17~21 的 IP 识别类操作时,前端自动改为 Property=5 并清空 ValueString.
- 0: Value,按字段值匹配;除 IP 识别类操作外,前端均使用该值
- 1: StrLen,字符串长度,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 2: Size,大小,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 3: Keys,Key 集合,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 4: Version,版本,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
- 5: IP,仅用于 Opretar=17~21 的 IP 识别类操作
- 6: Country,国家或地区,历史保留,当前前端通用组件未使用
Accurate.AccurateRules.Property.description_en:
Match Property Type Enumeration
The frontend defaults to Property=0. When the operator is an IP identification operation (17–21), the frontend automatically sets Property=5 and clears ValueString.
- 0: Value, matches by field value; the frontend uses this value except for IP identification operations
- 1: StrLen, string length, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 2: Size, size, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 3: Keys, key set, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 4: Version, version, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components
- 5: IP, only used for IP identification operations with Operator=17–21
- 6: Country, country or region, reserved for legacy use, not used by current frontend components

Accurate.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_cn:
匹配值.
前端校验规则:
- Opretar=17~21 时不涉及匹配内容,前端会清空 ValueString,可传空字符串
- Opretar=23/24 时填写 IP 地址组 ID,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=25/26 时填写地域编码,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=27 时填写 IP 情报标签,多个值以英文逗号分隔
- Opretar=28/29 时填写 ASN,多个值以英文逗号分隔;前端会校验 ASN 范围且不允许重复
- ObjType=request.ja3-hash 且 Opretar=14/15 时,多个 JA3 Hash 以英文逗号分隔,最多 10 个且不允许重复
- 其他操作符均需按实际匹配值填写
Accurate.AccurateRules.ValueString.description_en:
Matching value.
Frontend validation rules:
- When Opretar=17~21, matching content is not involved; the frontend will clear ValueString and can pass an empty string
- When Opretar=23/24, enter IP address group ID; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=25/26, enter region codes; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=27, enter IP intelligence tags; multiple values are separated by commas
- When Opretar=28/29, enter ASN; multiple values are separated by commas; the frontend will validate ASN range and duplicates are not allowed
- When ObjType=request.ja3-hash and Opretar=14/15, enter multiple JA3 Hash values separated by commas, up to 10 values and duplicates are not allowed
- All other operators require actual matching values

BackendGroups.description_en: Origin configuration details. Only required for **CNAME access**.

BackendGroups.AccessPort.description_cn:
接入端口号，用于标识源站组对应的生效接入端口，与`ProtocolPorts`的端口号信息一致。
仅自定义源站组需要配置，默认分组将统一对所有未关联到自定义源站组的接入端口号生效。
例如接入端口号信息为`HTTP：80，81`和`HTTPS：443`，自定义分组中添加了`80`，则默认分组对接入的`81`和`443`端口生效。
BackendGroups.AccessPort.description_en:
Access port number, used to identify the effective access port for the corresponding origin site group. This matches the port information in `ProtocolPorts`.
Only custom origin site groups require configuration; the default group will apply to all access port numbers not associated with a custom origin site group.
For example, if the access port information is `HTTP: 80, 81` and `HTTPS: 443`, and `80` is added to a custom group, then the default group will apply to access ports `81` and `443`.

BackendGroups.Backends.description_cn: 每个源站的配置详情，包括源站协议、源站地址、源站端口以及权重信息。
BackendGroups.Backends.description_en: Configuration details for each origin site, including protocol, address, port, and weight information.

BackendGroups.Backends.IP.description_cn: 源站的 IP 地址，用于指定 WAF 实例回源时访问的后端服务器地址。
BackendGroups.Backends.IP.description_en: Origin server IP address, used to specify the backend server address accessed by the WAF instance when forwarding requests.

BackendGroups.Backends.Port.description_cn: 源站的端口号，用于指定 WAF 实例回源时访问后端服务器的端口。
BackendGroups.Backends.Port.description_en: Origin server port number, used to specify the port accessed by the WAF instance when forwarding requests to the backend server.

BackendGroups.Backends.Protocol.description_cn:
源站的请求协议，用于指定 WAF 实例回源时访问后端服务器所使用的协议类型。支持的取值如下所示：

* `HTTP`：HTTP 协议；
* `HTTPS`：HTTPS 协议。

同一个域名下所有源站组内的源站协议全局保持一致。
BackendGroups.Backends.Protocol.description_en:
Origin server request protocol, used to specify the protocol type used by the WAF instance when accessing the backend server. Supported values are:

* `HTTP`: HTTP protocol
* `HTTPS`: HTTPS protocol

All origin servers within the same origin server group under a domain must use the same protocol globally.

BackendGroups.Backends.Weight.description_cn:
* 源站规则的权重，用于指定在负载均衡算法为加权轮询（`wrr`）或加权最小连接数（`wlc`）时，各源站的请求分配比例。
* 取值范围为 `1-100`，默认为 `100`。权重越高，分配的请求越多。
* 当负载均衡算法为源站地址哈希（`sh`）时无需填写。
BackendGroups.Backends.Weight.description_en:
* Origin server rule weight, used to specify the request distribution ratio for each origin server when the load balancing algorithm is weighted round robin (`wrr`) or weighted least connections (`wlc`).
* Value range is `1-100`, default is `100`. The higher the weight, the more requests are distributed.
* Not required when the load balancing algorithm is source address hash (`sh`).

BackendGroups.Name.description_cn:
源站组名称。预置默认分组（名称为`default`），您可以直接在默认分组中添加源站信息，也可以新建源站组。

* 长度1～15个字符。
* 仅支持中文、英文、数字、下划线，不支持特殊字符。
BackendGroups.Name.description_en:
Origin site group name. A default group (named `default`) is preset; you can add origin site information directly to the default group or create a new origin site group.

* Length: 1–15 characters
* Only Chinese, English, numbers, and underscores are supported; special characters are not allowed

CertificateID.description_en: [Not currently displayed] Certificate ID. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**. You can obtain the certificate ID via [ListWafServiceCertificate - View certificate details](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6511/1167982).

CertificatePlatform.description_en: Certificate management platform. WAF certificates are centrally managed in the Volcano Engine Certificate Center. Default value is `certificate_service`. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**.

ClientIPLocation.description_cn: 客户端ip获取，0: 自定义header字段  1: 通过X-Forwarded-For（XFF） 字段中第一个公网IP地址作为客户端真实 IP 地址
ClientIPLocation.description_en:
Client IP acquisition method, used to specify how the WAF instance obtains the real IP address of the client. You need to configure this when your service uses a proxy (`ProxyConfig=1`).

* `0`: Obtain via custom header field; you need to specify the `CustomHeader`.
* `1`: Obtain via the first public IP address in the `X-Forwarded-For` (XFF) field.

ClientMaxBodySize.description_en: Maximum client request body size. Used to limit the size of data uploaded by clients. Required only when using **CNAME access**. Supports `1-10240` MB, default is `60` MB.

CloudAccessConfig.description_en: Load balancing access parameter configuration. Required only for **application load balancing (ALB) access or load balancing (CLB) Layer 7 access**. Used to specify parameters for WAF instance access via load balancing. Supports configuring multiple load balancing instances.

CloudAccessConfig.DefenceMode.description_cn:
实例的防护模式。
1：启用防护，已配置的防护策略生效, 2：暂停防护，仅执行转发而不检测，已配置的防护策略不生效, 3：回源模式，直接将请求解析至源站，不再转发至 WAF 实例。 防护域名关联多个负载均衡实例的场景下，还存在以下状态： 5：默认防护模式为启用防护，但存在例外实例为暂停防护或回源模式状态。 6：默认防护模式为暂停防护，但存在例外实例为启用防护或回源模式状态。 7：默认防护模式为回源模式，但存在例外实例为启用防护或暂停防护状态。
CloudAccessConfig.DefenceMode.description_en:
Instance protection mode
1: Enable protection. Configured protection policies take effect.
2: Pause protection. Only forwarding is performed; inspection is disabled and configured protection policies do not take effect.
3: Origin mode. Requests are sent directly to the origin server and are not forwarded to the WAF instance.

If a protected domain is associated with multiple load balancer instances, the following statuses may also apply:
5: Default protection mode is enabled, but there are exceptions where some instances are in pause protection or origin mode.
6: Default protection mode is paused, but there are exceptions where some instances are in enable protection or origin mode.
7: Default protection mode is origin mode, but there are exceptions where some instances are in enable protection or pause protection mode.

CloudAccessConfig.InstanceID.description_cn:
负载均衡实例 ID。

* 负载均衡（CLB）7 层方式接入：请参考[DescribeLoadBalancers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71772)获取实例 ID。
* 应用型负载均衡方式接入：请参考[DescribeLoadBalancers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/113594)获取实例 ID。
CloudAccessConfig.InstanceID.description_en:
Load balancer instance ID

* For Load Balancer (CLB) Layer 7 access: See [DescribeLoadBalancers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71772) to obtain the instance ID.
* For Application Load Balancer access: See [DescribeLoadBalancers](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/113594) to obtain the instance ID.

CloudAccessConfig.ListenerID.description_cn: 负载均衡监听器 ID，仅**负载均衡（CLB）7 层方式**接入时需要配置。获取方式，请参考[DescribeListeners](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71776)。
CloudAccessConfig.ListenerID.description_en: Load balancer listener ID. Required only when using **Load Balancer (CLB) Layer 7** access. For details, see [DescribeListeners](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71776).

CloudAccessConfig.Port.description_cn: 负载均衡监听器监听的端口号，仅**负载均衡（CLB）7 层方式**接入时需要配置。获取方式，请参考[DescribeListeners](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71776)。
CloudAccessConfig.Port.description_en: Port number listened to by the load balancer. Required only when using **Load Balancer (CLB) Layer 7** access. For details, see [DescribeListeners](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71776).

CloudAccessConfig.Protocol.description_cn: 负载均衡监听器协议类型，仅**负载均衡（CLB）7 层方式**接入时需要配置。获取方式，请参考[DescribeListeners](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71776)。
CloudAccessConfig.Protocol.description_en: Load balancer listener protocol type. Required only when using **Load Balancer (CLB) Layer 7** access. For details, see [DescribeListeners](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71776).

CustomHeader.description_en:
Custom header field list, used to specify custom HTTP header information added by the WAF instance when forwarding requests.

* Required when the client IP acquisition method is custom header field, i.e., `ClientIPLocation=0`.
* Supports up to 5 custom headers.

CustomSNI.description_en:
Custom SNI. Only required for **CNAME access** and when SNI is enabled (`EnableSNI=1`).

* If your origin IP is bound to multiple domain names and WAF accesses your origin via HTTPS, you need to configure origin SNI (Server Name Indication) to specify the exact domain name for the request. The origin returns the corresponding SSL certificate based on the configured SNI name to ensure proper origin access.
* If no domain name is configured, origin access is based on the actual host in the traffic.

Domain.description_cn: 域名
Domain.description_en: Domain information to be protected. Supports wildcard and exact domains.

EnableCustomRedirect.description_cn: 是否开启用户自定义重定向
EnableCustomRedirect.description_en:
Enable forced redirection for non-standard ports. Required only for **CNAME access** and when the **protocol type includes HTTPS**. Default is 0 (disabled).

* 0: Disable forced redirection
* 1: Enable forced redirection

When enabled, if users access via a non-standard HTTPS port, WAF automatically redirects requests to the standard HTTPS port (443).

EnableHTTP2.description_cn: 是否开启http2.0,仅适用于高防型和saas型, 0: 关闭 1: 开启
EnableHTTP2.description_en:
Enable HTTP 2.0. Only required for **CNAME access**. Default is 0 (disabled).

* 0: Disabled
* 1: Enabled

EnableIPv6.description_cn: 是否支持ipv6,0: 关闭 1: 开启
EnableIPv6.description_en:
Enable IPv6 support. Required only when using **CNAME access**. Default is 0 (disabled).

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

EnableSNI.description_cn: 是否开启SNI配置,0: 关闭 1: 开启
EnableSNI.description_en:
Enable SNI (Server Name Indication) configuration to specify the requested domain name during HTTPS origin pull. Only required for **CNAME access**. Default is `0` (disabled).

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

When enabled, you must specify the origin domain in the `CustomSNI` field.

KeepAliveRequest.description_en: Number of persistent connection reuses. Specifies how many requests the WAF instance can reuse over persistent connections when pulling from the origin. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports `60-1000`, default is `100`.

KeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Keep-alive duration. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 0-900 seconds; default is 75 seconds.

LBAlgorithm.description_en:
Load balancing algorithm. Specifies the load balancing strategy used by the WAF instance when pulling from the origin. Only required for **CNAME access**.

* wrr: Weighted round robin
* wlc: Weighted least connections
* sh: Source address hash

ProjectName.description_en: Project resource name. For details, refer to [ListDomain - Query cloud WAF instance protected website information](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6511/1214827).

ProtocolFollow.description_cn: cname接入生效,是否开启协议跟随
ProtocolFollow.description_en:
Enable protocol follow. When enabled, WAF automatically matches the origin protocol based on the client's request protocol (HTTP/HTTPS). Only required for **CNAME access**. Default is `0` (disabled).

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

* When enabling protocol follow, select both `HTTP` and `HTTPS` in the `Protocols` field.
* This feature is suitable for scenarios where client-WAF-origin protocol consistency is required.

ProtocolPorts.description_en: Access port information. Required only when using **CNAME access**.

ProtocolPorts.HTTP.description_cn: HTTP 协议支持的端口列表，用于指定 WAF 实例在 CNAME 接入方式下监听的 HTTP 协议端口。
ProtocolPorts.HTTP.description_en: List of supported HTTP protocol ports, used to specify the HTTP protocol ports that the WAF instance listens on when using CNAME access.

ProtocolPorts.HTTPS.description_cn: HTTPS 协议支持的端口列表，用于指定 WAF 实例在 CNAME 接入方式下监听的 HTTPS 协议端口。
ProtocolPorts.HTTPS.description_en: List of supported HTTPS protocol ports, used to specify the HTTPS protocol ports that the WAF instance listens on when using CNAME access.

Protocols.description_en:
Access protocol type. Only required when using **CNAME access**. Supports single or multiple selections.

* HTTP
* HTTPS

* When `EnableHTTP2=1`, you must select `HTTPS`.
* When `ProtocolFollow=1`, you must select both `HTTP` and `HTTPS`.

ProxyConfig.description_en:
Enable proxy configuration. Default is `0` (disabled). Supported values:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

ProxyConnectTimeOut.description_en: Connection timeout between WAF and backend server. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 4-120 seconds, default is 4 seconds.

ProxyKeepAlive.description_en: Number of reusable WAF origin keep-alive connections. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 60–1000 connections; default is 100.

ProxyKeepAliveTimeOut.description_en: Idle keep-alive timeout. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 1-60 seconds; default is 15 seconds.

ProxyReadTimeOut.description_en: Timeout for WAF to read responses from the backend server. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 0-900 seconds, default is 60 seconds.

ProxyRetry.description_en: WAF origin retry count. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 1-10 times; default is 3 times.

ProxyWriteTimeOut.description_en: WAF request forwarding timeout to backend server. Only required for **CNAME access**. Supports 30-3600 seconds; default is 60 seconds.

PublicRealServer.description_cn: cname接入生效 0: 私网回源 1: 公网回源
PublicRealServer.description_en:
CNAME origin access method. **Only required for CNAME access**. Currently supports:

* 1: Public network origin pull

RedirectHTTPS.description_cn: 在仅开启https协议时，可是否做强制跳转; 默认值均为true
RedirectHTTPS.description_en: When only HTTPS is enabled, you can choose whether to enforce forced redirection; the default value for all settings is true

Region.description_en:

* cn-beijing: North China 2 (Beijing)
* cn-shanghai: East China 2 (Shanghai)
* cn-guangzhou: South China 1 (Guangzhou)
* ap-southeast-1: Asia Pacific Southeast (Johor)

SSLCiphers.description_en:
SSL cipher suite list. Used to specify the encryption algorithm combinations supported by the HTTPS protocol. Required only for **CNAME access** and when the **protocol type includes HTTPS**.
Different TLS protocol versions support different cipher suites. Each selected TLS protocol version must have at least one corresponding cipher suite. The mapping is as follows:

* TLSv1
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
* TLSv1.1
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
* TLSv1.2
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA
   * AES128-SHA
   * AES256-SHA
   * DES-CBC3-SHA
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-SHA256
   * ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-SHA384
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256
   * ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384
   * AES128-GCM-SHA256
   * AES256-GCM-SHA384
   * AES128-SHA256
   * AES256-SHA256
* TLSv1.3
   * TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
   * TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_128_CCM_SHA256
   * TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256

SSLProtocols.description_en:
TLS protocol version. Only required for **CNAME access** and when **protocol type includes HTTPS**. All versions are selected by default. Supported versions:

* TLSv1
* TLSv1.1
* TLSv1.2
* TLSv1.3

* Selecting only `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.2` is not supported
* The following combinations are supported:
   * `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.1`
   * `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.1`
   * `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.1`, and `TLSv1.2`

TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.description_cn: 用于配置 TLS 日志中 HTTP 头部字段的采集行为。

TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.Enable.description_cn:
是否在日志中包含 HTTP 头部字段，默认为 `0`（不包含）。支持的取值如下所示。

* `0`：关闭，仅记录常见头部字段；
* `1`：开启，记录全量头部字段，并可配置例外字段和统计字段。

*`ExcludedKeyList` 排除不记录的字段，通过 `StatisticalKeyList`配置用于统计分析的字段。
TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.Enable.description_en:
Whether to include HTTP header fields in logs. The default is `0` (do not include). Supported values are as follows:

* `0`: Off, only common header fields are logged
* `1`: On, all header fields are logged, with options to configure excluded fields and statistical fields

*`ExcludedKeyList` specifies fields to exclude from logging. Use `StatisticalKeyList` to configure fields for statistical analysis.

TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.ExcludedKey.description_cn:
* 例外 HTTP 头部字段列表，用于指定在记录全量 header 时排除不记录的字段。当 `HeadersConfig.Enable` 为 `1`时生效。
* 配置后，对应字段将不会出现在日志的 JSON 数据中，可帮助节约日志存储空间。
TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.ExcludedKey.description_en:
* List of excluded HTTP header fields, used to specify fields to exclude when logging all headers. Takes effect when `HeadersConfig.Enable` is set to `1`.
* After configuration, these fields will not appear in the log's JSON data, helping to save log storage space.

TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.Statistical.description_cn:
* 用于日志统计分析和告警的 HTTP 头部字段列表，当 `HeadersConfig.Enable` 为 `1`时生效。
* 配置后，对应字段将用于日志统计分析和告警。
TLSFieldConfig.HeadersConfig.Statistical.description_en:
* List of HTTP header fields for log statistics and alerts. Takes effect when `HeadersConfig.Enable` is set to `1`.
* After configuration, these fields will be used for log statistics and alerts.

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.HttpObj.description_en:
Matching Objects
Fixed objects are automatically generated as HttpObj by ObjType; only custom objects require specifying a Key in HttpObj.
All modules using frontend advanced condition components support the following fixed objects:
- request.schema: Request protocol
- request.uri: Request URI
- request.method: Request method
- request.path: Request path
- request.queryargs: Request parameters
- request.header: Request header
- request.header.ua: Request User-Agent
- request.header.refer: Request Referer
- request.header.cookie: Request Cookie header
- request.header.content-length: Request body length
- request.header.content-type: Request body format
- request.header.x-forwarded-for: X-Forwarded-For
- request.header.clientip: Client IP
Fixed objects controlled by capability switches:
- request.ja3-hash: JA3 Hash; BP CDN regions are supported, others are not
- request.session-id: Session ID; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
- request.fp: Browser fingerprint; available only for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true; latest VOLC waf_available supports all regions, BP waf_available supports no regions
Objects not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components:
- response.header/response.body/response.code/response.header.content-type/response.header.{Key}/response.body.{Key}: Not currently displayed in frontend advanced condition components, considered unsupported by frontend standards
- country/request.ja3: Not available in any frontend external modules
Custom object formats supported by all modules using frontend advanced condition components:
- request.queryargs.{Key}: Custom request parameter, Key is required
- request.header.{Key}: Custom request header, Key is required; frontend requires header words to start with a capital letter
- request.cookie.{Key}: Custom Cookie, Key is required
Note:
- When ObjType=13/14/15, you cannot directly pass request.queryargs./request.header./request.cookie.; a specific Key must be included

AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_cn:
匹配操作符枚举.
基础操作符:
- 0: 大于
- 1: 大于等于
- 2: 等于
- 3: 小于
- 4: 小于等于
- 5: 不等于
- 6: 包含子串
- 7: 不包含子串
- 8: 包含前缀
- 9: 不包含前缀
- 10: 包含后缀
- 11: 不包含后缀
- 12: 包含所有匹配集合
- 13: 不包含所有匹配集合
- 14: 属于匹配集合
- 15: 不属于匹配集合
- 16: 正则匹配
IP 识别类操作符,仅用于 request.header.clientip 和自定义对象;使用时 Property 固定为 5,ValueString 无需填写:
- 17: 判断为 IP
- 18: 判断为 IPv4
- 19: 判断为 IPv6
- 20: 判断为私网 IP
- 21: 判断为公网 IP
扩展操作符:
- 22: max,保留值;VOLC 和 BP valid_check 均不支持,所有前端对外模块均不可用
- 23: 包含地址组,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 24: 排除地址组,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 25: 包含地理位置,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 26: 排除地理位置,仅 request.header.clientip 可用
- 27: 包含 IP 情报,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单在 TIIPTagAvailable=true 时可用;最新 BP waf_available 仅 byteplus-global 可用,VOLC waf_available 无可用地域
- 28: AS 号码属于,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单/批量控制白名单在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC 和 BP waf_available 均全地域可用
- 29: AS 号码不属于,仅 request.header.clientip 可用;仅 CC V3/Bot 自定义/Bot 分析/批量控制黑名单/批量控制白名单在 SupportASNModuleAvailable=true 时可用;最新 VOLC 和 BP waf_available 均全地域可用
按 ObjType 过滤可选操作符:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: 可用 2~16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: 可用 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: 可用 0~5

- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN 地域已支持,其余未支持;可用 2/5/14/15;14/15 最多填写 10 个值且不能重复
AccurateGroup.AccurateRules.Opretar.description_en:
Matching operator enumeration
Basic operators:
- 0: Greater than
- 1: Greater than or equal to
- 2: Equal to
- 3: Less than
- 4: Less than or equal to
- 5: Not equal to
- 6: Contains substring
- 7: Does not contain substring
- 8: Contains prefix
- 9: Does not contain prefix
- 10: Contains suffix
- 11: Does not contain suffix
- 12: Contains all in match set
- 13: Does not contain all in match set
- 14: Belongs to match set
- 15: Does not belong to match set
- 16: Regex match
IP recognition operators, only for request.header.clientip and custom objects; when used, Property is fixed at 5, ValueString does not need to be specified:
- 17: Is IP
- 18: Is IPv4
- 19: Is IPv6
- 20: Is private IP
- 21: Is public IP
Extended operators:
- 22: max, reserved value; not supported by VOLC and BP valid_check, not available for any external frontend modules
- 23: Contains address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 24: Excludes address group, only available for request.header.clientip
- 25: Contains geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 26: Excludes geolocation, only available for request.header.clientip
- 27: Contains IP intelligence, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control when TIIPTagAvailable=true; latest BP waf_available is only available for byteplus-global, VOLC waf_available has no available regions
- 28: AS number belongs to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
- 29: AS number does not belong to, only available for request.header.clientip; available only for CC V3/Bot Custom/Bot Analysis/Batch Denylist Control/Batch Allowlist Control when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true; latest VOLC and BP waf_available are available in all regions
Available operators by ObjType:
- request.uri/request.path/request.queryargs/request.header/request.header.ua/request.header.refer/request.header.cookie/request.header.x-forwarded-for: available operators: 2–16
- request.schema/request.method/request.header.content-type: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16
- request.header.content-length: available operators: 0–5
- request.header.clientip: available operators: 2/5/14/15/16/17–21/23–26; 27 can only be used when TIIPTagAvailable=true and the region is available; 28/29 can only be used when SupportASNModuleAvailable=true and the region is available
- request.queryargs.{Key}/request.header.{Key}/request.cookie.{Key}: available operators: 0–21
- request.ja3-hash: BP CDN regions are supported, others are not; available operators: 2/5/14/15; for 14/15, up to 10 values can be entered and must be unique
